notes.title: NARAKA: BLADEPOINT Update – September 17th, 2025
notes.content:
[p]Dear players,[/p][p]The servers of NARAKA: BLADEPOINT will be suspended for maintenance from Sep. 16th, 2025 23:00 (UTC) to Sep. 17th, 2025 04:00 (UTC). We suggest you log out in advance and enter the game again after the maintenance.[/p][p]The details for this update are as follows:[/p][p] [/p][h1][b]Brand New Content[/b][/h1][p][/p][p]I. Showdown Season 4.0: Rimeflame[/p][p]1. New Hero - Akos Hu[/p][p]Akos Hu has joined Showdown! He arrives with an all-new skill and ultimate, unlike those in the Survival modes![/p][p]One tiger's roar resounds in the mountain. All evil spirits tremble in fear.[/p][p]2. New Boss and New Chapter[/p][p]A thousand years ago, she spread the knowledge of fire and religion to mortals. That brought her divine punishment.[/p][p]Now, atop Yushan's peak, she lays an array of ice and fire to seek redemption. The Herald elder, Agnivat, is finally here.[/p][p]3. Comprehensive Potential System Upgrade[/p][p]The Potential system gets a complete overhaul with elemental type selection, expanded tree branches, returning effects, and the all-new "Potential Radial Menu" and "Prowess" system. Explore countless new build possibilities![/p][p]4. Nirriti's Ruins and Yama's Abyss Reset[/p][p]Yama's Abyss, Nirriti's Ruins, and season challenge progress and rewards have been reset.[/p][p]Take on Yama's Abyss and Nirriti's Ruins this season for Splendor Treasure Choice Gift, Showdown Seal, limited-edition avatars, and much more![/p][p]5. Upgraded Some \[Flux Jade] Rewards to \[Legend Jade][/p][p]\[Legend Jade] can change a specific Attribute of Showdown Souljade into a random rare Attribute. If the attribute is already rare, the attribute can be changed into a specific Attribute.[/p][p]All \[Flux Jade] in Season Challenges, Yama's Abyss, and Showdown Pass now upgraded to \[Legend Jade].[/p][p]6. New Gameplay[/p][p]Brand-new \[Demonbane Mark] system: use dodges and Defuse abilities to build your Defuse slot, applying Ice, Thunder, and Poison \[Demonbane Marks] to monsters for different effects.[/p][p]Added counter mechanics and Deadeye Martial Skills for Swarm and Pistol.[/p][p]7. Season Journey Quests[/p][p]Season Journey Quests have been updated. After completing the beginner's Journey Quests, participate in Showdown to automatically unlock the Journey Quest of the current season.[/p][p]Within the limited event period after the season begins, complete any Showdown stage daily to claim daily rewards. Complete 7 days of quests to receive generous Journey rewards: powerful Souljade sets and precious Showdown resources—Flux Jade Shards.[/p][p]8. Season Settlements[/p][p]Windstorm Season will end on Sep. 17th, 2025 00:00 (UTC)[/p][p](1) Season Rewards:[/p][table equalcells="1" colwidth=","][tr][td][p]Rank Requirement[/p][/td][td][p]Rewards[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p]<Showdown Bronze>[/p][/td][td][p]Avatar \[Windstorm·Showdown Bronze][/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p]<Showdown Silver>[/p][/td][td][p]Avatar \[Windstorm·Showdown Silver][/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p]<Showdown Gold>[/p][/td][td][p]Avatar \[Windstorm·Showdown Gold][/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p]<Showdown Platinum>[/p][/td][td][p]Avatar \[Windstorm·Showdown Platinum][/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p]<Showdown Solar>[/p][/td][td][p]Avatar \[Windstorm·Showdown Solar], \[Splendor Treasure Choice Gift]*2, \[Showdown Seal]*5[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p]<Showdown Empyrean>[/p][/td][td][p]Avatar \[Windstorm·Showdown Empyrean], \[Splendor Treasure Choice Gift]*3, \[Showdown Seal]*10, Hero Badge \[Windstorm·Showdown Empyrean][/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p]<Showdown Astral>[/p][/td][td][p]Avatar \[Windstorm·Showdown Astral], \[Splendor Treasure Choice Gift]*5, \[Showdown Seal]*15, Hero Badge \[Windstorm·Showdown Astral][/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p]<Showdown Paragon>[/p][/td][td][p]Avatar \[Windstorm·Showdown Paragon], \[Splendor Treasure Choice Gift]*10, \[Showdown Seal]*20, Hero Badge \[Windstorm·Showdown Paragon][/p][/td][/tr][/table][p](2) Showdown Leaderboard Rewards:[/p][p]Receive Avatar rewards based on your highest Yama's Abyss Showdown leaderboard ranking in Windstorm Season (weekly and season settlements). Additionally, the top 3 players of any Yama's Abyss hero leaderboard at the end of the season will receive unique Hero Badges.  [/p][p] [/p][p]II. Blessed Brutality Available (Limited-time)[/p][p]Blessed Brutality mode gets the following updates, available from Sep. 17th, 2025 Update to Oct. 10th, 2025 at 00:00 (UTC)[/p][p]1. New Souljade Anima Rings and Anima Rings with general effects;[/p][p]2. Boss battle: defeat bosses faster within time limits for better rewards;[/p][p]3. Now starts with 3 free Anima Ring refreshes; subsequent refreshes cost 500 Dark Tide Coins each;[/p][p]4. Divine Thunder strikes no longer interrupt Golden Focus and Purple Focus moves;[/p][p]5. Improved visual feedback for some Anima Ring and blessing effects;[/p][p]6. Blessed Brutality mode is now available in custom rooms.[/p][p] [/p][p]III. New Rift Traversal Content[/p][p]1. New Limited-time Mode - Mirror Realm[/p][p]Mode Overview: Test high-quality loadouts of your design or system presets at no cost or risk. You don't have to worry about losing or damaging your personal assets.[/p][p]Loot cannot be extracted from this mode. Based on match performance and your loot, you will receive \[Delusion Mirror] to exchange for Extreme equipment, Extreme Keys, Jade Disks, Splendor Treasure Choice Gift, and more rewards.[/p][p]Available: Sep. 17th, 2025 to Oct. 8th, 2025, 08:00 - 17:00 (UTC) Every day[/p][p] [/p][p]2. Gameplay[/p][p]① Each match begins with one of the following random global effects:[/p][p]Fury: Increases Rage recovery rate for this match.[/p][p]Agility: Search Speed in this match is increased.[/p][p]Demonic Break: Damage to monsters in this match is increased.[/p][p]Dustfall: The Sandstorm will occur early in this match.[/p][p]② Escape Locations have been repositioned specifically for this mode[/p][p]
3. Weekly Bounties
(1) Complete weekly Contract Quests to earn points. Reach corresponding progress thresholds to claim rich Weekly Activeness rewards, with Master Key Choice Gift as the top prize!
(2) Master Keys can open multiple Treasure Rooms. If this Key and a normal Key are both equipped, the normal Key's durability will be consumed first.
(3) Contract Quests and Weekly Activeness progress reset every Thursday at 00:00 (UTC).[/p][p] [/p][p]IV. Limited-time Event:[/p][p]1. Reversal Flows[/p][p]Everything here is the complete opposite of what Inor Wan remembers...[/p][p]Event Duration: Sep. 17th, 2025 Update - Oct. 8th, 2025 20:00 (UTC)[/p][p]Claim Rewards Before: Oct. 12th, 2025 20:00 (UTC)[/p][p]Event Rules:[/p][p]1. Players can obtain Dice and Wild Dice by completing event quests. These can be used on the event map to assist Inor Wan in adventures and collect rewards.[/p][p]2. When Inor Wan moves to specific spaces, it will trigger a "Fortuitous Meeting". Different options will lead to different results.[/p][p]3. When Inor Wan triggers specific Companion Events during adventures, the corresponding character stories will be unlocked.[/p][p]4. After Inor Wan completes explorations of Yushan Ruins, City of Tang, and Plumed Castle, Cyclic Adventures will begin at Salvation Podium. After claiming treasure chest rewards at the destination, the map will restart for a new round of adventure.[/p][p] [/p][p]2. Moonlit Reunion[/p][p]The Moon Rabbit pounds frost into honeyed tablets as all on Earth share the joy of this full moon night.[/p][p]Event Duration: Sep. 23rd, 2025 20:00 (UTC) - Oct. 8th, 2025 20:00 (UTC)[/p][p]Claim Rewards Before: Oct. 12th, 2025 20:00 (UTC)[/p][p]Event Rules:[/p][p]1. During the event, earn Reunion Cakes by accessing the event every week. You can also earn Reunion Cakes by opening Stashes in the Survival modes, searching supplies in Rift Traversal, and playing Showdown or Casual Mode (excluding Bloodsport). Up to 200 Reunion Cakes can be earned from matches per week, resetting every Wednesday at 20:00 (UTC).[/p][p]2. Players can spend 5 Reunion Cakes to feed the Moon Rabbit and grind herbs once. Different Medicine combinations grant different rewards.[/p][p]3. Players can spend 25 Reunion Cakes to grind 5 times and receive 5 rewards.[/p][p]4. Gaining 3 Gold Medicines at once will earn you the grand prize. Each grind increases the chance of the next grind yielding 3 Gold Medicines. Winning the grand prize will reset this chance.[/p][p] [/p][p]3. Peerless Radiance[/p][p]This peerless radiance is proof of my unrivaled strength.[/p][p]Event Duration: Sep. 16th, 2025 20:00 (UTC) - Oct. 9th, 2025 20:00 (UTC)[/p][p]Event Rules:[/p][p]This peerless radiance is proof of my unrivaled strength. You can gather the exclusive champion collection from the 2024 NARAKA: BLADEPOINT J Cup (Trios and Solo) to earn the champion team's avatars, signed cosmetics, and other rewards.[/p][p] [/p][p]4. Moonlit Gold[/p][p]Amid the silvery moonlight and fragrant osmanthus, the hero returns home with joy.[/p][p]Event Duration: Sep. 24th, 2025 20:00 (UTC) - Oct. 22nd, 2025 20:00 (UTC)[/p][p]Event Rules:[/p][p]1. Players who sign in for a total of 8 days during the event will receive time-limited Gold*1800, Fission Treasure*2, limited-edition avatar, limited-edition base, Splendor Treasure Choice Gift*5, Cosmetics 50% Discount Voucher, Imprint Roller*120, and other event rewards.[/p][p]2. Limited-time Gold can be used together with regular Gold, but cannot be used in the following ways: In-game gifting, reviving in Showdown mode, purchasing Cleanse Stones in Nirriti's Ruins mode, purchasing Scented Sachets, Drum of War, Kites, or Fireworks in the Shop; Limited-time Gold will expire on Oct 23, 2025 at 00:00 (UTC). Please use promptly.[/p][p]5. Soul of Ice and Fire
Where disaster finally ends, yin and yang thrive together.
Event Duration: Sep. 17th, 2025 Update - Sep. 30th, 2025 20:00 (UTC)
Claim Rewards Before: Oct. 7th, 2025 20:00 (UTC)
Event Rules:
1. Gain Frostflame Tokens by completing quests during the event. Frostflame Tokens can be redeemed for rare rewards.
2. Complete all daily quests for the day to claim an extra special reward.
3. There are 5 groups of Challenge Quests, each available in turn at different times. Complete them to claim generous rewards. 
4. Rewards may only be redeemed up until Oct 7, 2025 at 20:00 (UTC), please redeem the rewards in time![/p][p] [/p][p]6. Mirror Realm Clash[/p][p]Enter the realm where reality meets illusion.[/p][p]Event Duration: Sep. 17th, 2025 Update - Oct. 8th, 2025 20:00 (UTC)[/p][p]Claim Rewards Before: Oct. 9th, 2025 20:00 (UTC)[/p][p]Event Rules:[/p][p]1. Earn Delusion Mirrors by completing quests during the event.[/p][p]2. Participate in Rift Traversal - Mirror Realm to earn Delusion Mirrors based on your performance.
Available daily at 08:00 - 17:00 (UTC).[/p][p]3. The rewards are redeemable till Oct. 9th, 2025 at 20:00 (UTC). Please redeem the rewards in time.[/p][p] [/p][p]7. Yi-ternal Love[/p][p]Event Duration: Sep. 25th, 2025 04:00 (UTC) - Oct. 8th, 2025 20:00 (UTC)[/p][p]Claim Rewards Before: Oct. 9th, 2025 23:00 (UTC)[/p][p]Event Rules:[/p][p]1. Complete daily quests to earn Star Discs. Consume Star Discs to cheer, which grants Cheer Points and unlocks rewards.[/p][p]2. Each cheer grants a Silver Mic Random Gift.[/p][p] [/p][p]V. New Souljades[/p][p]1. Polesword Legendary Souljade \[Thunder Portal]
Enhance Vertical attacks after a Battle Stride or a Vertical Charged Attack, during which you can use a Vertical attack evade enemy attacks and continue to attack.[/p][p]2. Fan Legendary Souljade \[Unseen Current]
Enhance Vertical Strikes made after a Quick Dash.[/p][p][/p][h1][b]Hero Adjustments[/b][/h1][p][/p][p]I. Lannie[/p][p]The following adjustments have been made to Ultimate \[Tricky Bounce: Leap]:[/p][p]1. Reduced airborne height dealt to enemies when activating Ultimate on the ground.[/p][p]2. In Solo mode, Health restored when Trick Balls return or are successfully caught reduced from 150 to 50; Duos and Trios unchanged.[/p][p] [/p][p]II. Kylin Zhang[/p][p]Optimized skill \[Raider's Touch: Choke]:[/p][p]1. Enemies controlled by Choke are no longer interrupted by White Focus move attacks;[/p][p]2. While Ultimate is active, hitting enemies below Golden Focus triggers special execution;[/p][p]Adjusted Ultimate \[Qilin Slash: Rend]:[/p][p]1. Reduced charged slash dash speed with the same slash distance;[/p][p]2. Charged slashes can be blocked by enemy counter, but after successful blocks, the enemy cannot trigger counterstrikes, and Kylin Zhang recovers 150 Health. (Includes charged slashes that did not consume Health.)[/p][p]3. Increased the damage multiplier of charged slashes from 2.8 to 3.0.[/p][p]Optimized Ultimates \[Qilin Slash] and \[Qilin Slash: Rend]:[/p][p]1. When Qilin Guard triggers while being hit or controlled, blast will be produced to knock enemies back;[/p][p]2. Added indicator effects for normal and charged slash releases. Improved the visual clarity of indicator effects for successful charges;[/p][p]//Dev Notes: The charged slash dash speed of Kylin Zhang's \[Qilin Slash: Rend] was too fast without startup frames indicators. This made it impossible for opponents to predict slash trajectories and led to poor counterplay experience. We've reduced the slash speed and made it blockable with counter while improving Kylin Zhang's attack indicators. This would help opponents observe his attack more clearly for better counterplay.[/p][p]Since Kylin Zhang's charged slashes can now be blocked by counter, his survivability is reduced. Therefore, we've adjusted his Qilin Guard mechanism to allow counterattacks when Qilin Guard triggers. A compensation for the move performance adjustments.[/p][p] [/p][h1][b]In-Game Adjustments[/b][/h1][p][/p][p]I. In-Game Adjustments[/p][p]1. Realm of Yang now displays hero avatars of both participants for easier team composition recognition.[/p][p]2. In Immortal War mode, teams with the highest team eliminations will see "Highest Team Elimination" displayed at the top of their bag interface.[/p][p]3. Gaining power of beasts no longer removes Yang Depletion, but capturing Sacred Beast Spirit Well resets remaining Yang Depletion time for Yang-depleted teams.[/p][p]4. When Vermillion Bird's Might wielders die, they no longer drop "Soulbloom Essence" but instead drop "Vermillion Bird Essence," which provides more Rage accumulation than "Soulbloom Essence." However, it cannot remove Yang Depletion; instead, it resets the remaining Yang Depletion time.[/p][p]5. Adjusted the number of Champion Fight Match Solo participants from 32 to 16.[/p][p] [/p][p]II. Feature Optimizations[/p][p]1. Counterstrike Combos no longer auto-aim at stage mechanisms or summons.[/p][p]2. The Smart Swap function has been changed from disabled by default to enabled by default. It can be manually turned off in Settings > Assist > General.[/p][p][/p][h1][b]Out-of-Game Adjustments[/b][/h1][p][/p][p]I. Chat Channel Optimizations[/p][p]When you return from match to lobby, you will auto-select your previously chosen chat channel.[/p][p] [/p][p]II. Team Display Adjustments[/p][p]Currently, only players on the Immortal War leaderboard may display their Immortal War rank level and ranking in team displays.[/p][p] [/p][p]III. Personal Tags[/p][p]Added \[Rift Traversal] to personal tags.[/p][p] [/p][p]IV. Shop Category Updates[/p][p][/p][h1][b]The Item Store, Gift Store and Spectral Silk Store are now integrated under the Daily Store tab.[/b][/h1][p][/p][h1][b]Rift Traversal Adjustments[/b][/h1][p][/p][p]I. New Rift Traversal Equipment[/p][p]1. Repeating Crossbow for Rift Traversal.[/p][p]New Celestia Repeating Crossbow: Broken Edge[/p][p]· Arcane: Disarm Bolt[/p][p]You cannot continuously fire bolts, but bolts can clash with melee Common Attacks, consuming 5 Durability from the melee weapon. If the melee weapon has 0 Durability, you can trigger a Counter against its Blue Focus Strike.[/p][p]New Legendary, Extreme Repeating Crossbow: Repeating Crossbow·Hunt[/p][p]· Extreme: Manhunt[/p][p]Reduces bolt flight speed, but bolts will auto-track enemies within a certain range[/p][p]Repeating Crossbow Rubric:[/p][p]· Venom Tip & Barbed Bolts: The Repeating Crossbow deals less damage. Landing a shot on an enemy with your Repeating Crossbow leaves them unable to sprint for 1 sec. Bolts are poisonous and can deal damage over time upon hitting the enemy; poison effects stack up to 15 levels at most[/p][p] [/p][p]II. Hero Adjustments[/p][p]1. Adjusted Viper Ning's skill \[Yushan Strike] silence effect from 8 sec to 4 sec.[/p][p]2. Adjusted the damage reduction during the activation of Viper Ning's Ultimate \[Moonbane Control: Unchained] to herself from 10% to 20%.[/p][p] [/p][p]III. In-Game Adjustments
1. In Tranquil Path, simply activate Rift Gate Tuner I to open a Rift Gate. Meanwhile, enemy escape cooldown restrictions have been removed.[/p][p] [/p][h1][b]Showdown Adjustments[/b][/h1][p][/p][p]I. Combat Adjustments[/p][p]1. New effect for \[Bow·Cloudpiercer] and \[Musket·Cloudpiercer]: Deadeye improves dodge performance during combat.[/p][p]2. Increased the base damage multiplier of the Souljade \[Thunder Counter] from 0.5 to 0.55 when equipped[/p][p]3. Introduced the new Souljade \[Tempest Kick·Element][/p][p]4. The Health increased by Souljade \[Copper Ward] has been reduced from 60% to 40%.[/p][p]II. Hero Adjustments[/p][p]1. Reduced the multipliers of Justina Gu's Ultimate \[Arctic Wraith: Showdown] strike affected by ice blast damage bonus by 30%, and increased those unaffected by 40%.[/p][p] [/p][p]III. Feature Adjustments[/p][p]1. Vinemire Gone Wild Event Concluded[/p][p]2. Tempered Inferno and Curio Temporarily Closed[/p][p]Tempered Inferno and Curio modes are temporarily closed. Stay tuned for updates in the new season.[/p][p]Curio materials of Windstorm Season will be cleared when the new Tempered Inferno returns. Please use them in time.[/p][p]3. New Trial Hero[/p][p]Updated Trial Heroes - Recommended Heroes to include Akos Hu.[/p][p]4. Specialized Practice Update[/p][p]1. Akos Hu has been added to Specialized Practice.[/p][p][/p][h1][b]Store Updates[/b][/h1][p] [/p][p]I. New Shop System: Exaltation[/p][p] [/p][p]1. Purchasing the basic cosmetic from a Exaltation Set will unlock the corresponding Exaltation System. When unlocking the basic cosmetic, you will additionally receive a random cosmetic from the set that normally requires Glazed Crystals to unlock.[/p][p] [/p][p]2. Some Appearances in the Exaltation Set can be unlocked and upgraded using Glazed Crystals. Consuming Glazed Crystals accumulates Exaltation Progress, and rewards on the progress track are unlocked as upgrade progress advances.[/p][p] [/p][p]After unlocking \[LUOTIANYI·Starry Sky], players can get an exclusive upgraded version of the cosmetic by using the \[Exalt] mechanism.[/p][p] [/p][p]3. Players can use Glazed Crystals to purchase the following cosmetics:[/p][p]Outfit \[LUOTIANYI·Startrack][/p][p]Hairstyles \[LUOTIANYI·Projection], \[LUOTIANYI·Age of Luo][/p][p]Accessories \[LUOTIANYI·Data Headphones], \[LUOTIANYI·Wings of Resonance][/p][p]Skill Cosmetic Accessory \[LUOTIANYI·Starlight][/p][p]Ultimate Cosmetic Accessory \[Tian Dian·Charging][/p][p]Background \[Glistening Music][/p][p]Base \[Astral Stage][/p][p] [/p][p]4. As players consume Glazed Crystals, they can acquire the following cosmetics:[/p][p]Kill Announcement \[LUOTIANYI·Heavenly Voice][/p][p]Pose \[Pop Song][/p][p]Accessory \[LUOTIANYI·Interstellar Earphone][/p][p]Voice Pack \[Kurumi·LUOTIANYI Chinese Voice Pack][/p][p]Skill Cosmetic Accessory \[LUOTIANYI·Radiant Glaze][/p][p]Ultimate Cosmetic Accessory \[Tian Dian·Shining Stage][/p][p]Avatar Frame \[LUOTIANYI·Melody Wings][/p][p] [/p][p]II. New Packs[/p][p]1. Added Kurumi exclusive Pack \[Starry Sky (Kurumi)], which contains the Legendary Outfit \[LUOTIANYI·Starry Sky] and Polesword Legendary Skin \[Starlit Moon]. Standard price: 3,300 Gold; Now: 600 Gold. Individual cosmetics have their own discounts, but the Pack discount is even bigger![/p][p]2. Newly added Dual Blades Pack \[Silent Blade Pack (All)], which contains the Dual Blades Legendary Skin \[The Breaker·Silent Blade] and the Epic Kill Announcement \[The Breaker·Peerless]. Standard price: 1,800 Gold; Now: 1,200 Gold. Individual cosmetics have their own discounts, but the Pack discount is even bigger![/p][p]3. Added Viper Ning exclusive Pack \[Rosefire Pack], including Legendary Outfit \[Sublime·Rosefire], Legendary Hairstyle \[Sublime·Fiery], Legendary Accessory \[Sublime·Royal Crown]. Standard price: 3,800 Gold; Now: 2,500 Gold. Individual cosmetics have their own discounts, but the Pack discount is even bigger![/p][p]4. Newly added Tessa exclusive Pack \[Wonders in Dreams Pack], including Legendary Outfit \[Sublime·Wonders in Dreams], Legendary Hairstyle \[Sublime·Innocence], Legendary Accessory \[Sublime·Blue Butterfly]. Standard price: 3,800 Gold; Now: 2,500 Gold. Single items are discounted, and you get even more discounts when you purchase a Pack.[/p][p]5. Newly added Wuchen exclusive Pack \[Feast of Absurdity Pack], including Legendary Outfit \[Sublime·Feast of Absurdity], Legendary Hairstyle \[Sublime·Eminence], Legendary Accessory \[Sublime·Top Hat]. Standard price: 3,800 Gold; Now: 2,500 Gold. Single items are discounted, and you get even more discounts when you purchase a Pack.[/p][p] [/p][p]III. New Discounts[/p][p]1. Newly added Grappling Hook Legendary Accessory \[Mr. Rabbit]. Standard price: 4,200 Gold; Now: 3,000 Gold.[/p][p]2. Newly added Legendary Bubble \[Bobble Head]. Standard price: 600 Gold; Now: 120 Gold.[/p][p]3. Newly added Viper Ning Legendary Pose \[Sublime·Gift]. Standard price: 800 Gold; Now: 600 Gold.[/p][p]4. Newly added Tessa Legendary Pose \[Sublime·Coquetry]. Standard price: 800 Gold; Now: 600 Gold.[/p][p]5. Newly added Wuchen Legendary Pose \[Sublime·Vow]. Standard price: 800 Gold; Now: 600 Gold.[/p][p]6. Newly added Legendary Stash Skin \[Sublime·Chess]. Standard price: 800 Gold; Now: 300 Gold.[/p][p]7. Newly added Legendary Background \[The Breaker·Dark Tide] for all heroes. Standard price: 600 Gold; Now: 400 Gold.[/p][p]8. Newly added Legendary Base \[The Breaker·Sea God] for all heroes. Standard price: 1,200 Gold; Now: 800 Gold.[/p][p] [/p][p]IV. New Items in Spectral Silk Store[/p][p]Newly added Viper Ning Legendary Accessory \[Sublime·Magnificent Jewels] with a price of 12,000 Spectral Silk.[/p][p] [/p][h1][b]Feature Adjustments[/b][/h1][p][/p][p]Added the option to switch between multiple displays in Graphics Settings.[/p][p][/p][h1][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/h1][p][/p][p]I. Hero-related Bugs[/p][p]1. Fixed an issue where Inor Wan couldn't use skills while using Mole Hook in Rift Traversal.[/p][p]2. Fixed an issue where Kurumi's Ultimate \[Purified Circle: Showdown] occasionally displayed incorrect visual effects.[/p]

notes.title: NARAKA: BLADEPOINT Update – September 4th, 2025
notes.content:
[p]Dear players,[/p][p]The servers of NARAKA: BLADEPOINT will be suspended for maintenance from Sep. 3rd, 2025 23:00 (UTC) to Sep. 4th, 2025 04:00 (UTC). We suggest you log out in advance and enter the game again after the maintenance.[/p][p]The details for this update are as follows:[/p][p] [/p][p]Brand New Content[/p][p]I. Limited-Time Return: Golden Roc Escort![/p][p] [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36350327/ba3541c643bccfaa292fd869785f9a8e55d077b1.png"][/img][/p][p]1. Changed the battle map into Perdoria.[/p][p]2. The Golden Roc now travels along a single route, with the escort divided into two stages. Reaching a checkpoint extends match time and refreshes respawn points for both sides.[/p][p]3. Economic System Optimization: Added more purchasable items to Rift Dealers. Free Combat Items will appear 3 and 7 minutes after matches begin.[/p][p]4. Attackers gradually recover Health while within the Golden Roc escort range, and Defenders recover Health while inside the Border Seal.[/p][p] [/p][p]II. Limited-time Events:[/p][p]1. A New Chapter[/p][p]Play Match-3 and embark on a new chapter of life.[/p][p]Event Duration: Sep. 4th, 2025 Update - Sep. 24th, 2025 20:00 (UTC)[/p][p]Claim Rewards Before: Sep. 28, 2025 20:00 (UTC)[/p][p]Event Rules:[/p][p]1. During the event, visit the event page daily to obtain Stamina; each week, open stashes in the Survival modes, loot in Rift Traversal mode, or play matches of Showdown, Casual modes (except for Bloodsport) to obtain Stamina. The weekly cap for Stamina gained from matches is 140 and refreshes Wednesdays at 20:00 UTC (first refresh at 20:00 UTC on September 10, 2025).[/p][p]2. On the event page, tap Get Credits to play Credits Match-3: Tap to swap adjacent course tiles to align three or more identical ones in a row or column to clear them and gain corresponding Credits. Each clear consumes 1 Stamina.
Eliminating 4 or more identical courses in a single move automatically triggers a Weapon Skill; Eliminating 30 courses of the same type automatically activates the corresponding Hero Ultimate once.[/p][p]3. Accumulate certain amounts of Credits to claim the corresponding event rewards.[/p][p] [/p][p]II. New Season Preview of Showdown[/p][p]A new Showdown season update will release between Sep. 16th (Tuesday) 11:00 PM and Sep. 17th (Wednesday) 04:00 AM (UTC). Please note that this update will occur at a different time than usual. Below are the special rules for this season. We apologize for any inconvenience caused.[/p][p]① Fatigue, Weekly Quests, and Doom will refresh one day earlier (along with the season update). Please plan your time wisely![/p][p]② Doom Speedrun challenges will close after the server maintenance in the final week of the Windstorm Season. All rewards will still be issued during the regular settlement window.[/p][p]③ The standard rules apply for Yama's Abyss Leaderboard. After the season ends, you will be awarded a special avatar based on the highest title and ranking you achieved during the season, but no title rewards will be granted in the final week. Additionally, the top 3 players for each hero at settlement will receive an exclusive Hero Badge.[/p][p]Hero Adjustments[/p][p]I. Temulch[/p][p]1. \[Storm Prison] Adjustments:
Temulch recovers Stamina more quickly while in his Storm Prison. He can also ride the winds after a double jump, allowing him to charge a dash attack in mid-air.
Charged dash attacks can be countered.[/p][p]2. \[Storm Prison: Reload] Adjustment:
Temulch recovers Stamina more quickly while in his Storm Prison.[/p][p]3. Deleted the Skill \[Zephyr Wisp: Track].[/p][p]4. Deleted the Ultimate \[Storm Prison: Energetic].[/p][p]//Dev Note: Temulch's overall combat performance has remained solid, but his Talent choices have been relatively rigid. This update focuses on strengthening his underused Talents. When selecting the Ultimate \[Storm Prison], Temulch can now perform a mid-air dash attack while airborne within the storm prison.
Tap Release: Enables a follow-up combo attack after hitting the target.
Charged Release: Unleashes a Golden Focused weapon attack that knocks back enemies.[/p][p]Considering that enemy Stamina recovery is significantly slowed within the storm prison, making it difficult to counter Temulch's charged dash attack through dodging, this move is designed to be blockable by Countering. However, a successful Counter will not trigger a Counterstrike Combo.[/p][p] [/p][p]II. Shayol Wei[/p][p]1. When \[Black Tortoise Block] is triggered while using \[Justiciar's Guard: Pursuit], a counterattack is stored. Counterattacks no longer remove \[Black Tortoise Marks]. If no enemy is marked, Shayol will perform a quick forward slash instead.[/p][p]2. Adjusted the Defensive Focus of Shayol's Ultimate \[Justiciar's Guard: Pursuit]'s counterattack move from Golden Focus (Skill) to Golden Focus (Ultimate).[/p][p] [/p][p]III. Inor Wan[/p][p]1. Optimized how \[Thunder Mark] is displayed next to the crosshair while transformed into the Thunder Lord.[/p][p] [/p][p]In-Game Adjustments[/p][p] [/p][p]I. Team Up[/p][p]Team Up recruitment now supports tier-based rank filtering.[/p][p] [/p][p] [/p][p]Rift Traversal Adjustments[/p][p]I. Rift Traversal·Journey Begins[/p][p]You can unlock Rift Traversal Journey quests upon your first participation in the Rift Traversal mode. Within a certain timeframe, play one Rift Traversal match each day for seven days to claim a Rift Traveler Choice Gift, an Illusion Treasure Choice Gift, and other valuable rewards.[/p][p] [/p][p]II. New Loadouts Available in the Rift Traversal Mode[/p][p]Sweep away all before you, leaving naught but destruction and a faint breeze! The Fan is now a part of Rift Traversal![/p][p]New Celestia Fan: Underwater[/p][p]Arcane Effect: Cleansed Draco[/p][p]Each Quick Dash summons a wind orb that circles you (max 3). While charging, the orbs fire in sequence, tracking down enemies. Hit the same target twice in 4 sec to trigger a tornado, knocking non-Focused enemies airborne.[/p][p]New Legendary and Extreme Fan: Fan·Gust[/p][p]Extreme Effect: Wild Windspout·Swift[/p][p]Alters charged Vertical Strikes and the 3rd strike in a Vertical Strike combo.[/p][p]New Legendary and Extreme Fan: Fan·Demount[/p][p]Extreme Effect: Energy Demount·Extreme[/p][p]Energy Demount stuns opponents for 1.5 sec.[/p][p]Fan Rubrics[/p][p]Windy Trinity: Alters Fan's charged Horizontal Strikes.[/p][p]Soulshatter & Netherstep: Alters the Fan's Quick Dash Horizontal Strikes and Quick Dashes can be performed repeatedly, with Stamina cost massively reduced.[/p][p]Martial Art·Tai Chi Fan: Alters Fan's crouching and sliding Horizontal Strikes[/p][p] [/p][p]III. Increased Drop Rates for the Crossover-themed Collectibles
Following players' feedback, the drop rates for Shanghai Museum Crossover-themed Collectibles \[Camel and Sogdian Rider] and \[Famille-rose Bat and Peach Vase] have been increased in the Tranquil, Perilous, and Doomed Paths of the Rift Traversal mode.[/p][p] [/p][p]IV. In-Game Adjustments[/p][p]1. Added a looting restriction for Remains Bags. For 5 seconds after a bag appears, only the players who participated in the kill (including assists) can claim items from it.[/p][p]2. Added "Rebirth Sets": While spectating, fallen players can spend out-of-game Void Coins to change into a stronger Rebirth Set. The coins are deducted upon revival by a teammate. The Rebirth Set offers the same loadouts as the Battle Edict, with different levels corresponding to stages of different difficulties[/p][p] [/p][p]V. Item Adjustments[/p][p]1. Bag adjustments:[/p][p]Standard bags now have increased capacity. While carrying a standard bag, other players can now loot your Remains Bag as long as your remains persist.[/p][p]Added a new bag type: Treasure Bag. The bag protects your resources from other players while your remains persist but have a smaller capacity.[/p][p]Your Relic Bag's capacity is as follows:[/p][table equalcells="1" colwidth=",,,"][tr][td][p] [/p][/td][td][p] [/p][/td][td][p] [/p][/td][td][p] [/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p]Quality[/p][/td][td][p]Current Bag[/p][/td][td][p]After Update[/p][/td][td][p]Treasure Bag[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p]Common[/p][/td][td][p]14[/p][/td][td][p]15[/p][/td][td][p]13[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p]Rare[/p][/td][td][p]24[/p][/td][td][p]25[/p][/td][td][p]22[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p]Epic[/p][/td][td][p]34[/p][/td][td][p]35[/p][/td][td][p]31[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p]Legendary[/p][/td][td][p]40[/p][/td][td][p]42[/p][/td][td][p]37[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p]Extreme[/p][/td][td][p]52[/p][/td][td][p]54[/p][/td][td][p]48[/p][/td][/tr][/table][p] [/p][p] [/p][p] [/p][p]Showdown Adjustments[/p][p]I. Combat Adjustments[/p][p]1. Reduced Huanyue's stats in Tempered Inferno.[/p][p] [/p][p]Store Updates[/p][p]I. Yin Yang Pool·Reversal Flows now available![/p][p] [/p][p]1. Each time you open the Yin Yang Pool, you need to consume 1 \[Reversal Flows Ingot], priced at 400 Gold. After opening the Yin Yang Pool, you will have a chance to get 22 rewards such as Justina Gu's Legendary Outfit \[Reversal Flows·Mourning Frost], Shayol Wei's Legendary Outfit \[Reversal Flows·Noble Thief], Justina Gu's Legendary Emote Gesture \[Reversal Flows·Rime Throne], and Justina Gu's Legendary Pose \[Reversal Flows·Reflection].[/p][p]2. The first opening is free, and you'll receive different rewards each time. You can open up to 21 times to collect all the rewards in the prize pool.[/p][p]3. When obtaining a special reward, you can get these Justina Gu cosmetics: Legendary Emote Gesture \[Reversal Flows·Rime Throne], and Legendary Pose \[Reversal Flows·Reflection][/p][p]4. When opening the Yin Yang pool, there is a chance that you will unlock all remaining rewards at once. After all the rewards have been obtained, \[Reversal Flows Ingots] can be exchanged into Gold.[/p][p]5. Guarantee: Based on the above drop rate, players are guaranteed to receive at least one Gold (Legendary) reward within the first 4 draws. Another guaranteed Gold (Legendary) reward within 5 more draws, followed by the next guaranteed Gold (Legendary) reward within 7 more draws.[/p][p] [/p][p]II. New Discounts[/p][p]1. Lannie Epic Pose \[Drowsy]. Standard price: 300 Gold; Now: 200 Gold.[/p][p]2. Legendary Emote Gesture \[Twister] for all heroes. Standard price: 900 Gold; Now: 360 Gold.[/p][p]3. Grappling Hook Legendary Skin \[Flying Squirrel]. Standard price: 4,200 Gold; Now: 3,000 Gold.[/p][p]4. Epic Kill Announcement \[Leafstep Grace]. Standard price: 300 Gold; Now: 200 Gold.[/p][p] [/p][p]III. New Store Items[/p][p]1. Added the new store item "Surmount Card·Fission," which can be used to upgrade the Fission Hidden Treasure by 30 levels for only 1,800 Gold. Can only be purchased once.[/p][p]III. New Items in the Lunar Pavilion[/p][p]1. Newly added Kylin Zhang Legendary Outfit \[Shadowed Clouds] with a price of 360 Jade Disks.[/p][p]2. Newly added Kylin Zhang Legendary Hairstyle \[Crane Grace] with a price of 160 Jade Disks.[/p][p]3. Newly added Kylin Zhang Legendary Accessory \[Ethereal Curtain] with a price of 240 Jade Disks.[/p][p]4. Newly added Kylin Zhang Epic Base \[Roc Wings] with a price of 80 Jade Disks.[/p][p]5. Newly added Kylin Zhang Epic Background \[Clouded Peaks] with a price of 40 Jade Disks.[/p][p]6. Newly added Legendary Weapon Skins \[Flaming Ash·Scorching], \[Flaming Ash·Burning], \[Flaming Ash·Auger], each with a price of 720 Jade Disks.[/p][p]7. Wuchen Legendary Outfit \[Fengshen Chronicles·Shen Gongbao] and Valda Cui Legendary Outfit \[Anahita] return, each with a price of 360 Jade Disks.[/p][p] [/p][p]IV. The Degenerate-Drawing Jianghu Crossover ends[/p][p]Our crossover with the classic Chinese animated series "The Degenerate-Drawing Jianghu" is coming to an end, and all related cosmetics will be removed from the Shop on September 11th at 04:00 (UTC).[/p][p] [/p][p]Feature Optimizations[/p][p]I. Client Optimization[/p][p]1. Improved Animation Loading. Optimized animation loading logic to reduce occasional in-game lag and stuttering.[/p][p]2. Enhanced the overall game performance.[/p][p][/p][p]II. In-Game[/p][p]1. Optimized the Champion Fight Match icon display. It is now only displayed in the top-left corner during the preparation stage and is hidden after the match begins.[/p][p][/p][p]BUG Fixes[/p][p]I. Hero-Related Bugs[/p][p]1. Fixed an issue where double-button counter could not be triggered during some of Yoto Hime's moves during her Ultimate \[Demon Blade].[/p][p] [/p][p]X. 2nd PlayStation® Tournaments #9[/p][p]The rivers and lakes awaken, where the blade reveals its true prowess. 2nd PlayStation® Tournaments #9 are available for a limited time![/p][p]Event Duration: Sep. 4th, 2025 at 20:00 (UTC) - Oct. 9th, 2025 at 20:00 (UTC).[/p][p]Event Rules[/p][p]Complete weekly quests during the event to claim Jade Medal - SEP. You can claim more Medals in the mail after advancing, and the quantity awarded for each rank is as follows:[/p][p]1st place: 300 Medals[/p][p]2nd place: 200 Medals[/p][p]3rd-4th place: 100 Medals[/p][p]5th-8th place: 50 Medals[/p][p]Medals can be used for redeeming rewards and participating in rankings.[/p][p]Start Time of Tournament:[/p][table equalcells="1" colwidth=",,"][tr][td][p]Server[/p][/td][td][p]Monday - Friday (UTC)[/p][/td][td][p]Saturday - Sunday (UTC)[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p]NA[/p][/td][td][p]03:00[/p][/td][td][p]23:00[/p][p]03:00[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p]AS[/p][/td][td][p]11:00[/p][/td][td][p]07:00[/p][p]11:00[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p]SEA[/p][/td][td][p]11:00[/p][/td][td][p]07:00[/p][p]11:00[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p]EU[/p][/td][td][p]19:00[/p][/td][td][p]15:00[/p][p]19:00[/p][/td][/tr][/table][p]Start Time of the First Tournament:[/p][p]NA: 2025.09.05 03:00[/p][p]AS: 2025.09.05 11:00[/p][p]SEA: 2025.09.05 11:00[/p][p]EU: 2025.09.05 19:00[/p][p]X. PlayStation Challenge:[/p][p]Challenge the wind in this race! PlayStation Sky-high Racing #18 is now open![/p][p]Compete against players worldwide and ascend the rankings by achieving a place among the Top 100 fastest in Sky-high Racing mode.[/p][p]How to participate:
Start Sky-high Racing on Fairyland Penglai to participate in the event.[/p][p]Event Duration: Sep. 4th, 2025 00:00 (UTC) - Oct. 9th, 2025 23:59 (UTC)[/p][p] [/p][p] [/p]

notes.title: NARAKA: BLADEPOINT Banned Players List August 26th
notes.content:
[p]Dear players,

NARAKA: BLADEPOINT is committed to creating a fair and healthy competitive environment. We have not only used new anti-cheat technologies, but also established special cheat-reporting reward activities to encourage those players who defend the fairness with us. From now on, players who make outstanding contributions to reporting cheats will get the Legendary spear skin 'Righteous Polearm' .

More details:
1. Players who successfully reported 1 time will get \[Immortal Treasure] X1;

2. Players who successfully report 10 times with low misreport rate will get \[Immortal Treasure] X10 (In order to ensure the efficiency of detecting, please report reasonably);

3. Players who have successfully reported for many times or made great contributions to anti-cheat will get the Legendary spear skin \[Righteous Polearm] X1.

We strongly recommend that players report via in-game report system, so that we can confirm the cheat as soon as possible and record successful report times for you!

From 8/18- 8/24,  there are 3 players who have successfully reported the cheating or hacking in total and get the reward \[Righteous Polearm]! We hope that more players can become the Justice Supporter on the Morus Isle in the future.

notes.title: NARAKA: BLADEPOINT Update – August 21st, 2025
notes.content:
[p]Dear players,[/p][p]The servers of NARAKA: BLADEPOINT will be suspended for maintenance from August 20th, 2025 at 23:00 (UTC) to August 21st, 2025 at 04:00 (UTC). We suggest you log out in advance and enter the game again after the maintenance.[/p][p]The details for this update are as follows:[/p][h1][b]Brand New Content[/b][/h1][p]I. New Tempered Inferno and New Curios[/p][p]1. Tempered Inferno returns with five exclusive Curios and four Curios for all heroes.[/p][p]2. Reduced Tempered Inferno unlock requirements. Unlock it by completing \[Morus Isle·Autumn Plains Turmoil·Normal] for earlier access to the new Tempered Inferno mode![/p][p]3. New Curios are now available! Additionally, after reaching level 6 Curio progress in a given season, you can craft Curios from previous seasons if your corresponding crafting levels are sufficient.[/p][p]4. With more Curios available, we've sped up crafting level progression and increased rates of Legendary attributes this season so you may all experience each Curio and craft your perfect Curios faster![/p][p]5. Tempered Inferno in-game updates:[/p][p](1) New Enigmatic Rifts have been added near \[Emberveil Hollow·Wyrm Pool] and \[Chaos Furnace] for players to teleport back and forth.[/p][p](2) Replaced \[Lotus Lock] with \[Effigy], which can still be unlocked by upgrading the Chaos Furnace.  \[Effigy] effect: When used, it will taunt enemies within a 15m area for up to 20 sec.[/p][p](3) Replaced \[Thunder Elixir] with \[Storm Elixir]. 
\[Storm Elixir] effect: When used, it will continuously reduce enemies' Astral Aegis within a certain range for 5 sec.[/p][p](4) Two new Omens have been added: \[Copper Crisis] and \[Muzzle Flash]
Following Tempered Inferno level updates, the types of monsters will also change.[/p][p] [/p][p] [/p][p]II. New Contents in Rift Traversal Mode[/p][p]1. Limited-time Crossover Collectibles[/p][p](1) Added 2 limited-time crossover collectibles, each valued at 2,888,888 Void Coins. They can appear as drops in Tranquil, Perilous, and Doomed Paths of Rift Traversal mode after the August 21, 2025 update until September 16, 2025 at 22:00 UTC.[/p][p](2) These crossover collectibles have fixed Treasure Points and cannot be appraised or traded. Upon unlocking their entries, you will permanently gain 28,888 Treasure Points.[/p][p](3) Each crossover collectible features an exclusive examine Emote Gesture. Upon submitting them in the collection, you will obtain the corresponding Emote Gesture.[/p][p] [/p][p]2. Newly Added Collection Gallery[/p][p](1) A personal collection gallery feature has been added to the camp, where unlocked collectibles from your collection can be displayed.[/p][p](2) When crossover collectibles are displayed, they also feature background information, which can help you figure out the answers to Relic Quiz questions in the Land of Treasures event.[/p][p] [/p][p]3. The Pistol is now a part of Rift Traversal![/p][p]New Celestia Pistol: Thunderclap[/p][p]Arcane Effect: Thunder Blast Barrel[/p][p]Gains Blue Focus while charging, exploding once fully charged to damage enemies in front within range. Staggers and fills the enemy's Thundershock Meter.[/p][p]New Legendary and Extreme Pistol: Pistol·Burst[/p][p]Extreme Effect: Detonating Rounds[/p][p]Reduces Charged Shot damage, but bullets lodge inside enemies hit and explode after 2 sec.[/p][p]Pistol Rubrics:[/p][p]Quick Charge & Thundercall: Charged Pistol shots fire with larger explosion range and higher damage, allowing you to load up to two shots at a time and the charging will be muted.[/p][p] [/p][p]4. Replaced system-spawned \[Convoy Chest] with \[Dragonsteed Chariot][/p][p](1) Mid-match, \[Dragonsteed Chariot] spawns randomly on the battlefield[/p][p](2) You can store your Relics in the Chariot Bag. A Chariot has 3 Chariot Bags in total, and each can only be used by 1 person.[/p][p](3) Unless it's destroyed, the Chariot will send out its stored items when the corresponding countdown ends. The Chariot Bag function will then be disabled for the remainder of the match.[/p][p](4) If attacked and reduced to 0 HP before the countdown ends, the Chariot's Bag will drop its contents and be destroyed. The Chariot Bag function will then be disabled for the remainder of the match.[/p][p] [/p][p]5. Added Thunder·Drunken Fire Crate[/p][p]When sandstorms or snowstorms arrive, air currents will appear. Ride them to reach Thunder Isle above Plumed Castle and break the seal to open Thunder·Drunken Fire Crate.[/p][p] [/p][p]6. Cross-Platform Matchmaking On[/p][p]Rift Traversal now supports partying up with Cross-Platform players.[/p][p] [/p][p]III. New Fairyland Penglai Feature: Bamboo Raft[/p][p]You can now board the Bamboo Raft on the north side of Seraphic Quartet and the west side of Mystoland (former Kiteboarding sites) in Fairyland Penglai to enjoy the island sights with your teammates![/p][p] [/p][p] [/p][p]IV. Limited-time Event: Artisanal Wonder[/p][p]Glazes of blue and white, delicate cloud patterns so fine as if crafted amid the heavens...[/p][p]Event Duration: Aug. 21, 2025 Update - Sep. 3, 2025 20:00 (UTC)[/p][p]Claim Rewards Before: Sep. 6, 2025 20:00 (UTC)[/p][p]Event Rules:[/p][p]1. During the event, earn Gemstones by opening Stashes in Survival modes.[/p][p]2. Gemstones are also obtainable through Casual Modes (excluding Bloodsport), Showdown, and in Rift Traversal. You can acquire up to 360 Gemstone per week through these methods.[/p][p]3. Tap the Treasure Hunt button on the event page to randomly receive Pottery Shards of the same type. Collect five of the same Pottery Shards to claim corresponding rewards.[/p][p]4. Claim 30 extra Gemstones upon first entering the event page each week. The weekly Gemstone limit and extra Gemstones reset every Wednesday at 20:00 (UTC). (First reset: Aug 27, 2025, at 20:00 UTC.)[/p][p] [/p][p]V. Limited-time Event: Land of Treasures[/p][p]Event Duration: Aug. 21, 2025 Update - Sep. 16, 2025 20:00 (UTC)[/p][p]Claim Rewards Before: Sep. 21, 2025 20:00 (UTC)[/p][p]Event Rules:[/p][p]1. During the event, Extreme Relics obtained have an increased chance to be collaboration Relics.[/p][p]2. Sign in to the event page daily to earn Museum Scrolls and unlock 1 question about the crossover collectibles.[/p][p]3. Answering a question costs 1 Museum Scroll. The first question does not cost any Museum Scrolls. Correct answers will yield generous rewards. Answer a set number of questions correctly to earn Ziping Yin's Legendary Outfit.[/p][p]4. During the event, Extreme Relics obtained from Rift Traversal have an increased chance to be crossover Relics. Playing a Rift Traversal match daily will yield 1 Museum Scroll and 1 Relic Chest, which may contain an Extreme Relic.[/p][p] [/p][p]VI. Limited-time Event: Celestus Furnace[/p][p]Earthly fires and heavenly craftsmanship forge weapons of wonder, as ashes of fallen demons drift down to lands below.[/p][p]Event Duration: Aug. 21, 2025 Update - Sep. 3, 2025 20:00 (UTC)[/p][p]Claim Rewards Before: Sep. 10, 2025 20:00 (UTC)[/p][p]Event Rules:[/p][p]1. Gain Celestus Tokens by completing quests during the event. Celestus Tokens can be redeemed for great event rewards.[/p][p]2. Complete each day's Daily Quests to receive bonus rewards.[/p][p]3. There are 5 groups of Challenge Quests, each available in turn at different times. Complete quests to claim plentiful rewards.[/p][p]4. The rewards are redeemable till Sep. 10, 2025 at 20:00 (UTC). Please redeem the rewards in time.[/p][p] [/p][p]VII. Limited-time Event: Gifts from the Sea[/p][p]Event Duration: Aug. 27, 2025 20:00 (UTC) - Sep. 10, 2025 20:00 (UTC)[/p][p]Event Rules:[/p][p]During this event, sign in for 7 days in total to get rewards including limited-edition Avatar, Legendary Base, Splendor Treasure Choice Gift, Fission Treasure etc.[/p][p] [/p][p]VIII. Limited-time Event: Season Treasures Return[/p][p]Event Duration: Aug. 21, 2025 Update - Sep. 4, 2025 00:00 (UTC)[/p][p]Event Rules:[/p][p]1. During the event, Aeon Treasure will return for a limited time.[/p][p]2. The content and drop rate of rewards in Treasures will remain unchanged.[/p][p]3. The number of times to trigger a Guarantee for the Treasures will not be reset, and the progress you made on the current season's Guarantee will carry over.[/p][p]Go to the Treasure Pavilion for more details![/p][p] [/p][p] [/p][p] [/p][h1][b]Hero Adjustments[/b][/h1][p]I. Inor Wan[/p][p]1. Adjusted Inor Wan's Skill \[Bolt Dash]'s derivative slash move Focus to Golden Focus, added Dodge frame detection during slash startup frames, and improved movement control.[/p][p]2. Slightly extended the damage reduction druation after \[Bolt Dash: Pact]'s dash; adjusted maximum dash distance from 25m to 30m and optimized sound effects.[/p][p]3. Significantly advanced the timing when Thunder Lord can chain skills after airborne and ground vertical strikes, and slightly reduced the recovery frames for ground vertical strikes.[/p][p]4. Optimized \[Lightning Execution] set-up move homing performance and slightly reduced the recovery frames for Thunder Lord's \[Lightning Execution].[/p][p] [/p][p]II. Kurumi[/p][p]Optimized visual effects for the Healing Circle summoned by the Ultimate \[Purified Circle] at close range.[/p][p] [/p][p]III. Lyam Liu[/p][p]Slightly extended the recovery frames for Lyam Liu's ground-cast \[Magnet Repel] and \[Auric Core] that can be interrupted by weapon attacks by 0.05 seconds and 0.03 seconds respectively.[/p][p] [/p][p] [/p][h1][b]Weapon Adjustments[/b][/h1][p]I. Dual Blades[/p][p]1. Increased the knockback for \[Sunder The Stars] and \[Rend The Moon] charged Horizontal moves, as well as \[Rapid Throw] charged Vertical moves when they hit mid-air enemies.[/p][p]2. Reduced the projectile speed of the 1st stage charged Horizontal move \[Sunder The Stars].[/p][p]3. Slightly increased the start-up frames for 1st stage Vertical strikes.[/p][p]4. Increased the grappling buffer for the charged Vertical move \[Rapid Throw].[/p][p] [/p][p] [/p][p]In-Game Adjustments[/p][p]I. In-Game Adjustments[/p][p]Expanded initial safe zone range in Champion Fight Match Solo mode and increased high-tier loot zone count.[/p][p] [/p][p] [/p][p]Out-of-Game Adjustments[/p][p]I. Rank Preview[/p][p]Added rank preview for Ranked Mode and Immortal War. Click rank icons in mode selection interface to view them.[/p][p] [/p][p]II. Out-of-Game Inventory[/p][p]1. Expanded out-of-game inventory capacity from 300 to 510.[/p][p]2. Modified stack amounts for some items.[/p][p] [/p][p]III. New Feature: Reserve Hero[/p][p]1. Added the ability to reserve heroes for The Herald's Trial Duos/Trios and Immortal War Duos/Trios. Select your preferred hero in the mode selection page.[/p][p]2. Reserving heroes includes selecting one primary hero and two secondary heroes. Matchmaking prioritizes your primary hero to reduce teammate hero conflicts.[/p][p] [/p][p]IV. One-Click Clear Prompt Red Dots Feature[/p][p]Optimized one-click red dot clearing to include red dots from Justice Chamber, Event Center, and more.[/p][p] [/p][p]V. Champion Fight Match Changes[/p][p]Significantly increased ranked point deduction reduction when entering Champion Fight Match early.[/p][p] [/p][p] [/p][p]Rift Traversal Adjustments[/p][p]I. Beginner's Trial Ground[/p][p]Added special Tranquil Path mode for beginners (players below Explorer V may automatically match into \[Trial Ground])[/p][p]Trial Ground in-game adjustments:[/p][p](1) Reduced map access range with more concentrated resources.[/p][p](2) Simplified stage mechanics and reduced escape difficulty.[/p][p](3) Reduced Evil-Ent strength.[/p][p] [/p][p] [/p][p]II. In-Game Adjustments[/p][p]1. Players may continue spectating in-game after successful escape.[/p][p]2. Significantly increased \[Wind Horn] flight time and distance; flight now supports ascending and descending.[/p][p]3. Optimized resource distribution in some areas and adjusted map terrain.[/p][p]4. Cargo Escort quests changed from 3 stations per round to 2. (The final reward remains Drunken Fire Crate·Legendary)[/p][p]5. When chest rewards are distributed via dice roll, auto-pickup occurs after gaining pickup rights when countdown ends (auto-pickup won't occur if your backpack space is insufficient or you're in a special status).[/p][p]6. Boss Challenge Quests now require only 1 Rune Stone instead of 2.[/p][p]7. Realm of Yang adjustments:[/p][p](1) Defeated players receive Yang Depletion status instead of being eliminated outright.[/p][p](2) Defeated players only drop items from Relic Bags.[/p][p](3) Advanced Realm of Yang spawn timing.[/p][p](4) Winners receive new Morus' Blessing rewards. They may choose between Draco Storm and Mystic Might.[/p][p](5) Interacting with Rift Gates also removes Yang Depletion.[/p][p]8. In the Tranquil Path, the guaranteed quality of Relics in the Drunken Fire Crate·Epic has been upgraded to Rare quality.[/p][p]9. Reduced escape animation length from 5.5 sec to 2.5 sec.[/p][p]10. Added inspection animations for 8 Relics: Devastation Furnace, Moonscourge Boat, Crystal Crab, Sea of Calamity, Astrolabe of Stars, Sunwing's Breath, Eternal Lamp, and Bell of Annihilation.[/p][p]11. Added Common Melee Weapon Lucky Bags to Rift Dealers. Purchase them to obtain a Common Weapon.[/p][p] [/p][p]III. Free Training Adjustments[/p][p]1. Resetting training ground now resets combat item cooldowns.[/p][p]2. Durability auto-repair now also repairs current weapon toughness.[/p][p] [/p][p]IV. Out-of-Game Adjustments[/p][p]1. Significantly increased Relic shop recycling prices.[/p][p]2. You may conveniently batch-list multiple items in Trading Market.[/p][p]3. When selecting Century Chests and Key Cases in the storeroom or loadout interface, you can now quickly use the limited-time cards in your inventory.[/p][p] [/p][p]V. Item Adjustments[/p][p]1. Added 1 slot to the tactical bag and adjusted tactical bag position accordingly.[/p][p]//Dev Notes: Two slots felt cramped with limited tactical item variety. We hope increasing tactical bag capacity will enrich strategic options.[/p][p]2. Increased Dual Blades's flight speed during \[Dual Blades·Whirl]'s extreme effect \[Universe Slash·Whirling Blade]. Adjusted \[Universe Slash] in The Herald's Trial and Showdown accordingly.[/p][p]3. Added an effect to the \[Dual Blades·Rush] extreme effect \[Belladonna Sprint·Rush]. Now, can charge Horizontal Strikes to the second and third stages, increasing hit count and hit Focus.[/p][p]4. Added effects to the \[Polesword·Stomp] extreme effect \[Battle Stride·Unstoppable]. Now, can perform Battle Stride successively. Unyielding Hilt deals 25% increased damage and restores Health or Armor on hit.[/p][p]5. Adjusted \[Heng Sword•Dash] extreme effect \[Aurora Burst•Shadow Step] silence duration from 1.6 sec to 4 sec.[/p][p]6. Added effects to \[Heng Sword•Stab] extreme effect \[Lethal Jab•Loopback]. Now, Lethal Jab damage increased by 10%. These strikes disable enemies' Grappling and Mole Hooks on hit.[/p][p]7. Added an effect to the  \[Dual Halberds·Immerse] extreme effect \[Benthic Descent·Soaked]. Airborne vertical strikes now become \[Benthic Descent].[/p][p]8.  Each \[Dual Halberds·Burn] extreme effect \[Dragonlike Might·Burn] hit applies burn.[/p][p]9. Adjusted the \[Charged Power Scale Rush] Scale Rush damage increase with charge time from 20%/25%/35%/45% to 25%/32.5%/40%/50%.[/p][p]10. Increased the Vulnerable effect for \[Line Breaker Scale Rush]  inflicted on enemies on hit from 15% to 20%.[/p][p]11. Increased the \[Yang Decay] explosion damage from \[White-Blue: Yang Emergence] by 150%.[/p][p]12. Increased the \[Yin Decay] explosion damage from \[Blue-White: Yin Resurgence] by 37.5%.[/p][p]13. Increased the \[Yin-Yang Burst] explosion damage from \[Yin Yang Convulsion] by 14%. The explosion can stagger enemies that are Focused. Also added the following effect: when \[Yin-Yang Burst] hits, summon a \[Yin-Yang Jade] for an AOE blast strike that staggers non-Focused enemies. Lasts for 5 sec, can be triggered once every 10 sec.[/p][p]14. Added an effect to \[Vajra Counter], making counters easier.[/p][p]15. Increased the recovery effect for \[Spring Vitality Counter] from 200 to 300.[/p][p]16. \[Quick Dart]'s Golden Roc escort speed bonus was increased from 2%/5%/10%/16.5% to 10%/16%/22%/33% (Common/Rare/Epic/Legendary), with a team max of 100%.[/p][p]17. \[Golden Touch] gathering speed bonus increased from 3%/9%/16%/25% to 10%/15%/20%/30% (Common/Rare/Epic/Legendary).[/p][p]18. \[Health] max Health bonus increased from 4.5%/10% to 6%/12% (Common/Rare).[/p][p]19. \[Damage Reduction] damage reduction bonus increased from 2%/4%/6.5%/9% to 4%/7%/10%/13% (Common/Rare/Epic/Legendary).[/p][p]20. \[Divine Form] damage reduction at full Health increased from 10% to 15%.[/p][h1][b] [/b][/h1][h1][b]Showdown Adjustments[/b][/h1][p]I. Hero Adjustments[/p][p]1. Yoto Hime[/p][p](1) Added Golden Focus (Skill) when skill \[Flying Edge: Showdown] throws the demon blade.[/p][p](2) Ultimate \[Demon Blade: Showdown] can home onto surrounding enemies when used.[/p][p](3) Defuse skill \[Annihilation Blade] and Aegis-break Martial Skill \[Annihilation Slash] damage increases with the number of charges you have.[/p][p] [/p][p]II. Combat Adjustments[/p][p]Improved the performance of the Combat Items[/p][p] [/p][p]III. Free Training Adjustments[/p][p]1. Entering Free Training now automatically sets elemental meter once based on equipped Souljade elemental attributes.[/p][p]2. Added hotkeys to set maximum values and reset elemental meter in the custom elemental meter page.[/p][p]3. When equipping Souljades that change effects based on imbued elements, automatically activates the effect corresponding to the highest current elemental meter type. You can select a fixed elemental type to activate for each such Souljade.[/p][h1][b]Store Updates[/b][/h1][p]I. New Packs[/p][p]1. Added Zai exclusive Pack \[Butterfly Reverie], which contains the Legendary Outfit \[Summer Party·Butterfly Reverie], Legendary Dagger Skin \[Summer Party·Sound of Waves], Epic Hairstyle \[Summer Party·Refreshing] and Legendary Accessory \[Summer Party·Goggles]. Standard price: 5,000 Gold; Now: 2,600 Gold. Individual cosmetics have their own discounts, but the Pack discount is even bigger![/p][p]2. Newly added Tessa exclusive \[Superstar Pack], including Legendary Outfit \[Laudation·Superstar], Legendary Nunchucks Skin \[Laudation·Rose Glass], Legendary Accessory \[Laudation·Nimble], Legendary Hairstyle \[Laudation·Starflame]. Standard price: 5,300 Gold; Now: 2,700 Gold. Single items are discounted, and you get even more discounts when you purchase a Pack.[/p][p] [/p][p]II. New Discounts[/p][p]1. Newly added Tessa Legendary Accessory \[Laudation·Soul Fox].
Standard price: 900 Gold; Now: 600 Gold.[/p][p]2. Newly added Lannie Epic Pose \[Drowsy]. Standard price: 300 Gold; Now: 200 Gold.[/p][p]3. Newly added Legendary Emote Gesture \[Twister] for all heroes. Standard price: 900 Gold; Now: 360 Gold.[/p][p]4. Newly added Tessa Legendary Background \[Dazzling Star]. Standard price: 600 Gold; Now: 400 Gold.[/p][p]5. Newly added Tessa Legendary Base \[Sound-chasing Fox]. 
Standard price: 1,200 Gold; Now: 800 Gold.[/p][p]6. Newly added Epic Kill Announcement \[Leafstep Grace]. Standard price: 300 Gold; Now: 200 Gold.[/p][p]7. Kylin Zhang Legendary Background \[Moonbane Ghost]. Standard price: 200 Gold; Now: 160 Gold.[/p][p]8. Kylin Zhang Legendary Base \[Shadow Flame]. Standard price: 400 Gold; Now: 300 Gold.[/p][p] [/p][p] [/p][p]III. Limited-time Items Removed[/p][p]1. Cyra Exclusive Pack \[Aurora Night] and Cyra Legendary Outfit \[Summer Party·Aurora Night] have been removed from the store.[/p][p]2. Kylin Zhang Exclusive Pack \[Sun-kissed Surf] and Kylin Zhang Legendary Outfit \[Summer Party·Sun-Kissed Surf] have been removed from the store.[/p][p] [/p][p]IV. New Items in the Lunar Pavilion[/p][p]1. Newly added Ziping Yin Epic Base \[Spring Reflection] with a price of 80 Jade Disks.[/p][p]2. Newly added Ziping Yin Epic Background \[Peach Blossom Song] with a price of 40 Jade Disks.[/p][h1] [/h1][h1][b]BUG Fixes[/b][/h1][p]I. Hero-Related BUGS[/p][p]1. Fixed an issue where Thunder Lord's strike detection didn't match visual effect ranges for some moves.[/p][p]2. Fixed an issue where Inor Wan's projectiles might unexpectedly magnetize to enemies behind when using skill \[Bolt Dash: Pact].[/p][p]3. Fixed an issue where Thunder Lord couldn't execute \[Lightning Execution] on enemies affected by \[Frozen] or \[Strong Dazzle].[/p][p]4. Fixed an issue where Lannie's Ultimate \[Tricky Bounce: Leap] had lingering strike detection during some moves.[/p][p]5. Fixed an issue where Thunder Lord might unexpectedly clip outside the scene when teleporting with \[Voltaic Spear·Edge] second-stage.[/p][p]6. Fixed an issue that would cause Inor Wan's \[Thunderforged: Edge]'s Voltaic Spear projectile to trigger clashes with enemy weapon attacks.[/p][p] [/p][p]II. Rift Traversal-Related Bugs[/p][p]Fixed an issue where high-quality Healing Berries/Armor Powder had abnormal recovery effects when equipped with \[Advanced Heal] Rubrics in Rift Traversal.[/p][p] [/p][p] [/p][p] [/p][p] [/p][p] [/p][h1] [/h1][p] [/p]

notes.title: NARAKA: BLADEPOINT Banned Players List August 19th
notes.content:
[p]Dear players,

NARAKA: BLADEPOINT is committed to creating a fair and healthy competitive environment. We have not only used new anti-cheat technologies, but also established special cheat-reporting reward activities to encourage those players who defend the fairness with us. From now on, players who make outstanding contributions to reporting cheats will get the Legendary spear skin 'Righteous Polearm' .

More details:
1. Players who successfully reported 1 time will get \[Immortal Treasure] X1;

2. Players who successfully report 10 times with low misreport rate will get \[Immortal Treasure] X10 (In order to ensure the efficiency of detecting, please report reasonably);

3. Players who have successfully reported for many times or made great contributions to anti-cheat will get the Legendary spear skin \[Righteous Polearm] X1.

We strongly recommend that players report via in-game report system, so that we can confirm the cheat as soon as possible and record successful report times for you!

From 8/11- 8/17,  there are 4 players who have successfully reported the cheating or hacking in total and get the reward \[Righteous Polearm]! We hope that more players can become the Justice Supporter on the Morus Isle in the future.

notes.title: NARAKA: BLADEPOINT Update – August 7th, 2025
notes.content:
[p]Dear players,[/p][p]The servers of NARAKA: BLADEPOINT will be suspended for maintenance from August 6th, 2025 at 23:00 (UTC) to August 7th, 2025 at 04:00 (UTC). We suggest you log out in advance and enter the game again after the maintenance.[/p][p]The details for this update are as follows:[/p][h1][b]Brand New Content[/b][/h1][p]I. New Hero: Inor Wan[/p][p]Thunder courses through his veins as he roams the land alone. Inor Wan is known as the Thunder's Voice among the martial artists. Upholding justice and honoring promises, he is also recognized as the Best Escort in Icuria.[/p][p]He readily accepts commissions to aid the world and benefit the people and never shirks requests for righteous vengeance. Once he takes on an escort mission, he will see it through even if it means traversing mountains of knives and seas of fire![/p][p] [/p][p]II. Season Exclusive: Fission Treasure[/p][p]1. The Fission Treasure is priced at 360 Gold. Open for a chance to obtain rewards like Yoto Hime Extreme Outfit \[Doll Dream] and the Katana Extreme Skin \[Blade Mystique].[/p][p]2. While wearing \[Doll Dream], there will be a  \[Waltz Finale] effect when you defeat enemies. Cannot be Imprinted: When combat begins, enters a special form: Crimson Puppet.[/p][p]3. Equipping Katana Extreme Skin \[Blade Mystique] changes the hit effects of Blink Strikes and the Souljade \[Swift Cut]. Cannot be Imprinted: Unleashing a charged strike with Blade Mystique will shift and change its appearance.[/p][p]4. Minimum Guarantee:[/p][p](1) Players are guaranteed to receive at least 1 Red (Extreme) reward during the process of opening at most 100 Treasures. This can be triggered multiple times.​ Red (Extreme) rewards will not repeat until all of them have been obtained.[/p][p](2) Legendary Cosmetic Minimum Guarantee: Within the first 25 Treasures opened, you are guaranteed to get either a Hero Outfit or a Weapon Skin. Subsequently, within every 25 Treasures opened, you are guaranteed to obtain a Legendary cosmetic that you have not yet unlocked. This guarantee can be triggered up to 14 times.[/p][p](3) Wishing Legendary Reward: If you draw an Extreme cosmetic, you can set a Legendary cosmetic which will be guaranteed when you draw a Legendary cosmetic next time. Times of guarantee can stack, but you can only set 1 cosmetic each time. If the Legendary Cosmetic Guarantee and Wishing Legendary Reward trigger simultaneously, priority is given to the Wishing Legendary Reward cosmetic and will reduce the number of remaining times that the Legendary Cosmetic Guarantee can be triggered by one.[/p][p]5. Fission Treasure 50% Discounts[/p][p]The first 10 Fission Treasures that you buy will benefit from a 50% discount. This discount cannot be stacked with discounts from other discount vouchers. After 10 Fission Treasures have been purchased, subsequent Fission Treasures will return to their standard price.[/p][p]6. Fission Treasure will be available on Aug. 7th, 2025 at 04:00 (UTC)![/p][p]After the server opens, players can preview content early, but the Treasures remain locked until the specified time.[/p][p]The Star-Collection unlocks at the same time as the Treasures.[/p][p] [/p][p]III. Reputation Score System[/p][p]We have reworked the Reputation system. You can access the Reputation interface through Profile-Reputation. By maintaining a high Reputation score, you can earn rewards, including Legendary Bases, Ranked Score, and Score Keeper Cards.[/p][p] [/p][p]IV. New Loadouts Available in the Rift Traversal Mode[/p][p]1. The "King of Weapons" Spear is now a part of Rift Traversal![/p][p]New Celestia Spear: Azure Dragon[/p][p]Arcane: Azure Dragon Break[/p][p]Alters Vertical Strikes after a charged Horizontal Strike, Nezha's Might, or Dragonslayer misses.[/p][p]New Legendary and Extreme Spear: Spear·Track[/p][p]Extreme: Heartstopper Kick·Flash[/p][p]Dragonslayer temporarily silences enemies hit, and can lead into a follow-up attack if it misses, up to 3 times.[/p][p]New Legendary and Extreme Spear: Spear·Air[/p][p]Extreme: Thunderous Smash[/p][p]After hitting with an airborne Horizontal Strike, alters the next airborne Vertical Strike.[/p][p]Spear Rubric:[/p][p]Razor Swift: Alters Nezha's Might's strikes.[/p][p]Erudition & Spear Storm: Alters the Spear's Charged Vertical Strike and the 3rd Vertical Strike in the Spear combo, and Spear Storm can be used by unleashing a Vertical Strike after using Erudition.[/p][p]Martial Art·Hexa-Harmony Spear: Alters Spear's charged Horizontal Strikes.[/p][p]Congeneric Martial Skills: Long-handle Weapon Skills for Rift Traversal.[/p][p] [/p][p]V. Newly added Extreme Collections Lock Feature[/p][p]1.When previewing the Extreme cosmetics, you can now use the buttons to switch between different forms[/p][p]2. The initial batch of cosmetics available for this feature:[/p][p](1) For Katana's Extreme Skin \[Blade Mystique], there are 3 types of effects available: Blade Mystique·Flow, Blade Mystique·Brilliance Shine, Blade Mystique·Deep Shadow[/p][p](2) For Yoto Hime's Extreme Outfit \[Doll Dream], there are 3 types of effects available: Doll Dream·Default, Doll Dream·White, Doll Dream·Crimson[/p][p] [/p][p]VI. Star-Collection Feature Optimizations[/p][p]1. Added a preview function that allows you to set Constellations to display while previewing Star-Collections. (This preview function will only include a small number of Constellation attributes).[/p][p]2. New Star Collections will have a Restyle guarantee. (Star Collections that have already been released will not change).[/p][p]\[Star - Mountain Crusher] and \[Star - Wind's Whisper] will have a Restyle guarantee for their final Constellation of 2,000 and 1,000, respectively.[/p][p]The upcoming Extreme and Legendary Star Collections will have a Restyle guarantee for their final Constellation of 2,000 and 1,000, respectively.[/p][p]3. Added a toggle feature for the final Constellation. You can activate \[Ultimate Aura Effect] in the Collection interface.[/p][p]4. Adjustment to Star-Collections in Season Treasure: From this Season, the Star-Collections in Season Treasures will be changed to limited-time bonus rewards. Star-Collections that are not given within a specified time period will be removed from and become unobtainable. Please refer to the corresponding treasure and event descriptions for details.[/p][p] [/p][p]VII. Limited-time event: Thunder's Voice[/p][p]This time, leave everything to me![/p][p]Event Duration: Aug. 7, 2025 Update - Aug. 20, 2025 20:00 (UTC)[/p][p]Event Rules:[/p][p]1. Complete Daily Quests to obtain Inor Wan Trial Vouchers and Thunder Tokens.[/p][p]2. Complete Event Quests to obtain Thunder Tokens. A new quest can be unlocked only after completing the current one. Quests can only be completed when they become available.[/p][p]3. Consume Thunder Tokens to redeem rewards.[/p][p] [/p][p]VIII. Limited-time Event: Source Awakening[/p][p]Event Duration: Aug. 15, 2025 20:00 (UTC) - Aug. 20, 2025 20:00 (UTC)[/p][p]Claim Rewards Deadline: Aug 23, 2025 20:00 (UTC)[/p][p]Event Rules:[/p][p]Powers gather at Jinsha Site, blades tearing through the sky! The 2025 NARAKA: BLADEPOINT Mid-Season Championship at EWC is underway![/p][p]1. Gain \[Power Core] by completing quests during the event. \[Power Core] can be redeemed for great event rewards.[/p][p]2. During the Mid-Season Championship Finals at EWC, participate in platforms' match-watching events to earn more \[Power Core].[/p][p] [/p][p]IX. Limited-time Event: Day of Reunion[/p][p]Event Duration: Aug. 13, 2025 20:00 (UTC) - Aug. 24, 2025 20:00 (UTC)[/p][p]During this event, sign in for 7 days in total to get rewards including limited-edition Avatar, Splendor Treasure Choice Gift, Fission Treasure etc.[/p][p] [/p][p]X. Limited Time Event: Tao Gate·Opening[/p][p]Event Duration: Aug. 7, 2025 Update - Aug. 20, 2025 20:00 (UTC)[/p][p]1. During the event, play any Survival Mode (excluding Immortal War), or interact with Rift Portals in Rift Traversal mode to obtain Rift Chests.[/p][p]2. You can earn up to 1 Rift Chest per match, and up to 3 Rift Chests per day.[/p][p]3. Open Rift Chests for a chance to receive rewards such as Legendary Outfit Choice Gift, Legendary Weapon Choice Gift, Legendary Accessory Choice Gift, Legendary Card Choice Gift, Fission Treasure, Splendor Treasure Choice Gift, Jade Disk, Advanced Battle Edict, Intermediate Battle Edict, Glazed Crystal, Fission Coins and more.[/p][p] [/p][p]XI. Fission Treasure with Bonus Star - Collections[/p][p]Event Duration: Aug. 7, 2025 04:00 (UTC) - Aug. 22, 2025 04:00 (UTC)[/p][p]Event Rules[/p][p]1. When opening Fission Treasures, there is a chance to receive the Extreme Polesword Skin \[Star - Mountain Crusher] and the Legendary Kurumi Outfit \[Star - Wind's Whisper].[/p][p]2. How to obtain: Each time you open a Fission Treasure, there is a chance to obtain them as an additional reward. This chance increases as you open more Fission Treasures. The Maximum chance is 100%[/p][p]3. The chances for the 2 Star-Collections are calculated separately and do not impact each other. After getting a Star-Collection, the corresponding chances will then reset.[/p][p]4. Each account can receive a maximum of 10 \[Star - Mountain Crusher] and 2 \[Star - Wind's Whisper].[/p][p]5. The number of Star-Collections that can be obtained from Fission Treasures is limited.[/p][p]6. The Star-Collections granted through the Fission Treasure are time-limited.[/p][p]\[Star - Mountain Crusher] cannot be obtained by opening Treasures after Aug 8th, 2025 at 04:00 (UTC).[/p][p]\[Star - Wind's Whisper] cannot be obtained by opening Treasures after Aug 22nd, 2025 at 04:00 (UTC).[/p][p] [/p][p]XII. 2nd PlayStation® Tournaments #8[/p][p]The rivers and lakes awaken, where the blade reveals its true prowess. 2nd PlayStation® Tournaments #8 are available for a limited time![/p][p]Event Duration: Aug 7, 2025 20:00 (UTC) - Sep 3, 2025 20:00 (UTC)[/p][p]Event Rules:[/p][p]Complete weekly quests during the event to claim Jade Medal - AUG. You can claim more Medals in the mail after advancing, and the quantity awarded for each rank is as follows:[/p][p]1st place: 300 Medals[/p][p]2nd place: 200 Medals[/p][p]3rd-4th place: 100 Medals[/p][p]5th-8th place: 50 Medals[/p][p]Medals can be used for redeeming rewards and participating in rankings.[/p][p]Start Time of Tournament:[/p][table equalcells="1" colwidth=",,"][tr][td][p]Server[/p][/td][td][p]Monday - Friday (UTC)[/p][/td][td][p]Saturday - Sunday (UTC)[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p]NA[/p][/td][td][p]03:00[/p][/td][td][p]23:00[/p][p]03:00[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p]AS[/p][/td][td][p]11:00[/p][/td][td][p]07:00[/p][p]11:00[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p]SEA[/p][/td][td][p]11:00[/p][/td][td][p]07:00[/p][p]11:00[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p]EU[/p][/td][td][p]19:00[/p][/td][td][p]15:00[/p][p]19:00[/p][/td][/tr][/table][p]Start Time of the First Tournament:[/p][p]NA: Aug 8, 2025 03:00 (UTC)[/p][p]AS: Aug 8, 2025 11:00 (UTC)[/p][p]SEA: Aug 8, 2025 11:00 (UTC)[/p][p]EU: 2025.08.08 19:00 (UTC)[/p][p] [/p][p]XIII.
