Start Sky-high Racing on Fairyland Penglai to participate in the event.[/p][p]Event Duration: Aug 7, 2025 00:00 (UTC) - Sep 3, 2025 23:59 (UTC)[/p][p] [/p][p] [/p][h1][b]Hero Adjustments[/b][/h1][p]I. Yoto Hime[/p][p]1. Added Golden Focus (Skill) when skill \[Flying Edge] throws the demon blade to distant targets.[/p][p]2. Adjusted the damage multiplier of charged moves of Ultimate \[Demon Blade] Horizontal Strikes from 1.0+2.0 to 1.8+1.3; that of ground Vertical Strikes from 0.5+2.5 to 0.2+2.8; that of airborne Vertical Strikes from 2.5 to 2.8.[/p][p]3. Adjusted the damage multipliers of the first three strikes of Ultimate \[Demon Blade: Combo] against heroes with transformation traits to match those against normal heroes, from 2.6/3.2/3.8 to 3.5/3.5/3.5; adjusted the lifesteal multiplier from 30% to 40%.[/p][p] [/p][p]II. Wuchen[/p][p]Adjusted the Defensive Focus during the charging process of skill \[Spirit Blades] after charging the 1st stage from Blue Focus to Golden Focus (Move); adjusted the Defensive Focus when releasing the charged move from Blue Focus to Golden Focus (Skill).[/p][p] [/p][p]III. Zai[/p][p]1. Adjusted the Defensive Focus during the dash of skill \[Flame Ward: Firestorm] from Golden Focus (Move) to Golden Focus (Skill).[/p][p]2. Optimized the pre-input timing for using movement actions to interrupt skill \[Flame Ward: Firestorm] while in aiming mode.[/p][p] [/p][p]IV. Kurumi[/p][p]Optimized the dodge interrupt timing when using Vertical Strikes during \[Linking] for skills \[Healing Ray] and \[Healing Ray: Defense].[/p][p] [/p][p]V. Cyra[/p][p]1. When she fires beam attacks when her Ultimate is active, a pursuit beam will be automatically released after 2 sec.[/p][p]Players can now Counter Level 1 and Level 2 pursuit beams, but sustained beams cannot be blocked. A successful Counter blocks most damage while inflicting a brief stagger—Cyra herself remains unaffected by the Counter. [/p][p]Level 1 and 2 pursuit beams' damage multiplier is adjusted from 1.3/2.3 to 1.5/2.5.[/p][p]2. The following adjustments have been made to Ultimate \[Light's Mercy]:[/p][p]Cyra can no longer fire Dazzling Light Orbs through Vertical Strikes when her Ultimate is active[/p][p]In the ultimate state, the Dazzling Light Orbs replace the skill and can be launched up to 3 times. The orbs fly faster and farther, exploding as soon as they reach their maximum distance. Adjusted the orbs' healing effect on Cyra and her allies from 60/180 to 150/200[/p][p]3. Reduced the initial cooldown time of \[Aureole: Attach] from 25 sec to 22 sec.[/p][p]//Dev Note: In the past, Cyra could continuously launch beams for a long time while attacking on the move, applying relentless pressure that often left enemies with no choice but to constantly dodge. To address this, we're adjusting the automatic pursuit beams with a duration limit, ensuring enemies have periodic openings to recover and counterplay.[/p][p]When Counter Cyra's pursuit beams, it won't trigger counterattacks but causes slight stagger, serving as a stamina-efficient alternative defense.[/p][p]Previously, the maximum number of orbs that could be launched was too high, putting too much pressure on enemies with constant interruptions and control. We've now limited the number of Dazzling Light Orbs that can be launched, but the hit rate has been increased. Additionally, we’ve improved beam damage and the healing amount from the orbs.[/p][p] [/p][p] [/p][p]Weapon Adjustments[/p][p]I. Flying Knives[/p][p]Appropriately shortened the strike lingering time for the 1st stage charged Horizontal Strike \[Sunder The Stars].[/p][p] [/p][p] [/p][p] [/p][h1][b]In-Game Adjustments[/b][/h1][p]I. Controller Adjustments[/p][p]1. Added default \[Quick Counter] key binding as left stick press for \[Classic] and \[Shooter] presets.[/p][p] [/p][p]II. Feature Optimizations[/p][p]1. Added Scene Escape to in-game ESC menu (Survival modes and Rift Traversal only).[/p][p]//Dev Notes: We're continuously optimizing and fine-tuning this feature.[/p][p]2. Optimized male character standing animations in Fairyland Penglai.[/p][p]3. Improved the adjustable angle range when launching with the Soaring Arm.[/p][p] [/p][p]III. Gameplay Adjustments[/p][p]Yang Spirit Wells have been removed from Quick Match mode.[/p][p] [/p][p] [/p][p]Out-of-Game Adjustments[/p][p]I. Limited-Time Mode Rotation[/p][p]\[Neo-Mech Clash] returns for a limited time while \[Blessed Brutality] is deactivated temporarily for optimization. We'll bring \[Blessed Brutality] back in better form when the time is right.[/p][p] [/p][p]II. One-click Clear Prompt Red Dots[/p][p]Added one-click notification dot cleanup in Settings - Gameplay to clear informational notification dots (excluding reward and functional dots).[/p][p]As notification dots span across many features, we're still working to improve the one-click cleanup function. We appreciate your understanding regarding any inconvenience.[/p][p] [/p][p]III. Baize's Blessing Update[/p][p]Newly added the following Cosmetics to redeem:[/p][p](1) Cyra's Legendary Outfit: \[Radiant Eclipse][/p][p](2) Spear Legendary Skin: \[Piercing Light][/p][p](3) Cyra's Legendary Accessory: \[Feathered Point][/p][p](4) Cyra's Legendary Accessory: \[Dark Moonlight][/p][p](5) Cyra's Legendary Accessory: \[Thorns of Pain][/p][p](6) Cyra's Legendary Hairstyle: \[Silver][/p][p][/p][p] [/p][p]Rift Traversal Adjustments[/p][p]I. Training Ground[/p][p]Added training ground for Rift Traversal.[/p][p]You can practice basic equipment loadouts and try items in the training ground.[/p][p] [/p][p]II. Examine Gesture[/p][p]1. Added a new Examine Gesture. After unlocking the entries for Authentic collectibles, one Examine Gesture can be obtained for free. Using it will trigger the Examine animation.[/p][p]2. This gesture cannot be used in the Rift Traversal, but it can be used in other maps and modes such as Fairyland Penglai, The Herald's Trial, and Showdown.[/p][p]3. After this update, players who unlocked the entries will automatically receive the corresponding Examine Gesture for their collectibles, no resubmission needed.[/p][p] [/p][p]III. Smart Node Assignment Added to Matchmaking[/p][p]To ensure better match experience, we've optimized matchmaking algorithms to intelligently assign match nodes based on player regions and real-time node conditions.[/p][p] [/p][p]IV. In-Game Adjustments[/p][p]1. In Tranquil Path mode, all keys except the Cave of Internal Chamber now consume 2 durability per cave opening and increased cave drop rates across all difficulties.[/p][p]2. In-game equipment obtained now has standard toughness instead of extreme toughness.[/p][p]3. Added Epic Weapon Racks to replace some previous Rare Weapon Rack spawns, and significantly increased Weapon Rack spawn amount as well as the drop rates of weapons.[/p][p]4. Rift Gate capture progress now slowly decays 6 sec after leaving the area.[/p][p]5. Switch escape point—Rift Gate mechanisms now feature protective shields that provide one-way defense against ranged attacks from outside.[/p][p]6. Now, after activating the final Rift Gate Tuner mechanism for switch escape points, escape points activate after 15 sec.[/p][p]7. New large transformable objects available when using the Combat Item \[Morph Rune]: Tent and Thatched Cottage. When transformed into these objects, you can still be attacked, but damage taken is reduced.[/p][p]8. Optimized the default settings for Smart Swap. When Smart Swap is enabled, different types of items such as equipment, keys, and bags can now be replaced with Relics.[/p][p]9. Optimized the Smart Swap logic for the Century Chest. When both the bag and Century Chest are enabled for replacement, items in the Century Chest will be prioritized for replacement. Items replaced from the Century Chest will be moved to the bag, and ultimately the lowest quality or lowest value items will be automatically discarded from your bag.[/p][p] [/p][p] [/p][p]V. Out-game Adjustments[/p][p]1. Loadouts Optimization[/p][p]Added quick purchase option for Extreme Toughness equipment in the Prepare interface.[/p][p]Rubrics etching can now be edited and saved in loadout presets.[/p][p]Improved system logic to significantly reduce Storeroom space requirements when applying equipment loadouts.[/p][p]Added confirmation prompts for abnormal situations when confirming loadouts, such as missing weapons.[/p][p]2. Added quick item exchange to Refurbishment and Prepare interfaces, no longer requiring navigation to the Travelling Merchant interface.[/p][p]3. Reduced the price of Common (white) weapons and armors, and decreased the Void Gold required for their refurbishment.[/p][p]4. Adjusted the stacking limit for certain items in the Storeroom, including combat items, low-quality Relics, and refurbishment parts, with a maximum increased to 999.[/p][p]5. During batch recycling, a secondary confirmation process has been added when you recycle an item of high value.[/p][p]6. Added detailed display for automatic teammate equipment return. The settlement page will now list all equipment that have been returned to teammates.[/p][p]7. Increased the capacity of Storerooms at all levels. The specific adjustments are as follows:[/p][table equalcells="1" colwidth=",,"][tr][td][p]Level[/p][/td][td][p]Before Update[/p][/td][td][p]After Update[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p]1[/p][/td][td][p]300[/p][/td][td][p]350[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p]2[/p][/td][td][p]350[/p][/td][td][p]400[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p]3[/p][/td][td][p]350[/p][/td][td][p]420[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p]4[/p][/td][td][p]350[/p][/td][td][p]440[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p]5[/p][/td][td][p]350[/p][/td][td][p]460[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p]6[/p][/td][td][p]400[/p][/td][td][p]500[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p]7[/p][/td][td][p]400[/p][/td][td][p]520[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p]8[/p][/td][td][p]500[/p][/td][td][p]560[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p]9[/p][/td][td][p]500[/p][/td][td][p]580[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p]10[/p][/td][td][p]500[/p][/td][td][p]600[/p][/td][/tr][/table][p] [/p][p] [/p][p] [/p][p]VI. Feature Optimizations[/p][p]We've added quality visual effects for Legendary and Extreme items. These effects will be active in Bag, Storeroom, and other relevant interfaces.[/p][p] [/p][p]VII. Items Adjustments[/p][p]1. Increased \[Scale Armor·Firmness]'s Extreme effect \[Iron Clad]'s Damage Reduction per hit by 25%, from 24 to 30.[/p][p]2. Added new effect for \[Scale Armor·Silk]'s Extreme effect \[Silkworm Cocoon]: +20% ranged damage reduction[/p][p]//Dev Note: We noticed that \[Katana·Silence] and 
\[Bow·Fire] usage rates are too high. We aim to bring back tactical diversity by strengthening counterplay mechanics.[/p][p] [/p][h1][b]Client Optimizations[/b][/h1][p]1. Optimized the smoothness of loading in certain areas.[/p][p]2. Optimized the time taken for preheating shaders.[/p][p] [/p][p] [/p][p] [/p][h1][b]Store Updates[/b][/h1][p]I. New Packs[/p][p]1. Added Valda Cui exclusive Pack \[Glaze Twilight], which contains the exclusive Legendary Outfit \[Sweet Dreams·Glaze Twilight] and the Legendary Hairstyle \[Sweet Dreams·Goodnight Melody]. Standard price: 2,600 Gold; Now: 1,800 Gold. Individual cosmetics have their own discounts, but the Pack discount is even bigger![/p][p]2. Added Cyra exclusive Pack \[Shattered Moonbeam], which contains Legendary Outfit \[Sweet Dreams·Shattered Moonbeams], Legendary Accessory \[Sweet Dreams·Shimmer Bear], Legendary Hairstyle \[\[Highlights] Sweet Dreams·Dusk Glow]. Standard price: 4,200 Gold; Now: 2,300 Gold. Individual cosmetics have their own discounts, but the Pack discount is even bigger![/p][p]3. Added Inor Wan exclusive Pack \[Yuan Tiangang], which contains the Legendary Outfit \[The Degenerate·Yuan Tiangang] and Legendary Voice Pack \[Inor Wan·Yuan Tiangang Chinese Voice Pack]. Standard price: 2,800 Gold; Now: 1,900 Gold. Individual cosmetics have their own discounts, but the Pack discount is even bigger![/p][p]4. Standard price: 3,400 Gold; Now: 2,100 Gold. Individual cosmetics have their own discounts, but the Pack discount is even bigger![/p][p] [/p][p]II. New Discounts[/p][p]1. Standard price: 4,800 Gold; Now: 3,200 Gold.[/p][p]2. Newly added Legendary Mark of Victory \[Horizon Feather]. Standard price: 2,400 Gold; Now: 1,000 Gold.[/p][p]3. notes.title: NARAKA: BLADEPOINT Banned Players List August 3rd
notes.content:
[p]Dear players,

NARAKA: BLADEPOINT is committed to creating a fair and healthy competitive environment. We have not only used new anti-cheat technologies, but also established special cheat-reporting reward activities to encourage those players who defend the fairness with us. From now on, players who make outstanding contributions to reporting cheats will get the Legendary spear skin 'Righteous Polearm' .

More details:
1. Players who successfully reported 1 time will get \[Immortal Treasure] X1;

2. Players who successfully report 10 times with low misreport rate will get \[Immortal Treasure] X10 (In order to ensure the efficiency of detecting, please report reasonably);

3. Players who have successfully reported for many times or made great contributions to anti-cheat will get the Legendary spear skin \[Righteous Polearm] X1.

We strongly recommend that players report via in-game report system, so that we can confirm the cheat as soon as possible and record successful report times for you!

From 7/28- 8/3,  there are 3 players who have successfully reported the cheating or hacking in total and get the reward \[Righteous Polearm]! We hope that more players can become the Justice Supporter on the Morus Isle in the future.

notes.title: NARAKA: BLADEPOINT Update – July 23rd, 2025
notes.content:

After the update, the championship entries of \[ASE] and \[SZ.WBG.Verse] will be added to the Tournament Champion Leaderboard in RANK.[/p][p]2. The three players from \[ASE] - \[ASE.Han], \[ASE.XiaoWen], and \[ASE.Mist] - have been awarded the exclusive title "2025 NBPL Spring Split - Trios Champion" and their "Personal Highlights" page now displays the "2025 NBPL Spring Split - Trios Champion" trophy.[/p][p]3. \[SZ.WBG.Verse] has been awarded the exclusive title "2025 NBPL Spring Split - Solo Champion" and their "Personal Highlights" page now displays the "2025 NBPL Spring Split - Solo Champion" trophy.[/p][p]May all of you achieve even greater results in future tournaments![/p]

notes.title: NARAKA: BLADEPOINT Update – June 18th, 2025
notes.content:
[p][/p][p]Dear players,[/p][p]The servers of NARAKA: BLADEPOINT will be suspended for maintenance from Jul. 8th, 2025 23:00 (UTC) to Jul. 9th, 2025 04:00 (UTC). We suggest you log out in advance and enter the game again after maintenance is complete.[/p][p]The details for this update are as follows:[/p][h1][b]Brand New Content[/b][/h1][p]I. The brand-new treasure hunting mode, Rift Traversal, is now available (Trailblazer Season)[/p][p] [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36350327/17b4715fbc49d8be27bdfd820277aa8fd970faa8.png"][/img][/p][p]Ancient deities stir. Rifts tear the world apart, and heroes converge upon this calamity.[/p][p]Your goal: scavenge lost supplies, defeat opponents, and escape safely through Rift Gates.[/p][p]Whatever you extract from the rifts enters your personal out-of-game storeroom and becomes resources for your next match.[/p][p] [/p][p]1. Basic Rules[/p][p](1) Collect lost Relics across the fractured lands of Holoroth in Rift Traversal.[/p][p](2) While treasure hunting, you must deal with monsters and beware of prowling "counterparts". Bring your Divine Armory or travel light, but rebirth means losing everything you carry.[/p][p](3) Find Rift Gates on the map, awaken the Aegis Tree, restore yin-yang balance, and escape with your plundered treasures intact.[/p][p] [/p][p]2. Out-of-Game Systems[/p][p](1) Preparation[/p][p]Purchase and equip supplies in the Preparation interface before entering rifts. You'll spawn into matches with your prepared loadout.[/p][p] [/p][p](2) Storeroom[/p][p]Store supplies extracted from matches in your storeroom, where you can organize and sell these resources.[/p][p] [/p][p](3) New Assist Gear "Mole Hook"[/p][p]Switch between Grappling Hook and Mole Hook assist gear during Preparation or at Rift Dealers in-game. Both consume hook items.[/p][p]a. Stealth Movement: Use on the ground to burrow and move stealthily. While burrowed, you can organize your bag, drop items, and even search for treasures underground.[/p][p]b. Aerial Rush: Rush in any direction, even skyward.[/p][p]c. Leap: Press dodge while burrowing to jump over obstacles and gain brief invulnerability at the cost of Stamina.[/p][p]d. Underground Moves: Horizontal strike charges toward crosshair, vertical strike performs Uppercut Slash. You can charge underground, waiting for the right opportunity to burst forth![/p][p] [/p][p]3. In-Game Mechanics[/p][p](1) Spawn: After Preparation, you will spawn randomly on one of the map's two sides.[/p][p](2) Resource Searching: Interact with in-game objects to search for resources. Interactables have highlight outlines.[/p][p](3) Precious Resources: Drunken Fire Crates are precious, limited resources on the map. They are more likely to contain high-quality Relics.[/p][p](When opening some Drunken Fire Crates, you must seize the moment and use counters to weaken their seal meter.)[/p][p](4) Weather:[/p][p]a. Blizzard: You build Coldness during blizzards. Your Rage is continuously drained when you reach a certain amount of Coldness. Find Campfires for warmth. Blizzards also spawn frozen treasures across the battlefield.[/p][p]b. Sandstorm: Crouch to hide in the dust during Sandstorm for ambushes and retreats.[/p][p](5) In-Game Quests:[/p][p]As matches progress, quests activate across the map.[/p][p]a. Contract: Defeat specific targets like the heathens at Yushan Ruins, the horse bandits at Plumed Castle, and the shadow guards at the City of Tang per quest requirements.[/p][p]b. Valiant Challenge: Reveals your position once picked up, but scouts for enemies within a certain range every once in a while. You have to survive for a certain period of time.[/p][p]c. Revenge: Deal 1,000 damage to your teammate's killer and your party will gain 1 additional rebirth (Requires one of your teammates to have been eliminated).[/p][p]d. Flag: Escort your party's flagbearer, and head for the target Spirit Well zone. Defend the area until progress reaches 100% to complete the quest and receive Drunken Fire Crates.[/p][p]e. Cargo Escort: Capture and escort the Golden Roc to the station to obtain Drunken Fire Crates.[/p][p]f. Clear: Clear out Evil-Ent strongholds to receive Drunken Fire Crates.[/p][p]g. Guard: Protect the target boss from being defeated within the quest time.[/p][p]h. Challenge: Collect 2 Rune Stone items from clearing Evil-Ent strongholds to unlock boss challenges. Defeat the boss to receive Drunken Fire Crates.[/p][p](6) Caves[/p][p]More than 10 cave types await across each match, but you’ll need keys to unlock them. Keys have limited durability, and the amount used varies depending on the vault's and map's difficulty.[/p][p]Special cave keys can be purchased from Rift Dealers. Keys with special descriptions cannot be extracted from matches.[/p][p](7) Escape[/p][p]As matches progress, escape points—Rift Gates—gradually activate across the map.[/p][p]Different Rift Gates have varying limits, activation times, and durations. Gates close when their duration ends.[/p][p]Beyond regular Rift Gates, gates with special conditions include:[/p][p]a. Weight-Limited Gates: Requires Relic Bag weight below a certain threshold[/p][p]b. Triggered Gates: Requires triggering the Rift Gate Guides located in the West Wing, Forecourt, and East Wing of Plumed Castle, in that order. Once used, they enter cooldown and cannot be used immediately by other parties.[/p][p]c. Quest Gates: Requires completing any quest[/p][p]d. Hidden Gates: Requires purchasing specific items from Rift Dealers[/p][p]Escape Rules: An escape point can be used to escape only if there are no enemies within its zone. Once the progress bar fills up, interact with the Rift Gate to escape. (Interacting with a Rift Gate to escape takes 5.5 sec)[/p][p] [/p][p] [/p][p]4. In-game Items[/p][p]1) Combat Items[/p][p]Players can choose two of the following Combat Items to carry into the game:[/p][p]·Morph Rune: It contains the Herald's Psylith shapeshifting secrets. Use to transform into nearby ordinary objects.[/p][p]· Enigmatic Rift: Summons an Enigmatic Rift that connects a location in a valid area with the current location. (Only accessible for allies.)[/p][p]·Demon Sealing Talisman: Summons a Forbidden Seal at the current location.[/p][p]·Scout Eye: Detects enemies in the selected area[/p][p]·Convoy Flag: Summons a Convoy Chest. After the countdown ends, if the chest is not destroyed, the items stored in it can be sent.[/p][p]·Treasureseer: Reveals the Drunken Fire Crate nearby within 180 sec and increases looting speed.[/p][p]·Wind Horn: A horn carefully crafted by the Herald. Use it to summon the flying eagle to ride on its back to move forward against the wind. The heavier the Relic Bag, the shorter the flying distance.[/p][p]·Enchanting Incense: An incapacitating trap designed by the Herald. Puts an enemy to sleep, allowing you to steal from their Bag. Stealing might alert the enemy, possibly waking them up early. Becomes visible to everyone after 90 sec. Does not work on enemies in Ultimate Focus. You can slap affected teammates to wake them up.[/p][p] [/p][p](2) New Buff Items:[/p][p]·Wedding Wine: Within 600 sec after drinking it, increase Attack by 5% and Damage Reduction by 5%.[/p][p]·Rejuvenation Nectar: Within 600 sec after drinking it, if being attacked, activate self Vitality and gain Armor Recovery for 36 sec, restoring 30 Armor per sec. This effect has a 60-sec cooldown and can be triggered up to 2 times.[/p][p]·Vajra's Sobriety: When being Countered within 300 sec after drinking it, restore 450 Health and your weapon will not drop. Can be triggered up to 2 times.[/p][p]·Green Plum Brew: Within 600 sec after drinking it, if you are airborne because of being attacked by Uppercut Slashes, flash Emerald Glow to interrupt enemies around. This effect has a 60-sec cooldown and can be triggered up to 3 times.[/p][p]·Sorrow-free Dew: Within 600 sec after drinking it, when taking lethal damage, negate the damage and knock back nearby enemies. You will gain 30% Damage Reduction for 5 sec and restore 1000 health. This effect can only be triggered once.[/p][p]·Mythic Dew: Within 600 sec after drinking it, increase maximum Health by 50%.[/p][p]Throat-burning Hard Liquor: For 600s after drinking it, it warms your body and dispels cold, and your melee attacks will trigger fiery explosions, burning all nearby enemies. 120-second cooldown, up to 2 times.[/p][p] [/p][p]5. The Trailblazer season is positioned as a trial season, with the goal of building a more refined gaming experience for the official first season.[/p][p]Based on player feedback and data validation, the following content will be dynamically iterated during the season:[/p][p](1) Weapon Type Expansion: The first phase will introduce 11 weapon types, with more to be added in future updates.[/p][p](2) Collection System Refinement: The initial version includes 6 Collections and 110+ Relics, with more types of collectibles and relics to be introduced in subsequent updates.[/p][p](3) Gameplay Optimization: As the Trailblazer season evolves, gameplay mechanics and features will be dynamically adjusted throughout the season.[/p][p](4) Numerical Balance Iteration: To ensure a fair competitive environment, adjustments will be made to the balance of heroes/weapons/armor/support gear/rubrics as the season progresses.[/p][p](5) Economic System Tuning: To maintain market stability and pricing consistency, the cost of certain items will be dynamically balanced throughout the season.[/p][p](6) Other Adjustments: We will continuously optimize any content that impacts player experience—your feedback is our driving force![/p][p]Your feedback is crucial! Every piece of input during this trial season lays the foundation for the official season.[/p][p] [/p][p]6. Rift Traversal currently does not have controller support, nor is it supported on console platforms. Optimizations are in progress, and we will make it available as soon as possible![/p][p] [/p][p]II. New Mechanism \[Dragonsteed Chariot][/p][p]1. Survival modes (except Immortal War) now feature \[Dragonsteed Chariot]. Each chariot carries three: one driver, two passengers;[/p][p]2. The driver controls the chariot's direction, and passengers can hurl spears to attack;[/p][p]3. Dragonsteed Chariots deal continuous ramming damage while moving and can charge into enemies to create a powerful impact;[/p][p]4. Chariot movement and charging consume durability. Chariots will stop moving at 0 durability, but drivers can consume Weapon Repair Kits to repair them.[/p][p] [/p][p]III. New Ranks[/p][p]1. Ranks beyond \[Asura] will switch to a star-based system, with every 100 points converted to 1 star.[/p][p]2. We're also adding two new ranks at 15 and 30 stars, above \[Unrivaled Asura]: \[Formless Dragon] and \[Infinite Nirvana].[/p][p]Optimized Rank Display on Player Profiles – Players can now toggle the primary ranked mode shown.[/p][p]Developer Notes: // Due to many players focusing on one ranked mode while leaving others at Bronze, the previous parallel display was not ideal. To address this, we’ve emphasized the primary mode’s rank and allowed players to manually select which mode’s rank is showcased. In the future, we’ll enhance multi-mode Asura displays to better highlight players who challenge themselves across all modes.[/p][p]4. In the near future, the Champion Fight system will be introduced. Ranked matches above 4500 points will be classified as \[Champion Fight] matches. \[Champion Fight] matches have a maximum of 16 teams per game. Players earn Champion Fight Points based on combat performance in these matches. These Points accumulate throughout the season and never decrease. As your Champion Fight Points increase, you'll unlock rewards including Profile background and display effects to showcase your achievements.[/p][p] [/p][p]XIV. New Season: Fission[/p][p]Ignis Season will end on Jul. 9, 2025 at 00:00 (UTC)[/p][p]For more details, please see the Season Settlement Notice:
[/p][p][url="https://www.narakathegame.com/news/update/20250627/33459_1243594.html"]https://www.narakathegame.com/news/update/20250627/33459_1243594.html[/url][/p][p][/p][p] [/p][p]V. Fission Battlepass[/p][p]\[Fission] BATTLEPASS is now available, which includes a variety of valuable items and skins! Players can obtain more rewards by unlocking the Advanced Hidden Treasure! You can get a Treasure Scroll at the price of 1,200 Gold and a Glory Scroll at 2,840 Gold.[/p][p] [/p][p]VI. New Item: Wonder Chest[/p][p]Wonder Chest can be gained in Stashes in Ranked Mode and Immortal War, or found through searching in Rift Traversal, or obtained by consuming Fatigue in Showdown. Up to 2 per week.[/p][p]Open to choose one of the following rewards: Void Coin*1,200,000, Imprint Roller*1, Jade Disk*40, 5x Showdown Season XP Bonus*2.[/p][p]Wonder Chest can also be traded on Steam.[/p][p] [/p][p] [/p][p]VII. Brand New Anniversary Events[/p][p]During the 4th Anniversary, all anniversary events will be listed on the Anniversary·Fission page[/p][p]4th Anniversary Duration: 07/09/2025 Update – 08/06/2025 20:00 (UTC)[/p][p]Event Details: Unlock anniversary achievements by completing various anniversary activities.[/p][p] [/p][p]1. Event·Galactic Reform[/p][p]Event Duration: Jul. 9, 2025 Update - Aug. 6, 2025 20:00 (UTC)  [/p][p]Event Rules:[/p][p]1) In the Survival modes, Showdown, and Rift Traversal, players can obtain Starstones and Starsouls by opening stashes, clearing stages, and opening lootable containers. The weekly limit for Starstones and Starsouls resets every Wednesday at 20:00 (UTC). The first reset is at 20:00 on Jul. 16, 2025 (UTC).[/p][p]2) On the event page, players can craft Starstones and Starsouls into Starjades. Crafting Starjades grants random rewards.[/p][p]3) Obtaining Starjades grants Starjade Points, which can be used to unlock attribute bonuses in the Constellation Collection. These bonuses remain available until the event reward claim period ends on Aug.10, 2025, at 20:00 (UTC).[/p][p]4) Each week, visit the Starjade submission page for extra points and rewards.[/p][p]5) Players can gift one Starjade to someone else per day, and can only receive one gifted Starjade daily.[/p][p] [/p][p]2. Event·Heavenly Revelation[/p][p]Event Duration: Jul. 9, 2025 Update - Aug. 6, 2025 20:00 (UTC)  [/p][p]Event Rules:[/p][p]1) During the event, you will receive refreshes at the end of each Survival, Showdown, Rift Traversal, or Casual match based on your in-match actions such as damage dealt, counters, and healing. You can earn up to 120 refreshes from matches per week. Team up with Justice Chamber members or returning players to earn refreshes more quickly.  [/p][p]2) All players start with 10 refreshes. Entering the event page will grant an additional 5 refreshes each day, which do not count toward the weekly limit on refreshes from matches.  [/p][p]3) You can use refreshes to refresh the rewards in this event.  [/p][p]4) During the event, complete weekly quests to earn Astral Coins. Astral Coins can also be earned from other events.  [/p][p]5) You can use Astral Coins to redeem rewards in this event. After redeeming a reward, a new reward will appear in its place. If you do not have enough Astral Coins, you can use Gold to cover the difference.  [/p][p]6) Weekly quests and the weekly limit for refreshes from matches reset every Wednesday at 20:00 (UTC). The first reset will be on Jul. 16, 2025 at 20:00 (UTC).[/p][p] [/p][p]3. Rift Exploration[/p][p]Event Duration: Jul. 9, 2025 Update - Aug. 6, 2025 20:00 (UTC)  [/p][p]Event Rules:[/p][p]1) Complete Heroes' quests to gain Explorer's Mirrors. Spend 10 Explorer's Mirrors on the event map to flip one tile and earn its rewards.  [/p][p]2) Special items such as Scout Bells and Moonbane Charms are hidden in the tiles of the event map. Flipping a tile with a special item will reveal multiple tiles at once.  [/p][p]3) Each event map contains one Grand Prize. Flipping the tile with the Grand Prize will instantly grant all remaining rewards on the map and unlock the next event map.[/p][p]4) During the event, failing your first Rift Traversal escape of the day will grant you a Hero Brew and Void Coins as encouragement.[/p][p] [/p][p]4. Year Four Sign-in[/p][p]Event Duration: Jul. 9, 2025 Update - Aug. 6, 2025 20:00 (UTC)  [/p][p]Event Rules:[/p][p]1. During the event, sign in daily on the event page to claim daily check-in rewards. You can sign in up to 28 times total.[/p][p]2. You can make up for missed sign-ins from the previous 2 days. Once the event countdown ends, the sign-in page will close, and no further make-ups will be available.[/p][p]3. During the event, you can earn milestone rewards after signing in for a total of 1, 7, 14, and 21 days. The reward for 21 days is the Greatsword Extreme Skin \[Dragon Epoch].[/p][p] [/p][p]5. Anniversary Giftbox[/p][p]Event Duration: Jul. 9, 2025 Update - Aug. 6, 2025 20:00 (UTC)  [/p][p]Event Rules:[/p][p]1) During the event, Anniversary Giftboxes will be available. Log in for 7 days to claim 200% Gold and Precious Treasure Choice Gifts. With the Standard Edition, claim 2 Precious Treasure Choice Gifts on day 7. With the Deluxe Edition, claim 10 Precious Treasure Choice Gifts on day 7.[/p][p]2) Each player can unlock only 1 Standard Edition Giftbox and 1 Deluxe Edition Giftbox. Any extras will be automatically converted to Gold of equal value. The Deluxe Edition Giftbox can only be claimed after unlocking the Standard Edition Giftbox.[/p][p]3) Anniversary Giftboxes can only be unlocked during the event. Once unlocked, you can claim daily login rewards. After the event, you'll have 10 extra days to collect any remaining rewards. Rewards not claimed due to missed logins will be lost.[/p][p] [/p][p]6. Anniversary Stats[/p][p]Event Duration: Jul. 9, 2025 Update - Aug. 1, 2025 20:00 (UTC)  [/p][p]Event Rules:[/p][p]During the event, tap View My Anniversary Stats or scan the QR Code to complete quests such as viewing and sharing the Anniversary Stats or viewing others' Anniversary Stats to receive rewards of Illusion Treasure Choice Gift*1, Anniversary Stats Share Gift*1; for more info, please refer to the specific event page.[/p][p] [/p][p]7. Anniversary Deals[/p][p]Event Duration: Jul. 9, 2025 Update - Aug. 6, 2025 20:00 (UTC)  [/p][p]Event Rules:[/p][p]1. During the event, players can purchase three tiers of gift packs: Anniversary Special Offer, Choice Gift of 3, and Choice Gift of 7. Contents are as follows:[/p][p]\[Anniversary Special Offer]: Spend 120 Gold to buy any one specified item.[/p][p]\[Choice Gift of 3]: Choose 1 Outfit + 1 Hairstyle + 1 Weapon, available as combos or separately. Discounts increase with more purchases, up to 50% off.[/p][p]\[Choice Gift of 7]: Choose 1 Outfit + 1 Hairstyle + 1 Weapon + 1 Accessory + 1 Background + 1 Base + 1 Pose, available as combos or separately. Discounts increase with more purchases, up to 70% off.[/p][p]2. Buying all three tiers grants the 4th Anniversary Animated Avatar.[/p][p]3. Discount details: For the same gift pack, buy 1 for 30% off, 2 for 40% off, 3 for 50% off, 4 for 60% off, and 5 - 7 for 70% off.[/p][p]4. The event applies only to cosmetics released before December 20, 2024. Choice Gifts are available only for Legendary cosmetics released before or during Season 14: Aurora.[/p][p] [/p][p]8. Year Four Giftbox[/p][p]Event Duration: Jul. 9, 2025 Update - Aug. 7, 2025 00:00 (UTC)  [/p][p]Event Rules[/p][p]At a price of 0.63 USD, buy it to get 120 Gold, Dual Blades Legendary Skin Twilight Vixen, Splendor Treasure Choice Gift*5 and more rewards over three days![/p][p] [/p][p]VIII. Limited-time Event: Dew Bazaar[/p][p]Event Duration: Jul. 9, 2025 Update - Jul. 15, 2025 20:00 (UTC)  [/p][p]Event Rules:[/p][p]1. The Dew Bazaar will hold a limited-time sale on the tradable \[Akos Hu·Dragon Will Morning Dew Gift]. Use to unlock the Akos Hu Outfit: \[The Dragon·Dauntless] and Hairstyle \[The Dragon·Punch], and Avatar \[Dragon Will·Berserk].[/p][p]2. The first round of sales will begin at 12:00 on Jul. 9 (UTC), followed by the second round at 12:00 on Jul.11 (UTC). Additional stock will be replenished for the second round based on remaining availability. Purchase limits apply per user.[/p][p]3. Using the gift pack more than once will earn you Spectral Silk on subsequent uses.[/p][p]4. For details on the number of items and other information, check the in-game event page.[/p][p] [/p][p]IX. Limited-time Event: Tao Gate·Preface[/p][p]Event Duration: Jul. 9, 2025 Update - Aug. 6, 2025 20:00 (UTC)[/p][p]Event Rules[/p][p]1. During the event, play any Survival Mode (excluding Immortal War) to open Stashes or search for supplies in Rift Traversal mode, with a certain probability of obtaining Aegis Twig.[/p][p]2. notes.title: NARAKA: BLADEPOINT Banned Players List July 1st
notes.content:
[p]Dear players,

NARAKA: BLADEPOINT is committed to creating a fair and healthy competitive environment. We have not only used new anti-cheat technologies, but also established special cheat-reporting reward activities to encourage those players who defend the fairness with us. From now on, players who make outstanding contributions to reporting cheats will get the Legendary spear skin 'Righteous Polearm' .

More details:
1. Players who successfully reported 1 time will get \[Immortal Treasure] X1;

2. Players who successfully report 10 times with low misreport rate will get \[Immortal Treasure] X10 (In order to ensure the efficiency of detecting, please report reasonably);

3. Players who have successfully reported for many times or made great contributions to anti-cheat will get the Legendary spear skin \[Righteous Polearm] X1.

We strongly recommend that players report via in-game report system, so that we can confirm the cheat as soon as possible and record successful report times for you!

From 6/23 - 6/29,  there are 5 players who have successfully reported the cheating or hacking in total and get the reward \[Righteous Polearm]! We hope that more players can become the Justice Supporter on the Morus Isle in the future.

notes.title: NARAKA: BLADEPOINT Update – June 19th, 2025
notes.content:
[h1][b]NARAKA: BLADEPOINT Update – June 19th, 2025[/b][/h1][p]Dear players,[/p][p]The servers of NARAKA: BLADEPOINT will be suspended for maintenance from Jun. 18th, 2025 23:00 (UTC) to Jun. 19th, 2025 04:00 (UTC). We suggest you log out in advance and enter the game again after the maintenance.[/p][p]The details for this update are as follows:[/p][h1][b]Brand New Content[/b][/h1][h2]I. Brand-new Casual Gameplay: \[Blessed Brutality][/h2][p]New PvP Mode—Blessed Brutality, Now Live![/p][p]Team up in pairs for casual competition! Choose Anima Rings, gain blessings, and crush your enemies![/p][p]Each defeat reduces your team's morale. When morale hits zero, you're eliminated.[/p][p]*Dev Note: Reduced the Rage Rate of Justina Gu's Ultimate \[Arctic Wraith: Frostwind], Tessa's Ultimate \[Enchant] and \[Enchant: Group Prey] in the Blessed Brutality mode.[/p][p] [/p][h2]II. Limited-time Event: The Anonymity Game[/h2][p]Strange music echoes through the sealed music hall... Detectives, move out![/p][p]Take your heart![/p][p]1. During the event, explore the map to find the buried treasure in each area.[/p][p]2. Players can earn Hearts of Rebellion by entering the event daily and completing exploration quests within the area. Heart of Rebellion is the action item for the event. Hearts of Rebellion will be consumed while exploring.[/p][p]3. Other than the Completion Reward, each area contains other exploration rewards, so make sure you explore locations beyond the objective.[/p][p]4. Once the event ends, any remaining Hearts of Rebellion can be exchanged for Spectral Silk at a 1:1 ratio through the event interface.[/p][p]Event Duration: Jun. 18th, 2025 20:00 (UTC) - Jul. 2nd, 2025 20:00 (UTC)[/p][p]Claim Rewards Deadline: Jul. 5, 2025 20:00 (UTC)[/p][p] [/p][h2]III. Limited-time Event: Four Banes[/h2][p]Event Duration: Jun. 18th, 2025 20:00 (UTC) - Jun. 28, 2025 20:00 (UTC)[/p][p]Event Rules: During the event, participate in the new Blessed Brutality mode and complete quests to earn Jade Disks. Exchange Jade Disks for rewards at the Lunar Pavilion.[/p][p] [/p][h2]IV. Limited-time Event: Fresh Start[/h2][p]Event Duration: Jun. 25th, 2025 20:00 (UTC) - Jul. 2nd, 2025 20:00 (UTC)[/p][p]Event Rules[/p][p]1. During the event, sign in daily on the event page to claim daily sign-in rewards. You can sign in up to 7 times total. You can earn milestone rewards after signing in for a total of 3 days and 7 days.[/p][p]2. If you miss a daily sign-in during the event, you can make it up the following day when you log in. Make-up is not available after the event ends.[/p][p]3. Player sign-ins also contribute to the server progress. Once the server goal is reached, all players who log in after July 3rd, 2025 at 01:00 (UTC) can claim a special bonus reward. Any player who logs in during the entire anniversary event period is eligible to claim this reward.[/p][p] [/p][h1][b]Hero Adjustments[/b][/h1][h2]I. Lannie[/h2][p]The following adjustments have been made to skill \[Vanishing Act: Lift]:[/p][p]1. The carpet during flight and when exiting flight can now interrupt enemies' Golden Focus Strikes.[/p][p]2. Increased skill CD from 22 sec to 23 sec.[/p][p] [/p][p]The following adjustments have been made to the Ultimate \[Tricky Bounce]:[/p][p]1. During her Ultimate, if Lannie takes cumulative damage reaching the threshold, the Ultimate will be forcibly ended.[/p][p]2. Lannie can interrupt Golden Focus Strikes while using her Skill to fly.[/p][p]3. Trick Ball explosion damage reduced from 3.3 to 3.2.[/p][p]4. Optimized visual effects for certain Gestures.[/p][p] [/p][p]The following adjustments have been made to Ultimate \[Tricky Bounce: Leap]:[/p][p]1. Health restored when Trick Balls return or are successfully caught reduced from 200 to 150.[/p][p]2. Reduced maximum flight distance when charged Trick Balls miss environmental targets.[/p][p]3. Reduced knockback height while increased the knockback range from Trick Ball explosions.[/p][p]4. Increased startup frames after successful Trick Ball catch before striking.[/p][p]5. Optimized visual effects for certain Gestures.[/p][p]//Dev Notes: Lannie's survivability and combo potential were too dominant in the current meta, so we've raised the requirement for her combos while reducing her recovery capabilities.[/p][p] [/p][h2]II. Akos Hu[/h2][p]Adjusted the Defensive Focus of the 3rd \[Pounce] when casting to Golden Skill Focus.[/p][p] [/p][h2]III. Temulch[/h2][p]When casting his Ultimate, Temulch will immediately face the aimed direction.[/p][p] [/p][h2]IV. Hadi[/h2][p]1. While Hadi is flying with his Ultimate, his 3rd-stage charged attacks can now be blocked by countering. A player who blocks an attack this way will not be able to trigger Counterstrike Combos as a follow-up.[/p][p]//Dev Notes: As it stands, when Hadi's attacks are blocked, both sides become Golden Focused and act as though they clashed. Other rules follow clash mechanics: equal stagger time with no counterstrikes possible, both sides take minor clash damage, and Fans/Daggers can still trigger Soulbreak off of horizontal strikes.[/p][p]2. When flying with his Ultimate, Hadi recovers Health or Armor equal to 20% of damage dealt with his 3rd-stage charged attacks.[/p][p]3. When casting an Ultimate (either \[Aerial Ascent] or \[Aerial Ascent: Blaze]), Hadi recovers 200 Health (excess converts to Armor).[/p][p] [/p][h2]V. Matari[/h2][p]Slightly reduced the thrust distance of skill \[Flash: Thrust] when charged, and slightly reduced the AoE of the strike when charged.[/p][p] [/p][h2]VI. Other Adjustments[/h2][p]Fixed issues where certain Ultimate visual effects didn't match actual effects in high latency and network fluctuation scenarios (such as Yueshan's Ultimate activation).[/p][p] [/p][h1]Weapon Adjustments[/h1][h2]I. Flying Knives[/h2][p]1. Appropriately increased recovery frames for the Charged Vertical Strike \[Rapid Throw] and the Charged Vertical Strike Souljade \[Palm Lightning].[/p][p]2. Reduced the damage multiplier of the 1st stage Charged Horizontal Strikes \[Sunder The Stars] from 4.22 to 3.94.[/p][p]3. Reduced the damage multiplier of the 2nd stage Charged Horizontal Strikes \[Rend The Moon] from 3.47+2.08 to 3.24+1.94.[/p][p]4. Reduced the stagger inflicted by 1st stage Vertical Strikes on targets that are on the ground.[/p][p]5. Reduced the stagger inflicted by Vertical Strikes on targets that are in mid-air, and increased the number of recovery frames.[/p][p]6. Appropriately reduced the AoE of 2nd stage Horizontal Strikes.[/p][p][/p][p]//Dev Notes: Flying Knives were too dominant against other weapons currently, so we've increased vulnerability windows while reducing damage output to improve counterplay options.[/p][p] [/p][p] [/p][h1][b]Souljade Adjustments[/b][/h1][p]I. Buff Souljade[/p][p]\[Focus Slide] returns with the following adjustments:[/p][p]1. Increased startup frames and can now be countered.[/p][p]2. Increased the damage multiplier from 1 to 1.52.[/p][p] [/p][p] [/p][p] [/p][h1][b]In-Game Adjustments[/b][/h1][h2]I. Feature Optimizations[/h2][p]New feature Smart Swap: Enable in Settings > Assist to automatically display the smart swap interface when better armor or weapons are within pickup range. Press the swap key to equip the recommended gear.[/p][p] [/p][h2]II. Mechanism Adjustments[/h2][p]Realm of Spirit adjustments: During the Realm of Spirit registration period, you can open the Realm of Spirit interface from the spectator interface to register. Realm of Spirit begins when enough participants join.[/p][p] [/p][h2]III. Immortal War Adjustments[/h2][p]1. After the 6th wave of Shadow Corruption ends, Kylin Zhang's \[Qilin Guard] no longer blocks Health loss from the Shadow Corruption.[/p][p]2. After the 6th wave of Shadow Corruption ends, the damage from Shadow Corruption now ignores Valda Cui's and Cyra's light shields, directly reducing their Health.[/p][p] [/p][h1][b]Out-of-Game Adjustments[/b][/h1][h2]I. Team Up[/h2][p]Team Up now includes team blocking. A team with players you blocked won't be recommended to you, and the system will gradually reduce recommendations for such players' teams.[/p][p] [/p][h2]II. Lobby Music[/h2][p]Added Persona 5 Royal crossover music "Life Will Change" to the lobby playlist. Enjoy![/p][p] [/p][h1]Showdown Adjustments[/h1][h2]I. Combat Adjustments[/h2][p]1. Potential \[Incorporeal] now allows ranged weapons to chain dodge before follow-up attacks after successful counters.[/p][p]2. Potential \[Element Fury] gains 15% Poison Blast damage bonus. Potential \[Element Afterglow] gains 20% Divine Thunder damage bonus.[/p][p]3. Increased the total additional strike multiplier of Souljades \[Thunder Shot], \[Ice Bomb], \[Toxic Shot] to 3.5, removing the "increased elemental accumulation on monsters" effect.[/p][p]4. Increased the Attack bonus of Poison Blast Souljade \[Element Surge] from 10% to 12%, Divine Thunder damage bonus from 40% to 55%. And removed the 20% Burn damage debuff. Poison-wielding Souljade \[Element Surge] gains 25% Poison Blast damage bonus.[/p][p]5. The trigger condition for the Souljade \[Thunder Chain] is changed from "After every 6 instances of Divine Thunder damage dealt" to "5 instances".[/p][p]6. Advanced the timing of Golden Focus runes during \[Huanyue]'s ring sword energy attacks in phase one, and adjusted the hitstun and knockback parameters to reduce the possibility of being hit consecutively by both strikes.[/p][p]7. Reduced the damage of certain sword energy moves during \[Huanyue]'s 1st stage and adjusted the damage of different backward moves for consistency.[/p][p]8. Adjusted \[Huanyue] AI for both phases, reducing frequency of certain attack combos and making attack patterns better match her combat range.[/p][p]9. Optimized facial expressions during \[Huanyue]'s execution attacks in phase two, and adjusted timing of strikes for better visual coherence.[/p][p]10. Reduced the damage taken when hit by multiple projectiles from the \[Astral Deer Sorcerer]'s moves.[/p][p] [/p][h2]II. Stage Adjustments[/h2][p]1. Nirriti's Ruins Adjustments[/p][p](1) Optimized portal and Nirriti Codex spawn locations across all stages.[/p][p](2) Added a map marker in \[Rolling in Riches] to guide you to the portal after clearing the stage.[/p][p](3) Enhanced the audio effects played when portals to special stages unlocked by Nirriti Codices appear.[/p][p] [/p][h2]III. Yama's Abyss Adjustments[/h2][p]Quick restart or advancing to the next stage in Yama's Abyss now resets Deadeye mode and any Deadeye buildup.[/p][p] [/p][h2]IV. Feature Adjustments[/h2][p]1. Starting now, log into Showdown weekly to claim Chaos Stone*10 through login quests to boost Curio crafting levels.[/p][p]Crafting levels will carry forward permanently to help with your future Tempered Inferno progression![/p][p]Even with maxed crafting levels, you can complete weekly Curio crafting quests to claim 10 Souljade Fragments.[/p][p]2. Fixed an issue where maxed Souljade attributes were not displayed as maxed in ratings.[/p][p]3. Optimized Souljade recommendation logic to prioritize higher-rated Souljades.[/p][p]4. Optimized the layout of modes in Showdown map interface.[/p][p]5. Added new recast material "Small Souljade Fragment" to replace some Rare Souljade drops in Normal+ difficulty main stages and Nirriti's Ruins.[/p][p]//Dev Notes: Without Souljade upgrades, excess Rare Souljades were being converted to Epic/Legendary and then deconstructed, which is tedious. We've removed some Rare drops and replaced them with recast materials while reducing Small Souljade Fragment costs compared to Rare Souljades in recasting.[/p][p] [/p][h1]Settings[/h1][h2]I. New Notification Settings[/h2][p]Added a feature in Settings > Gameplay > Settings: "Red dot notifications for new cosmetics"[/p][p]When enabled, receive a red dot notification when new cosmetic items are obtained for heroes, weapons, or other gear.[/p][p]When switching to \[Legendary or higher] or \[Extreme or higher], notifications for items below required rarity will be turned off, and existing notifications for those items will be cleared.[/p][p] [/p][h1]Feature Optimizations[/h1][h2]I. Client[/h2][p]Increased custom face slot limit per hero from 6 to 10.[/p][p] [/p][h1][b]Store Updates[/b][/h1][h2]I. New Packs[/h2][p]1. Added Wuchen exclusive \[JOKER Pack], which contains the Wuchen exclusive Legendary Outfit \[P5R·JOKER] and the Epic Accessory \[P5R·JOKER Hairstyle]. Standard price: 2,600 Gold; Now: 240 Gold. Individual cosmetics have their own discounts, but the Pack discount is even bigger![/p][p]2. Added Zai exclusive Pack \[PANTHER Pack], which contains Zai exclusive Legendary Outfit \[P5R·PANTHER], Legendary Hairstyle \[P5R·PANTHER], Legendary Accessory \[P5R·PANTHER's Tail]. Standard price: 3,500 Gold; Now: 1,750 Gold. Individual cosmetics have their own discounts, but the Pack discount is even bigger![/p][p]3. Added Kurumi exclusive Pack \[VIOLET Pack], which contains the Legendary Outfit \[P5R·VIOLET] and the Legendary Hairstyle \[P5R·VIOLET Hairstyle]. Standard price: 2,600 Gold; Now: 1,300 Gold. Individual cosmetics have their own discounts, but the Pack discount is even bigger![/p][p]4. Added Wuchen Voice Pack \[Joker Chinese/Japanese Voice Pack], which contains both \[Joker Chinese Voice Pack (Wuchen)] and \[Joker Japanese Voice Pack (Wuchen)]. Standard price: 2,000 Gold; Now: 800 Gold. Individual voice packs have their own discounts, but the Pack discount is even bigger[/p][p]5. Added Zai Voice Pack \[PANTHER Chinese/Japanese Voice Pack], which contains both \[PANTHER Chinese Voice Pack (Zai)] and \[PANTHER Japanese Voice Pack (Zai)]. Standard price: 2,000 Gold; Now: 800 Gold. Individual voice packs have their own discounts, but the Pack discount is even bigger[/p][p]6. Added Kurumi Voice Pack \[VIOLET Chinese/Japanese Voice Pack], which contains both \[VIOLET Chinese Voice Pack (Zai)] and \[VIOLET Japanese Voice Pack (Zai)]. Standard price: 2,000 Gold; Now: 800 Gold. Individual voice packs have their own discounts, but the Pack discount is even bigger[/p][p]7. Added Feria Shen Voice Pack \[NOIR Chinese/Japanese Voice Pack], which contains both \[NOIR Chinese Voice Pack (Feria Shen)] and \[NOIR Japanese Voice Pack (Feria Shen)]. Standard price: 2,000 Gold; Now: 800 Gold. Individual voice packs have their own discounts, but the Pack discount is even bigger[/p][p] [/p][p] [/p][h2]II. New Discounts[/h2][p]1. Newly added Flying Knives Legendary Skin \[Lucky Poker]. Standard price: 1,500 Gold; Now: 1,250 Gold.[/p][p]2. Newly added Wuchen Legendary Accessory \[Black-Rimmed Glasses]. Standard price: 1,200 Gold; Now: 120 Gold.[/p][p]3. Newly added Kurumi Legendary Pose \[VIOLET·All-Out Attack]. Standard price: 900 Gold. Now: 360 Gold.[/p][p]4. Newly added Legendary Base \[P5R·Morgana Car]. Standard price: 1,200 Gold; Now: 800 Gold.[/p][p]5. Newly added Legendary Mark of Victory \[P5R·Calling Card]. notes.title: NARAKA: BLADEPOINT Update – June 5th, 2025
notes.content:
Dear players,
The servers of NARAKA: BLADEPOINT will be suspended for maintenance from June 4th, 2025 23:00 (UTC) to June 5th, 2025 04:00 (UTC). We suggest you log out in advance and enter the game again after the maintenance.
The details for this update are as follows:
Brand New Content
I. Showdown Season 3.0: Windstorm
1. New Hero: Justina Gu
The Herald stirs. Ancient shadows awaken. Three legendary blades cross paths for the first time.
What alliance could bring together Justina Gu, the Saint Eagle of Holoroth, and the Wolf King of the Prairie against impossible odds?
The new Hero Justina Gu has now joined Showdown. Her blade weaves frost and shadow, cleansing corruption from every realm.

2. New Boss and New Chapter
Something sinister awakens in the silent Empyreal Village. Beneath twisted totem poles, a woman clad in wolf pelts emerges from the darkness...
Three hundred years of desert storms could not bury Sirius' fury—Huanyue, one of the elders of the Herald, walks among mortals once more.
The brand new Showdown series [Tenfold Doom: The Herald Elder Council] officially begins, with the new chapter [Howling Gale] now live!
//Dev Notes: We're streamlining our storytelling approach and update cadence. While keeping the same 4 stages per 2 seasons, we're now delivering a steady 2 stages each season for better pacing.
Plus, starting this season, every new stage's Easy mode is unlocked from the get-go; no requirements, no level gates. You can all enjoy the Showdown saga and face our latest bosses right away.

3. Trial Heroes and Team Support
(1) When teaming up with other players, you can select 2 heroes displayed in your teammate's profiles and their corresponding loadouts during the preparation phase. As teammates, they can also directly configure loadouts and provide these support heroes during the preparation phase. System trial heroes are also available when not in a team.
(2) Initial trial attempts are 2 per week. Upgrade your Showdown season level to unlock more attempts.
(3) Provide support heroes for Popularity points, Souljade Fragments, and Scented Sachet rewards.
(4) This feature is available in Normal/Hard stages, Doom mode, and Topaz Enigma Domain.
(5) Trial attempts and reward progress reset every Thursday at 4:00 AM.

4. New Showdown Journey Quests
Starting with [Windstorm Season], each new Showdown season will feature exclusive Journey Quests. The existing beginner's Journey Quests will still be available.
How to Unlock: After completing the beginner's Journey Quests, participate in Showdown to automatically unlock the Journey Quest of the current season.
Quest and Rewards: Within the limited event period after the season begins, complete any Showdown stage daily to claim daily rewards. Complete 7 days of quests to receive generous Journey rewards: powerful Souljade sets and precious Showdown resources—Flux Jade Shards.

5. Nirriti's Ruins and Yama's Abyss Reset
Yama's Abyss, Nirriti's Ruins, and season challenge progress and rewards have been reset.
Take on Yama's Abyss and Nirriti's Ruins this season for Splendor Treasure Choice Gift, Showdown Seal, Flux Shard, limited-edition avatars, and much more!

6. Brand-new Gameplay
(1) New "Element Surge" Souljades. Max out your elemental meter and unleash devastating power. Works with Ice, Thunder, and Poison builds.
(2) Bow and Musket now support Quick Counter.
(3) Ranged weapons now feature the "Cloudpiercer" mechanism. Build up your Deadeye meter through shooting, then enter Deadeye mode for advanced techniques. Bow and Musket lead the charge with weakness exploitation and signature Deadeye skills.
(4) Potential levels have been reset. We've overhauled all existing potential effects and added new ones for Element Surge and Deadeye, providing a wider range of combo selections!

7. Sense Level Redesigned as Showdown Level
Sense levels for Showdown Souljades and heroes are now unified as "Showdown Level", and we're merging Potential levels into it too.
Your maximum Sense level of Souljades in Might Season will be partially carried over and converted to your Showdown Level. levels 1050 and below don't transfer, but every 5 levels above 1050 becomes 1 Showdown Level (i.e., maxed Lv. 1120 becomes Lv. 15).
Earn Showdown XP through weekly Showdown quests or Fatigue usage to upgrade your Showdown Level. Higher levels mean more potential points and massive attribute boosts.
//Dev Notes: The new Showdown Level system removes barriers for newcomers.
Additionally, it eliminates the tedious grind when experimenting with different Souljade builds. No more wasted drops on upgrades, and there will be more recasting materials.

8. Season Settlements
Might Season will end on June 5th, 2025 00:00 (UTC)
Season Rewards:
Rank Requirement	Rewards
<Showdown Bronze>	Avatar [Might·Showdown Bronze]
<Showdown Silver>	Avatar [Might·Showdown Silver]
<Showdown Gold>	Avatar [Might·Showdown Gold]
<Showdown Platinum>	Avatar [Might·Showdown Platinum]
<Showdown Solar>	Avatar [Might·Showdown Solar], [Splendor Treasure Choice Gift]*2, [Showdown Seal]*5
<Showdown Empyrean>	Avatar [Might·Showdown Empyrean], [Splendor Treasure Choice Gift]*3, [Showdown Seal]*10, Hero Badge [Might·Showdown Empyrean]
<Showdown Astral>	Avatar [Might·Showdown Astral], [Splendor Treasure Choice Gift]*5, [Showdown Seal]*15, Hero Badge [Might·Showdown Astral]
<Showdown Paragon>	Avatar [Might·Showdown Paragon], [Splendor Treasure Choice Gift]*10, [Showdown Seal]*20, Hero Badge [Might·Showdown Paragon]

(2) Showdown Leaderboard Rewards
Players will be rewarded with an Avatar that corresponds to the highest rank that they held on the Yama's Abyss leaderboards at any point during this Showdown Might Season (recorded either at weekly settlement or at season settlement). Additionally, the top 3 players on any Yama's Abyss Hero leaderboard will receive an exclusive Hero Badge.


II. Showdown Limited-time modes
Vinemire Gone Wild events
Vinemire has descended into madness, and rampages throughout Showdown! What path will you take?
During the event:
1. There's a chance for [Vinemire Gone Wild] to trigger while facing the boss in main Showdown stages (excluding Immovable, None Shall Pass, Vibrations, and Buried Giant), Topaz Enigma Domain, and Nirriti's Ruins.
2. While Vinemire attacks all indiscriminately while on a rampage, its hatred of the boss far outweighs that of the heroes.
3. In some cases, the rampaging Vinemire may leave the battle of its own accord.


III. MVP Highlight
We're rolling out MVP highlight reels. In the end of Capture the Spirit Well, Golden Roc Escort, The Bloodbath, and Showdown Trios mode (Enigma Domain, Nirriti's Ruins, Doom, Tempered Inferno), the highlight clips of the MVP of that game will be displayed to everyone present.

IV. Safe Exit for Non-Premade Teams During Prep
In non-premade teams, if a teammate leaves during the preparation phase and the match begins with fewer players, you can now exit early without penalty or match result being recorded, as long as you have not engaged in combat within a set time after the match starts.

V. New Look for Fairyland Penglai's Music Zone
1. Music Zone has been redesigned as a standing microphone, with three performance instruments added to the stage area: guitar, drum sets, and keyboard. Form a band with your friends!
2. Music Zone appearance has been refreshed, with stage effects that pulse with the music rhythm.

VI. Limited-time Event: Rising Soundwave
Event Duration: June 4th, 2025 20:00 (UTC) - Jun. 18, 2025 20:00 (UTC)
Event Rules
1. The event includes 4 Proficiency quest groups: drum set, keyboard, guitar, and microphone. Each is unlocked in turn, one after the other. Complete their quests to receive Golden Records, used to redeem event rewards.
2. Completing a quest grants 1 of its quest group's Proficiency points. Gain 4 Proficiency to unlock that instrument's Audio Track.
3. Audio Tracks can be stacked and played, and freely combined together. Once all 4 instruments have been unlocked, you can play the full band piece: "The Blade Blossoms".

VII. Limited-time Event: Soundwave Storm
Event Duration: June 4th, 2025 20:00 (UTC) - Jun. 18, 2025 20:00 (UTC)
Collect Soundwave Storm cosmetics during the event, exchange for exclusive event rewards, and claim valuable Gold Chests!

VIII. Limited-time Events: Windscourge
Event Duration: Jun. 4th, 2025 20:00 (UTC) - Jun. 18, 2025 20:00 (UTC)
1. Gain Demon Discs by completing quests during the event. Demon Discs can be redeemed for great event rewards.
2. Complete each day's Daily Quests to receive bonus rewards.
3. There are 5 groups of Challenge Quests, each available in turn at different times. Complete quests to claim plentiful rewards.
4. The rewards are redeemable till June 25, 2025 at 20:00 (UTC). Please redeem the rewards in time.



IX. PlayStation Challenge
Challenge the wind in this race! PlayStation Sky-high Racing #15 is now open!
Compete against players worldwide and ascend the rankings by achieving a place among the Top 100 fastest in Sky-high Racing mode.
How to participate:
Start Sky-high Racing on Fairyland Penglai to participate in the event.
Event Duration: Jun. 5, 2025 00:00 (UTC) - Jul. 2, 2025 23:59 (UTC)

X. 2nd PlayStation® Tournaments #6
The rivers and lakes awaken, where the blade reveals its true prowess. 2nd PlayStation® Tournaments #6 are available for a limited time!
Event Duration: Jun. 5, 2025 20:00 (UTC) - Jul. 2, 2025 20:00 (UTC)
Event Rules
Complete weekly quests during the event to claim Jade Medal - JUN. You can claim more Medals in the mail after advancing, and the quantity awarded for each rank is as follows:
1st place: 300 Medals
2nd place: 200 Medals
3rd-4th place: 100 Medals
5th-8th place: 50 Medals 
Medals can be used for redeeming rewards and participating in rankings.

Hero Adjustments
I. Tianhai
1. Slightly increased the strike range of skills (Stomp) when unarmed in Ultimate Titan's Call status and optimized the knockback effect.
2. In Ultimate Titan's Call status, when using skills, you will immediately face the crosshair direction.
//Dev Notes: We optimized the strike range and knockback effect of Titan's Call to make it easier to follow up with horizontal strikes and vertical strike grabs after skill hits, ramping up the pressure on close-range opponents.

II. Takeda Nobutada
Adjusted the Defensive Focus of skill [Mythic Grab: Dash] when released to Golden Focus (Skill).

III. Lyam Liu
Adjusted the defensive focus after [Magnet Attract] strike takes effect to Golden Focus (Skill).

IV. Tarka Ji
The horizontal and vertical counter moves of [Flame Force] can no longer interrupt Golden Focus (Skill), but can still interrupt Golden Focus (Move).

Weapon Adjustments
I. Long-handle Weapon
Slightly increased the counter detection range of long-handle weapons.

II. Nunchucks
Slightly reduced the counter detection range of nunchucks.


Souljade Adjustments
I. Souljades
Souljade [Stormstride] is now renamed to [Bolt Rod].

In-Game Adjustments
I. Feature Optimizations
1. Survival modes now guarantee a common melee weapon in the first stash you crack open each match. No more punching air after landing.
2. Failed pickup attempts now flag the target item with lower priority automatically. This optimization aims to avoid the scenario of frequently pressing E while moving but failing to pick up target items.

Out-of-Game Adjustments
I. Match History Interface Optimization
The match history interface has been optimized to distinguish between The Herald's Trial and Showdown.

II. Added Automatic Switching for Glyph Plans
1. You can preset match types for automatic Glyph Plan switching in the lobby. Glyph Plans will automatically equip when the preset match type is met.
2. Automatic Glyph Plan switching match types are divided into Solo, Duos, and Trios. This feature applies to all modes in The Herald's Trial that allow Potential Plan switching.


Showdown Adjustments
I. Battle Adjustments
1. Souljades [Stormstride], [Stormstride Sword], [Thunder Sword], [Arcane Thunder], [Thunder Mastery], [Thundercall Shot] are now renamed to [Bolt Rod], [Bolt Effort], [Charged Bolt], [Arcane Stratos], [Bolt Mastery], [Bolt Shot].
2. Anima Rings [Thunderbolt Resonance], [Thunder Array], [Static Recharge], [Enhanced Thunderbolt], [Thunderbolt Chain], [Incessant Thunder Array], [Lightning Rod·White], [Lightning Rod·Blue], [Lightning Rod·Might], [Lightning Rod·Red], [Lightning Rod·Defuse], [Thundercall Charm] are now renamed to [Bolt Resonance], [Bolt Array], [Bolt Recharge], [Enhanced Bolt], [Bolt Chain], [Incessant Bolt Array], [Bolt·White], [Bolt·Blue], [Bolt·Might], [Bolt·Red], [Bolt·Defuse], [Bolt Charm].
3. Souljade [Depths Blast] now builds more Frostbite on you when triggering Ice Blast.
4. Optimized the indicator effect when triggering Divine Thunder at full ThunderShock.
5. Monsters gained a new category of [Golden Focus (Glyph)] moves that cannot be resolved by "Defuse·Solve," "Defuse·Combo," or "Defuse·Dash" moves.
6. Adjusted the model of monster [Hanged Ent].
7. Adjusted the model of monster [Twin Hammer Ent] and added new moves.

II. Hero Adjustments
1. Tianhai
(1) Extended the duration of skill [Divine Bell: Showdown] and increased Damage Multiplier, while correspondingly reducing its Damage Multiplier to Astral Aegis.
(2) Duration of his Ultimate [Titan's Call: Showdown] is changed from 15 sec to 20 sec, and successful counter during Ultimate extends transformation duration by 3 sec.

2. Valda Cui
(1) Adjusted the skill [Water Trap: Showdown] effect to:
Shoots toward the aimed direction and generate multiple [Water Bombs]. They deal damage when contacting enemies and reduces their Astral Aegis, while applying [Soaked].
· Hold to aim.
· Detonating the large Water Bomb at the center will additionally generate [Water Mark].
(2) Adjusted the Ultimate [Rising Tide: Showdown] effect to:
Leap into mid-air, and can cast multiple [Water Spears] for 8 sec.
· Horizontal or vertical strikes throw binding water spears that apply [Soaked] and [Tender Aegis].
· Hit [Water Mark] or large Water Bombs with water spears to detonate them for additional damage.

3. Yoto Hime
(1) Increased damage multiplier of skill [Flying Edge: Showdown].
(2) Increased damage multiplier of each slash in her Ultimate [Demon Blade: Showdown].

III. Stage Adjustments
1. Enigma Domain Adjustments
(1) Adjusted boss monsters appearing in Enigma Domain.
(2) Adjusted the Enigma Domain to non-Morus Legends mode.
2. Yama's Abyss Adjustments
Updated monsters and omens in all Yama's Abyss stages.

IV. Nirriti's Ruins Adjustments
1. Adjusted Nirriti's Ruins stages, added scenes beyond Eventide Temple, and adjusted monster deployment logic.
2. Optimized stage "Eradicating the Evil" in Ghost Face Peak, removed stage "Strike It Rich", and added new stage "Rolling Fortune".
3. Adjusted the settlement logic for portal mechanisms when all team members have made selections. Now it immediately proceeds to the next stage.
4. Adjusted Anima Ring series for ranged weapons:
· Added [Primed Shot], [Reinforced Cartridge], [Endless Precision], [Marksman's Ward], and [Healing Shot].
· Optimized effects of [Second Wind], [Enhanced Ranged Weapon], [Energized Cartridge], [Archer's Blessing], [Ranged Blessing I], and [Ranged Blessing II].
· No longer drop [Serration·Weapon Repair Kit], [Honed Cartridge], [Lethal Barrage], [Recouping Ammo], and [Finale Shot].
5. Added "Blessing" Anima Rings for each series; added secret Anima Ring [Borrowed Time].

V. Omen System
1. Added Pomegrenade omen mechanism: Pomegrenades grow from the ground, exploding and building your ThunderShock when you approach; you can attack these fruits to damage nearby enemies.
2. Omens [Lightning Rod] and [Forked Lightning] renamed to [Bolt Rod] and [Bolt Ghost Call].

VI. Function Adjustments
1. Added Showdown Souljade Rating
To assess Souljade value more clearly, we've introduced a new Souljade rating system.
(1) Every Souljade gets a comprehensive score based on quality, secondary attributes, and elemental attributes. Higher numbers mean better potential. You can check the ratings in the Souljade tooltip interface.
(2) Personal profiles and Souljade screens in Showdown now show your character's total Souljade score instead of Sense level.
(3) Added "Keep Best Rating Per Type" option in Souljade Deconstruction interface for quick filtering while preserving optimal Souljades.
(4) Added "Sort by Rating" option in Souljade Deconstruction, Conversion, and Inventory interfaces for management and filtering based on rating.

2. Curio Deactivated
The Chaos Furnace is almost empty. All Curios have been deactivated.
Curios can no longer take effect during this phase, but you can still consume unused crafting materials to increase your crafting level, which carries forward permanently.
When the Chaos Furnace reconcentrates its essence and the "Tempered Inferno" mode reopens in the new season, new Curios will appear, while your previous Curios and crafting materials will be reclaimed.

3. Item "5x Potential XP Bonus" Adjusted to "5x Showdown Season XP Bonus"
After Potential level merges into Showdown Level, "Potential XP Bonus" in your inventory will upgrade to "Showdown Season XP Bonus" with unchanged effects.

4. Showdown Weapon Data Adjustment
Starting from Windstorm Season, weapon data in Showdown will be calculated separately from The Herald's Trial, recording distinctive Showdown data (excluding Nirriti's Ruins mode).

5. Season Collection and Souljade Redeem Added to Narakapedia
Starting from Windstorm Season, seasonal Souljade collection rewards will be added to Narakapedia. Collect Souljades in the new season for rewards, which reset with season updates.
New Souljade category "Commemorative" is added. For each Showdown season, based on Souljade selection rates and performance, underperforming Souljades will be removed from drops and archived in "Commemorative Souljades."
Commemorative Souljades can still be used and can be directly redeemed in Narakapedia using Souljade Fragments.


VII. Souljade Drop Adjustments
1. The following Showdown Souljades will no longer drop from regular stages or Souljade Gifts:
[Condensed Qi], [Lotus Recovery], [Astral Break], [Lotus Barrier], [Reawakening], [Defuse·Thaw], [Against the Odds].

2. New Exclusive Drops:
Buried Giant·Hard: New special drop [Cyan Fang·Element].
Dangers in the Deep·Hard, Dangers in the Deep·Nightscream: New special drop [Tundra Might].

Settings
I. Assist Settings
New feature [Weapon Slot Souljade Compatibility Indicator]. When enabled, displays Souljade compatibility information at weapon slots.


Feature Optimizations
I. In-game
1. Unified the movement distance of hero skills and ultimates that can move toward aimed direction across different frame rate environments to better match expected effects, such as: Justina Gu's [Arctic Wraith], Matari's [Flash: Thrust], Yueshan's [Scorching Dash: Ambition], etc.
2. Fixed an issue of abnormal airborne height caused by strikes in extremely high latency environments.
3. New feature [Block Special Effects of Showdown Teammates] in Settings-Game-Combat. When enabled, it blocks some special summoning effects from Souljades, Curios, Anima Rings, etc. equipped by your teammates in [Showdown] mode.

Store Updates
I. New Pack
1. Added Justina Gu exclusive Pack [Stellar Radiance], which contains the Legendary Outfit [Soundwave Storm·Stellar Radiance], Dual Halberds Legendary Skin [Soundwave Storm·Azure Echo] and Legendary Hairstyle [Highlights] [Soundwave Storm·Dark Star]. Standard price: 4,800 Gold; Now: 3,000 Gold. Individual cosmetics have their own discounts, but the Pack discount is even bigger!
2. Added the Yoto Hime exclusive Pack [Pure Punk], which contains the exclusive Legendary Outfit [Soundwave Storm·Pure Punk] and the Greatsword Legendary Skin [Soundwave Storm·Violet Keys]. Standard price: 4,200 Gold; Now: 2,880 Gold. Individual cosmetics have their own discounts, but the Pack discount is even bigger!
3. Added Lannie exclusive Pack [Forever Young], which contains the Legendary Outfit [Soundwave Storm·Forever Young], Legendary Accessory [Soundwave Storm·Limited Monitor], and Legendary Hairstyle [Highlights] [Soundwave Storm·Flute] . Standard price: 4,500 Gold; Now: 2,900 Gold. Individual cosmetics have their own discounts, but the Pack discount is even bigger!
4. Newly added Temulch exclusive Pack [Thunder Beats], including Legendary Outfit [Soundwave Storm·Thunder Beats], Legendary Hairstyle [Soundwave Storm·Rebel Bone]. Standard price: 2,600 Gold; Now: 1,800 Gold. Single items are discounted, and you get even more discounts when you purchase a Pack.

II. New Discounts
1. Newly added Legendary Pose [Fragrant Breeze] for all heroes. Standard price: 900 Gold; Now: 600 Gold.
2. Newly added Legendary Emote Gesture [Soundwave Storm·Finale of Flaming Strings] for all heroes. Standard price: 900 Gold; Now: 360 Gold.
3. Newly added Epic Bubble [Not Coaching]. Standard price: 200 Gold; Now: 120 Gold.
4. Newly added Epic Kill Announcement [Pulsing Rhythm]. Standard price: 300 Gold; Now: 200 Gold.
5. Newly added Justina Gu Epic Pose [Soundwave Storm·Dancing Chords]. Standard price: 300 Gold; Now: 200 Gold.
6. Newly added Justina Gu Epic Pose [Soundwave Storm·Musical Rhyme]. Standard price: 300 Gold; Now: 200 Gold.
7. Newly added Lannie Epic Pose [Soundwave Storm·Let's Sing]. Standard price: 300 Gold; Now: 200 Gold.
8. Newly added Justina Gu Epic Background [Soundwave Storm·Blues]. Standard price: 200 Gold; Now: 160 Gold.
9. Newly added Yoto Hime Epic Background [Soundwave Storm·Pink Dream]. Standard price: 200 Gold; Now: 160 Gold.
10. Newly added Lannie Epic Background [Soundwave Storm·Note Wave]. Standard price: 200 Gold; Now: 160 Gold.

III. New Cosmetics
Upgrade Greatsword Legendary Skin [Soundwave Storm·Violet Keys] to [Soundwave Storm·Golden Pulse] with 60 [Glazed Crystals]. (Upgrade to unlock moves' sound effects, attacks' special effects, and change the weapon's appearance.)
Upgrade Dual Halberds Legendary Skin [Soundwave Storm·Azure Echo] to [Soundwave Storm·Lightning] with 60 [Glazed Crystals]. (Upgrade to unlock moves' sound effects, attacks' special effects, and change the weapon's appearance.)

IV. New Items in the Lunar Pavillion
1. Newly added Yueshan Legendary Ultimate Accessory [Vineheart] with a price of 720 Jade Disks.
2. Newly added Justina Gu Legendary Background [Ascended Pool] with a price of 120 Jade Disks.
3. Newly added Viper Ning Epic Base[Land Scroll] with a price of 80 Jade Disks.

V. Rebirth Seal Store
1. Newly added Splendor Treasure Choice Gift with a price of 4 Rebirth Seals. Can only be bought 3 times.
2. Ziping Yin Legendary Outfit [AI Painting·Serendipity] and Dual Blades Legendary Skin [Soulreavers] along with 18 other cosmetics return for a limited time!

VI. Hero Badge Store
1. Newly added Rescue Effect [Keep the Beat] with a price of 9,000 Spectral Silk.
2. Newly added Epic Hairstyle [Female Hairstyle 16] with a price of 4,000 Spectral Silk.
3. Newly added Hadi Epic Hairstyle [Crank] with a price of 4,000 Spectral Silk.
4. Added Justina Gu Legendary Hairstyle [Crisp Autumn] with a standard price of 800 Gold.
5. Replaced Lotus Treasure with Splendor Treasure Choice Gift.

VII. New Store Items
Added the new store item "Surmount Card·Ignis" which can be used to upgrade the Ignis Hidden Treasure by 30 levels for only 1,800 Gold. Can only be purchased once.

VIII. New Items in Item Store
Event Duration: Jun. 12th, 2025 20:00 (UTC) - Jun. 15, 2025 20:00 (UTC)

Summer Party & 2674 series collections are back for a limited time with a purchase limit of 3. Purchase the Refreshing Summer Gift to choose one item each from the returning outfit and hairstyle sets, with a limit of 2 purchases. Available in the Shop on the Recommended page.
