notes.title: NARAKA: BLADEPOINT Banned Players List May 27th
NARAKA: BLADEPOINT Update – May 22nd, 2025
notes.content:
Dear players,
The servers of NARAKA: BLADEPOINT will be suspended for maintenance from May 21st, 2025 23:00 (UTC) to May 22nd, 2025 04:00 (UTC). We suggest you log out in advance and enter the game again after the maintenance.
The details for this update are as follows:
Brand New Content
I. Fairyland Penglai Brand-new Gameplay: Fly High
Grab some friends and fly high above Fairyland Penglai. The scenery is perfect for a tour in the sky!
1. Approach other players to use gesture "Fly High" on them, forming a flight team.
2. The player that started the interaction is the flight leader, and controls its movement.
3. Beware of the obstacles in the air and on the ground, as the flight team will auto-disband if an obstacle is hit.
4. This is only available in certain areas. The areas around the Pantheon and Songbird Arena are not supported.

II. New Howie & Landau Crossover Mechanism: Seven-Sword Array
Seven-Sword Arrays will respawn on the battlefield in Ranked Modes, Bot Modes and Quick Matches. Players can discard weapons, equipments, and items of required quality and quantity within the array to interact with the Seven-Swords Arra. After interaction, they can obtain the item Shrouded Jades.
 [Shrouded Jade] Can be used in Bag. After use, select a Souljade for imbuing to add one additional attribute to the Souljade.

III. Limited-time Event: Wandering Swordsman
Event Duration: May 21, 2025 20:00 (UTC) - Jun. 11, 2025 20:00 (UTC)
Event Rules
1. Gain Dice and Wild Dice by completing quests during the event. These become Howie's tools for navigating the perilous event map and uncovering hidden treasures.
2. Enemies lurk along Howie's journey. Roll Dice and unleash Sword Skills to triumph and claim your rewards.
3. Howie starts with the "Rainbow Sunburst" skill. Meet other Seven Sword inheritors to unlock their Sword Skills. Each skill can only be used once per battle.
4. Landing on special spaces triggers "Encounters." Your choices determine different outcomes.
5. Companion Events and Enemy Events are mandatory paths. When rolling dice, the number cannot exceed the remaining steps from Howie's current position to the event space.

IV. Limited-Time Event: Woven Blessings
Event Duration: May 28, 2025 20:00 (UTC) - Jun. 4, 2025 20:00 (UTC)
Event Rules
1. A new phase unlocks each day, with four unique sets of quests awaiting.
2. Completing quests rewards you with 5 colors of silk . Collect a certain number of 5 colors of silk to receive milestone rewards. The quests will not refresh during the event period and progress can be continuously accumulated.




Hero Adjustments
I. Yueshan
Optimized how Almighty Generals' [Rampage]'s hits are adjudicated when hitting enemies who are in mid-air or grounded.

II. Akos Hu
1. [Roar: Blast]'s range and knockback speed have both been increased when fully charged. Additionally, slightly increased the time that enemies who are knocked back by this skill spend in mid-air. 
(Note: Knockback speed denotes the speed at which a unit that has been knocked back travels through the air.)
2. Optimized the feeling of using [Roar: Blast] in mid-air and then following up with a weapon attack.
3. Increased the size of the area affected by [Feral Frenzy: Lockdown] on cast, but the size of the area within which enemies are trapped has not been changed.

III. Tessa
Slightly increased the time required for enemies to retrieve souls when interacting with Soul Vessels generated by Ultimate [Enchant] and [Enchant: Group Prey].

IV. Takeda Nobutada
Increased how much Demonic Force Takeda gets from weapons of certain quality levels while using [Demonic Aid: Force]. The changes are as follows:
Common: 20->20 (Unchanged)
Rare: 30->45
Epic: 60->80
Legendary: 100->160
Extreme: 120->180

V. Kurumi
Adjusted the duration of the healing circle created by Ultimate [Purified Circle] from 15 sec to 14 sec.

VI. Tarka Ji
Adjusted the time without [Heat] gain after [Overheated] ends from 10 sec to 16 sec in Ultimate status.

VII. Other Adjustments
Optimized how Rage is carried over when transformer heroes cancel their ultimates. Now, when returning to normal form, your Rage percentage will be set to whichever is higher: your Rage percentage before transforming or your Rage percentage when you cancel the ultimate.

Weapon Adjustments
I. Flying Knives
Slightly reduced the stagger duration of the third Vertical Strike in a combo against grounded enemies.

II. Dual-wielded Weapons
Optimized the special effects when repairing dual-wielded weapons with Weapon Repair Kits.

III. Single-edged Weapon
1. Slightly increased the stagger duration of Single-edged Weapon Skills' blast on enemies.
2. Single-edged Weapon Skills will change to Blue Focus status after the first Chinese character appears.

IV. Heavy Sword
The first strike of Heavy Swords' Congeneric Skills can now clash with both enemy's Common Attacks and Focus Strikes.

Battle Adjustments
1. Congeneric Skills will no longer consume durability of weapons not in the current weapon slot.
2. Grappling Hooks will no longer cause hit effects when hitting enemies being countered.
//Dev Notes: After a successful counter, targets were often interrupted by your teammates' grappling hooks, which prevents the countering player from landing their counter attack. We've adjusted the hit priority of characters when being countered to address this issue.

Souljade Adjustments
I. Heng Sword Souljade
Advanced the timing of the prompt special effect for [Aerial Dash].

II. Flying Knives Souljade
Slightly reduced the explosion special effect size of [Palm Lightning].

III. Other Adjustments
Removed the Soujade [Focus Slide] as an in-game drop from Quick Match, The Herald's Trial, and Immortal War modes.
In-Game Adjustments
I. Gameplay Process Adjustments
1. In Immortal War, an additional Yang Spirit Well will spawn during the third round of Spirit Well refreshes. When occupied or when it disappears after the timer, it will inflict Yang Depletion to players within range who don't have the power of beasts.
Players affected by Yang Depletion will receive the [Capture the Flag] quest. A Sunwing Flag will spawn in the scene. Deliver the Sunwing Flag to the Spirit Well Shrine and keep it there for 10 sec to complete the quest and remove Yang Depletion from your entire team.
If no players on the team are in Yang Depletion status, the Sunwing Flag will be dropped.
2. Increased Realm of Yang's number in the first round of Immortal War from 3 to 4

II. Feature Optimizations
1. You can now see the skill variants you and your teammates choose on the hero selection screen during the preparation phase.
2. Camera orientation will no longer reset when revive at a Soul Altar.
3. Enhanced the visual display of some in-game quest panel progress bars

III. Mechanism Adjustments
Yang Spirit Well Adjustment: Reduced the area that inflicts Yang Depletion effect in The Herald's Trial, Quick Match, and Bot mode.
Added new exits and Soul Altars within the safe zone at the end of the second round of Realm of Yang to ensure teams leaving Realm of Yang can resume previous match without disruption.

IV. In-game Economy Adjustments
In Immortal War, the first round of Epic Armors available to purchase at Rift Dealers will now begin earlier.
In Immortal War Duos and Trios, the price of Epic Armor has been increased. The number of Epic Armors available in the first round has been increased.
Some modes will have their Epic and Legendary Armor replaced with Yang Crystal Powder·Advanced and Yang Crystal Powder·Intermediate.

Out-of-Game Adjustments
I. Added Emote Reception Settings
You can now choose whose emotes you receive during matches.

II. Stack Up High Interaction Adjustments
Adjusted the interaction for Stack Up High. When near other players, use your radial interaction menu, and select Stack Up High to interact.

III. Optimized Applicable Items of Cosmetics 50% Discount Voucher and More
When using the Cosmetics 50% Discount Voucher, some outfits that can be purchased with Tae were visible but couldn't be discounted. To avoid confusion, the following cosmetics will no longer be supported by the Cosmetics 50% Discount Voucher:
Accessory-Spring Furin, Kami Bells, Scarlet Glare, Nightmare Hunter, Silver Masquerade, Ramskull, Royal Augur, Sly Treasure, Birdbrain, Panda Bear, Sloth, Lucky Lantern, Eaglet, Ruthless, Imperial Crane, Imperial Creed, Kitsune Face, Peaks, Biding Serpent, Harmony, Wrathful, and Firebrand Conch

IV. Lobby Music
Added "Life is Only a Century" and "Still Thinking of Him" to the lobby music from the Howie & Landau crossover. Enjoy!


Showdown Adjustments
I. Battle Adjustments
1. Optimized the preparation animation for the [Vinemire]'s decimator move.

II. Stage Adjustments
1. Tempered Inferno Adjustments
(1) After all team members exit the stage clearance tip screen during the preparation phase, the preparation phase countdown will be shortened.
(2) Based on online data, the following numerical adjustments have been made:
· Appropriately reduced the attack of monsters in Tempered Inferno·Solo and Tempered Inferno·Nightscream·Solo, and increased the initial Health of Chaos Furnace.
· Added one extra rebirth chance to Tempered Inferno and Tempered Inferno·Solo.
· Appropriately reduced the Health of the 4th and 5th round boss monsters in Tempered Inferno·Nightscream·Solo.
2. Nirriti's Ruins Adjustments
Shortened the duration of the black screen when switching between areas.

III. Feature Optimizations
1. Added Showdown hero display setting in profiles, where you can customize which heroes to display.
2. Main Chapter Stage Unlock Requirement Adjustment:
In main chapter modes, when you complete a stage you haven't unlocked while with teammates, your completion record will be saved. When you complete the prerequisite stages, this stage will be immediately marked as completed.
3. Added hero potential recommendations to the Recommended feature. It shows both recommended potential and popular potential for the current hero.




Feature Optimizations
I. Client Optimizations
Ray Tracing Experimental Version Now Available
After this update, ray tracing can be enabled in the graphics settings after activating DirectX 12 mode. When enabled, ray tracing global illumination and ray tracing reflections technologies will greatly enhance visual effects across all maps and modes, providing more realistic real-time lighting effects and a more immersive gaming experience.
(1) Ray tracing is currently only available on NVIDIA and AMD graphics cards that support ray tracing acceleration. In future versions, Intel graphics cards with ray tracing acceleration will support ray tracing after deep optimization at the driver level. Players are recommended to upgrade to the latest driver version for their graphics cards.
(2) Enabling ray tracing will incur some performance costs. This can be offset by using image enhancement features (DLSS, FSR, XeSS) and Frame Generation to improve performance and get a better experience.
(3) This update integrates NVIDIA DLSS ray reconstruction technology, which uses AI to denoise sampling results, generating higher quality pixels and improving ray-traced image quality. Players can enable ray reconstruction in the graphics settings after enabling ray tracing. This technology is currently only available on RTX 40 series and above graphics cards.
(4) Ray tracing is currently in experimental version and will continue to be optimized in future versions. If abnormal crashes occur with ray tracing enabled, players can disable it in the settings on the login screen.

II. In-Game
Standardized the speed of entering Blue Focus status during charging and successful charging in different frame rates.


Store Updates
I. New Items in Item Store
Newly added Legendary Item [Swordsman Crate]  with a price of 120 Gold. Purchase Limit: 10. Grants a random unowned Howie & Landau Outfit, Weapon, Hairstyle or Accessory. Completing the collection unlocks Legendary Gesture Howie & Landau·Cyclone Rise. Can be claimed in Profile - Collections. After completion, a crate opened grants you Spectral Silk*240.

II. New Discounts
1. Newly added Legendary Rescue Effect [You Good?]. Standard price: 900 Gold; Now: 600 Gold.
2. Newly added Epic Kill Announcement [Paper Glider]. Standard price: 300 Gold; Now: 200 Gold.


III. New Items in the Gift Store
In the Gift Store, newly added:
Legendary Gestures [Playhouse·Left]. Redeemable by 270 Fragrant Jades.
Legendary Gestures [Playhouse·Right]. Redeemable by 270 Fragrant Jades.
Please note that with this update, the Draconic Treasures will be removed in the Gift Store. Instead, players can now redem for Splendor Treasure Choice Gift by 65 Fragrant Jade each, with a monthly redemption limit of 3.


Bug Fixes
I. Battle-related Bugs
1. Fixed an issue where outfit attack rotation could cause abnormal character model collision in specific cases.
2. Fixed an issue where players could release Ultimates not usable under attack while airborne after being hit by the combat item [Katana Tome].

II. Hero-related Bugs
Fixed an issue that would cause Temulch's Storm Prison's Slowed effect to be applied to Temulch's allies in some situations.

notes.title: NARAKA: BLADEPOINT Update – April 29th, 2025
notes.content:
Dear players,
The servers of NARAKA: BLADEPOINT will be suspended for maintenance from Aprile 28th, 2025 at 23:00 (UTC) to April 29th, 2025 at 04:00 (UTC). We suggest you log out in advance and enter the game again after the maintenance.
The details for this update are as follows:
Brand New Content
I. New Mechanism - Yang Spirit Line
1. Gameplay Info:
Yang Spirit Line will spawn during the battle. Capturing it grants Sunwing's Strength and randomly drops combat items (Longsword Tome, Greatsword Tome, Dagger Tome, Dual Blades Tome, Katana Tome).
When Yang Spirit Line disappears, players within its range will be afflicted with Yang Depletion (players with the power of beasts or the Sunwing's Strength are immune to its effect).
A certain number of Bloom Essence mechanism will spawn within the area. Interacting with them will remove Yang Depletiont for the entire team and drop additional resources.
2. Available Mode: The Herald's Trial, Quick Match and Bot Mode
3. Sunwing's Strength Effect:
Picking it up instantly restores a certain amount of Health, Armor and Rage for allied units, and restores Health by a certain percentage when the entire team attacks. When the holder of Sunwing's Strength has their Health reduced to 0, Mortal Defiance will be triggered once.
When the holder of Sunwing's Strength dies, it will drop Yangbloom Essence, granting the collector Sunwing's Strength and removing Yang Depletion.
Sunwing's Strength has a fixed total duration, which will be cleared at a fixed time during the battle.
4. Yang Spirit Line and Bloom Essence mechanism will disappear after not being interacted with for a certain period of time.
5. The effect of the power of beasts and the Sunwing's Strength are mutually exclusive. When one of these effects is active, you cannot gain the other.
6. Longsword Tome, Greatsword Tome, Dagger Tome, Dual Blades Tome, Katana Tome effects description: Using it casts powerful Golden Focus. The combat item will not be consumed but will be on cooldown, and will disappear after a certain period of time during the battle.
7. Moonbane Charms cannot be used to place Banebreath inside the Yang Depletion area for Yang Spirit Lines.

II. New Mechanism - Realm of Spirit
1. Introduction
During the battle, the Realm of Spirit will be available 120 seconds after the first Shadow Corruption spread concludes. Spectating players whose team still has surviving teammates can participate in Realm of Spirit via the spectator interface. Players must seize Rebirth Banner within the Realm of Spirit. When the Realm of Spirit is over, the player holding Rebirth Banner will be granted Rebirth qualification.
2. Available Mode: The Herald's Trial, Duos and Trios in Quick Match
3. Others
a. Players in the Realm of Spirit cannot use Ultimate skills.
b. Vermillion Bird's Might is ineffective against players in the Realm of Spirit.
c. Players in the Realm of Spirit cannot initiate or respond to Vertical Blink Strike.

III. Season Exclusive: Ignis Treasure
1. The Ignis Treasure is priced at 360 Gold. Open for a chance to obtain rewards like Tarka Ji Extreme Outfit [Infernal Armor] and the Flying Knives Extreme Skin [Emperor's Flamewheel].
2. While you have the outfit [Infernal Armor] equipped, there will be a Return to Ashes effect when you defeat enemies. Cannot be Imprinted: When in rapid movement, charging, or performing a charged attack, different special forms can be triggered.
3. Equipping Polesword Extreme Skin [Emperor's Flamewheel] changes the Attack Effects of the Souljade [Moonshards Storm]. Shows [Roaming Blades] effects when standing still or walking. The flame pattern will ignite again during combat.
4. Minimum Guarantee:
(1) Players are guaranteed to receive at least 1 Red (Extreme) reward during the process of opening at most 100 Treasures. This can be triggered multiple times.​ Red (Extreme) rewards will not repeat until all of them have been obtained.
(2) Legendary Cosmetic Minimum Guarantee: Within the first 25 Treasures opened, you are guaranteed to get either a Hero Outfit or a Weapon Skin. Subsequently, within every 25 Treasures opened, you are guaranteed to obtain a Legendary cosmetic that you have not yet unlocked. This guarantee can be triggered up to 14 times.
(3) Wishing Legendary Reward: If you draw an Extreme cosmetic, you can set a Legendary cosmetic which will be guaranteed when you draw a Legendary cosmetic next time. Times of guarantee can stack, but you can only set 1 cosmetic each time. If the Legendary Cosmetic Guarantee and Wishing Legendary Reward trigger simultaneously, priority is given to the Wishing Legendary Reward cosmetic and will reduce the number of remaining times that the Legendary Cosmetic Guarantee can be triggered by one.
5. Ignis Treasure 50% Discount Voucher
The first 10 Ignis Treasure that you buy will benefit from a 50% discount. This discount cannot be stacked with discounts from other discount vouchers. After 10 Ignis Treasure have been purchased, subsequent Ignis Treasure will return to their standard price.
6. Ignis Treasure will be available on Apr. 28, 2025 at 04:00 (UTC)! 
After the server opens, players can preview content early, but the Spring Lantern·Hua will remain locked until the specified time.
The Star-Collection unlocks at the same time as the Spring Lantern·Hua.

IV. Single-edged Weapon Skill
Heng Sword & Katana: After using an air blast to block any opponent's common attack or focus strikes, you can follow up a powerful move at the right timing. If the sudden slash is fully unleashed, it will deal its maximum damage.


V. Limited-time Event: Trial by Flame
Event Time: From the update on April 29, 2025 to May 21, 2025 at 20:00 (UTC)
Event Content:
1. Players who complete the daily Cultivation Quests will receive Stone of Flame, which can be used to aid Tarka Ji in his cultivation.
2. Each object has different cultivation progress. When the cultivation progress reaches 50%, players will receive the cultivation rewards of the corresponding object.
3. When the cultivation progress of an object reaches 99%, the Breakthrough Quest will be unlocked. Compleing the Breakthrough Quest grants the Liquor of Lava, which can be used to help Tarka Ji overcome his inner demons. Players will then receive breakthrough rewards and unlock the complete storyline related to these inner demons.
4. Complete the breakthrough of all inner demons to assist Tarka Ji in conquering Fire Omnius, and rise reborn from the ashes.

VI. Limited-time Events: Infernal Reckoning
1. Event Duration: Extended to May. 7, 2025 20:00 (UTC)
2. Rewards may only be redeemed up until May. 14, 2025 20:00 (UTC)
3. Added Chaos Stones and other rewards that can be exchanged for.


VII. Ignis Treasure with Bonus Star - Collections
Event Duration: Apr. 29, 2025 04:00 (UTC) - Jul. 31, 2025 00:00 (UTC)
Event Rules
1. When opening Ignis Treasures, there is a chance to receive the Staff Extreme Skin, Star - Aegis Reckoning and the Valda Cui Legendary Outfit, Star - Azure Silk.
2. How to obtain: Each time you open an Ignis Treasure, there is a chance to obtain them as an additional reward. This chance increases as you obtain more Legendaries. The Maximum chance is 100%
3. The chances for the 2 Star-Collections are calculated separately and do not impact each other. After getting a Star-Collection, the corresponding chances will then reset.
4. Each account can receive a maximum of 10 [Star - Aegis Reckoning] and 2 [Star - Azure Silk].
5. The number of Star-Collections that can be obtained from Ignis Treasures is limited.


VIII. 2nd PlayStation® Tournaments #5
The rivers and lakes awaken, where the blade reveals its true prowess. 2nd PlayStation® Tournaments #5 are available for a limited time!
Event Duration: May 8, 2025 20:00 (UTC) - Jun 4, 2025 20:00 (UTC)
Event Rules:
Complete weekly quests during the event to claim Jade Medal - MAY. You can claim more Medals in the mail after advancing, and the quantity awarded for each rank is as follows:
1st place: 300 Medals
2nd place: 200 Medals
3rd-4th place: 100 Medals
5th-8th place: 50 Medals 
Medals can be used for redeeming rewards and participating in rankings.

IX. PlayStation Challenge:
Challenge the wind in this race! PlayStation Sky-high Racing #14 is now open!
Compete against players worldwide and ascend the rankings by achieving a place among the Top 100 fastest in Sky-high Racing mode.
How to participate:
Start Sky-high Racing on Fairyland Penglai to participate in the event.
Event Duration: Apr. 29, 2025 00:00 (UTC) - Jun. 4, 2025 23:59 (UTC)

Hero Adjustments
I. Tarka Ji
1. Adjustments to [Flame Force]:
Use a defensive stance to block hit damage and recover stamina.
 · After successfully blocking any damage, you can tap the horizontal attack button to counterattack, [Burning] enemies and heavily staggering them.
·After blocking damage, you can also tap the vertical attack button to counterattack, dealing relatively high AOE damage and [Burning] enemies in the aimed direction.
2. Reduced the start-up frames for adjudicating [Flame Force]'s hit damage block effect.
3. The defensive focus level of [Flame Force: Fireball] has been changed to Golden Focus while casting.
4. Adjustments to the ultimate [Fire Frenzy]:
Significantly improves Tarka's agility, and some moves will also deal hit damage and [Burn] enemies, can be used under attack.
· Tarka blocks ranged weapon attacks when running.
·Can consume Rage to use [Flame Force] repeatedly.
· Can also become [Overheated] while this ultimate is active, which happens when Tarka's Heat maxes out.
· Attacking or being attacked grows Heat. Once it reaches max, become [Overheated] for 20 sec, changing 2nd-stage dodges into knee strikes and gaining increased Stamina recovery.
·While [Overheated], tapping the ultimate button will knock back nearby enemies. Can be used under attack.
5. Adjustments to the ultimate [Fire Frenzy: Extend]:
Significantly improves Tarka's agility and increases his Attack damage. Some moves will also deal hit damage and [Burn] enemies. Can be used under attack.
· Tarka blocks ranged weapon attacks when running and builds rage when attacking enemies.
· Increases all allied heroes' attack.
· Can also become [Overheated] while this ultimate is active, which happens when Tarka's Heat maxes out.
· Attacking or being attacked grows Heat. Once it reaches max, become [Overheated] for 20 sec, changing 2nd-stage dodges into knee strikes and gaining increased Stamina recovery. Tapping the vertical attack button after a knee strike will cause Tarka to dash forward and smash an enemy.
6. Adjusted the duration of Ultimate [Fire Frenzy: Extend] from 25 seconds in Duos and Trios, 20 seconds in Solo to 22 seconds in Duos and Trios, 18 seconds in Solo, but the efficiency of Rage recovered from attacks has been increased from 65% to 100%.
7. Increased the knockback range of Ultimate [Fire Frenzy] and [Fire Frenzy: Extend] when they are activated, and adjusted their damage multiplier from 1.0 to 0.1.
8. Slightly increased the staggered duration when the 2nd-stage dodge (Elbow Strike) hits the target during the Ultimate, making it combo into most weapons’ Crouch Verical Strike, and adjusted the damage multiplier from 1.5 to 1.3. The damage multiplier of the 2nd-stage dodge (Knee Strike) during [Overheated] status is 1.8, making it interrupt Golden Focus and move farther.
9. Optimized the pre-input response for movement actions during the Ultimate, and the timing for action interruption when the status of the Ultimate has been changed.
10. Skill [Flame Force: Block] has been removed.
11. Ultimate [Fire Frenzy: Reload] has been removed.

II. Yueshan
Further narrowed the vertical detection range when Yueshan casts his Ultimate.

III. Temulch
1. Temulch no longer has the basic feature to ignore enemies’ Storm Prison. After casting his Ultimate, the entire team can resist the debuff of enemies’ Storm Prison.
2. When Temulch passes through enemies’ Storm Prison, he no longer automatically reloads his windball.

IV. Kylin Zhang
Adjusted the damage multiplier of Ultimate [Qilin Slash: Rend’s] charged strikes from 3.0 to 2.8.


V. Cyra
Adjust the basic value of [Light's Mercy] in Solo/Trios from 1500/1800 to 1200/1500.

VI. Lannie
While Lannie's Ultimate [Tricky Bounce: Leap] is active, the height that it knocks enemies who are mid-air up has been reduced, and the distance that enemies are knocked back has been increased.

VII. Justina Gu
While the Ultimate [Arctic Wraith] is active, the height that enemies who are in mid-air are knocked up has been reduced.


Weapon Adjustments
I. Staff
Slightly increased the airborne duration when Uppercut Slash hits the enemy.
//Dev Note: We received feedback from players that Staff’s Uppercut Slash combo was rather difficult. Therefore, we made a slight adjustment to improve the combo’s error tolerance.

II. Flying Knives
1. Slightly advanced the dodge interruption point of the 1st-stage of Vertical Strike, and slightly increased the flight speed of Flying Knives．
2. Optimized the performance and movement of Horizontal Strike’s charging while sprinting.
3. Optimized the dodge moves.
4. Optimized the performance of Vertical Strike’s charging while moving.
5. The Flying Knives' 2nd stage Horizontal Strikes, 3rd stage Vertical Strikes, and Cyan Fang moves now use melee pull to determine their direction.
6. Optimized the pull of 2nd stage Vertical Strikes.

III. Single-edged Weapon
Improved the timing for switching weapons during the 1st-stage Horizontal/Vertical Strike, Charged Horizontal/Vertical Strike and 3rd-stage Horizontal/Vertical Strike.


Souljade Adjustments
I. Flying Knives Souljade
Added Souljade [Palmar Thunder]: Rapid Throw Extreme, making changes in Flying Knives’ Vertical Strike

II. Heng Sword Souljade
Added Souljade [Aerial Dash]: Improves Crouch Vertical Strike

III. Fistblades Souljade
Slightly reduced the startup frames of [Sky Punch] and adjusted it to Blue Focus, making it no longer enhance Slide Vertical Strike.
Increased the damage multiplier from 2.45 to 3.07.

In-game Adjustments
I. Survival Modes Adjustments
1. Game Pace Adjustments
Adjusted the radius of the safe zone after the first Shadow Corruption spreads from 700 to 770, the start time of Shadow Corruption spread from 300 seconds to 270 seconds, the duration of the safe zone from 300 seconds to 270 seconds, and the duration of spread from 210 seconds to 180 seconds.
Adjusted the radius of the safe zone after the second Shadow Corruption spreads from 350 to 400, and the start time of Shadow Corruption spread from 690 seconds to 630 seconds.
Adjusted the radius of the safe zone after the third Shadow Corruption spreads from 165 to 180, the start time of Shadow Corruption spread from 1080 seconds to 960 seconds, the duration of the safe zone from 120 seconds to 180 seconds, and the duration of spread from 90 seconds to 120 seconds.
Adjusted the start time of the fourth Shadow Corruption spreads from 1125 seconds to 1170 seconds, and the duration of the safe zone from 75 seconds to 90 seconds.
Adjusted the start time of the fifth Shadow Corruption spreads from 1245 seconds to 1290 seconds.
Adjusted the start time of the sixth Shadow Corruption spreads from 1350 seconds to 1395 seconds.
Adjusted the start time of the seventh Shadow Corruption spreads from 1455 seconds to 1500 seconds.
Due to game pace adjustments, the respawn time for Spirit Well and Morus' Blessing, the refresh time of in-game quests, and the duration of Moonbane Charm have been adjusted accordingly.

II. In-game Optimization
1. Increased the number of Stash resources in the Morus Isle.
2. Adjusted the number of Morus' Blessing in the first and second round of the survival mode in the Morus Isle to 2.

III. Bot Mode Adjustments
Increased the total number of AI opponents in Duos and Trios.

IV. Golden Roc Escort
1. Morus' Blessings will no longer spawn.
2. New kinds of Souljades have been added to Rift Dealers, and some of their prices have been reduced.
3. During the middle and end of each round, Rift Dealers will gain free combat items: Ploy Charm·Ballista, Ploy Charm·Forbidden Seal. Players can purchase them, but must use them before they expire.


Out-of-game Adjustments
!. Weekly Quests Adjustments
1. The following Daily Quests have been added:
(1) Defeat 3 enemies
(2) Heal 8,000 Health or Armor 
(3) Deal 15,000 damage
The following quests have been removed:
(1) Open 10 Stashes
(2) Complete 6 Quest Scrolls
(3) Spend 20,000 Dark Tide Coins at Rift Dealers

II. With Ease Adjustments
Reduced the magnitude of bonus score decay of With Ease.

III. Hero Return Adjustments
Added Jade Disks in daily online rewards during Hero Return event.
*Players who have triggered Hero Return event between April 23rd and the time prior to this update will receive retroactively issued Jade Disks via in-game mail after the update.

IV. New Gesture Type
Added new Gesture type - [Precise Interactive Actions], which can be aimed and activated at other players in Seraphic Quartet of Fairyland Penglai and Music Zone (in front of Pantheon), allowing collaborative performance with targeted players. They function as solo gestures outside the designated area.

V. Upgradable Paints
1. Spend 1 Glazed Crystal to upgrade Feria Shen's Outfit [Justice·Mystic Cat] to [Justice·Feline Phantom] and unlock the "jacket-off" style.
2. Spend 1 Glazed Crystal to upgrade Akos Hu's Outfit [Justice·Nightwalker] to [Justice·Traceless Night] and unlock the "jacket-off" style.

VI. Voice Pack Collection Points
The voice packs now have a Collection Points feature, and all released voice packs in the game have been given corresponding points.



Showdown Adjustments
I. Stage Adjustments
1. Tempered Inferno features two modes: [Tempered Inferno] (relatively easy) and [Tempered Inferno·Nightscream] (original difficulty). It is unlocked after completing [Manticore's Hunt·Normal].
2. In-game Function Improvements of Tempered Inferno
a. When the remaining time of Chaos Furnace Essence reaches 60 seconds, a prompt message and sound effect will be played.
b. When the remaining time of Chaos Furnace Essence reaches 30 seconds, its Health bar will continuously flash red as a warning, and a persistent alert sound effect will be played.
c. The text indicating the number of monster waves defeated in this round will be displayed on the settlement screen.
3. Out-of-game Function Improvements of Tempered Inferno
Tap the information button beside the Gameplay title to check its description.


II. Battle Adjustments
1. Bosses no longer prioritize attacking targets that are not in [Stralth] status.
2. Optimized [Thunderstorm Array’s] strike effect to address the issue where countering while standing occasionally fails to successfully counter the electrical wave impact of Thunderstorm Array.
3. Reduced the aggression of surrounding monsters when the Boss unleashes high-threat moves in [Tempered Inferno].
4. Adjusted the timing when the Boss of the eighth wave casts high-threat moves in [Tempered Inferno·Nightscream].
5. Added Omens [Hanged Ent]

III. Curio Adjustments
1. The first two stages of [Void Sunder] strikes no longer deduct [Slash Mind].
2. When equipping [Glazed Mirror], the cooldown for [Healing Ray: Showdown] will begin upon skill cast instead of after the skill ends.
3. Curio [Flaming Soul Bead’s] awakening effect “[Explosive] is now regarded as Elemental Burst, but it can no longer cause Elemental Accumulation”,
Added a new effect: Hitting enemies affected by [Explosive] with [Flame Force: Showdown] causes explosion.
4. Optimized the explosion effect of [Explosive] when equipping [Flaming Soul Bead].
5. Added new display of [Yin-Yang Mastery]:
a. A Yin-Yang Mastery icon will be displayed below players with Yin-Yang Mastery in the party area of the main interface.
b. A bonus effect of Yin-Yang Mastery will be displayed in the Bonus Card area on the left of Gameplay of the main interface.
Only effective in PvE Lobby.
IV. Feature Optimizations
1. Adjusted the display rules for the attribute panel in the Preparation interface. Most attributes and effect bonuses will no longer be displayed when they are 0.
2. Adjusted the Hero display order in PvE profiles: When Heroes share the same Sense level, those with higher total Curio scores will now be prioritized. Future updates will also introduce a Hero display customization feature.
3. Optimized the lense performance of some moves of [Manticore].


Feature Optimizations
I. Client
1. Updating via Steam has been optimized.
Optimized the file size of update patch on Steam.

II. Out-of-Game
Optimized the quick selection logic and interface performance of Inventory Mass Dispose feature


Store Updates
I. New Packs
1. Newly added Feria Shen exclusive Pack [Feline Night Walker Pack], including Legendary outfit [Justice·Feline], Legendary Accessory [Justice·Feline Ears], Legendary Accessory [Justice·Feline Mask], Legendary Accessory [Justice·Feline Tail], Legendary Hairstyle [Justice·Mystic]. Standard price: 5,900 Gold; Now: 2,880 Gold. Single items are discounted, and you get even more discounts when you purchase a Pack.
2. Newly added Akos Hu exclusive Pack [Feline Night Walker Pack], including Legendary outfit [Justice·Nightwalker], Legendary Accessory [Justice·Nightwalker Ears], Legendary Accessory [Justice·Nightwalker Mask], Legendary Accessory [Justice·Nightwalker Tail], Legendary Hairstyle [Justice·Night]. Standard price: 5,900 Gold; Now: 2,880 Gold. Single items are discounted, and you get even more discounts when you purchase a Pack.

 
II. New Discounts
1. Newly added Legendary Precise Interactive Actions [Firework Cannon] for all heroes. Standard price: 2,000 Gold; Now: 360 Gold.
2. Newly added Cyra Legendary Hairstyle [Vivid Bloom]. Standard price: 800 Gold; Now: 600 Gold.
3. Newly added Tessa Legendary Hairstyle [Blazing Feather]. Standard price: 800 Gold; Now: 600 Gold.
4. Newly added Takeda Epic Pose [Demonized]. Standard price: 300 Gold; Now: 200 Gold.
5. Newly added Cyra Epic Pose [Sunbathing]. Standard price: 300 Gold; Now: 200 Gold.
6. Newly added Takeda Epic Background [Surging Malice]. Standard price: 200 Gold; Now: 160 Gold.
7. Newly added Takeda Epic Base [Serpent Ward]. Standard price: 400 Gold; Now: 300 Gold.
8. Newly added Tarka Ji Legendary Hero's Theme [Wildfire]. Standard price: 800 Gold; Now: 600 Gold.


III. New Floral Dew Items
Newly added Floral Dew Items in the Item Store.
1. Imprint Roller*5 with a price of Floral Dew*4.
2. Glazed Crystal*7 with a price of Floral Dew*1.
3. Immortal Treasure*1 with a price of Floral Dew*1.
4. Lotus Treasure*1 with a price of Floral Dew*1.

IV. New Items in Spectral Silk Store
1. Newly added Epic Pose [Silent Observation] for all male heroes with a price of 1,200 Spectral Silk.
2. Newly added Epic Pose [Peep] for all female heroes with a price of 1,200 Spectral Silk.

V. New Items in the Lunar Pavillion
1. Takeda Nobutada Legendary Outfit [Warrior's Flame] and Lyam Liu Legendary Outfit [Searing Sincerity].
2. The end of availability for Peak Speed crossover cosmetics is now displayed in a reminder, please exchange for them while they are available!

Bug Fixing
I. Hero-related Bugs
1. Optimized an issue where the water spears of Valda Cui’s Ultimate [Rising Tide: Unchained] occasionally failed to apply the bind effect when hitting enemies.
2. Optimized an issue where Valda Cui’s Ultimate [Rising Tide: Unchained] can be occasionally interrupted when being activated.
3. Optimized an issue where Justina Gu’s Ultimate Ice Mist can trigger the shield block of Shayol Wei’s Ultimate Mystic Roar.
4. Optimized an issue where enemies may trigger environmental landslides when [Rampage] hits them with Rampage in complex scenarios.
5. Fixed a problem that prevented players playing as Justina Gu from using the ultimate button to unleash icy attacks while her ultimate [Arctic Wraith] was active.


II. Battle-related Bugs
1. Fixed an issue where [Void Sunder’s] effect and the persistence of additional strikes from rare affixes were not functioning correctly.
2. Fixed an issue where the speacial effect volume of some Curios cannot be adjusted. You can now adjust Curio effect volume in [Character].

notes.title: NARAKA: BLADEPOINT Update – April 17th, 2025
notes.content:
Dear players,
The servers of NARAKA: BLADEPOINT will be suspended for maintenance from Apr 16th, 2025 23:00 (UTC) to Apr 17th, 2025 04:00 (UTC). We suggest you log out in advance and enter the game again after the maintenance.

The details for this update are as follows:

 

Brand New Content
I. New Showdown Gameplay: Tempered Inferno

In the Soul-forging Abyss hidden in the Shadowjade Mine, the "Chaos Furnace" that once refined the legendary weapons of the Herald used to be alight day and night. However, under the mad scheme of Omnius, a drastic change occurred.

After Omnius's plan to revert the Five Phases back to primordial chaos was foiled by the heroes, some formless chaotic Qi escaped and seeped into the Chaos Furnace. A bursting of energy flooded out because of the imbalanced Five Elements within, attracting countless evil spirits into action. Thus, a battle to protect the furnace began.

In this crisis, the heroes used Chaos Stones crafted by the Chaos Furnace to forge Curios imbued with the powers of Yin and Yang. These Curios then became their weapons to slay demons and eradicate evils.

However, as the energy of the Chaos Furnace continued to leak, the furnace fire gradually weakened. The heroes who sought more Curios could only wait for the Five Phases True Qi to return to balance on the Morus Isle before they could once again awaken the Furnace.

Defeat waves of enemies, claim numerous prizes, and revel in the power of the Curios!

 

II. New Showdown Item: Curio

Each hero has two Curio slots: Yin and Yang. One Curio can be equipped in each slot.

1. Crafting Curios

Chaos Stones, acquired in Tempered Inferno, can be used to craft Curios. There are two kinds of Curio crafting: Random Craft and Targeted Craft.

[Random Craft]:

[Random Craft] produces a random Curio of the current season, and builds XP to boost its Crafting level.

[Targeted Craft]:

Once you have raised a given Curio to Lv. 1, you'll be able to choose to craft that Curio using [Targeted Craft].

At the end of the season, Curios will be reclaimed, but Crafting Levels will be retained. In following seasons, players with Crafting levels will be able to craft Curios from past seasons. From time to time we will hold Rerun Events for players who missed out.

During the season, each Curio Crafting level you upgrade will increase the season progress by 1. Season progress rewards include Flux Shards, Curio crafting materials and more!

2. Curio Stars

Curios can be smelted into Chaos Extract, a resource used in leveling up Curios.

Each level gained grants an attribute of a random quality and type (that the Curio does not already have). A Curio can have at most 4 attributes.

3. Awakening Curios and Harmonic Balance

Extreme Curio raised to 3-Star level can be awakened with Tempered Essence.

If successful, the Curio gains random awakened attributes (these differ between Curios).

Failure will result in the loss of the lowest-quality or lowest-level attribute. You can still raise the Curio's stars to get a new attribute. Each failure boosts your awakening chance across all Curios.

With both an awakened Yin and Yang Curio, you unlock [Harmonic Balance] for all your heroes (whether you have the Curios equipped or not), boosting your Luck by 2,000, and your team's by 1,000.

Boosts can stack. Lasts until Tempered Inferno reopens next season.

 

III. Limited-time Event: Hunting Grounds

Event Duration: Apr. 17, 2025 Update - May. 21, 2025 20:00 (UTC)

Event Rules:

1. During the event, hunt Scorpions, Lizards, Squirrels, and Rats in Survival Modes to get Hunting Grounds Chests.

2. Each player can get up to 2 Hunting Grounds Chests per match, up to 6 per day.

3. Use a Hunting Grounds Chest for a chance to get Golden Light Outfit Choice Gift, Golden Light Weapon Choice Gift, Golden Light Party Choice Gift, Golden Light Accessory Choice Gift, Gold, Floral Dew, Splendor Treasure Choice Gift, Jade Disk, Splendor Treasure Shard Choice Gift or Floral Dew Shard.

 

IV. Limited-time Event: Underground Treasures

Event Duration: Apr. 17, 2025 Update - May. 7, 2025 20:00 (UTC)

Event Rules:

1. During the event, earn Flame Gems by opening Stashes in Survival modes or through Casual Modes and Showdown. You can acquire up to 400 Flame Gems per week through these modes.

2. Tap the Hunt button on the event page to randomly receive ores of the same type. Collect five of the same ore to claim corresponding rewards.

4. Claim 50 extra Flame Gems upon first entering the event page each week. The weekly Flame Gems limit and extra Flame Gems reset every Wednesday at 20:00 (UTC).

 

V. Limited-time Events: Infernal Reckoning

Event Duration: Apr. 17, 2025 Update - Apr. 31, 2025 20:00 (UTC)

Event Rules:

1. Gain Omen Coins by completing quests during the event. Omen Coin can be redeemed for great event rewards.

2. Complete each day's Daily Quests to receive bonus rewards.

3. There are 5 groups of Challenge Quests, each available in turn at different times. Complete quests to claim plentiful rewards.

4. The rewards are redeemable till May 07, 2025 at 20:00 (UTC). Please redeem the rewards in time.

 

VI. Limited-time Event: Fire of Seven Stars

Event Duration: Apr. 17, 2025 Update - Apr. 23, 2025 20:00 (UTC)

Event Rules:

Players who sign in a total of 3 days during the event can receive Ignis Treasure, Splendor Treasure Choice Gift, Jade Disks.

 

VII. Limited-time Event: Moonlit Tribute

Event Duration: Apr. 27, 2025 20:00 (UTC) - May. 7, 2025 20:00 (UTC)

Event Rules:

During the event, you can earn Jade Disks from activities such as Daily Quests, Baize's Blessing, limited-time events, and The Hero Returns. Use the Jade Disks to redeem generous rewards at Lunar Pavilion.

 

Hero Adjustments
I. Tianhai

Adjusted the damage multiplier of Great Vajra's smash attack after seizing two enemies from 12.0 to 12.5.

 

II. Yueshan

1. Extended the duration of Defense Focus after landing from [Scorching Dash: Weaken] to cover the full recovery frames.

2. Slightly reduced the judgment scene height when Yueshan casts his ultimate.

//Dev Note: Since different maps feature various design styles, and real battle scenes tend to be more complex, it's difficult to establish a universal spatial judgment standard for casting transform ultimates. If the judgment is based solely on model size, it becomes easier to cast the ultimate, but this can lead to larger characters getting stuck in narrow doorways, unable to move freely in or out of the scene. On the other hand, increasing the judgment size ensures the space meets battle requirements after transformation, but it also makes successful transformation more difficult. Therefore, after comparing multiple scenes, we decided to slightly reduce the judgment height to accommodate more transformation scenarios.

 

III. Temulch

1. For the ultimate [Storm Prison: Reload]: When Temulch uses the reloaded windballs after passing through a wind wall, his skill will not enter CD.

2. When Temulch already has windballs in store, passing through a wind wall will not generate additional windballs.

 

IV. Takeda Nobutada

Increased all the recovery effects after enabling the ultimate: Increase [Demonic Strike]'s recovery multiplier from 150% to 180% in [Demonic Aid], [Demonic Aid: Teleport]'s recovery multiplier from 30% to 50%, and [Demonic Strike: Havoc]'s recovery multiplier from 750% to 800% in [Demonic Aid: Force].

 

V. Viper Ning

Adjusted [Yushan Strike]'s CD from 15 sec to 18 sec.

 

VI. Zai

Reduced the stagger time caused when the ultimate weapon Chain Scythe hits a downed enemy with a sliding horizontal strike.

 
Weapon Adjustments
I. Flying Knives

1. The crosshair now becomes red when you aim at an enemy with Flying Knives.

2. Flying Knives thrown by Charged Vertical Strikes now hit with a slightly wider range and faster flying speed.

3. Flying Knives thrown by 1st-stage Vertical Strikes now hit with a slightly wider range.

4. Optimized the character displacement when landing a charged horizontal strike while sprinting.

5. Optimized the displacement speed when performing a grappling strike with the Flying Knives.

6. Added grappling hook buffering to the 3rd-stage vertical strikes.

7. Hidden Barb can interrupt an enemy's Common Attack from 1m away.

8. Adjusted the damage multiplier of 3rd stage Horizontal Strikes from 2.77 to 3.3.

9. Adjusted the damage multiplier of the Flying Knives' Uppercut Slashes from 1.26 to 1.64.

10. Adjusted the damage multiplier of the Flying Knives' sliding attack from 1.18 to 1.54.

11. Shortened the Flying Knives' 2nd stage Vertical Strikes' start-up frames, and adjusted its damage multiplier from 1.36 to 1.8.

 

II. Longsword

Delayed the activation time for Grappling Hook use while wielding a Longsword with [Cyan Fang] equipped.

 
Souljade Adjustments
I. Staff Souljade

Increased [Stanchion·Rising·Sky Pillar]'s hit range.

 

II. Flying Knives Souljades

[Moonshards Storm]'s damage multiplier has been adjusted from 5.8 to 6.96.

 

In-game Adjustments
I. Gameplay Adjustments

1. Adjusted Draco Storm: Removed the possessor's Armor Recovery and adjusted Thunder damage from 150 to 100.

2. Added default starting armor (common) to Survival Mode.

 

Out-of-game Adjustments
I. Brand-new Store: [Lunar Pavilion]

1. Jade Disks can be obtained through Weekly Regular Rewards, Baize's Blessing, Limited-time Events, The Hero Recall.

2. Jade Disks can be used to redeem Legendary Outfits, Accessories, Backgrounds. Lunar Pavilion will be updated from time to time.

3. Cosmetics 50% Discount Voucher will be added in the Lunar Pavilion on May 1st, which can be redeemed by 75 Jade Disks.

*Crossover items will be removed from the Lunar Pavilion once the crossover event ends. Please tredeem them in time.

 

II. Inventory Disposal Function Adjustments

1. Added "Mass Dispose" function: A new "Mass Dispose" option has been added to the inventory interface, allowing you to select and dispose of multiple items at once.

2. Added disposable items: Collection Trial Cards, Hero Trial Vouchers, and XP Bonus Cards can now be disposed of,

 

III. Friends & Party Invite Limitations

To protect players from harassment, we've implemented a periodic limit on the number of times you can add friends and invite other players to join your party.

 

IV. New Feature

In Customization page, players can select the emote bubbles equipped on the wheel to perform random bubble editing.

 

V. The Hero Returns Event Adjustments

Adjusted the rewards for recalled friends. Jade Disks have been added to the original rewards, which can be redeemed for rewards in the Lunar Pavilion.

 

Showdown Adjustments
I. Combat Adjustments

1. Adjusted [Hammer Evil-Ent]'s close-range Purple Focus Strike starting move to common attack.

2. Optimized the sound effect when surrounded by Lotuses.

3. Optimized the color or thunderbolts from Thunderspawn and Rotspawn.

 

II. Catch-Up Points Feature Updates

If you spend 600 or more fatigue in a given week, you will receive extra rewards in accordance with your Catch-Up Points after that week's settlement. This reward will be available to claim for 1 week, so please claim them promptly!

 

Client Optimizations
I. AMD FSR4 Feature Support

Support for AMD FSR4 on Radeon™ RX 9070 series graphics cards (requires driver version 25.4.1 and above) uses machine learning technology trained on high-quality gaming benchmark data from AMD Instinct™ GPUs, combined with the hardware acceleration of AMD's RDNA™ 4 architecture, to provide players with higher-quality image magnification, improving performance.

 

Performance Optimization
I. Xbox Performance Optimization

1. Xbox Series X now adds new FSR3 graphics enhancement technology

AMD FidelityFX™ Super Resolution 3 (FSR 3) uses a combination of super resolution temporal upscaling technology and frame generation to deliver a massive increase in framerates.

Enabling AMD FSR 3 will apply 120Hz VSync and requires a high refresh rate display. To set your refresh rate to 120 Hz on Xbox, go to Settings > General > TV & display options > Refresh rate and select 120 Hz.

Compatible devices can enable this feature in Settings > Graphics Quality > Image Enhancement option.

 

Store Updates
I. New Pack

notes.title: NARAKA: BLADEPOINT Update – April 1st, 2025
notes.content:
Dear players,
The servers of NARAKA: BLADEPOINT will be suspended for maintenance from Mar 31st, 2025 23:00 (UTC) to Apr 1st, 2025 04:00 (UTC). We suggest you log out in advance and enter the game again after the maintenance.

The details for this update are as follows:

 

Brand New Content
I. New Weapon - Flying Knives
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36350327/5479ef6342508618d3ef361163be87c6cf9a3880.png[/img]
Deadly accurate and never missing a shot!

In the new version, we are introducing a brand new weapon: Flying Knives. Come and try it out for yourself!

Weapon Skills:

Hidden Barb: The first Vertical Strike can interrupt an enemy's Common Attack from 2m away and stagger them for an extended period.

Free Targeting: All the Flying Knives' moves can be freely unleashed with adjustable direction.

Sunder The Stars: The attack range and distance are determined by charging. The 1st-stage charged attack unleashes the [Sunder The Stars], while the 2nd unleashes [Rend The Moon].

Rapid Throw: Rapidly throw multiple flying knives to overwhelm your enemies.

Pierce The Sun: A dash attack that follows up on charged strikes, allowing you to close the gap and attack distant foes.

 

II. Fairyland Penglai Brand-new Gameplay

1. Ferris Wheel

Players can hop on the Ferris wheel from the bridge on the north side of the Seraphic Quartet on Fairyland Penglai. Inside, you can enjoy a slow ride and take in the beautiful views. It’s a great chance to ride with friends and make some fun memories together!

2. Rocking Chair

New rocking chairs have been added to the Seraphic Quartet. Players can sit in it to trigger unique actions and music!

 

III. New Season: Ignis

Mirage Season will end on Apr. 1, 2025 at 00:00 (UTC)

Details of the Season Settlement Notice: https://www.narakathegame.com/news/update/20250331/33459_1223917.html

 

IV. Limited-time Event: Scorching Rebirth

The flames brightened the vast sky, while the hidden embers in the abyss conceal the mysterious light.

Event Rules:

1. Players can select one of two Cultivation Bonuses each day:

Ignis Rise: If you gain Score from a Ranked match, you will get a 25% score bonus; if you lose Score from a Ranked match, your Score loss will be halved. Eurekas will diminish by 1. No Eureka is used when the score is 0.

Blazing Abyss: Gain 150% XP and Treasure XP from the next match of the Survival mode, Casual mode or Showdown (Yama's Abyss excluded), diminishing Eurekas by 1.

Players can choose only one Cultivation Bonus per day, and the choice cannot be changed.

2. Choosing a Cultivation Bonus each day grants an additional Eureka.

3. Completing each event quest grants an Eureka. There are 7 quest sets, unlocking sequentially over time, one after another upon completion of the prior set.

4. Eurekas expire daily, so please use them the same day they're received.

5. The event grants extra rewards based on the total number of quests completed.

Event Duration: Mar. 31, 2025 20:00 (UTC) - Apr. 16, 2025 20:00 (UTC)

 

V. Limited-time Event: Blessing of Water

Event Duration: Apr. 1, 2025 Update - Apr. 16, 2025 20:00 (UTC)

Claim Rewards Before: Apr. 19, 2025 20:00 (UTC)

1. During the event, players visiting Fairyland Penglai can interact with the special Water NARAKA Ball to transform into it.

2. When transformed into a Water NARAKA Ball, colliding with other players gives both you and the collided player a chance to get Water Balls. Water Balls can be exchanged for exclusive event rewards.

3. The ranged weapon [Swarm] gains a special effect during the Water Festival: shooting water bombs! Swarms can be obtained from Stashes or Morus' Blessing, and can be cast into the Wishing Well.

 

VI. Limited-time Event: Watery Rebirth

Event Duration: Apr. 9, 2025 20:00 (UTC) - Apr. 22, 2025 20:00 (UTC)

1. During the event, there is a 17% time-limited discount for Outfits, Weapon Skins, and Accessories.

2. Buy cosmetics in bulk during the event to receive even greater discounts: Buying 2-3 cosmetics, outfits, and accessories nets you an extra 22% discount; for weapons, an extra 33% discount. If you buy 4+ items, all cosmetics enjoy an extra discount (45% at most). These discounts won't stack with other discounts.

3. There are better discounts for Justice·Polar Night, Dragon Will·Awareness, and 2674·Ruby-Red Emblem. The prices of all items are subject to the actual payment amount.

4. You'll be rewarded further for collecting designated cosmetics from the event too. Collect any 1 piece of cosmetics to obtain the Epic Background - Bai Ethnic·Blue Dye; collect 2 pieces to obtain the Epic Base - Bai Ethnic·Velvet; collect 4 pieces to obtain Legendary Accessory - Wamao.

 

VII. PlayStation Challenge

Challenge the wind in this race! PlayStation Sky-high Racing #13 is now open!

Compete against players worldwide and ascend the rankings by achieving a place among the Top 100 fastest in Sky-high Racing mode.

How to participate:
Start Sky-high Racing on Fairyland Penglai to participate in the event.

Event Duration: Apr. 1, 2025 00:00 (UTC) - May 7, 2025 23:59 (UTC)

 

VIII. 2nd PlayStation® Tournaments #4

The rivers and lakes awaken, where the blade reveals its true prowess. 2nd PlayStation® Tournaments #4 are available for a limited time!

Event Duration: Apr. 1, 2025 20:00 (UTC) - May 7, 2025 20:00 (UTC).

Event Rules:

Complete weekly quests during the event to claim Jade Medal - APR. You can claim more Medals in the mail after advancing, and the quantity awarded for each rank is as follows:

1st place: 300 Medals

2nd place: 200 Medals

3rd-4th place: 100 Medals

5th-8th place: 50 Medals

Medals can be used for redeeming rewards and participating in rankings.

Hero Adjustments
I. Viper Ning

1. Adjusted the effect of [Yushan Strike] to: Blast enemies in front of you and mark them with [Silence].

2. Optimized the movement speed and the performance of the auto-aim for the the skills [Yushan Strike] and [Yushan Strike: Wound] when used in mid-air.

3. Ultimate [Moonbane Control] now can be used when hit, and the consumption of Rage has been adjusted: 60% is consumed immediately upon release, and 40% is consumed during the subsequent skill duration.

4. Ultimate [Moonbane Control: Unchained]'s explosive strike now will silence the enemy for 4 seconds.

5. Enemies' health bars will be displayed while marked by Viper Ning's Ultimates [Moonbane Control] and [Moonbane Control: Unchained].

6. Deleted [Yushan Strike: Silence].

7. Deleted [Moonbane Control: Silence].

 

II. Lannie

The following adjustments have been made to Ultimate [Tricky Bounce: Leap]:

1. Hold to charge and enhance the power of the Trick Ball when you have it in hand; swinging after dashing to catch the ball will enhance its power.

2. Optimized the hit box when the Trick Ball collides with the environment.

3. Adjusted the hit effect of the Trick Ball when it hits an enemy.

4. Optimized the feel of Dash Catch moves and Lannie's final throw.

 

III. Wuchen

1. Increased the projectile speed and hitbox of the flying swords for the skill [Spirit Blades: Swap]. When Wuchen lands after teleporting, he will now emit a blast that knocks back nearby enemies.

2. After Wuchen releases [Yin Yang Orb], the distance between the character and his teammates is displayed in real-time.

 

IV. Tessa

1. When releasing the Ultimate [Enchant], the amount of Tessa's Health restored upon hitting an enemy has been increased from 100 to 140.

2. Upon releasing [Enchant: Group Prey], Tessa restores 100 Health for each enemy hit.

 

V. Kurumi

Adjusted [Healing Ray]'s Cooldown time from 15 sec to 18 sec.

 

Weapon Adjustments
I. Unified Adjustments for Melee Weapons

Optimized the buffering of dodge interruption for Scale Rush.

 

II. Unified Adjustments for Ranged Weapons

Reduced dodge distance when holding a ranged weapon.

 

III. Katana

Slightly reduced the stagger time caused when 1st stage charged Horizontal Strikes or Vertical Strikes hit an enemy, and slightly sped up the timing of combos.

 

IV. Dual Blades

1. Slightly delayed the timing of combos after 1st stage charged Vertical Strikes.

2. Slightly reduced the stagger time caused by charged Horizontal Strikes.

 

V. Staff

1. Increased how high enemies are knocked airborne by Uppercut Slash.

2. Slightly reduced the stagger time caused after hitting an enemy on the ground with a charged Horizontal Strike.

3. Delayed the point at which weapon switching can happen after a charged Horizontal Strike.

 

VI. Nunchucks

1. Increased how high enemies are knocked airborne by Uppercut Slash.

2. Reduced damage multiplier for 1st stage charged Horizontal Strikes from 2.56 to 1.98.

 

VII. Longsword

Delayed the point at which 2nd, 3rd stage Horizontal Strikes, and 3rd stage Vertical Strikes can be interrupted with Grappling Hooks.

//Dev Note: Balancing risk and reward during gaming is something we've been working on for a long time. Some combos have been weakened in the new version, making the gain of a combo more reasonable.

 
Souljade Adjustments
I. Longsword Souljade

[Engraving] The point at which the warning effect for the move appears has been moved forward.

 
In-game Adjustments
I. Feature Optimizations

Adjustments to the way Dark Tide Coins are given out for in-game Quest Scrolls.

The total number of Dark Tide Coins will now be calculated based on the number of members in a team and the Dark Tide Coins supposed to be given to each person in a quest, after which the Dark Tide Coins will be divided equally in real-time based on the number of members in the team who were not eliminated.

*Please note that players who quit the game (marked with an Unplugged icon) will not have their Dark Tide Coins counted towards the total. Players who have not died but still quit the game will not get the Dark Tide Coins for the eliminated players.

2. Optimization for the playing of hints on loading screens

Hints will now be played on a loop on loading screens.

 

II. Bloodsport Adjustments

Optimized the logic of switching targets when spectating a battle. Now targets will be switched in the order in the Match Schedule.

 

Out-game Adjustments
I. Compatibility Marking

When this setting is on, weapons on the ground that match the Souljades in your Bag will be marked.

 

Showdown Adjustments
I. Combat Adjustments

1. Optimized the resident sound effect of [Lotus].

2. Rephrased the descriptions of [Elemental Damage] of some Souljades.

3. Significantly reduced the frequency of [Fiery Monster]'s Binding Formation.

4. Optimized the sound effects of Mountain Ghost and Stone Monster when they are spawned.

5. Reduced the Focus level of Omen [Rapid Growth], so you won't be knocked back when using attack moves anymore.

 

II. Enigma Domain

Optimized the boundary range for Bosses in the Enigma Domain triggering return behavior in certain areas.

 

III. Free Training Adjustments

Added continuous attack training mode for Mountain Ghost.

 
Feature Optimizations
I. Client

1. Supports AMD Anti-Lag2, which is an in-game technology that minimizes the input lag for the ultimate in low-latency gaming by frame alignment between the CPU and GPU to deliver even more responsive experiences. AMD RDNA™ architecture and above discrete and integrated graphics: AMD Radeon™ RX 5000 series desktop and mobile graphics, and higher. For DX11 mode, Adrenalin Edition™ 24.6.1 or higher is required. For DX12 mode, Adrenalin Edition™ 24.7.1 or higher is required.

2. AMD FSR3 is updated to version 3.1, which supports advanced frame generation technology combined with AMD Anti-Lag2 technology to deliver even more responsive experiences.

3. Integrates Intel® Xe Low Latency technology, employing advanced algorithms optimized for Intel® Arc™ GPUs to improve responsiveness from user inputs to display output.

 

4. Integrates the latest Intel® XeSS Frame Generation technology, enabling players to activate this feature on Intel® Arc™ GPUs with AI acceleration hardware. When combined with Xe Low Latency technology, the AI-powered frame interpolation significantly boosts performance.

 

5. Added an adaptive option for Variable Rate Shading (VRS) which, when turned on, adaptively calculates the shading rate based on the relationship between the object currently being drawn and the camera position, the size of the object on the screen, and other factors. This effectively improves the rendering performance while ensuring the graphics quality.

6. Optimized texture stream loading strategy to improve performance.

 

Store Updates
I. Extreme Hairstyle

Tarka Ji Extreme Hairstyle [Ember's Fury] is now available. To redeem it, you'll need 50 Cloud Mirror and 60 Floral Dew.

You will also get exclusive Tattoo [Ember's Fury Tattoo] and exclusive Debute Pose [Blazing Lotus].

 

II. New Packs

1. Newly added Tessa exclusive [Kuromi Pack], including Legendary Outfit [Sanrio Family·Kuromi], Legendary Accessory [Kuromi·Sweet & Cool], Legendary Hairstyle [Kuromi·Bicolor Curls]. Standard price: 4,500 Gold; Now: 2,880 Gold. Single items are discounted, and you get even more discounts when you purchase a Pack.

2. Added Kurumi exclusive Pack [Hello Kitty Pack], which contains the exclusive Legendary Outfit [Sanrio Family·Hello Kitty], Legendary Accessory [Hello Kitty·Lace Headband], Legendary Hairstyle [Hello Kitty·Odango]. Standard price: 3,800 Gold; Now: 2,500 Gold. Individual cosmetics have their own discounts, but the Pack discount is even bigger!

4. Added Yueshan exclusive Pack [River of Crimson Pack ], which contains the exclusive Legendary Outfit [Poetic Rhymes·River of Crimson] and the Legendary Hairstyle [Poetic Rhymes·Valorous Tie]. notes.title: NARAKA: BLADEPOINT Update – March 13th, 2025
notes.content:
Dear players,
The servers of NARAKA: BLADEPOINT will be suspended for maintenance from March 12th, 2025 23:00 (UTC) to March 13th, 2025 04:00 (UTC). We suggest you log out in advance and enter the game again after the maintenance.
The details for this update are as follows:
Brand New Content
I. Limited-Time Event: Poetic Springtime
Event Duration: Mar. 13, 2025 Update - Mar. 31, 2025 20:00 (UTC)
Event Rules:
1. Complete Daily and Weekly Quests during the event to receive Soulbloom School Badges.
2. Spend Soulbloom School Badges on the event page to unlock campus locations, obtain their rewards, and a picture. There are a total of 5 locations to unlock.
3. You'll no longer be able to take on new quests once the event finishes, but you can still spend Soulbloom School Badges to unlock campus locations.


Combat Adjustments
1. Reduced dodge distance when not holding a weapon.
2. Optimized the pre-input for a successful counter, preventing the accidental triggering of a second counter.

Souljade Adjustments
I. Longsword Souljade
Changed [Leaping Slash] to [Engraving], introducing a new motion.

Out-of-game Adjustments
I. Debut Pose Optimization
1. Debut Poses can now be triggered manually. Press F7 (or select the option in the radial menu if using a controller) in Fairyland Penglai or during the preparation stage to activate them.

II. Friend Adjustments
Added friend verification messages. You can now include a custom message when sending a friend request.

III. Home Display Gesture
Adjusted the Home display gesture for Katana and Heng Sword.


Showdown Adjustments
I. Combat Adjustments
1. Optimized the Freeze effect when Frostbite reaches the cap, extending its alarm time. This effect can now be resisted by Defuse.
When your ThunderShock maxes out, you will no longer take damage from Divine Thunder.
2. The moves of [Matron of Yushan] and [Omnius·Aureate] and the [Manticore]'s poison balls, lightning balls, and spinning lightning strikes now deal significantly decreased elemental accumulation damage to players.
3. Optimized the motion of Ziping Yin's Aegis-break Martial Skill [Celestial Passage].
4. Fixed the issue where some of [Vinemire]'s moves had a slight chance of missing their hit and improved hit reactions for certain moves.
5. Optimized the Health of [Omnius·Bough]'s light orbs, making them easier to destroy.
6. Reduced the combo damage of the consecutive hits by [Omnius·Bough]'s light orbs.
7. Slightly increased the damage multiplier of [Blossom Blast] when the Souljade [Poison Root] is equipped.
8. The base damage multiplier when countering Divine Thunder while [Thunder Counter] is equipped has been changed from 0.47 to 0.5.
II. Feature Optimizations
1. The corresponding Combat BGM will now play when you approach a boss in Enigma Domain, Nirriti's Ruins, and Yama's Abyss.
2. Added "Auto-Recast" to Souljade Recast - Recast Attribute. Auto-Recast automatically consumes materials to recast the selected attributes until a target is reached or all materials are depleted.
Added "Recast 5 Times" to the Recast interface. You can now consume materials for 5 Recasts to Recast a chosen attribute 5 times in a row.
3. Added "Skip" option in Souljade Conversion to skip animation.


Feature Adjustments
1. When purchasing Extreme Hairstyles, players will now be able to purchase the required Cloud Mirrors or Floral Dew all at once.
2. After this update, Customization and Hairstyle interfaces will support zooming in and out.

Store Updates
I. New Packs
1. Added Zai exclusive Pack [Moonlit Waves Pack], which contains Zai exclusive Legendary Outfit [Spring Prelude·Moonlit Waves], Legendary Accessory [Spring Prelude·Clarity], Legendary Hairstyle [Spring Prelude·Nocturne]. Standard price: 3,800 Gold; Now: 2,400 Gold. Individual cosmetics have their own discounts, but the Pack discount is even bigger!
2. Added Cyra exclusive Pack [Harmony Light Pack], which contains Cyra Legendary Outfit [Spring Prelude·Harmony Light] and Legendary Hairstyle [Spring Prelude·Euphony]. Standard price: 2,600 Gold; Now: 1,800 Gold. Individual cosmetics have their own discounts, but the Pack discount is even bigger!

II. New Discounts
1. Newly added Dual Blades Legendary Skin [The Cursed Moon]. Standard price: 1,500 Gold; Now: 240 Gold.
2. Newly added Zai Epic Pose [Spring Prelude·Inquiry]. Standard price: 300 Gold; Now: 200 Gold.
3. Newly added Cyra Epic Pose [Spring Prelude·Reflection]. Standard price: 300 Gold; Now: 200 Gold.
4. Justina Gu Legendary Pose [Spring Prelude·Polite Refusal]. Standard price: 900 Gold; Now: 750 Gold.
5. Ziping Yin Legendary Pose [Spring Prelude·A Little Proud]. Standard price: 900 Gold; Now: 750 Gold.
6. Kurumi Legendary Outfit [Spring Prelude·Morning Breeze]. Standard price: 1,800 Gold; Now: 1,500 Gold.
7. Kurumi Epic Hairstyle [Spring Prelude·Early-Flowering Cherry]. Standard price: 500 Gold; Now: 400 Gold.
8. Kurumi Legendary Accessory [Spring Prelude·Ice Cream]. Standard price: 900 Gold; Now: 750 Gold.
9. Tessa Legendary Outfit [Spring Prelude·Carmine Feather]. Standard price: 1,800 Gold; Now: 1,500 Gold.
10. Tessa Legendary Hairstyle [Spring Prelude·Ethereal Crystal]. Standard price: 800 Gold; Now: 600 Gold.
11. Tessa Legendary Accessory [Spring Prelude·Little Fox]. Standard price: 900 Gold; Now: 750 Gold.

III. New-Look Bubble Choice Gift Available for a Limited Time
Event Duration: Mar. 21, 2025 03:00 - Mar. 26, 2025 20:00 (UTC)
The New-Look Bubble Choice Gift will be available for purchase in the store and recommendation page for a limited time. Buy it to choose any one of nearly 50 BATTLEPASS Bubbles. You can purchase up to 5 of them. Check the official website for a list of the cosmetics.

IV. New-Look Avatar Choice Gift Available for a Limited Time
Event Duration: Mar. 21, 2025 03:00 - Mar. 26, 2025 20:00 (UTC)
The New-Look Avatar Choice Gift will be available for purchase in the store and recommendation page for a limited time. Buy it to choose any one of nearly 60 BATTLEPASS Avatars. You can purchase up to 5 of them. Check the official website for a list of the cosmetics.


Bug Fixes
I. Battle-related Bug
Fixed the issue where Counter Form can be quickly interrupted by using Healing Berries or Armor Powder.
II. Cosmetic-related Bugs
Upgradable cosmetics' Iridescent Paints will not be calculated as a part of a player's total Legendary or Extreme cosmetics. For now, the calculation rules for [2674·Prototype] will not be affected by this.

notes.title: NARAKA: BLADEPOINT Update – February 27th, 2025
notes.content:
Dear players,
The servers of NARAKA: BLADEPOINT will be suspended for maintenance from Feb 26th, 2025 at 23:00 (UTC) to Feb 27th, 2025 04:00 (UTC). We suggest you log out in advance and enter the game again after the maintenance.
The details for this update are as follows:
Brand New Content
I. Showdown: Brand New Content
1. New Hero: Ziping Yin
The new hero Ziping Yin has now joined Showdown! All who suffer shall by her hand be healed!
Ziping Yin has a new mechanism in Showdown:
(1) [Nature's Touch] increases the Elemental Accumulation Rate for the entire team. If Ziping Yin performs a Horizontal Strike immediately after casting this skill, Dragonslayer will be unleashed.
(2) [Saving Grace] increases the Elemental DMG for the entire team.

2. New Souljades
Newly added Souljades [Frostbound Lotus], [Thunderous Lotus], and [Venomous Lotus]

3. Limited-time Event Level [Suffer No Demon]
Event Duration: Feb. 27, 2025 Update - Mar. 12, 2025 20:00 (UTC)
(1) During the event, you can select this level on the Showdown Map. Complete all Event Quests to get an exclusive Hero Badge, Exhilarating Elixir, and other rewards.
(2) Sense Level in [Suffer No Demon] will not impact damage dealt or received, and the Level is split into two chapters:
Chapter 1: Mystic Waters
Using Heroes' Skills summon a barrage of water spears, delivering wide-range attacks.
Chapter 2: Calm the Storm
Fallen enemies release ring-shaped currents, significantly boosting Elemental Accumulation for enemies struck.
