Hero Adjustments
I. Ziping Yin
1. Adjusted the casting mechanism of Ziping Yin's skills [Nature's Touch] and [Nature's Touch: Protect]. When aiming at a teammate, a lock-on frame will be displayed; firing a Spiritual Twig at this time will enhance its tracking ability.
2. After casting her Ultimate, Ziping Yin can now perform a special dodge without consuming Stamina.
3. Removed the Skill variant [Nature's Touch: Surround].
4. Removed the Ultimate variant [Saving Grace: Gauze].
//Dev Note: Ziping Yin's Spiritual Twigs sometimes failed to catch fast-moving teammates in battle. To resolve this issue, we optimized the skill's casting mechanism.


II. Shayol Wei
1. Slightly delayed when the Skill [Shield Bash: Rush] goes on cooldown after casting.
2. Slightly delayed the point at which crouching or jumping can be used to interrupt the Skill [Shield Bash: Rush]'s attack.
3. When the Ultimates [Justiciar's Guard] or [Justiciar's Guard: Pursuit] triggers [Black Tortoise Block], Shayol's Skill's remaining cooldown is reduced.
4. When [Black Tortoise Block] is triggered, the counterattack move of the Ultimate [Justiciar's Guard] is stored. Stored counterattacks can be used at any time, as long as Shayol Wei isn't under control or attack.
5. Optimized the casting method of the counterattack move of the Ultimate [Justiciar's Guard]. This move can now be cast in the aimed direction, with its Damage Multiplier adjusted from 2.8 to 3.0.
//Dev Note: As battle strategies and environments evolve, we've identified a lack of viable vertical combat techniques for Shayol Wei. To address this issue, we optimized the casting method of [Justiciar's Guard]'s counterattack move, offering greater flexibility in the timing of counterattacks.


III. Lannie
1. The following adjustments have been made to the Ultimate [Tricky Bounce]:
(1) Optimized the Trick Ball's catch mechanism: When Lannie uses her Skill while her Ultimate is active, she now can only catch a returning Trick Ball. (Prior to this change, Lannie could catch Trick Balls that had just been launched or were attacking while using her Skill.)
(2) The progress of the Trick Ball's return will now be displayed.
(3) Optimized the crosshair when the Ultimate is active.
(4) Optimized some motion and special effects.

2. The following adjustments have been made to the Ultimate [Tricky Bounce: Leap]:
(1) A small amount of HP will be restored when the Trick Ball returns or upon successfully catching it.
(2) Increases the Trick Ball's flight time; its flight speed is no longer reduced when it bounces back.
(3) Trick Ball attacks can now interrupt an enemy's Golden Focus weapon moves; both the first and final hit during the attack can stagger Vajras, Almighty Generals, and Bronze Mechs.
//Dev Note: We noticed that the sound effect for the Trick Ball's return during the Ultimate [Tricky Bounce] was not functioning properly in certain situations. Therefore, we optimized the sound effect and added a visual display to show Trick Ball's return progress.


IV. Hadi
1. Hadi can no longer use recovery items (Healing Berries, Armor Powder, etc.) when flying. Adjusted the Rage cost for reentering flying mode after exiting it during the Ultimate from 12 to 8.
2. Adjusted the duration of Mechanical Cubes placed by the Ultimate [Aerial Ascent] from 25 sec to 20 sec and added a remaining time display on the interface.
3. Increased the hit range of the Mechanical Arms launched by the skill [Mechanical Arm].

V. Cyra
Adjusted the duration of the Ultimate [Light's Mercy] in Trios from 25 sec to 22 sec, and its basic Light Shield from 2000 to 1800.

VI. Valda Cui
Adjusted the basic shield of the Ultimate [Rising Tide: Unchained] in Solos from 2200 to 1800.

VII. Kylin Zhang
Adjusted the HP cost of a single slash in the Ultimate [Qilin Slash: Rend] from 350 to 300 and the recovery amount for hitting one enemy from 100 to 150.

VIII: Kurumi
Optimized the special effects of the Healing Circle summoned by the Ultimate [Purified Circle], making them more fitting for the actual skill effects.

Souljade Adjustments
I. Fistblades Souljades
Optimized the motion of [Tempest Kick]. The character can now change directions while attacking.

II. Spear Souljades
Optimized the special effects of [Razor Swift].

In-game Adjustments
I. Bot Mode
Optimized the tempo of skirmishes between AI opponents and players.
II. Golden Roc Escort
1. Lowered the price of Melee Purple Souljades and increased the purchase limit for certain Souljades.
2. Added the [Reward System]. Rewards will be triggered when a player survives for a certain period and when defeating or assisting with defeating multiple enemies in a row. Defeating opponents with different reward levels grants corresponding amounts of Dark Tide Coins.
3. Raised the Reputation Score requirement for participating in Golden Roc Escort matchmaking to 8500 points and increased the AFK penalty in the gameplay.

Out-of-game Adjustments
I. Talents
Changed the effect "2nd stage Dodge does not consume Stamina" in [Omni] Wave Roll to "2nd stage Dodge Stamina Cost -30%."
//Dev Note: The effect of [Omni] Wave Roll was a bit too powerful against heroes like Hadi and Yoto Hime, so we've increased the opportunities to counter it while preserving its unique system.

II. Free Training Adjustments
1. Added "Counter" and "Counterstrike Combo" to Custom Training.
2. Reduced the frequency of dropped items being cleared.

III. Ranked Season Rewards Adjustment
Starting this season, players who make it to Asura in all three queues (Solo, Duos, and Trios) will get an additional Hero Badge.

IV. Out-Game Optimizations
Optimized the mechanisms that governed switching Outfits, Accessories, Weapons, Hairstyles, Hair Dyeing, and other cosmetics. All switching of cosmetics will no longer have a cooldown (Except the hero being used in Fairyland Penglai). Switch as fast as you like!
Showdown Adjustments
I. Combat Adjustments
1. Optimized the performance of using movement to interrupt the special stances Defuse·Solve, Defuse·Combo, or Defuse·Dash, or the defuse motion for all heroes.
2. Reduced the damage of multiple hits dealt by [Vinemire]'s rush.
3. Reduced the damage of multiple hits dealt by [Manticore]'s rush in Stage I.
4. Reduced the damage of multiple hits dealt by [Omnius·Bough]'s laser in Stage I.

II. Stage Adjustments
Optimized the descriptions of some quests in Prologue - The Beginning.

III. Unlock Level Adjustments
Showdown now unlocks at Lv. 15. This change applies to all new accounts created after Feb. 18th (UTC+8).

IV. Potential Adjustments
1. Slightly increased the Damage Multiplier of [Lotus Impact] and [Blossom Blast] when equipped with the Potential [Thunder Root].
2. Optimized the display of Potentials in Showdown.
3. Added a display of Potentials equipped by ranked players in Racing Leaderboard and Yama's Abyss Leaderboard.


Client Optimization
1. DLSS4 Multi-Frame Generation
Integrated the latest DLSS4 multi-frame generation technology. Players with GeForce RTX 50 Series graphics cards can enable this feature, using AI to generate up to three additional frames for each rendered frame, delivering higher FPS and smoother visuals.
2. Optimized the character Grappling Hook resources, offering a smoother experience when using the Grappling Hook.
3. Optimized in-game loot memory, improving memory reclamation after battles to reduce memory growth.


Store Updates
I. New Packs
1. Added Kurumi exclusive Pack [Soft Dream], which contains Legendary Outfit [Heart Beat·Soft Dream], Katana Legendary Skin [Snow-Touched Velvet], Legendary Hairstyle [Heart Beat·Ballad of Love] and Voice Pack [Kurumi·Soft Dream Chinese Voice Pack]. Standard price: 5,100 Gold; Now: 3,000 Gold. Individual cosmetics have their own discounts, but the Pack discount is even bigger!
2. Added Justina Gu exclusive Pack [Eira Blossom], which contains the Legendary Outfit [Spring Prelude·Eira Blossom], Legendary Accessory [Spring Prelude·Glasses of Grace] and Legendary Hairstyle [Spring Prelude·Icy Dewdrop]. Standard price: 3,800 Gold; Now: 2,400 Gold. Individual cosmetics have their own discounts, but the Pack discount is even bigger!
3. Added Ziping Yin exclusive Pack [Spring Prelude·Blissful Bloom], which contains the Legendary Outfit [Spring Prelude·Blissful Bloom], Legendary Hairstyle [Spring Prelude·Sweet Whisper] and Legendary Accessory [Spring Prelude·Marshmallow Rabbit]. Standard price: 3,800 Gold; Now: 2,400 Gold. Individual cosmetics have their own discounts, but the Pack discount is even bigger!



II. Added New Discounts
1. Newly added Kurumi Legendary Pose [Heart Beat·Please Accept This]. Standard price: 900 Gold. Now: 750 Gold.
2. Newly added Justina Gu Legendary Pose [Spring Prelude·Polite Refusal]. Standard price: 900 Gold; Now: 750 Gold.
3. Newly added Ziping Yin Legendary Pose [Spring Prelude·A Little Proud]. Standard price: 900 Gold; Now: 750 Gold.
4. Kurumi Legendary Outfit [Spring Prelude·Morning Breeze].
Standard price: 1,800 Gold; Now: 1,500 Gold.
5. Kurumi Epic Hairstyle [Spring Prelude·Early-Flowering Cherry]. Standard price: 500 Gold; Now: 400 Gold.
6. Kurumi Legendary Accessory [Spring Prelude·Ice Cream].
Standard price: 900 Gold; Now: 750 Gold.
7. Tessa Legendary Outfit [Spring Prelude·Carmine Feather].
Standard price: 1,800 Gold; Now: 1,500 Gold.
8. Tessa Legendary Hairstyle [Spring Prelude·Ethereal Crystal]. Standard price: 800 Gold; Now: 600 Gold.
9. Tessa Legendary Accessory [Spring Prelude·Little Fox].
Standard price: 900 Gold; Now: 750 Gold.
 
III. New Items in Spectral Silk Store
Newly added Lannie Legendary Voice Pack [Lannie·Melodic Tales Chinese Voice Pack] with a price of 10,000 Spectral Silk.
 
IV. New Items in the Item Store
Added the new store item "Surmount Card·Mirage," which can be used to upgrade the Mirage Hidden Treasure by 30 levels for only 1,800 Gold. Can only be purchased once.

Bug Fixes
I. Hero-Related Bugs
1. Fixed the issue where the skill casting was interrupted if Justina Gu moved at the moment she hit the ground after the plunging attack from the 2nd-stage move of her Ultimate [Arctic Wraith] cast in mid-air.
2. Fixed the issue where the Invisible duration of Lannie's skill [Vanishing Act] from the player's perspective didn't match its actual duration.
3. Fixed the issue where the sound effect signalling the return of the Trick Ball in Lannie's Ultimate [Tricky Bounce] was occasionally not audible.

II. Battle-related Bugs
1. Fixed the issue where the glow intensity of some outfits under the Blue Focus effect was inconsistent.
2. Fixed the issue where attacks from teammates occasionally interrupt the rescue process.
3.Fixed an issue in Showdown mode where Valda Cui's 'Water Trap: Showdown' would replace the [Soaked] effect previously applied by allies.

notes.content:
Dear players,
Starting on February 13th, 2025 at 04:00 (UTC), we will be carrying out maintenance on NARAKA: BLADEPOINT servers. There is no need to log out during this time, and you can continue to play normally while the servers are being updated.

Store Updates
I. Yin Yang Pool·Twice the Bliss
Each time you open the Yin Yang Pool, you need to consume 1 [Twice the Bliss Ingot], priced at 400 Gold. After opening the Yin Yang Pool, you will have a chance to get 22 rewards such as Tessa's Legendary Outfit [Thread of Fate], Wuchen's Legendary Outfit [Joyous Feathers] and the Legendary Emote Gesture [Twice the Bliss·Tender Bond] for all heroes.
The first opening is free, and you'll receive different rewards each time. You can open up to 21 times to collect all the rewards in the prize pool.
When obtaining a special reward, you can get the following cosmetics: Legendary Emote Gesture [Twice the Bliss·Tender Bond] for all heroes and Legendary Avatar [Sweetest Union].
When opening the Yin Yang pool, there is a chance for you to unlock all remaining rewards at once. After all the rewards have been obtained, [Twice the Bliss Ingots] can be exchanged into Gold.
Guarantee:
Based on the above drop rate, players are guaranteed to receive at least one Gold (Legendary) reward within the first 4 draws. Another guaranteed Gold (Legendary) reward within 5 more draws, followed by the next guaranteed Gold (Legendary) reward within 7 more draws.

notes.title: NARAKA: BLADEPOINT Update – Jan 21st, 2025
notes.content:
Dear players,
The servers of NARAKA: BLADEPOINT will be suspended for maintenance from January 20th, 2025 at 23:00 (UTC) to January 21st, 2025 at 04:00 (UTC). We suggest you log out in advance and enter the game again after the maintenance.
The details for this update are as follows:
Brand New Content
I. New Hero: Lannie
 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36350327/8c17f26039248670c6f70f7d334dc73b54b9c867.png[/img]
Life, they say, life, they say, means ya gotta work all day.
But life for Lannie ain't like that, and she is never going back.
Learn a trade and secure my future? No way, no way!
Work hard and climb life's ladder? No way, no way!
They tell you lies so you'll work for free.
But when it's late morning and you're slaving away, who's living like a god? That's right, me!

II. Season Exclusive: Spring Lantern·Hua
 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36350327/6bec80d86d1aa217131ef68241a8e1674366a6a0.png[/img]
1. The Spring Lantern·Hua is priced at 360 Gold. Open for a chance to obtain rewards like Lannie Extreme Outfit [Immortal in the Scroll] and the Polesword Extreme Skin [Fierce Tiger].
2. While you have the outfit [Immortal in the Scroll] equipped, there will be a running astral deer effect when you defeat enemies. Cannot be Imprinted: Moving fast or attacking will trigger an exclusive carefree immortal effect.
3. Equipping Polesword Extreme Skin [Fierce Tiger] changes the special effect of Counterstrike Combo and Souljade [Sap]. After a charged attack, the amber shatters to unlock the Tiger's Fury form, which then reconstructs itself once you are out of the combat.
4. Minimum Guarantee:
(1) Players are guaranteed to receive at least 1 Red (Extreme) reward during the process of opening at most 100 Treasures. This can be triggered multiple times. Red (Extreme) rewards will not repeat until all of them have been obtained.
(2) Legendary Cosmetic Minimum Guarantee: Within the first 25 Treasures opened, you are guaranteed to get either a Hero Outfit or a Weapon Skin. Subsequently, within every 25 Treasures opened, you are guaranteed to obtain a Legendary cosmetic that you have not yet unlocked. This guarantee can be triggered up to 14 times.
(3) Wishing Legendary Reward: If you draw an Extreme cosmetic, you can set a Legendary cosmetic which will be guaranteed when you draw a Legendary cosmetic next time. Times of guarantee can stack, but you can only set 1 cosmetic each time. If the Legendary Cosmetic Guarantee and Wishing Legendary Reward trigger simultaneously, priority is given to the Wishing Legendary Reward cosmetic and will reduce the number of remaining times that the Legendary Cosmetic Guarantee can be triggered by one.
5. Spring Lantern·Hua 50% Discount Voucher
The first 10 Spring Lantern·Hua that you buy will benefit from a 50% discount. This discount cannot be stacked with discounts from other discount vouchers. After 10 Spring Lantern·Hua have been purchased, subsequent Spring Lantern·Hua will return to their standard price.
6. Spring Lantern·Hua will be available on Jan. 21, 2025 at 04:00 (UTC)! 
After the server opens, players can preview content early, but the Spring Lantern·Hua will remain locked until the specified time.
The Star-Collection unlocks at the same time as the Spring Lantern·Hua.

III. [Golden Roc Escort] mode content adjustment
1. New [Faction Fusion] feature. Players in the same faction can't choose the same hero.
2. Slightly increased the capture rate of the Spirit Well.

IV. Fairyland Penglai: Spring Festival Gameplay
1. Wealth God's Blessing
The Wealth God has been added to the Seraphic Quartet. At the start of every hour and 15 minutes thereafter (UTC), the Grand Wealth God will descend on Fairyland Penglai, bringing Year of the Snake Grand Lucky Bags for all players.
Additionally, spending Fu Characters at the Wealth God's Hat in Fairyland Penglai will invite the Golden Wealth God in the spender's name, offering Golden Lucky Bags for all players on Fairyland Penglai.
Forming a Stack Up High team and collecting Red Packet Showers will provide additional boons. The rewards for the two types of Red Packet Showers are different. Wishing everyone good luck!
2. Fairyland Penglai New Year's Scenery
The Fairyland Penglai is decorated anew to celebrate the coming festival. May you all enjoy good fortune and wealth in the Year of the Snake!


V. Limited-time Event: Golden Spring Rising
Event Duration: Jan. 21, 2025 Update - Feb. 26, 2025 20:00 (UTC)
Event Rules:
1. During the event, players can get Spring Coins by opening Stashes in Survival modes or by completing matches of Golden Roc Escort mode or Showdown mode. Players can get up to 800 Spring Coins through matches every week. This limit will refresh at 20:00 (UTC) every Wednesday (first refreshes at 20:00 on Jan 29, 2025 (UTC)). Spring Coins can be used to upgrade Gift Tickets on the event page.
2. Each Gift Ticket can be upgraded 5 times and there is a chance of getting bonus effects like level skipping, multiplying, etc. during the process.
3. The higher your Gift Ticket Level, the higher the chance of getting high-quality rewards when opening the ticket; the higher your Gift Ticket Multiplier, the higher the number of rewards.
4. You can choose one from four Prize Pools when opening the Gift Tickets.
5. Gift Tickets will be issued regularly. You can check the next issue time and amount in the upper right corner of the event page.
6. The corresponding rewards will be granted after you upgrade your Gift Tickets a certain number of times. 

VI. Limited-time Event: Spring Festival Sign-in
Event Duration: Jan. 21, 2025 Update - Feb. 12, 2025 20:00 (UTC)
1. During the event, players can get special rewards by signing in on specific days during the event and can make up for the previous 2 days if they missed them.
2. If you sign in for 5, 10 and 15 consecutive days, you will get extra rewards such as Splendor Treasure Choice Gift, Spring Lantern·Hua or Legendary Base. 


VII. Limited-time Event: Wealth God's Arrival
Prosperity For All: The Wealth God Arrives!
Event Duration: Jan. 21, 2025 Update - Feb. 10, 2025 00:00 (UTC)
1. During the event, players can head to the Seraphic Quartet in Fairyland Penglai and interact with the Wealth God to make a Wish, or view others' Wishes. The most sincere of all wishes may receive a reward from the Wealth God!
2. Complete Quests to get Wealth God's Ingots. These can be consumed in the Wealth God Red Packet interface to open the Wealth God's exclusive Red Packets. Opening Red Packets can grant rich rewards.
Wealth God Red Packet:
1. Complete Quests to get Wealth God's Ingots. These can be consumed in the Wealth God Red Packet interface to open the Wealth God's exclusive Red Packets. Opening Red Packets can grant rich rewards.
2. The event runs for one round per week, 3 rounds in total. At the start of each round, the number of obtainable Wealth God Red Packets will be refreshed.
Wealth God's Rest is at the Seraphic Quartet on Fairyland Penglai.

VIII. Limited-time Event: Wealth God's Blessing
Event Duration: Jan. 21, 2025 Update - Feb. 27, 2025 00:00 (UTC)
Event Rules:
1. Grand Lucky Bag showers will appear in Fairyland Penglai at the start of every hour and every 15 min thereafter (UTC). 
2. During the event, every 300 Gold you spend grants you Fu Character*1. Spending Fu Characters at the Wealth God's Hat in Fairyland Penglai will invite the Golden Wealth God in the spender's name, offering [Golden Lucky Bags] for all players on Fairyland Penglai.
3. Inviting the Golden Wealth God a certain number of times will unlock Year of Snake Collections, including a Bubble, Avatar, Gesture, Chat Bubble, and Moonbane Charm Skin! 

IX. Limited-time Event: Dreamy Clouds
Event Duration: Jan. 21, 2025 Update - Feb. 10, 2025 20:00 (UTC)
Redeem the rewards before: Feb. 16, 2025 at 20:00 (UTC)
Event Rules:
1. Complete Daily Quests to obtain Lannie Trial Vouchers and Trick Balls.
2. Complete Event Quests to obtain Trick Balls. A new quest can be unlocked only after completing the current one. Quests can only be completed when they become available.
3. Consume Trick Balls to redeem rewards.

X.  Limited-time Event: Free Trial All Heroes
Event Duration: Jan. 21, 2025 Update - Feb. 26, 2025 20:00 (UTC)
Event Rules:
1. Play [The Herald's Trial] during the event to try out all heroes for free.
2. Trialing heroes in this event will not cost any Trial Vouchers. You may also complete Hero Cultivation tasks as per usual.


XI. Limited-time Event: Eternal Guandan
Event Duration: Jan. 27, 2025 00:00 - Feb. 16, 2025 20:00 (UTC)
1. During the event, play 1 round of Guandan to receive a limited, exclusive Bubble!
2. How to Start Playing:
There are three ways to access Guandan:
· Select Casual Mode from the Mode menu
· Navigate through Penglai Guide - Naraka Guandan
· Interact with Guandan tables in Fairyland Penglai (near Sky-high Racing) to open the Guandan menu.
3. New rewards have been added to the Guandan Redeem Shop, including Legendary Head Accessory [Guandan Crown], Epic Avatar [Guandan Fun Crown], Spring Lanter·Hua and other great rewards.

XII. Limited-time Event: Retro Bazaar
Limited-edition cosmetics in limited-time return!
Event Duration: Jan. 21, 2025 Update - Feb. 27, 2025 00:00 (UTC)
Specific cosmetics from before Tenacity Season are now returned with a 50% discount at most.
Viper Ning Legendary Outfit [Moonlit Attire], Legendary Accessory [Santa Hat·Male](For all), Legendary Accessory [Santa Hat·Female](For all), Tarka Ji Pose [Advance] and other gorgeous cosmetics await!
(Renewal Vouchers can be purchased in the Item Store.) 

XIII. Limited-time Event: Spring Festival Special Offer
Event Duration: Jan. 21, 2025 Update - Feb. 27, 2025 00:00 (UTC)
Event Rules:
1. During the event, 4 kinds of vouchers are claimable on the event page: Legendary Outfit 40% discount voucher, Legendary Weapon 40% discount voucher, Legendary Accessory 40% discount voucher and other Legendary Item 40% discount voucher. There are 2 of each voucher type to be claimed.
2. Use a voucher when purchasing the corresponding Legendary cosmetic with Gold, and you'll get a 40% discount. These discounts cannot be applied when purchasing gifts for friends.
3. Please note that vouchers are only eligible for the Legendary cosmetics of Season 12: Tenacity and previous seasons.
4. Vouchers are valid for a limited time only. Make sure you use yours before it expires.

XIV. Spring Lantern·Hua with bonus Star - Collections
Event Duration: Jan. 21, 2025 04:00 (UTC) - May. 8, 2025 00:00 (UTC)
Event Rules:
1. When opening Spring Lantern·Hua, there is a chance to receive the Zai Extreme Outfit, Star - Opaline Cascade and the Bow Legendary Skin, Star - Frostwind Arch.
2. How to obtain: Each time opening a Spring Lantern·Hua, there is a chance to obtain them as an additional reward. This chance increases as you obtain more Legendaries. The Maximum chance is 100%
3. The chances for the 2 Star-Collections are calculated separately and do not impact each other. After getting a Star-Collection, the corresponding chances will then reset.
4. Each account can receive a maximum of 10 [Star - Opaline Cascade] and 2 [Star - Frostwind Arch].
5. The number of Star-Collections granted through the Spring Lantern·Hua is limited and available while stocks last.

XV. 2025 Spring Festival Gift
Unlock for just $4.63 to purchase and claim 600 Gold, Viper Ning Legendary Outfit [Prehistory·Mountain Mist], Katana Legendary Skin [Guardian's Resolve], and loads of other rewards!

XVI. 2nd PlayStation® Tournaments #2
The rivers and lakes awaken, where the blade reveals its true prowess. 2nd PlayStation® Tournaments #2 are available for a limited time!
Event Duration: Jan. 21, 2025 20:00 (UTC) - Feb. 26, 2025 20:00 (UTC)
Event Rules:
Complete weekly quests during the event to claim Jade Medal - FEB. You can claim more Medals in the mail after advancing, and the quantity awarded for each rank is as follows:
	1st place: 300 Medals
	2nd place: 200 Medals

	Increased the Damage Multiplier of [Dreadful Wail]from 10.49 to 13.62.



II. Hero Adjustments
1. Matari
(1) Adjusted the skill effect to:
	Thrusts in the aimed direction and stops upon hitting an enemy, increasing your Elemental Accumulation and dealing Elemental damage; Dancing Leaves and Soulbreak Tusk are strengthened for a certain amount of time after releasing the skill, and will deal higher damage.
	Charge will penetrate enemies and increase the distance and damage of thrusting.
(2) Adjusted the ultimate to:
Reset skill cooldown and grant herself [Stealth].
	During the ultimate, [Flash] flashes faster with extra damage.
	Restore Health or Armor by attacking enemies.
(3) Matari will now be Golden Focused while using her Dagger's [Dreadful Wail] attack, and a certain pull effect has been added. It can be interrupted by Quick Dashing after the second stage.
(4) Matari's initial martial arts skills now include [Netherstep] and [Abyssal Aura].
(5) Skills and Ultimates can be used earlier after Matari executes an Airborne Quick Dash.

2. Wuchen
Added initial martial skill [Netherstep] for Wuchen.

3. Temulch
Adjusted the focus level of [Zephyr Wisp: Showdown] when launching a wind ball to Golden Focus, and wind balls' damage multipliers have been adjusted from 4.14 to 9.


III. Yama's Abyss Adjustments
Trios Mode for Yama's Abyss.
1. In Trios mode, all team members must agree before you can restart or continue to challenge the next level.
2. Solo mode shares first-time clear progress with Trios mode, but has a separate leaderboard.


IV. Function Adjustments
1. The screen for obtaining rewards, the screen for obtaining Souljade, and the Souljade containing rare attributes will also have special effects. The effect is consistent with the settlement screen.



V. Nirriti's Ruins Adjustments
1. Changed [HydroFlare·Condensed Flow] to be a Legendary Anima Ring, and shortened the cooldown of [HydroFlare] to 1.2 seconds.
2. [Toxin Blessing I] New effect: Reduces [Miasma] damage received by 35%, and [Miasma] and [Burning] damage taken will deduct the Armor value first; Remove the non-fatal effect of [Miasma] and [Burning].
3. Fixed the issue that the Anima Ring [Elemental Priming] and [Elemental Resonance] could not raise the damage of Ice Blast.

1. Fixed the issue where under certain circumstances, enemies could still be manipulated after Lyam Liu unleashes [Metal Fusion: Core] and successfully grabs an enemy.

notes.title: NARAKA: BLADEPOINT Update – Dec. 19th, 2024
notes.content:
Dear players,
The servers of NARAKA: BLADEPOINT will be suspended for maintenance from Dec. 18th, 2024 23:00 (UTC) to Dec. 19th, 2024 04:00 (UTC). We suggest you log out in advance and enter the game again after the maintenance.
The details for this update are as follows:
Brand New Content
I. Brand-new Gameplay: [Golden Roc Escort]

 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36350327/2d8a737953a725d2abb4751e00a344b1a03f7c84.png[/img]

Basic Rules
1. Each match is split into two halves, with teams taking turns playing as the Attackers and the Defenders.
2. During the first half, the Attackers must capture the Spirit Well, then summon and escort a Golden Roc to the destination to destroy a Border Stele. The Defenders must prevent this from happening.
3. In the second half, the teams swap roles and compete again.

Victory Conditions
1. After swapping sides, the targets and allotted time for the second half will be adjusted based on how well Attackers did in the first half.
2. If the second-half attackers can match the first-half progress within a certain time limit, they win; otherwise, it's a tie or loss.

Others
1. When defeated, select a Soul Altar on the map to revive.
2. Once the Spirit Well is captured, two Golden Rocs will appear with different routes. The Attackers only need to escort one of them to the destination.
3. The game will enter overtime if the Attackers are still within range of the Spirit Well or Golden Roc when regular match time expires.
4. Once overtime is up, the game will end immediately.
5. Soul Lantern: Across the map, you will find Soul Lanterns that can be activated to restore your Armor, Health, and Rage. Additionally, they provide a temporary boost to your Attack and Melee Resist. Once a lantern is used, it will go on cooldown.
II. New Season: Mirage
Aurora Season will come to an end on Dec. 19th, 2024 at 00:00 (UTC). For the full recap of season rewards and score resets please see our official announcement post:
https://www.narakathegame.com/news/update/20241216/33459_1200281.html

III. Brand New: Mirage BATTLEPASS
[Mirage] BATTLEPASS is now available, which includes a variety of valuable items and skins! Players can obtain more rewards by unlocking the Advanced Hidden Treasure! You can get a Treasure Scroll at the price of 1200 Gold and a Glory Scroll at 2840 Gold.

IV. New Fairyland Penglai Feature: Reindeer Sleigh
You can now board the Reindeer Sleigh on the north side of Seraphic Quartet and the west side of Mystoland (former Kiteboarding sites) in Fairyland Penglai to enjoy the festive vibe and island sights!
Gameplay:
1. You can move freely while riding the Reindeer Sleigh.
2. You can board the Reindeer Sleigh at any point along its route.

V. New Feature: Team Up
Access the Team Up feature by clicking the + button in the Lobby or switching tabs on the Friends page.
This feature will recommend suitable teams and players based on your compatibility with other teams and players. Team Up integrates the former team lobby features. You can access Create Party and other features from the former team lobby on this page.

VI. Limited-time Event: Winter's Blessings
Event Duration: Dec. 20, 2024 20:00 (UTC) - Jan. 8, 2024 20:00 (UTC)
Claim Rewards Deadline: Jan. 11, 2025 20:00 (UTC)
1. Open Stashes in Survival modes and play Showdown to gain up to 10 Rime Crystals per day. These can be redeemed for great event rewards.
2. Log into the game each day of the event to receive Winter's Blessings from different heroes, and other rewards. Collect all 12 Blessings to receive bonus rewards.
3. During the event, the ranged weapon Cannon will be changed to Snow-Cannon, firing snowballs (but not when using the Extreme Cannon skin [Divine Trial] while the [Meteor] Souljade is equipped). The Cannon Souljade [Rupture Gale Orb & Burn] will temporarily be replaced with [Rupture Gale Orb & Frostwind], but the effects and damage remain the same.

VII. Limited-time Event: Reverie Dragon
Butterflies flutter in dreamlike lands, as dragons vie for brilliant splendor.
Event Rules
1. Each day, players can choose one of the two Cultivations.
Dragon Splendor: If you gain Score from a Ranked match, you will get a 25% Score Bonus; if you lose Score from a Ranked match, your Score loss will be halved. Eurekas will diminish by 1. (No Eureka is used when the Score is 0.)
Butterfly Dreams: Gain 150% XP and Treasure XP from the next Survival mode, Casual mode or Showdown (Yama's Abyss excluded) match, diminishing Eurekas by 1.
Choose one for today. Once chosen, it cannot be changed.
2. Players can choose only one Cultivation Bonus per day, and the choice cannot be changed.
3. Completing each event quest grants a Eureka. There are 7 quest sets, which unlock sequentially over time, one after another upon completion of the prior set.
4. Eurekas expire daily, so please use them the same day they're received.
5. Complete more quests to win more great rewards.
Event Duration: Dec. 18, 2024 20:00 (UTC) - Jan. 7, 2025 20:00 (UTC)


VIII. Limited-time Event: Supremacy Clash
Event Duration: Dec. 19, 2024 Update - Jan. 4, 2025 20:00 (UTC)
Event Rules:
1. Collect Roc's Feathers by completing quests during the event, and redeem them for exclusive rewards.
2. Play Golden Roc Escort to complete quests faster.



IX: Limited-time Event: Season Treasures Return
Event Duration: Dec. 19, 2024 Update - Jan. 18, 2025 00:00 (UTC)
1. During the event, Mythic Treasure will return for a limited time.
2. The content and drop rate of rewards in Treasures will remain unchanged.
3. The number of times to trigger a Guarantee for the Treasures will not be reset, and the progress you made on the current season's Guarantee will carry over.

X. Limited-time Event: Starcatcher's Pavilion
Starcatcher's Pavilion: Where stars cascade into the celestial palace.
During the event, Star-Collections will be available for auction in the Starcatcher's Pavilion. Players can participate in the bidding using Spectral Silk. Once the bidding period ends, the highest bidder will claim the prize.
1. This Term of Star-Collections:
(1) Nunchucks Extreme Skin [Star - Ignis Animae] will be distributed independently across different platforms, with the quantity allocated to each platform detailed in the corresponding announcement.
The number of Star-Collections is limited, and will not be restocked after they are sold out.
2. There will be multiple rounds of bidding in this term. Details are as follows:
Rounds	Preview Starts	Auction Starts	Auction Ends	Item Name	Total Quantity	Starting Bid	Max Bid
1	After Dec. 19, 2024 Update
	Dec. 19, 2024 12:00 (UTC)	Dec. 25, 2024 14:00 (UTC)

(1) Preview: Preview the basic info of the items, their quantity, price, auction time, etc.
(2) Auction: During auction time, players can place bids and raise bids to win items.
(3) Settlement: After the auction, the system will tally the results.
(4) Conclusion: Check the auction results on the event page and claim your items if you win. If you lose, you will get your Spectral Silk back.
Please check the in-game event page for more details.

XI. PlayStation Challenge
Challenge the wind in this race! PlayStation Sky-high Racing #10 is now open!
Compete against players worldwide and ascend the rankings by achieving a place among the Top 100 fastest in Sky-high Racing mode.
How to participate:
Start Sky-high Racing on Fairyland Penglai to participate in the event.
Event Duration: Dec. 19, 2024 00:00 (UTC) – Jan. 21, 2025 23:59 (UTC).

XII. 2nd PlayStation® Tournaments #1
The rivers and lakes awaken, where the blade reveals its true prowess. 2nd PlayStation® Tournaments #1 are available for a limited time!
Event Duration: Dec. 19, 2024 20:00 (UTC) - Jan. 21, 2025 20:00 (UTC).
Registration time: You can register for the tournament 5 hours in advance. For example, if the tournament starts at 19:00 local time, you use the event card to register for the tournament at 14:00.
Event Rules
Complete weekly quests during the event to claim Jade Medal - JAN. You can claim more Medals in the mail after advancing, and the quantity awarded for each rank is as follows:
	1st place: 300 Medals
	2nd place: 200 Medals
	3rd-4th place: 100 Medals
	5th-8th place: 50 Medals 
Medals can be used for redeeming rewards and participating in rankings.

Hero Adjustments
I. Kurumi
1. Adjusted the amount of Health instantly restored when breaking a [Healing Ray] link using the Vertical Strike button. The Health restored has been changed from 500 to 300, with excess Health converted to Armor.
2. Adjusted [Healing Ray: Guard]'s CD from 22 sec to 25 sec.
3. Adjustments to the Ultimate [Purified Circle]:
(1) After placing the healing circle, recover Armor and apply [Cleanse] to allies every 1.5 sec within the circle. Vajras and Almighty Generals have their Health restored instead.
(2) Adjusted its max Rage from 60,000 to 75,000.
4. Adjusted the max Rage for her Ultimate [Purified Circle: Rapid] from 75,000 to 60,000.

II. Viper Ning
1. Ultimate [Moonbane Control: Unchained] now recovers 60 Health per second, with excess Health converted to Armor.

III. Shayol Wei
1. Reduced [Shield Bash]'s CD from 27 sec to 25 sec.
2. Adjusted the Damage Multiplier of Ultimate [Justiciar's Guard]'s counterattack move from 2.5 to 2.7, and enemies hit by counterattacks will no longer be interrupted by non-focus moves during bind.
3. Increased the stagger duration of Ultimate [Justiciar's Guard: Pursuit]'s counterattack moves and improved melee aim assist for the counterattack moves.

IV. Akos Hu
1. Increased the stagger duration of the third pounce strike.
2. Adjusted the Damage Multipliers for the tiger strikes of [Feral Frenzy] from 2.7/3.0/3.3 to 3.0/3.2/3.4.
3. Akos is now Ultimate Focused while using [Roar].
4. Optimized the timing for using pounce strikes, allowing pounce within 1.6 sec after tiger leap landing.
//Dev Note: Previously, the tiger leap state could end due to turning or stopping animations after landing. We've optimized this and slightly extended the tiger leap state duration after landing while running.

V. Cyra
1. Cyra is now Purple Focused while her Ultimate is active by default. While using her 2nd stage Light Beam, Cyra will become Golden Focused.
Cyra's Ultimate duration has been adjusted from 16 sec to 18 sec in Solo/Duos and from 18 sec to 25 sec in Trios. The base value of her Light Shield has been adjusted from 1800 to 2000 in Trios, while remaining unchanged in Solo/Duos.
The small Light Orbs no longer stagger enemies who are Golden Focused when they explode, but enemies who are Golden Focused can still be Dazzled by the orbs' explosions.
2. Ultimate [Light's Mercy: Field] no longer fires small light orbs or provides light shield protection.
Adjusted Light Zone healing per second from 50 to 160, Damage Reduction from 50% to 30%, and Cyra now receives that healing. Previously, Cyra had light shield protection and didn't receive Light Zone healing.
Adjusted the duration of Light Zone burst's [Powerfully Dazzled] effect from 3 sec to 6 sec.

VI. Justina Gu
1. Optimized the visual distinction between friendly and enemy ice mist effects for Ultimate [Arctic Wraith: Frostwind].

VII. Tessa
1. Extended the duration for Rage recovery inhibition following the Ultimate of [Enchant] and [Enchant: Group Prey] from 13 sec to 12 sec.
In-game Adjustments
I. Controller
1. Reduced how long players have to hold the D-pad to bring up the [Item Wheel], the [Emote Wheel], and the [Weapon Wheel].
Out-of-game Adjustments
I. Matchmaking Process Optimization
1. Added confirmation pop-up for canceling matchmaking: Your matchmaking priority increases with your wait time. Canceling resets priority for the next match, which would cause additional wait time. When the wait time exceeds a certain duration, canceling matchmaking will trigger a confirmation pop-up to prevent accidental cancellation.
II. Title
1. Quality Upgrade
Upgraded quality for Immortal Leaderboard, Collection Leaderboard, Yama's Abyss Leaderboard, Speedrun Leaderboard, and Justice Chamber (Individual) Leaderboard titles.
2. Brief Profile
Your brief profile background now changes based on the title you equip.
III. Fairyland Penglai
1. Adjusted maximum team size for Stack Up High to 15 players.
IV. Justice Chamber
The following two points have been improved in the Weekly Refresh system:
1. When the season updates, ''This Week's Points'' for members will be reset, but it won't affect the total weekly points for the Justice Chamber.
2. Progress made before unlocking the quests of Heroes Assemble and Justice Chamber will count towards your progress this week.
V. Outfit Collection
1. Raised the collection score limit and added a new collection level: Elite Patron.



Showdown Adjustments
I. Combat Adjustments
1. Improved the performance of Enigmatic Rifts in Showdown.
2. The effect of the lightning strike of [Manticore] Stage II's Ultimate is changed from knocking targets airborne to knocking them back.
3. Optimized an issue where [Korvine] and [Manticore] model collision persists after death.
4. Optimized some sound effects for the Lotuses to reduce their frequency.
II. Function Adjustments
1. In the Showdown Settlement Rewards, the [Peerless Treasure Choice Gift] will be changed to [Splendor Treasure Choice Gift] (includes Draconic Treasure).
2. The unlock level for the Showdown has been lowered from Lv. 15 to Lv. 7


Feature Adjustments
I. In-game Adjustments
1. Optimized incorrect hit reactions caused by certain moves when experiencing poor network connections.

Performance Optimization
1. (XBOX) Optimized the memory allocator to enhance the average frame rate.
2. (PS) Optimized memory usage for PS5 Pro upscaling.


Store Updates
I. New Regular Treasure: Draconic Treasure Now Available in the Treasure Pavilion
Draconic Treasure sells for 240 Gold. Open it and there's a chance to get Feria Shen Extreme Outfit [Midnight Mischief], Lyam Liu Extreme Outfit [Lambent Draco], Heng Sword Extreme Skin [Kochab Radiance], Pistol Extreme Skin [Starlight Messenger]
Minimum Guarantee:
1. Loop Guarantee: On top of the basic drop rate, players are guaranteed to receive at least 1 Purple (Epic) reward within 10 Treasures. This can be triggered multiple times.
2. Special Guarantee: On top of the basic drop rate, players are guaranteed to receive at least 1 Red (Extreme) reward during the process of opening at most 100 Treasures. This cannot be triggered repeatedly.
3. Red (Extreme) rewards will not repeat until all of them have been obtained.

II. New Extreme Hairstyle
Tessa Extreme Hairstyle [Crystalline Dew] is now available. To redeem it, you'll need 50 Cloud Mirror and 60 Floral Dew. Acquiring this hairstyle also unlocks Tessa exclusive Debut Pose [Dreamy Glasswork] and Bubble [Tessa·Blossom]

III. Baize's Blessing Update
The 'Peerless Treasure Choice Gift' in Baize Shop has been changed to 'Splendor Treasure Choice Gift'.

IV. Gold Purchase Updates
Bonus rewards when recharging Gold are adjusted from 'Peerless Treasure Choice Gift' to 'Splendor Treasure Choice Gift'.
Splendor Treasure Choice Gift: Immortal Treasure*1, Lotus Treasure*1, Brocade Treasure*1, Draconic Treasure*1

V. New Pack
1. Added Zai exclusive Pack [Light's Cadence], which contains the Zai exclusive Legendary Outfit [Heart Beat·Light's Cadence], Legendary Staff Skin [Idol's Star Staff], Legendary Hairstyle [Heart Beat·Heartbeat Melody] and Legendary Voice Pack [Zai·Light's Cadence Chinese Voice Pack]. Standard price: 5,100 Gold; Now: 3,100 Gold. Individual cosmetics have their own discounts, but the Pack discount is even bigger!
2. Added Shayol exclusive pack [Chill Workout], which contains the Legendary Outfit [Heart Beat·Chill Workout], Legendary Hairstyle [Chilling Gale] and Legendary Voice Pack [Chill Workout Chinese Voice Pack]. Standard price: 3,600 Gold; Now: 2,400 Gold. Individual cosmetics have their own discounts, but the Pack discount is even bigger!

VI. New Discounts
1. Newly added Justina Gu Legendary Accessory [Glacial Aspect] (Unlock it to get a new appearance for Justina Gu's Ultimate "Arctic Wraith"). Standard price: 4,600 Gold; Now: 3,000 Gold.
2. Newly added Legendary Rescue Effect [Go Wild]. Standard price: 900 Gold; Now: 600 Gold.
3. Newly added Legendary Stash skin [Sugar Snow]. Standard price: 800 Gold; Now: 600 Gold.
4. Newly added Legendary Pose for [Heartbeat Dance] for female heroes. Standard price: 900 Gold; Now: 750 Gold.
5. Newly added Legendary Emote Gesture [Wild Dreams] for all heroes. Standard price: 900 Gold; Now: 360 Gold.
6. Newly added Feria Shen Legendary Pose [Feign Surrender]. Standard price: 900 Gold; Now: 750 Gold.
7. Newly added Zai Epic Pose [Icy Gaze]. Standard price: 300 Gold; Now: 200 Gold.
8. Newly added Shayol Wei Epic Pose [Graceful Move]. Standard price: 300 Gold; Now: 200 Gold.
9. Newly added Lyam Liu Legendary Pose [Blade At The Ready]. Standard price: 900 Gold; Now: 750 Gold.
10. Newly added Feria Shen Legendary Hairstyle [Stellar Enigma]. Standard price: 800 Gold; Now: 600 Gold.
11. Newly added Lyam Liu Legendary Hairstyle [Celestial Edge]. Standard price: 800 Gold; Now: 600 Gold.
12. Newly added Cyra Legendary Hairstyle [Illusory Dream]. Standard price: 800 Gold; Now: 600 Gold.
13. Newly added Cyra Legendary Accessory [Dreamer's Dream]. Standard price: 1,200 Gold; Now: 900 Gold.
14. Newly added Cyra Legendary Background [Deer in Forest]. Standard price: 600 Gold; Now: 400 Gold.
15. Newly added Cyra Legendary Base [Winter Seat]. Standard price: 1,200 Gold; Now: 900 Gold.
16. Newly added Lyam Liu Legendary Background [Unfurling Wings]. Standard price: 600 Gold; Now: 400 Gold.
17. Newly added Lyam Liu Legendary Base [Phoenix Flame]. Standard price: 1200 Gold; Now: 900 Gold.
18. Newly added Zai Epic Background [Delight]. Standard price: 200 Gold; Now: 150 Gold.
19. Newly added Zai Epic Base [Show stage]. Standard price: 400 Gold; Now: 300 Gold.
20. Newly added Shayol Wei Epic Background [Rectification]. Standard price: 200 Gold; Now: 150 Gold.
21. Newly added Shayol Wei Epic Base [Perseverance Pavilion]. Standard price: 400 Gold; Now: 300 Gold.

VII. New Items in Spectral Silk Store
1. Newly added Lyam Liu Legendary Accessory [Golden Resolve] with a price of 12,000 Spectral Silk.


VIII. Christmas Limited-time Discount
Event Duration: Dec. 22, 2024 03:00 (UTC) - Jan. 2, 2025 00:00 (UTC)
During the event, you can purchase exclusive Christmas discount items in the Shop-Item.
Christmas Choice Gift
Priced at 4,400 Gold, limit of 2 purchases per account. Purchase the Gift and you can choose 1 reward each from a Refined Accessory Choice Gift and a Refined Treasure Choice Gift.
Refined Accessory Choice Gift: Journey of Blades·Divine Seal, 2674·Mech Prototype, Flamed Figurine, Zhurong's Jadeball, Flying Squirrel, Colossus of Sunwing, Verdant Guardian·Bamboo Breeze, The Nine Songs·Landscape, Laudation·Shackles, Flying NARAKA Doll
Refined Treasure Choice Gift: Aurora Treasure*10, Splendor Treasure Choice Gift*15
[Christmas Lucky Box]
Priced at 600 Gold, limit of 2 purchases per account. Use to get a random [Unowned Legendary Cosmetic] purchasable with Gold, limited to those released before the June 6, 2024 Update. The prize pool will not change with future updates. For more details, please see our official websites. If you already own all of the cosmetics, you will get Peerless Treasure Choice Gift*8 instead.



Bug Fixes
I. Hero-related Bugs
1. Fixed abnormal controls after automatically exiting Ultimate when heroes with transformation traits are bound by Dragon's Coil effects.

II. Showdown Bugs
1. Fixed an issue where Tianhai's [Divine Bell: Showdown] skill could not correctly counter certain enemy moves.
2. Fixed an issue where [Manticore] Stage II would cause floating in extreme cases. 
3. Fixed an issue with the Showdown Souljade [Thunderproof] that would cause characters to sheathe certain weapons when hit with Divine Thunder.
4. Fixed an issue in Nirriti's Ruins where Weekly Challenges would not correctly tabulate when players defeated the [Manticore].
5. Fixed an issue that caused [Universe Slash]'s 2nd stage damage to be calculated incorrectly.
6. Fixed the issue where Souljade [Lotus Barrier]'s damage reduction effect is granted without equipping this Souljade.

notes.content:
Dear players,

NARAKA: BLADEPOINT is committed to creating a fair and healthy competitive environment. We have not only used new anti-cheat technologies, but also established special cheat-reporting reward activities to encourage those players who defend the fairness with us. From now on, players who make outstanding contributions to reporting cheats will get the Legendary spear skin 'Righteous Polearm' .

We strongly recommend that players report via in-game report system, so that we can confirm the cheat as soon as possible and record successful report times for you!

From 12/9 to 12/15, there are 10 players who have successfully reported the cheating or hacking in total and get the reward [Righteous Polearm]! We hope that more players can become the Justice Supporter on the Morus Isle in the future.

notes.title: NARAKA: BLADEPOINT Aurora Season Settlement Notice
notes.content:
Dear Players,
The Aurora Season will come to an end on December 19th, 2024 at 00:00 (UTC), and the final ranks for this season will be tabulated. We would like to thank you all for the suggestions and feedback that you have offered during this Season. We will continue to do our utmost to improve everyone's gaming experience and raise the quality of in-game competition!
During the Aurora Season, a new hero, Cyra, The Lightbearer, came from the West and joined the battle on Morus Isle. We also collaborated with Kan Liu to bring the Koi Flow 3D Water Fan to "life".

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36350327/ad5ea3d3b7b63cf294e6a93a1d13084118302ed8.png[/img]

"Mount Cangshan, Lake Erhai and a cloud-speckled sky; in this moment, the world's beauty is boundless." Sunwing Relics project [Dali·Bai Ethnic] brought "Nature's Beauty" to Morus Isle.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36350327/8a440c64b841e5ba9a0edb5bcf879e260f548a08.png[/img]

Geralt traveled across incalculable distances to go toe to toe with the best of the best itinerant fighters from NARAKA's jianghu. We collaborated with "The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt" to bring a Witcher flavor to Morus Isle. In "Martial Art Mastery", we brought martial arts masters both from within China and without, both old and new, to Morus Isle to see who the greatest truly is. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36350327/adf1688fa855b479399ebb4415834beef6ee7435.png[/img]

Prepare yourselves! A new Season is coming, and we have a whole host of interesting content and new challenges for you!


1.	Season Rewards:
(1) Ranked: Season rewards will be awarded based on the highest rank gained in the ranked modes (Solo, Duos, or Trios) during the Aurora Season.

Rank	Rewards
<Bronze>	Avatar [Aurora·Bronze]
<Silver>	Avatar [Aurora·Silver]
<Gold>	Avatar [Aurora·Gold], Kylin Zhang Epic Outfit [Travel Cloths·Cloud Peak]
<Platinum>	Avatar [Aurora·Platinum], Kylin Zhang Epic Outfit [Travel Cloths·Cloud Peak], Bow Legendary Skin [Ebony Bow]

The Avatar rewards for the Asura and Unrivaled Asura ranks are differentiated by Solo, Duos, and Trios, and can be earned separately across those various game modes. 

(2) Immortal War: Rewards will be given out according to the highest rank that a player achieved in Immortal War Solo, Duos and Trios during the Aurora Season.

Rank	Rewards

<Master III>	Peerless Treasure Choice Gift x4, Bow Legendary Skin [Faded Shadow]
<Master IV>	Peerless Treasure Choice Gift x5, Bow Legendary Skin [Faded Shadow]

Avatars will be awarded to players based on the highest rank that they achieved on the Immortal Leaderboard during the Aurora Season. Additionally, all players on the Immortal Leaderboard at the time of season settlement will receive an Avatar.

When season settlement occurs, the top 3 players on the Immortal Leaderboard will receive exclusive Hero Badges.

Avatars and Hero Badges are differentiated by the highest Rank a player achieves in Solo, Duos, and Trios. Players receive rewards regardless of if they will also receive rewards in other modes or not.

New Rewards for Immortal War:
Starting from next Season (Aurora), Immortal War will include Background and Bubble rewards which are Season specific. The Team Stats page will also show your current Immortal War Rank (Grandmaster I, Grandmaster II, etc.) and your current Ranking (No. 1, No. 2, No. 3, etc.)

notes.title: NARAKA: BLADEPOINT Update – Dec. 5th, 2024
notes.content:
Dear players,

The servers of NARAKA: BLADEPOINT will be suspended for maintenance from Dec 4th, 2024 23:00 (UTC) to Dec 5th, 2024 04:00 (UTC). We suggest you log out in advance and enter the game again after the maintenance.
The details for this update are as follows:
Brand New Content
I. Showdown Season 2.5: Might
Increased the max level of Sense to 1120.
1. New Hero Tessa has joined Showdown.
A new hero, Tessa, has joined Showdown. Her smile alone is enough to win over the masses!
2. New Boss and New Enigma Domain
A beastly roar echoes forth, and the arena begins to tremble! An earth-shaking showdown is about to unfold. Are you ready?
New Enigma Domain [Shipwreck Expanse] is now available.
3. Nirriti's Ruins and Yama's Abyss have been reset.
Season Challenge progress and rewards of Nirriti's Ruins and Yama's Abyss have been reset.
Take on Yama's Abyss and Nirriti's Ruins this season for Peerless Treasure Choice Gifts, Legendary weapon skins, Flux Shards, limited-edition avatars, and much more!
4. Brand New Souljades and Potentials
Introducing Lotus Souljades, with Ice, Thunder, and Poison Element combinations!
Potential levels have been reset, and we have adjusted the effects of existing Potentials, while adding new Lotus-related Potentials, providing a wider range of combo selections!
5. Catch-Up Points
Upon finishing a stage with at least 15 Fatiguecost, the Souljade reward targets you've failed to meet will be granted as Catch-Up Points. 
Spend 600 Fatigue to convert Catch-Up Points into Legendary/Epic Souljades or Carved Crystals.
Catch-Up Points are not carried over from week to week, and are reset to 0 every Wednesday 20:00 (UTC)
Newly added Hero Badge: Against All Odds, serves as a counter for the matches where you've earned Catch-Up Points. By upgrading the Hero Badge, you will get Carved Crystal, Souljade Fragment, Exhilarating Elixir, Flux Shards as rewards.
//Dev Note: We have been closely monitoring the loot experience since the launch of Showdown mode. In this mode, luck significantly influences the results because the loot distribution is inherently random. So, when there is a significant disparity between the effort invested and the rewards received, it may lead to disappointment.
We are introducing a new catch-up points feature to compensate for lower rewards when luck isn't on your side. At the same time, this preserves the experience of earning greater rewards when luck is favorable. As a result, the overall loot rewards have been improved.
6. Season Settlements
Deepwood Season will end on December 5, 2024 at 00:00 (UTC)
(1) Season Rewards:
Rank Requirement	Rewards
<Showdown Bronze>	Avatar [Deepwood·Showdown Bronze]
<Showdown Silver>	Avatar [Deepwood·Showdown Silver]
<Showdown Gold>	Avatar [Deepwood·Showdown Gold]
<Showdown Platinum>	Avatar [Deepwood·Showdown Platinum]
<Showdown Solar>	Avatar [Deepwood·Showdown Solar], [Peerless Treasure Choice Gift]*2, [Showdown Seal]*5
<Showdown Empyrean>	Avatar [Deepwood·Showdown Empyrean], [Peerless Treasure Choice Gift]*3, [Showdown Seal]*10, Hero Badge [Deepwood·Showdown Empyrean]
\<Showdown Astral>	Avatar [Deepwood·Showdown Astral], [Peerless Treasure Choice Gift]*5, [Showdown Seal]*15, Hero Badge [Deepwood·Showdown Astral]
<Showdown Paragon>	Avatar [Deepwood·Showdown Paragon], [Peerless Treasure Choice Gift]*10, [Showdown Seal]*20, Hero Badge [Deepwood·Showdown Paragon]
(2) Showdown Leaderboard Rewards:
Players will be rewarded with an Avatar that corresponds to the highest rank that they held on the Yama's Abyss leaderboards at any point during this Showdown Deepwood Season (recorded either at weekly settlement or at season settlement). Additionally, the top 3 players on any Yama's Abyss Hero leaderboard will receive an exclusive Hero Badge.

II. Showdown Tutorial: The Beginning
Clouds hung over Morus Isle, as dark as ink. Thunder rumbled and boomed. It felt as if all the energy in the world was beginning to stir...
This level serves as an introductory guide to Showdown, detailing its main combat mechanics and preliminary storyline. We recommend going through it first.

III. New Game Mode: Naraka Guandan
1. Go to the poker table in southern Fairyland Penglai to enjoy the new game mode—Naraka Guandan.
2. The Classic Mode supports solo and duo matchmaking, where you can earn Naraka Beans and exchange them for valuable rewards!
3. The 4-player mode allows 4 players to join a custom room and set their own rules. Grab your friends and play Guandan together!
4. This game mode is currently only available on PC.


IV. Limited-time Return: Neo-Mech Clash
Gameplay Updates:
1. New Heroes: Tarka Ji, Cyra
2. Faction restrictions for hero selection have been removed. You can now freely choose your hero.
Gameplay Info:
A 6V6 score-based game mode.
1. Within the designated time, strive to defeat more enemies to earn more points. Periodically, the top player will be marked as the bounty target. Killing the bounty target grants extra points.
Kills: +1 point
Killstreaks: +1 bonus point
Killing the bounty target: +10 bonus points
2. The Exquisite Vessel occasionally produces mode-exclusive Souljades. 
(1) Tianhai: The Ultimate [Titan's Call] will trigger an additional wide-range strike after smashing the enemy.
(2) Almighty General: The Ultimate [General's Call] will deliver an additional thrust strike upon a charged leaping strike.
(3) Hadi: The Ultimate [Aerial Ascent] will release additional flaming sword energy with a [Burn] effect after a three-stage charge.
(4) Feria Shen: In cannon mode, the Ultimate [Mech Mayhem] will deliver additional laser strikes when firing with the cannon by consuming Energy.
Newly Added:
(1) Tarka Ji: Ultimate's 2nd-stage dodge ("punch") now has an additional [Freeze] attack.
(2) Cyra: Ultimate's 2nd-stage charged horizontal strike now has an additional ranged attack.
The following adjustments are made for this mode:
(1) All heroes' Ultimates will have unlimited duration.
(2) Rage recovery rate is significantly increased, and cooldown for certain skills is significantly reduced.
(3) Tarka Ji's [Fire Frenzy: Reload] Ultimate is changed in this mode. Tarka ji will build Rage upon attacking enemies, and the fiery trail that he leaves behind has been removed.
(4) Some of Yueshan Almighty General's Focus Strikes can now repel the Bronze Mech.

V. Limited-time Addition: Grandmaster's Secret (Combat Item)
In Ranked Mode, Bot Mode, and Quick Match, press "E" to interact with the Morus' Blessing in the Realm of Yang or Grandmasters in Caves and obtain a Grandmaster's Secret. Press "Z" to use the item.
[Grandmaster's Secret•Musashi]: Use to summon the blademaster Miyamoto Musashi, and unleash his nitō ichi-ryū two-sword Extreme.
[Grandmaster's Secret•White Wolf]: Use to summon the Witcher, Geralt, and unleash his elegant swordplay Extreme.
[Grandmaster's Secret•Buakaw]: Use to summon the Muay Thai legend Buakaw, and unleash his devastating Muay Thai Extreme.
[Grandmaster's Secret•Chin Woo]: Use to summon the martial arts hero Bruce Lee, and unleash his quadruple-roundhouse kick Extreme.

VI. New Crossover Mechanism: Places of Power
In Ranked Mode, Bot Mode, and Quick Match, interact with Places of Power and obtain a random Sign (Combat Items). The Places of Power is available for interaction 3 minutes after the match starts and can be used only once per game.
[Sign·Quen]: Restore some Armor
[Sign·Yrden]: Cast traps that silence and deal damage to enemies that make contact with them.
[Sign·Aard]: Knock back nearby enemies.
[Sign·Axii]: Cast a zone, enemies staying for a certain period will be enchanted.
[Sign·Igni]: Deal fire damage ahead and burn enemies.

VII. New Event: Showdown·Journey Begins
You can unlock Showdown Journey quests and claim rewards by playing Showdown. 
Within a certain timeframe, by completing any Showdown Stage a day for 7 days, you can claim a powerful Souljade Set, a Martial Trial Treasure Choice Gift, and other rewards, including an Extreme Item—Flux Jade.

VIII. Limited-time Event: The Witcher's Journey
[previewyoutube=IuzygJrFQkg;full][/previewyoutube]
Medallion's humming, must be a place of......
Complete the The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt event [The Witcher's Journey] to get the Tarka Ji Legendary Outfit [The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt·Geralt] and other The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt crossover event cosmetics and items.
1. During the event, daily Contracts are available on the notice board. Complete both daily and weekly Contracts to earn Witcher XP and Bounties. The status and content of daily Contracts on the notice board reset each day.
2. Complete Contracts to earn Witcher XP and increase your Witcher level. Higher levels unlock new dialogues with the characters. Complete these dialogues to receive rewards.
3. Completing Contracts grant [Bounties], which can be used to redeem exclusive event rewards.
Event Duration: Dec. 5, 2024 Update - Jan. 8, 2024 20:00 (UTC)
Claim Rewards Deadline: Jan. 12, 2024 20:00 (UTC)

IX. Limited-time Event: Witcher's New Gear
Event Duration: Dec. 5, 2024 Update - Mar. 12, 2024 20:00 (UTC)
Event Rules: Collect The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt crossover cosmetics during the event, redeem exclusive event rewards, and claim valuable Gold Chests!

X. Limited-time Event: Martial Art Mastery
Event Time: Dec 5, 2024 Update - Dec 12, 2024, 20:00 (UTC)
Event Rules
1. Open Stashes in Survival modes or participate in Showdown to get Tempest Emblems. You can get a maximum of 25 Tempest Emblems per day. You can also get rare rewards—Warrior Chests— from opening gold or green Stashes, up to 2 per game and 3 per day.
2. Tempest Emblems can be exchanged for limited-edition Event Rewards! 
3. During the event, you can use Grandmaster's Secret items in Ranked, Quick Match, or Bot Mode to summon the phantoms of the Four Grandmasters, each of which will perform that Grandmaster's signature move. After using a Grandmaster's Secret, you can collect the corresponding Grandmaster's Gift on the event page. You can only collect each Grandmaster's Gift once.
(Grandmaster's Secrets can be acquired in the Realm of Yang or by opening Caves in Ranked, Quick Match and Bot Mode)

X. Limited-time Event: Score Bonus
Event Time: Dec 5, 2024 Update - Dec 9, 2024, 20:00 (UTC)
Event Rules
During the event, players receive bonus Score by completing matches in the [Ranked Mode].
Details of this Score bonus are as follows:
If you gain Score from a match, it will be increased by 25%.
In cases where Score would be lost, no Score will be deducted.
Every player can benefit from this bonus Score effect up to three times per day throughout the event's duration.

XII. Limited-time Event: Guandan For All
3. Event Duration: From the Dec 5, 2024 Update to the Dec 19, 2024.
Event Rules: During the event, play 2 rounds of Guandan to receive a limited, exclusive Bubble!

XIII. Limited-time Event: Clash of the Beast
Event Duration: Dec. 5, 2024 Update - Dec. 18, 2024 20:00 (UTC)
Event Rules:
1. Gain Lion-Eye Coins by completing quests during the event. Lion-Eye Coins can be redeemed for great event rewards.
2. Complete each day's Daily Quests to receive bonus rewards.
3. There are 5 groups of Challenge Quests, each available in turn at different times. Complete quests to claim plentiful rewards.
4. The rewards are redeemable till December 25, 2024 at 20:00 (UTC). Please redeem the rewards in time.

XIV. Limited-time Event: PlayStation® Tournaments #12
We brandish swords to gain fame, the only heroes in this game. PlayStation® Tournaments #12 are available for a limited time!
Event Duration: Dec. 5, 2024 00:00 (UTC) - Dec. 18, 2024 20:00 (UTC).

XV. PlayStation Challenge:
Challenge the wind in this race! PlayStation Sky-high Racing #9 is now open!

How to participate:
Start Sky-high Racing on Fairyland Penglai to participate in the event.
Event Duration: Dec 5, 2024 00:00 (UTC) - Dec 18, 2024 23:59 (UTC).
Hero Adjustments
I. Justina Gu
1. Adjustments to the skills [Ice Shield] and [Ice Shield: Blink]:
 (1) Removes debuffs both when entering Icy Aura and when Icy Aura disappears.
 (2) Justina can now exit Icy Aura using horizontal and vertical strikes in addition to jumps and dodges, and when Icy Aura expires, she knocks back nearby enemies.
2. Adjustments to the skill [Arctic Wraith]:
(1) In Ultimate status, pressing the Ultimate button again consumes Rage (20% in solos/duos, 15% in trios) to release an ice burst that [Freezes] nearby enemies not in Blue Focus and enhances the next [Shadowswipe]'s [Freeze] effect.
 (2) Enhanced [Shadowswipe] can freeze enemies not in Ultimate Focus, and its freeze duration against transformed enemies is increased from 1.6 sec to 3 sec.
3. Adjustments to the skill [Arctic Wraith: Frostwind]:
 (1) Ice mist now blocks enemies' melee attacks.
 (2) Rage lock duration after Ultimate activation adjusted from 2 sec to 4 sec.
4. Removed the skill variant [Ice Shield: Surround].
5. Removed the Ultimate variant [Arctic Wraith: Blizzard].


II. Hadi
1. Adjusted the initial Rage cost of the Ultimate [Aerial Ascent: Blaze] from 40 to 60.
2. Adjusted [Mechanical Arm: Blast] cooldown time from 25 sec to 27 sec.
3. In Ultimate status, Rage consumption increases at higher altitudes, and the height threshold is adjusted from 15m to 12m.


III. Cyra
1. Optimized the visual effect indicator and crosshair feedback for beam attacks during Ultimate status.
2. In Ultimate status, her continuous beam now deals damage every 0.3 sec with the damage multiplier adjusted from 0.55 to 0.35.
Level 1 and 2 pursuit beams' damage is adjusted from 1.2/1.8 to 1.6/2.8.
3. Reduced the explosion radius of small light orbs against enemies in Ultimate status. Self/ally healing is adjusted from 120/180 to 60/180.
4. Slightly delayed beam timing after firing light orbs in Ultimate status.
5. Adjusted [Light's Mercy] duration to 18 sec in trios. The duration remains 16 sec in solos/duos.
//Dev Note: Currently, Cyra's pursuit ability with her continuous beam during her Ultimate is too strong. We've reduced the continuous beam's damage and compensated by increasing the pursuit beam's damage.

IV. Valda Cui
Adjusted the water sphere control duration in [Water Trap: Trinity] from 0.5 sec to 0.3 sec.

V. Zai
Slightly increased the cast animation duration of [Flame Ward].

VI. Other Adjustments
All heroes can now use skills or Ultimates after a successful Counter.

Weapon Adjustments
I. Greatsword
Increased the move distance of a sprint horizontal strike with Greatsword, allowed earlier dodge cancel, and reduced damage multiplier from 2.59 to 2.1.
II. Polesword
Reduced the move distance of a sprint horizontal strike with Polesword and adjusted the damage multiplier from 2.17 to 2.1.
Combat Adjustments
I. Added hero info identification when marking enemies with the middle mouse button.
II. Characters can now carry multiple combat items. When multiple combat items are in the bag, hold the combat item hotkey (default "Z") and use the mouse wheel to switch between them.
III. Optimized the cancel timing for crouch, jump, and dodge for certain combat items.
IV. Optimized the pre-input timing for ballista shots.

Souljade Adjustments
I. Longsword Souljade
Introduced the new Souljade [Jump Slash], enhancing airborne vertical strike moves.

In-game Adjustments
I. Feature Optimizations
1. Alliance Optimizations
(1) Extended Alliance window from 490 sec to 930 sec after match start (90 sec after second Shadow Corruption Spread ends).
(2) Added player Alliance initiation notifications and optimized prompt visuals.
2. Earth Shrine Interaction Optimization: Now you can interact directly with the interaction key in designated areas instead of using gestures.

II. Songbird Arena
1. Added the option to enable Grandmaster's Secret in Song Arena.
When enabled, random Grandmaster's Secrets will be distributed to players' bags.

III. Controller Adjustments
Increased Radial Menu capacity. The Menu now dynamically displays actual bag contents instead of fixed items.
Out-of-game Adjustments
I. Game Settings
Added a new setting under Settings > Audio > Other Audio Settings: Play in Background. When enabled, game audio playback continues even if the game window is inactive.

II. Gameplay Updates
The Hungry Dragons mode is temporarily disabled, and the Neo-Mech Clash mode is enabled.

III. Lobby Music
Added new lobby music: The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt - Kaer Morhen.

Showdown Adjustments
I. Combat Adjustments
1. Adjusted monster move and projectile interaction: monsters can no longer deflect player projectiles.
2. Adjusted hit stagger and startup frames for certain Blue Focus moves of [Copperclad Hammer] and [Copperclad Staff].
3. Optimized the hit reactions for [Omnius·Void]
4. Added new Toxified Omens: [Copperclad Staff Poison], [Miasma Slash], and [Toxic Tips].
5. Optimized the Counter animation for [Vinemire].


II. Souljade Potential Adjustments
1. Changed the [Blazing Flame] effect to: "You lose all Health Bonus by Percentage, but for every 0.5% of Health Bonus lost, your [Burn] damage increases by 0.3%."
2. Changed the [Water and Fire Raged] effect to: "Increases HydroFlare damage by 20%."
3. [Weapon Repair Kit Boon] no longer reduces ranged weapon damage.
4. Increased the burst damage multiplier of charged shots to 1.15 for [Detonating Rounds], [Frost Bomb], [Thunder Detonation], and [Toxic Explosion].
5. Increased the explosion damage multiplier to 5.62 for the 2nd-stage charge of [Frost Arrows], [Thunder Arrows], and [Toxic Arrows].
6. Increased the [Thunder Cannon] spark damage multiplier from 0.5 to 0.57, and the total elemental damage of projectile and sparks is increased to 250.
7. Increased the [Toxic Cannon] projectile damage multiplier from 2.75 to 2.97, and the elemental damage is increased to 250.
8. Increased additional elemental damage to 210 for [Ice Repeating Crossbow], [Thunder Crossbow], and [Toxic Crossbow].
9. Increased additional elemental damage to 310 for [Ice Swarm], [Thunder Swarm], and [Toxic Swarm].
10. Increased the [Thunder Shot] successive attack damage multiplier from 0.21 to 0.28, and the elemental damage is increased to 240.
11. Increased the [Toxic Shot] successive attack damage multiplier from 0.14 to 0.19, and the elemental damage is increased to 160.
12. [Defuse (Concentrate)] has now faded and no longer has any effects. Click the Souljade in the Souljade equip screen to reforge it into another Souljade.
The original effect of this Souljade "Easier to trigger Defuse" has been added to the Martial Skill.
13. When equipping both [Thunder Counter] and [Thunderproof], slightly delayed last two Thunderbolts to make countering after dodging easier for heavy weapons.
14. Slightly reduced the ThunderShock accumulation rate on self from unarmed and ranged attacks when wearing [Thunderpull].

III. Weapon Adjustments
1. Increased the [Earthshaker] damage multiplier per hit to 2.45, 2.45, 2.45, 3.96, 2.45, 2.45, 2.45, 2.45, 2.45, 2.45, 0.82, 0.82, 5.71 and the total damage multiplier from 24 to 33.36.
2. Increased [Soul Slash]'s light charged attack damage multiplier per hit from 0.95 to 1.1 and the total damage multiplier from 10.45 to 12.1.
3. Increased the [The Overcomer] damage multiplier per hit from 3.00 to 3.75 and the total damage multiplier from 21 to 26.25.
4. Increased the [Stanchion·Rising Cloud] damage multiplier from 2.25 to 2.78.
Increased the [Heaven Uproar] damage multiplier per hit to 1.86, 1.86, 1.39, 1.39, 1.39, 1.39, 1.63, 1.63, 1.63, 1.63 and the total damage multiplier from 13.78 to 15.8.
Increased the [Merciless Havoc] damage multiplier per hit to 1.38, 1.38, 1.38, 1.65, 1.65, 1.65, 7.45 and the total damage multiplier from 13.7 to 16.54.
5. Increased the [Dreadful Wail] damage multiplier per hit to 0.84, the final hit damage multiplier from 1.34 to 2.09, and the total damage multiplier from 6.64 to 10.49.
6. Increased the [Dragon Roar] damage multiplier per hit to 0.87, 0.87, 0.87, 0.87, 0.87, 0.83, 0.83, 0.83, 0.83, 1.32, 6.62 and the total damage multiplier from 12.14 to 15.61.
7. Increased the [Universe Slash] damage multiplier per hit from 3.89 to 4.27 and the total damage multiplier from 7.78 to 8.54.
8. Increased the [Yurang's Rage] damage multiplier per hit to 0.93, 1.85, 1.85, 4.63 and the total damage multiplier from 6.15 to 9.26.


IV. Hero Adjustments
1. General Adjustments
Changed the unlocking levels for Hero Weapon and Defuse Martial Skills, making them all unlock at level 1 (default unlock) instead of previous levels 2 and 12.

2. Feria Shen
(1) Adjusted the skill [Gunplay: Showdown] effect to:
Rush and continuously shoot in all directions, dealing damage.
· Move the crosshair while rushing to adjust the direction.
· Available while being hit.

3. Tianhai
(1) A successful Counter of [Divine Bell: Showdown] now increases the damage of Counterstrike Combos and reflected attacks.
(2) In Vajra state, the damage multiplier of vertical strikes is increased from 2.5 to 5, with the tenacity reduction ability adjusted from 75 to 500.
(3) In Vajra state, the damage multiplier of Counterstrike Combos is increased from 18 to 30, with the tenacity reduction ability adjusted from 1800 to 3000.
(4) In Vajra state, the damage multiplier of [Ground Stomp: Showdown] cast while unarmed is increased from 11 to 25, with the tenacity reduction ability adjusted from 330 to 2500.

4. Temulch
(1) After summoning windballs, reduces elemental burst cooldown by 10% for 8 sec.
(2) Windball hits increase enemy elemental damage taken for 5 sec.

5. Tarka Ji
(1) Increased the [Flame Force: Showdown] damage multiplier from 5 to 12, with the tenacity reduction ability increased from 500 to 1200.
(2) Increased the damage dealt by [Burn] inflicted by Tarka Ji for 5 sec after using [Flame Force: Showdown].
(3) Adjusted skill Rage cost in Ultimate status from 6.8% to 10%.

6. Valda Cui
(1) The duration of [Soaked] caused by [Water Trap: Showdown] and the Ultimate [Rising Tide: Showdown] is adjusted from 10 sec to 5 sec, but [Soaked] will no longer be removed by [HydroFlare].

7. Yueshan
(1) Increased the [Scorching Dash: Showdown] damage multiplier from 0.5 to 12, with the tenacity reduction ability adjusted from 50 to 1200.
(2) Changed [Scorching Dash: Showdown] hit effect from reducing enemy attack to recovering Rage and increasing Rage Conversion. Hitting multiple enemies grants additional Rage and extends increased conversion rate duration.
(3) Adjusted the Almighty General state duration of the Ultimate [General's Call: Showdown] from 30 sec to 16 sec.
(4) In Almighty General state, adjusted the horizontal/vertical strike 1st-stage move damage multiplier from 2 to 4 with the tenacity reduction ability from 200 to 400, the horizontal/vertical strike 2nd-stage move damage multiplier from 3 to 8 with the tenacity reduction ability from 300 to 800, and the jump horizontal/vertical strike damage multiplier from 1.5 to 3 with the tenacity reduction ability from 150 to 300.
(5) In Almighty General state, adjusted the horizontal charged strike damage multiplier from 5.5 to 15.5 with the tenacity reduction ability from 1100 to 3100 and the vertical charged strike damage multiplier from 10 to 20 with the tenacity reduction ability from 1000 to 2000.
(6) In Almighty General state, adjusted the Counterstrike Combo damage multiplier from 12 to 30 with the tenacity reduction ability from 1200 to 3000.
(7) In Almighty General state, adjusted the [Rampage: Showdown] damage multiplier from 16 to 30 with the tenacity reduction ability from 1600 to 3000.

8. Matari
After flash, gains a 10% increase in elemental accumulation speed and a 5% increase in elemental damage for 6 sec.



V. Enigma Domain Adjustments
1. Added [Shipwreck Expanse] to Enigma Domain maps and replaced [Stone Monster] and [Omnius·Rock] with [Mountain Ghost] and [Korvine] as Enigma Domain bosses.
2. Optimized the boss spawn location algorithm in Enigma Domain for more intuitive placement.
3. Adjusted possible Omens in Topaz Enigma Domain, replacing Thunder Omens with Ice Omens, and removed [Impassable].
4. Changed Rune Key drop locations to: Nightscream stages, Nirriti's Ruins·Hard and above, Manticore's Hunt·Hard (new).



VI. Nirriti's Ruins Adjustments
1. Added [Lotus Ghast] Anima Ring series with new blessing effects. The [Lotus Ghast] Anima Ring series requires Fire Forge to unlock.
2. [HydroFlare] Anima Ring series is now unlocked by default.
3. Adjusted and replaced certain stages to feature Omens from Nirriti's Ruins.
4. Optimized Anima Ring Collections: moved [Second Wind], [Enhanced Ranged Weapon], [Serration·Weapon Repair Kit], [Lethal Barrage], and [Sturdy Weapon] to the "Ranged" category.


VII. Function Adjustments
1. New Function: Trios Entry Level
Added Sense level requirements for three-player stages. Your highest hero Sense level must exceed the entry level of the stage to start matchmaking. For teams, the average level must exceed the entry level of the stage.
Level requirements:
	The entry level for Hard stages is 20 below the Recommended Sense Level.
	The entry levels for Nightscream & Doom Stages are 10 below the Recommended Sense Level.
	The entry levels for Topaz Enigma Domain & Doom Speedrun are the same as the Recommended Sense Level.
2. Added Souljade name display in preparation and hero selection screens.
3. Optimized Showdown matchmaking:
Narrowed matchmaking range with larger reductions at higher difficulties to improve match quality. Please note and understand that this may affect matchmaking times.
4. Weekly Challenge Adjustments:
Combined stage completion quests for Souljade Fragments and Shrouded Jade into one. You can get all rewards by completing stages 10 times.
Either the melee or the ranged monster defeat quest will now appear randomly, with rewards doubled.
5. Removed the Morus Legends mode from Doom (normal) and Nirriti's Ruins. Duplicate heroes are now allowed.
6. Added a Reputation Score system and AFK detection to Showdown multiplayer. Leaving during preparation or while alive with matched teammates remaining deducts reputation points.
7. Increased the drop rate of unlocked Epic/Legendary Souljades in the level's reward pool.

Client Optimization
1. Graphics Enhancement Support
Intel discrete GPUs and some integrated GPUs support XESS image enhancement in DX11, which requires the latest Intel drivers (at least 6302).

Performance Optimization
1. (XBOX) Optimized the memory allocator to enhance the average frame rate.

Bug Fixes
I. Weapon-related Bugs
1. Fixed an issue where some moves caused incorrect hit reactions during network fluctuations.
2. Fixed incorrect facing direction when charging Scale Rush with dual weapons on trees.

II. Hero-related Bugs
1. Fixed an issue that led to Cyra's Ultimate [Light's Mercy: Field]'s effect [Powerfully Dazzled] being unable to interrupt Zai's [Flame Ward] ability.

III. Combat-related Bug
Optimized incorrect hit reactions for certain moves under poor network conditions.

IV. Showdown-related Bug
Fixed an issue that led to bosses in Topaz Enigma Domain having different total Health than the Health of their breakable sections combined.

V. Rescue FX-related Bug
Fixed an issue with [Soul Land·Rescue] where a damaged sound file caused the sound effect to play without reverb.
