notes.title: NARAKA: BLADEPOINT Update – Nov. 14, 2024
notes.content:
Dear players,
The servers of NARAKA: BLADEPOINT will be suspended for maintenance from November 13, 2024 at 23:00 (UTC) to November 14, 2024 at 04:00 (UTC). We suggest you log out in advance and enter the game again after the maintenance.
The details for this update are as follows:

Brand New Content
I. Have A Nice Dream
I am by your side. May you have sweet dreams tonight.
Event Time: Nov. 14, 2024 Update - Dec. 5, 2024, 20:00 (UTC)
Event Rules
1. The seven ornaments will unlock in sequence over time. After each ornament's unlock time, you can complete the three quests corresponding to that ornament.
2. Completing an ornament's quests rewards you with Teddy Knight. Collect a certain number of Teddy Knights to receive various rewards. The quests will not refresh during the event, and progress can be continuously accumulated.

II. Limited-time Events: 
1. 2024 J Cup
Event Duration: Nov. 22, 2024 20:00 (UTC) - Dec. 18, 2024 20:00 (UTC)
The 2024 NARAKA J Cup is in full swing, with top players from worldwide competing. The events include:
1. Warriors of Faith
Event Duration: Nov. 22, 2024 20:00 (UTC) - Dec. 14, 2024 20:00 (UTC)
Window to Claim Rewards: Dec. 14, 2024 at 20:00 (UTC) - Nov. 18, 2024 at 20:00 (UTC)
Event Rules
1. Earn Tickets by completing daily quests, and Fan Lightsticks by watching or predicting matches. Use these items to redeem rare in-game rewards in the [Redeem Rewards] and [Redeem Gifts] sections.
2. Each tier of gifts on the [Redeem Gifts] page requires specified amounts of both Tickets and Fan Lightsticks for redemption.
3. During the J Cup from November 26 to December 15 (GMT+8), tap [Watch Now] to participate in platforms' match-watching events and earn Fan Lightsticks. Each player can earn up to 2 each day during the Group Stage, up to 5 during the Scoring Stage, and up to 10 during the Grand Final, along with other rewards.
4. From November 23 to December 15 (GMT+8), tap [Predict] to participate in match prediction events and earn more Fan Lightsticks and points that can be exchanged for the exclusive weapon skin Banner·J Cup, plus a slew of other rewards.
5. During the J Cup, spend Gold and Spectral Silk to purchase the J Cup Boost Pack, gaining extra points to upgrade [Race Against Time·J Cup] and obtaining Commemorative Coins. Commemorative Coins can be exchanged for match prediction points.

2. Divine Convergence
Event Duration: Nov. 22, 2024 20:00 (UTC) - Dec. 18, 2024 20:00 (UTC)
Event Rules
1. Players can collect custom cosmetics for previous champions to exchange for HP. HP can be used in [Road to Glory] to obtain event rewards.
2. Each cosmetic grants different HP and can only be claimed once.
3. During the 2024 NARAKA J Cup, custom cosmetics for previous champions will be available in the store at a limited-time discount. Don't miss out this time!

3. Road to Glory
Event Duration: Nov. 22, 2024 20:00 (UTC) - Dec. 18, 2024 20:00 (UTC)
Event Rules
1. Participate in the Road to Glory event on the official e-sports website, obtain Stamina, and complete quests to earn many rare rewards.
2. How to obtain Stamina: 1) get for free every week; 2) obtain by completing quizzes in Support Your Team; 3) obtain through the [Divine Convergence] event.

3. Phantom Rave
Given the positive feedback on the Dance Parties, we have decided to extend the event time to 20:00 (UTC) on December 4 and added a new exchange reward: Gesture [Moving Dance] (standard dance move at Dance Parties). Shadows sway in the night, endless laughter echoing through the immortal land. We're waiting for you at the Dance Parties! 
Here is the updated event information:
Event Time: Oct. 30, 2024 20:00 (UTC) to Dec. 4, 2024 20:00 (UTC)
Claim Rewards: Dec. 4, 2024 20:00 (UTC) to Dec. 6, 2024 20:00 (UTC)
Added the exchange reward: Gesture [Moving Dance] (available for exchange after the version update).

Hero Adjustments
I. Cyra
1. Slightly delayed the moment when Cyra can be interrupted while firing the Light Beam.
2. Accelerated the starting moves for the Ultimates [Light's Mercy] and [Light's Mercy: Field].
3. Optimized the dodge performance while using the Ultimates, increasing both dodge distance and drift speed.
4. Adjusted the Light Shield of [Light's Mercy] from a fixed 1500 to 1500 in Solos and Duos, while 1800 in Trios.
5. Adjusted the Light Shield of [Light's Mercy: Field] from a fixed 1200 to 1200 in Solos and Duos, while 1500 in Trios.

II. Kylin Zhang
1. Optimized the sound effects of the Ultimates [Qilin Slash] and [Qilin Slash: Rend] upon triggering Qilin Guard, and added an audio reminder for the remaining time of Qilin Guard.

Weapon Adjustments
I. Unified Adjustments for Melee Weapons
1. Optimized the pre-input and interrupt timing for transitioning from Counterstrike to jumping.

II. Katana
1. Fixed the issue where Clash would sometimes not trigger when the [Thunderstrike] vertical strike was hit by other Blue Focus moves.

III. Dual Halberds
1. Fixed the issue where Clash would sometimes not trigger when [Hooked Wings] was hit by other Blue Focus moves.

In-game Adjustments
I. Immortal War Adjustments
1. In rounds 3 and 4, the duration of the four creatures-type Buff obtained from the Spirit Well will be increased from 120 seconds to 150 seconds.
(Notes: If your current four creatures-type buff is still active, capturing a new Spirit Well won't grant more effect.)

II. Gameplay Adjustments for Hungry Dragons
1. Viper Ning has joined the Hungry Dragons gameplay!
Out-game Adjustments
I. Chat Optimizations
1. Added the function - message quoting.
2. Added the function - quick messaging.
3. Added the function: interactive labels. Type "#" in lobby chat to create a label that other players can tap to quickly send a friend request or party invite.
4. Adjusted the private chat display. You can now view private messages with other players, and recent private messages with friends will be saved locally.


II. New Functions in Custom Room
1. Added the option in the gameplay settings for Custom Room - Martial Artist Solo: Set Different Lineup Requirements. This allows you to specify requirements for different lineups during the preparation stage.

III. Fairyland Penglai
1. Music Zone Adjustments
The details for the adjustments are as follows:
1. The default dance move after a DJ plays music is now set as [Moving Dance]. Players can join in by using the interaction button.
2. Once the dance move is set by the DJ, other players can press the interaction button to follow and dance along. However, players cannot follow the dance if the hero cannot perform particular emote gestures (for example, some hero-type exclusive gestures).
3. If the DJ has not set any dance move nor played any music for a certain period of time, they will automatically exit the music zone.
4. After a DJ exits the music zone, there is a cooldown period before they can interact with it again.

Showdown Adjustments
I. Combat Adjustments
1. Adjusted the Omen [Miasma Bomb] so it can no longer knock airborne players in Focus.
2. Optimized the physical collision effects at the Aegis-break of [Hun Dun].
3. Added new Toxified Omens: Miasma Pool and Miasma Bloom.

II. Function Adjustments
1. The settlement page now features a Souljade deconstruction option, allowing players to deconstruct Souljades right away by tapping the button.
2. Lock and deconstruction features have been added to the Temporary Inventory.

Settings
I. Showdown Storage Security Lock
1. When the Showdown Storage Security Lock is enabled, unlocking, imbuing, or recasting locked Souljades requires security lock password verification.
Store Updates
I. New Packs
1. Added the Yoto Hime exclusive Pack [Longing Whispers], which contains the Yoto Hime exclusive Legendary Outfit [Onmyoji Arena·Longing Whispers], the Greatsword Legendary Weapon Skin [Onmyoji Arena·Dream Pillow] and Yoto Hime exclusive voice pack [Longing Whispers Chinese Voice Pack]. Standard price: 5,200 Gold; Now: 3,000 Gold.
2. Added Lyam Liu exclusive Pack [Yama], which contains the Lyam Liu Legendary Outfit [Yama], the Dual Halberds Legendary Skin [Soul Hook] and Legendary Hairstyle [Deep Night]. Standard price: 4,100 Gold; Now: 2,600 Gold. Individual cosmetics have their own discounts, but the Pack discount is even bigger!
II. New Discounts
1. Newly added Lyam Liu Legendary Accessory [Judge of the Underworld] Unlock it to get a new appearance for Lyam Liu's Ultimate "Metal Fusion"(Unavailable for Ultimate "Metal Fusion: Core"). Standard price: 2,100 Gold; Now: 1,500 Gold.
2. Newly added Yoto Hime Legendary Pose [Wakeful]. Standard price: 900 Gold; Now: 750 Gold.
3. Newly added Yoto Hime Legendary Background [Sugared Dream]. Standard price: 600 Gold; Now: 400 Gold.
4. Newly added Yoto Hime Legendary Base [Slumber Stand]. Standard price: 1,200 Gold; Now: 900 Gold.
5. Newly added Legendary Rescue Effect [Affection's Blessing]. Standard price: 900 Gold; Now: 600 Gold.
6. Newly added Lyam Liu Epic Pose [Sharpened Blade]. Standard price: 300 Gold; Now: 200 Gold.
7. Newly added Epic Kill Announcement [Pillow Cloud]. Standard price: 300 Gold; Now: 200 Gold.
 
III. New Store Items
1. In the "Item" store, [Surmount Card·Aurora] is now available. Can be used to upgrade Hidden Treasure of Aurora Season by 30 levels. The price of [Surmount Card·Aeon] is 1,800 Gold, purchase limit is 1.
 
IV. New Items in Spectral Silk Store
1. Newly added Yueshan Legendary Background [2674·Star Seas] with a price of 6,000 Spectral Silk.
 
V. Limited-time items removed
1. Tessa Exclusive Pack [Ruby Sunray] and Tessa Legendary Outfit [Summer Party·Ruby Sunray] have been removed from the store. 

Bug Fixes
I. Hero-Related Bugs
1. Fixed the issue where attack counts were incorrectly consumed when Kylin Zhang launched an attack with the Black-Gold Sword shortly before Qilin Guard ended.
2. Fixed the issue where Cyra's 2nd-stage pursuing Light Beam doesn't stagger the Vajra who was grabbing players through horizontal strike.

notes.title: New Hero Cyra Available on Oct 30th
notes.content:
Happy Halloween, Forerunners!

For this year’s celebration you’ll get to enjoy unforgettable events brimming with dance parties, exclusive themed items available only during this event, alongside new costumes and gameplay modes. Dive into a festive atmosphere filled with spooky surprises. 

For the first time, the event features culturally inspired Halloween-themed cosmetics, adding an exciting layer of diversity and style, alongside fresh gameplay modes that promise to elevate your adventure further. Here’s what we have to offer:

[h1]New Hero: Cyra [/h1]

We will introduce Cyra, a former Temple of Light and Shadow priestess turned hero, on October 30 PT. Raised with a strong faith as an orphan, her beliefs were shaken after uncovering a dark secret involving her orphanage, leading to a dramatic awakening of her latent powers during a fatal ritual, where she lost her memory. Determined, she embarked on a quest, eventually reaching Morus Isle.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36350327/ab73fc2b58954f5b5c102a2ac52a135c481b5ab2.jpg[/img]

Cyra’s abilities include casting orbs that explode to heal allies or damage enemies, and the ability to control the timing and targeting of the explosions. Her ultimate skills allow her to levitate, shield herself, and alternate her attacks between healing light beams and damaging, blinding explosive orbs.

With her intriguing backstory and versatile abilities, Cyra is poised to add a new layer of strategy and depth to the NARAKA gameplay experience.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36350327/a4f82132d266c2569fb68feff5e3fb8bd7ddc6bd.png[/img]

[h1]New Cosmetic: Peculiar Tales[/h1]

Throughout the event, players can unlock new cosmetics based on mythological figures, each with distinct styles. Currently available are Kurumi's Aoandon-inspired outfit and Zai's Lucifer-themed look, complete with an Ult Special Effect Accessory.

Hadi's attire, influenced by Hades and featuring a transformation accessory, will be available alongside a richly detailed witch-themed Grappling Hook starting October 30. Additionally, a cosmetic based on YanWang will be unveiled soon.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36350327/dfc5b9d4e7f337c3ec491a0f179e4d0e3c02fe3e.jpg[/img]

[h1]New Gameplay on Fairyland Penglai[/h1]

Starting October 30th, Fairyland Penglai, our in-game 3D Lobby, will be revamped with a Halloween twist. It will be complete with thematic music, dance options, and seasonal activities, this engaging space invites players to mingle, interact, and revel in the holiday festivities. 

[h1]New Hungry Dragons Mode:[/h1]

We're refreshing the classic Snake Game mode - Hungry Dragons with a unique deathmatch twist where kills make your koi fish-shaped snake longer. Surviving the arena means dodging traps, utilizing tactical items for speed and skill recharges, and staying clear of large attacks. Growth brings power, but keep your lengthening tail safe. Stay alert! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36350327/982d3541da491fbff86ac4c4440cdcb284b9ceb1.jpg[/img]

notes.title: NARAKA: BLADEPOINT Update – Oct. 31, 2024
notes.content:
[h1]Dear players,[/h1]


The servers of NARAKA: BLADEPOINT will be suspended for maintenance from October 30th, 2024 at 23:00 (UTC) to October 31st, 2024 at 04:00 (UTC). We suggest you log out in advance and enter the game again after the maintenance.
The details for this update are as follows:

[h2]Brand New Content[/h2]
[h3]I. New Hero: Cyra[/h3]
The chief Divine Healer, the Saint of Dawn. Cyra was widely considered a Lunazran treasure. Yet her former glory and good name were lost, replaced by biting criticism and cruel rumors. 
Some named her a heretic, others merely considered her insane. She cared little since the Light's blinding rays would dazzle them so. Cyra is ready to do whatever it takes, entirely unwavering in her quest to champion the Light.

[h3]II. New Casual Mode[/h3]
The new Hungry Dragons mode is now available! Use whatever means you have at your disposal to defeat your opponents and make your dragon the longest one!
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36350327/974d7a8cd1869db849b61d401accd171e9c99e10.png[/img]

[b]Rules:[/b]
You can queue for this mode Solo or as a Trio, but this mode is always a free-for-all, with a maximum of 12 people.
[olist]
[*] Earn points by collecting Dragon Orbs (EXP items), defeating opponents, leveling up, and attacking opponents' tails.
[*] Attacking tails degrade the level and grants Dragon Scales (Upgrade items).
[*] EXP items provide EXP for leveling up and additional Rage. Reaching a higher level increases your maximum Health and Ultimates' attack range. 
[*] Periodic AOE attacks will be triggered by mechanisms in the scene. Use Jump or Crouch to evade as appropriate.
[/olist]
Winning Conditions: Players are ranked based on their total scores at the end of the match.
[list]
[*] Small Dragon Orb: +1; Large Dragon Orb: +3
[*] Defeating a player: +15
[*] Attacking the tail once: +5
[*] Each level at the time of settlement: +10
[/list]
In the event of a tie in final scores, the winner will be determined by comparing the players' Kill Score, Level Score, and Item Score in that order.

[b]Other Rules:[/b]
[list]
[*] Characters gain new powerful Ultimate Moves at Lv. 9 and Lv. 17. 
[*] Hitting a mechanism in the battlefield with an Ultimate Move triggers resonance, causing an AOE attack.
[/list]
[h3]III. Season Exclusive: Aurora Treasure[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36350327/ef7bb98bfcff981760fd36eb12171e0c639fe46f.jpg[/img]

[olist]
[*] The Aurora Treasure is priced at 360 Gold. Open for a chance to obtain rewards like Cyra's Extreme Outfit [Wings of Light] and the Fan's Extreme Skin [Koi Flow].
[*] While wearing [Wings of Light], there will be a Shining Wings effect when you defeat enemies. While standing still and not in combat, a special effect will trigger - Six Wing Splendor. This effect cannot be Imprinted. 
[*] Equipping [Koi Flow] changes the special effect of Quick Dash Horizontal Strikes and Souljade [Soulshatter]'s attack. Flowing water and fish effects will appear while charging attacks.
[*] Minimum Guarantee:
[list]
[*] Players are guaranteed to receive at least 1 Red (Extreme) reward during the process of opening at most 100 Treasures. This can be triggered multiple times. Red (Extreme) rewards will not repeat until all of them have been obtained.
[*] Legendary Cosmetic Minimum Guarantee: Within the first 25 Treasures opened, you are guaranteed to get either a Hero Outfit or a Weapon Skin. Subsequently, within every 25 Treasures opened, you are guaranteed to obtain a Legendary cosmetic that you have not yet unlocked. This guarantee can be triggered up to 14 times.
[*] Wishing Legendary Reward: If you draw an Extreme cosmetic, you can set a Legendary cosmetic which will be guaranteed when you draw a Legendary cosmetic next time. Times of guarantee can stack, but you can only set 1 cosmetic each time. If the Legendary Cosmetic Guarantee and Wishing Legendary Reward trigger simultaneously, priority is given to the Wishing Legendary Reward cosmetic and will reduce the number of remaining times that the Legendary Cosmetic Guarantee can be triggered by one.
[/list]
[*] Aurora Treasure 50% Discount Voucher
The first 10 Aurora Treasures that you buy will benefit from a 50% discount. This discount cannot be stacked with discounts from other discount vouchers. After 10 Aurora Treasures have been purchased, subsequent Aurora Treasures will return to their standard price.
[/olist]

[h3]IV. Limited-time Event[/h3]
[b]1. Aurora Treasure with bonus Star - Collections[/b]
Event Duration: Oct. 31, 2024 Update – Jan. 22, 2025 00:00 (UTC).

[u]Event Rules[/u]
[list]
[*] When opening Aurora Treasures, there is a chance to receive the Extreme Outfit, [Star - Autumn Tale] and the Legendary Outfit, [Star - Twilight].
[*] When you open an Aurora Treasure, there is a chance to obtain them as an additional reward. This chance increases as you open more. The Maximum chance is 100%.
[*] The chances for the 2 Star-Collections are calculated separately and do not impact each other. After getting a Star-Collection, the corresponding chances will then reset.
[*] Each account can receive a maximum of 10 [Star - Autumn Tale] and 2 [Star - Twilight].
[*] The number of Star-Collections granted through Aurora Treasures is limited and available while stocks last.
[/list]
[b]2. Cosmetics Return[/b]
Limited-edition cosmetics in limited-time return!
Event Duration: Oct. 31, 2024 Update – Dec. 5, 2024 00:00 (UTC).

Specific cosmetics from before Righteous Season are now returned with a 50% discount at most.
Zai Legendary Outfit [Creatures Myth·Deity of Winter], Valda Cui Legendary Outfit [Pearled Maiden], Tarka Ji Pose [Advance] and other gorgeous cosmetics await!
(Renewal Voucher can be purchased in the Item Store.) 

[h3]V. New Events[/h3]
[b]1. Phantom Rave[/b]
Event Time: Oct. 31, 2024 Update - Nov. 13, 2024, 20:00 (UTC)
Window to Claim Rewards: Nov. 13th, 2024 at 20:00 (UTC) - Nov. 16, 2024 at 20:00 (UTC)

[u]Event Rules[/u]
[olist]
[*] Open Stashes in the Survival modes, participate in Showdown or Hungry Dragons, or join the Dance Parties in Fairyland Penglai to earn Spooky Hats. You can collect up to 40 Spooky Hats from matches and 30 Spooky Hats from Dance Parties every day. For more details about getting Spooky Hats, visit [Get Spooky Hats] on the event page.
[*] The Dance Parties are held at Fairyland Penglai - Pantheon - Music Zone. To join in a Dance Party, dance to the beat in the dance area, and you will get Spooky Hat*3 each time you participate.
[*] Any participant can play their favorite songs at the Music Zone to become a DJ. Once a DJ has chosen a dance via the Radial Menu, other players can join. A DJ will get Spooky Hat*10 per Dance Party.
[*] Players will receive Invitations each day, specifying the dress code. Those who wear cosmetics matching the dress code will get extra Spooky Hat*7. In this case, a code-matching participant gets Spooky Hat*10 totally, while a code-matching DJ gets Spooky Hat*17.
[*] Interact with the [Trick or Treat] Pumpkin Carriage on the event page to obtain Magic Candies. Each interaction costs Spooky Hat*4 and grants Magic Candy*1. Magic Candies can be used to redeem for event rewards.
[*] After the event ends, expired Spooky Hats can be converted into Tae. 
[/olist]
[b]2. Everglowing Aurora[/b]
Event Time: Oct. 31, 2024 Update - Nov. 13, 2024, 20:00 (UTC)
Window to Claim Rewards: Nov. 13th, 2024 at 20:00 (UTC) - Nov. 17, 2024 at 20:00 (UTC)

[u]Event Rules[/u]
[list]
[*] Complete Daily Quests to obtain Cyra Trial Vouchers and Golden Twigs.
[*] Complete Event Quests to obtain Golden Twigs. A new quest can be unlocked only after completing the current one. Quests can only be completed when they become available.
[*] Consume Golden Twigs to redeem rewards.
[/list]
[b]3. Halloween Sale[/b]
Event Time: Oct. 31, 2024 Update - Nov. 13, 2024, 20:00 (UTC)

[u]Event Rules[/u]
[list]
[*] During the event, 4 kinds of vouchers are claimable in the event page: Legendary Outfit 30% discount voucher, Legendary Weapon 30% discount voucher, Legendary Accessory 30% discount voucher and other Legendary Item 30% discount voucher. There are 2 of each voucher type to be claimed.
[*] Use a voucher when purchasing the corresponding Legendary cosmetic with Gold, and you'll get a 30% discount. These discounts cannot be applied when purchasing gifts for friends.
[*] Please note that vouchers are only eligible for the Legendary cosmetics from Season 10: Pioneer Season and previous seasons.
[*] Vouchers are valid for a limited time only. Make sure you use yours before it expires.
[/list]
[h3]VI. Fairyland Penglai Adjustments[/h3]
[b]1. Fairyland Penglai Permanent Feature: Stack Up High[/b]

Grab some friends and stack on each other in Fairyland Penglai!
[list]
[*] Approach other players to interact with them and lift each other up, forming a tower.
[*] The player that started the interaction is the tower leader, and controls its movement.
[*] This is only available in certain zones. Pantheon nearby and Songbird Arena areas are not supported.
[*] Stacks can have a maximum of 8 people.
[/list]
[b]2. Fairyland Penglai Brand-new Gameplay—Music Zone[/b]
Enter the Music Zone, join the party, become a DJ and dance to your heart's content!
[olist]
[*] You can play music in the Music Zone to become a DJ.
[*] After a DJ uses the Radial Menu to choose certain dances, other players can join.
[*] The lights will change according to Trend Points. Send gifts and call your friends over to join the dance party. Let's all throw down together!
[*] Friendly Reminder: Adjust your sound settings in Settings - Audio - Sound to get the optimal experience.
[/olist]
[h3]VII. New Function: Lobby Music Selection[/h3]
1. Open the Lobby Music page via the button in the top-right corner of the Lobby to select music and set the playback mode.
2. Tap [Like] to add a song to [Liked Songs] and decide which songs to play as Lobby Music.

[h2]Hero Adjustments[/h2]
[h3]I. Wuchen[/h3]
1. Increased the damage dealt by the medium-sized spirit blades generated by the Ultimate [Tai Chi Teleport: Blade Storm] from 0.25 to 0.3 and reduced the knockback distance to enemies; increased the damage dealt by the large spirit blades from 1.8 to 2.1 and changed the hit effect from knocking enemies airborne to knocking them back.
2. Slightly reduced the teleport recovery frames for the skill [Spirit Blades: Swap] and slightly extended the duration of Golden Focus when teleporting.


[h2]In-game Adjustments[/h2]
[h3]I. Feature Optimizations[/h3]
[b]1. Spirit Well Optimization in Immortal War[/b]
Players can now view the highest capture progress of a Spirit Well while within a certain range of that Well.

[b]2. Hero Alliance Adjustments[/b]
Reduced the Dark Tide Coins required to start an Alliance from 7,500 to 2,500 and shortened the Alliance close time from 1,490s to 490s. (The Alliance will now close 10 seconds after the first Shadow Corruption Spread ends.)
When the Alliance closes, players still in an Alliance will receive a refund of the Dark Tide Coins used to start it.

[h2]Out-of-game Adjustments[/h2]
[h3]I. Hair Dyeing System Adjustments[/h3]
[b]1. New Mode: [Highlights][/b]
[list]
[*] Added the new Hair Dyeing method: [Highlights]. 24 Coloriums are required to unlock [Highlights], which can be applied to any hairstyle with the [Highlights] prefix.
[*] When applying Highlights, players can customize the hair color separately for the parts to be dyed. [Flourish] and [Gradient] can also be applied to these parts.
[*] 8 [Dye Creams] are required to dye hair using [Highlights].
[/list]
[b]2. In Hair Dyeing, 7 Flourish colors have been newly added:[/b]
[list]
[*] Pearlescent color: Aqua, Purple Cowry
[*] Matte color: Oriole, Emberfall, Waves, Starlight, Green
[/list]
[h2]Showdown Adjustments[/h2]
[h3]I. Souljade Adjustments[/h3]
1. Upgraded the effects for elemental melee Souljades: Attacks now deal elemental damage corresponding to the elemental attribute of the Souljade. (For example: [Velocity Untold·Ice-wielding\Thunder-wielding] has been changed to [Velocity Untold·Element]. If [Velocity Untold·Element] has the elemental attribute "Ice-wielding +1," Nunchucks' charged horizontal strikes will deal extra Frostbite Damage; if it has the attribute "Poison-wielding +1," the strikes will deal extra Toxin Damage; if it has the attribute "Thunder-wielding +1," extra Thundershock Damage will be applied.)
     This change involves the following Souljades:
[list]
[*] [Horizontal Blink Strike·Ice-wielding] 
[*] [Vertical Blink Strike·Thunder-wielding] 
[*] [Horizontal Energy·Ice-wielding] 
[*] [Vertical Energy·Thunder-wielding] 
[*] [Uppercut Rush·Ice-wielding] 
[*] [Abyssal Aura·Thunder-wielding]

[*] [Cavalry Bloom·Ice-wielding]
[*] [Petal Fall Flurry·Thunder-wielding]
[*] [Crescent Slam·Ice-wielding]
[*] [Crescent Slam·Thunder-wielding]
[*] [Erudition·Ice-wielding]
[*] [Velocity Untold·Ice-wielding]
[*] [Velocity Untold·Thunder-wielding]
[*] [Cyan Fang·Ice-wielding]
[*] [Cyan Fang·Thunder-wielding]
[*] [Cyan Fang·Poison-wielding]
[/list]
2. Added the elemental melee Souljades: [Chained Sweeping·Element], [Serpent's Whisper·Element]
3. Added the poison-wielding ranged Souljades: [Toxic Cannon], [Toxic Arrows], [Toxic Explosion], [Toxic Shot], [Toxic Swarm]
4. Changed the Souljade [Rockfall Slash·Thunder-wielding] to [Aerial Rend·Element]
5. Changed the Souljade [Venom Tip] to [Toxic Crossbow] and added it back to the game
6. Optimized the description of the Souljades [Thunder Shot] and [Thunder Detonation] without altering their actual effects.
7. Optimized the special effect triggered when hit by the Souljade [Thunder Detonation]

[h3]II. Combat Adjustments[/h3]
1. Optimized collision issues that occurred after defeating [Omnius·Beast]
2. Fixed the issue where spear counterstrikes sometimes cannot hit large enemies
3. Optimized the finishing motions for some of Stone Monster's attack moves


[h3]III. Nirriti's Ruins Adjustments[/h3]
1. Added the Anima Rings: [Armor Recovery·Vanquisher], [Calamity Fortitude], [Charged Power Strike], [Charged Aegis-break], [Might·Restraint], [Might·Defuse].

[h3]IV. Hero Adjustments[/h3]
1. Matari's Defuse martial skill [Soulbreak Tusk] can now use airborne Quick Dash during the special technique "Defuse·Dash".
2. Extended Matari's invulnerability time upon successfully using Defuse. Matari now gains Golden Focus for the duration of the move and can use airborne Quick Dash again after a successful Defuse.

[h3]V. Feature Adjustments[/h3]
[b]1. Added the new function "Upgrade Sense Level"[/b]
The function "Upgrade Sense Level" can be accessed on the Equip Souljade page. Selected upgrade materials will be used to upgrade the 6 equipped Souljades simultaneously according to the optimal solution.

[b]2. Adjusted Weekly Quests[/b]
Added a new Weekly Quest that can be completed by clearing 12 random Showdown stages. Completing this quest grants a reward of 15 Souljade Fragments.

[b]3. Added descriptions for the drops in Enigma Domain and Nirriti's Ruins[/b]
Enigma Domain yields more Souljades, while Nirriti's Ruins provide more Carved Crystals.
Existing rules have been elaborated on for clarity, but no adjustments have been made to the actual yields.

[i]//Dev Note: Our data shows that some players have experienced Carved Crystal overflow, so we have increased the yield of Souljade Fragments in the Weekly Quests. Players can manage their Fatigue strategically to balance the quantities of both items.[/i]

[b]4. Optimized the display of remaining rebirth attempts in Showdown.[/b]

[b]5. Disabled the environmental kill mechanism after defeating Omni Core in Buried Giant.[/b]

notes.title: NARAKA: BLADEPOINT Update – Oct. 17, 2024
notes.content:
[h1]Dear players,[/h1]
The servers of NARAKA: BLADEPOINT will be suspended for maintenance from October 16th, 2024 at 23:00 (UTC) to October 17th, 2024 at 04:00 (UTC). We suggest you log out in advance and enter the game again after the maintenance.

The details for this update are as follows:

[h2]Brand New Event[/h2]
[h3]Brand New Content[/h3]
[b]I. Aurora Season's Immortal War is now available[/b]
After reaching Platinum, players can participate in Immortal War, competing across new ranks and winning Season rewards. These rewards will be awarded based on the highest rank attained in Immortal War (Solo, Duos, or Trios).
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36350327/955bd016d3e74fde021d55aeb1a5fbfc03136a71.png[/img]
Players who make it into to the Top 500 in Immortal War will enter the Immortal Leaderboard. This leaderboard is updated every Monday at 04:00 (UTC). Being in the Top 500 earns you a special title. At the end of the season, players who earned a special title this way will receive an Avatar reward as well. A player who is on the Immortal Leaderboard at the end of the season will receive additional rewards.

In addition, the Top 3 players of the last tally will be awarded exclusive Hero Badges.

[b]II. Divine Light[/b]
Event Time:  Oct. 17, 2024 Update - Oct. 30, 2024, 20:00 (UTC)

[u]Event Rules[/u]
[olist]
[*] By completing Daily Quests, players can obtain Cyra's Tokens: Grail, Temperance, Sun, and Fate and have an additional chance to obtain one of the following rewards: Tae, Spectral Silk, Mythic Treasure, Peerless Treasure Choice Gift, Hero Coin, Legendary Trial Card, and Aurora Coins.
[*] There are 4 Sections, which can be unlocked with the corresponding Tokens.
[*] You can claim rewards by unlocking any of the four Sections. Some rewards will be available after the new version is released, so stay tuned. 
[/olist]
[h3]Hero Adjustments[/h3]
[b]I. Kylin Zhang[/b]
[list]
[*] Slightly increased the charging and pulling effect of the charged move in the Ultimate [Qilin Slash].
[*] Adjusted the damage multiplier of the horizontal strike in the Ultimate [Qilin Slash: Rend] from 2.5 to 1.5, and the damage multiplier of the charged move [Wrath Slash] from 2.8 to 3.0.
[*] Slightly increased the charging time and recovery frames required to release the charged move [Wrath Slash] in the Ultimate [Qilin Slash: Rend], and slightly reduced the charging distance of [Wrath Slash].
[*] Slightly delayed the timing of jump and dodge cancels for the horizontal strike in the Ultimates [Qilin Slash] and [Qilin Slash: Rend].
[*] Slightly increased the recovery frames of the skill [Raider's Touch].
[/list]
[b]II. Valda Cui[/b]
[list]
[*] The binding of enemies by the water bubble of the skills [Water Trap] and [Water Trap: Trinity] will no longer be interrupted by grappling hook attacks.
[*] Adjusted the Defense Focus during the charging of the skill [Water Trap] to Golden Focus.
[/list]
[b]III. Hadi[/b]
[list]
[*] Adjusted the initial Rage cost of the Ultimate [Aerial Ascent] from 40 to 60.
[*] After releasing the Ultimates [Aerial Ascent] and [Aerial Ascent: Blaze], even if the Ultimate is deactivated early, Rage will still not be gained for 15 sec (starting from when the Ultimate is activated).
[*] Enhanced the visual effects of the Mechanical Cube.
[/list]
[i]//Dev Note: We hope this limits the phenomenon of Hadi creating too many Mechanical Cube items by frequently deactivating his Ultimate early. We also enhanced the cues of the Mechanical Cube to all sides of the battlefield.[/i]

[h3]Weapon Adjustments[/h3]
[b]I. Katana[/b]
1. Slightly reduced the startup frames of the horizontal and vertical strikes of the [Thunderstrike] move.

[b]II. Greatsword[/b]
1. Optimized the melee auto-aim of the charged horizontal strikes.

[b]III. Spear[/b]
1. Fixed an issue where the player could be knocked back too far away in the air after being hit by an Uppercut Slash.

[b]IV. Dagger[/b]
1. Optimized the effect range of charged vertical strikes.

[b]V. Nunchucks[/b]
1. Slightly increased the startup frames of the Dragon Flurry and [Dragon Roar] moves.
2. Adjusted the damage multiplier of the final stage of Dragon Flurry from 0.38*5 to 0.43*5.
     Adjusted the damage multiplier of the final stage of [Dragon Roar] from 1.28 to 1.53.

[b]VI. Fistblades[/b]
1. Delayed the timing at which moves can be performed after Wild Sweep.

[b]VII. Dual Blades[/b]
1. Optimized the melee auto-aim of the charged horizontal strikes.

[h3]Souljade Adjustments[/h3]
[b]I. Katana Souljades[/b]
1. Slightly reduced the stagger time inflicted on enemies hit by the final stage of attack of [Swift Cut].

[b]II. Ranged Souljades[/b]
1. Adjusted the upgrade effect of [Switch·Dazzle] to increase Attack for a period of time after hitting enemies with Switch·Dazzle, and increased the duration from 3 sec to 6 sec.

[h3]In-game Adjustments[/h3]
[b]I. Immortal War Adjustments[/b]
1. In the Duos and Trios modes of Immortal War, Draco Storm has been added to the Spirit Well rewards, which lasts for 120 sec.

[h3]Out-game Adjustments[/h3]
[b]I. Personality Tag Adjustments[/b]
1. Personality tags will now be displayed on player profiles.
2. Updated a large number of personality tag options.
3. Optimized the personality tag editing page to improve usability.

[b]II. Event Reward Adjustments[/b]
The redeeming limit for Small Tae String in the [Aureate Gravel] event has been increased to 499 times. The event will end at 20:00 (UTC) on October 20.

[h3]Showdown Adjustments[/h3]
[b]I. Buried Giant Stage Adjustments[/b]
The Lightning Spear will appear after entering the level. You need to defeat the monsters on the platform to accumulate energy for it. Once it reaches full energy, you can interact and use it. If the spear misses the Omni Core, the energy will not be consumed.
2. Optimized the scene and process flow in the stage. Newly added countering tips for some moves.

[b]II. Nirriti's Ruins Adjustments[/b]
1. Modified the appearance requirements of the Nirriti Codex related to [Divinity Guard].

[b]III. Enigma Domain Adjustments[/b]
1. Added some new Scout Bells in Enigma Domain: Shadowjade Mine and Enigma Domain: Celestra.

[b]IV. Omens Adjustments[/b]
1. In Yama's Abyss, the [Ice Mound] Omen mechanism has been changed to be immediately attackable by players, and the initial attack cooldown time has been removed.

[b]V. Feature Adjustments[/b]
1. The quality of [Shrouded Jade] and [Flux Jade Shard] has been adjusted from Epic to Legendary to better match their value.
(Adjustments to quality will not affect drop rates.)

[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]
[b]I. Hero-related Bugs[/b]
1. Fixed an issue where Tarka Ji could directly start sprinting when standing up from a crouch in the Ultimate status.

[h3]Store Updates[/h3]
[previewyoutube=1amKHVFNnoA;full][/previewyoutube]
[b]I. New Packs[/b]
1. Added Zai exclusive Pack [Dark Wings], which contains the Zai exclusive Legendary Outfit [Dark Wings], Legendary Accessory [Thorned Crown], Legendary Hairstyle [White Crow] and the Legendary Polesword Skin [Penance]. Standard price: 5,300 Gold; Now: 3,200 Gold. Individual cosmetics have their own discounts, but the Pack discount is even bigger!
 
2. Added Kurumi exclusive Pack [Blue Lantern], which contains the Kurumi exclusive Legendary Outfit [Blue Lantern], Legendary Accessory [Azure Horns], Legendary Hairstyle [Glowworm] and the Legendary Katana Skin [Waking Dream]. Standard price: 5,300 Gold; Now: 3,200 Gold. Individual cosmetics have their own discounts, but the Pack discount is even bigger!

[b]II. New Discounts[/b]
[olist]
[*] Newly added Zai Legendary Accessory [Night Rose]. (Unlock it to get a new appearance for Zai's Ultimate [Chain Scythe].) Standard price: 3,600 Gold; Now: 2,350 Gold.
[*] Newly added Zai Legendary Pose [Chained Puppet]. Standard price: 900 Gold; Now: 750 Gold.
[*] Newly added Zai Legendary Background [Night Hunt]. Standard price: 600 Gold; Now: 400 Gold.
[*] Newly added Kurumi Legendary Pose [Gotcha!]. Standard price: 900 Gold. Now: 750 Gold.
[*] Newly added Legendary Mark of Victory [Devotion Gem]. Standard price: 2,000 Gold; Now: 1,200 Gold.
[*] Newly added Kurumi Legendary Background [Glimmering Blue]. Standard price: 600 Gold; Now: 400 Gold.
[*] Newly added Kurumi Legendary Base [Lotus Lantern]. Standard price: 1200 Gold; Now: 900 Gold.
[/olist]

notes.title: NARAKA: BLADEPOINT Banned Players List Sept 24th
notes.content:
Dear players,

NARAKA: BLADEPOINT is committed to creating a fair and healthy competitive environment. We have not only used new anti-cheat technologies, but also established special cheat-reporting reward activities to encourage those players who defend the fairness with us. From now on, players who make outstanding contributions to reporting cheats will get the Legendary spear skin 'Righteous Polearm' .

More details:
1. Players who successfully reported 1 time will get [Immortal Treasure] X1;

2. Players who successfully report 10 times with low misreport rate will get [Immortal Treasure] X10 (In order to ensure the efficiency of detecting, please report reasonably);

3. Players who have successfully reported for many times or made great contributions to anti-cheat will get the Legendary spear skin [Righteous Polearm] X1.

We strongly recommend that players report via in-game report system, so that we can confirm the cheat as soon as possible and record successful report times for you!

From 9.16 to 9.22, there are  10 players who have successfully reported the cheating or hacking in total and get the reward [Righteous Polearm]! We hope that more players can become the Justice Supporter on the Morus Isle in the future.

notes.title: NARAKA: BLADEPOINT Update – Sep. 24, 2024
notes.content:
[h1]Dear players,[/h1]

The servers of NARAKA: BLADEPOINT will be suspended for maintenance from Sep. 23, 2024 23:00 (UTC) to Sep. 24, 2024 04:00 (UTC). We suggest you log out in advance and enter the game again after the maintenance.

The details for this update are as follows:

[h2]Brand New Content[/h2]
[h3]I. Alliance[/h3]
1. In Quick Match and Ranked Mode (below the Asura rank), when teammates leave the battle early in a multi-player team, the last remaining player may use the "Alliance" tag in the Bag page to join forces with other players. If the requirements are met, the player initiating the Alliance will form a new team with other players for that match.
The requirements for Alliance:
[olist]
[*] Spend 7,500 Dark Tide Coins;
[*] The Alliance must be initiated before the fifth Shadow Corruption starts in the match;
[*] Each player can initiate at most one Alliance per match, and each match can only have a certain number of Alliances.
[*] The Alliance feature is disabled when fewer than 4 teams are left in the match;
[*] When you are in the Realm of Yang, the Alliance process will be paused; when the Realm of Yang ends, it will resume.
[/olist]
When an Alliance is completed:
[list]
[*] You will exit the Ultimate state if you are in one when the Alliance is activated.
[*] When you successfully activate an Alliance, any active Bounty, Protection, and Valiant Challenge 
[/list]Quests relating to you or your alliance member(s) will be canceled.
The current version allows Alliances of up to 2 heroes.

[h3]II. New Events[/h3]

[b]1. Limited-time event: Alchemy Trials[/b]
1. Event Time: From Sep. 24, 2024 Update to Oct. 16, 2024 at 20:00 (UTC)

[u]Event Rules:[/u]
[olist]
[*] During the event, earn Sparks by opening Stashes in Survival modes. Sparks are also obtainable through Showdown. You can acquire up to 300 Sparks per week through these methods.
[*] Tap the Mineralcraft button on the event page to randomly receive Crystals of the same type (consumes 10 Sparks). Collect five of the same Crystal to claim corresponding rewards.
[*] Claim 50 extra Sparks upon first entering the event page each week. The weekly Spark limit and extra Sparks reset every Wednesday at 20:00 (UTC). (First reset: Oct. 2, 2024, at 20:00 UTC) 
[/olist]
[b]2. Panda Sign In[/b]
Event Duration: Oct. 10, 2024 at 04:00 (UTC) - Oct. 23, 2024 at 20:00 (UTC)
During this event, sign in for 7 days in total to get rewards including limited-edition Accessory, and limited-edition Avatar, Aeon Treasure etc.

[b]3. Righteous Purge[/b]
Event Duration: Sep. 25, 2024 20:00 (UTC) - Oct. 9, 2024 20:00 (UTC).

[u]Event Rules:[/u]
[olist]
[*] Gain Lumenrift Wood by completing quests during the event. Lumenrift Wood can be redeemed for rare event rewards.
[*] Finish all daily quests to unlock bonus special rewards.
[*] There are 5 groups of challenge quests, each unlocking sequentially at different times. Completing them will earn you generous rewards.
[*] Redemption for the event ends on Oct. 23, 2024, at 20:00 (UTC). Make sure to redeem your rewards in time.
[/olist]
[h3]III. Fairyland Penglai Adjustments[/h3]
[b]Sky-high Racing Update, Mission & Rewards Adjustments[/b]
A new track, mission system, and Coin Collection missions offer more dimensions to freshen up the Sky-high Racing experience!

[h3]IV. New Preview Feature: Change Scenery[/h3]
A new feature has been added while previewing Outfits, Accessories, Faces, Hairstyles, Ranged Weapon Skins and Melee Weapons Skins: Change Scenery. This will allow players to switch between [Default], [Morning], [Midday], [Dusk], or [Night].

[i]//Dev Note: The four different sceneries are similar to those found in-game and on Fairyland Penglai. We hope that these will simulate the in-game visual environment, helping players create the look that they want.[/i]

[b]Aurora Season Pack[/b]
Can be purchased from Sep. 24, 2024 00:00 (UTC) to Dec. 19, 2024 00:00 (UTC)
Purchase the Season Pack to get the following rewards:
[list]
[*] Aurora Season Pack Exclusive Epic Head Accessory for Kylin Zhang: Kylin
[*] Advanced Hidden Treasure Card: Use to unlock the Advanced Hidden Treasure of the current season. (Usable during Aurora Season or all subsequent seasons)
[*] Baize's Blessing: Use to collect rewards from Baize's Blessing for 30 days.
[*] Gold*600
[*] Peerless Treasure Choice Gift*10
[/list]    
[h3]New Season[/h3]
Aeon Season will end on Sep 24, 2024 at 00:00 (UTC)
For the full recap of season rewards and score resets please see our official announcement post:
[url=https://www.narakathegame.com/news/update/20240919/33459_1181753.html]https://www.narakathegame.com/news/update/20240919/33459_1181753.html[/url]

[h2]Hero Adjustments[/h2]
[h3]I. Valda Cui[/h3]
[olist]
[*] Adjustments to the skill [Water Trap]:
[list]
[*] It can be charged by holding the button. After a successful charge, releasing the button will set multiple Water Bombs with a shorter binding duration. The large Water Bomb in the center can bind enemies for 1.1 sec, and the small Water Bombs around it can bind enemies for 0.5 sec. 
[*] Casting the charged move will increase its cooldown time.
[/list]
[*] Adjusted the Water Bombs generated by [Water Trap] and [Water Trap: Trinity] to bind enemies in the Gold Focus state, unless it's skill-based.
[*] Adjusted the duration of [Rising Tide: Unchained] in duo and trio modes from 20 sec to 25 sec and in solo mode from 15 sec to 18 sec. The damage multiplier of the Water Spear hit has been adjusted from 0.1 to 1.0.
[*] Enemies bound by the Dragon's Coil will no longer break free when hit by a grappling hook.
[*] Removed the skill variant [Water Trap: Array].
[*] Removed the Ultimate variant [Rising Tide: Barrage].
[/olist]
[h3]II. Feria Shen[/h3]
[olist]
[*] 1. Adjustments to the Ultimate [Mech Mayhem]:
[list]
[*] While in the Bronze Mech state, clicking the Ultimate button again will expand the Bronze Mech shield, providing a 25% damage reduction effect to nearby allies for 4 sec.
[*] Slightly reduced the base durability of the Bronze Mech to match that of [Mech Mayhem: Co-pilot].
[/list]
[*] All Bronze Mech Ultimate variants now allow double jumping, and the purifying effect that comes with Cannon mode has been changed from a 2-sec delay to an immediate effect.
[*] Adjusted the bullets of [Gunplay: Aim] to break Gold Focus unless it's skill-based, and slightly increased the hitbox of the bullets.
[*] Optimized the beacon interaction of [Mech Mayhem: Co-pilot]. Now, even if a player is interrupted during the transformation process after using the beacon, Feria will no longer lose her remaining Rage, and the beacon will not disappear.
[*] Removed the skill variant [Gunplay: Scattershot].
[*] Removed the Ultimate variant [Mech Mayhem: Restore].
[/olist]
[h3]III. Zai[/h3]
[olist]
[*] Adjusted the duration of the Flame Ward state for the [Flame Ward] skill from 2 sec to 3.5 sec.
[*] Optimized the hit determination of the skill [Flame Ward: Firestorm] and slightly increased the attack range of the explosion.
[*] For the special vertical strike charged move [Chain Link] of the Ultimate [Chain Scythe], adjusted the casting direction to the aiming direction of the crosshair, shortened the startup frames, and optimized the attack range and knockback effect.
[*] Removed the skill variant [Flame Ward: Ignition].
[*] Removed the Ultimate variant [Chain Scythe: Afflict].
[/olist]
[h3]IV. Akos Hu[/h3]
[list]
[*] Adjusted the damage of the three consecutive Tiger-Lunging strikes of the Ultimate [Feral Frenzy] from 2.4/2.7/3.0 to 2.7/3.0/3.3, and slightly increased the stun duration these strikes inflict on the Vajra, the Bronze Mech, and the Almighty General.
[/list]
[h3]V. Lyam Liu[/h3]
[olist]
[*] Adjusted the flight distance of the Auric Core in the Ultimate [Metal Fusion: Core] from 25m to 22m.
[*] Adjusted the knockback effect suffered by players grabbed by the [Auric Core] when they are automatically released and fly to the farthest point. They will now fall faster after being knocked back.
[*] Increased the duration of the immunity granted after emerging from an [Auric Core] from 3 seconds to 5 seconds.
[/olist]
[h3]VI. Kurumi[/h3]
[list]
[*] Adjusted the damage reduction for the linked target and Kurumi of her vertical strike moves from 90% to 70% while the [Healing Ray: Defense] connection lasts.
[/list]
[h2]Weapon Adjustments[/h2]
[h3]I. Unified Adjustments for Melee Weapons[/h3]
The range used to determine if a Counter is successful or not has been expanded to 360 degrees.

[h3]II. Fistblades[/h3]
[list]
[*] Slightly reduced the stagger time when the crouching horizontal strike hits enemies.
[*] Delayed the timing at which attacks can be followed up after releasing charged moves.
[/list]
[h3]III. Spear[/h3]
[list]
[*] Reworked the charged horizontal strikes.
[*] Slightly increased the knock-up height caused by hitting enemies with the Uppercut Slash moves.
[*] Slightly reduced the movement of the horizontal strikes while sprinting.
[/list]
[h3]IV. Dual-wielded Weapons[/h3]
[list]
[*] Optimized the pre-input for transitioning from horizontal strikes to crouching.
[/list]
[h3]V. Katana[/h3]
[list]
[*] Adjusted the horizontal [Thunderstrike] move from a Focus attack to a common attack and can be charged. Reduced the damage multiplier from 2.83 to 1.33.
[*] Increased the damage multiplier of the first stage of the charged vertical strike from 1.17*4 to 1.26*4.
[/list]
[i]//Dev Note: The decision-making after the Katana's [Blink Strike] has become a bit too monotonous, so we've adjusted the horizontal [Thunderstrike] move to a common attack to add more branches to the Katana's decision-making.
[/i]
[h3]VI. Heng Sword[/h3]
[list]
[*] Reduced the damage multiplier of the first stage of the charged vertical strike from 2.47*2 to 2.35*2.
[/list]
[h2]Souljade Adjustments[/h2]
[h3]I. Fistblades Souljades[/h3]
[list]
[*] Introduced the new Souljade [Sky Punch].
[*] Introduced the new Souljade [Tempest Kick].
[*] Reduced the damage multiplier of [Cloud Weaver] from (0.7*3+3.48) to (0.66*3+3.29).
[/list]
[h3]II. Spear Souljades[/h3]
[list]
[*] The last hit of [Martial Art·Hexa-Harmony Spear] can now be changed to another direction.
[/list]
[h3]III. Heng Sword Souljades[/h3]
[list]
[*] Greatly reduced the duration of the silence effect caused by hitting enemies with the first hit of [Aurora Burst].
[*] Reduced the damage multiplier of [Aurora Burst] from (2.25+0.45*12) to (2.17+0.43*6+0.44*6).
[/list]
[h3]IV. Dual Halberds Souljades[/h3]
[list]
[*] Reduced the damage multiplier of [Martial Art·Will-Form Hook] from (1.35+0.99*4+1.46) to (1.23+0.89*4+1.33), and increased the recovery multiplier of the last hit from 1.6 to 2.2.
[/list]
[h3]V. Dagger Souljades[/h3]
[list]
[*] Reduced the damage multiplier of [Dreadful Wail] from (0.47*10+1.18) to (0.42*5+0.43*5+1.06). 
[/list] 
[h3]VI. Katana Souljades[/h3]
[list]
[*] For [Soul Slash], slightly increased the number of hits and attack duration, reduced the knockback distance and knock up height caused by hitting enemies, increased the damage multiplier of the horizontal strikes from 0.73*8 to 0.56*11, and adjusted the damage multiplier of the vertical strikes from 0.73*8 to 0.58*10.
[*] Introduced the new Souljade [Swift Cut].
[/list]
[i]//Dev Note: Currently, [Soul Slash] causes knockback too frequently when hitting enemies, making it inconvenient for teammates to cooperate in team play. Therefore, we've optimized the knockback distance and knock up height caused by [Soul Slash] when hitting enemies, granting potential for better benefits through in-team cooperation.[/i]

[h2]In-game Adjustments[/h2]
[h3]I. Combat Item Adjustments[/h3]
[list]
[*] Players hit by the White Tiger's Prowess roar now gain a 2-sec immunity to the Roar effect.
[*] Obtaining the Draco Storm now restores a certain amount of Health, Armor, and Rage.
[/list]
[h3]II. Immortal War Adjustments[/h3]
[list]
[*] The Spirit Well now features Divine Beast Powers in the third round just like in the fourth round, and the duration of the buffs gained from capturing Spirit Wells in the third and fourth rounds have been adjusted to 120 sec.
[*] After a Spirit Well spawns, it will only persist for 180 sec. If not captured within that time, it will disappear.
[*] Slightly adjusted the respawn timing of Spirit Wells.
[/list]
[h3]III. In Ranked/Quick Match Duos or Trios, the cost of Rebirth Charms has been reduced from 9,000 to 7,500.[/h3]

[h2]Out-of-game Adjustments[/h2]
[h3]I. Free Training Adjustments[/h3]
[list]
[*] Adjusted the order of Fistblades and the relevant Souljades.
[/list]
[h3]II. Profile[/h3]
[list]
[*] A section for displaying Heroes has been added to the Profile page. You can display 3 Heroes and their highest associated Titles. Your Mini-Profile has also been updated to display the same heroes as well.
[*] A new Hero Score section and new Title display have been added to Profile-Hero Stats
[*] Added the option to filter by Hero Score to the Hero list on Profile-Hero Stats.
[*] Added a section to Profile-Hero Stats showing the match average for each Hero's special stat, and adjusted the stats shown for Tarka Ji and Matari.
[/list]
[h3]III. Justice Celebration[/h3]
[list]
[*] Removed the limit on the number of times a player could participate in the Songbird Arena during a celebration. Players can participate in the Songbird Arena without limit, but can receive 3 Victory Rewards at most.
[*] Removed the restriction on the number of Red Packets that could be collected per Red Packet Shower round (previously 3). Now, players can collect as many packets as they can each round.
[*] The first 3 packets that players collect in each Red Packet Shower round will be counted as Advanced Red Packets, with more abundant rewards. You can collect up to 27 Advanced Red Packets per week.
[*] The Host of a Celebration will get additional Red Packets based on the number of players that participate in each Red Packet Shower round.
[/list]
[h3]IV. Journey's Dawn[/h3]
Revamped the event interface, optimized quest content, and added a [Coming Soon] feature, allowing players to view game modes or features that they are about to unlock.

[h3]V. Hero Score Changes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Current Hero Score = Hero Score from Ranked Mode + Hero Score from Immortal War
[*] Some Hero Score will be carried over into the new Season, with a greater percentage of Hero Score carrying over at lower levels. The maximum possible Ranked Mode Hero Score that can carry over from the Aeon Season will be 6,300. Hero Score from Immortal War will be set to 0.
[*] Both modes have a [Threshold] for Hero Score. As long as your Hero Score from that mode is below the [Threshold], you will gain Hero Score faster, and you will gain Hero Score slower while above the [Threshold]. The [Thresholds] increase as your Rank increases, reaching their maximum at Unrivaled Asura (Ranked) and Magnate (Immortal War) respectively.
[*] [Threshold] Detailed Rules: Your Hero Score [Threshold] for Ranked modes depends on your Rank, with a maximum number of 5,000. Your Hero Score [Threshold] for Immortal War is based on your current Immortal War Rank Score (Immortal War Rank Score – 3,000), with a maximum number of 4,000.
[/list]
[h3]VI. Hot Potato Counter[/h3]
Adjusted the XP players may earn from each match.

[h2]Showdown Adjustments[/h2]

[h3]I. Showdown Event Level [Suffer No Demon][/h3]
Event Duration: Sep. 25, 2024 at 20:00 (UTC) - Oct. 9, 2024 at 20:00 (UTC)
[olist]
[*] During the event, you can select this level on the Showdown Map. Complete all Event Quests to get an exclusive Hero Badge, Exhilarating Elixir and other rewards.
[*] While in [Suffer No Demon], Sense Level differences will have no impact on damage dealt and damage received. [Suffer No Demon] is split into two chapters, corresponding to the brand new Auspicious Omens. Using the Auspicious Omen offered by each Chapter will let you defeat any monsters you face with ease.
[b]Chapter 1: Mystic Waters[/b]
With the exclusive "Water Spears" Auspicious Omen, using Heroes' Skills summon a barrage of water spears, delivering wide-range attacks and swiftly clearing the field!
[b]Chapter 2: Toxic Shroud[/b]
With the exclusive "Miasma Burst" Auspicious Omen, fallen monsters release a toxic mist, infecting nearby foes and triggering a devastating chain reaction!
[*] This stage will have its own Souljade drops, and is appropriate for trying to collect certain Souljades.
Chapter 1: [Ice Break], [Sub-Zero Seal], [Thunderproof], [Thunder Counter], [Thunderpull], [Spring's Call]
Chapter 2: [Cyan Fang·Poison-wielding], [Renewed Vigor], [Noxious Blast], [Miasma Drive], [Pestilent Pool], [Infectious Touch]
[*] Chapter 1 will be available immediately after the event begins. Chapter 2 will be available after Oct. 2, 2024 at 20:00 (UTC).
[/olist]
[h3]II. Enigma Peak Made Available[/h3]
[olist]
[*] In this season, Enigma Peak features three types: [Thunder-wielding], [Ice-wielding], and [Poison-wielding]. They will all be available on September 26, 2024 at 00:00 (UTC).
[*] In the Enigma Peak, Showdown Souljades drop by various kinds. If you defeat a certain number of Bosses in a single match, you can also receive rewards like Legendary Souljade Choice Gift, exclusive achievements and so on.
[*] Some bosses in the Enigma Peak will have special moves.
[*] Auspicious Omens corresponding to the elements have been added to the Enigma Peak, making it easier to deal with them using the appropriate Souljades.
[/olist]
[h3]III. Combat Adjustments[/h3]
[list]
[*] Optimized the AI for coordinated attacks between different types of monsters.
[*] Optimized the move transitions of [Omnius·Bough], and added some new combos.
[*] Optimized the move transitions of [Vinemire], and optimized the knockback distance caused by some moves.
[/list]
[h3]IV. Nirriti's Ruins Adjustments[/h3]
[olist]
[*] Reduced the Attack of monsters in solo mode on Nightscream and Legend difficulties.
[*] Changed the Repurpose encounter in the Nirriti Codex to discarding 2 Anima Rings to obtain 1 new Anima Ring; increased the probability of obtaining higher-quality or higher-level Anima Rings in encounters New Beginnings, Only The Strong, and Repurpose.
[*] Adjusted the logic for the appearance of Thundercall Charm and Avarice-related options in the Nirriti Codex; increased the probability of Useless Rocks appearing.
[*] A small amount of Dark Tide Coins can now be obtained when giving up the Secret Anima Ring yielded by certain Nirriti Codex.
[*] Eradicating the Evil and Strike It Rich of the Nirriti Codex will no longer appear in the 13th area.
[*] Slightly adjusted the spawn locations of the Nirriti Codex in the shop area.
[*] Increased the Frostbite added when [Frostbite Blessing II] triggers an Ice Blast from 200 to 350 points.
[*] Introduced the new Anima Rings [Mighty Counter·Heal], [Defuse·Heal], [Element·Heal], [Aegis-break·Assault], and [Dampen·Damage Reduction].
[*] Adjusted the [Burn] damage caused by [HydroFlare Blessing I] melee attacks from 30% per sec to 75% per sec.

[/olist]

[list]

3. Newly added Legendary Kill Announcement [Verdant Guardian·Panda Master] for all heroes. Standard price: 600 Gold; Now: 400 Gold.

5. Newly added Kylin Zhang Legendary Pose [Demon Slayer]. Standard price: 900 Gold; Now: 750 Gold.
6. Newly added Tessa Epic Pose [Enchanting Charm]. Standard price: 300 Gold; Now: 200 Gold.
7. Newly added Valda Cui Epic Pose [Leaning on Railing]. Standard price: 300 Gold; Now: 200 Gold.
8. Newly added Feria Shen Legendary Background [Verdant Guardian·Serene Skies]. Standard price: 600 Gold; Now: 400 Gold.
9. Newly added Feria Shen Legendary Base [Verdant Guardian·Roly Poly]. Standard price: 1,200 Gold; Now: 900 Gold.

[h3]III. New Type of Store for [Extreme Hairstyles][/h3]
[list]
[*] Newly added [Extreme Hairstyles] in the Shop, where Kurumi's Extreme Hairstyle [Petal Reverie] is now available!
[*] It takes 50 Cloud Mirror + 60 Floral Dew to redeem for a [Petal Reverie]. Obtaining the Hairstyle will also grant you Kurumi exclusive Debut Pose [Cherry Breeze] and Bubble [Kurumi·Falling Blossom]
[*] The price of a Cloud Mirror is 300 Gold.

Floral Dews can be traded in the Steam Community Market or bought in-game, with a price of 240 Gold.)

Please note that Floral Dews cannot be traded between console players.

[list]

Fixed the issue where Shayol Wei's skill [Shield Bash: Rush] sometimes could not hit enemies.

notes.title: NARAKA: BLADEPOINT Aeon Season Settlement Notice
notes.content:
Dear players,

The Aeon Season will come to an end on September 24th, 2024 at 00:00:00 (UTC), and the ranks for this season will be settled. To start off, we would like to thank you all for your suggestions and feedback that you offered during this season. We will continue to endeavor to bring a better gaming experience, and raise the quality of in-game competition! 


1.Season Rewards:
(1) Ranked: Season rewards will be awarded based on the highest rank gained in the ranked modes (Solo, Duos, or Trios) during the Aeon Season.

Rank	Rewards
<Bronze>	Avatar [Aeon·Bronze]
<Silver>	Avatar [Aeon·Silver]
<Gold>	Avatar [Aeon·Gold], Lyam Liu Epic Outfit [Pleated Finery·Ultramarine]
<Platinum>	Avatar [Aeon·Platinum], Lyam Liu Epic Outfit [Pleated Finery·Ultramarine], Greatsword Legendary Skin [Emerald Lion]
<Solar>	Avatar [Aeon·Solar], Lyam Liu Epic Outfit [Pleated Finery·Ultramarine], Greatsword Legendary Skin [Emerald Lion], Epic Background [August Banner], Aeon Treasure x3
<Empyrean>	Avatar [Aeon·Empyrean], Lyam Liu Epic Outfit [Pleated Finery·Ultramarine], Greatsword Legendary Skin [Emerald Lion], Epic Background [August Banner], Aeon Treasure x5
<Astral>	Avatar [Aeon·Astral], Lyam Liu Epic Outfit [Pleated Finery·Ultramarine], Greatsword Legendary Skin [Emerald Lion], Epic Background [August Banner], Aeon Treasure x7
<Asura>	Avatar [Aeon·Asura], Lyam Liu Epic Outfit [Pleated Finery·Ultramarine], Greatsword Legendary Skin [Emerald Lion], Epic Background [August Banner], Aeon Treasure x10
<Unrivaled Asura>	Avatar [Aeon·Unrivaled Asura], Lyam Liu Epic Outfit [Pleated Finery·Ultramarine], Greatsword Legendary Skin [Emerald Lion], Epic Background [August Banner], Aeon Treasure x10

The Avatar rewards for the Asura and Unrivaled Asura ranks are differentiated by Solo, Duos, and Trios, and can be earned separately across those various game modes. 

(2) Immortal War: Rewards will be given out according to the highest rank that a player achieved in Immortal War Solo, Duos and Trios during the Aeon Season.

Rank	Rewards
<Master II>	Peerless Treasure Choice Gift x3
<Master III>	Peerless Treasure Choice Gift x4, Cannon Legendary Skin [Inferno Lion]
<Master IV>	Peerless Treasure Choice Gift x5, Cannon Legendary Skin [Inferno Lion]
<Grandmaster I>	Peerless Treasure Choice Gift x6, Cannon Legendary Skin [Inferno Lion], Hero Badge [Aeon·Grandmaster I]
<Grandmaster II>	Peerless Treasure Choice Gift x7, Cannon Legendary Skin [Inferno Lion], Hero Badge [Aeon·Grandmaster II]
<Grandmaster III>	Peerless Treasure Choice Gift x8, Cannon Legendary Skin [Inferno Lion], Hero Badge [Aeon·Grandmaster III]
<Grandmaster IV>	Peerless Treasure Choice Gift x9, Cannon Legendary Skin [Inferno Lion], Hero Badge [Aeon·Grandmaster IV]
<Magnate>	Peerless Treasure Choice Gift x10, Cannon Legendary Skin [Inferno Lion], Hero Badge [Aeon·Magnate]

Avatars will be awarded to players based on the highest rank that they achieved on the Immortal Leaderboard during the Aeon Season. Additionally, all players on the Immortal Leaderboard at the time of season settlement will receive an Avatar.

When season settlement occurs, the top 3 players on the Immortal Leaderboard will receive exclusive Hero Badges.

Avatars and Hero Badges are differentiated by the highest Rank a player achieves in Solo, Duos, and Trios. Players receive rewards regardless of if they will also receive rewards in other modes or not.

New Rewards for Immortal War:
Starting from next Season (Aurora), Immortal War will include Background and Bubble rewards which are Season specific. The Team Stats page will also show your current Immortal War Rank (Grandmaster I, Grandmaster II, etc.) and your current Ranking (No. 1, No. 2, No. 3, etc.)

Additionally, players on the Immortal Leaderboard will receive an additional exclusive Avatar reward.
Starting from the next Season (Aurora), Hero Badges will no longer be issued to players for achieving any of the Ranks from Grandmaster I to Magnate.

Score Reset:

1. Scores in the Ranked modes (Solos, Duos, or Trios) will partially carry over to the new season.

Hero Scores are equal to your Ranked Mode Hero Score and your Immortal War Hero Score. Completing matches of both Ranked Mode and Immortal War can increase your score.

Some Hero Score will be carried over into the new Season, with a greater percentage of Hero Score carrying over at lower levels. The maximum possible Ranked Mode Hero Score that can carry over from the Aeon Season will be 6,300. Hero Score from Immortal War will be set to 0.

Both modes have a [Threshold] for Hero Score. As long as your Hero Score from that mode is below the [Threshold], you will gain Hero Score faster, and you will gain Hero Score slower while above the [Threshold]. The [Thresholds] increase as your Rank increases, reaching their maximum at Unrivaled Asura (Ranked) and Magnate (Immortal War) respectively.

[Threshold] Detailed Rules: Your Hero Score [Threshold] for Ranked modes depends on your Rank, with a maximum number of 5,000. Your Hero Score [Threshold] for Immortal War is based on your current Immortal War Rank Score (Immortal War Rank Score – 3,000), with a maximum number of 4,000.

Thank you all for supporting NARAKA: BLADEPOINT. Your feedback is always greatly appreciated. A new season is coming, let’s go explore it together!

notes.title: NARAKA: BLADEPOINT Update – Sep 12th, 2024
notes.content:
Dear players,

The servers of NARAKA: BLADEPOINT will be suspended for maintenance from Sep 11th, 2024 23:00 (UTC) to Sep 12th, 2024 04:00 (UTC). We suggest you log out in advance and enter the game again after the maintenance.


The details for this update are as follows:
Brand New Content

I. Limited-time Event: Moonlit Laurel
Event Duration: Sep 12th, 2024 update to Sep 23rd, 2024 20:00 (UTC)
Event Rules: Gain Laurel Bouquets by completing quests during the event. Laurel Bouquets can be redeemed for great event rewards.

II. The expiration date of the Aeon Season Battlepass has been changed to September 23rd, 23:00 (UTC).

Hero Adjustments
I. Tarka Ji
1. Added the ability to block damage from ranged attacks for [Flame Force: Block].

II. Matari
1. Optimized the visual effects of the Ultimate [Invisible Assassin: Restore] when activated.

III. Lyam Liu
1. Slightly reduced the pulling effect in the Ultimate [Metal Fusion]'s teleportation move.

Weapon Adjustments
I. Single-edged Weapon
1. Optimized the gestures when charging for a new horizontal strike after the third move in a horizontal strike.

Out-of-game Adjustments
I. More Rewards for Heroes Assemble
1. Each prize draw in Heroes Assemble will now provide an additional 150 Hidden Treasure XP.
2. Added Cleanse Stones to the prize pool, and increased the quantity of Exhilarating Elixirs, Carved Crystals, random Legendary Souljades, random Epic Souljades, Legendary Rune Keys, and Rebirth Beads.
3. Removed Elemental Essences and Potential XP Bonus Cards from the prize pool.

Showdown Adjustments
I. Combat Adjustments
1. Optimized the physical collision effects at the Aegis-break stage of the [Stone Monster].
2. Extended the duration of Lightning Spear in the Buried Giant stages.

II. Hero Adjustments
1. Increased the transparency of the special effects for Yoto Hime's Martial Skill [Annihilation Slash].

III. Nirriti's Ruins Adjustments
1. Increased the Fatigue accumulation in Nirriti's Ruins. The increased Fatigue accumulation will provide additional rewards corresponding to the extra accumulation in areas 6 to 15.
2. Added a prompt about the attribute bonus level enhanced in [Fire Forge] on the stage selection screen.
3. Added the [Survival] Anima Rings to the initial selectable Anima Rings in the preparation phase. When all Anima Ring types are activated, 5 of them will be randomly drawn.
4. Slightly reduced the number of Death Spores or Crimson Mist spawned in each stage when the [Death Spores] or [Crimson Mist] Omens are triggered.
5. Slightly increased the score added for each Dark Tide Coin pickup in the [Strike It Rich] stages.
6. Adjusted the random rules for Nirriti Codex content. Now, you won't get the codex event that acquires [Atomize] if you have the [Thundercall Charm], and vice versa.

IV. Yama's Abyss Adjustments
1. Added a prompt on how to deal with the Moonbane's Eye in stages where the boss is the Matron of Yushan.

V. Stage Adjustments
1. Adjusted the nodes corresponding to Fatigue accumulation and output in the Dangers in the Deep level.

VI. Features Adjustments
1. As some players have not had the chance to see the notice that the old Recasting system will be removed, we are moving its removal date from September 12th to September 24th (UTC+8).

VII. Showdown Battle-related Bug
1. Fixed an issue where the descriptions of some Anima Rings in Nirriti's Ruins contained [Souljade] and [Potential].
2. Fixed an issue where the Dark Tide Coins cost did not count to the Anima Ring [Wealth Confluence] in the Nirriti Codex.
3. Fixed an issue where the output of Carved Crystals and Shrouded Jades during the third and fourth Fatigue levels of some stages was lower than expected.
4. Fixed an issue that caused Vinemire's aggression to be lower at long distances.
5. Fixed the issue in Yama's Abyss Empyrean 2 where Omnius·Vortex (Real) might not immediately transform into Omnius·Void.

Feature Optimizations
I. Out-game
1. Optimized the logic for default equipment of new hero weapons.
After a new hero is released, the system will prioritize equipping them with high-quality weapon skins that you already own. If there are newer skins of the same quality available, those skins will be equipped first.
Note: If a player logs in after a long absence, a default weapon match will be generated for all heroes released during their absence.
II. Keyword & Terminology Adjustments
1. "Vaporize" type Anima Rings have all been renamed to "HydroFlare" type. This adjustment is purely cosmetic.
2. The name of the item "Alchemical Crystallized Soul" has been renamed to "Alchemized Souls". This adjustment is purely cosmetic.
3. The word used to refer to the grade (Common, Rare, Epic, Legendary, Extreme) of weapons, Armor, and Souljades has been changed from “rarity” to “quality.” Effects that previously referred to "weapon rarity" or "Armor rarity" (including but not limited to Takeda's Demonic Force, Tianhai's Vajra form damage and health, and the damage of Valda Cui's Water Spears) all use "weapon quality" and "Armor quality" instead. This adjustment is purely cosmetic. No effects that previously referenced weapon, Armor, or Souljade rarity have been changed as a direct result of this adjustment.
Store Updates
I. Yin Yang Pool·Fengshen Chronicles is available now
Each time you open the Yin Yang Pool, you need to consume 1 [Fengshen Chronicles Ingot], priced at 400 Gold, after opening it, you will have a chance to get 22 rewards such as Zai's Legendary Outfit [Fengshen Chronicles·Nezha], Valda Cui's Legendary Outfit [Fengshen Chronicles·Ao Bing] and Zai's Legendary Emote Gesture [Fengshen Chronicles·Wield the Wind].

The first opening is free, and you'll receive different rewards each time. You can open up to 21 times to collect all the rewards in the prize pool.

When obtaining a special reward, you can get these Zai cosmetics: Legendary Emote Gesture [Fengshen Chronicles·Wield the Wind] and Legendary Pose [Fengshen Chronicles·Fiery Punch]

While opening the Yin Yang Pool, there is a chance to claim all the remaining rewards at once.
 
After all the rewards are obtained, [Fengshen Chronicles Ingot] can be exchanged into Gold.

Guarantee:
Based on the above drop rate, players are guaranteed to receive at least one Gold (Legendary) reward within the first 4 draws. Another guaranteed Gold (Legendary) reward within 5 more draws, followed by the next guaranteed Gold (Legendary) reward within 7 more draws.

II. New Packs
1. Added Tessa exclusive Pack [Ruby Sunray], which contains the Tessa Legendary Outfit [Summer Party·Ruby Sunray], Epic Hairstyle [Summer Party·Gorgeous] and Legendary Accessory [Summer Party·Rose-Tinted]. Standard price: 3,500 Gold; Now: 2,300 Gold. Individual cosmetics have their own discounts, but the Pack discount is even bigger!

III. New Discounts
1. Refined Attire Choice Gift available for a limited-time: Sep 17, 2024 03:00 (UTC) - Sep 24, 2024 00:00 (UTC)
The Refined Attire Choice Gift is now available for a limited time, with a limit of 2 purchases. It includes selected outfits, accessories, and treasures at a 50% discount. Come and make your selection now!
2. Newly added Valda Cui Legendary Pose [Fengshen Chronicles·Awaiting the Tides]. Standard price: 900 Gold; Now: 600 Gold.
3. Newly added Zai Legendary Background [Fengshen Chronicles·Sandalwood]. Standard price: 600 Gold; Now: 400 Gold.
4. Newly added Valda Cui Legendary Background [Fengshen Chronicles·Shaker of Seas]. Standard price: 600 Gold; Now: 400 Gold.
5. Newly added Zai Legendary Base [Fengshen Chronicles·Lotus of Wrath]. Standard price: 1,200 Gold; Now: 800 Gold.
6. Newly added Valda Cui Legendary Base [Fengshen Chronicles·Snowscale]. Standard price: 1,200 Gold; Now: 800 Gold.

IV. New Items in Spectral Silk Store
1. Newly added Zai Epic Face Item [Zai Exclusive Eyeshadow 2] with a price of 5,000 Spectral Silk.
2. Newly added Valda Cui Epic Face Item [Valda Cui Exclusive Eyeshadow 2] with a price of 5,000 Spectral Silk.

notes.title: NARAKA: BLADEPOINT Banned Players List Sept 3rd
notes.content:
Dear players,

NARAKA: BLADEPOINT is committed to creating a fair and healthy competitive environment. We have not only used new anti-cheat technologies, but also established special cheat-reporting reward activities to encourage those players who defend the fairness with us. From now on, players who make outstanding contributions to reporting cheats will get the Legendary spear skin 'Righteous Polearm' .

More details:
1. Players who successfully reported 1 time will get [Immortal Treasure] X1;

2. Players who successfully report 10 times with low misreport rate will get [Immortal Treasure] X10 (In order to ensure the efficiency of detecting, please report reasonably);

3. Players who have successfully reported for many times or made great contributions to anti-cheat will get the Legendary spear skin [Righteous Polearm] X1.

We strongly recommend that players report via in-game report system, so that we can confirm the cheat as soon as possible and record successful report times for you!

From 8.26 to 9.1, there are  8 players who have successfully reported the cheating or hacking in total and get the reward [Righteous Polearm]! We hope that more players can become the Justice Supporter on the Morus Isle in the future.
