notes.title: NARAKA: BLADEPOINT Update – Aug 29th, 2024
notes.content:
[h1]Dear players,[/h1]

The servers of NARAKA: BLADEPOINT will be suspended for maintenance from August 28th, 2024 at 23:00 (UTC) to August 29th, 2024 at 04:00 (UTC). We suggest you log out in advance and enter the game again after the maintenance.
The details for this update are as follows:

[h2]Brand New Content[/h2]

[h3]1. Showdown 2.0 Deepwood [/h3] 
[previewyoutube=wfc1RXUhkiw;full][/previewyoutube]
A new Showdown season is here, bringing strange omens to the world. The base Sense levels of all stages and heroes have been altered.

[b]1. New Hero in Showdown: Yoto Hime[/b]
Yoto Hime has now joined Showdown.
With the demonic blade in hand, may you slay all evil!

[b]2. New Chapter: Sunwing's Rest[/b]
The dark valley is fraught with hidden dangers. Omnius is attacking in an even more shocking manner this time.

[b]3. Nirriti's Ruins and Adjustments to Yama's Abyss[/b]
Yama's Abyss has been transformed into a purer trial ground. Players can now bring their Souljades into battle, continuously challenging higher stages to advance their Showdown rank.
The original format of Yama's Abyss has been made into a brand new game mode, Nirriti's Ruins, featuring more powerful Anima Rings, fresh gameplay elements, and an even more thrilling experience.
Take on the challenges of Nirriti's Ruins and Yama's Abyss separately for a variety of bountiful season-limited rewards.

[b]4. Brand New Souljades and Potentials[/b]
With the arrival of a new season, players can now use a new "Poison-wielding" power and new Souljades! "Fight poison with poison" and seize victory through unexpected means.
Potential levels have been reset, and we have adjusted the effects of existing Potentials, as well as added new Poison-related Potentials to provide a wider range of combo selections.

[b]5. Season Settlements[/b]
Turmoil Season will end on August 29, 2024 at 00:00 (UTC)
(1) Season Rewards:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36350327/dac638b085185e074593729475562dbb4fd41763.jpg[/img]
(2) Showdown Leaderboard Rewards
Players will be rewarded with an Avatar that corresponds to the highest rank that they held on the leaderboards at any point during Showdown Turmoil Season (recorded either at weekly settlement or at season settlement). Additionally, the top 3 players on each leaderboard will receive an exclusive Hero Badge.

(3) Progress Reset:
In the new season, players will start from <Showdown Bronze 1> in Yama's Abyss.

[h3]II. Brand New Showdown Pass[/h3]
The new Deepwood Showdown Pass is here. Unlock the pass to level up and obtain the Legendary Weapon Skins [Ivy Shards] and [Celestial Abyss], exclusive Martial Skill Cosmetics [Thunderbolt·Blaze] and [Draconic Lightning Strike·Radiant] for Viper Ning, and [Annihilation Slash·Inferno] and [Annihilation Blade·Crimson] for Yoto Hime, the new Legendary Souljade [Pestilent Pool], the Extreme item [Flux Shard], and a host of other rewards!

[h3]III. New Events[/h3]
[b]1. Truth and Myth[/b]
Event Time: From Aug 28, 2024 20:00 (UTC) to Sep 23, 2024 20:00 (UTC) 
Claim rewards until Sep 29, 2024 20:00 (UTC) 

[u]Event Rules[/u]
This artifact comes from the Perdoria. Try to piece together the story it holds.
[olist]
[*] During the event, participating in Survival modes or Showdown matches will earn you Insight Tokens according to your in-game performance (including but not limited to dealing damage, countering, and healing). You can earn up to 100 Insight Tokens per match, with a daily cap of 200 Insight Tokens.
[*] Every 200 Insight Tokens automatically converts into 1 Knowledge Point. Spend Knowledge Points to unlock clue stories for three artifacts and receive clue rewards.
[*] Once all three artifact clues are unlocked, you can open the Artifact Treasure to obtain the final reward.
[*] Each day, players can claim an Archaeology Gift to gain 100 bonus Insight Tokens, which doesn't count towards the cap for points earned from matches.
[/olist]
[b]2. Ancient Wood[/b]
Event Time: From Aug 29, 2024 03:00 (UTC) to Sep 11, 2024 20:00 (UTC)
Claim rewards until Sep 18th, 2024 at 20:00 (UTC)

[u]Event Rules:[/u]
The resting place of the ancient remains, a site where fate and peril converge.
[olist]
[*] Gain Fallen Branches by completing quests during the event. Fallen Branches can be redeemed for great event rewards.
[*] Complete all Daily Quests to receive bonus rewards.
[*] There are 5 groups of Challenge Quests, each available in turn at different times. Complete quests to claim plentiful rewards.
[/olist]
[h2]Hero Adjustments[/h2]
[h3]I. Kylin Zhang[/h3]
[list]
[*] Optimized the hit sound effect when Kylin Zhang's Black Gold Blade under Ultimate state hits enemies.
[*] Slightly shortened the startup frames of the charged strikes in the Ultimate [Qilin Slash] and optimized the performance of Horizontal strikes and Charged strikes.
[*] Added a special effect prompt to the attack path of the echo strike in the Ultimate [Qilin Slash: Rend], making the attack path easier to discern.
[/list]
[h3]II. Shayol Wei[/h3]
[list]
[*] The Skill [Shield Bash: Rush] can now block ranged weapon projectiles during the rush.
[/list]
[h3]III. Other Adjustments[/h3]
Redesigned the calculation method for the Endurance Threshold. After being [Frozen] by Justina Gu or [Enchanted] by Tessa, any armor or health damage taken during this period will be reduced by the corresponding threshold.

[i]//Dev Note: Previously, when a player was Frozen or Enchanted, enemies could use [Armor Pierce] and other tactics to deal a large amount of damage without breaking the armor threshold and the control effect, which went against the design purpose of the threshold. Therefore, we adjusted the calculation method used for the threshold so that Justina Gu's [Freeze], Tessa's [Enchant], Ziping Yin's [Inspiration Shield], and Hadi's [Aerial Ascent] are now all consistent with one another.[/i]

[h2]Weapon Adjustments[/h2]
[h3]I. Fistblades[/h3]
[olist]
[*] When you have [Cloud Weaver] equipped, the Wild Sweep effect will change when using the charged horizontal strike.
[*] Slightly increased the startup frames of the 2nd stage charged vertical strike.
[*] Slightly reduced the movement of the horizontal and vertical strikes while sprinting.
[*] Slightly reduced the stagger time when the vertical strike and crouching horizontal strike hit grounded enemies.
[*] Reduced Horizontal and Vertical Strike Damage Multipliers:
[list]
[*] Reduced the 1st-stage charged Horizontal Strike Damage Multipliers from 0.81*4 +2.42 to 0.75*4 +2.26.
[*] Reduced the 2nd-stage charged Horizontal Strike Damage Multipliers from 0.64*6 +1.93 to 0.59*6 +1.76.
[*] Reduced the 1st-stage charged Vertical Strike Damage Multipliers from 5.48 to 4.96.
[*] Reduced the 2nd-stage charged Vertical Strike Damage Multipliers from 2.82*2 to 2.48*2.
[/list]
[*] Reduced the damage multiplier of [Cloud Weaver] from (0.76*3+3.8) to (0.7*3+3.48).
[/olist]
[h3]II. Katana[/h3]
[list]
[*] Adjusted the effect when the 4th stage horizontal strike hits standing enemies.
[/list]
[h2]Combat Adjustments[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added a special effect prompt when successfully dodging an enemy's attack.
[*] Optimized the display for damage value text colors when dealing damage.
[/list]
[h2]In-game Adjustments[/h2]
[h3]I. Mechanism Adjustments[/h3]
Added a new mechanism [Treasure Stele]. Interact with it to accept the [Serial Cache Hunt] quest. Follow the clues provided by the Treasure Stele to find all the chests and get rich rewards!

[h2]Out-of-game Adjustments[/h2]
[h3]I. Custom Room[/h3]
Added the following custom room settings:
[list]
[*] Disable Global Kill Log: Disables the kill log in the lower right corner of the screen will be hidden.
[*] Disable Kill Announcement: When enabled, the hero avatar and player name in the kill log will be hidden.
[*] Disable Info of the Killer: When enabled, the hero avatar will be hidden in the killer info, and the player's name will be displayed as the corresponding hero's name.
[*] Disable info of the Kill Leader: When enabled, the kill leader party will be hidden.
[/list]
The above settings are only available in the Survival modes.

[h3]II. Match History[/h3]
Due to the changes to Yama's Abyss, all previous player records will be reset after the update.

[h3]III. Shoes Switch[/h3]
Added a new Shoe cosmetic for the Viper Ning Legendary Outfit [Maple Snowfall].

[h3]IV. Hair Dyeing Page Optimization[/h3]
The camera in the hair dyeing page now allows you to adjust its pitch angle and zoom level.

[h3]V. Baize's Blessing[/h3]
After the update, players can choose to get the Deepwood Legendary Souljade Random Gift after using the [Baize Bless Gift] obtained from the Baize's Blessing.

[h3]VI. Justice Store[/h3]
After the update, players can get the Deepwood Epic Souljade Random Gift and the Deepwood Legendary Souljade Random Gift from the Justice Store.

[h3]VII. Songbird Arena[/h3]
The attributes and skills of heroes in Songbird Arena have been adjusted to match the Solo mode effects.

[h2]Showdown Adjustments[/h2]
[h3]I. Season Challenge[/h3]
[list]
[*] Season Challenges are added to the Showdown Pass. Complete season challenges to accumulate [Showdown Challenge Points] and unlock season challenge titles and rich rewards.
[*] There are [General] season challenges and [Nirriti's Ruins] season challenges. Complete specific [Nirriti's Ruins] challenges to unlock additional game content and basic ability boosts in Nirriti's Ruins.
[/list]
[h3]II. Yama's Abyss Adjustments[/h3]
[list]
[*] Yama's Abyss has been adjusted to a stage-advancing mode that only supports solo challenges.
[*] The Yama's Abyss leaderboard will no longer distinguish between solo and trios. The past Yama's Abyss leaderboards will be merged, and only your highest ranking in both leaderboards will be displayed.
[*] Added a Quick Restart button. Select it in the pause menu to immediately restart the challenge for the current stage.
[*] Added a function to quickly enter the next stage after winning. Interact with the portal in the scene after winning to enter the next stage without quitting.
[/list]
[h3]III. Nirriti's Ruins (formerly Yama's Abyss) Adjustments[/h3]
[list]
[*] Nirriti's Ruins now has four difficulty levels: Normal, Hard, Nightscream, and Legend.
[list]
[*] In Hard levels, Showdown Souljades that can be obtained in other Hard stages have a chance of dropping.
[*] In Nightscream and Legend levels, any Showdown Souljades can drop, and the drop rates are the same for both difficulties.
[/list]
[*] Your Souljades, Sense levels, and Potentials will no longer take effect in Nirriti's Ruins, but the bonuses from hero levels will still apply. In addition, you can complete Season Achievements to obtain Fire Forge bonuses for Nirriti's Ruins.
[*] New effect - Blessing: For some types of Anima Rings, having 4 grants a certain blessing, and having 12 upgrades the blessing, granting an even more powerful effect.
[*] New feature - Nirriti Codex: There is a chance to encounter the Nirriti Codex when completing area quests. The Nirriti Codex can enhance existing Anima Rings, provide new ones, or make the stage content change.
[*] Added a batch of Anima Rings, including several Secret Anima Rings. The new Secret Anima Rings can be obtained through the Nirriti Codex. The values and qualities of some Anima Rings have been readjusted, and some Anima Rings will no longer be available.
[*] Souljades will no longer be available in Nirriti's Ruins. The effects of some Souljades will appear in the form of Blessings or Anima Rings.
[*] Increased the amount of Dark Tide Coins provided by all sources in Nirriti's Ruins (defeating monsters, opening Cursed Chests, abandoning Anima Rings, etc.), but also increased the price of Carved Jades. In addition, the Rift Dealer's refresh function has been removed, but he will sell three types of temporary enhancement items at the same time.
[*] The two types of Zones, Eradicating the Evil and Money Hungry, will no longer appear in the normal process.
[*] Dark Tide Coins can no longer be obtained by abandoning Anima Rings in default cases.
[*] Increased the Health of the Axe Evil-Ent in Nirriti's Ruins and slightly reduced the Health of the Hammer Evil-Ent, Copperclad Staff, Copperclad Hammer, Depth Fiend, and Nerusa.
[/list]
[h3]IV. Souljade Adjustments[/h3]
[list]
[*] All Ultimate Souljades have become Faded Souljades, losing their original effects. They can no longer be obtained or enhanced. Faded Souljades can be reforged into any other Legendary Souljade from Showdown 1.5 by selecting Reborn in the Equip Souljades page. The reborn Souljade will inherit the original Souljade's sub-attributes.

Below is the list of Faded Souljades:
[list]
[*] [Moonbane Control·Unlimited]
[*] [Purified Circle·Assist]
[*] [Rising Tide·Aegis-break]
[*] [Fire Frenzy·Enrage]
[*] [Storm Prison·Aegis-break]
[*] [Titan's Call·Soul Seeking]
[*] [Invisible Assassin·Enrage]
[*] [General's Call·Soul Seeking]
[*] [Mech Mayhem·Load]
[*] [Tai Chi Teleport·Autotrack]

//Dev Note: Considering that heroes' ultimates have relatively less effect on the Showdown battles, we have added some of the Souljades' effects to the heroes' ultimates while removed the Souljades with low pick rate. For compensation, the value of the Ultimates have been enhanced. For more detail, please navigate to [V. Hero Adjustments].

[/list]
[*] The content of the Ultimate Souljade Choice Gift has been changed to Legendary Souljades from Showdown 1.5.
[*] [Detonating Rounds] will be temporarily unavailable. Players who already own this Souljade will not be affected and can continue to develop them.
[*] [Desperation] has been adjusted to only drop in [Toppled Mountains·Nightscream].
[*] Slightly delayed the timing of the freezing effect when the Frostbite is full in [Yushan Shadows].
[*] The effect of the Souljade Attribute [Scorching] has been changed. Now, after countering, your next melee attack will deal extra blaze damage.
The damage multiplier of the [Burn] inflicted by blazes has been increased from 0.11 to 0.25.
[*] Optimized the performance of the damage numbers that pop up when dealing Elemental damage while you have Souljades with Elemental Attributes equipped.
[/list]
[h3]V. Hero Adjustments[/h3]
Reduced how far some heroes move backwards when using Defuse·Solve, making it easier for them to use. (Affected heroes: Viper Ning, Valda Cui, Kurumi and Temulch)

[b]Viper Ning[/b]
During her ultimate [Moonbane Control: Showdown], Viper Ning can move freely and gain an additional 70% damage reduction.

[b]Feria Shen[/b]
The single-shot Aegis-break ability of the swarm in her Ultimate [Mech Mayhem·Showdown] has been adjusted from 25 to 30. In non-cannon mode, the damage multiplier of Bronze Mech is adjusted from 3 to 3.5, and the tenacity reduction ability has been adjusted from 90 to 105.

[b]Tianhai[/b]
[list]
[*] The duration of his Ultimate [Titan's Call: Showdown] is changed from 30 sec to 15 sec.
[*] In Vajra state, when unarmed, the action of releasing skill moves has been adjusted to a punch, with damage multiplier adjusted from 5 to 11, and Tianhai's Aegis-break ability adjusted from 500 to 1100. In addition, it can cause a stagger effect on large enemies.
[*] In Vajra state, the damage multiplier of Vertical Strikes is adjusted from 2 to 2.5, and his Aegis-break ability adjusted from 200 to 75.
[*] In Vajra state, the Counterstrike Combo against large enemies is adjusted to attack combos, with a healing effect upon hit.
[/list]
[b]Temulch[/b]
With his Ultimate [Storm Prison: Showdown], an eye of wind forms in the center of the Prison, periodically pulling enemies within range and reducing their Astral Aegis.

[b]Tarka Ji[/b]
With his Ultimate [Fire Frenzy: Showdown], he can build Rage by attacking enemies.

[b]Kurumi[/b]
With her Ultimate [Purified Circle: Showdown], the Attack of allies in the circle is increased by 20%.

[b]Valda Cui[/b]
Enemies hit by the water spears in her Ultimate [Rising Tide: Showdown] will take additional Astral Aegis damage.

[b]Yueshan[/b]
With his Ultimate [General’s Call: Showdown], the Counterstrike Combo against large enemies is adjusted to a 2-stage attack, and hits will have a healing effect.

[b]Matari[/b]
[list]
[*] When activating her Ultimate [Invisible Assassin: Showdown], the damage multiplier of her skill [Flash: Showdown] is adjusted from 4.5 to 6, with the Aegis-break ability adjusted from 450 to 600.
[*] The healing percentage when dealing damage to enemies during her Ultimate has been adjusted from 40% to 45%.
[*] The Attack bonus obtained after releasing the skill [Flash: Showdown] is adjusted from 40% to 50%.
[/list]
[b]Wuchen[/b]
[list]
[*] The damage multiplier of a single spirit blade in his Ultimate [Tai Chi Teleport: Showdown] is adjusted from 0.53 to 0.75, with the Aegis-break ability adjusted from 53 to 75.
[*] The damage multiplier of a single large spirit blade in his Ultimate [Tai Chi Teleport: Showdown] is adjusted from 5 to 5.4, with the Aegis-break ability adjusted from 500 to 540.
[/list]
[h3]VI. Doom Domain Adjustments[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added Auspicious Omens to the Doom Domain, which will grant heroes various ultra-powerful bonuses. The omens rotate weekly and take effect in all four levels.
[*] After the update, the Doom·Speedrun will be temporarily closed, the rest of the levels in Doom Domain will still be available for you. After Sep 12th, 2024 at 00:00 (UTC) Doom·Speedrun will be reopened.
[/list]
[i]//Dev Note: Currently, the experience in the Doom Domain is too similar to regular levels, causing Doom Speedrun to overlap with Yama's Abyss. Additionally, the high difficulty has led to negative matchmaking experiences. Therefore, we've introduced the new and unique Auspicious Omens to enhance the fun and playability of Doom Domain. We look forward to seeing more diverse playstyles with these Auspicious Omens.[/i]

[h3]VII. Feature Adjustments[/h3]
[b]Fatigue Compensation[/b]
Fatigue Compensation has been moved to the Weekly Quests page, and now must be unlocked. Once you complete Dharma-Ending Ruin on Normal difficulty, you will unlock weekly Fatigue Compensation.

[b]Old Recasting System Removal[/b]
The old Recasting System will be removed from the game as a part of the September 12th Update. We apologize for any inconvenience that this may cause. After the old Recasting System is removed, any remaining Quench Crystals will still be usable with the new Recasting System. A Quench Crystal's value will be equal to that of a Carved Crystal.

[b]Adjustments to Monsters[/b]
[list]
[*] Bosses' Jump Attacks cannot be interrupted by Ultimates or Skills.
[*] Vinemire's Blue Focus Strikes cannot be blocked by Defuse but can be Countered.
[*] Bosses' Blue Focus Attacks have additional auditory cues. 
[/list]
[h2]End of Support for the Xbox One[/h2]
After this update, NARAKA: BLADEPOINT will no longer be supported on the Xbox One, and players will not be able to experience the game on this platform.

Players who played on the Xbox One can still access the game through their player accounts on the Xbox Series X/S or the Xbox App on Windows PC, and all account progress will be saved and switched. 

In recognition of the disruption and inconvenience this brings to players, we will provide transition gifts to all Xbox One players who have switched to other platforms. For full details about this change and gifts, please see:
[url=https://www.narakathegame.com/news/update/20240625/33459_1163041.html]https://www.narakathegame.com/news/update/20240625/33459_1163041.html[/url]

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[h3]I. Hero-related Bugs[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where Kylin Zhang couldn't immediately crouch after stopping charged movement during his Ultimate.
[*] Fixed inconsistencies in the timing required to chain certain skills (such as Kylin Zhang's [Raider's Touch: Choke] and Ziping Yin's special dodge) with quick counters and normal counters.
[*] Fixed an issue where Akos Hu's [Feral Frenzy: Lockdown] movement restriction effect wasn't working on certain hero movement mechanics.
[*] Fixed an issue where Kylin Zhang would enter skill cooldown if interrupted at the moment of using [Raider's Touch: Choke].
[*] Fixed an issue with the visual effects for Tarka Ji's hands displayed to allies while his Ultimate [Fire Frenzy: Extend] was active.
[*] Optimized memory reclamation for Fairyland Penglai on Playstation, reducing the frequency of lag.
[/list]
[h2]Official Tournament[/h2]
[h3]I. NARAKA: BLADEPOINT Koi Cup[/h3]
The 2024 Koi Cup Global Invitational came to a successful conclusion on July 27th, 2024. notes.title: NARAKA: BLADEPOINT Update – Aug 15th, 2024
notes.content:
[h1]Dear players,[/h1]

Starting on August 15th, 2024 at 03:00 (UTC), we will be carrying out maintenance on NARAKA: BLADEPOINT servers. There is no need to log out during this time, and you can continue to play normally while the servers are being updated.

The details for this update are as follows:

[h2]Brand New Content[/h2]
[h3]Limited-time Event: [/h3]
[b]Summer Party[/b]
Event Duration: August 15th, 2024 at 03:00 (UTC) - August 28th, 2024 at 20:00 (UTC)
Window to Claim Rewards: August 28th, 2024 at 20:00 (UTC) - August 31st, 2024 at 20:00 (UTC)

[u]Event Rules[/u]
A cool summer awaits by the sea! A mysterious beach suddenly appeared on Fairyland Penglai, and Hot Potato Counter has also changed...
[olist]
[*] Open Stashes in Survival modes or participate in Showdown or Hot Potato Counter to obtain Popsicles, up to 10 per day.
[*] Consume Popsicles to randomly unlock a location on the event page. You'll get corresponding rewards and unlock a Summer Party comic after unlocking an area. There are 6 areas in total waiting to be unlocked.
[*] Enter the event page for the first time each day to get 1 Watermelon Popsicle. Use the Watermelon Popsicle to specify and unlock any location.
[*] After all 6 areas are unlocked, you can still use Watermelon Popsicles on the event page to get Tae and Spectral Silk awards.
[*] Brand-new decorations on Fairyland Penglai - pool, beach, beach chairs ...... Enjoy the summer party together!
[/olist]
[h2]Hero Adjustments[/h2]
[h3]I. Kylin Zhang[/h3]
[list]
[*] Slightly reduced the airborne height caused by horizontal strikes while his Ultimate is active.
[*] Optimized the timing for canceling charged attacks while Kylin Zhang's Ultimate [Qilin Slash] is active. Moves after each slash can now be canceled in advance.
[*] Optimized the sound effects of the charged attacks [Wrath Slash] under his Ultimate [Qilin Slash: Rend] and optimized how his echo performs when attacked.
[/list]
[i]//Dev Note: Currently, Kylin Zhang is a bit overpowered in group battles with his Ultimate frequently knocking enemies airborne. Additionally, he often loses sight of his enemies because his attacks send enemies too far away. To improve the experience of playing with and against Kylin Zhang, we have slightly reduced the knockback on his attacks while his Ultimate is active.
[/i]
[h3]II. Tarka Ji[/h3]
[list]
[*] After activating the Ultimate, the Rage consumed by Tarka Ji's 2nd-stage dodge (elbow strike) attack has been reduced by 20%.
[/list]
[h3]III. Tianhai[/h3]
[list]
[*] Removed the cooldown on Tianhai's [Jump and Stomp] for all Ultimates. Instead, Tianhai can use [Jump and Stomp] up to 2 times, and can use them one after the other.
[*] Tianhai's [Jump and Stomp] move can now be canceled with a jump.
[/list]
[h3]IV. Yoto Hime[/h3]
[list]
[*] The damage multipliers of the first 3 strikes of Yoto Hime's Ultimates' have been adjusted from 3.0/3.5/4.0 to 3.5/3.5/3.5. The damage multipliers will remain the same as before (3.0/3.5/4.0) when hitting heroes that have transformed.
[*] The damage multipliers of the final three slashes of Yoto Hime's Ultimate variant [Demon Blade: Combo] have been increased from 2.0/2.0/2.0 to 2.2/2.2/2.2.
[/list]
[h3]V. Kurumi[/h3]
[list]
[*] The cooldown of Kurumi's Skill variant [Healing Ray: Guard] has been increased from 20 sec to 22 sec.
[/list]
[h3]VI. Matari[/h3]
[list]
[*] The cooldown of Matari's Skill variant [Flash: Thrust] has been increased from 18 sec to 22 sec.
[*] The damage and recovery multipliers of [Flash: Thrust] while Matari's Ultimate variant [Invisible Assassin: Restore] is active have been reduced. The Skill's damage multiplier has been reduced from 3.5 to 3.0, and the recovery multiplier has been reduced from 2.8 to 2.4.
[/list]
[h3]VII. Lyam Liu[/h3]
[list]
[*] The cooldown of Lyam Liu's Skill variant [Magnet Repel] has been decreased from 28 sec to 27 sec.
[*] The amount of Rage consumed by each use of [Auric Sword]'s Ultimate Skill in Solo mode has been increased from 20% to 30%. Other modes remain unaffected.
[*] The recovery multiplier of [Auric Sword]'s Ultimate Skill's flash move has been increased from 1.5 to 2.1.
[/list]
[i]//Dev Note: In Solo mode, Lyam's ability to disengage with [Auric Sword] allows him create opportunities to counterattack a bit too frequently. Thus, we have increased both his Ultimate's rage consumption and the healing effect that it provides in Solo mode to account for this.[/i]

[h2]Weapon Adjustments[/h2]
[h3]I. Fistblades[/h3]
[list]
[*] Slightly reduced the stagger time caused by the 1st and 2nd stage vertical strikes.
[*] Slightly reduced the stagger time caused by the 2nd stage vertical charged attacks.
[*] Slightly reduced how long the Fistblades' Blue Focus will linger after a charged attack.
[*] Slightly reduced the auto-aim for the Fistblade's airborne horizontal strikes and 2nd stage vertical charged attacks.
[*] Slightly delayed how quickly a player using the Fistblades can start a combo after using a Crouch Attack.
[*] Reduced the damage multiplier of [Cloud Weaver] by 7%.
[/list]
[h2]Store Updates[/h2]
[h3]I. New Packs[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added Zai exclusive Pack [Searing Sun], which contains the Zai Legendary Outfit [Summer Party·Searing Sun], Legendary Dagger Skin [Summer Party·Watermelon Popsicle], Epic Hairstyle [Summer Party·Dazzling Tress] and Legendary Accessory [Summer Party·Quack Quack]. Standard price: 5,000 Gold; Now: 3,200 Gold. Individual cosmetics have their own discounts, but the Pack discount is even bigger!
[*] Added Ziping Yin exclusive Pack [Summer's Serenity], which contains the Ziping Yin Legendary Outfit [Summer Party·Summer's Serenity], Epic Hairstyle [Summer Party·Blossom] and Legendary Accessory [Summer Party·Moonstone Fragrance]. Standard price: 3,500 Gold; Now: 2,600 Gold. Individual cosmetics have their own discounts, but the Pack discount is even bigger!
[/list]
[h2]II. New Discounts[/h2]
[olist]
[*] Valda Cui Legendary Outfit [Creatures Myth·Jingwei]. Standard price: 1,800 Gold; Now: 1,500 Gold.
[*] Dual Blades Legendary Skin [Eggy Party·Fin-isher]. Standard price: 1,500 Gold; Now: 120 Gold.

notes.title: NARAKA: BLADEPOINT Update – Aug 2nd, 2024
notes.content:
[h1]Dear players,[/h1]

The servers of NARAKA: BLADEPOINT will be suspended for maintenance from August 1st, 2024 at 23:00 (UTC) to August 2nd, 2024 at 03:00 (UTC). We suggest you log out in advance and enter the game again after the maintenance.


The details for this update are as follows:

[h2]Brand New Content[/h2]

[h3]I. New Hero: Kylin Zhang[/h3]
[previewyoutube=_jqbiuilutg;full][/previewyoutube]
The Zhang family patriarch, the keeper of immortality's secret, and the transcendent wordless Qilin.
To fulfill his family's destiny, Kylin Zhang ventures across the world in search of lost memories while safeguarding the "Ultimate" of all things.

[h3]II. New Crossover Mechanism[/h3]
1. Ghost Seal: Interact to spawn several Ghostly Hands. Enemies that touch the hands will be silenced and knocked airborne.

2. Bronze Sacred Tree: Interact to create an illusion circle which only affects enemies, inflicting Illusory state on those who stay inside long enough.

3. Green-Eyed Fox: Can be obtained from the Morus' Blessing or Caves in Perdoria. It offers automatic Remains recovery.

[h3]III. Season Exclusive: Aeon Treasure[/h3]
[previewyoutube=0JFSmh8HQNo;full][/previewyoutube]
1. The Aeon Treasure is priced at 360 Gold. Open for a chance to obtain rewards like Kylin Zhang Extreme Outfit [Qilin Guardian] and the Fistblades Extreme Skin [Soul Maw].

2. When equipping [Qilin Guardian], dodging, sprinting and his Ultimate's charging sprint will trigger an exclusive ink cloud effect.

3. Equipping [Soul Maw] changes the special effect of the Souljade [Cloud Weaver]. When the Qilin stretches, its legs will display a Qilin Flame effect.

4. Minimum Guarantee:
[list]
[*] Players are guaranteed to receive at least 1 Red (Extreme) reward during the process of opening at most 100 Treasures. This can be triggered multiple times.​
[*] Red (Extreme) rewards will not repeat until all of them have been obtained.
[*] Wishing Legendary Reward: If you draw an Extreme cosmetic, you can set a Legendary cosmetic which will be guaranteed when you draw a Legendary cosmetic next time. Times of guarantee can stack, but you can only set 1 cosmetic each time.
[/list]
[h3]IV. Limited-time Event: Qilin Descends[/h3]
Swiftly he rides the wind with a raider's touch. A Qilin guards the path as the ancient blade vanquishes foes.

Event Duration: Aug 1, 2024 20:00 (UTC) - Aug 14, 2024 20:00 (UTC).
Redeem the rewards before: Aug 18th, 2024 at 20:00 (UTC)

1. Complete Daily Quests to obtain Kylin Zhang Trial Vouchers and Qilin Gold.
2. Complete Event Quests to obtain Qilin Gold. A new quest can be unlocked only after completing the current one. Quests can only be completed when they become available.
3. Consume Qilin Gold to redeem rewards.

[h2]Hero Adjustments[/h2]
[h3]I. Wuchen[/h3]
1. Skill [Spirit Blades: Shield] has been changed to [Spirit Blades], while retaining its effects.

2. Skill [Spirit Blades: Autotrack] has been changed to [Spirit Blades: Swap], featuring brand new effects.
Create Spirit Blades.
[list]
[*] Unleash blades, and swap positions with the hit enemy.
[*] Can be used under attack.
[/list]
3. Ultimate [Tai Chi Teleport: Switch] has been changed to [Tai Chi Teleport: Blade Storm], featuring brand new effects.
Activate the Ultimate to cast a spell in the aimed direction.
[list]
[*] Can be used twice.
[*] If the spell hits an enemy: the enemy will be struck with a series of spirit blades.
[*] If the spell doesn't hit any enemies: the area of impact will be struck with a series of spirit blades.
[/list]
4. Deleted the Ultimate [Tai Chi Teleport: Portal]

[i]//Dev Note: The skill design for Wuchen has always been a favorite among our team. Wuchen stands out as the only hero with three distinct ultimate abilities. However, we've noticed that Wuchen has a pick rate of just 1.03% in Trios mode, while 0.43% in Duos, and 0.43% in Solo. Among players who picked Wuchen, the skill Spirit Blades is chosen 5.6% of the time, and the ultimate Tai Chi Teleport: Portal is chosen 2.2% of the time. To enhance the experience for dedicated Wuchen fans, we've decided to introduce the new skill variant Spirit Blades: Swap to boost Wuchen's initiative and combat capabilities. Additionally, we're adding the ultimate Tai Chi Teleport: Blade Storm which features an enduring sword rain, giving Wuchen a more aggressive edge than ever before.[/i]

However, we won't completely delete the original Wuchen mechanics. They may reappear in other heroes, items, or even gameplay, combined with new features.

[h3]II. Matari[/h3]
1. Adjustments to the Skill [Flash: Thrust]:
[list]
[*] Matari's Charged Skill moves, and the tap-activated Skills that she gets when her Ultimate is active, will now only interrupt moves with Golden Focus. Furthermore, a Matari player can only cancel charging Matari's Skill by dodging.
[*] Matari's Defensive Focus when charging is now equal to Golden Weapon Focus.
[*] Slightly reduced the strike width of this skill when her Ultimate is active.
[*] Reduced the extra recovery effect of this skill upon hitting the target by 60% when the Ultimate [Invisible Assassin] is activated.
[*] Optimized the visual and audio effects when the skill is released.
[/list]
2. Adjustments to the Ultimate [Invisible Assassin: Restore]:
[list]
[*] Removed the Attack boost granted after [Flash].
[*] Reduced the duration of Invisible granted after releasing the skill or [Flash] from 3 seconds to 1.5 seconds.
[/list]
[i]//Dev Note: Matari's new skill and Ultimate variant offer substantial offensive power while maintaining impressive survivability. The multiple consecutive dashes and extended the duration of Invisible make it challenging for opponents to track Matari's movements. Therefore, we've offset this by reducing some of the additional offensive and survivability boosts and shortening the duration of Invisible to make it easier for opponents to track Matari.[/i]

[h3]III. Lyam Liu[/h3]
1. The flash move in the Ultimate [Metal Fusion] can now only interrupt Golden Weapon Focus.

[h3]IV. Hadi[/h3]
In Solo and Duos modes, the max duration of Hadi's Ultimate has been adjusted to 20 seconds, while in Trios mode, it remains at 25 seconds.

[h2]Weapon Adjustments[/h2]

[h3]I. Fistblades[/h3]
[list]
[*] Reduced the max number of charge stages from three to two.
[*] Now, after using Wild Sweep, charging can immediately enter the final stage.
[*] Adjusted the timing for canceling the second stage of a charged horizontal strike.
[*] Slightly reduced the stagger duration caused by hitting enemies with the second stage of both horizontal strikes and vertical strikes, as well as charged horizontal strikes.
[/list]
[i]//Dev Note: Wild Sweep serves both to reposition and to improve the charge stage. However, repeatedly using Wild Sweep can lead to excessive Stamina consumption, as well as creating decision-making challenges for players. Therefore, we have simplified the process of improving the charge stage with Wild Sweep, allowing Fistblades to perform powerful moves more straightforwardly. Additionally, we have adjusted the damage of charged strikes accordingly.
 
We have reduced the stagger duration of certain moves to lessen the continuous pressure on enemies. The timing for cancelling the second stage of charged horizontal strikes has also been adjusted to enhance the flexibility and strategy of using Fistblades.[/i]

[h3]II. Nunchucks[/h3]
[list]
[*] Adjusted the damage multiplier of Vertical Strike's 1st charging stage from 3.83 to 4.64.
[*] Adjusted the damage multiplier of Dragon Flurry from 0.57*8+0.5*4+0.4*5 to 0.7*8+0.24*4+0.38*5.
[/list]
[h3]III. Heng Sword[/h3]
[list]
[*] Adjusted the damage multiplier of Vertical Strike's 1st charging stage from 2.65*2 to 2.47*2.
[*] Adjusted the damage multiplier of Vertical Strike's 2nd charging stage from 3.22*2 to 3.01*2.
[*] Adjusted the damage multiplier of Charged Horizontal Strike's damage multiplier from 4.68 to 4.37.
[/list]
[h3]IV. Polesword[/h3]
[list]
[*] Adjusted the damage multiplier of Vertical Strike's 1st charging stage from 5.33 to 5.08.
[*] Adjusted the damage multiplier of Vertical Strike's 2nd charging stage from 6.40 to 6.04.
[/list]
[h3]V. Single-edged Weapon[/h3]
Slightly increased in the timeframe in which Grappling Hooks can be used when Crouching + Vertical Strike.

[h3]VI. Bow[/h3]
Adjusted the damage ratio from 60% to 40% within the 0 - 12m range.

[h3]VII. Unarmed[/h3]
[list]
[*] Slightly reduced the stagger duration of enemies hit by a Charged Vertical Strike.
[*] Slight delayed the timing for a possible interruption to a charged Vertical Strike.
[/list]
[i]//Dev Note:
At the start of each season, we make necessary adjustments to weapons based on their performance in the previous season. Considering that the Koi Cup is using the initial version of the Season 13, these adjustments have been made to ensure fairness and stability in the competition.

Polesword has been dominating in Duos and Trios, and took second place in Solo for two seasons. Heng Sword was at the top in Solo last season and third in Duos and Trios. The Nunchucks performed poorly in all modes. Additionally, the Bow's extra stagger effect upon headshots provided excessive benefit. Therefore, we've adjusted their damage values while maintaining the same gameplay.[/i]

[h2]Souljade Adjustments[/h2]
[h3]I. Heng Sword Souljade[/h3]
Reduced the damage multiplier of [Aurora Burst] from 2.42+0.47*12 to 2.25+0.45*12.

[h3]II. Fistblades Souljade[/h3]
[list]
[*] [Cloud Weaver] now changes the second stage of charged horizontal strikes instead of the third stage.
[*] Reduced the damage multiplier of [Cloud Weaver] from 0.98*3+4.4 to 0.82*3+4.09.
[*] Optimized the effective attack range of [Cloud Weaver].
[*] Temporarily removed the Souljade [Mistwalker].
[/list]
[h3]III. Nunchucks Souljades[/h3]
Adjusted the damage multiplier of [Dragon Roar] from 0.5*8+0.33*6+0.67+1.33 to 0.7*8+0.16*6+0.64+1.28.

[h2]In-game Adjustments[/h2]
[h3]I. Feature Optimizations[/h3]
[b]Weapon Imprint[/b]
Use 108 Imprint Roller to imprint a special effect from a Souljade special effect from an already owned Extreme Weapon Skin onto a Legendary Weapon Skin of the corresponding type. 

[b]Weapon Interface Optimizations[/b]
Optimized the display of the Dual Halberds in the Weapon interface, Store and other interfaces.

[h3]II. Optimization to White Tiger's Prowess[/h3]
Unified White Tiger's Prowess's Melee Resist and Ranged Resist into Damage Reduction.

[h3]III. Hot Potato Counter[/h3]
[Nunchucks] and [Katana] are now included in players' initial Weapon Bag and will no longer drop in the Exquisite Vessel.

[h3]IV. Realm of Yang Adjustments[/h3]
Battle duration has been prolonged. In Solo mode, the time limit has been changed from 75 sec to 105 sec, and in Duos and Trios modes, it has been changed from 105 sec to 120 sec.

[h2]Out-of-game Adjustments[/h2]
[h3]I. Adjustments to Custom Rooms[/h3]
Custom Rooms are no longer unlocked by default. New players must reach Level 20 to unlock them, while existing accounts will remain unaffected.

[h3]II. Inventory[/h3]
Type sorting is now introduced to Inventory.

[h3]III. Lobby Music[/h3]
New background music featuring Time Raiders is now played in the Lobby page.

[h3]IV. Justice Chamber[/h3]
Removing players from your Justice Chamber will deduct the Season Points they have offered within the week.

[h3]V. Shoes Switch[/h3]
Added new Shoe cosmetic for Viper Ning Extreme Outfit [Original Maiden].

[h2]Showdown Adjustments[/h2]
[h3]I. Combat Adjustments[/h3]
1. Reduced the pullback time for [Matron of Yushan]'s chain sword during her second stage.
2. Improved the visual effect warnings for [Matron of Yushan]'s aerial moves.

[h2]Client Optimization[/h2]
1. Optimized required storage space for models.
2. Optimized rendering performance while using D3D12.

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[h3]I. Weapon-related Bugs[/h3]
Fixed an issue where the Katana's animation was displayed incorrectly upon a successful counter.

[h2]Tournament[/h2]
The 2024 NBPL Spring Split concluded successfully on June 10, 2024. We thank all participants for their exciting matches and congratulate [CD.GG] for winning the 2024 NBPL Spring Split - Trios Champion and [OUG.Mike] for securing the 2024 NBPL Spring Split - Solo Champion.

1. With this update, the Leaderboard - Tournament Champions now features entries for [CD.GG] and [OUG.Mike].

2. The three players from [CD.GG] - [CD.GG.330], [CD.GG.Lxm], and [CD.GG.Cjs] - have been awarded the exclusive title "2024 NBPL Spring Split - Trios Champion" and their "Personal Highlights" page now displays the "2024 NBPL Spring Split - Trios Champion" trophy.

3. [OUG.Mike] has been awarded the exclusive title "2024 NBPL Spring Split - Solo Champion" and their "Personal Highlights" page now displays the "2024 NBPL Spring Split - Solo Champion" trophy.

Congratulations once again to these outstanding players for achieving the pinnacle of tournament success. We look forward to their continued achievements in future competitions!

[h2]Store Updates[/h2]
[h3]I. New Packs[/h3]
1. Added Kylin Zhang exclusive Pack [Wild Hoodie], which contains Legendary Outfit [Time Raiders·Wild Hoodie], Heng Sword Legendary Skin [Time Raiders·Black-Gold Sword] and Kylin Zhang Hero Theme [The Awakening Qilin]. Standard price: 4,100 Gold; Now: 2,300 Gold. Individual cosmetics have their own discounts, but the Pack discount is even bigger!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36350327/abf4c28632bca1a7fb45546e6b4c932545cf6d32.jpg[/img]
2. Added Kylin Zhang exclusive Pack [Uncanny Secrets], which contains Legendary Outfit [Uncanny Secrets] and the Legendary Hairstyle [Placid]. Standard price: 2,600 Gold; Now: 1,950 Gold. Individual cosmetics have their own discounts, but the Pack discount is even bigger!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36350327/aa766fedf82428ed0bc9903fa2da4813962a7fa3.jpg[/img]

Standard price: 3,800 Gold; Now: 2,200 Gold. Single items are discounted, and you get even more discounts when you purchase a Pack.

notes.title: NARAKA: BLADEPOINT Update – July 18th, 2024
notes.content:
[h1]Dear Players,[/h1]

The servers of NARAKA: BLADEPOINT will be suspended for maintenance from July 17th, 2024 at 23:00 (UTC) to July 18th, 2024 at 03:00 (UTC). We suggest you log out in advance and enter the game again after the maintenance.

The details for this update are as follows:

[h2]Brand New Content[/h2]
[h3]I. Aeon Season's Immortal War is now available[/h3]
After reaching Platinum, players can participate in Immortal War, competing across new ranks and winning Season rewards. These rewards will be awarded based on the highest rank attained in Immortal War (Solo, Duos, or Trios).
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36350327/62ff56073b4c2b1aa17fae5f5e8e85171c4fb5cb.png[/img]
If you make it to the Top 500 in the Immortal War, you'll be on the Immortal Leaderboard. It's updated every Monday at 04:00 (UTC). Being in the Top 500 earns you a special title. At the end of the season, being on the leaderboard or having a title gets you an avatar.

In addition, the Top 3 players of the last tally will be awarded exclusive Hero Badges.

[h3]II. Limited-time Events:[/h3]
[b]1. Echoes of Qilin[/b]
The silent Kylin, transcendent and peerless. Protected by sacred blood, all evil is repelled.

Event Duration: Jul 17, 2024 20:00 (UTC) - Aug 1, 2024 20:00 (UTC).
Redeem the rewards before: Aug 8th, 2024 at 20:00 (UTC)

[u]Event Rules[/u]
[olist]
[*] By completing Daily Quests, players can obtain Kylin's Token: Memory Shard and have an additional chance to obtain one of the following rewards: Tae, Spectral Silk, Peerless Treasure Choice Gift, Hero Coin, Legendary Trial Card, Aeon Coins. 
[*] There are 4 Items, which can be unlocked with the corresponding Memory Shards.
[*] You can claim rewards by unlocking any of the four Items. Some rewards will be available after the new version is released, so stay tuned.
[*] Each day, you can help a player obtain a Memory Shard (by tapping the "Share Kylin's Token" in the contact list, selecting a Memory Shard, and confirming to share it). You won't consume your Memory Shards by doing so. However, each player can only be given one Memory Shard per day.
[*] After the event ends, you can still claim unlocked rewards on the event page within the remaining time to claim rewards. But you can no longer complete Quests or Share Kylin's Tokens during that period. Once the Tokens expire, they can be disposed into 160 Tae each in the Inventory.
[/olist]

[b]2. We Are The Champions[/b]
Event Duration: July 18th, 2024 at 03:00 (UTC) - July 28th, 2024 at 20:00 (UTC)

[u]Event Rules[/u]
Fight to the pinnacle! Collect TE Team's 2023 NARAKA: BLADEPOINT J Cup Trios Champion exclusive cosmetics from the "Champion Forged" series. As your collection of these cosmetics grows, you can earn exclusive rewards.

[b]3. Koi Ascension[/b]
Event Duration: July 21st, 2024 at 20:00 (UTC) - July 27th, 2024 at 20:00 (UTC)
Window to Claim Rewards: July 21st, 2024 at 20:00 (UTC) - July 30th, 2024 at 20:00 (UTC)

[u]Event Rules[/u]
[olist]
[*] The 2024 Koi Cup Global Invitational is in full swing! Earn [Jade Koi] by completing daily quests, and [Koi Tokens] by watching or predicting matches. Use these items to redeem rare in-game rewards in the [Redeem Rewards] and [Redeem Gifts] sections.
[*] The [Redeem Gifts] page offers 2 tiers of gifts, each requiring specified amounts of both [Jade Koi] and [Koi Tokens] for redemption.
[*] Participate in streaming platforms' match-watching events during the Koi Cup Finals from July 26th to July 27th (UTC+8). Complete the quests to earn Koi Tokens. Each player can earn up to 10 tokens per match day. (Platforms include Twitch.)
[*] From July 22th to July 27th (GMT+8), participate in match prediction events and earn more [Koi Tokens], which can be exchanged for even more rewards.
[/olist]

[h3]III. New Feature: Shoes Switch[/h3]
1. Introduced the Shoes Switch feature. On the outfit preview page, you can switch shoe appearances by tapping the Switch Shoes button.

2. The initial batch of cosmetics with switchable shoes includes:
[list]
[*] Matari's Extreme Outfit [Wasteland Beauty]
[*] Viper Ning's Legendary Outfit [Serpent Sacrifice]
[*] Viper Ning's Legendary Outfit [The Matron's Fetters]
[*] Viper Ning's Legendary Outfit [The Clear Eye]
[/list]
[h2]Hero Adjustments[/h2]
[b]I. Matari[/b]
[list]
[*] The skill [Flash: Thrust] can now be interrupted with a jump, crouch, or dodge during the thrust.
[*] When the Ultimate is activated, the skill [Flash: Thrust] can now interrupt Golden Focus instead of Blue Focus by tapping the cast button.
[*] Optimized the sound and visual effects when [Flash: Thrust] is fully charged.
[*] Adjusted the usage of the [Flash] move of the Ultimate [Invisible Assassin: Restore] to 4 times in Trios mode and 3 times in Duos mode, and increased the Ultimate duration from 25 seconds to 30 seconds.
[*] Optimized the camera angle when using the [Flash] move of the Ultimate [Invisible Assassin: Restore], so the camera now aligns with the character's facing direction.
[/list]
[h2]Weapon Adjustments[/h2]
[h3]I. Unified Adjustments for Melee Weapons[/h3]
Unified the height of the grappling strike for all melee weapons.

[h3]II. Fistblades[/h3]
[list]
[*] The attack range of its charged horizontal strikes has been slightly increased.
[*] The timing to interrupt the third stage of both its horizontal and vertical strikes has been slightly brought forward.
[*] The timing to strike after its charged vertical strikes has been slightly brought forward.
[*] Optimized the sound effects for the Wild Sweep.
[*] Optimized the animation for charged horizontal and vertical strikes while sprinting.
[/list]
[h2]Souljade Adjustments[/h2]
[h3]I. Fistblades Souljade[/h3]
[b]Increased the attack range of [Cloud Weaver].[/b]
Reduced the damage multiplier of [Cloud Weaver] from (1.03*3+4.66) to (0.98*3+4.4).

[h2]In-game Adjustments[/h2]
[h3]I. Mechanism Adjustments[/h3]
Optimized the Wishing Well: When you throw in a weapon, you will get a weapon, armor, or Souljade of a random quality.

[h3]II. Sound Effect Optimization[/h3]
1. Optimized the sound effects triggered when the Grappling Hook hits different objects.
2. Optimized some ambient sound effects in Perdoria.

[h3]III. Perdoria Adjustments[/h3]
1. Removed the Health reduction effect from the Carnivorous Yam.
2. Increased the number of items available in the Fortune Land.

[h3]IV. In-game Adjustments[/h3]
Slightly increased the number of stashes at medium-sized resource points on The Morus Isle.

[h2]Out-of-game Adjustments[/h2]
[h3]I. New Feature for Custom Room - Martial Artist Solo[/h3]
Added a new feature to Custom Room - Martial Artist Solo: [Attrition Warfare Mode]. When enabled, each player selects a certain number of hero-weapon combinations. During battles, the winner retains their current hero and the remaining Armor and Health while the loser deploys a new hero. This continues until all of one party's heroes are defeated.

[h3]II. Hair Dyeing Adjustments[/h3]
[list]
[*] After the update, when a customization code is generated, it will save both the face customization and hair dye data.
[*] After the update, players can also generate a customization code on the hair dyeing page. Codes generated here will include both the face customization and hair dye data.
[*] When using a customization code, using it on the customization page will import face customization data, while using it on the hairstyle page will import hair dyeing data. Note: Applying a hair dyeing preset in this way also costs Dye Cream.
[/list]
[h3]III. Chamber Scoreboard[/h3]
To receive the title, you must have logged into the game at least once during the 7 days leading up to the scoreboard settlement.


[h2]Client Optimizations[/h2]
[list]
[*] (PC, Xbox) Direct3D 12 added VRS optimization settings to improve performance during special effects rendering.
[*] (Xbox) Improved the speed of shadow rendering.
[*] (Xbox) Optimized the skinned performance of characters.
[*] (PS) Optimized static scenery rendering, reducing the main thread's CPU expenditure.
[/list]
[h2]Store Updates[/h2]
[h3]I. New Packs[/h3]
[olist]
[*] Newly added Ziping Yin exclusive Pack [Ethereal Glow], including Legendary Outfit [Champion Forged·Ethereal Glow], Legendary Hairstyle [Champion Forged·Sandalwood], Legendary Accessory [Champion Forged·Shimmer Wings] and [Champion Forged·Shimmer Tail]. Standard price: 4,400 Gold; Now: 2,880 Gold. Single items are discounted, and you get even more discounts when you purchase a Pack.
[*] Newly added Yueshan exclusive Pack [Shepherd of Torrents], including Legendary Outfit [Champion Forged·Shepherd of Torrents], Legendary Hairstyle [Champion Forged·Scales], Legendary Accessory [Champion Forged·Dragon Horns]. Standard price: 3,800 Gold; Now: 2,200 Gold. Single items are discounted, and you get even more discounts when you purchase a Pack.
[*] Newly added Takeda exclusive Pack [Wind Guardian], including Legendary Outfit [Champion Forged·Wind Guardian], Legendary Hairstyle [Champion Forged·Pride], Katana Legendary Skin [The Breaker·Dazzling Sun]. Standard price: 4,100 Gold; Now: 2,400 Gold. Single items are discounted, and you get even more discounts when you purchase a Pack.
[*] Newly added Temulch exclusive Pack [Dire Omen], including Legendary Outfit [Champion Forged·Dire Omen], Legendary Accessory [Champion Forged·Dark Lord's Crown]. Standard price: 3,000 Gold; Now: 1,950 Gold. Single items are discounted, and you get even more discounts when you purchase a Pack.
[/olist]
[h3]II. New Discounts[/h3]
[olist]
[*] Newly added Dual Halberds Legendary Skin [Dragon Vanquisher]. Standard price: 1,500 Gold; Now: 1,250 Gold.
[*] Newly added Spear Legendary Skin [Champion Forged·Dark Lord's Scepter]. Standard price: 1,500 Gold; Now: 1,250 Gold.
[*] Newly added Ziping Yin Legendary Pose [Champion Forged·Aetherwing]. Standard price: 800 Gold; Now: 600 Gold.
[*] Newly added Yueshan Legendary Pose [Champion Forged·Heaven and Earth]. Standard price: 800 Gold; Now: 600 Gold.
[*] Newly added Takeda Legendary Pose [Champion Forged·Evilbreaker]. Standard price: 800 Gold; Now: 600 Gold.
[*] Newly added Temulch Legendary Pose [Champion Forged·Vastview]. Standard price: 800 Gold; Now: 600 Gold.
[/olist]
[h3]III. New Items in Spectral Silk Store[/h3]
Newly added Takeda Legendary Accessory [Champion Forged·Feathered Victory] with a price of 12,000 Spectral Silk.

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[h3]I. Hero-related Bug Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue with Zai's Ultimate weapon, the [Chain Scythe], where the direction that the character was facing was not correctly adjusted during certain counter situations.
[*] Fixed an issue with Matari's [Flash: Thrust] that occasionally led to abnormal healing.
[/list]
[h3]II. Weapon-related Bug Fixes[/h3]
Fixed an issue where using certain moves under trees could result in abrupt interruptions.

[h3]III. Combat-related Bug Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed the issue of incorrect animations when switching weapons under certain conditions.
[*] Fixed the issue of a miscalculated staggering duration when being hit while getting up from the ground.
[/list]
[h3]IV. Scene-related Bug Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Optimized and fixed most map issues in Perdoria.
[*] Fixed an issue where players were improperly teleported to the Emperor's Tomb.
[/list]
