notes.title: NARAKA: BLADEPOINT Update – May 9th, 2024
notes.content:
[h1]Dear players,[/h1]

The servers of NARAKA: BLADEPOINT will be suspended for maintenance from May 8th, 2024 at 23:00 (UTC) to May 9th, 2024 at 03:00 (UTC). We suggest you log out in advance and enter the game again after the maintenance.
The details for this update are as follows:

[h2]Brand New Content[/h2]
[h3]I. New Hero: Lyam Liu[/h3]
[previewyoutube=wGUHaG4zYfA;full]https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=wGUHaG4zYfA&t=9s[/previewyoutube]
The century-old furnace in Northwestern Fortuna has forged numerous gold and stones, also fostering the metal power passed down through generations of the Liu family.

Lyam Liu never believes in natural talent; he knows that only a hundred times of practice leads to perfection.
 

[h3]II. Season Exclusive: Tenacity Treasure[/h3]
[previewyoutube=oopyxmPNdbQ;full]https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=oopyxmPNdbQ[/previewyoutube]
The Tenacity Treasure is priced at 360 Gold. Open this treasure for a chance to obtain rewards like the Kurumi Extreme Outfit [Sakura Angel] and the Dual Halberds Extreme Skin [Startling Reach].
[list]
[*] While the Outfit [Sakura Angel] is equipped, recovery effects, jumping, and using Kurumi's Skills or Ultimates that heal continuously will create a cherry blossom effect.
[*] While the Skin [Startling Reach] is equipped, special effects will appear when standing still or while walking slowly, and when charging [Cloudbreaker] attacks.
[/list]
[u]Minimum Guarantee:[/u]
[olist]
[*] Players are guaranteed to receive at least 1 Red (Extreme) reward during the process of opening at most 100 Treasures. This can be triggered multiple times.​
[*] Red (Extreme) rewards will not repeat until all of them have been obtained.
Wishing Legendary Reward: If you draw an Extreme cosmetic, you can set a Legendary cosmetic which will be guaranteed when you draw a Legendary cosmetic next time. Times of guarantee can stack, but you can only set 1 cosmetic each time.
[/olist]

[h3]III. Limited-time Event: Golden Radiance[/h3]
Tempered fortitude transmutes to gold; wholehearted dedication ascends to the apogee.
Event Duration: 8 May, 2024 20:00 (UTC) - 22 May, 2024 20:00 (UTC)
[u]Event Rules:[/u]
[olist]
[*] Complete Daily Quests to obtain Lyam Liu Trial Vouchers and Azure Rings.
[*] Complete Event Quests to obtain Azure Rings. A new quest can be unlocked only after completing the current one. Quests can only be completed when they become available.
[*] Consume Azure Rings to redeem rewards.
[/olist]

[h3]IV. Limited-time Event: Forged Legend[/h3]
Event Duration: May 8, 2024 20:00 (UTC) - Jun 5, 2024 20:00 (UTC)
Event Rules:
1. Players can complete eight different types of quests to earn event points Auric Emblem and unlock event rewards.
2. The event's quests are spread over four weeks, with a new quest stage opening each week. When progressing to the next stage of quests, the quest count from the previous stage will be carried over.
3. Completing quests in each stage will reward event points Auric Emblem.

[h2]Hero Adjustments[/h2]
[h3]I. Tianhai[/h3]
[olist]
[*] Shortened the recovery frames for Skills and Ultimate stomps in Vajra state. Optimized the direction and height of the airborne effect from Vajra's stomp.
[*] Relocated the weak spot for the Ultimate [Titan's Call: Restore]. After transformation, the weak spot will be fixed to the head.
[*] Removed the Skill [Divine Bell: Blast].
[*] Removed the Ultimate [Titan's Call: Support].
[/olist]
[i]//Dev Note: Previously, the stomp move of Titan's Call posed a low threat to enemies. To address this, we've adjusted its recovery frames and enhanced its power. This allows Titan to execute combos of horizontal strikes and grabs, increasing its threat in close combat.[/i]

[h3]II. Tessa[/h3]
[olist]
[*] Slightly increased the speed for [Tail Strike: Trap] to generate the Tailglow Zone after Foxfire bullets hit the environment.
[*] Redesigned the Ultimate [Enchant: Group Prey] in the following ways:

[list]
[*] It now consumes 55% Rage to release, and the shockwave from [Enchant: Group Prey] no longer ignores dodge.
[*] Enemies must approach and interact with the Soul Vessel within 6 seconds to reclaim their soul. Failure to do so will result in Health loss. This loss significantly restores Tessa's Health (originally the Ultimate variant [Enchant: Bite]'s effect).
[/list]
[*] Extended the duration for Rage regen inhibition following the cast of [Enchant] and its derived Ultimates from 11 to 13 seconds.
[*] Reduced the invincibility duration for the skill [Tail Strike]. The invincible state now doesn't persist throughout the entire move.
[*] Removed the Skill [Tail Strike: Repel].
[*] Removed the Ultimate [Enchant: Bite].
[/olist]
[i]//Dev Note: Tessa's Ultimate is now being cast too frequently during battles, so we've slightly extended the Rage regen inhibition period to bring its usage more in line with our intentions.[/i]

[h3]III. Hadi[/h3]
[olist]
[*] Redesigned the skill [Mechanical Arm] in the following ways:

[list]
[*] Now Hadi can aim and launch the mechanical right arm, pulling hit enemies to him.
[*] Hold the Skill button to aim, during which a left-click (horizontal strike button) triggers the default effect.
[*] When the mechanical arm reaches its maximum distance or hits an enemy, right-click (vertical strike button) to pull Hadi to its position and trigger an explosion.
[/list]
[*] The Ultimate [Aerial Ascent] now also deploys the Mechanical Cube (originally the Ultimate variant [Aerial Ascent: Rescue]'s effect).
[*] Adjusted the Ultimate [Aerial Ascent] and its variant [Aerial Ascent: Blaze]:

[list]
[*] The duration has been adjusted to 25 seconds for both.
[*] Slightly reduced the recovery frames for the 1st and 2nd stages of charged attacks in the flight state.
[/list]
[*] Adjusted the damage dealt by the 1st, 2nd, and 3rd stages of the charged attacks from [Aerial Ascent] in the flight state from 1.8/2.7/3.2 to 2/2.8/3.4.
[*] Adjusted the damage dealt by the 1st, 2nd, and 3rd stages of the charged attacks from [Aerial Ascent: Blaze] in the flight state from 1.8/2.7/2.8 to 2/2.8/3.2.
[*] Removed the Skill [Mechanical Arm: Pursuit].
[*] Removed the Ultimate [Aerial Ascent: Rescue].
[/olist]
[h2]Weapon Adjustments[/h2]
[h3]I. Greatsword[/h3]
[olist]
[*] Increased the attack range of the first move of Rockfall Slash.
[*] After executing a horizontal or vertical strike, or a slide horizontal strike, a long press on the horizontal strike will now initiate a horizontal strike charge.
[/olist]
[h2]Souljade Adjustments[/h2]
[h3]I. Spear Souljade[/h3]
[olist]
[*] Shortened [Erudition]'s startup frames, changed the focus level of the two stages of follow-up strikes to Purple Focus, and reduced the damage multipliers from 1.73*4 to 1.5*4.
[*] [Spear Storm]'s startup frames can now be interrupted by dodging.
[/olist]
[h3]II. Upgradable Souljade Adjustments[/h3]
[olist]
[*] Reduced the Spear Souljade [Erudition & Spear Storm] upgrade condition to 4 times.
[*] Reduced the Repeating Crossbow Souljade [Venom Tip & Barbed Bolts] upgrade condition to 10 times.
[*] Reduced the Repeating Crossbow Souljade [Curative Bolts & Healing Bolts] upgrade condition to 10 times.
[*] Reduced the Pistol Souljade [Quick Charge & Thundercall] upgrade condition to 10 times.
[*] Reduced the Bow Souljade [Fire Arrows & Target Lock] upgrade condition to 3 times.
[*] Reduced the Musket Souljade [Slowshot & Sunwing Shot] upgrade condition to 3 times.
[*] Reduced the Melee Souljade [Assault·Smolder] upgrade condition to 6 times.
[*] Reduced upgrade condition of the Nunchucks Souljade [Trigger & Lock Breaker] to 1 time.
[/olist]
[h2]In-game Adjustments[/h2]
[h3]I. Feature Optimizations[/h3]
Increased the queue size for Heroes Assemble to 6 players.

[h3]II. Hot Potato Counter[/h3]
[olist]
[*] Optimized the victory conditions, with the number of rounds won now playing a pivotal role in determining the winner.
[*] Introduced a Final Round feature: when only two players from opposing teams are left, the playable area will be reduced.
[/olist]

[h3]III. Collection Levels[/h3]
1. Expanded the collection level certification ranks and updated the new rank icons. The current ranks:
[list]
[*] Walk-in I: 0-4,999
[*] Walk-in II: 5,000-19,999
[*] Walk-in III: 20,000-49,999
[*] Frequent Visitor I: 50,000-99,999
[*] Frequent Visitor II: 100,000-159,999
[*] Frequent Visitor III: 160,000-239,999
[*] Esteemed Guest I: 240,000-319,999
[*] Esteemed Guest II: 320,000-399,999
[*] Esteemed Guest III: 400,000-479,999
[*] Esteemed Guest IV: 480,000-559,999
[*] Collector I: 560,000-639,999
[*] Collector II: 640,000-719,999
[*] Collector III: 720,000-799,999
[*] Collector IV: 800,000-879,999
[*] Connoisseur I: 880,000 and above
[/list]
2. Newly added [The Nine Songs] Collections. Collecting the set of cosmetics to earn Dynastic Treasure Choice Gift, Peerless Treasure Choice Gift and more rewards.

[h2]Out-game Adjustments[/h2]
[h3]I. Star-Collection Auto Restyle[/h3]
[olist]
[*] On the Star-Collection Restyle screen, click the "Auto Restyle" to show Auto Restyle settings.
[*] After you have configured your Constellation Locks, Restyle Objectives, Restyle Items, and confirmed these settings, the system will automatically Restyle accordingly.

[h3]II. Pack interface has been updated with recommended packs and optimized browsing experience.[/h3]

[list]
[*] Lock Constellation: This allows you to lock Constellations. Locked Constellations cannot have Restyle Objectives. You can also choose to automatically roll back to the previous state. Once enabled, each time the Restyle fails to complete any objective, it will automatically consume a Rollback Orb to roll back once.
[*] Restyle Objective: You can set Restyle Objectives for each Constellation. Each Constellation supports up to 4 selectable objectives based on its unlocking status and attributes. These include: No Objective, Unlock Constellation, Legendary or Extreme Number, and Extreme Number.
[*] Restyle Item: You can view and purchase Restyle Items, and decide whether to automatically consume Spectral Silk or Gold to purchase items when they are insufficient.
[/list]
[*] During Auto Restyle, you can adjust the speed to [1x Speed] or [2x Speed].
[*] Upon completing any objective, Auto Restyle pauses for timely adjustment of Restyle Objectives. Once all preset objectives are achieved, Auto Restyle concludes.
[/olist]

[h2]Showdown Adjustments[/h2]
[h3]I. Preview of the Changes to Souljades Recast[/h3]
In future updates, we plan to make changes to the Souljade recasting system (specifics will come in future update notices). Some of the general changes that we intend to make are as follows:

[b]The recasting of Souljades will no longer be restricted by the attributes of the material Souljades. [/b]
Instead, Epic and Legendary Souljades will be decomposed into a general material (in different quantities), which can then be used for recasting.

[b]There will be 2 types of recasting: [Attribute Type Recasting] and [Attribute Value Recasting]. Players can choose any attribute on a Souljade and recast its type or its value.[/b]
During the new system's initial phase, the old and new recast systems will coexist for a limited time.
We hope that in the upcoming seasons of Showdown, players can have more time to experiment with various Souljade builds with the new recasting system, where we aim to make the process more affordable and reduce the influence of luck, ensuring more promising results from recasting. We hope you can feel more at ease when trying out the new effects from the new Souljade recasting.

[h3]II. Combat Adjustments[/h3]
[olist]
[*] Reduced the staggering duration from [Axe Evil-Ent]'s Blue Focus lunge strike.
[*] Extended the startup frames for non-Focus melee strikes of [Bow Evil-Ent] and [Ocean Yaksa], along with [Bronzoid Swarm]'s Blue Focus melee strikes.
[/olist]

[h3]III. Stage Adjustments[/h3]
[olist]
[*] Adjusted the attributes of enemies in Eventide Ember·Normal, and the monster lineups for the second and third strongholds.
[*] The three strongholds now appear in the order indicated by the guide.
[/olist]

[h3]IV. Yama's Abyss Adjustments[/h3]
[olist]
[*] Adjusted the monster lineups in some Hard-level Zones, slightly reducing the challenge difficulty.
[*] Tweaked the algorithm of the Rift Dealer selling Souljades. Now, in most cases, the Rift Dealer will sell at least one of the Souljades that the player carried during the preparation phase.
[*] Increased the number of shop areas and Hard-level areas in the Void Space.
[/olist]

[h2]Function Optimizations[/h2]
[h3]I. Client Optimizations[/h3]
[list]
[*] Intel XeSS has been updated to version 1.3, optimizing AI models. This will offer both more detailed reconstructed images and better anti-aliasing, while simultaneously reducing image retention and making images more stable.
[*] Newly added graphics levels: Super Performance, Ultra Quality +, and Native Anti-Aliasing
This allows for better performance while maintaining visual quality. This expands the number of graphics cards supported by XeSS, meaning that all graphics cards that can support Shader Model 6.4 can also use XeSS.
[*] Adjusted FSR's algorithm and parameter configuration, significantly improving FSR2 and FSR3 display effects. The improvement will be most pronounced at low resolutions.
[/list]

[h3]II. In-game[/h3]
Fixed the issue where using a controller to cancel the cast of a Hero's Ultimate skill may accidentally trigger the use of the Weapon Repair Kit.

[h2]Shop Updates[/h2]
[h3]I. New Packs[/h3]
Added Lyam Liu exclusive Pack [Midnight Gilt], which contains the Legendary Outfit [Midnight Gilt], Heng Sword Legendary Skin [Prosperity], Legendary Hairstyle [Unblemished] and Lyam Liu's combat BGM [Tempered Maven]. notes.title: Season Treasure Returns
notes.content:
[h1]Dear Forerunners[/h1]

notes.title: NARAKA: BLADEPOINT Update – April 25th, 2024
notes.content:
[h1]Dear players,[/h1]

The servers of NARAKA: BLADEPOINT will be suspended for maintenance from April 24th, 2024 at 23:00 (UTC) to April 25th, 2024 at 03:00 (UTC). We suggest you log out in advance and enter the game again after the maintenance.
The details for this update are as follows:
[h2]Brand New Content[/h2]
Mysterious objects are turning up in the waters of Holoroth's Plumed Castle, and the sky over Fairyland Penglai seems to portend something ominous...

[h3]I. Tenacity Season's Immortal War is now available[/h3]
After reaching Platinum, players can participate in Immortal War, competing across new ranks and winning Season rewards. These rewards will be awarded based on the highest rank attained in Immortal War (Solo, Duos, or Trios).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36350327/72354d6d1dc63fb6bb14eba1087a14dc1bd3c1ab.png[/img]

If you make it to the Top 500 in the Immortal War, you'll be on the Immortal Leaderboard. It's updated every Monday at 04:00 (UTC). Being in the Top 500 earns you a special Title. At the end of the season, being on the leaderboard or having a Title gets you an avatar.
In addition, at the time of the final weekly settlement, the Top 3 players will be awarded exclusive Hero Badges.

[h3]II. Limited-Time Event: Tempered Metal[/h3]
Event Duration: Apr 24, 2024 20:00 (UTC) - May 8, 2024 20:00 (UTC)
Event Rules
1. By completing Daily Quests, players can obtain Lyam's Token: Lodestone and have an additional chance to obtain one of the following rewards: Tae, Spectral Silk, Mythic Treasure, Peerless Treasure Choice Gift, Hero Coin, Legendary Trial Card, Tenacity Coin. 
2. There are 4 Sections, which can be unlocked with the corresponding Lodestones.
3. You can claim rewards by unlocking any of the four Sections. Some rewards will be available after the new version is released, so stay tuned.
4. Each day, you can help a player obtain a Lodestone (by tapping the "Share Lyam's Token" in the contact list, selecting a Lodestone, and confirming to share it). You won't consume your Tokens by doing so. However, each player can only be given one Lodestone per day.
5. After the event ends, you can still claim unlocked rewards on the event page within the remaining time to claim rewards. But you can no longer complete Quests or Share Lyam's Tokens during that period. Once the Tokens expire, they can be disposed into 160 Tae each in the Inventory

[h3]III. Limited-Time Event: Soothing Picnic[/h3]
Event Duration: Apr 24, 2024 20:00 (UTC) - May 13, 2024 20:00 (UTC)
Sign in daily to get Lotus Leaves. The number of Lotus Leaves will increase after signing for 10 days. Open a Lotus Leaf to randomly get a reward from: Treasure, Legendary Outfit, Showdown Souljade Gift, Tenacity Coin, Spectral Silk or Tae. By signing in for multiple days, players can get the Legendary Accessory [Whaleglass], Peerless Treasure Choice Gift, Tenacity Treasure and other rewards.

[h3]IV. Season Treasures Return[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36350327/983fd4430b0153f50dc1e0363c4a2bf4176dd92c.jpg[/img]

During the event, Mythic Treasure, Echelon Treasure, Dawn Treasure and Reckoning Treasure will be available again for a limited time.

[h2]In-game Adjustments[/h2]
[h3]I. Feature Optimizations[/h3]
Optimized the pillar display at the Songbird Arena in Fairyland Penglai for better speculation.

[h3]II. Mechanism Adjustments[/h3]
1. Adjusted the hitbox of Scout Bells and Springtime Targets to address certain cases where they cannot be hit.
2. Changed the effects of the Chandeliers in Holoroth's Plumed Castle. Now, these Chandeliers will cause characters that they hit to be Stunned for 3 sec.

[h3]III. Hot Potato Counter[/h3]
1. Newly added Weapon [Polesword] and Souljade [Hot Potato·Blistering Edge].
2. Reduced the number of rounds in Solo and Trios modes, and adjusted the Health value of each round in Solo mode.
3. Optimized the performance when the Hot Potato respawns.
4. Adjusted the speed of Hot Potato.
5. Enabled Ref Mode for Custom Rooms.
6. After being knocked out, players can send messages in the channel, switch which player they are spectating, and check the game rules.
7. Live stats leaderboard now always shows your own stats.

[h3]IV. Weapon Adjustments[/h3]
As the Festival of Water event has come to an end, the projectiles of the Swarm have been changed back to normal bombs and can no longer be obtained from Stashes. Projectiles' direct hit damage multiplier is changed back from 0.13 to 0.18, and explosion damage multiplier from 0.27 to 0.37. 

[h2]Out-game Adjustments[/h2]
[h3]I. New Option: Random Map if Timeout[/h3]
In the map selection page, a new option, Random Map if Timeout, has been added for multi-map mode. If the leader checks this option, the team will be automatically assigned to any map to shorten the matchmaking time when waiting long enough. This option is disabled by default upon launching.

[h3]II. Rotation[/h3]
The rotation of game modes will be changed to: Shadow Surge·Holoroth, Capture the Spirit Well·Celestra, Capture the Spirit Well·Plumed Castle, Shadow Surge·The Morus Isle, Capture the Spirit Well·Plumed Castle, Capture the Spirit Well·Morus Isle

[h3]III. Added the Toggle Feature for Cloak[/h3]
Outfit that currently supports cloak toggle: Timeless Crafts·Tiger Tally
1. Toggle the cloak function to preview how it shows in-game.
2. Can be previewed in the Training Ground.
3. The cloak's effects apply only during matches.
4. Other player models are unaffected.

[h3]IV. Optimization of Outfits' See-through Effects[/h3]
Outfits that support the See-through feature: Onmyoji Arena·Ecliptic Meander, Golden Damselfly, Giant Whale, Justice·Gossamer Iris, Nine Tailed Destiny and Star - Nine Tailed Destiny.
1. When enabled, transparency allows a see-through effect for outfits and cosmetics that block your view.
2. Toggle to preview how it shows in-game. Please note that it cannot be enabled while playing a cosmetic's preview animation.
3. This feature applies only during matches.
4. Other player models are unaffected.

[h2]Showdown Adjustments[/h2]
[h3]I. Enigma Peak: Thunder-wielding Available[/h3]
1. In the Enigma Peak, Showdown Souljades drop by various kinds. If you defeat a certain number of Bosses in a single match, you can also receive rewards like a Legendary Souljade Choice Gift, exclusive achievements and so on.
2. Some bosses in the Enigma Peak now have special moves.
3. This season's Enigma Peak will have two phases: [Thunder-wielding] and [Ice-wielding]. It is recommended to use the corresponding Souljades for an easier experience. Stay tuned for the specific time of the Enigma Peak·Thunder-wielding in the upcoming notices.

[h3]II. Combat Adjustments[/h3]
1. Adjusted the startup frames for the [Water Ent]'s double bite, and adjusted the sound effects of its invisible moves.
2. Adjusted the startup frames for [Depth Fiend]'s double slash move.
3. Adjusted the collision size of [Omnius·Aureate].
4. Optimized the flash effect cues for the blue moves of [Omnius·Rock] in its second phase and [Omnius·Aureate].
5. Changed the [Ghost Hornet]'s dash from a golden move to a white move, and shortened the duration it can block bullets during the move.
6. [Omnius·Hell Scorch] and [Omnius·Umbra Scorch] now have new execution strikes.


[h3]III. Enigma Domain Adjustments[/h3]
1. Adjusted the monster types and their activity ranges in certain strongholds of Celestra in the Enigma Domain.
2. Adjusted the combat range of bosses in Celestra in the Enigma Domain.


[h3]IV. Yama's Abyss Adjustments[/h3]
1. Reduced the total number of stages in Void Space from 30 to 24 (the Fatigue cost and rewards per game remain unchanged).
2. Each Rift Dealer in Void Space will now sell a maximum of 20 Carved Jades (unchanged in the main Yama's Abyss story).
3. An extra Anima Ring will be given during the Preparation Phase and after boss battles in Void Space.
//Dev Notes: We've adjusted the pace in Void Space, shortening the duration of individual games while ensuring the income per game and the development ceiling remain unchanged.
4. Reduced the total number of monsters appearing in "Protect the Soul Altar" stage.
5. Adjusted the spawn locations of some ranged monsters.

[h3]V. Feature Adjustments[/h3]
1. Global Max Drop Level has been increased from 750 to 760. Max Enhancement Level has been increased from 770 to 780. These two levels will no longer change during this Showdown season.
2. The gameplay intro for the Void Space is now displayed at the bottom of the gameplay interface.
3. Extended the time required for the stage of the [Immovable] in the Doom mode.



[h2]Feature Optimizations[/h2]
[h3]I. Client[/h3]
Optimized the loading for melee weapon assets to improve fluency greatly.

[h3]II. Title Adjustment[/h3]
After selecting Titles on the "Profile" page, they will be broadcast to all players during the Preparation Phase.
Titles that will be broadcast include: tournament Title, the Top 100 Immortal Leaderboard, the Top 100 Hall of Fame, the Top 100 of Yama's Abyss Leaderboard, and the Top 100 of Speedrun Leaderboard.
Also, other Titles no longer show the previous pop-up prompts.

[h3]III. Hero Theme Adjustments[/h3]
Hero Themes can be equipped to certain Outfits, without affecting the music played while wearing other outfits.

[h3]IV. Justice Chamber[/h3]
1. If the Leader of a Justice Chamber has been offline for 14 days, members of that Justice Chamber will have a chance to take over as Leader in the following order: Co-Leader, Honorary Leader, members with a Level 5 Title, a Level 4 Title, and finally a Level 3 Title.
2. If no member with a given position or rank takes over as Leader within 14 days, then members with the next position or rank on the list will have the chance to take over.
3. After a new Leader has taken over, the former Leader will become an Honorary Leader, with the same permissions as a Co-Leader.

[h3]V. PlayStation 5 Optimizations[/h3]
1. Improved the garbage collection process, reducing the impact that garbage collection has on frame rate. (Note: Garbage collection happens when the application needs to free up memory)
2. Optimized visual effects in the tutorials to prevent frame rate drops.

[h2]Store Updates[/h2]
[h3]I. New Packs[/h3]
1. Added Shayol Wei exclusive Pack [Zhan Lu Pack], which contains the Shayol Wei Legendary Outfit [Zhan Lu], Longsword Legendary Skin [Crystal Edge] and Legendary Hairstyle [Tied Tassel]. Standard price: 4,100 Gold; Now: 2,600 Gold. Individual cosmetics have their own discounts, but the Pack discount is even bigger!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36350327/f103d6a1b0b1353b3749a6165e0178e0f209652c.png[/img]

2. Added Akos Hu exclusive Pack [Tiger Tally Pack], which contains the Akos Hu exclusive Legendary Outfit [Timeless Crafts·Tiger Tally] and the Legendary Hairstyle [Timeless Crafts·Free Spirit]. Standard price: 2,600 Gold; Now: 1,800 Gold. Individual cosmetics have their own discounts, but the Pack discount is even bigger!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36350327/d98f0d46be66ff446dba825a148fe3fcbe6992ad.png[/img]


[h3]II. New Discounts[/h3]
1. Newly added Akos Hu's Legendary Accessory [Timeless Crafts·Roaring Rally]. (Equipping it changes the appearance of the Akos Hu's Skill, Roar. But it won't change Roar: Blast and Roar: Terror.) Standard price: 1,200 Gold; Now: 600 Gold.
2. Newly added Shayol Wei Legendary Pose [Frost Gleam]. Standard price: 900 Gold; Now: 750 Gold.
3. Newly added Shayol Wei Legendary Background [Prime Alloy]. Standard price: 600 Gold; Now: 500 Gold.
4. Newly added Shayol Wei Legendary Base [Paramount Stand]. Standard price: 1,200 Gold; Now: 1,000 Gold.
5. Legendary Pose [Charming] for all heroes. Standard price: 900 Gold; Now: 360 Gold.
6. Heng Sword Legendary Skin [Laudation·Unlimited]. Standard price: 1,500 Gold; Now: 1,250 Gold.


[h3]III. New Items in Spectral Silk Store[/h3]
1. Newly added Epic Customization Item [Eyeshadow 31] with a price of 5,000 Spectral Silk.
2. Newly added Shayol Wei Legendary Accessory [Endazzle] with a price of 12,000 Spectral Silk.

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[h3]I. Showdown-related Bugs[/h3]
1. Fixed a scene physics issue with the second-floor bridge of Celestra in the Enigma Domain.
2. Fixed an issue where the Miasma Ghosts summoned by Cursespawns and Thunderspawns in Yama's Abyss could have abnormally high Health.

[h3]II. In-game Bugs[/h3]
Fixed an issue with the Chandeliers in Holoroth's Plumed Castle where they would not affect characters in the area around where they fell.

[h3]III. PlayStation 5-related Bug[/h3]
Fixed some crashes that may have been caused by asynchronous instantiation.

[h3]IV. Fairyland Penglai Bug[/h3]
Fixed an issue in Fairyland Penglai where the quick gift button for instruments is still visible in photo mode.

notes.title: One of the biggest free Steam games hits new high after massive update
notes.content:
The fight for the top free Steam games is always fun to watch, and while the Valve charts are still largely dominated by the developer's own Counter-Strike 2 and Dota 2 along with the titan of PUBG Battlegrounds, notably more stylish fellow battle royale games Apex Legends and Naraka Bladepoint continue to fight for that elusive fourth spot. With the arrival of the Naraka Bladepoint Season 12 update, 24 Entertainment and NetEase's slick, melee-focused action game builds even further on new ways to play, and it's paying off as it reaches a new peak player count on Steam.

Read the rest of the story...

RELATED LINKS:
One of Steam's biggest free games is getting a casual dodgeball mode
Steam battle royale rereleases coveted skins, gains 50,000 players
The most stylish free Steam game adds a new weapon to kick off 2024

notes.title: NARAKA: BLADEPOINT Update – Apr 11th, 2024
notes.content:
[h1]Dear players,[/h1]

The servers of NARAKA: BLADEPOINT will be suspended for maintenance from April 10th, 2024 at 23:00 (UTC) to April 11th, 2024 at 03:00 (UTC). We suggest you log out in advance and enter the game again after the maintenance.
The details for this update are as follows:

[h2]Brand New Content[/h2]
[h3]I. Brand New Glyph Plan[/h3]
1. Glyph Boards, now called "Glyph Plans", have been overhauled. They use a system similar to Potential Plans in Showdown mode, and all Tae spent on unlocking and upgrading Glyphs will be returned.
2. Unlocked Hero Glyph Boards will be converted into Hero-Exclusive Glyph Plans.
3. Glyphs will be unlocked when the account level reaches Level 4, and a Glyph point will be awarded for every two levels advanced. These points can then be allocated in the Glyph Plan to activate various Glyphs needing to spend Tae.

[h3]II. BATTLEPASS Updates [/h3]
[previewyoutube=r4vWU857A1M;full][/previewyoutube]
[Tenacity] BATTLEPASS is now available, which includes a variety of valuable items and skins! Players can obtain more rewards by unlocking the Advanced Hidden Treasure! You can get a Treasure Scroll at the price of 1,200 Gold and a Glory Scroll at 2,840 Gold.

[h3]III. Changes to Stamina[/h3]
1. Increased Maximum Stamina by 18.16%, which equals the Maximum Stamina provided by the previous Glyph: [Omni] Mind.
2. Reduced Stamina cost for Dodge and Short-handle Weapons' Quick Dash by 3.52%.
3. Increased Stamina recovery speed by 3.33%.
//Developer's Note: When all Stamina-related Glyph points are activated in the new Glyph Plan, the Stamina cost and Stamina recovery speed for Dodge and Short-handle Weapons' Quick Dash will be on par with equipping [Omni] Mind *6 and [Lunar] Agility *6 before this update.

[h3]IV. New Mode: Hot Potato Counter[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36350327/a914fc6cab5ade4ea602c4bf41b1ce28e94efee1.jpg[/img]
Description: Use various techniques to bounce the Hot Potato and defeat the opponent.
Players: 9 for Solo, 6 for Trios
Gameplay
Rounds:
1. The game has multiple rounds. Each round begins with a NARAKA Hot Potato spawning in the center, which starts by tracking a random player and then gains speed as it is struck by players. Being hit by the Hot Potato reduces Health.
2. In Solo mode, players have one Health point per round; in Trios, each player gets two.
3. Win by defeating all opponents or scoring the highest before the round concludes.
Hot Potato:
1. The Red Hot Potato is coming right for you!
2. Blue Hot Potatoes are friendly. You don't have to dodge them.
3. A Hot Potato will deal damage to anyone in its path. Even a White Hot Potato isn't safe.
4. Use different moves to rebound the Hot Potato faster!
Intercept:
Hot Potatoes struck by enemies/teammates can be struck again to change their trajectory and target.
Catch (Trios Only):
When a teammate hits a Blue Hot Potato and it's nearby, you can use a charged strike to have it circle your body, then quickly toss the Hot Potato.
Techniques:
1. Vertical strike to pass a Hot Potato to your teammates (Trios Only).
2. Different moves will let you manipulate the speed and direction of the Hot Potato's movement:
 · Common Attack - Regular rebound shot
 · Focus Strike - Speeds up the Hot Potato a moderate amount
 · Counter - Catch the Hot Potato and throw it in a curve to the aimed direction with an extra speed boost.
3. Skills and Souljades - More powerful rebound techniques!
4. Speed boosts from the same move can stack, but hitting the Hot Potato with a different move will reset the speed boost.
Exquisite Vessel:
There's a chance that Souljades and items will spawn in the Exquisite Vessel: 
 · Armor - blocks one instance of Hot Potato damage
 · Hot Potato·Rampage—hitting the Hot Potato will let you rebound it in a rightward arc with a speed boost
Counter-type Glyphs: [Lunar] Agile is effective against active Hot Potatoes

[h3]V. Fairyland Penglai Updates[/h3]
1. Instrument Proficiency Updates
(1) A proficiency system for Er-hu, Flute, Drum, Gong and Woodblock instruments is now available.
(2) Added performance effects as new rewards as players level up their proficiency.
2. Kite Updates
Certain Emote Gestures can be performed on the kite. Enjoy the show with your friends!


[h3]VI. Limited-time Event: Currents Clash[/h3]
Lakes and seas so vast and wide, with mists and clouds that doth abide.
1. Each day, players can choose one of the two Cultivations.
Fortuna's Gift: If you gain Score from a Ranked match, you will get a 25% Score Bonus; if you lose Score from a Ranked match, your Score loss will be halved. Eurekas will diminish by 1. (No Eureka is used when the Score is 0.)
Thunder Cove's Mercy: Gain 150% XP and Treasure XP from the next match of the Survival mode, Casual mode or Showdown, diminishing Eurekas by 1.

2. Players can choose only one Cultivation Bonus per day, and the choice cannot be changed.
3. Completing each event quest grants a Eureka. There are 7 quest sets, which unlock sequentially over time, one after another upon completion of the prior set.
4. Eurekas expire daily, so please use them the same day they're received.
5. The event grants extra rewards based on the total number of quests completed.


[h3]VII. Limited-time Event: Festival of Water[/h3]
Event Duration: Apr 10, 2024 20:00 (UTC) - Apr 21, 2024 20:00 (UTC)
Redeem the rewards before: Apr 24, 2024 at 20:00 (UTC)
Event Rules
1. Players earn Serene Drops by completing event quests. Serene Drops can be redeemed for rewards.
2. Throughout the event, the ranged weapon, Swarm, gains a limited-time special effect: shooting water bombs! Obtain Swarm from Stashes or Morus' Blessings (except in Showdown and Immortal War modes). Projectiles' direct hit damage multiplier is reduced from 0.18 to 0.13, and explosion damage multiplier from 0.37 to 0.27. 
Enjoy a lively water fight!

[h3]VIII. Limited-time Event: PlayStation® Tournaments #4[/h3]
We brandish swords to gain fame, the only heroes in this game. PlayStation® Tournaments #4 are available for a limited time!
Event Duration: Apr 11, 2024 20:00 (UTC) - May 8, 2024 20:00 (UTC).
Event Rules
Complete daily quests during the event to claim Honor Medals - APR. You can claim more Medals in the mail after advancing, and the quantity awarded for each rank is as follows:
1st place: 300 Medals
2nd place: 200 Medals
3rd-4th place: 100 Medals
5th-8th place: 50 Medals 
Medals can be used for redeeming rewards and participating in rankings.
Start Time of Tournament:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36350327/ef36321b91f669b2e528731a0746f30f4be834e5.png[/img]
Start Time of the First Tournament:
NA: 2024.04.12 03:00
AS: 2024.04.12 11:00
SEA: 2024.04.12 11:00
EU: 2024.04.12 19:00


[h3]IX. PlayStation Challenge[/h3]
Challenge the wind in this race! PlayStation Sky-high Racing #1 is now open!
Compete against players worldwide and ascend the rankings by achieving a place among the Top 100 fastest in Sky-high Racing mode.
How to participate:
Start Sky-high Racing on Fairyland Penglai to participate in the event, and check the global leaderboard on the event card.
Event Duration: Apr 11, 2024 00:00 (UTC) - May 9, 2024 00:00 (UTC).

[h3]X. New Tenacity Season Pack[/h3]
Can be purchased during Apr 11, 2024 00:00 (UTC) to Jul 4, 2024 00:00 (UTC)
Discount Duration: Apr 11, 2024 00:00:00 (UTC) - May 9, 2024 00:00:00 (UTC)
Purchase the Season Pack to get the following rewards:
(1) Tenacity Season Pack Exclusive, Epic Head Accessory for Shayol Wei: Whisker-Watcher
(2) Advanced Hidden Treasure Card: Use to unlock the Advanced Hidden Treasure of the current season. (Usable during Tenacity Season or all subsequent seasons)
(3) Baize's Blessing: Use to collect rewards from Baize's Blessing for 30 days.
(4) Gold*600
(5) Peerless Treasure Choice Gift*10
 

[h2]Hero Adjustments[/h2]
[h3]I. Akos Hu[/h3]
1. Slightly reduced the startup frames of [Roar: Blast].
2. Adjusted the Damage Multiplier for the 1st/2nd/3rd stage of [Pounce] strike in Ultimate Status from 1.0/1.3/1.6 to 1.0/1.5/2.0.
3. Adjusted the Damage multipliers for the three lunges of [Feral Frenzy] from 2.2/2.5/2.8 to 2.4/2.7/3.0, and the multiplier of healing through attacks from 0.3 to 0.4.
4. Optimized the performance of [Feral Frenzy: Grab] and increased the vertical range of lunges. The priority of the knockdown effect has also been adjusted. Shayol Wei's [Black Tortoise Block] will no longer be triggered (however, if Shayol Wei is already in the [Black Tortoise Guard] phase, Akos Hu cannot knock her down), and hitting Zai will force her out of [Flame Ward].

[h3]II. Viper Ning[/h3]
1. Increased the Damage Reduction of all Ultimate variants of [Moonbane Control] from 50% to 70%.
2. Increased the sustained Damage Reduction of all Ultimate variants of [Moonbane Control: Unchained] from 40% to 50%.

[h3]III. Kurumi[/h3]
1. Increased the Damage Reduction of all Ultimate variants of [Purified Circle] from 50% to 70%, and reduced recovery frames.
2. Reduced the startup frames of the Ultimate [Purified Circle: Rapid]'s airborne strikes. The strike can be interrupted by dodging.

[h3]IV. Tarka Ji[/h3]
1. Adjusted the timing of skill usage for [Flame Force: Fireball] to the moment of shooting the fireball.
2. Increased the Damage Reduction of all Ultimate variants of [Fire Frenzy] from 50% to 70%.
3. Tarka Ji will no longer be interrupted by Valda Cui's [Rising Tide] in Ultimate Status.

[h3]V. Zai[/h3]
1. Reduced the recovery frames when unleashing Ultimate under all [Chain Scythe]'s Ultimate variants.
2. Optimized the attack direction detection for the horizontal and vertical strikes of Zai's Ultimate weapon [Chain Scythe].

[h3]VI. Shayol Wei[/h3]
1. Slightly reduced the recovery frames when unleashing Ultimate under all [Justiciar's Guard]'s Ultimate variants.
2. Increased the cooldown of [Shield Bash: Rush] from 16 to 19 sec. Reduced the extra cooldown time added after a successful hit or at the end of the Rush from 8 to 5 sec.
//Developer's Note: We've increased the initial cooldown time for skills that fail to hit, while keeping the overall cooldown time after a successful hit the same as it was. This will make dodging an enemy Shayol's [Shield Bash: Rush] more rewarding.

[h2]Weapon Adjustments[/h2]
[h3]I. Nunchucks[/h3]
1. After a successful block, players can interrupt the enemy by jumping or dodging, and the window for unleashing a counterstrike has been extended.
2. Optimized the attack speed and melee correction for Scale Rush, and slightly increased the stagger time of the hit enemy.

[h3]II. Katana[/h3]
Optimized the effects of [Soul Slash] and [Thunderstorm] upon attacking enemies, stabilizing the combo connection of multiple strikes.

[h2]Combat Adjustments[/h2]
1. Adjusted the stagger time caused by airborne attacks so that it matches the corresponding network delay.
2. Increased the maximum value of all types of Armor by 20%.
Max value of Common armor increased from 500 to 600.
Max value of Rare armor increased from 750 to 900.
Max value of Epic armor increased from 1000 to 1200.
Max value of Legendary armor increased from 1250 to 1500.
Max value of Extreme armor increased from 1500 to 1800.
3. Increased the recovery amount of Armor Powder by 20%.
Recovery amount of Armor Powder increased from 250 to 300.
Recovery amount of Armor Powder II increased from 500 to 600.
4. Increased the recovery amount of Armor Powder by 20% when equipped with Advanced Heal and Group Heal Souljades.
5. Armor display adjustment: Increased the Armor value of each bar segment from 250 to 300.


[h2]In-game Adjustments[/h2]
[h3]I. Immortal War Adjustments[/h3]
1. Increased the amount of rewarded Dark Tide Coins for defeating enemies during specific timeframes to 3000/6000/12000/18000 in Duos and Trios and 3000/10000/20000/30000 for Solo.
2. Added to the Rift Dealer a new tab for items that unlock over time and some limited-time items. Added item "Universal Key" (Transforms into the key to the nearest Cave after purchase).
3. Replaced the Morus' Blessing that refreshes each round outside the Realm of Yang with Spirit Well, and introduced a shield that only blocks incoming bullets coming from outside.
4. The same rewards offered for Morus' Blessing are now generated at the Spirit Well upon capture. If the Power of Four Beasts is among the rewards, it will be directly granted to the capturing team.
5. Added new Morus' Blessing to be unlocked in the Cave, which includes:
Epic armor, Epic weapons, Epic Souljades, random Rare weapons or armor, Healing Berries II, Armor Powder II, and Grappling Hook.
6. The highest quality of equipment that players can obtain from a Blue Stash has been changed from Epic to Rare.
7. The golden toad which carries the Cave's key will no longer respawn.
8. Reduced the Dark Tide Coins spawned in the map.

[h3]II. Feature Optimizations[/h3]
1. Adjusted the duration of Soulbloom Essence dropped in Remains in The Survival modes to 120 sec, after which the item will disappear.
2. Changed the color of icons for scout effects on the map to red.
3. The brightness of the in-game map has been adjusted appropriately to highlight the key information more prominently. The icon layers for Rift Dealer and Soul Altars have been moved below the Shadow Corruption's layer.

[h3]III. Other Adjustments[/h3]
Removed in-game Soul Land Crossover content.

[h2]Out-game Adjustments[/h2]
[h3]I. Chat[/h3]
1. Added notification when receiving unread private messages in Lobby, Justice Chamber and Party channels.
2. These notifications can be enabled/disabled under Settings > Social > Chat > Message Notifications.

[h3]II. Rotation[/h3]
1. Adjusted the rotation cycle to every 2 hours.
2. Currently featured rotation order: Shadow Surge·Holoroth, Capture the Spirit Well: Celestra, Shadow Surge·The Morus Isle, Capture the Spirit Well: Plumed Castle

[h3]III. [Soul Land] Crossover Ends[/h3]
As our crossover event with Soul Land comes to a close, all crossover-related products will no longer be sold starting on April 17, 2024, at 16:00 (UTC), including:
[Soul Land·Xiao Wu], [Soul Land·Tang San], [Soul Land·Huo Yuhao], [Soul Land·Tang Wutong], [Soul Land·Conqueror], [Soul Land·Ghostcarve], [Soul Land·Asura], and all other cosmetics, including Outfits, Hairstyles, Weapon Skins, Accessories, Poses, Backgrounds, etc.
All Upgradable Collections can continue to be upgraded.

[h3]IV. Showdown now has exclusive Battlepass Challenge Quests, which you can complete to increase your Hidden Treasure level.[/h3]

[h3]V. Capture the Spirit Well Scoring[/h3]
Adjusted the scoring rules of Capture the Spirit Well mode.

[h2]Showdown Adjustments[/h2]

[h3]I. Free Training Mode for Showdown[/h3]
Free Training mode for Showdown is now available. Players can head to the Off-islands of Morus Isle for unrestricted trials of all Souljades to explore the best matches and understand their effects and damage. You can also practice with all Heroes, mastering their Skills, Martial Skills, and Defuse Martial Skills timing.

[h3]II. Combat Adjustments[/h3]
1. Increased Max Armor for all armor tiers by 20%.
Max Armor for Common armor increased from 500 to 600.
Max Armor for Rare armor increased from 750 to 900.
Max Armor for Epic armor increased from 1000 to 1200.
Max Armor for Legendary armor increased from 1250 to 1500.
Max Armor for Extreme armor increased from 1500 to 1800.
2. Armor display adjustment: Increased the Armor value of each bar segment from 250 to 300.  
3. Added a prompt and an attack increase icon for triggering [Defuse·Aegis-break] Souljade effects.
4. Optimized Burning-related descriptions.
5. Modified the effect from Blue variant Potentials, "The chance that items won't deplete after use", to "After triggering Ice Blast, gain a recovery effect".
6. Reduced the Damage Multiplier for [Water Ent]'s 5-hit water spits from 2.0 to 1.5.
7. Reduced the stagger time of [Water Ent]'s Blue downward strike.
8. Reduced the Damage Multiplier of [Fiery Monster]'s White melee attacks from 4 to 2.5.
9. Optimized the collision size of [Omnius·Aureate] and [Iron Taifeng].
10. Moderately reduced the Attack and Health of [Omnius·Umbra Scorch] in Eventide Ember (Normal).
11. Optimized the recommendation logic for [The Awakening] Souljades in Yama's Abyss.
12. Added new label [Burn] to [HydroFlare] Anima Rings.

[h3]III. Hero Adjustments[/h3]
1. Increased the Damage Reduction of Viper Ning's Ultimate [Moonbane Control: Showdown] from 50% to 70%.
2. Increased the Damage Reduction of Kurumi's Ultimate [Purified Circle: Showdown] from 50% to 70%.
3. Adjusted the timing of usage for Tarka Ji's skill [Flame Force: Showdown] to the moment of shooting the fireball.
4. Increased the Damage Reduction of Tarka Ji's Ultimate [Fire Frenzy: Showdown] from 50% to 70%.
5. Fixed a damage loss issue with Wuchen's Martial Skills [Yin Yang Seal] and [Spirit Blade Seal].

[h3]IV. Enigma Domain Adjustments[/h3]
Optimized the physical collision of the giant plant tentacles in the Eventide Temple in Enigma Domain.

[h3]V. Yama's Abyss Adjustments[/h3]
1. Added Omen indicators next to the minimap to make it easier to view the specific effects of each Omen. Besides, stage Omens are now displayed during hero selection.
2. The stage Omens will also appear in the Preparation Stage and at Rift Dealer Stages.

[h3]VI. Features Adjustments[/h3]
1. Global Max Drop Level has been increased from 730 to 750. Max Enhancement Level has been increased from 750 to 770.
2. Souljade locking is now enabled on the settlement page.
3. Added category tabs to the Souljade Inventory, which allow players to view their Souljade stocks by category.
4. Optimized Inventory sorting rules. Souljades that are incompatible with the current hero are moved to the end by default.
5. Players can now check the Challenge Quests for the current Doom Level on the hero selection page when playing the Doom mode.
6. On the Preparation page, heroes' weapon information has been changed to small icons.

[h2]Store Updates[/h2]
[h3]I. New Packs (https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=-qPdNncYE_4)[/h3]
Added the Yoto Hime exclusive Pack [Porcelain Hue], which contains the Yoto Hime exclusive Legendary Outfit [Timeless Crafts·Porcelain Hue] and the Greatsword Legendary Skin [Timeless Crafts·Porcelain Shard]. Standard price: 4,200 Gold; Now: 2,880 Gold. Individual cosmetics have their own discounts, but the Pack discount is even bigger!

[h3]II. New Discounts[/h3]
1. Heng Sword Legendary Skin [Laudation·Unlimited]. Standard price: 1,500 Gold; Now: 1,250 Gold.
2. Newly added Epic Kill Announcement [Timeless Crafts·Ceramic Melody]f for all heroes. Standard price: 300 Gold; Now: 200 Gold.
3. Newly added Epic Emote Gesture [Vitality Surge] for all heroes.
Standard price: 300 Gold; Now: 180 Gold.
4. Newly added Legendary Pose [Charming] for all heroes. Standard price: 900 Gold; Now: 360 Gold.
5. Newly added Tessa Epic Pose [Charming]. Standard price: 300 Gold; Now: 180 Gold.
6. Newly added Yoto Hime Epic Background [Dyed Cyan]. Standard price: 200 Gold; Now: 150 Gold.
7. Newly added Yoto Hime Epic Base [Glazed Colors]. Standard price: 400 Gold; Now: 300 Gold.
8. Yoto Hime Epic Pose [Free Spirit]. Standard price: 500 Gold; Now: 400 Gold.
9. The [Stamp Feet], [Quite Interesting], and [Greeting Applaud] Emote Gestures are now discounted at the same rate as when they were initially added.

[h3]III. New Items in the Tae Store[/h3]
1. Newly added Repeating Crossbow Legendary Skin [Powderkeg-Tech] with a price of 30,000 Tae.
2. Newly added Staff Legendary Skin [Spiked Tumbler] with a price of 30,000 Tae.
3. Newly added Legendary Accessory [Frost Garland] with a price of 24,000 Tae.
4. Newly added Legendary Accessory [2674·Energy Cell] with a price of 18,000 Tae.
5. Newly added Legendary Accessory [2674·Plum Blossom] with a price of 18,000 Tae.
6. Newly added Epic Accessory [Panda] with a price of 6,000 Tae.
7. Newly added Epic Accessory [Gilded Mirror] with a price of 6,000 Tae.
8. Newly added Epic Background [The Lab] with a price of 4,000 Tae.
9. Newly added Epic Background [Astra Street] with a price of 4,000 Tae.
10. Newly added Epic Background [Repair Station] with a price of 4,000 Tae.
11. Newly added Epic Background [The Frontier] with a price of 4,000 Tae.
12. Newly added Epic Background [Dark Forest] with a price of 4,000 Tae.
13. Newly added Epic Bubble [Yueshan·Tu Na] with a price of 4,000 Tae.
14. Newly added Item [Spectral Silk Box] with a price of 10,000 Tae. Can only be bought 3 times.
15. Newly added Item [Peerless Treasure Choice Gift] with a price of 6,000 Tae. Can only be bought 5 times.


[h2]Feature Adjustments[/h2]
[h3]I. In-game Adjustments[/h3]
1. Optimized many of the settings that fall under "Filter" on the Graphics page, fixing an issue where Blue Focus Visual Effects would not change accordingly.
// Dev Note: We noticed that many players would activate the "Tender" filter because of how strong the lighting became when active. Not turning on Tender would make the visual effects of Focuses more visible, but this would also cause other visual effects to get crowded out, interfering with lines of sight. We have therefore modified the brightness of Focus visual effects for each filter type. This will ensure that Focus visual effects appear equally well across all filter types, while maintaining the brightness of all other visual effects to make visual information in combat clearer.
2. Optimized the Free Camera feature. In Free Camera state, attacks will reorient the camera towards the crosshair.

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[h3]I. Hero-related Bugs[/h3]
1. Fixed an issue where players would still be inflicted with debuffs (such as Burning and Cripple) even after successfully using Defuse to neutralize enemies' attacks.
2. Fixed an abnormal Burning damage issue with Zai's [Flame Ward: Firestorm] and [Chain Scythe: Suppress].

[h3]II. Battle-related Bugs[/h3]
Fixed an issue in the Greatsword Counter Training in Free Training mode where the AI opponent unleashed a limited variety of moves.

[h3]III. Showdown-related Bugs[/h3]
1. Fixed an issue where players would still be inflicted with debuffs (such as Burning and Cripple) even after successfully using Defuse to neutralize enemies' attacks.
2. Fixed an issue where certain heroes' attacks mistakenly emptied the defuse slots when equipped with Souljades [Defuse·Ice Flow] or [Defuse·Raging Flame].
3. Fixed incorrect descriptions of [Sap] class Souljades.
4. Fixed an issue where the corresponding effects would fail to trigger when successfully performing Divine Thunder strike while having Souljades [Defuse Flaming Blade] or [Defuse Solidification], and the Potential [Honed Blessing] equipped.
5. Fixed an issue where enemies who were killed while airborne would not disappear due to improper collision.
6. Fixed an issue where hitting allies' arrows would trigger the effects of Potential [Skilled Fire Chant] and Anima Ring [HydroFlare Scorched Cloud] when equipped with Souljade [Advanced Heal Crossbow].
7. Fixed an issue of missing map legends in the minimap of the Celestra in Enigma Domain.
8. Fixed an issue where Wuchen being unable to obtain [Short-handle Weapon Sap] and [Netherstep] in Yama's Abyss.
9. Fixed an issue that would occur with the damage multipliers of Fan Counterstrike Combos.
10. Fixed the abnormal damage multipliers of Fan Counterstrike Combos while having the Souljade [Short-handle Weapon Sap] equipped.
11. Fixed the abnormal display of a red dot on the Enigma Domain Tab.
12. Fixed an issue where no Dark Tide Coins being given upon defeating Korvine in the Yama's Abyss.

[h3]IV. PlayStation-related Bugs[/h3]
1. Fixed an issue that infrequently caused crashes when connecting to a server.
2. Fixed an issue that infrequently caused the game to lag out when returning to the Lobby.


[h2]Others[/h2]
1. Fixed the required number of Anima Rings to complete the Hero Badge [Rings of Turmoil] Citrine.
2. Fixed an issue where the tabs under the Achievements page in Profile would mysteriously disappear.

notes.title: NARAKA:BLADEPOINT – Righteous Season Settlement Notice
notes.content:
[h1]Dear players,[/h1]

The Righteous Season will come to an end on April, 11th, 2024 at 00:00:00 (UTC), and the ranks for this season will be settled. Thank you all for your feedback during the season, we will continue to endeavor to bring you a better gaming experience! 

While journeying on the path of the Righteous Season, the flexible and versatile [Heng Sword] and Shayol Wei, the shrewd Golden Keeper who can control the power of the Black Tortoise entered the fray, adding new elements to the NARAKA's combat.
[url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=jXIpYKdzamI&t=92s][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36350327/043f5e46289cc23c51e623e932d7d07f7504a0e7.jpg[/img][/url]

Novel and innovative gameplay is important to us as well, so we added Heroes Assemble to Justice Chambers, so that every hero can experience the fun of teaming up to beat Omnius, and added the Songbird Arena so that the clash and clang of sword fighting could add to the joyful atmosphere on Fairyland Penglai.

In addition, we had our crossover event with Soul Land, launching exquisite crossover skins - Tang San·Temulch, Xiao Wu·Kurumi, Huo Yuhao·Akos Hu, Tang Wutong·Feria Shen, the Soul Land·Trident Weapon Skin... and added new Soul Beasts, Soul Bones and a rich variety of other elements, so that every hero has a more immersive crossover event experience.

Stay tuned for the upcoming season, packed with thrilling content and challenges!

The details of season rewards and the Score reset are as follows. Players will be able to claim the rewards after updating and starting the new season. 

[h2]Season Rewards:[/h2]

Season rewards will be awarded based on the highest rank gained in the ranked modes (Solo, Duos, or Trios) during the Righteous Season.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36350327/351c4582eeb22538a2638afec6024482a348ac2c.png[/img]

The Avatar rewards for the Asura and Unrivaled Asura ranks are differentiated by Solo, Duos, and Trios, and can be earned separately across those various game modes. 

[h2]Immortal War:[/h2]

Rewards will be given out according to the highest rank that a player achieved in Immortal War Solo, Duos and Trios during the Righteous Season.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36350327/ac1d5e98738dd98748ce2b2aed634175b2f4458d.png[/img]

Avatars will be awarded to players based on the highest rank that they achieved on the Immortal Leaderboard during the Righteous Season. Additionally, all players on the Immortal Leaderboard at the time of season settlement will receive an Avatar.

When season settlement occurs, the top 3 players on the Immortal Leaderboard will receive exclusive Hero Badges.

Avatars and Hero Badges are differentiated by the highest Rank a player achieves in Solo, Duos, and Trios. Players receive rewards regardless of if they will also receive rewards in other modes or not.

[h2]Hero Leaderboards:[/h2]

All players that are ranked on their server's Hero Leaderboards at the time of season settlement will receive an Avatar corresponding to that Hero. This Avatar cannot be acquired multiple times. Go to Profile - Avatars to see all Avatars.

[h3]Season Rewards Display:[/h3]

Hadi Epic Outfit [Brocade Shirt·Amber]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36350327/6a31bb936ad973e83020136675493caac88da316.jpg[/img]

[h3]Score Reset:[/h3]

1. Scores in the Ranked modes (Solos, Duos, or Trios) will partially carry over to the new season.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36350327/270ed085ce40a21a53eac869ce022590fa6e77f0.png[/img]

2. Players' Solo, Duos, and Trios Immortal War Rank Score will not carry over to the next season.

3. Hero scores and scores from Capture the Spirit Well, Shadow Surge, The Bloodbath, and Bloodsport will partially carry over to the new season, with a higher carry-over ratio for lower scores. The maximum possible score that can be carried over into the next season is 10,000.

notes.title: Season 12: Tenacity Preview
notes.content:
[h1]Hey Forerunners,[/h1]

It’s been a minute! We’re excited to bring you a special video where the developer spills all the juicy details about Season 12 and the upcoming changes. You can also check out the key sections covered in the video below:

https://youtu.be/HUZcqE6RhQ0


[h3]The New Potential System[/h3]

To reduce the complexity of the PVP potential system we have undertaken a massive rework. We hope to give players more potential combinations in PVP mode to enhance strategic diversity.

The new potential system will be unlocked at level 5 and comes with 1 potential point. Every subsequent 2 levels will earn you 1 potential point, up to a maximum of 18 potential points. If you are new to NARAKA we will also share some handy recommended builds to help you on your PVP journey.

[h2]Hero Skill Adjustment in Season 12[/h2]

We will be introducing skill reworks for previous heroes in upcoming patches. Our goal is to preserve and integrate the gameplay as much as possible while ensuring that the adjusted skills are better suited for the current battle environment.

Here's a sneak peek of the skill changes for some of our heroes in Season 12:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36350327/9e564580ced465a40fd0d8889d41f9b8e4b65680.jpg[/img]
[h3]Hadi: [/h3]Combining his F1 and F3 variants into a new skill with the default effect of F1. Adjustments to Ult 2 and 3 for improved balance.

[h3]Tianhai: [/h3]Removing Divine Bell: Blast (F3 skill) and ult 2 (grab teammates). Strengthening Vajra combos to enhance his threat level.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36350327/c54ed8c310c9e085faa7af0dd53d40a864a94dd2.jpg[/img]
[h3]Yueshan: [/h3]Merging F3 and F2 skills and incorporating the Terror effect into skill 2 variant. Optimizing skill casting and values. Removing ult 2 variants.

[h3]Tessa:[/h3] Removing skill 3 and ult 3 variants.

[h2]Extended Testing Period For New Heroes[/h2]

We will be extending the testing period for new heroes and opening the server one patch earlier. This means that players will have the opportunity to experience and provide feedback on the new heroes before their official launch. This will also give us more data to adjust the balance of the new heroes based on player feedback. 

We hope that you will be excited to try out our new hero - Lyam Liu the Ascendant Lodestar - in the Test Server on April 18th. Stay tuned for more details about him, his story, and his abilities!


[h2]Two New Casual Modes[/h2]

In our first update of Season 12, we will introduce a new mode: Hot Potato Counter Mode. In Hot Potato Counter Mode, the criteria for victory will be to eliminate your opponents with a ball on the field.

You can use normal attacks, focus attacks, counters and hero skills to control the state and direction of the ball. If the ball turns red, it means it's time to strike. You can choose to press the right button to pass the ball to your teammates, or you can choose other actions to throw the ball at the enemy directly in front of you. The speed of the ball will get faster and faster as you pass it again and again!

Unlike other game modes, Hot Potato Counter is turn-based. The team that accumulates the most points over a set of rounds wins. Points are awarded for hitting and eliminating other players in each round. Weary from your battles in Morus Isle? Come and experience a different kind of rush in the new Hot Potato Counter Mode!

In addition, to Hot Potato Counter Mode we are looking into adding another mode that focuses players into two teams and they duke it out using their ultimates. To start, it will have Tianhai, Feria, and Yueshan as playable heroes! Be sure to stay tuned to our channels for more details.

[h2]Mode Changes: Immortal War[/h2]

To improve the experience overall of Immortal War, as well as to add some additional excitement we are making a couple of changes.

First, we will limit the highest tier level for equipment found in stashes to Rare. This will require that you visit Rift Dealers to get Epic armor and weapons. Second, we are increasing the Dark Tide Coins gained on kills and this increase grows over time. Teams that are playing well can kill their opponents, gain coins, and reap even greater power. Third, the Cave Key will now be available at the Rift Dealer with the cave now featuring better rewards and an extra Morus’ Blessing.

You can try out these changes in the test server on April 3rd.

[h2]Festive Events[/h2]

[h2]Festival of Water[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36350327/d387c448bacacdfde46393ed0434717bfe6b2faf.jpg[/img]
Get ready to celebrate the Festival of Water from April 11th to April 25th! During this lively event, the Swarm in the game will transform into Hydro-Swarm, playfully spraying water at players. You can engage in quests and complete them to unlock exciting event rewards, including a water element-related rescue effect, a unique pose, or a special kill announcement.

notes.title: NARAKA: BLADEPOINT Update – Mar 21st, 2024
notes.content:
[h1]Dear players,[/h1]

The servers of NARAKA: BLADEPOINT will be suspended for maintenance from March 20th, 2024 at 23:00 (UTC) to March 21st, 2024 at 03:00 (UTC). We suggest you log out in advance and enter the game again after the maintenance.

The details for this update are as follows:
[h2]Brand New Content[/h2]

[h3]I. Showdown Season 1.5: Turmoil[/h3]
[b]1. New Hero: Wuchen[/b]
He arrives with all-new skills and ultimates unlike those in the Survival modes!
Wade into battle and cut down your foes to forge a path leading ever onward!

[b]2. New Boss: Korvine[/b]
The last of Mt. Tian Psylith's bloodline, a new boss roams the Autumn Plains of Morus Isle…
[previewyoutube=ccdIO1AHK4k;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]3. Brand New Souljades and Potentials[/b]
We've added plenty of new Souljades! Use [Burn] and [Soaked] effects to vaporize and vanquish your enemies.

We've reworked Potential and remade all core Potential effects! Try out all-new strategies in the upcoming season!

[b]4. New Item: Flux Shard[/b]
An imbuement item that can be used to change a specific Attribute of Showdown Souljade into another random rare Attribute.

To get this item, you must complete the Nightscream level of the new stage, reach Showdown Paragon in Yama's Abyss, or purchase a Showdown Pass.

[b]5. Season Settlements[/b]
Chasm Season will end on March 21, 2024 at 00:00 (UTC)
(1) Season Rewards:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36350327/6775d5fc192d8a6b55bf1e13e1cd6c8c4dc36b45.png[/img]
In the new Showdown Season, the [Regular Treasure Choice Gift] will be upgraded to [Peerless Treasure Choice Gift] (includes Brocade Treasure).
(2) Showdown Leaderboard Rewards
Players will be rewarded with an Avatar that corresponds to the highest rank that they held on the leaderboards at any point during this Showdown Chasm Season (recorded either at weekly settlement or at season settlement). Additionally, the top 3 players on each leaderboard will receive an exclusive Hero Badge.
(3) Progress Reset:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36350327/d53b6312e7f099cbb1f8544bd36690f8e7b24bb4.png[/img]
[i]Dev Note: In the first Showdown Season, we introduced the new mode "Yama's Abyss", where Sense Level had no negative impact, completely new Anima Ring gameplay, seeking to let everybody enjoy a purer combat experience. After a full season has come and gone, we are carrying out wide-ranging optimizations of many parts of Yama's Abyss, as well as upgrading the season rewards. We welcome everyone to try out Yama's Abyss and hope that you all continue to provide such valuable feedback.[/i]

[h3]II. Brand New Showdown Season: Turmoil[/h3]
Season Duration: Mar 21, 2024 00:00 (UTC) - Aug 29, 2024 00:00 (UTC)
Showdown Pass Updates:
This season's pass is worth more than 80,000 Gold!
This season's pass brings an extensive selection of impressive rewards, such as a breathtaking Weapon Skin, captivating Martial Skill cosmetics, a special Turmoil Souljade Gift, and the extraordinary [Flux Shard]. The Advanced Showdown Pass is now 400 Gold cheaper.
The Glory Showdown Pass unlocks 20 levels and exclusive items.
Please note that you can only select either the Advanced or Glory Showdown Pass.

[h3]III. Limited-time Event: Egg Hunt[/h3]
Event Duration: Mar 20, 2024 20:00 (UTC) - Apr 1, 2024 20:00 (UTC)
Redeem the rewards before: Apr 4, 2024 at 20:00 (UTC)
Event Rules:
1. Gain Easter Eggs by completing quests during the event.
2. Interact with the Easter NARAKA Ball within Fairyland Penglai during the event, to transform into a NARAKA Bunny Ball, and smash into players! You'll both have a chance to receive Easter Eggs and Soulbloom Easter Eggs!
3. Easter Eggs can be exchanged for exclusive event rewards. Spend Soulbloom Easter Eggs to activate the Easter Bunny at the Fairyland Penglai Seraphic Quartet, and receive loads of rewards!

[h3]IV. Limited-time Event: NARAKA: BLADEPOINT SAGA[/h3]
Event Duration: Mar 20, 2024 20:00 (UTC) - Apr 10, 2024 20:00 (UTC)
Follow Wuchen's story in the official comic, NARAKA: BLADEPOINT SAGA, by tapping the link in the Event Center! You'll even receive an exclusive avatar! 

[h3]V. Limited-time Event: Plume of Chaos[/h3]
Event Duration: Mar 20, 2024 20:00 (UTC) - Apr 3, 2024 20:00 (UTC)
Redeem the rewards before: Apr 10, 2024 at 20:00 (UTC)
Event Rules: 1. Gain Hun Dun Feathers by completing quests during the event. Hun Dun Feathers can be redeemed for great event rewards. 2. Complete each day's Daily Quests to receive bonus rewards.

[h3]VI. Fairyland Penglai Brand-new Gameplay: Gold Hunt[/h3]
Location: Fairyland Penglai, Wind's Abode.
Roll around in NARAKA Ball form, leap high, and smash into players for points. Complete weekly challenges for more rewards.

[h2]Hero Adjustments[/h2]
[h3]I. Tarka Ji[/h3]
Optimized the attack performance of casting Ultimates in the air.

[h2]In-game Adjustments[/h2]
[h3]I. Feature Optimizations[/h3]
Improved the scout effects of items like the Scout Bell and Mystic Might by adding a new ability to mark the nearest 3 enemies with yellow icons, making it easier for players to quickly locate enemy positions.

[h3]II. Heroes Assemble Adjustments[/h3]
Reduced the Max Health of all enemies in Operatic Flames, the first stage of the Heroes Assemble.

[h3]III. Immortal War Adjustments[/h3]
1. Increased the number of Realm of Yang in the first round of the Immortal War (both solo and Trios modes) from 2 to 3.
2. Added another round of automatically triggered Banebreath.

[h3]IV. Controller Adjustments[/h3]
1. Added a new combination key for [2nd-stage Ultimate]. Players can use this key to trigger subsequent stages for certain heroes like Shayol Wei and Akos Hu after activating their [Ultimates].
2. Players can configure the [2nd-stage Ultimate] key in [ESC] - [Controls] - [Controller] - [Remap].

[h2]Out-game Adjustments[/h2]
[h3]I. Fairyland Penglai[/h3]
1. NARAKA Ball has returned!
2. When you enter the vicinity of the Songbird Arena, Pantheon, or the plaza area in front of Pantheon, the NARAKA Ball form will automatically deactivate.
3. Adjusted the collision mechanism with other players when using the NARAKA Ball form.

[h3]II. New Visual Display and Interactive Mode on the Home Page[/h3]
1. The Home page is now divided into two major sections: [The Herald's Trial] and [Showdown].
Each section has its own unique visual display.

Added the [Preparation] feature: In [The Herald's Trial], it is for equipping Talent Glyphs and Skills/Ultimates; In [Showdown], it is for heroes and Souljade cultivation, Potential, and the Showdown Shop.

Adjusted the [Select Mode] and [RANK] panels. They now display only relevant gameplay and content specific to their sections.

[h3]III. Match History[/h3]
1. Added match history for the Showdown mode.

[h3]IV. Justice Chamber[/h3]
1. Can take over the position of the Leader of the Justice Chamber now.
Co-Leaders may apply to become the Leader once the current Leader has been offline for 14 days. Members may apply to become the Leader once both the current Leader and Co-Leader have been offline for 14 days. Once a new Leader is appointed, the former Leader will lose their position and become a member again.

2. Newly added the Justice Chamber Tag
The chamber Leader can choose the suitable tags in [Edit the Justice Chamber].

[h3]V. Hero Voice[/h3]
Change the ultimate-casting voice line of enemy Akos Hu to the previous one.

[h3]VI. Collection Feature Optimizations[/h3]
After the upgrade, you can freely use the cosmetic from the previous level.

[h3]VII. Others[/h3]
1. Adjusted the initial level required to unlock [The Bloodbath] to 9.
2. Adjusted the initial level required to unlock the [BOT Mode - Medium] to 10 and to unlock the [BOT Mode - Hard] to 20.
3. The [RANK] feature is now unlocked by default.


[h2]Showdown Adjustments[/h2]
[h3]I. Mechanism Adjustments[/h3]
1. [Burn] and [Soaked] effects inflicted on enemies by different players now operate independently. Additionally, [Burn] or [Soaked] effects from different sources can stack on the same enemy.
For example: (1) Player A and Player B each use the Souljade [Cloudscorch] to attack the same enemy. This enemy will have a total of 2 stacks of [Burn] from the two players.
(2) Player A uses the Souljade [Cloudscorch] and the Souljade [Ember] to attack an enemy. This enemy has 1 stack of [Burn] from each respective Souljade.
2. The Hydroflare effects triggered by players using [Burn] and [Soaked] now operate separately.
Example: The [Hydroflare] effect will only activate when [Burn] and [Soaked] from Player A come into contact. [Burn] caused by Player B cannot work with [Soaked] from Player A to create the [Hydroflare] effect.
3. You can now see icons representing [Burn] and [Soaked] effects from you displayed next to the Boss's Health Bar.

[h3]II. Combat Adjustments[/h3]
1. Increased the startup frames of Omnius·Beast's Dragon's Coil.
2. Optimized visual display of Omnius·Umbra Scorch, Omnius·Umbra Rock, Matron of Yushan·Umbra, and Omnius·Umbra Aureate.

[h3]III. Souljade Adjustments[/h3]
1. Some Souljades are temporarily unavailable. They will be obtainable through other means in future versions. Players who already own these Souljades will not be affected and can continue to develop them. Below is the list of Souljades affected:
[Tracking Arrow], [Dealer Phantom], [Advanced Heal Crossbow], [Wave Roll], [Blue Moon], [Splitter], [Stamina Strike], [Dual Ring], [Venom Tip], [Scarlet Guanyin], and [Bounce Shell].
2. Optimized the overview of the following Souljades: [Thunderproof], [Condensed Qi], [Thunderpull], and [Tundra Might]. Optimized the detailed description of the Souljade effects of [Sub-Zero Seal] and [Desperation Shield].
3. [Burn] and [Fire Arrows]
Increased the burning multiplier per second from 0.3 to 0.4.
4. [Gunpowder]
Increased the burning multiplier per second from 0.25 to 0.4.

[h3]IV. Hero Adjustments[/h3]
1. Advanced the dodge timing for all heroes' Defuse Martial Skills.
2. Valda Cui
(1) Increased the Damage Multiplier of individual water bombs from [Water Trap: Showdown] from 0.3 to 0.4, with Aegis-break ability increased from 450 to 600.
(2) Increased the Aegis-break ability of the Horizontal Strike water spear from [Rising Tide: Showdown] from 350 to 1225, with the Damage Multiplier of the water spear's direct hit + explosion increased from 2.0+0.25 to 0.25+2.0.
(3) Adjusted the Attack reduction applied by [Soaked] from 10% to 5%.

[h3]V. Enigma Domain Adjustments[/h3]
1. During the temporary closure of the Enigma Peak in the Chasm Season, players can still claim rewards. Please stay tuned for further notice about the new season's Enigma Peak.
2. Added new map: Celestra
3. In the Enigma Domain, the Matron of Yushan has been replaced by Omnius·Aureate, the Fiery Monster has been replaced by Iron Taifeng, and the Frostbite Omens have been replaced by the Thunder Omens.

[h3]VI. Yama's Abyss Adjustments[/h3]
[olist]
[*] Added Korvine to the Yama's Abyss, and some of the bosses on certain stages have been adjusted.
[*] Introduced Sense Level to Yama's Abyss. Players below the recommended level will not be affected, but those above it will.
[*] Adjusted the fixed Omens appeared on Stage 26 and above.
[*] Adjusted the rules for distributing Enhancements during the preparation phase. Now, it is fixed to choose 1 Elemental Essence and 1 Rare Anima Ring, with an option of selecting up to 1 from a maximum of 5 Anima Rings. If at least one boss was defeated in the previous Yama's Abyss stage, 1 Anima Ring can be upgraded to an Epic Ring.
[*] The Souljade [Copper Ward] can be obtained from loots once again.
[*] Optimized the descriptions of the effects of the following Anima Rings: [Might·Robust], [Armor Conversion], [Might·High Roller], and [Wealth Confluence].
[*] The effect of the Anima Ring [Mighty Counter·Gale Blast] has been changed. After a successful Counter, trigger an Astral Gust, dealing damage equal to that of a Counterstrike Combo to nearby enemies. Has a 0.5 sec cooldown. The damage multiplier of the Astral Gust at Lv.1 has been increased from 2.5 to 5.6, and at Lv.2 and Lv.3, the damage coefficients are 1.7 and 2.5 times that of Lv.1, respectively.
[*] [Yin-Yang]-type Anima Rings will no longer appear in this Showdown Season.
[*] The Anima Ring [Backup Armor], [Dampen·Discharge], [Dampen·Resistance], [Dampen·Resilience], and [Frostbite Fortitude] will no longer be available this season.
[/olist]

[h3]VII. Feature Adjustments[/h3]
1. Upgrade Hero Changes
The cadence of content and the leveling speed had been adjusted. Martial Skills, Aegis-break and Defuse will now unlock earlier than before, and we've raised the leveling speed.

2. Increase the maximum Sense Level cap for Souljades dropped in all stages
This means that it is possible to get a max Sense Level Souljade as a stage drop. When the Sense Level of a stage drop is higher than the global drop level, the drop's level will be set to that of the global drop level.

We will also display the Souljade's original enhancement level cap. Both of these levels will continue increase slightly with each game update.

[h2]Feature Adjustments[/h2]
[h3]I. Client Optimizations[/h3]
1. Direct3D 12 has been updated and now uses FSR3, adding frame insertion functionality, thus greatly improving effects and framerate.
2. Added an asynchronous instantiation feature, which optimizes the amount of time used to load scenery resources, improving overall performance and reducing fluctuations.
3. Adjusted how numbers are generated in combat, reducing fluctuations in the heat of battle.

[h3]II. PlayStation Optimizations[/h3]
Reduced the loading cost of character facial animations for a more stable frame rate.

[h3]III. Xbox Optimizations[/h3]
1. Increased the efficiency of GraphicsJob and improved render rate.
2. Optimized skeletal animation rendering processes, and improved the character render rate.

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[h3]I. Showdown-related Bugs[/h3]
1. Fixed the problem where Hammer Evil-Ent failed to bounce back the Sword Energy after Countering.
2. Optimized the height of the locking position when locking on the Matron of Yushan.
3. Fixed the issue where the Omens [Divine Strikes] could potentially produce double Thundershock.

[h3]II. Other Bugs[/h3]
Fixed the Hairstyle [Torrent] display effect for Valda Cui in the hairstyle interface to make it closer to its appearance in battles.

[h2]Store Updates[/h2]
[h3]I. New Pack[/h3]
1. Newly added Shayol Wei exclusive Pack [Polar Night Pack], including Legendary outfit [Justice·Polar Night], Legendary Hairstyle [Justice·Aurora], Legendary Accessory [Justice·Immaculate], Legendary Pose [Dauntless]. Standard price: 5,700 Gold; Now: 2,880 Gold. Single items are discounted, and you get even more discounts when you purchase a Pack.

1. Soul Land Crossover Cosmetics are currently available with a discount. [Soul Land·Xiao Wu], [Soul Land·Conqueror] and others are discounted at the same rate as when they were initially added.
