notes.title: NARAKA: BLADEPOINT Update – Mar 7th, 2024
notes.content:
[h1]Dear players,[/h1]

The servers of NARAKA: BLADEPOINT will be suspended for maintenance from Mar 6th, 2024 23:00 (UTC) to Mar 7th, 2024 03:00 (UTC). We suggest you log out in advance and enter the game again after the maintenance.

The details for this update are as follows:

[h2]Brand New Content[/h2]

[h3]I. New Morus' Blessing Combat Item Available: White Tiger's Prowess[/h3]
The Heralds believe the mighty White Tiger's appearance to be a symbol of warfare, and that those with its blessing are destined for greatness in battle.
1. Effect Details: Instantly restores a set amount of Health, Armor, and Rage to all allied units, as well as restoring their Health over time (excess Health is restored as Armor). While the owner of White Tiger's Prowess survives, any allied unit will gain a permanent Melee Resist and Ranged Resist boost upon defeating an enemy. Additionally, whenever an ally defeats an enemy, the owner of the White Tiger's Prowess will unleash a shockwave with a range of 40m. Enemies hit by the shockwave will be dealt a percentage of damage to their Health. White Tiger's Prowess lasts for 180 sec. 
2. The new item can be acquired from Morus' Blessings across all modes of Realm of Yang as well as during the first and second rounds of Trios Immortal War.

[h3]II. Limited-time Event: Spring Prelude[/h3]
Event Duration: Mar 6, 2024 20:00 (UTC) - Mar 20, 2024 20:00 (UTC)
Redeem the rewards before: Mar 24, 2024 at 20:00 (UTC)
Event Rules: 
1. Open Stashes to find Bow Ties. Up to 10 can be obtained per day.
2. Use a Bow Tie on the event page to randomly unlock a Campus location. Unlock all the locations in an area to receive rewards, as well as a School Life Comic featuring Kurumi and Tessa. There are 7 areas to unlock in the event.
3. You'll receive 1 Spring Bow Tie upon first opening the event page each day. Use them to choose and unlock a Campus location.
4. After all 7 areas have been unlocked, Bow Ties and Spring Bow Ties can still be used on the event page to redeem Tae and Spectral Silk.

[h3]III. Limited-time Event: PlayStation® Tournaments #3[/h3]
We brandish swords to gain fame, the only heroes in this game. PlayStation® Tournaments #3 are available for a limited time!
Event Duration: Mar 7, 2024 20:00 (UTC) - Apr 10, 2024 20:00 (UTC).
Event Rules:
There are 3 quests available each week. Completing each weekly quest earns you 100 Honor Medals - MAR. You can claim more Medals in the mail after advancing in the tournaments, and the number of Medals awarded for each rank is as follows:
1st place: 300 Medals
2nd place: 200 Medals
3rd-4th place: 100 Medals
5th-8th place: 50 Medals 
Medals can be used for redeeming rewards and participating in rankings.
Tournament Start Time:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36350327/1d1e9f33844f3ec4d7830360581805c9aa676c3d.png[/img]

Start Time of the First Tournament:
    NA: Mar 8, 2024 03:00 (UTC)
    AS: Mar 8, 2024 11:00 (UTC)
    SEA: Mar 8, 2024 11:00 (UTC)
    EU: Mar 8, 2024 19:00 (UTC)

[h3]IV. Extended the Righteous Season[/h3]
The Righteous Season and the Righteous Battlepass have been extended to Apr 11th, 2024 00:00 (UTC)

[h2]Souljade Adjustments[/h2]

[h3]I. Dual Halberds Souljade[/h3]
Optimized the camera movements and effects of [Martial Art•Will-Form Hook].

[h3]II. Fan Souljade[/h3]
Fixed the bug where characters equipped with [Martial Art•Tai Chi Fan] were unable to counter while charging for Horizontal Strikes in a crouching stance.

[h2]In-game Adjustments[/h2]

[h3]I. Feature Optimizations[/h3]
1. Upon leaving the Realm of Yang, all Ultimate effects will now be automatically terminated.
2. The duration of Draco Storm has been changed to 180 seconds.

[h3]II. Hero Adjustments[/h3]
When in Ultimate status, Tianhai's jumping stomp skill now has an expanded impact range, along with his stomp skill when he is not grabbing anyone. Corresponding changes have also been applied in Showdown.

[h2]Out-game Adjustments[/h2]

[h3]I. Fairyland Penglai[/h3]
1. Made some QoL improvements to the Songbird Arena
(1) When interacting with an instrument, players will no longer receive "Public Challenge" requests.
(2) Players now have the option to "ignore all player requests for 5 minutes" on the challenge request popup.
(3) During a Songbird Arena combat, players can interact with the Songbird Monolith to access combat info.
(4) The cooldown period for initiating combat challenges now begins counting down after the end of the previous match.

[h3]II. Personal Information[/h3]
Now, your personal information will display your rankings on various leaderboards.

[h3]III. Friend List[/h3]
1. Players have a new option to indicate their online status as "Seeking Party".
2. Its visual effects have been optimized for a more appealing appearance.
3. It displays how many players are in the current team.

[h3]IV. Heroes Assemble[/h3]
A reminder popup will now appear when the Heroes Assemble event begins.

[h3]V. Place Marker Feature[/h3]
Players can now mark the warning range when refreshing warnings in Morus' Blessing and the Realm of Yang.

[h3]VI. Hero Voice[/h3]
A plethora of new voice lines have been added for each Hero.
//Dev Notes: These include messages such as "Need Armor" and "Mark the Morus' Blessing", allowing effective communication even when players don't turn on microphones.
VII. Free Training Optimization
Players can now try out the Weapon Skins in the Free Training mode before obtaining them.

[h3]VIII. Optimization of New Items and Voice Packs[/h3]
1. In Shop, recommended cosmetics are added for the new cosmetics.
2. The contents of Voice Packs can be listened to on the "New" page.
3. Can now jump to the "Audio" page to listen to Voice Packs that are a part of Packs.
4. Voice Packs can now be sent as gifts.

[h2]Showdown Adjustments[/h2]

[h3]I. Yama's Abyss Adjustments[/h3]
1. You can now challenge Yama's Abyss up to Stage 50.
2. The rules governing monsters' cooperative attacks within Yama's Abyss have been fine-tuned. In general, when a substantial number of monsters of the same type are present, fewer of these monsters will attack simultaneously. However, the likelihood of different types of monsters coordinating their attacks has slightly increased.
3. In the Souljade Attribute Interface, secondary Attributes generated by Souljade brought from outside Yama's Abyss will be highlighted in green.

[h3]II. Stage Adjustments[/h3]
1. Adjustments to Eventide Ember Stages:
(1) Some terrains and pathways in Eventide Ember have been optimized, along with corresponding adjustments to Evil-Ent Strongholds.
(2) The final boss in Eventide Ember has been replaced by Omnius·Umbra Scorch. Additionally, the Fiery Monsters have undergone attribute and move adjustments and now serve as minions within an earlier Evil-Ent Stronghold.

[h3]III. Feature Adjustments[/h3]
1. Showdown Leaderboard
New Feature: You can now view detailed information about the Souljade and Anima Rings used by players when they achieved their rankings on the leaderboard.
Please note that data prior to the introduction of this feature cannot be accessed.

[h3]IV. Combat Adjustment[/h3]
1. Reduced the damage of Omnius·Rock's slam with double hands.
2. The character model of the [Bow Evil-Ent] has been optimized to improve visibility in dark areas.

[h2]Store Updates[/h2]

[h3]I. New Packs[/h3]
1. Newly added Tessa exclusive Pack [Carmine Feather Pack (Tessa)], including Legendary Outfit [Spring Prelude·Carmine Feather], Legendary Hairstyle [Spring Prelude·Ethereal Crystal], Legendary Accessory [Spring Prelude·Little Fox]. Standard price: 3,500 Gold; Now: 2,400 Gold.

[h3]II. New Discounts[/h3]
1. Newly added Tessa Legendary Accessory [Cloudy Fox].
Standard price: 1,200 Gold; Now: 800 Gold.
2. Newly added Epic Emote Gesture [Stamp Feet] for all heroes.
Standard price: 300 Gold; Now: 180 Gold.
3. Kurumi Legendary Outfit [Spring Prelude·Morning Breeze].
Standard price: 1,800 Gold; Now: 1,500 Gold.
4. Kurumi Epic Hairstyle [Spring Prelude·Early-Flowering Cherry].
Standard price: 500 Gold; Now: 400 Gold.
5. Kurumi Legendary Accessory [Spring Prelude·Ice Cream].
Standard price: 900 Gold; Now: 750 Gold.
6. Kurumi Legendary Pose [Spring Prelude·Pounding Heartbeat].
Standard price: 900 Gold; Now: 750 Gold.
7. Tianhai Legendary Accessory [Ice Vajra Bangle] (Unlock it to get a new appearance for Tianhai's Ultimate "Titan's Call").
Standard price: 500 Gold; Now: 360 Gold.
8. Legendary Emote Gesture [Pop Dance·Left] for all heroes.
Standard price: 1,200 Gold; Now: 900 Gold.
9. Legendary Emote Gesture [Pop Dance·Right] for all heroes.
Standard price: 1,200 Gold; Now: 900 Gold.


[h3]III. Event Ended[/h3]
1. Limited-time discounts for the Legendary cosmetics of Season 8: Reckoning Season and previous seasons have ended. Legendary Outfit 40% discount vouchers, Legendary Weapon 40% discount vouchers, Legendary Accessory 40% discount vouchers and other Legendary Item 40% discount vouchers will expire.
2. The limited-time return of the Bruce Lee-themed outfits has ended.

[h3]IV. New Items in the Item Store[/h3]
1. In the "Item" store, [Surmount Card·Righteous] is now available. Use to upgrade Hidden Treasure of Righteous Season by 30 levels. The price of [Surmount Card·Righteous] is 1800 Gold, purchase limit is 1.

[h2]Client Optimization[/h2]

1. Optimized character skeleton processing on Fairyland Penglai.
2. Optimized the character skeleton processing for faces during battles.
3. Optimized the animation processing for characters' Grappling Hooks.
4. Optimized shadow processing.
5. When Shayol Wei use a Ranged Weapon in the Extreme Outfit [Rectitude], there will be a blast effect.
6. Improved the effects of the wings for Justina Gu's Extreme Outfit [Star - Rimefrost Fairy].
7. Adjusted the Outfits sorting, the newer Outfits will be sorted on top if under the same quality.

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]

[h3]I. Hero-related Bugs[/h3]
1. Fixed the issue where Shayol Wei, in Ultimate status, experienced abnormalities when triggering [Black Tortoise Block] or switching weapons upon being countered.
2. Fixed the bug where Shayol Wei's [Black Tortoise Block] was interrupted when sliding down slopes in certain circumstances.
3. Fixed the problem where some Skills and Ultimates could be interrupted through certain interactions.


[h3]II. Weapon-related Bugs[/h3]
The issue where "Quick Counter" had a chance of not activating while moving backward has been fixed.

[h3]III. Showdown-related Bugs[/h3]
1. Fixed the bug where an incorrect increase in Viper Ning's counterattack damage when she depleted all Defuse slots by using the [Defuse·Counterattack] Souljade.
2. Fixed the bug preventing Feria Shen, equipped with the [Swift Heal] Souljade, from properly triggering its effect when using recovery items on the Bronze Mech.
3. The character model of the [Bow Evil-Ent] has been optimized to improve visibility in dark areas.

[h3]IV. Others[/h3]
1. Corrected the calculation for awarding Fragrant Jade after a match in the Songbird Arena.
2. Fixed the abnormal posture of Tarka Ji during his "Severed Thorns" pose on the character display interface.

Dear players,

NARAKA: BLADEPOINT is committed to creating a fair and healthy competitive environment. We have not only used new anti-cheat technologies, but also established special cheat-reporting reward activities to encourage those players who defend the fairness with us. From now on, players who make outstanding contributions to reporting cheats will get the Legendary spear skin 'Righteous Polearm' .

More details:
1. Players who successfully reported 1 time will get [Immortal Treasure] X1;

2. Players who successfully report 10 times with low misreport rate will get [Immortal Treasure] X10 (In order to ensure the efficiency of detecting, please report reasonably);

3. Players who have successfully reported for many times or made great contributions to anti-cheat will get the Legendary spear skin [Righteous Polearm] X1.

We strongly recommend that players report via in-game report system, so that we can confirm the cheat as soon as possible and record successful report times for you!

From 1.29 to 2.4, there are 14 players who have successfully reported the cheating or hacking in total and get the reward [Righteous Polearm]! We hope that more players can become the Justice Supporter on the Morus Isle in the future.

notes.title: NARAKA: BLADEPOINT Update – Feb 1st, 2024
notes.content:
[h1]Dear players,[/h1]

The servers of NARAKA: BLADEPOINT will be suspended for maintenance from January 31st, 2024 at 23:00 (UTC) to February 1st, 2024 at 03:00 (UTC). We suggest you log out in advance and enter the game again after the maintenance.

The details for this update are as follows:

[h2]Brand New Content[/h2]

[h3]I. New Hero: Shayol Wei[/h3]
Shayol joins the King's Judiciary as a youth, cracking every case that crossed her desk and passing judgment with unsurpassed skill and speed.

After being dispatched to the south, Shayol follows a trail of breadcrumbs across the country, tracking the criminals' trail for hundreds of leagues.

Shayol Wei, Chief of the Golden Keepers, swears to ensure that the truth will always come to light.

[h3]II. Spring Lantern·Rui available for a limited time[/h3]
The Spring Lantern·Rui is priced at 360 Gold. Open for a chance to obtain rewards like Shayol Extreme Outfit [Rectitude] and the Heng Sword Extreme Skin [Yi's Will].
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36350327/99dc15a00df99a6efc293b5ad6ebb9590f12c59d.jpg[/img]
[b]Minimum Guarantee:[/b]
1. Players are guaranteed to receive at least 1 Red (Extreme) reward during the process of opening at most 100 Treasures. This can be triggered multiple times.​ 
2. Red (Extreme) rewards will not repeat until all of them have been obtained.

[b]Wishing Legendary Reward: [/b]
If you draw an Extreme cosmetic, you can set a Legendary cosmetic which will be guaranteed when you draw a Legendary cosmetic next time. Times of guarantee can stack, but you can only set 1 cosmetic each time.

[h3]III. Fairyland Penglai Brand-new Gameplay[/h3]
[b]1. Songbird Arena[/b]
The Songbird Palace area in Fairyland Penglai has been updated and renamed as Songbird Arena.
Interact with the Arena Monolith to initiate a challenge request to all players on Fairyland Penglai or to specific players. (Challenges to designated players are not limited to being in the same Fairyland Penglai.)

After the player accepts, both parties will be teleported to the Arena for a 1V1 battle!
Other players in the room can spectate and send gifts to support players.

[u]Rules Info[/u]
[olist]
[*] By default, the current hero and weapon used on Fairyland Penglai will be used in the Arena. If you want to change them, please change the displayed heroes and weapons in the lobby.
[*] The player initiating the challenge can set the battle rules, such as the victory conditions, whether to enable the Grappling Hook, and whether to enable skills or ultimates.
[*] "Public Challenge" can challenge all players in the current Fairyland Penglai; "Challenge" can invite the specified player (regardless of their current location), and they will automatically teleport to the current scene upon accepting the invitation.
[*] Navigate to Settings - Social - Fairyland Penglai to customize your preferences for challenge invitations and battle notifications.
[*] Players can only initiate or accept challenges once their account reaches Lv.10 or above.
[/olist]
[b]2. Spring Festival Exclusive[/b]
(1) Koi Lantern·Fu
Interact with the Koi Lantern·Fu in the map to obtain a random part of the lantern. Find players who have other parts and complete the lantern together!

During the Spring Festival event, participate in the completion of Koi Lantern·Fu or Castell to obtain event rewards.

(2) Prosperity Firecracker
During the event, a Red Packet Shower will descend in front of the Pantheon on Fairyland Penglai at the start of every hour (based on the timezone of UTC+0).

Moreover, by using Prosperity Firecrackers, you can trigger a Prosperity Red Packet Shower in your name for all players on Fairyland Penglai. There is also a chance to become Caishen!

The rewards for the two types of Red Packet Showers are different. Wishing everyone good luck!

(3) Fairyland Penglai Spring Festival Scene
The Fairyland Penglai is decorated anew to celebrate the coming festival. May you all enjoy good fortune and wealth in the Year of the Dragon!

[h3]IV. New Social Feature: Gift[/h3]
1. You can now use [Gift Items] on other players in the match settlement screen or in Fairyland Penglai; [Gifts] are always the best choice, no matter whether you're celebrating a joint victory in the Herald's Trial or toasting to a music maestro in Fairyland Penglai.

2. "Giving a rose to someone leaves a fragrance in your own hand." The new reward exchange item, [Fragrant Jade], can be used in the [Gift Store] to exchange for Legendary Gestures and Background, Brocade Treasures, and more.

How to get [Fragrant Jade]:
(1) Send gifts to other players to get [Fragrant Jade]
(2) Engage in the Fairyland Penglai Songbird Arena, whether as a participant or spectator. As the total Trend Points exceed 2,000, the rewards increase accordingly. Aim for higher Trend Points to unlock greater rewards. (Maximum of 50 Fragrant Jades per week).

3. The player who receives the gift will get the followings:
[olist]
[*] Add [Popularity]: Now displayed in your personal profile, tap to view your gift history and ranking. The previous number of [Likes] is incorporated into Popularity points, and every Like received contributes to its growth. Players can earn up to 500 Popularity per week through Likes. Additionally, new Hero Badge [Popularity] will be unlocked based on your Popularity points.
[*] Increase [Intimacy]
[*] Increase the [Trend Points]. The [Trend Points] of both sides in Songbird Arena will increase due to the Gifts accepted or the increase in the number of spectators.
[/olist]

4. New Giftable Items: [Scented Sachet], [Drum of War], [Kite], and [Firework]. (Can only be used on Fairyland Penglai)

How to get [Giftable Items]:
(1) Can be obtained through weekly rewards
(2) Purchase from the Shop

[h3]V. Spring Festival Limited-time Events[/h3]
[b]1. Spring Festival Flavor[/b]
Event Duration: Jan 31, 2024 20:00 (UTC) - Mar 3, 2024 20:00 (UTC).
Redeem the rewards before: Mar 6, 2024 at 20:00 (UTC)

[u]Event Rules:[/u]
[olist]
[*] During the event, explore each of the four chapters' maps to aid the Four Heavenly Kings in finding earthly delicacies.
[*] Upon entering the event for the first time each day and by completing chapter quests of the event, players will receive some of the Action Item [Tasty Buns]. Consuming [Tasty Buns] enables players to explore the event maps. [Tasty Buns] can also be obtained through the [Splendid Spring] event.
[*] Players can use [Heavenly Orders] to instantly complete a chapter quest. [Heavenly Orders] can be obtained through the [New Year Roll Call] event.
[*] Each chapter features two Objectives. Upon successful exploration, players can unlock chapter Rewards.
[*] In addition to chapter rewards, each chapter also offers other rewards for exploration. Remember to explore areas beyond the Objective Points for additional rewards.
[*] After the event comes to an end, all remaining [Tasty Buns] can be redeemed into the same amount of Spectral Silk on the event page.
[/olist]

[b]2. New Year Roll Call[/b]
Event Duration: Feb 8, 2024 20:00 (UTC) - Mar 3, 2024 20:00 (UTC).

[u]Event Rules:[/u]
During this event, check in 7 days in total to get Spring Festival Flavor Items and rewards including Heavenly Order, Spring Lantern·Rui, Peerless Treasure Choice Gift, etc.

[b]3. Splendid Spring[/b]
Event Duration: Feb 7, 2024 20:00 (UTC) - Mar 6, 2024 20:00 (UTC).
[u]Event Rules:[/u]
[olist]
[*] During the event, players can use Dragon Ingots to open exclusive Four Heavenly Kings Red Packets. Opening these Red Packets can yield a variety of great rewards.
[*] Players can acquire Dragon Ingots by opening Stashes in the Survival Modes, joining in Heroes Assemble during the event time (will be available on Feb 22, 2024 at 03:00 UTC) or by visiting the Shop - Gift and redeeming Fragrant Jade for the Ingots.
[*] The event runs for one round per week, four rounds in total. At the start of each round, the number of obtainable Four Heavenly Kings Red Packets and Dragon Ingots will be refreshed.
[*] After the event comes to an end, players can still draw prizes until Mar 10, 2024 at 20:00 (UTC), but can no longer get Dragon Ingots.
[/olist]

[b]4. Fortune's Arrival[/b]
Event Duration: Jan 31, 2024 20:00 (UTC) - Mar 7, 2024 00:00 (UTC).

[u]Event Rules:[/u]
During the event, a Red Packet shower will descend on Fairyland Penglai at the start of every hour (based on the timezone of UTC+0), providing players with the opportunity to collect free [Fortune Red Packets] of the Year of the Dragon. 

Spend Gold during the event to acquire [Prosperity Firecrackers]. Interact with Fairyland Penglai's cannon to trigger a special Red Packet shower in your name, granting [Prosperity Red Packets]. Open them for fantastic rewards, and a chance to win thrilling gifts like Martial Trial Treasure Choice Gift *50 and Peerless Treasure Choice Gift *50!

After triggering a certain number of Prosperity Red Packet Showers, you will receive a customized Collection from the Caishen series, which includes a Bubble, an Avatar, a Head Accessory and a Chat Bubble!

[h3]VI. Limited-time Event: Law Guardian[/h3]
[previewyoutube=OodSnGjERjY;full][/previewyoutube]
In the ever-changing world, she places her trust in the blade she wields, her discerning gaze, and the heart that yearns for truth.

Event Time: Jan 31, 2024 20:00 (UTC) - Feb 21, 2024 20:00 (UTC).
Redeem the rewards before: Feb 26, 2024 at 20:00 (UTC)

[u]Event Rules:[/u]
[olist]
[*] Gain Shayol Wei Trial Voucher and Secret Order by completing Daily Quests.
[*] Gain Secret Order by completing quests during the event. Unlock a new quest after completing the previous quest. Quests cannot be completed before they take effect.
[*] Use Secret Order to redeem certain rewards.
[/olist]

[h3]VII. Limited-time Event: PlayStation® Tournaments #2[/h3]
We brandish swords to gain fame, the only heroes in this game. PlayStation® Tournaments #2 are available for a limited time!

Event Duration: Feb 1, 2024 20:00 (UTC) - Mar 6, 2024 20:00 (UTC).

[u]Event Rules:[/u]
Complete daily quests during the event to claim 100 Honor Medals - FEB. You can claim more Medals in the mail after advancing, and the quantity awarded for each rank is as follows:
[list]
[*] 1st place: 300 Medals
[*] 2nd place: 200 Medals
[*] 3rd-4th place: 100 Medals
[*] 5th-8th place: 50 Medals 
[/list]
Medals can be used for redeeming rewards and participating in rankings.

Start Time of Tournament:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36350327/7da2994c5b225fcab2cc09518bb779aa65ff7584.png[/img]
First-Round Tournament Start Time (UTC):
[list]
[*] NA: 2024.02.02 03:00
[*] AS: 2024.02.02 11:00
[*] SEA: 2024.02.02 11:00
[*] EU: 2024.02.02 19:00 
[/list]

[h3]VIII. Spring Lantern·Rui with bonus Star - Collections[/h3]
Event Duration: Feb 1, 2024 Update - May 4, 2024 00:00 (UTC).
[olist]
[*] When opening Spring Lantern·Rui, there is a chance to receive the Extreme Outfit, Star - Rimefrost Fairy and the Legendary Outfit, Star - Martial Legend.
[*] How to obtain: Each time opening a Spring Lantern·Rui, there is a chance to obtain them as an additional reward. This chance increases as you obtain more Legendaries. The Maximum chance is 100%
[*] The chances for the 2 Star-Collections are calculated separately and do not impact each other. After getting a Star-Collection, the corresponding chances will then reset.
[*] Each account can receive a maximum of 10 [Star - Rimefrost Fairy] and 2 [Star - Martial Legend].
[*] The number of Star-Collections granted through the Spring Lantern·Rui is limited and available while stocks last.
[/olist]
[h3]IX. Limited-time Event: Spring Festival Special Offer[/h3]
Event Duration: From the Feb 1st, 2024 Update to Mar 6, 2024 at 20:00 (UTC).

[u]Event Rules:[/u]
[olist]
[*] During the event, 4 kinds of vouchers are claimable on the event page: Legendary Outfit 40% discount voucher, Legendary Weapon 40% discount voucher, Legendary Accessory 40% discount voucher and other Legendary Item 40% discount voucher. There are 2 of each voucher type to be claimed.
[*] Use a voucher when purchasing the corresponding Legendary cosmetic with Gold, and you'll get a 40% discount. These discounts cannot be applied when purchasing gifts for friends.
[*] Please note that vouchers are only eligible for the Legendary cosmetics of Season 8: Reckoning Season and previous seasons.
[*] Vouchers are valid for a limited time only. Make sure you use yours before it expires.
[/olist]

[h2]Hero Adjustments[/h2]

[h3]I. Hadi[/h3]
Reduced the dash distance of the charged attack in flight state and slightly delayed the timing for capable dodging or attacking after the charged dash move.

[h3]II. Tessa[/h3]
Slightly increased the interactive range for all Soul Vessels under Ultimate, so as to optimize the interaction.

[h2]Weapon Adjustments[/h2]

[h3]I. General Adjustments for all Melee Weapons[/h3]
The weapon switch can now be pre-input earlier during the Uppercut Slash move.

[h3]II. Heng Sword[/h3]
1. Slightly increased the stagger time caused by Straight Lunge and Lethal Jab on hit.
2. Slightly delayed the timing for a capable combo after hitting with Straight Lunge and Lethal Jab.
3. Reduced the disengagement value caused by hits of follow-up horizontal strikes launched after Straight Lunge or Lethal Jab.

[h3]III. Spear[/h3]
Accelerated the follow-up move timing when the Precise Charged Attack misses.

[h2]Souljade Adjustments[/h2]

[h3]I. Fan Souljade[/h3]
New Souljade: [Martial Art·Tai Chi Fan]

[h2]In-game Adjustments[/h2]

[h3]I. Feature Optimizations[/h3]
1. Moonbane Slaying
[list]
[*] The Moonbane Slaying gameplay will appear by chance in the Herald's Trial (Solo and Duos) and Quick Match (Solo, Duos, and Trios).
[*] The chance that Moonbane Slaying gameplay will appear has increased.
[/list]
2. In BOT Mode, when all team members have selected their heroes, spawn points, and left the quest interface, the countdown during the preparation stage will be directly reduced to 15 sec so as to decrease the waiting time in the preparation stage.

[h2]Out-Game Adjustments[/h2]

[h3]I. Brand-new Feature: [Hero's Theme][/h3]
The golden blade upholds justice, while the mirror reflects her righteous heart.
Shayol Wei exclusive theme [Wielding the Golden Blade] is now available. Equipping it changes the Hero's [Combat BGM].

[h3]II. Gestures Sync[/h3]
Some gestures now support synchronized playing with other players.
When another player within 6m is playing a gesture, aim at them, open the wheel, and select the same gesture for a synced playing with them.

The following gestures support synchronization:
[list]
[*] [Dragon Will·One Inch Punch]
[*] [Dragon Will·Jeet Kune Do]
[*] [Smooth Combo·Subject Three]
[*] [Tianhai·Shaolin Staff]
[*] [Wuchen·Tai-Chi Fan]
[*] [Zai·Hexa-Harmony Spear]
[*] [Tessa·Will-Form Hook]
[*] [Feria Shen·Octa-Slash Blade]
[*] [Journey of Blades·Elegance]
[*] [Journey of Blades·Web Veil]
[*] [Journey of Blades·Alluring Bones]
[*] [Tessa·Fan Dance]
[*] [Poetic Rhymes·Fish Dragon Dance]
[*] [Fuchun Mountains·Gleaming Peak]
[*] [Pop Dance·Right]
[*] [Pop Dance·Left]
[/list]
[h3]III. Collection Points for Star-Collections[/h3]
1. Each Star-Collection owned contributes to your Collection Points.

2. The Collection Points of each Star-Collection equals the sum of Basic Collection Points and Constellation Collection Points.

Basic Collection Points: Each Star-Collection has a fixed number of Collection Points before restyling.
Constellation Collection Points: The points are based on the number of revealed Constellations and their quality. Constellation Collection Points vary with the actual restyle result.

3. When you lose a Star-Collection, the Collection Points from the Collection will also be removed.
After the update, all Star-Collections you own grant you Collection Points in the corresponding amount.

[h3]IV. Fairyland Penglai[/h3]
[b]Sky-high Racing[/b]
Optimized the display of the number of players on the track and reduced instances where players are blocked by others.

[h2]Showdown Adjustments[/h2]

[h3]I. New Content[/h3]
[b]1. New Showdown Souljades:[/b]
[list]
[*] [Arcane Thunder]: Using skill or ultimate will trigger a high-damage Thunderbolt at the closest enemy.
[*] [Tundra Might]: Attack is increased by 10%, and Frostbite damage dealt by attacks is increased by 40% for 5 sec whenever your Frostbite increases.
[*] [Frozen Blast]: Ice Blast DMG is increased by 25%, and the cooldown of Ice Blast is reduced by 33%, but Max Frostbite is reduced by 450.
[/list]
The above Souljades will drop in Yama's Abyss after Stage 25 and in the new Void Space stage.

[b]2. New stages of Yama's Abyss:[/b]
New stage: Void Space. There are three different sub-stages for Void Space. You can unlock them when you clear Stages 25, 30, and 35 in Yama's Abyss respectively. Void Space introduces easier challenges, more blessings and, a longer game.

[i]//Dev Notes: We aim to provide a Yama's Abyss gameplay experience with less pressure, encouraging players to try different builds.[/i]

[h3]II. Yama's Abyss Adjustments[/h3]
1. You can now challenge Yama's Abyss up to Stage 48.

2. New Anima Rings. The Awakening: [Thunder Array] and [Incessant Thunder Array]; The Yin-Yang: [Yin Yang Soulseek]; The Survival: [Armor Recovery Passive], [Armor Recovery Shockwave], and [Armor Loss Slide].

3. Starting from Stage 26 of Yama's Abyss, each stage will have a fixed set of "Stage Omens" effective throughout the stage, eliminating random Omens in-game (except in Hard-mode monster areas). Additionally, a large number of new Omens will be added to Yama's Abyss.
From Stage 26, the Health of all monsters in both Solo and Trios in Yama's Abyss will be significantly reduced (0%–30%, higher reduction at higher stages), and the Attack of all monsters in Trios will be significantly reduced (0–40%, higher reduction at higher stages).

[i]//Dev Notes: We aim to enrich the combat experience across different stages without increasing the difficulty.[/i]

4. New area: Money Hungry. You have a chance to encounter this area during a Yama's Abyss game.

5. Anima Ring Effect Changes
(1) The quality of Anima Rings [White-Blue: Yang Emergence] and [Blue-White: Yin Resurgence] are modified from Epic to Rare.
The damage multiplier of Level 1 [Yang Decay] has been reduced from 1.4 to 0.6. The damage multiplier of Level 1 [Yin Haze] has been reduced from 0.5 to 0.1, and its Aegis-breaking ability has been reduced from 400 to 300.
(2) Level 1 effect of Anima Ring [Yin Haze Corruption] while above 50% Health:
 · Previous: the damage from [Yin Haze] increases by 100%. 
 · Now: the damage to 'Astral Aegis' from [Yin Haze] increases by 160%
Level 1 effect of Anima Ring [Yang Decay Eroding] while above 50% Health:
 · Previous: the damage from [Yang Decay] increases by 100%. 
 · Now: the damage from [Yang Decay] increases by 160%.

[i]//Dev Notes: In previous versions, Yin-Yang Anima Rings were scarce and challenging to build; in the new version, we hope to address this by lowering quality and adding new Anima Rings.[/i]

(3) The effects of Anima Rings [Fortified Armor], [Armor Conversion], and [Armor Synergy] are now based on the Max Armor gained from Anima Rings and Souljades instead of only from Anima Rings.
(4) Matari can now trigger Thunderbolt with her Aegis-break Martial Skill [Dancing Leaves] when equipped with Anima Ring [Lightning Rod·Swift].

6. Lowered the AI difficulty of all normal monsters and some Boss monsters in the first 3 stages and replaced the appearances of Fiery Monster with Mountain Ghost.

7. Reduced the frequency of Nerusa's attacks in Hard-mode monster areas.

8. Enemies spawned by the curse [Powerful Foe] will no longer use Ultimate skills.

9. The Anima Ring provided at the initial level has been adjusted from [Blessed Weapon Repair Kit] to [Enhanced Thunderbolt]

10. Adjusted the recommendation logic for certain Souljades

[h3]III. Potential Adjustments[/h3]
The following potentials in the red potential branch have been modified:
[olist]
[*] [Honed Skills] -> [Divine Thunderfall]. It causes a Thunderbolt to strike at the nearest enemy every 2 sec while in Honed status.
[*] [Divine Ultimate] -> [Caller of Lightning]. It grants Honed status and 15% Thunderbolt damage boost for 25 sec after unleashing Ultimate.
[*] [Honed Apparatus] -> [Divine Storm]. It increases Thunderbolt damage by 40% and grants extra elemental accumulation.
[*] [Valiant Spirit]: Now increases DMG to Boss instead of reducing DMG taken from non-Boss monsters.
[*] [Divine Hunt]: Each monster you assist in defeating now grants you the Honed status for 5 sec instead of 3.
[*] [Divine Rider]: Become Honed for 9 sec instead of 6 upon having attacked 3 different enemies within 10 sec.
[/olist]

[h3]IV. Hero Adjustments[/h3]
[olist]
[*] The invulnerability duration of Tianhai's [Brahma Seal] has been increased, and [Defuse·Combo]'s attack resistance takes effect earlier.
[*] Adjusted the hit effect of [Onslaught] and [Arhat's Fury] of Tianhai with Staff in Showdown so that enemies won't be knocked airborne for too long a distance.
[*] The invulnerability duration of Tarka Ji's [Blazing Phoenix Flash] has been increased, and [Defuse·Combo]'s attack resistance takes effect earlier.
[*] The Focus of Tarka Ji's [Flame Force: Showdown] is now Golden Focus.
[*] The Focus of Valda Cui's [Water Trap: Showdown] is now Golden Focus.
[*] While playing as Valda Cui, the moves [Winter Frost] and [Heavenly Flaming Strike] can be interrupted by dodging or jumping at any time.
[*] The mechanisms for unleashing a hero's [Aegis-break Martial Skill] while using [Defuse·Solve] have been unified. Kurumi now unleashes [Severing Gust] with a vertical strike instead of a horizontal strike after a charged attack.
[*] Increased the damage multipliers of [Dragonslayer] and [Heartstopper Kick] from 1.41 to 6.97.
      Adjusted the damage multiplier of [Nezha] from (0.42+0.53+0.69)*2 to (1.31+1.74+2.18)*2.
      [Dragonslayer], [Heartstopper Kick], and [Nezha] no longer have additional Aegis-breaking abilities.
[*] Increased the damage multiplier of [Arhat's Fury] from 1.1*2 to 1.26*2.
[*] Increased the damage multiplier of [Brahma Seal] from 0.31*7 to 0.36*7.
[*] Increased the damage multiplier of Dual Blades Souljade [Cavalry Bloom·Ice-wielding] from 1.08*6 to 1.31*6.
[/olist]

[h3]V. Feature Adjustments[/h3]
[b]1. Souljade Conversion[/b]
[Souljade Conversion] has been renamed to [Advanced Souljade Conversion], and a [Basic Souljade Conversion] feature has been added. Using [Basic Souljade Conversion], you can convert 20 Rare and Common Souljades into 1 random Epic or Legendary Souljade.

[b]2. Hero Selection in Showdown[/b]
While in Showdown mode, you can now select duplicate heroes in Normal/Hard Main Mode and in Yama's Abyss before Stage 25.

[b]3. Brand-new Anima Ring Collection Hero Badge[/b]
A new Hero Badge [Rings of Chasm] has been added to the game, which can be unlocked by progressing in the Anima Ring collection during the Chasm Season.

[b]4. Season Settlement Time Adjustment[/b]
We have postponed the settlement time of [Showdown 1.0 Chasm] from March 7 to March 21, and postponed the expiration time of Showdown Pass accordingly.

[i]//Dev Notes: In the first season of Showdown, we continuously adjusted and optimized Yama's Abyss by making significant changes, especially in the current version. Therefore, we want everyone to have more time to challenge and reach higher tiers, during which we can also better prepare the content for the next season.[/i]

[h3]VI. Combat Adjustments[/h3]
[olist]
[*] The Health of Boss monsters in the last 4 waves and the Astral Aegis of Boss monsters in the last wave of Enigma Peak have been reduced.
[*] The Attack of Omnius·Hell Scorch has been reduced in Omnius Descent (Normal).
[*] The flight speed of ghostly underlings summoned by Omnius·Hell Scorch in Omnius Descent has been reduced, and they cannot interrupt Golden Focus moves.
[*] The ranged chasing moves of Omnius·Hell Scorch, Omnius·Aureate, and Omnius·Beast, as well as Iron Taifeng's 4-hit combo, all now knock targets airborne.
[*] Omnius·Beast's water bombs and the minor water tornadoes created by its major water tornado, as well as Omnius·Void's water wall, can all now hit dodging targets.
[*] The weak points of Omnius·Aureate will not recover when broken.
[*] Optimized some of Iron Taifeng's attacks and the startup frames for some of its moves.
[*] Thunderspawns and Cursespawns can now block attacks with moves only when there is the Omen [Banner of Metal].
[*] Axe Evil-Ents, Bow Evil-Ents, Thunderspawns and Cursespawns can now dodge only when there are certain Omens.
 Axe Evil-Ent: It can dodge when there are Omens [Icy Blast Axe], [Icy Axe], and [Split Axe].
 Bow Evil-Ent: It can dodge when there is the Omen [Relentless Volley].
 Thunderspawns and Cursespawns: They can dodge when there is the Omen [Banner of Metal].
[*]  Thunderspawns and Cursespawns: The interval of Miasma Ghost summoning and the Omen [Double Trouble] are increased.
[*] When a Thunderspawn or a Cursespawn uses their healing move, it will now only restore their own Health, not the Health of other Thunderspawns and Cursespawns.
[*] Reduced the ranged attack resistance of all ranged monsters by 20%.
[*] The Hammer Evil-Ents in Eventide Ember (Normal) can now only use single Blue Focus moves.
[*] You can now view the duration of Honed status obtained from your Potential in the upper left of the screen.
[*] You can now see your cooldowns for triggering Ice Blast or Divine Thunder beside the Boss's Health Bar.
[*] The Armor restored for you by the Omen [Ice Flower] when it is attacked has been reduced.
[/olist]

[h2]Settings[/h2]

[h3]I. Combat Settings[/h3]
Added "Justina Gu Shadowswipe's Pulling Settings":
After turning this on, the skills "Shadowswipe" and "Shadowswipe: Blizzard" derived from Justina Gu's Ultimate "Arctic Wraith" and "Arctic Wraith: Blizzard" have been optimized. Now, if either move hits any enemy during the dash and the player then uses a melee attack to cancel the dash, that attack will have a slightly improved melee auto-aim and pulling effect, prioritizing targets hit by the dash.

[h3]Feature Optimizations[/h3]
Appropriately optimized the lighting performance of character skins without affecting performance.

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]

[h3]I. Hero-related Bugs[/h3]
[olist]
[*] Fixed an issue where Tarka Ji's skills [Flame Force] and [Flame Force: Block] couldn't block Draco Storm and the effects of the Souljade [Stormstride].
[*] Fixed an issue where some heroes' ranged skills could pass through invisible walls.
[*] Fixed an issue where enemies linked by Viper Ning's Ultimate [Moonbane Control] could break the link by repeatedly crouching next to a wall.
[/olist]

[h3]II. Showdown-related Bugs[/h3]
[olist]
[*] Fixed an audio issue that would occur when players successfully used Souljade [Thunder Counter] to counter Divine Thunder.
[*] Fixed an issue in Yama's Abyss where players couldn't move after entering the first Zone.
[*] Fixed an issue where Viper Ning's Ultimate could be interrupted by weapon attacks if she used her Ultimate right after using a Defuse move.
[/olist]

[h3]III. Controller-related Bug[/h3]
1. Fixed an issue where button combinations, like LB + X, would conflict with one another while using a controller.

[h3]IV. PlayStation-related Bug[/h3]

The 2023 J Cup came to a successful conclusion on December 17th, 2023. We would like to express our gratitude to each and every participant for delivering an exciting competition. notes.title: Changes to Hero Skills - Overview
notes.content:
[h2]Hey Forerunners, [/h2]

In this post, we will discuss the upcoming changes to hero skills and explain why they were made. We'll also address common questions and concerns in the following FAQ below. We recognize that this change is huge and changes some of the skills that players may have gotten used to, however, this change was made in the best interest of the game.


[h3]1)Why are you making changes to hero skills? [/h3]

Our goal is to ensure that every hero is viable and can be used in different ways to create an enjoyable gameplay experience for all players. By analyzing the data, we have identified certain skill variants that have very low usage rates. To address this, we are implementing a comprehensive revamp of our skills by streamlining the skill variants from three versions to two more polished options.

[h3]2)Why are some skill variants experiencing low usage rates?[/h3]

There can be various reasons for skill variants to have low usage rates. It could be due to balancing issues, where certain variants may feel underpowered or overshadowed by others. It could also be due to certain variants having specific usage conditions that make them less appealing or practical in most gameplay scenarios. The current meta and player preferences can also influence the skill variants.

These factors can contribute to skill variants having low usage rates, and it is important for us to identify and address these issues to ensure a balanced and engaging gameplay experience for all players.

[h3]3)Will all heroes be affected by the skill revamp?[/h3]

[previewyoutube=jXIpYKdzamI;full][/previewyoutube]
Our newest hero, Shayol Wei, Justice Vigilant, will be the first to launch with only two variants to her skill and ultimate. Eventually, all heroes will undergo a skill revamp to improve and update them—ensuring they remain playable, viable, and aligned with the current standards of the game.

Shayol Wei is currently available on the test server, and players can try her out before she becomes available in the game on JAN 31 PT. Follow this guide if you’re interested and let us know your thoughts! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36350327/3b42c723069da5d857b4cec2eb910c2daffab3c5.jpg[/img]

[h3]4)Will these changes make heroes more or less versatile?[/h3]

We believe that these skill revamps will enhance the overall balance and diversity of hero skills. Each hero will become more versatile and enjoyable to play as these changes take effect. 

As always, balancing hero versatility with overall gameplay balance is a priority, and we will continue to monitor and make adjustments to find the optimal balance between hero diversity and competitive gameplay.


[h3]5)When can we expect to see these skill revamps implemented?[/h3]

The skill revamps are currently in progress, and we are working diligently to ensure that the changes are well-designed and thoroughly tested before implementation. You can expect updates from us about these changes to other heroes in the next few seasons. We appreciate your patience and support during this process.

notes.title: NARAKA: BLADEPOINT Update – Jan 18th, 2024
notes.content:
[h1]Dear players,[/h1]
The servers of NARAKA: BLADEPOINT will be suspended for maintenance from January 17th, 2024 at 23:00 (UTC) to January 18th, 2024 at 03:00 (UTC). We suggest you log out in advance and enter the game again after the maintenance.
The details for this update are as follows:

[h1]Brand New Content[/h1]

[h3]I. Disengage System[/h3]
The Disengage system is now available in all modes, except for Ranked Mode and Immortal War.

[h3]II. Soul Land Crossover Available Now[/h3]
1. Limited-time Event: Soul Awakening
Masters of the Soul Land assemble!
Event Rules
(1) Choose among the following Soul Shape to awaken: Moonlapis Leaf, Fleetcharm Bunny, Spirit Eye, and Morpho Butterfly, and receive its Legendary Emote Gesture. The three you didn't choose can be purchased in the SHOP.
(2) Complete cultivation quests to earn Soul Coins and raise your Soul Power Level. More difficult cultivation quests grant more Soul Power EXP.
(3) Your Soul Power Level reaches a limit every 10 levels. To raise your rank and your level limit, you need to complete breakthrough quests. This also awards you with a reward for that rank.
(4) Consume Soul Coins to redeem rewards.
2. Map Updates
We have introduced crossover content with Soul Land, adding a new area, Yin Yang's Eye, to both The Morus Isle and Holoroth.
3. New Mechanism
Some new content has been added to BOT Mode, Quick Match, and The Herald's Trial:
(1) In the Yin Yang's Eye field, a new mechanism has been added that creates seals. These seals provide continuous healing for allies and damage over time for enemies when interacted with.
(2) Small animals have been placed on The Morus Isle, and the following three crossover animals have been added to both The Morus Isle and Holoroth: Boreal Scorpio, Human Faced Demon Spider, and Ice Silkworm.
(3) Four crossover immortal herbs are now available for picking: Wonder Tulip, Dreamy Orchid, Silken Fragrance, and Lover's Yearning.
4. New Souljades
Six new brand crossover Souljades have been introduced to the game. They are [Evil Orca Lord (Left Leg Bone)], [Moonlapis Empress (Right Leg Bone)], [Exoskeleton·Arachnid Lances], [Titan Ape (Left Arm Bone)], [Bull Python (Right Arm Bone)], and [Boreal Scorpion (Trunk Bone)].
5. Fairyland Penglai Updates
Newly added crossover themed event mechanism: Seahorse Obelisk.
Players can go to the Seahorse Obelisk and interact with the testing platform, triggering the Sea God’s trial. The Seahorse Obelisk will announce your results in chat! 

[h3]III. Limited-time Event: Righteous Judgement[/h3]
1. Event Rules:
1) By completing Daily Quests, players can obtain Shayol's Token: Golden Keeper Scrolls with an additional chance to obtain one of the following rewards: Tae, Spectral Silk, Peerless Treasure Choice Gift, Hero Coin, Legendary Trial Card, Righteous Coin and other rewards.
2) There are 16 pieces in the four Confidential Scrolls, which can be unlocked by collecting the Golden Keeper Scrolls.
3) You can claim rewards by unlocking any of the four Confidential Scrolls. Some rewards will be available after the new version is released, so stay tuned.
4) Each day, you can help a player obtain a Golden Keeper Scroll (by tapping the contact list, selecting a "Share Shayol's Scroll” and confirming it). You won't consume your Golden Keeper Scroll by doing so. However, each player will be given just one Golden Keeper Scroll per day. 
2. After the event ends, you can still claim unlocked rewards on the event page and unlock Golden Keeper Scroll to obtain rewards within the remaining time to claim rewards. But you can no longer complete Quests, unlock Confidential Scrolls and share Golden Keeper Scrolls during that period. Once the items expire, they can be converted into 160 Tae each in the Inventory 
3. Event Duration: From the January 18th, 2024 update to January 31st, 2024 at 20:00 (UTC).
4. Redeem the rewards before: February 6th, 2024 at 20:00 (UTC)

[h3]IV. Immortal War[/h3]
1. Rules
(1) Time: Open for 3 hours daily.
(2) Requirements: A rank of Platinum or above is required for Immortal War.
(3) Score:
·The Score bonus is determined by your ranking and the total number of enemies downed by your party.
·Knocking down the same enemy multiple times within a short period will not all be counted. A maximum of two knockdowns per enemy will be counted.
·There are no rank restrictions when making teams; instead, matchmaking is based on the team member who has the highest score.
(4) Players: 18-player in Trios; 16-player in Solo.
(5) Rewards: You gain 3,000 Dark Tide Coins upon knocking down an enemy. The first three players in a match to do so also receive a 3,000, 2,000 or 1,000 Dark Tide Coin bonus. You can only receive this reward up to twice from each enemy, however.
(6) Realm of Yang: The basic rules are the same as in Ranked Mode. The Realm of Yang only refreshes once in the first round of Trios.
(7) Rift Dealers: More Rift Dealers were added to the map, and you will obtain Epic or Legendary Souljades through Lucky Souljade Bags.
(8) Quests: All the Scroll tasks will become Bounty Quests in Solo. While in Trios, the amount and duration of the quests will be decreased.
(9) Drops: There will be less Epic equipment and no Legendary equipment on the map.
(10) Caves: Extra drops of Legendary weapons, Souljades IV and huge amounts of Dark Tide Coins.
2. Season Rewards:
Season rewards will be awarded based on the highest rank gained in the Immortal War (Solo or Trios).
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36350327/957d2757933f601c4b6d0db5ef374c838256ead4.png[/img]
If you make it to the Top 500 in the Immortal War, you'll be on the Immortal Leaderboard. This leaderboard is updated every Monday at 04:00 (UTC). Being in the Top 500 earns you a special title. At the end of the season, if you are on the leaderboard or have a title, you get an Avatar.
In addition, when the leaderboard is updated for the final time, the Top 3 players will be awarded exclusive Hero Badges.

[h1]Hero Adjustments[/h1]

[h3]I. Justina Gu[/h3]
Optimized the pulling effect that occurs when Justina Gu interrupts her dash and initiates a weapon move during the casting of [Shadowswipe] or [Shadowswipe: Blizzard].
1. Fixed an issue where the camera would oscillate when the player rapidly adjusted the viewing angle and switched the target during targeting.
2. The pulling effect of this move will only be activated when Justina Gu's target is an enemy hit by [Shadowswipe] or [Shadowswipe: Blizzard]; if not, the move will not trigger the pulling effect and will simply auto-aim melee strikes toward the enemy.

//Developer's Comment: After introducing the post-emergency-stop pulling effect for Justina Gu, we have observed an increase in players executing thrilling moves with Justina Gu. However, we also recognize that some seasoned players have had a less satisfactory experience due to changes in character control habits. To address this, we have implemented the above fine-tunings for better performance. Moreover, we are in the process of developing a setting that will allow players to choose whether to enable the post-emergency-stop pulling effect for Justina Gu. We will also continue to pay close attention to player feedback.

[h1]Weapon Adjustments[/h1]

[h3]I. Heng Sword[/h3]
1. Slightly reduced the knockback distance when a target is hit by a charged vertical strike.
2. Enhanced the melee correction for Straight Lunge and Lethal Jab.
3. Optimized the pre-input timing for Straight Lunge and Lethal Jab.
4. Slightly reduced the startup frames of follow-up horizontal strikes launched after Straight Lunge or Lethal Jab.
5. Reduced the window for interrupting the follow-up horizontal strikes launched after the Straight Lunge or Lethal Jab.
6. Reduced the window for interrupting the follow-up vertical strikes launched after the third stage of the vertical strike or Shadow Step.
7. Fixed an issue where the first strike of the charged vertical strikes would hit an airborne enemy but its second strike would miss the target.
8. Optimized animations of the second, third, and fourth stages of the vertical strike.
9. Optimized character animations when charging a new charged vertical strike after executing charged vertical strikes.
10. Optimized character animations when a successfully countering.
11. Optimized the sound effects for some moves.

[h1]Souljade Adjustments[/h1]

[h3]I. Dual Halberds Souljade[/h3]
A new Souljade, [Martial Art·Will-Form Hook], has been added to the game.

[h3]II. Heng Sword Souljade[/h3]
1. The Focus effect of the second strike of [Rampage] has been changed from Blue Focus to Purple Focus.
2. The first strike of [Aurora Burst] now applies a silence effect upon hitting the target and extends the range of subsequent strikes.

[h3]III. Effect (Consumable) Souljades[/h3]
The special effects of [Explosive Armor] have been optimized, and the uses have been adjusted to 1.

[h1]Out-game Adjustments[/h1]

[h3]I. Free Heroes Adjustments[/h3]
Matari has been replaced with Feria Shen on the Free Heroes list available for new accounts. Their positions on the hero selection page have also been exchanged.

[h3]II. Fairyland Penglai[/h3]
1. Sky-high Racing
The blue totems on the track are now individually displayed for each player while ensuring that racers do not affect each other.
//Developer's Comment: Since the last update of the track, we have observed some players engaging in unsportsmanlike conduct. Actions have been taken against these players, and we encourage everyone to contribute to maintaining a friendly environment on Fairyland Penglai.
III. Righteous Season Pack Adjustments
Steam players can now purchase the Righteous Season Pack in-game. You can check the 'Season Pack' page in the 'Event Center' to check and buy the Righteous Season Pack. Meanwhile, the Righteous Season Pack DLC will be removed from the Steam Store.
The limited-time discount for the Righteous Season Pack will be extended till 23:00 on March 6, 2024 (UTC).

[h1]Showdown Adjustments[/h1]

[h3]I. Enigma Peak is Now Available![/h3]
In the Enigma Peak, Showdown Souljades drop by various kinds. If you defeat a certain number of Bosses in a single match, you can also receive rewards like Legendary Souljade Choice Gift, Thunder Essence, exclusive Hero Badge and so on.
Since the Sense Levels are unlocked in alignment with Enigma Peak, the Sense Level cap has been increased to 700. The cultivation level cap for some stages of Yama's Abyss has been adjusted accordingly.

[h3]II. Yama's Abyss Adjustments[/h3]
1. A preparation phase has been added in Yama's Abyss: Before the battle starts, players can choose one from the Ice Essence, Thunder Essence, or [Blessed Weapon Repair Kit] blessings as their starting enhancement.
2. The Health and Attack of the first Boss have been reduced, while the Health and Attack of the last two Bosses have been increased.
3. The price of the Weapon Repair Kit has been reduced to 50 Dark Tide Coins, the price of the Grappling Hook has been reduced to 15 Dark Tide Coins, and the prices of these two items will not increase across the stages of Yama's Abyss. The price of the Boss Soul Remnant item has been reduced to 0 Dark Tide Coins.
4. Now, in Stage 41 and above of Yama's Abyss, the Rift Dealer will only sell temporary enhancement items of Legendary rarity or higher.
5. Some Bosses on certain stages have been adjusted: The first Boss on Stage 36 has been changed from the Fiery Monster to Iron Taifeng, and the first Boss on Stage 38 has been changed from the Fiery Monster to Stone Monster.
6. Now, when entering the dual-Boss battle due to the [Lost] curses, it will not consume battle time, and even if the two Bosses are not defeated, the player will automatically clear the stage after a certain time, but the quality of rewards obtained will be lowered.
7. The Health of the weak point of [Water Ent] in Yama's Abyss has been changed to 30% of its total Health.
8. Now, when using the Boss move item [Annihilate Light] on distant enemies, the aim assist will trigger automatically.
9. The Souljade [Copper Ward] is no longer available in the selection of Souljade enhancements.

[h3]III. Enigma Domain Adjustments[/h3]
1. Stone Monster and Omnius·Rock have been temporarily removed from the Enigma Domain, and the Matron of Yushan has been added. Meanwhile, the Thunder Omens in Enigma Domain are now changed to Frostbite Omens.
//Developer's Comment: We will change the Bosses and Omens in the Enigma Domain from time to time in the future.
2. The area of the Boss battle in the Shadowjade Mine has been adjusted, and the battle range of the Boss has been decreased.

[h3]IV. Omens Adjustments[/h3]
1. Valda Cui's Water-attribute attacks can now extinguish [Hellhole] for 10 seconds, and Tarka Ji's Fire-attribute attacks can now melt [Frozen Earth] for 10 seconds. Additionally, the height of [Hellhole] and [Frozen Earth] has been lowered to better match their visual performances.
2. Melee attacks on the [Divine Thunder] and [Ice Mound] mechanisms will now trigger a pulling effect.
3. The gestures of the Ice Spore emerging after the use of the [Ice Coral] item have been optimized, making the attack animation smoother.

[h3]V. Combat Adjustments[/h3]
1. The hit detection of [Water Ent]'s weak point has been relaxed.
2. [Water Ent] will no longer use its invisible attack move twice in a row.
10. The maximum triggering range of the Potential [Honed Apparatus] has been adjusted from 15 meters to 50 meters.

[h1]Client Optimization[/h1]

[h3]I. Performance Optimization[/h3]
Fixed the sudden frame rate drop under certain circumstances like hitting opponents in Soul form.

[h3]II. Xbox One Performance Optimization[/h3]
Reduced scene culling overhead to decrease lag on the Xbox One.

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]

[h3]I. Performance Bugs[/h3]
1. Fixed occasional unresponsiveness and freezing that occurred when playing the game on DX12. 
2. Fixed some bugs that caused performance issues on the Steam Deck while playing the game on DX 11.

[h3]II. PlayStation 5 Bugs[/h3]
Fixed some sneaky crashes.

[h1]Store Updates[/h1]

[h3]I. New Feature: Cosmetic Upgrade[/h3]
1. Players can use Glazed Crystals to upgrade Weapon Skin, and use Abysmal Crystals to upgrade Emote Gesture.
 2. After upgrading, the cosmetic will get a new look, but it can no longer be reverted to the previous levels.
3. Players get Collection Points accordingly by upgrading the cosmetic levels.
4. Glazed Crystal and Abysmal Crystals can be purchased in SHOP. You can also get Abysmal Crystals in the Soul Awakening event.
5. Cosmetics that can be upgraded are as follows:
Legendary Weapon Skin: Soul Land·Conqueror
Legendary Emote Gesture: Soul Land·Conqueror's Maul, Soul Land·Moonlapis Leaf, Soul Land·Fleetcharm Bunny, Soul Land·Morpho Butterfly, Soul Land·Spirit Eye.
There will be more upgradable cosmetics in the future. Please stay tuned.

[h3]II. New Packs[/h3]
1. Newly added Temulch exclusive Pack [Tang San Pack (Temulch)], including Temulch Legendary Outfit [Soul Land·Tang San], Temulch Legendary Hairstyle [Soul Land·Ocean Power] and Temulch exclusive Voice Pack [Temulch·Tang San Voice Pack]. Standard price: 3,600 Gold; Now: 120 Gold.
2. Newly added Kurumi exclusive Pack [Xiao Wu Pack (Kurumi)], including Kurumi Legendary Outfit [Soul Land·Xiao Wu], Kurumi Legendary Hairstyle [Soul Land·Phoenix] and Kurumi exclusive Voice Pack [Kurumi·Xiao Wu Voice Pack]. Standard price: 3,600 Gold; Now: 2,400 Gold.
3. Newly added Pack [That's Interesting Pack] for Male Characters, including Epic Emote Gestures [Quite Interesting] and [Cheery Greeting] for Male Characters, as well as Epic Poses [That's Interesting] and [Greeting Applaud] for Male Characters. Standard price: 1,200 Gold; Now: 600 Gold.

[h3]III. New Discounts[/h3]
1. Newly added Polesword Legendary Skin [Soul Land·Conqueror]. Standard price: 1,500 Gold; Now: 1,250 Gold.
2. Newly added Legendary Emote Gesture [Soul Land·Conqueror's Maul]. Standard price: 1,200 Gold; Now: 900 Gold.
3. Newly added Legendary Rescue Special Effect [Soul Land·Rescue]. Standard price: 1,200 Gold; Now: 400 Gold.
4. Newly added Epic Kill Announcement [Soul Land·Fleetcharm Bunny]. Standard price: 300 Gold; Now: 200 Gold.
5. Newly added Temulch Epic Pose [Daring Charge]. Standard price: 300 Gold; Now: 200 Gold.
6. Newly added Legendary Emote Gesture [Soul Land·Moonlapis Leaf]. Standard price: 900 Gold; Now: 360 Gold.
7. Newly added Legendary Emote Gesture [Soul Land·Fleetcharm Bunny]. Standard price: 900 Gold; Now: 360 Gold.

9. Newly added Legendary Emote Gesture [Soul Land·Spirit Eye]. Standard price: 900 Gold; Now: 360 Gold.
10. Newly added Temulch Legendary Outfit [Soul Land·Tang San]. Standard price: 1,800 Gold; Now: 1,500 Gold.
11. Newly added Temulch Legendary Hairstyle [Soul Land·Ocean Power]. Standard price: 800 Gold; Now: 600 Gold.

19. Newly added Epic Pose [Greeting Applaud] for Male Characters. Standard price: 300 Gold; Now: 200 Gold.

[h3]IV. Removal of Crossover Themed Item[/h3]
Our collaboration with the masterpiece “Dwelling in the Fuchun Mountains”, housed in the Zhejiang Provincial Museum, will soon come to an end. After the update on Jan 18, 2024, the following cosmetics will no longer be available:

[h3]VI. New Items in Spectral Silk Store[/h3]

From 1.8 to 1.14, there are 8 players who have successfully reported the cheating or hacking in total and get the reward [Righteous Polearm]! We hope that more players can become the Justice Supporter on the Morus Isle in the future.

Dear players,

NARAKA: BLADEPOINT is committed to creating a fair and healthy competitive environment. We have not only used new anti-cheat technologies, but also established special cheat-reporting reward activities to encourage those players who defend the fairness with us. From now on, players who make outstanding contributions to reporting cheats will get the Legendary spear skin 'Righteous Polearm' .

More details:
1. Players who successfully reported 1 time will get [Immortal Treasure] X1;

2. Players who successfully report 10 times with low misreport rate will get [Immortal Treasure] X10 (In order to ensure the efficiency of detecting, please report reasonably);

We strongly recommend that players report via in-game report system, so that we can confirm the cheat as soon as possible and record successful report times for you!

From 1.1 to 1.7, there are 8 players who have successfully reported the cheating or hacking in total and get the reward [Righteous Polearm]! We hope that more players can become the Justice Supporter on the Morus Isle in the future.
