notes.title: NARAKA: BLADEPOINT Update – Jan 4th, 2024
notes.content:
[h2]Dear players,
[/h2]
Happy New Year! May the coming year be filled with boundless joy and prosperity. Let us take a look at the new adventures that lie ahead on the Morus Isle.

The servers of NARAKA: BLADEPOINT will be suspended for maintenance from Jan 3rd, 2024 at 23:00 (UTC) to Jan 4th, 2024 at 03:00 (UTC). We suggest you log out in advance and enter the game again after the maintenance.

The details for this update are as follows:

[h1]Brand New Content[/h1]

[h2]I. New Congeneric Weapon: Heng Sword[/h2]
[previewyoutube=eOZfxv7mEXk;full][/previewyoutube]
A blade of gold refined, a cold glint so divine.
In the new update, we'll be introducing the ancient Chinese weapon—Heng Sword. Try it out!

[h2]II. Fairyland Penglai Updates[/h2]
[b]1. Newly added Fairyland Penglai Guide[/b]
Players can access the Fairyland Penglai Guide through the Event Center or shortcut button. The Guide introduces all current gameplay and rewards, aiming to enhance players' experience in the Fairyland Penglai.

[b]2. Sky-high Racing Update[/b]
New tracks and new quests with new racing challenges of various weapons are available! Create your legends of speed in Fairyland Penglai!

[b]3. New Instrument Proficiency[/b]
[list]
[*] Increase your proficiency level by playing instruments or practicing with sheet music.
[*] Players can participate in a test when they reach proficiency at Levels 3/6/9. Passing these tests can unlock the Master Mode, increasing the maximum music score recordings and earning other great rewards.
[/list]
Guzheng and Suona proficiency levels are now available. Other instrument proficiency levels will be added in future updates.

[h2]III. BATTLEPASS Updates[/h2]
[previewyoutube=g3-C3iyGiqQ;full][/previewyoutube]
[Righteous] BATTLEPASS is now available, which includes a variety of valuable items and skins! Players can obtain more rewards by unlocking the Advanced Hidden Treasure! You can get a Treasure Scroll at the price of 1200 Gold and a Glory Scroll at 2840 Gold.

[h2]IV. Limited-time Event: Freeze and Heat[/h2]
Specter Arch bites with bitter cold, whereas Cura Center harbors comforting warmth. Still, both prove ideal grounds for cultivation.

Event Rules:
[olist]
[*] Each day, you may choose one of the two Cultivation Zones.
[list]
[*] Specter Arch: If you gain a Score from a Ranked match, you will get a 25% score bonus. If you lose a Score from a Ranked match, your Score loss will be halved. (Diminish Eurekas by 1). If you get a 0 Score, it doesn't consume an Eureka.
[*] Cura Center: XP and Hidden Treasure XP from Survival, Casual, or Showdown modes are increased by 150% (Diminish Eurekas by 1).
[/list]
You can choose only one type each day, and once chosen, it cannot be changed.
[*] You will receive 1 Eureka once you've made your choice.
[*] You will receive an additional Eureka for each event quest you complete. These quests are divided into 7 groups and each group is available at different times. The next set of quests can be unlocked only after completing the former ones.
[*] Eurekas gained are valid for that day only. They do not carry over to the next day, so please use them in time.
[*] Complete more quests to win more great rewards.
[/olist]
[h2]VII. New Cosmetics: Chat Bubble[/h2]
A new cosmetic, Chat Bubble is added to Other Cosmetics > Social. When unlocked and equipped, it changes your texts' background in the chat channel.

The first three chat bubbles available in this updates are: [Star - Wolf King's Fang], [Star - Nine Tailed Destiny], [Star - Florescent Cryolite]

The above chat bubbles are rewarded when you unlock the Star-Collections with the same titles. The chat bubbles will be locked again if you no longer own the Star-Collections after trading.


[h2]VIII. New Attribute of the Outfits: [Talents Effects][/h2]
[list]
[*] Players can apply new effects to the ultimates that support 'Custom Effects' by selecting HERO > Collection > Talents > Custom Effects.
[*] The new Talent Effect for Feria Shen's [2674·Mech Prototype], Bronze Mech Paint - [2674·Midnight Prototype], is now available.
[/list]
You have to own [2674·Mech Prototype] before customizing the effect of [2674·Midnight Prototype].

[h2]IX. Righteous Season Pack[/h2]
New Season Pack is now available. During the limited-time sale, there's a 63% discount. 
After the limited-time sale ends, the offer returns to a 54% discount.

[u]Event Time: From Jan 4, 2024 update to Apr 1, 2024 at 00:00 (UTC)[/u]
Discount Time of the First Term: Jan 4, 2024 update - Jan 17, 2024 at 20:00 (UTC) 
Purchase to get the following rewards:
[list]
[*] Righteous Season Pack Exclusive Hadi Epic Head Accessory - The Helm
[*] Advanced Hidden Treasure Card: Use to unlock the Advanced Hidden Treasure of the current season. (Usable for Righteous Season or any subsequent season.)
[*] Baize's Blessing: Use to unlock Baize's Blessing where you can claim rewards for 30 days.
[*] Gold*600
[*] Peerless Treasure Choice Gift*10
[/list]
Purchase to get the following privileges (privileges already unlocked cannot be reacquired):
Privilege Overview
[list]
[*] Unlock Ranked Mode at Level 20.
[*] Unlock Public Chat at Level 5.
[*] Unlimited exchange of Hero Coins.
[*] Custom Rooms available.
[/list]
(If you're playing via EPIC, you can make purchases at the in-game Event Center. If you're playing via Steam, Xbox or PlayStation, please head over to the corresponding platform to make your purchases.)

[h2]X. Limited-time Event: Starcatcher's Pavilion Now Available for Star-Collection Bidding[/h2]
Starcatcher's Pavilion: Where stars cascade into the celestial palace.

During the event, Star-Collections will be available for auction in the Starcatcher's Pavilion. Players can participate in the bidding using Spectral Silk. Once the bidding period ends, the highest bidder will claim the prize.

[b]This Term of Star-Collections:[/b]
[list]
[*] Greatsword Extreme Skin [Star - Wolf King's Fang]
[*] Tarka Ji Legendary Outfit [Star - Dragon's Bane]
[/list]
The number of Star-Collections is limited, and will not be restocked after they are sold out.

[b]There will be 2 rounds of bidding in this term. Details are as follows:[/b]
Round 1:
[list]
[*] Preview Start Time: After Jan 4 Update
[*] Auction Start Time: Jan 4 12:00 UTC
[*] Auction End Time: Jan 7 14:00 UTC
[/list]
Round 2:
[list]
[*] Preview Start Time: Jan 7 20:00 UTC
[*] Auction Start Time: Jan 8 12:00 UTC
[*] Auction End Time: Jan 11 14:00 UTC
[/list]
For players playing via different platforms, please check the number of items on each platform on the in-game event page.
[olist]
[*] Preview: Preview the basic info of the items, their quantity, price, auction time, etc.
[*] Auction: During auction time, players can place bids and raise bids to win items.
[*] Settlement: After the auction, the system will tally the results.
[*] Conclusion: Check the auction results on the event page and claim your items if you win. If you lose, you will get your Spectral Silk back.
[/olist]
Please check more details on the in-game event page.

[h2]XI. New Season[/h2]
We have come to the end of Season 10: Pioneer and would like to thank all the players who participated in this season’s ranked matches. For the full recap of season rewards and score resets please see our [url=https://www.narakathegame.com/news/update/20240103/33459_1129662.html]official announcement post[/url].

[b]1. Season Rewards:[/b]
Season rewards will be awarded based on the highest rank gained in the ranked modes (Solo, Duos or Trios) during the Pioneer Season.

[b]2. Score Reset:[/b]
Scores in the ranked modes (Solos, Duos or Trios) will partially carry over to the new season.

[b]3. Score Carry-Over:[/b]
Hero scores and scores from Capture the Spirit Well, Shadow Surge, The Bloodbath, and Bloodsport will partially carry over to the new season, with a higher carry-over ratio for lower scores. The maximum score limit after carry-over is 10,000 points.

[h2]Hero Adjustments[/h2]

[h3]I. Yoto Hime[/h3]
[olist]
[*] When casting [Flying Edge: Resist], the character is immune to hit damage before completing the action of throwing the blade.
[*] Each Ultimate Variant has undergone damage adjustments as follows:
[list]
[*] The slash damage multiplier for all Ultimate Variants has been revised from 2.6/3.2/3.8 to 3.0/3.5/4.0.
[*] The Attack Healing ratio for each variant has been boosted as follows:
[*] The ratios for both [Demon Blade] and [Demon Blade: Combo] have been elevated from 30% to 40%.
[*] The ratio for [Demon Blade: Restore] has been elevated from 60% to 70%.
[*] The multiplier for extra slash damage of Demon Blade: Combo has been revised from 1.6 to 2.0.
[/list]
[*] For all Ultimate Variants, the duration of recovery frames following slash gestures has been slightly decreased.
[/olist]

[h3]II. Justina Gu[/h3]
[olist]
[*] When casting [Arctic Wraith] and [Arctic Wraith: Blizzard], the knockback distance has been slightly expanded.
[*] For all Ultimate Variants, the duration of the [Freeze Immunity] status, which is gained at the end of the Freeze effect, has been shortened from 6 to 4 seconds.
[*] For the [Shadowswipe] and [Shadowswipe: Blizzard] skills derived from [Arctic Wraith] and [Arctic Wraith: Blizzard], if an enemy is hit during the sprint and the sprint process is interrupted by a melee move, the current move will have a slightly enhanced pulling effect and will prioritize attacking the target hit during the sprint.
[/olist]
[i]//Dev’s Notes: Justina Gu can end the sprint process with an attack at any point during the sprint. A popular strategy among players using Justina Gu is to halt the sprint immediately after freezing an enemy to execute a charged attack. Given Justina Gu's rapid sprint speed, mastering the ‘sprint-brake’ strategy often necessitates substantial practice. Therefore, we are endeavoring to increase the permissible distance for targeting post-sprint, with the hope of simplifying the execution of the ‘brake’ for players.[/i]

[h3]III. Tessa[/h3]
[olist]
[*] The duration for Rage recovery inhibition, following the casting of [Enchant], has been reduced from 15 seconds to 11 seconds. Similarly, the Rage recovery inhibition period after casting [Enchant: Bite] has also been reduced from 12 seconds to 11 seconds.
[*] Upon casting [Enchant], Tessa recovers a small amount of Health for each enemy hit by the fox.
[/olist]

[h3]IV. Hadi[/h3]
Each Ultimate Variant has experienced modifications to the damage dealt by charged attacks executed during flight:
[list]
[*] The damage multiplier for [Aerial Ascent]'s charged attacks at all stages has been revised from 2.0/3.0/4.0 to 1.8/2.7/3.2.
[*] The damage multiplier for [Aerial Ascent: Blaze]'s charged attacks at all stages has been revised from 2.0/3.0/3.5 to 1.8/2.7/2.8.
[*] The damage multiplier for [Aerial Ascent: Rescue]'s charged attacks at all stages has been revised from 2.0/3.0/3.2 to 1.8/2.7/3.0.
[/list]

[h3]V. Takeda[/h3]
[olist]
[*] The Rage consumption upon activating [Demonic Aid] has been raised from 25% to 40%, aligning it with specific heroes (such as Justina Gu). Concurrently, the Rage requirement for casting [Demonic Strike] has been reduced from 25% to 20%, thereby maintaining the initial cast count at 3 times.
[*] The damage multiplier for [Demonic Strike: Havoc] (Gold tier) cast after [Demonic Aid: Force] at medium to long ranges has been adjusted from 0.08/1.00 to 0.04/0.06.
[/olist]
[i]//Dev’s Notes: Takeda has demonstrated outstanding performance in solo mode and various competitions, primarily due to the superior Rage recovery ability of his V1 skill. To ensure consistency with certain heroes, we've marginally increased the cost of activating his V1 skill. At the same time, while preserving his V3 skill's capability of drawing aggro and casting stable charged attacks, we've reduced Takeda's recovery ability at the Gold tier when drawing aggro at medium to long ranges.[/i]

[h3]VI. Feria Shen[/h3]
[olist]
[*] The damage multiplier of [Gunplay] has been reduced from 1.0 to 0.1.
[*] The space determination for deploying the beacon of [Mech Mayhem: Co-pilot] in narrow areas has been optimized slightly.
[/olist]

[h3]VII. Ziping Yin[/h3]
The recovery amount provided by the [Sedate Soul] effect of [Saving Grace: Aegis] has been reduced from 500 to 300.

[i]//Dev’s Notes: Ziping Yin has demonstrated exceptional performance in top-tier Trios and various competitions, thanks to her reliable survivability. However, the immunity to fatal damage provided by [Sedate Soul] has led to instances where her Health paradoxically increases when she is executed by an enemy. To address this, we have decided to retain this feature while reducing its minimum recovery effect.[/i]

[h3]VIII. Other Adjustments[/h3]
The method for calculating the charge time of certain skills has been revised. Post this update, and the following skills will also benefit from the boosts provided by the [Skill CD Speed] Glyph:
[list]
[*] Matari's [Flash: Repeat]
[*] Feria Shen's [Rocket Thrust] when in the Bronze Mech form of [Mech Mayhem].
[/list]

[h2]Weapon Adjustments[/h2]
[b]I. Katana[/b]
The issue where the actual strike range of the third stage of the Horizontal Strike was smaller than the range of its visual effect has been rectified.

[h2]Souljade Adjustments[/h2]
[b]I. Spear Souljade[/b]
A new Souljade, [Martial Art·Hexa-Harmony Spear], has been introduced to the game.
[b]II. Staff Souljade[/b]
A new Souljade, [Martial Art·Shaolin Staff], has been introduced to the game.

[h2]Out-game Adjustments[/h2]
[h3]I. Adjustments to the rules for calculating Hero Scores[/h3]
We have adjusted the rules for calculating Hero Scores to enhance the impact of the Immortal War on these scores. Here are the specifics:
[list]
[*] Upon completing a ranked mode or an Immortal War match, your Hero Score will be adjusted based on your performance and the current Rank Score. However, once you surpass the specified [threshold], the difficulty of earning Hero Scores will significantly increase.
[*] [Threshold]: The base threshold equals to the current Rank Score, capped at a maximum of 7,500 points. In Immortal War, the threshold will be raised, with the increased ratio calculated as (highest score across various modes of Immortal War - 3,000)/8,000. For instance, suppose your score in Ranked Mode (Solo) stands at 1,000 points, and your peak score across various modes of the Immortal War is 5,000 points. In that case, when you engage in a solo Ranked Mode, the threshold for your Hero Score would be calculated as follows: 1,000 x (1+ (5,000 -3,000)/8,000).
[/list]
[h3]II. Team Display Customization[/h3]
Players now can customize each team Collection display by adding backgrounds, bases, and gestures.

[h3]III. Adjustment to Display of Teammate Performance in Previous Match[/h3]
Visual effects have been enhanced, and a display time limit has been introduced.

[h3]IV. Rank[/h3]
In future seasons, the Kills Leaderboard and Survival Leaderboard will be removed.

[h3]V. Rotating Mode[/h3]
The Shadow Surge will no longer be part of the rotating mode, with only the Capture the Spirit Well gameplay retained.

[h3]VI. Baize's Blessing Updates[/h3]
New items are added to the Baize Shop.

[h3]VII. Meeting Chest Updates[/h3]
Purchases of the Meeting Chests have been reset. Players that had purchased the Meeting Chests before can purchase it again. With the same price as before, there are more and updated rewards inside the chest now, including the Legendary Longsword Skin, Peerless Treasure Choice Gift*10.
Meeting Chests on Xbox and PS5 will be updated in the next version.

[h3]VIII. BATTLEPASS Updates[/h3]
Players who possess the Advanced Hidden Treasure Card can use it to deduct 1200 Gold when purchasing the Glory Scroll.

[h3]IX. Golden Poetry of Tang Event Updates[/h3]
The rewards in the Golden Poetry of Tang Event have been adjusted from Pioneer Coins to Righteous Coins.

[h2]Showdown Adjustments[/h2]
[h3]I. Combat Adjustments[/h3]
[list]
[*] In Showdown (Normal), the Attack of monsters has been slightly increased, and the number of revivals has been adjusted to three.
[*] The behavior logic of monsters in Showdown (Normal) has been fine-tuned for each stage.
[*] All Miasma Ghosts, except for Immovable, have been removed from Showdown (Normal).
[*] Bronzoid Swarms have been removed from the Chaos of the Immortals (Normal).
[*] In Omnius Descent, Toppled Mountains, Gelid Yushan, Together We Stand, and Chasm Undertow, a red dot marker will guide you to the portal after each revival.
[*] The strike timing for the Blue Focus move of [Omnius·Beast] when stepping on water in mid-air has been delayed.
[*] The timing detection of the binding array of [Fiery Monster] has been optimized, and the discrepancy between the strike range and visual effect range of Yi's Instrument has been rectified.
[*] The probability of [Water Ent] spitting water toward the sky has been slightly reduced, and the hit detection of weak points has been relaxed.
[*] Optimized the movement of monsters [Cursespawn], [Thunderspawn], [Axe Evil-Ent] and [Ocean Yaksa]. After being knocked down, they will stand up in their current place without rolling.
[*] Improved the stagger animation when hit by the Hammer Evil-Ent's consecutive smash on the ground.
[/list]
[h2]II. Yama's Abyss[/h2]
[list]
[*] [Soulfire Blades], [Moonbane's Wrath], [Annihilation Render], and [Shadow Eclipse] have been added to Yama's Abyss. When using heroes wielding the corresponding weapons, there's a certain probability of obtaining enhanced Extreme Souljades in the [Monster Area], [Hard-mode Monster Area], and [Boss Area]. These Souljades can only be used within Yama's Abyss and are not available for acquisition or development.
[*] The 46th stage of Yama's Abyss is currently unavailable in this version. Please stay tuned for future announcements regarding its opening.
[*] The ‘Eradicating the Evil’ quest will no longer appear in the initial 5 areas, which means its probability of occurrence in the final 10 areas has been increased, maintaining the overall probability of occurrence.
[*] The description of Souljade effects during enhancement selection has been optimized.
[*] The description of the effects of some Anima Rings has been optimized.
[*] The effect of the Anima Ring [Contract Quests] has been revised from ‘Obtain a certain amount of Dark Tide Coins after clearing a Zone’ to ‘Immediately obtain a certain amount of Dark Tide Coins, with additional small amounts of Dark Tide Coins awarded for each subsequent Zone cleared’.
[*] The strike location of the Boss move item [Annihilate Light] has been optimized.
[*] The rules for refreshing enhancement content have been optimized.
[*] The spawn locations of ranged monsters in certain stages have been optimized.
[/list]
[h3]III. Stage Adjustments[/h3]
[list]
[*] The arrangement of strongholds in each difficulty level of Eventide Ember has been reconfigured to create a more compact distribution.
[*] [Stage Clearance Tips] have been introduced to Eventide Ember (Normal), and the waiting duration in the Quality Square has been slightly extended.
[*] The locations of several initial monster strongholds in the Shadowjade Mine have been optimized.
[/list]

[h3]IV. Hero Adjustments for Viper Ning[/h3]
[list]
[*]  The Defense Focus granted upon the cast of [Yushan Strike: Showdown] has been upgraded to Ultimate Focus.
[*] The effect of [Moonbane Control: Showdown] has been adjusted to recover Armor when Health is full. However, the recovery amount has been reduced from 150% Attack per second to 85% Attack per second.
[*] The damage multiplier of [Thunderbolt] has been increased from 1 to 2.2, and its Aegis-breaking ability has been increased from 1,300 to 1,540.
[*] The damage multiplier of [Draconic Lightning Strike] has been increased from 1 to 2.2, and its Aegis-breaking ability has been increased from 2,000 to 2,200.
[*] The [Thunderbolt] can now be cast after a period of charging.
[*] The duration of startup frames for both [Thunderbolt] and [Draconic Lightning Strike] has been slightly shortened.
[*] The strike range of both [Thunderbolt] and [Draconic Lightning Strike] has been slightly expanded.
[/list]

[h3]V. Souljade Adjustments[/h3]
[list]
[*] Defuse·Combo (Concentrate), Defuse·Solve (Concentrate) and Defuse·Dash (Concentrate) are now integrated as Defuse (Concentrate), with an effect of triggering Defuse (Counterattack) more easily.
[*] Defuse·Combo (Counterattack), Defuse·Solve (Counterattack) and Defuse·Dash (Counterattack) are integrated as Defuse (Counterattack) with an effect of Melee attacks and triggering Defuse can fill the Defuse slot. When it is filled, a Defuse (Counterattack) will consume the Defuse slot, unleashing a Counterstrike Combo that deals 60% increased damage.
[/list]
[i]//Dev’s Notes: We strive to reduce the difficulty for the new players to understand Defuse, and to familiarize them with the Souljade system and the mechanics of Defuse. Additionally, we plan to enhance the existing Souljades while preserving their sub-attributes, allowing for greater flexibility in Souljade builds.[/i]

[h3]VI. Fatigue Compensation[/h3]
[list]
[*] When Fatigue resets, you will gain random Legendary or Epic Showdown Souljades based on 20% of your drop rate last week. Only Souljades dropped from the completed stages on Morus Isle and Holoroth, or challenged Enigma Domain can be acquired this way.
[*] Complete any stage to get the compensation.
[*] Fatigue Compensation will be calculated starting from the first week and distributed on the second week.
[/list]
[h3]VII. Souljade Recasting Adjustments[/h3]
Recast Guarantee is now shown on the Souljade Recast Page, now you can check the remaining times to trigger the Guarantee when recasting the Souljade.

[h3]VIII. Others[/h3]
A notice of the 'Max Sense Level of the Dropped Souljade' is added to each stage, which indicates the highest Sense Level of the Souljades you can get from the stage.

[h2]Store Updates[/h2]
[h3]I. New Regular Treasure: Brocade Treasure Now Available in the Treasure Pavilion[/h3]
Brocade Treasure sells for 240 Gold. Open it and there's a chance to get Viper Ning's Extreme Outfit [Scarlet Bride], Akos Hu's Extreme Outfit [Wrathful Guardian], Polesword's Extreme Skin [Rebellion], and Cannon's Extreme Skin [Divine Trial].
Minimum Guarantee:
[list]
[*] Loop Guarantee: On top of the basic drop rate, players are guaranteed to receive at least 1 Purple (Epic) reward within 10 Treasures. This can be triggered multiple times. ​
[*] Special Guarantee: On top of the basic drop rate, players are guaranteed to receive at least 1 Red (Extreme) reward during the process of opening at most 100 Treasures. This cannot be triggered repeatedly.
[*] Red (Extreme) rewards will not repeat until all of them have been obtained.
[/list]
[h3]II. New Packs[/h3]
[list]
[*] Newly added Zai exclusive Pack [Baji Pack], including Legendary Outfit [Martial Infinity·Baji], Epic Hairstyle [Martial Infinity·Fierce], Legendary Accessory [Martial Infinity·Non-Self] and Legendary Pose [Martial Infinity·Bajiquan]. Standard price: 4,300 Gold; Now: 2,880 Gold.
[*] Newly added Justina Gu exclusive Pack [Lithe Feathers Pack], including Legendary Outfit [Lithe Feathers], Legendary Hairstyle [Frosty], Legendary Accessory [Lunar Flute]. Standard price: 3,500 Gold; Now: 2,400 Gold.
[*] Newly added Feria Shen exclusive Pack [2674·Midnight Prototype Pack], including Legendary Accessory [2674·Mech Prototype] (unlock it to get a new appearance for Feria Shen's ultimate ‘Mech Mayhem’) and new Bronze Mech Paint [2674·Midnight Prototype]. Standard price: 6,200 Gold; Now: 3,800 Gold. 
[/list]
[h3]III. New Discounts[/h3]
[olist]
[*] Heng Sword Legendary Skin [Bejeweled Aurum Blade]. Standard price: 1,500 Gold; Now: 1,250 Gold.
[*] Spear Legendary Skin [Martial Infinity·Hidden Dragon]. Standard price: 1,500 Gold; Now: 1,250 Gold.
[*] Fan Legendary Skin [Floral Mystery]. Standard price: 1,500 Gold; Now: 1,250 Gold.
[*] Zai Legendary Emote Gesture [Zai·Hexa-Harmony Spear]. Standard Price: 1,000 Gold; Now: 800 Gold.
[*] Tianhai Legendary Emote Gesture [Tianhai·Shaolin Staff]. Standard Price: 1,000 Gold; Now: 800 Gold.
[*] Viper Ning Legendary Hairstyle [Ruby Red]. Standard price: 800 Gold; Now: 600 Gold.
[*] Akos Hu Legendary Hairstyle [Fiend Wind]. Standard price: 800 Gold; Now: 600 Gold.
[*] Feria Shen Legendary Hairstyle [Street Carnival·Color Pop]. Standard price: 800 Gold; Now: 600 Gold.
[*] Tessa Legendary Hairstyle [Morning Dew]. Standard price: 800 Gold; Now: 600 Gold.
[*] Zai Epic Background [Martial Infinity·Settled]. Standard price: 200 Gold; Now: 150 Gold.
[*] Tianhai Epic Background [Martial Infinity·Zen]. Standard price: 200 Gold; Now: 150 Gold.
[/olist]
[h3]IV. Discounts End[/h3]
[olist]
[*] Feria Shen Legendary Outfit [Martial Infinity·Wing Chun] has returned to its standard price of 1,800 Gold.
[*] Feria Shen Epic Hairstyle [Martial Infinity·Wing] has returned to its standard price of 400 Gold.
[*] Feria Shen Legendary Pose [Martial Infinity·Wing Chun Kuen] has returned to its standard price of 900 Gold.
[*] Legendary Emote Gesture [Smooth Combo] has returned to its standard price of 1,000 Gold.
[*] Feria Shen Legendary Emote Gesture [Feria Shen·Octa-Slash Blade] has returned to its standard price of 1,000 Gold.
[*] Wuchen Legendary Emote Gesture [Wuchen·Tai-Chi Fan] has returned to its standard price of 1,000 Gold.
[*] Tessa Legendary Emote Gesture [Tessa·Will-Form Hook] has returned to its standard price of 1,000 Gold.
[*] Feria Shen Epic Background [Martial Infinity·Equilibrium] has returned to its standard price of 200 Gold.
[*] Grappling Hook Skin [Flying Squirrel] has returned to its standard price of 4,200 Gold. 
[/olist]
[h3]V. New Items in Spectral Silk Store[/h3]
Newly added Epic Customization Item [Face Tattoo 24] with a price of 3,000 Spectral Silk.

[h3]VI. Gold Purchase Updates[/h3]
Bonus rewards when recharging Gold are adjusted from 'Regular Treasure Choice Gift' to 'Peerless Treasure Choice Gift'.

Peerless Treasure Choice Gift allows you to choose one of the following Treasure as reward: Immortal Treasure*1, Lotus Treasure*1, Brocade Treasure*1.

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[h3]I. Hero-related Bugs[/h3]
[list]
[*] An issue with Takeda Nobutada's [Demonic Aid: Force], where the damage dealt was beyond expectations when hitting an enemy at specific distances with [Demonic Strike: Havoc] of White or Purple tiers, has been rectified. However, the hit effect remains unchanged.

[i]//Dev’s Notes: Previously, at distances of 3-5m, 5-7m, 9.5-12m, etc., using [Demonic Strike: Havoc] of White or Purple tiers surprisingly resulted in higher damage than the one of Gold tier. This was due to an additional strike beyond our expectations. We've decided to keep this extra strike but have slightly reduced its damage multiplier.[/i]

[*] Fixed an issue where Kurumi's skills were behaving abnormally under certain conditions.
[/list]
[h3]II. Audio-related Bugs[/h3]
[list]
[*] The problem causing players to mistakenly hear a falling sound effect upon opening the home interface in Fairyland Penglai has been addressed, along with the occasional disappearance of background music.
[*] The music-playing mechanism for emotes has been refined. Now, when a player in Fairyland Penglai uses an emote with accompanying music, the music will resume playing even when the home interface is opened.
[/list]

[h3]III. Outfit-related Bug[/h3]
Adjusted the foot sound effects for the Epic and Rare Outfits of Zai to high heel sounds.

notes.title: NARAKA: BLADEPOINT – Pioneer Season Settlement Notice
notes.content:
[h2]Dear players,[/h2]

The Pioneer Season will come to an end on January, 4th, 2024 at 00 : 00 : 00  (UTC), and the ranks for this season will be settled. Thank you all for your feedback during the season, we will continue to endeavor to bring you a better gaming experience! 
In the Pioneer Season, guided by the river of destiny, Hadi: The Visionary set foot on Morus Isle. With unexpected twists and turns in his journey, where will he venture next?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36350327/8445278a5cd203edc075059755c52ba74f1a03de.jpg[/img]

We were thrilled to introduce the highly anticipated Fan, a Dagger congeneric weapon. With elegance and hidden fierceness, it promises swift footwork and powerful discharges.
[previewyoutube=wSB9KbPwPaE;full][/previewyoutube]

Stay tuned for the upcoming season, packed with thrilling content and challenges!

[h3]The details of season rewards and the Score reset are as follows. Players will be able to claim the rewards after updating and starting the new season. [/h3]

[h3]Season Rewards:[/h3]
Season rewards will be awarded based on the highest rank gained in the ranked modes (Solo, Duos, or Trios) during the Pioneer Season.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36350327/a2193e88cafb610ad47d09db3c148ce0085f39dc.png[/img]
The Avatar rewards for the Asura and Unrivaled Asura ranks are differentiated by Solo, Duos, and Trios, and can be earned separately across those various game modes.	


[h3]Hall of Fame Leaderboard:[/h3]
Starting from the Pioneer Season, players who rank on the leaderboard will receive an Avatar corresponding to the hero with which they achieved their ranking. This Avatar can be obtained only once. Furthermore, we have adjusted the rules around how Hero Score resets. The details of these changes can be found in the following section.
In the next season, we will be revising how Hero Score is calculated. Stay tuned and anticipate the exciting changes ahead!

[h2]Season Rewards:[/h2]
[h3]Tessa Epic Outfit [Fairy Robe·Rosy Clouds][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36350327/6357d2ccfd6968bcb5cadb83757165a5a401e6fa.jpg[/img]
[h3]Staff  Legendary Skin [Staff of the Honored][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36350327/71087b7bf54bef4c15a60c171536ce8c5d8aed33.jpg[/img]
[h3]Epic Background [Pioneer][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36350327/9458fee09f61ad1e110350e1b0ef26d15a6d2ab0.jpg[/img]

[h3]Score Reset[/h3]

1.Scores in the ranked modes (Solos, Duos, or Trios) will partially carry over to the new season.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36350327/73a67542d762f347e5abe31f2c2508b0c5b2ef43.png[/img]
2.Hero scores and scores from Capture the Spirit Well, Shadow Surge, The Bloodbath, and Bloodsport will partially carry over to the new season, with a higher carry-over ratio for lower scores. The maximum possible score that can be carried over into the next season is 10,000.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36350327/1b737da118f5cca2f544a72817e10d6aa55e1b70.png[/img]

Thank all for supporting NARAKA: BLADEPOINT. Your feedback is always greatly appreciated. A new season is coming, let’s go explore it together!

notes.title: NARAKA FEST 2023 Recap
notes.content:
Hello, Forerunners!

NARAKA Fest is over and oh boy was it ever a great show full of reveals and new information! You can check the main recap video of the show here: [previewyoutube=J6g1gXZbK4k;full][/previewyoutube]
In addition to our recap, you can find a ton of cool rewards and unlockables by visiting our [url=https://www.narakathegame.com/narakafest/2023/#/]official event page[/url].

[h2]Martial Infinity[/h2]

[previewyoutube=OA0f-NanDU8;full][/previewyoutube]

Honouring some of the many martial arts traditions that exist, the Martial Infinity project seeks to celebrate these various schools through a host of new hero outfits, weapon skins, and souljades. Prepare to devastate your opponents in style.


[h2]New Hero - Shayol Wei[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36350327/eb98710fbf643af8d4a8cbeadff22a1440341e3a.png[/img]

In February 2024, prepare to report for duty as Icuria’s keeper of order and leader of the Golden Keepers. Shayol Wei arrives in Morus Isle. How will she shape the battles that are yet to come?


[h2]New Weapon - Heng Sword[/h2]

[previewyoutube=eOZfxv7mEXk;full][/previewyoutube]

Combining the grace of swords and the might of blades is a new weapon - the Heng Sword. This weapon of culture and power is the congeneric weapon of the Katana and a staple among Icuria’s officers and troops. Cut your foes to shreds with this weapon starting on January 3 PT.


[h2]Holiday Event & Bruce Lee Crossover[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36350327/ee57870f19572d7dd811f5d0e161ac43765e2eba.jpg[/img]

To celebrate Christmas, we are having a very special holiday event. By joining this time-limited event you can get access to special rewards and don some festive cosmetics. In addition, we are happy to announce that the Bruce Lee crossover will return in Spring 2024 with a new Dragon Will Star Outfit.


[h2]The Soul Land Crossover[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36350327/8981260a93ff641f48c670bc616c5f956f1cd585.png[/img]

Show your Spirit Ring! In our crossover event, players will get to be a Spirit Master with their own special spirit to fight and cultivate their own Spirit Ring. This crossover will come soon in 2024 so stay tuned for more details.


[h2]
NARAKA x Kunio Okawara Crossover[/h2]

[previewyoutube=SRAeKL2AGYU;full][/previewyoutube]

We are honored to work with the legendary mech designer - Okawara Kunio, otherwise known as “the father of Gundam”. With his talent and expertise, we are happy to announce that a mecha skin for Yueshan will be coming to NARAKA in the summer of 2024. Stay tuned for more information!


That’s all for now Forerunners. We wish you an amazing holiday season and look forward to seeing you in-game on Morus Isle!

notes.title: NARAKA: BLADEPOINT Update – December 21st, 2023
notes.content:
Dear players,
The servers of NARAKA: BLADEPOINT will be suspended for maintenance from December 20th, 2023 at 23:00 (UTC) to December 21st, 2023 at 03:00 (UTC). We suggest you log out in advance and enter the game again after the maintenance.
The details for this update are as follows:
[h1]Brand New Content[/h1]
[h2]I. New Hadi Skill [Mechanical Arm: Pursuit]and Ultimate [Aerial Ascent: Rescue] are now available. [/h2]
[previewyoutube=_-HIlx_8o2E;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]
[h2]II. Disengage System[/h2]
Shadow Surge and Capture the Spirit Well modes will both support the Disengage System.
[h2]III. Fairyland Penglai[/h2]
[h3]1. Scenery Updates[/h3]
Fairyland Penglai has been updated in accordance with the Martial Infinity and Holly Christmas themes:
(1) In the Martial Infinity Theme Area, players can interact with Martial Pedastals and display the flag of their chosen school;
(2) In the Holly Christmas Theme Area, players can interact with Gift Boxes to turn into snowpeople!
[h3]2. Castell[/h3]
Four (4) Castell mechanisms have been added to the plaza in front of the Pantheon on Fairyland Penglai. After activating the ring, a Martial Arts Manual will appear above. Bring your friends and earn rewards!
(The reward for interacting with a Martial Arts Manual will change with version updates. In this version, you will get up to 1 Martial Treasure, a Martial Infinity event item, per week.)
In addition to the rewards, players can also challenge new heights: stack on top of each other to reach the flags above the ring.
[h2]IV. Limited-time Events: [/h2]
[h3]1. Martial Infinity[/h3]
Our possibilities unlimited, our martial spirits unchained.
[h3]Event Rules[/h3]
1. During the event, you must join one of the following schools: Will-Form, Tai Chi, Wing Chun, Baji, or Shaolin. By completing Daily Quests and School Quests, you will earn rewards and Martial Fame. Reach certain Martial Fame milestones to claim rare rewards.

2. During the event, open Stashes in Ranked Mode, Quick Match, Immortal's Trial, and BOT Mode for Martial Boxes. You can obtain up to 2 Martial Boxes per game and up to 3 per day. Upon match settlement, you gain Martial Fame based on the number of Martial Boxes acquired. The daily cap for Martial Fame earned by Stashes is 300. Opening a Martial Box randomly yields rare items, with a chance to receive Banner·Martial Arts.

3. During the event, match settlement of Ranked Mode, Quick Match, and BOT Mode earn Martial Fame based on the number of times their team captures a Spirit Well. If 2 or 3 team members belong to the same martial arts school, the Martial Fame earned will receive a 20% or 50% bonus, respectively. The daily cap for Martial Fame earned by capturing the Spirit Well is 600.

4. Martial Fame you accumulate through various means will also be counted as Martial Fame for the martial arts school you belong to. The school that accumulates enough Martial Fame the quickest will be crowned the Unrivaled School.

5. If you reach 12,500 in total Martial Fame, you will receive the Legendary Emote Gesture [Martial Infinity·Victory] via mail after the event ends and the next version update rolls out. The design of this reward will be based on the school elected as the Unrivaled School.

[h3]2. Holly Christmas[/h3]
The holiday bells are ringing, a wish for peace and happiness in the New Year.
[h3]Event Rules[/h3]
1. Gain Pinecones by completing quests during the event. Pinecones can be redeemed for great event rewards.

2. During the event, in all modes except Showdown, the ranged weapon Cannon will be changed to Snow-Cannon, firing snowballs. The Cannon Souljade [Rupture Gale Orb & Burn] will temporarily be replaced with [Rupture Gale Orb & Frostwind], but the effects and damage remain the same.

[h3]3. Gingerbread Joy Sign-In[/h3]
As the year ends, remember the Gingerbread.
[h3]Event Rules[/h3]
Players can get special rewards by signing in on specific days during the event and can make-up for yesterday if it was missed. If you sign in for 5, 10 or 15 consecutive days, you will get extra rewards such as Epic Pose, Spectral Silk*2024 or Regular Treasure ChoiceGift*2.
[h3]4. Christmas Limited-time Discount[/h3]
(1) Season Treasure in limited-time return
During the event, Tidal Treasure, Echelon Treasure, Untamed Treasure, Dawn Treasure and Reckoning Treasure will be available again for a limited time.

(2) Christmas Special Offer
During the event, 4 kinds of vouchers are claimable on the event page: Legendary Outfit 30% discount voucher, Legendary Weapon 30% discount voucher, Legendary Accessory 30% discount voucher and other legendary Item 30% discount voucher. There are 2 of each voucher type to be claimed. Use these vouchers to get a 30% discount on cosmetics released before the Untamed Season.

(3) Selected Cosmetics Discounts
We have brought [Journey of Blades·Divine Seal], [Poetic Rhymes·Lion Dance] and [Udumbara] back to the store for a limited-time discount. For more details, please visit the "SHOP-Featured".

[h2]V. Playstation Exclusive Mode[/h2]
1. A brand-new Solo mode "PlayStation®Tournaments - Martial Artist Solo" is now open for limited-time test! Contend with other players in a 1v1 mode to experience the epitome of competitive combat!
Test Time: Dec 21, 2023 - Jan 3, 2024 20:00(UTC+0)
The mode will go live officially after the update on Jan 4, 2024, offering great rewards for players to enjoy!
After the game mode opens up, there will be a tournament held every day. In groups of 16, players will compete in 1v1 Best of 5 matches to advance, culminating in a single victor for the group, after which the competition will end.
Tournaments are hosted on respective servers, each with its own start time. Please select the appropriate tournament to register. Once registered, players are required to join in within 5 minutes after the tournament's start time.
Registration Instructions: To register, open the PlayStation Tournaments Card on your PlayStation, or select the"PlayStation® Tournaments Martial Artist Solo" mode in game and select "Start Game."
Participation: Before the tournament starts, log in to the corresponding server, select "Start Game," and access the PlayStation Tournaments Card to join.
[h1]Hero Adjustments[/h1]
[h2]I. Hadi[/h2]
1. Reduced the stagger time of Plume Blade's horizontal 1st stage charged attack.

2. Increased the time that Hadi has to wait to attack after dodging while flying.

3. Slightly reduced the strike coverage time of charged dash attack, making it match the animation better.

4. Optimized the special effects of Hadi's Skill Mechanical Arm: Pursuit, solving issues that would occur when Hadi hit targets that were bound by Water Bombs, Frozen or being controlled by others skills. 
[h1]Weapon Adjustments[/h1]
[h2]I. Staff[/h2]
(1) When Stanchion·Rising Cloud misses, the following Heaven Uproar's second hit will grant Blue Focus instead of Gold Focus.

(2) Restrictions to the timing of using grappling Hook during the third hit of Heaven Uproar.
[h2]II. Fan[/h2]
(1) Reduction in hit stun duration of charged Horizontal Strikes and Vertical Strikes.

(2) Reduction in damage coefficient of charged Horizontal Strike from 2.77*2 to 2.55*2.

 Reduction in damage coefficient of charged Vertical Strike from 2.5*2 to 2.29*2.

[h2]III. Polesword[/h2]
(1) Improvements to the gestures of charged vertical Strikes.

(2) Slight increase in the time frame for a possible interruption to a charged Vertical Strike.

(3) Reduction in the Polesword's Stone Formdamage reduction from 75% to 60%.
[h1]Souljade Adjustment[/h1]
[h2]I. Dual Blades Souljade[/h2]
Souljade "Martial Art·Octa-SlashBlade” added.
[h1]In-match Adjustments[/h1]
[h2]I. Feature Adjustments[/h2]
In-match quest "Salute" was adjusted such that players only need to send the emote to the specified Clay Figurine once, instead of twice.
[h2]II. Realm of Yang Adjustments[/h2]
The collision size of the pillars in the Realm of Yang has been adjusted.
[h2]III. BOT Mode Adjustments[/h2]
The logic of AI opponents using Hero Ultimates improved, slightly increasing the frequency of Hero Ultimates.
[h1]Out-of-match Adjustments[/h1]
[h2]I. My Info[/h2]
Statistics for past Showdown seasons have been added. They can be viewed in "All Seasons" and "Showdown Pre-Season."
[h2]II. Request Party[/h2]
Players can now send a party request to friends in the game through the friend list.
[h2]III. Mastery Leaderboard[/h2]
Players must be at least Lv.50 to be ranked on the Mastery Leaderboard.
[h2]IV. The "Golden Poetry of Tang" Event[/h2]
An in-game icon for the H5 event, "Journey with Tang Poetry" in "Golden Poetry of Tang” has been added.
[h1]Showdown Adjustments[/h1]
[h2]I. Opening of Yama's Abyss Leaderboards[/h2]
The number of available levels in Yama's Abyss has been increased to 45, accompanied by a new challenge: the Yama's Abyss Leaderboard, a part of the Showdown Leaderboards.
In Yama's Abyss, reaching higher levels, trying different heroes, and completing stages with greater speed will help you rise to the top of the leaderboards and earn rare titles and Hero Badge rewards.
The rules are as follows:
1. The leaderboards are separated into Solos and Trios. Getting records in different modes will be registered on the respective leaderboard.

2. We hope that each hero will shine on the leaderboards. For this reason, each hero will have their own leaderboard for Yama's Abyss.

3. After leaderboards open, completing a stage will create a record. Data from before leaderboards are opened will not be recorded.

4. Leaderboards will consider both the stage reached and the time taken, reaching higher stages will increase your rank; when there is a tie in stage reached, ranking will occur by the time taken, down to the second. If there is still a tie, then the player who created the record first will be given a higher rank.

5. After the update, the leaderboards will be settled every Wednesday at 20:00 (UTC). If any one of your heroes ranks within the top 500 at the time of settlement, you will receive a title reward. At the end of the current Showdown season, a limited-edition avatar will be awarded to you based on your best title ranking and your final ranking. After the settlement of the season's final week, the top 3 players will also receive a unique Hero Badge, with only 1 Hero Badge per player based on their highest rank.
At the same time, we will also optimize the Speedrun Leaderboard: The Speedrun Leaderboard will also be separated by Hero. We hope that this will let everyone use their favorite hero to get the appropriate glory.
[h2]II. Combat Adjustments[/h2]
1. Increased the scattering angle between arrows when the Bow Evil-Ent is on Hard and above, and when it has the [Relentless Volley] Omen, to avoid multiple arrows hitting the same target, and reduced the damage value of [Relentless Volley] by a certain amount.

2: A [Ocean Yaksa] using [Swirl Crossbow] can still attack while being hit by a melee white attack.

3. After using the [Swirl Crossbow] and stowing it away, monsters will no longer switch to an unarmed state. Instead, they will revert to using the weapon that was equipped prior to the crossbow.

4. The Hammer Evil-Ent in Normal mode will no longer perform consecutive ground smashes.

5. The clash window of usable moves when attacked for [Thunderspawn] and [Cursespawn] has been removed, and the cooldown of usable moves when attacked has been increased.

6. The casting interval and probability of the Blue Focus move of the Fiery Monster in Hard mode have been slightly reduced.

7. The Fiery Monster will now proactively exit the affected area of the [Hellhole] Omen when it finds itself within it.

8. The probability of Nerusa using the dive move in the Yama's Abyss has been reduced.

9. The kneeling animation of Nauticus and Nerusa post-Aegis-break has been optimized to fix a bug that prevented certain moves from attacking them in the Aegis-broken state.

10. The invincibility status of Mountain Ghost, Fiery Monster, and Stone Monster upon spawning in the Enigma Domain and Yama's Abyss modes has been removed. The invincibility status of Thunderspawn and Cursespawn upon spawning in any mode has also been removed.

11. The damage of some moves of Omnius·Aureate has been reduced.

12. The collision detection area for the tail and limbs of [Omnius·Beast] has been enlarged. Additionally, the collision detection area for its head during the post-Aegis-broken falling state has been adjusted.

13. Delayed the time at which [Omnius·Beast]'s charged tail strike will hit after it flips itself over.

14. The invincibility of players upon rebirth has been altered. Now, even if a player performs an action, the invincibility will not be canceled. However, the player will be unable to deal damage during the invincibility period.

15. The difficulty level of all Boss monsters in the single-player mode has been toned down.

16. An issue causing a mismatch between the attack range of certain monster moves and their special effect range has been resolved.

17. The impact of monster attack moves on the environment (such as trees, grass, water) in PvE battles has been optimized.

18. Optimized the movement of Counterstrikecombos when using the Katana, the Nunchucks or the Staff, making it easier to hit monsters.

19. The attributes of Soul Altars·Immutable Wood in Immovable have been slightly increased.

20. The accumulation meter for Frostbite, ThunderShock, Spirit Erosion, and Liquid Miasma has been relocated to the right side of the player information panel.

21. When Feria Shen is driving the Bronze Mech, she will no longer sustain direct damage from attacks. Additionally, the mechanism that made the Bronze Mech "less likely to be targeted by Bosses" has been eliminated.
[h2]III. Yama's Abyss Adjustments[/h2]
[h3]1. Rift Dealer Adjustments[/h3]
(1) A refresh feature has been introduced, enabling players to refresh the temporary enhancement items and Souljades offered by the Rift Dealer. Players are granted one refresh opportunity each time they enter the Boss Zone.

(2) The likelihood of the Rift Dealer selling the same type of Souljade that the player currently has equipped has been increased. The Rift Dealer is also more likely to sell Souljades that can form combo effects with Souljades and Anima Rings already owned by the player.

(3) Players who have previously purchased Ice Essence or Thunder Essence will be unable to purchase the same type of Element Essence again.

(4) The display of Souljades sold by the Rift Dealer has been improved. Players can now accurately view the Elemental Attributes of the Souljades.

[h3]2. The likelihood of players receiving Souljades that can form combo effects with Souljades and Anima Rings they already own has been increased when completing area quests for Souljade rewards.[/h3]
//Devs' Note: In Showdown, certain Souljades can create potent effects when working with other specific Souljades.We have optimized the Souljade loot rules to enhance players' chances of experiencing these combo effects in Yama's Abyss.

[h3]3. Adjustments to the Dark Tide Coin Loot Rules in Yama's Abyss:[/h3]
(1) Monsters will no longer drop Dark Tide Coins upon defeat. Instead, all players will directly receive a specified number of Dark Tide Coins. In multi-player scenarios, all players will share the Dark Tide Coins obtained from defeating monsters equally.
(2) In the "Capture the Spirit Well" and "Braving the Ambush" quests, monsters will no longer provide Dark Tide Coins rewards after their second respawn.
//Devs' Note: We have revised the Dark Tide Coins loot rules to address the issue of some Dark Tide Coins not being automatically collected, and the problem of a single player in a multi-player mode collecting most of the Dark Tide Coins.
[h3]4. Combat Items Adjustments[/h3]
(1) The startup frames for the animation of using the Boss summoning item and the animation of Boss attacks have been reduced, and the damage to Astral Aegis caused by items has been significantly increased. Different items will also yield different buffs. The specific effects are as follows:
[Ignis Blaze]: When this item is used, it not only summons Omnius·Hell Scorch to unleash a flame attack, but also restores Rage to all team members.
[Annihilate Light]: When this item is used, the laser strike will render the enemy into a [Vulnerable] state, increasing the damage they receive from melee and ranged attacks.
[Obliterate Hammer]: When this item is used, it not only summons Omnius·Aureate to execute a hammer smash but also restores Armor to all team members.

(2) Boss summoning items can now be purchased from the Rift Dealer, while [Yushan Bladestorm] cannot be.
[h3]5. Stage Unlocking Adjustments:[/h3]
In Yama's Abyss mode, when you and other teammates complete a stage that you have not unlocked, this completion record will be saved for you. Once you complete the prerequisite stage for this stage, this stage will also be marked as completed immediately.
//Devs' Note: Currently, in Yama's Abyss mode, players have varying progress statuses. We aim to ensure that players who are progressing at a slower pace can also advance when playing with their friends.
[h3]6. Portal Adjustments[/h3]
(1) Improved the placement of Portals leading to the next area, ensuring that they correspond better.

(2) After teleporting, the player's character will no longer keep their hands raised.
[h3]7. Adjusted the levels at which different content appears, lower stages will now feature Omens, Cursed Chests and Hard Monster Zones. Details are as follows:[/h3]
Stage 1: Monster Areas will contain the "Capture" mode.
Stage 2: Curse Chests may appear in The SHOP area, and players can choose whether to open them. They may contain [Melee Sunder], [Ranged Sunder], and [Health Sap] curses.
Stage 4: An Omen will appear in the monster area.
Stage 6: A Hard-mode monster area may appear, and players can choose whether to enter it.
Stage 8: Curse Chests may contain [Powerful Foe] and [Lost] curses.
//Developer's Comment: Players can now experience some elements that offer varied gameplay but will not significantly increase the difficulty level in the early stages of Yama's Abyss.
[h3]8. Adjustments to Omens in the Yama's Abyss:[/h3]
(1) In the "Capture the SpiritWell" quest, the [Ghostly Hand], [Ice Wind], and [Frozen Earth] Omens will no longer appear.
(2) The positions of some Omens that were too close to the player's spawn point have been adjusted.
(3) The number of Omens in the Boss area has been reduced.
[h3]9. Cursed Chest Adjustments[/h3]
(1) Adjusted the curse effect of [Health Sap] so that it won't reduce a player's health below 0.

(2) A text prompt will now appear after a Curse Chest is opened and the Dark Tide Coins and Curses contained inside are collected.

[h3]10. Players who utilize Cleanse Stones to refresh the enhancement content will no longer encounter the same rewards that were previously available before the refresh.[/h3]

[h3]11. The total remaining battle time is now displayed above the minimap.[/h3]

[h3]12. The descriptions of some Blessings and items sold by the Rift Dealer have been optimized.[/h3]

[h3]13. The tags of Anima Rings have been optimized, and players will now receive recommendations for suitable enhancement content based on their current style.[/h3]

[h3]14. The size of the Boss area has been expanded.[/h3]

[h3]15. The quantity of Nerusa in the initial areas has been increased.[/h3]
[h2]IV. Omen Adjustment[/h2]
Activation time of Divine Thunder and Ice Mound omen mechanisms increased. The player will only be attacked 5 seconds after their appearance.
[h2]V. Anima Ring Collections Adjustments[/h2]
(1) When selecting Anima Rings in Yama's Abyss, the player will get a prompt if a higher-level Anima Ring has not been collected.
(2) Details of each type of Anima Ring in the Anima Ring Collections added.
[h2]VI. New Showdown Souljade[/h2]
Swift Heal: Use Special Healing Berries and Special Armor Powder quicker.
[h2]VII. Souljade Adjustments[/h2]
[h3]Yushan Shadows[/h3]
(1) Reduction in the number of Frostbite stacks required to summon a Matron of Yushan Shadow for an assist attack from 3 to 1, and the maximum stacks from 3 to 2. Reduction in the damage coefficient of Matron of Yushan Shadow from 25 to 12.

(2) When using Defuse (Counterattack), players can consume 1 stack to summon 2 Matron of Yushan Shadows for assist attacks. However, the damage coefficient of each Matron of Yushan Shadow will be reduced by 30%.
[h2]VII. Others[/h2]
(1) Showdown Season Reward Adjustment
Extra Showdown Seals and Hero Badges added to Showdown Season rewards. Final Rewards:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36350327/ccc716a052294bbd6d629fe841da50564f0d3cd3.png[/img]

(2) Descriptions of Martial Skills added to the Hero Upgrade panel. The Lv.12 and Lv.18 skills are Aegis-break Martial Skill and Defuse Martial Skill, respectively.
[h1]Feature Adjustments[/h1]
[h2]I. Performance Adjustments[/h2]
(1) Characters' sprinting movements adjusted.

(2) The position of red aura from Counters changed.

(3) Issue where the character in Home was facing the wrong direction when holding a bow and arrow fixed.

(4) Optimized some frequently appearing special effects in Showdown mode, reducing the number of effects that will appear onscreen at the same time and reducing lag.

(5) Modified the interaction between certain accessories and hair, making the hair appear more natural.
[h2]II. Xbox Performance Optimization[/h2]
Reduced memory usage by 80MB, lowering the likelihood of crashes on low-memory devices due to insufficient memory.
[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
[h2]I. Hero Bugs[/h2]
1. Fixed an issue with the damage reduction type of Mighty Bellow of Yueshan's General's Call: Protection. Effects remain unchanged.

2. Fixed an issue where Zai's Flame Ward: Firestorm failed to immediately generate a hit under specific circumstances.
[h2]II. Showdown Bugs[/h2]
1. Fixed an issue where the incorrect number of Dark Tide Coins would be dropped by certain monsters in Yama's Abyss.

2. Fixed an issue with the map that would occur in Yama's Abyss's cave stages.

3. Fixed an issue where players could not clash with some of Depth Fiend's Purple Focus moves.

4. Fixed an issue that would occur when attacking the Water Ent while it was in stealth and countering it while it was dealing an execution move.

5. Fixed the shaky camera that could occur when locking onto Omnius·Beast.

6. If Kurumi uses a Horizontal Strike when neutralizing an action with the Martial Skill "Fang Severing Slash," she will now cast Thunderstorm instead of the Aegis-break Martial Skill "Severing Gust."

7. Fixed incorrect recommended Sense Levels for the Topaz Enigma Domain.
[h1]Store Updates[/h1]
[h2]I. Yin Yang Pool·Martial Infinity Goes Live[/h2]
Each pull requires 1 Ingot·Martial Infinity, which costs 400 Gold. There are as many as 21 rewards, including Tessa's Legendary Outfit [Martial Infinity·Will-Form], Wuchen's Legendary Outfit [Martial Infinity·Tai Chi], and the brand-new Legendary Group Gesture [Martial Infinity·Yin-Yang Debate]. The first open is free. You will not receive duplicate rewards, which means you can get all the rewards after opening 21 times. Each open grants a chance to get all the remaining rewards in the pool. After getting all the rewards, you can go to your Inventory to convert unused Ingots·Martial Infinity into Gold.
[h3]Guarantee:[/h3]
Based on the above drop rate, players are guaranteed to receive at least one Gold (Legendary) reward within the first 4draws. Another guaranteed Gold (Legendary) reward within 5 more draws, followed by the next guaranteed Gold (Legendary) reward within 7 more draws.
[h2]II. New Packs[/h2]
Newly added Feria Shen exclusive Pack [WingChun Pack], including Legendary Outfit [Martial Infinity·Wing Chun], EpicHairstyle [Martial Infinity·Wing] and Legendary Pose [Martial Infinity·Wing Chun Kuen]. Standard price: 3,100 Gold; Now: 2,400 Gold.

notes.title: NARAKA: BLADEPOINT Banned Players List 12-19
notes.content:
Dear players,

NARAKA: BLADEPOINT is committed to creating a fair and healthy competitive environment. We have not only used new anti-cheat technologies, but also established special cheat-reporting reward activities to encourage those players who defend the fairness with us. From now on, players who make outstanding contributions to reporting cheats will get the Legendary spear skin 'Righteous Polearm' .

More details:
1. Players who successfully reported 1 time will get [Immortal Treasure] X1;

2. Players who successfully report 10 times with low misreport rate will get [Immortal Treasure] X10 (In order to ensure the efficiency of detecting, please report reasonably);

3. Players who have successfully reported for many times or made great contributions to anti-cheat will get the Legendary spear skin [Righteous Polearm] X1.

We strongly recommend that players report via in-game report system, so that we can confirm the cheat as soon as possible and record successful report times for you!

From 12.11 to 12.17, there are 7 players who have successfully reported the cheating or hacking in total and get the reward [Righteous Polearm]! We hope that more players can become the Justice Supporter on the Morus Isle in the future.

notes.title: NARAKA: BLADEPOINT Update – November 30th, 2023
notes.content:
[h1]Dear players,[/h1]
The servers of NARAKA: BLADEPOINT will be suspended for maintenance from November 29, 2023, at 23:00 (UTC) to November 30, 2023, at 03:00 (UTC). We suggest you log out in advance and enter the game again after the maintenance.

The details for this update are as follows:

[b][h2]Brand New Content[/h2][/b]
[b]I. Showdown Season 1.0: Chasm[/b]
Seasons have now been introduced in Showdown mode: After each Showdown season ends, all levels and the base Sense Level of Heroes will change. Also, the Potential progress and content will be reset. Showdown Season 1.0: Chasm will end on March 7, 2024 at 00:00 (UTC).

[i]//Dev Notes: The idea behind switching to a season system is based on the gap that has emerged between experienced players and newer players in Showdown. Seasons will let us keep a stream of new rewards and fresh stages, while also making necessary changes to various stages and minimum/maximum sense levels. Furthermore, it will allow newer players to integrate into the Showdown community without feeling a large gap with more experienced players.[/i]

[u]1. New Gameplay: Yama's Abyss[/u]
[previewyoutube=QdFErjhhyjE;full][/previewyoutube]
This is a brand new roguelike iteration of Showdown Mode. In Yama's Abyss, all players start on equal footing, taking on an unlimited number of random stages. Players can obtain a wide variety of temporary enhancements to strengthen themselves as levels get progressively more challenging.

When playing Yama's Abyss, Souljades that you have equipped will not initially appear in your Souljade Bag, but instead will randomly appear in the in-game Rift Dealer. Explore Yama's Abyss, discover various enhancements, and challenge countless random levels!

Advancing through the tiers of Yama's Abyss and increasing your rank in the Showdown Season will earn you valuable rewards, including the Regular Treasure Choice Gift and the Rank Avatar. At the end of each Showdown Season, both your rank and rewards progress will be reset.

[u]2. New Boss: Omnius·Vortex [/u]
[previewyoutube=AqsQBwRPwoU;full][/previewyoutube]
Water, is the source of all things, the fountain of countless changes.
Take on the ferocious beasts of Omnius and 3 new levels at the Shipwreck Expanse on the Morus Isle.

[u]3. New Hero Introduced in the Mode: Feria Shen[/u]
Pilot her Bronze Mech and obliterate all enemies that stand in your way!

[u]4. Potential System and Huge selection of new Showdown Souljades[/u]
There is a brand new Potential System where you can play Showdown mode to get Potential XP and Potential Points. Level up your Potential and build your Souljades to create your own play style in Showdown.

The progress of the Potential System will be reset at the start of every Showdown Season, offering a fresh battle experience with new content and challenges.

[u]5. Fatigue system[/u]
After this update, Showdown will be available at all times and will have a new Fatigue system.
By playing a stage of Showdown, Showdown Souljades, Quench Crystals, and other items can be obtained as drops. At the same time, Fatigue will increase up to a maximum of 2,000. While below the first threshold of Fatigue, drops will be increased by 150%. Each time that Fatigue passes a threshold, in-game drops will decrease. Fatigue will reset to 0 every Wednesday at 20:00 (UTC).
(Showdown Scroll items will expire after the update, and there will be no way to use or acquire them again)

[u]6. Showdown Store Updates[/u]
Newly added Legendary Weapon Skins [Calamity Forge·Blade], [Auger], etc. and Enhancement Items.

[b]II. Advanced Showdown Pass - Chasm Undertow[/b]
Event Time: November 30, 2023 Update to March 6, 2024 at 23:00 (UTC). 
[olist]
[*] Showdown Pass XP can only be obtained through [Showdown] modes and quests.
[*] Upgrade your Showdown Pass to claim plentiful rewards.
[*] Tons of Showdown Seals, Rebirth Beads, Enhancement Materials, and other rewards in the Showdown Pass are claimable; Unlock the Legendary Weapon Skin [Chasm Vortex·Surging], Martial Skill Cosmetic [Severing Gust·Plum], [Fang Severing Slash·Ocher] and bottomless exclusive rewards!
[/olist]
[b]III. Time-limited Event: Secret of the Shipwreck[/b]
Event Time: From after the update on Nov 30, 2023 to Dec 13, 2023 at 20:00 (UTC). 

Event Rules: Players can get Aqua Pearls by completing quests during the event. Aqua Pearls can be redeemed for great event rewards.
[list]
[*] Complete each day's Daily Quests to receive bonus rewards.
[*] There are 5 groups of Challenge Quests, each available in turn at different times. Complete quests to claim plentiful rewards.
[/list]
[b][h2]Hero Adjustments[/h2][/b]
[b]I. Zai[/b]
[list]
[*] Added a flash cue for the Gold Focus move of the Ultimate Weapon [Chain Scythe].
[*] Optimized the special effects of the third Horizontal and Vertical Strikes of the [Chain Scythe].
[/list]
[b]II. Hadi[/b]
[list]
[*] Enabled the mechanism for Hadi to counter while in flight.
[*] Optimized the hit performance of the Charged Attack during flight.
[*] Optimized the sound effect during flight.
[*] Optimized the damage calculation mechanism that exits flight status upon accumulating certain damage during flight. Now, the damage dealt by Armor Pierce is properly included, while the damage dealt by Shadow Corruption is not included.
[/list]
[i]//Dev Notes: Hadi has a unique flight mechanism, adding new experiences and challenges to the battlefield. We'll continue to monitor the players' evolving control and strength performances. Hadi can now counter while in flight, with the same effect as his 3rd stage of charged attack. We hope these adjustments will introduce more tactics and variations in battles between Hadi and other heroes.[/i]

[b][h2]Souljade Adjustments[/h2][/b]
[b]I. General Souljades[/b]
Newly added Souljade (Consumable) [Vajra's Grip]: When being Countered, restore some Health and your weapon will not drop.

[b][h2]In-game Adjustments[/h2][/b]
[b]I. Feature Optimizations[/b]
[list]
[*] Now, using emotes and gestures immediately can interrupt an ongoing emote or gesture.
[*] Optimized the perspective view selection mechanism when the spectator is the last team member eliminated and all their teammates are in the Remains.
[*] Optimized the transition mechanism between the hero selection screen, spawn point selection screen, and map screen during the preparation phase. You can now quickly switch to the corresponding screen by pressing the respective keys on each above-mentioned screen.
[/list]
[b]II. Bot Mode Adjustments[/b]
[list]
[*] Optimized AI Counter use at each difficulty level.
[*] Hard difficulty AIs have received differentiated playstyles, AIs with different playstyles will behave differently in combat.
[/list]
[b]III. Controller Adjustments[/b]
During the preparation phase, press L1 + Touchpad (PS) / LB + View Button (XBOX) to view hero skill descriptions in the hero selection screen.

[b][h2]Out-game Adjustments[/h2][/b]
[b]I. Added Scoring System in Casual Mode[/b]
[list]
[*] Added scores to Shadow Surge, Capture the Spirit Well, The Bloodbath, and Bloodsport modes. The scoring system is added only to reflect your proficiency in these modes.
[*] The initial score is 1,000, with each 500-point increment moving up a tier, up to a maximum of 9 tiers.
[*] Scores will be reset proportionally at the season update.
[/list]
[b]II. Personal Information[/b]
[list]
[*] Your scoring stats are now included in the Casual Mode.
[*] Showdown Mode will now have Yama's Abyss Rank information. Starting from Showdown Season 1.0, related stats will be collected in accordance with the new Showdown Season format. Previous stats will temporarily not be visible.
[/list]
[b]III. Rank[/b]
[list]
[*] Added a Mastery Leaderboard to reflect your proficiency in different modes, ranking based on Casual Mode scores in the following four modes: Shadow Surge, Capture the Spirit Well, The Bloodbath, and Bloodsport.
[*] Added a Collection Leaderboard, ranking based on Collection Points.
[/list]
[b]IV. Hero Badge[/b]
Added the expanded stages for several Hero Badges, including [Morus Legends], [Divine Treasures], and [Admirable Collection].

[b]V. Star - Collections System[/b]
Viper Ning exclusive Star Collection Outfit[Star - 2P] will be tradable after 04:00 (UTC) on November 30, 2023. It can be traded on the Steam Community Market.

[b]VI. Fairyland Penglai[/b]
Players can now teleport to the Fairyland Penglais of players that they are not friends with.

[b][h2]Showdown Adjustments[/h2][/b]
[b]I. Combat Adjustments[/b]
[list]
[*] Shortened the rebirth and revival time in all Showdown gameplay.
[*] Now, monsters with Astral Aegis won't roll to get up after being downed.
[*] Optimized some combat effects.
[/list]
[b]II. Souljade Adjustments[/b]
[u]1. Removed the Rage recovery effect from additional hits of Souljades[/u], such as [Stormstride Sword], [Thunder Sword], and [Ice Bomb], while increasing the damage multipliers in certain strikes. Specific adjustments are as follows:
[list]
[*] [Draco Stride]: Increased the damage multiplier of the wave from 0.6 to 0.72;
[*] [Icefall]: Increased the damage multiplier of the icicle from 0.75 to 1.0;
[*] [Stormstride]: Increased the damage multiplier of the lightning strike from 1.5 to 1.6;
[*] [Stormstride Sword]: Increased the damage multiplier of Thunderbolt from 0.25 to 0.27;
[*] [Thunder Sword]: Increased the damage multiplier of Thunderbolt from 0.2 to 0.24;
[*] [Frost Cannon]: Increased the damage multiplier of Frost Wind from 0.11*6 to 0.13*6;
[*] [Ice Bomb] Increased the damage multiplier of Frost Wind from 0.08*5 to 0.1*5;
[*] [Thunder Cannon]: Increased the damage multiplier of the electric sparks from 0.4 to 0.5;
[*] [Thunder Shot]: Increased the damage multiplier of Thunder from 0.17*2 to 0.21*2.
[/list]
[i]//Dev Notes: With the new Souljades and Potential System, hits beyond weapon moves provided excessive Rage. Therefore, in the new version, we have removed Rage recovery effects from these hits. To maintain the strength of relevant Souljades, we have increased their damage multipliers.[/i]

[u]2. [Thunderpull][/u]
Reduced the speed at which damage dealt increases Thundershock for oneself at low Thunder-wielding levels.

[u]3. [Jabbing·Ice-wielding][/u]
Increased the Damage Multiplier from 4.29 to 5.21.

[u]4. [Defuse·Solve (Counterattack)], [Defuse·Combo (Counterattack)], and [Defuse·Dash (Counterattack)][/u]
The method of filling the Defuse slot changed from "dealing damage with uncharged attacks" to "dealing damage with melee attacks or triggering the Defuse".

[b]III. Elemental Effect Adjustments[/b]
[list]
[*] Removed the Rage recovery effect from element-triggered hits.
[*] Reduced the accumulation speed of elemental effects by 48%.
[/list]
[i]//Dev Notes: The Potentials in the new season will bring in a lot of gameplay and enhancements around elemental effects. Therefore, we have lowered the frequency of triggering elemental effects, hoping that the rising elemental mechanic in current gameplay won't become the only solution in the version.[/i]
[list]

[*] The cooldown for accumulating elemental effect points after monsters trigger elemental effects has changed from a 2-second team-shared cooldown to a 6-second individual cooldown.
[/list]
[i]//Dev Notes: In the previous version, triggering an elemental effect on a monster paused the entire team's elemental accumulation on that monster for 2 seconds. In the new version, only the player who triggers the elemental effect will pause their own elemental accumulation on the monster. This pause will no longer be affected by your teammates, therefore allowing more control over your triggering time.[/i]

[b]IV. Hero Adjustments[/b]
[u]1. Viper Ning[/u]
[list]
[*] The Damage Multiplier of skill [Yushan Strike: Showdown] has increased from 1 to 9, with Aegis-break ability increased from 2,200 to 3,150.
[*] The Aegis-break ability of Ultimate [Moonbane Control: Showdown] has increased from 9,500 to 11,000.
[/list]
[u]2. Tarka Ji[/u]
[list]
[*] The Damage Multiplier of the fireball in the skill [Flame Force: Showdown] has increased from 4 to 5, with Aegis-break ability increased from 400 to 500.
[*] The Rage consumption ratio of a single fireball in Ultimate [Fire Frenzy: Showdown] has reduced from 8% to 6.5%.
[/list]
[u]3. Valda Cui[/u]
[list]
[*] The Aegis-break ability of the Horizontal Strike water spear in Ultimate [Rising Tide: Showdown] has increased from 200 to 1,200, with the Damage Multiplier of the Vertical Strike water spear increased from 3 to 5.
[/list]
[u]4. Kurumi[/u]
[list]
[*] Increased Kurumi's Rage limit to align with other heroes.
[*] Aegis-break Martial Skill [Severing Gust] can now be unleashed by using a horizontal strike after a charged strike.
[/list]
[u]5. Temulch[/u]
[list]
[*] The total Damage Multiplier of Ultimate [Zephyr Wisp: Showdown] is increased from 1.35 to 4.2, with Aegis-break ability increased from 1,350 to 4,200.
[/list]
[u]6. Yueshan[/u]
[list]
[*] The duration of enemy Attack reduction in skill [Scorching Dash: Showdown] has increased from 6 sec to 8 sec.
[/list]
[u]7. Tianhai[/u]
[list]
[*] Skill [Divine Bell: Showdown] grants 50% damage reduction to self for 8 sec upon release.
[/list]
[b]V. Omens Adjustments[/b]
[olist]
[*] Monsters with [Impassable] Omen can now use Blue Focus moves more frequently and will lose more Astral Aegis when hit by a counter.
[*] Adjustments to Frostbite accumulation caused by some Frostbite Omens:
[/olist]
[list]
[*] [Ice Blast]: Frostbite accumulation for each explosion has increased from 100 to 320;
[*] [Frozen Earth]: Frostbite accumulation per sec has increased from 200 to 300;
[/list]
[b]VI. Anima Ring Collections[/b]
The selection of Anima Rings of different levels in Yama's Abyss unlocks corresponding Anima Ring Collections. As the Anima Ring Collections level increases, various enhancement attributes will be unlocked, effective only in the Yama's Abyss mode.

[b]VII. New Showdown Item: Rebirth Bead[/b]
While playing any Showdown Stage, if you die when your default Rebirths have been used up, you can consume a Rebirth Bead and get an extra Rebirth.

[b]VIII. Souljade Recasting Adjustments[/b]
The chance of getting an extra attribute when recasting a Souljade will increase with each recast that has not yielded an extra attribute. A Souljade that has not reached its attribute limit is guaranteed an extra attribute after 50 recasts.

[i]//Dev Notes: Enhancement of Souljades is an important part of Showdown Mode. To deal with cases where it is difficult to acquire rare attributes, we will continue to carry out optimizations in future updates.[/i]

[b]IX. Sense Level Adjustments[/b]
The minimum recommended Sense Level and the minimum Sense Level of dropped Souljades have increased to 450. The maximum Sense Level for a single Season has been increased to 680. 

[b]X. Other Changes[/b]
[list]
[*] Now, you must clear specific levels before you can unlock and obtain the corresponding Souljades through Souljade conversion and the new Souljade Choice Gifts. Previous Souljade Choice Gifts are not subject to this change.
[*] Showdown quests have been revamped. The new Showdown Quest Handbook includes weekly quests, weekly doom rewards, and season quests. Complete the corresponding quests to earn Showdown Pass XP, Quench Crystals, and Showdown Souljades.
[*] Stage progress is now displayed on the map for gameplay selection in Showdown.
[/list]

[b][h2]Settings[/h2][/b]
[b]I. Video Playback[/b]
DirectX 12 is supported.

[b]II. Brightness[/b]
Added [Min Brightness] and [Max Brightness] adjustments when HDR Display is enabled.

[b][h2]Client Optimization[/h2][/b]
[list]
