notes.title: NARAKA: BLADEPOINT Update – November 16th, 2023
notes.content:
[b][h1]Dear players,[/h1][/b]

The servers of NARAKA: BLADEPOINT will be suspended for maintenance from November 15, 2023 at 23:00 (UTC) to November 16, 2023 at 03:00 (UTC). We suggest you log out in advance and enter the game again after the maintenance.

The details for this update are as follows:

[b][h2]Brand New Content[/h2][/b]
[b]I. New Hero: Hadi Ismail, The Visionary[/b]
[previewyoutube=8Ww2y_KPWW4;full][/previewyoutube]
Hadi refused to yield to adversity. Tragedy and misfortune, instead of breaking him, steeled his determination to shape his own destiny. His unwavering commitment to pursuing knowledge and self-improvement was the path he followed to hold fast to his fate...

[i](Hadi's third skill variant and third ultimate variant will be made available in future updates. Once they are, complete the corresponding Cultivation Quests to unlock them. They will automatically unlock for players that have already completed the corresponding Cultivation Quests.)[/i]

[b]II. Limited-time Event: Pioneer Wonder[/b]
He comes with a vision unfinished, missing a piece which he hopes to find in the East.

Event Duration: From after the November 16, 2023 update is complete until November 29, 2023 at 20:00 (UTC).

[u]Event Rules:[/u]
[olist]
[*] Complete Daily Quests to obtain Hadi Trial Vouchers and Mech Plumes.
[*] Complete Event Quests to obtain Mech Plumes. A new quest can be unlocked only after completing the current one. Quests can only be completed when they become available.
[*] Consume Mech Plumes to redeem rewards.
[/olist]
[b]III. Limited-time Event: Golden Poetry of Tang[/b]
Kurumi, Yueshan and Matari convened outside the capital city of Chang'an. A meeting of three great minds under the moon to revel in poetry.

Event Duration: From after the November 16, 2023 update is complete until January 31, 2024 at 16:00 (UTC).

[u]Event Rules:[/u]
[olist]
[*] A Festive Lantern will be lit each day, and players can choose the Festive Lantern to answer the questions about Tang dynasty-style poems for great rewards.
[*] Play the minigame "Journey with Tang Poetry" to win rewards like Regular Treasure Choice Gift and Exclusive Avatar!
[/olist]
[b]IV. Limited-time Event: Rise of Heroes[/b]
Here is where the heroes gather and rise. The 2023 J Cup is about to kick off, with top players from all five regions competing for the ultimate honor.
[olist]
[*] Participate in the limited-time event Zenith Clash to obtain Martial Jadestones, which can be redeemed for amazing custom rewards. Join the platform's spectator and tournament prediction events to earn a ton of Martial Jadestones.
[*] Participate in the limited-time event Glory of the Past Offers to purchase previous world Champions' custom cosmetics in bulk and get additional exclusive event discounts. Collect enough cosmetics to claim exclusive item rewards.
[*] Participate in the limited-time event Player Support, and help the supported team complete quests to receive team-exclusive custom Tattoos.
[/olist]
[b]V. Pioneer Treasure with Bonus Star - Collections[/b]
Event Duration: From the November 16th, 2023 update to Feburary 1st, 2024 at 00:00 (UTC).
[olist]
[*] When opening Pioneer Treasures, there's a chance to obtain the Extreme Longsword Skin [Star - Florescent Cryolite] and the Legendary Tianhai Outfit [Star - Variance].
[*] How to obtain: Each time you open a Pioneer Treasure, there is a chance to obtain them as an additional reward. This chance increases as you obtain more Legendaries. The maximum chance is 100%.
[*] The chances for the 2 Star-Collections are calculated separately and do not impact each other. After getting a Star-Collection, the corresponding chances will then reset.
[*] Each account can receive a maximum of 10 [Star - Florescent Cryolite] and 2 [Star - Variance].
[*] The number of Star-Collections granted through the Pioneer Treasure is limited and available while stocks last.
[/olist]
[b]VI. Set Rotation Feature[/b]
You can now enable cosmetic set rotation for every Hero individually.

On the Hero cosmetics interface, tap Rotation Settings to choose the sets to include in the rotation and the rotation rules. After saving, you can check the option to enable it. You may choose between Random Rotation or Sequential Rotation.

Once the set rotation feature is enabled, each time you enter the game, a set will automatically be selected for you according to the rotation rules.

This feature does not work in training mode.

[b]VII. Pro Label Adjustments[/b]
With the 2023 J Cup approaching, players from the five regions that have advanced to the J Cup will have a verified 2023JCUP player label added to their accounts. We look forward to seeing everyone shine in the J Cup.

[b][h2]Hero Adjustments[/h2][/b]
[b]I. Feria Shen[/b]
[list]
[*] Increased Bronze Mech's initial Cannon energy to 2 bars for all Ultimate Talents, and greatly increased the natural recovery speed of Cannon energy.
[*] Slightly increased the transformation speed of Bronze Mech's Cannon mode.
[*] Optimized shooting performance of the Cannon when uncharged, and slightly expanded the view and angle options in Cannon mode.
[*] Optimized the hitbox for the pilot in the Bronze Mech. It is now harder to hit the pilot in the Bronze Mech with ranged attacks from the side.
[/list]
[b]II. Temulch[/b]
[list]
[*] Brought forward the timing of granting allies [Storm Prison: Detox] when casting any Ultimate Talents. Temulch can now enable allies to be immune to Storm Prison's control in the moment he casts his Ultimate.
[/list]
[b]III. Kurumi[/b]
[list]
[*] Added a new effect for all minor Skill Talents, allowing Kurumi to recover Health when connected to her target.
[*] Slightly brought forward the interruption timing of Vertical Strikes when connected to the target for all minor Skill Talents, and added Gold Focus.
[*] Slightly brought forward the interruption timing of Moves when casting any Ultimate Talents.
[*] Slightly brought forward the healing effect timing of the Ultimate [Purified Circle: Rapid], and upon taking effect, all allies now receive a 30% Damage Reduction that lasts 5s.
[/list]
[b]IV. Akos Hu[/b]
[list]
[*] Adjusted [Roar] Damage Multiplier from 1.0 to 0.1.
[/list]
[b]V. Ziping Yin[/b]
[list]
[*] Increased Rage limit; after adjustment, the limit is now consistent with most other Heroes.
[/list]
[i]//Dev Note: Ziping Yin's Ultimate can be cast at 70% Rage, and can be actively stopped to conserve Rage. We plan to maintain her advanced control of flexibly casting and stopping her Ultimate during combat. However, due to Ziping Yin's previously lower Rage limit (80% of the average limit), the frequency of her Ultimate casts was too high, hence this adjustment.[/i]

[b]VI. Valda Cui[/b]
[list]
[*] Slightly reduced the target's height when knocked airborne by the water spear's Vertical Strike in her Ultimate [Rising Tide: Barrage].
[/list]
[b][h2]Weapon Adjustments[/h2][/b]
[b]I. Dual Blades[/b]
[list]
[*] Slightly increased the knockback distance of Charged Horizontal Strikes and Charged Vertical Strikes when attacking an enemy that has been knocked down.
[/list]
[b]II. Polesword[/b]
[list]
[*] Slightly reduced the vertical range of Charged Horizontal Strikes.
[/list]
[b][h2]In-game Adjustments[/h2][/b]
[b]I. Feature Optimizations[/b]
[list]
[*] Redesigned the interface performance for achieving Immortal Glory in The Herald's Trial modes.
[*] Added a new display showing progress for Soulajdes (Upgradable).
[/list]
[b]II. Pack Optimizations[/b]
[list]
[*] It is now possible to filter Packs by heroes.
[*] It is now possible to watch a preview video of included items while looking at a Pack.
[/list]
[b]III. Sound FX Optimizations[/b]
[list]
[*] Footstep sounds when wearing high-heels and when barefoot are now different.
[/list]
[b][h2]Out-game Adjustments[/h2][/b]
[b]I. Fairyland Penglai[/b]
[list]
[*] Adjusted Sky-high Racing's times for obtaining the 2nd and 3rd tier rewards to 90s and 150s respectively, and added more rewards for each tier.
[*] Adjusted image format for sharing music scores, optimizing recognition issues caused by low resolutions.
[/list]
[b]II. Free Training[/b]
[list]
[*] Added a bot to help players test various effects triggered upon defeating an enemy.
[*] Introduced Fireflies and fruits like Vajra Fruit, Salak, and Sand Pear; these items will refresh after being picked up.
[*] Optimized calculation of damage statistics; overkill damage dealt to AI opponents is now correctly accounted for.
[/list]
[b]III. Chat[/b]
[list]
[*] You can now send private messages to players who are not yet your friends.
[*] Go to Settings - Social - Chat - Private Message Settings to control who can send you messages. [This option is not available for Xbox] 
[*] Shortened the cooldown for private message notification sound's trigger.
[/list]
[b]IV. Newly added Collection Set[/b]
Under the Collections tab on the My Profile page, a new Set has been added: [Poetic Rhymes]. Collecting these outfits allows you obtain a Dynastic Treasure Choice Gift and a Regular Treasure Choice Gift, among other rewards.

[b][h2]Showdown Adjustments[/h2][/b]
[b]I. Combat Adjustments[/b]
[b]1. Kurumi[/b]
[olist]
[*] Brought forward the interruption timing of Vertical Strikes when connected to the target in the Skill [Healing Ray: Showdown], and added Gold Focus.
[*] Slightly brought forward the interruption timing of moves in the Ultimate [Purified Circle: Showdown].
[*] Optimized the hit reaction of the [Hook Axe] Omen.
[/olist]
[b][h2]Store Updates[/h2][/b]
[b]I. Season Exclusive: Pioneer Treasure Available Now[/b]
[previewyoutube=-1ltwyivExY;full][/previewyoutube]
The Pioneer Treasure is priced at 360 Gold. Open for a chance to obtain rewards like Hadi Extreme Outfit [Enlightened Conductor] and the Fan Extreme Skin [Cosmic Inverter].

[u]Minimum Guarantee:[/u]
1. Players are guaranteed to receive at least 1 Red (Extreme) reward during the process of opening at most 100 Treasures. This can be triggered multiple times.

2. Red (Extreme) rewards will not repeat until all of them have been obtained.
Wishing Legendary Reward: If you draw an Extreme cosmetic, you can set a Legendary cosmetic which will be guaranteed when you draw a Legendary cosmetic next time. Times of guarantee can stack, but you can only set 1 cosmetic each time.

notes.title: NARAKA: BLADEPOINT Update – November 2nd, 2023
notes.content:
Dear players,
Starting on November 2 at 03:00 (UTC), we will be carrying out maintenance on NARAKA: BLADEPOINT servers. There is no need to log out during this time, and you can continue to play normally while the servers are being updated.
The details for this update are as follows:

[h3]Brand New Content[/h3]

I. Limited-time Event: The Enlightening Key
Event Duration: From November 2, 2023 at 03:00 (UTC) to November 15, 2023 at 20:00 (UTC).
Event Rules:
1. By completing Daily Quests, players can obtain Hadi's Token: Cog with an additional chance to obtain one of the following rewards: Tae, Spectral Silk, Regular Treasure Choice Gift, Hero Coin, Legendary Outfit Trial Card, Pioneer Coin.
2. The mechanical arm has 4 parts that need to be repaired by the corresponding Cogs. You can claim corresponding rewards as you progress in repairing the 4 parts.
3. Each day, you can help a player obtain a Cog (by tapping the "Share Hadi Cog" in your Contact List, selecting a Cog, and confirming to share it).

[h3]Shop Updates[/h3]

I.New Packs
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36350327/b808292796cf285134108f919125291f3164fec7.png[/img]
1. Added the Yoto Hime exclusive Pack [Flame of Truth], which contains the Yoto Hime exclusive Legendary Collection Outfit [Flame of Truth] and the Greatsword Legendary Weapon Skin [Scarlet Cloud Blade]. Standard price: 4,200 Gold; Now: 2,880 Gold.
2. Added the Yoto Hime exclusive Pack [Void Ablaze], which contains the Yoto Hime exclusive Legendary Accessory [Flamed Figurine] (Unlock it to get a new appearance for Yoto Hime's ultimate, 'Demon Blade'), and the Yoto Hime exclusive Legendary Accessory [Origami·Blade] (Unlock it to get a new appearance for Yoto Hime's skill "Flying Edge"). Standard price: 7,200 Gold; Now: 4,850 Gold.
II. New Discounts
1. Newly added Fan Legendary Skin [Udumbara]. Standard price: 1,500 Gold; Now: 1,250 Gold.
2. Newly added Yoto Hime Legendary Background [Gilded Tower]. Standard price: 600 Gold; Now: 450 Gold.
3. Newly added Yoto Hime Legendary Base [Verdant Pipa]. Standard price: 1,200 Gold; Now: 900 Gold.
4. Newly added Yoto Hime Legendary Collection Outfit [Flame of Truth]. Standard price: 2,400 Gold; Now: 1,700 Gold.
5. Newly added Greatsword Legendary Weapon Skin [Scarlet Cloud Blade]. Standard price: 1,800 Gold; Now: 1,500 Gold.
6. Newly added Yoto Hime Legendary Accessory [Flamed Figurine], unlock it to get a new appearance for Yoto Hime's ultimate, "Demon Blade". Standard price: 4,800 Gold; Now: 3,200 Gold.
7. Newly added Yoto Hime Legendary Accessory [Origami·Blade], unlock it to get a new appearance for Yoto Hime's skill "Flying Edge". Standard price: 2,400 Gold; Now: 1,850 Gold.
8. Yoto Hime Epic Pose [Free Spirit]. Standard price: 500 Gold; Now: 400 Gold.
III. Discounts End
1. Fan Legendary Weapon Skin [Iron Feathers] has returned to its standard price of 1,500 Gold.
IV. Removed from Shop
As our crossover event with NieR comes to a close, all crossover-related products will no longer be sold starting on November 2, 2023 at 03:00 (UTC), including:
[Automata·2B], [Automata·9S], [Automata·A2], [Replicant·Kainé], [Replicant·Nier] and all related Packs, Outfits, Hairstyles, Weapon Skins, Accessories, Team Stats Screen cosmetics, etc.
At the same time, [Star - 2P], which could previously be acquired through Mythic Treasures, can no longer be acquired. Players that already own [Star - 2P] will not be affected.

[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]

I. Weapon-related Bugs
1. Fixed the issue where the Fan's skill [Fan's Curve] could trigger the Nunchucks' [Horizontal Block Backfire].

notes.title: NARAKA: BLADEPOINT Update - October 19th, 2023
notes.content:
[h1]Dear players,[/h1]
The servers of NARAKA: BLADEPOINT will be suspended for maintenance from October 18th, 2023 at 23:00 (UTC) to October 19th, 2023 at 03:00 (UTC). We suggest you log out in advance and enter the game again after the maintenance.

The details for this update are as follows:

[b][h2]Brand New Content[/h2][/b]
[b]I. New Congeneric Weapon: the Fan [/b]
[previewyoutube=wSB9KbPwPaE;full][/previewyoutube]
Sweep away all before you, leaving naught but destruction and a faint breeze!
In this new update, we'll be introducing the ancient Chinese weapon— the Fan. Try it out!

[b]II. Fairyland Penglai Updates[/b]
[u]1. Musical Performance[/u]
[list]
[*] Added 3 new playable instruments: Suona, Gong, and Woodblock.
[*] Added a music score recording and sharing feature: You can now record original music scores and share them. After receiving a QR code for a shared score, players can import and play it.
[/list]
[u]2. Sky-high Racing[/u]
New track, new mechanisms, new rewards, and challenges await! Create new legends of speed in Fairyland Penglai!

[u]3. Weather Changes[/u]
Added the aurora borealis to the sky. It will appear at night, following real-time.

[b]III. Limited-time Event: Strife of Sun and Moon[/b]
Event Time: From Oct 19, 2023 update to Nov 1, 2023 at 20:00 (UTC)

[u]Event Rules:[/u]
[olist]
[*] Each day, players may choose one of the two Cultivation Zones:
[list]
[*] Flicker of Yushan: If you gain Score from a Ranked match, you will get a 25% score bonus. If you lose Score from a Ranked match, your Score loss will be halved. And Eurekas will diminish by 1.
[*] If you get 0 Score, it doesn't consume Eurekas.
[*] Temple of Light and Shadow: XP and Hidden Treasure XP from Survival, Casual, or Showdown modes are increased by 150%. And Eurekas will diminish by 1.
[*] You can choose only one type each day, and once chosen, it cannot be changed.
[/list]
[*] You will receive 1 Eureka once you've made your choice.
[*] An additional Eureka is granted for each event quest you complete. There are 7 groups of quests and each group becomes available at different times. The next set of quests can be unlocked only after completing the previous ones.
[*] Eurekas gained are valid only on the day they’re earned. They do not carry over to subsequent days, so please use them before they expire! 
[*] Complete more quests to win more great rewards.
[/olist]

[b]IV. Limited-time Event: Twilight Trickery[/b]
Event Time: From Oct 29, 2023 at 20:00 to Nov 5, 2023 at 20:00 (UTC)

[u]Event Rules:[/u]
On the night the spooky spirits descend, those who trick get treats.
During the event, players visiting Fairyland Penglai can interact with the special Spooky NARAKA Ball to transform into it.

When transformed into a Spooky NARAKA Ball, colliding with other players gives both you and the collided player a chance to get Pumpkin Candy. Pumpkin Candy can be exchanged for exclusive event rewards.

[b]V. New Collection Set[/b]
Added 6 new sets to the collections in the player profile: [Dragon Will], [Journey of Blades·Exorcism], [Journey of Blades·Spirits], [Creatures Myth·Four Seasons], [Creatures Myth·Beast], and [NieR]. Collect the sets to earn Dynastic Treasure Choice Gift, Regular Treasure Choice Gift and more rewards.

[b]IV. Pioneer Season Pack[/b]
New Season Pack is now available. During the limited-time sale, there's a 63% discount.
After the limited-time sale ends, the offer returns to a 54% discount.

Event Time: From Oct 19, 2023 update to Jan 4, 2024 at 00:00 (UTC)

First Round of Limited-time Sale: From Oct 19, 2023 update to Oct 25, 2023 at 20:00 (UTC)

Purchase to get the following rewards:
[olist]
[*] Exclusive Epic Mark of Victory: Brave Battle
[*] Advanced Hidden Treasure Card: Use to unlock the Advanced Hidden Treasure of the current season. (Usable for Pioneer Season or any subsequent season.)
[*] Baize's Blessing: Use to unlock Baize's Blessing where you can claim rewards for 30 days.
[*] Gold*600
[*] Regular Treasure Choice Gift*10
[/olist]
Purchase to get the following privileges (privileges already unlocked cannot be reacquired).

Privilege Overview:
[list]
[*] Unlock Ranked Mode at Level 20.
[*] Unlock Public Chat at Level 5.
[*] Unlimited exchange of Hero Coins.
[*] Custom Rooms available.
[/list]
(If you're playing via our official website or EPIC, you can make purchases at the in-game Event Center. If you're playing via Steam, please head over to Steam to make your purchases.)

[b]VII. BATTLEPASS Updates[/b]
[previewyoutube=7j7rs_tAS3U;full][/previewyoutube]
[Pioneer] BATTLEPASS is now available, which includes a variety of valuable items and skins! Players can obtain more rewards by unlocking the Advanced Hidden Treasure! You can get a Treasure Scroll at the price of 1,200 Gold and a Glory Scroll at 2,840 Gold.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36350327/6ec52aeea06e5a5eb2d78a649e18cce766f777ce.png[/img]

[b]VIII. New Season: Pioneer[/b]
We have come to the end of Season 9: Mythic and would like to thank all of the players who participated in this season’s ranked matches. For a full recap of the season rewards and Score resets, please see our official announcement post. [url=https://www.narakathegame.com/news/update/20231017/33459_1115254.html]https://www.narakathegame.com/news/update/20231017/33459_1115254.html[/url]

[b][h2]Hero Adjustments[/h2][/b]
[b]I. Yoto Hime[/b]
1. Changed the Defense Focus during the startup frames of [Flying Edge: Callback] to a Blue Focus. Increased the Demonic Blade's hover time from 5 sec to 9 sec, and enhanced the horizontal strike's 2nd stage pull performance.
2. Adjusted initial Ultimate Talent [Demon Blade]
(1) Canceled the mechanism of "increasing Attack based on the number of nearby Remains". Yoto Hime's Ultimate Attack is now increased based on the number of living enemies within a 10m radius at each flash or strike. The corresponding relationship is as follows:  
[list]
[*] ≤1 Enemies = 0% Ultimate Attack Increase
[*] 2 Enemies = 20% Ultimate Attack Increase
[*] 3 Enemies = 40% Ultimate Attack Increase
[*] 4 Enemies = 50% Ultimate Attack Increase
[*] ≥5 Enemies = 55% Ultimate Attack Increase
[/list] 
(2) Increased Attack remains consistent throughout the Ultimate duration and lasts until the Ultimate ends.

[i]//Dev Note: The previous conditions for [Demon Blade] were a bit harsh in real combat as it was difficult to ensure the presence of Remains in every scenario. Therefore, we adjusted it to have a more common trigger condition. We also distributed the trigger chances to every flash or strike, providing more gameplay options during actual combat.[/i]

[b]II. Wuchen[/b]
[olist]
[*] Adjusted the calculation formula of reducing enemy weapon's durability for the [Spirit Blades] Skill during a Clash from a fixed value to 34% of the weapon's max durability, ensuring a consistent reduction across different weapon qualities.
[*] Optimized the experience of casting the [Spirit Blades: Autotrack] Skill in the air. The recovery frame stagger can now be interrupted in advance with a Dodge or plummet strike.
[*] Adjusted Ultimate [Tai Chi Teleport: Portal]:
[/olist]
[list]
[*] Increased the interaction radius of the Portal from 2m to 4m.
[*] Adjusted the way the Portal is cast in the air. Wuchen can now cast the Portal while airborne without waiting to land.
[/list]

[b][h2]Weapon Adjustments[/h2][/b]
[b]I. Staff[/b]
[list]
[*] Slightly reduced the stagger duration after a Charged Horizontal Strike hits.
[*] Increased the knockback distance of Charged Vertical Strikes.
[/list]
[b]II. Nunchucks[/b]
[list]
[*] Blue Focus Strikes can now restore Biding Fury on hit.
[*] Slightly increased the stagger duration when a Horizontal Strike or a Sprint Horizontal Strike hits.
[/list]
[b]III. Longsword[/b]
[list]
[*] Slightly increased the stagger duration when a Vertical Strike or a Sprint Vertical Strike hits.
[/list]

[b][h2]Souljade System Update[/h2][/b]
Added Consumable and Upgradable Souljades to the current Souljade System, expanding the possibilities in battles.

[b]I. Consumable Souljades:[/b]
These Souljades have a limited number of uses. Each Souljade's uses are consumed on hit. Once the Souljade runs out of uses, it will transform into the corresponding Rare Souljade.

Consumable Souljades have a default attribute of 6% Melee Damage Reduction.

[u]1. Some Souljades have changed into Consumable Souljades.[/u]
This kind of Souljade adds a new effect on top of the original strike and reduces the start-up frames. However, these Souljades have limited uses, which increases the intensity that Souljades bring to combat.
[list]
[*] Long-handle Weapon Souljade: [Dual Ring] Alters the third horizontal strike in the Spear's and the Staff's combos, temporarily silencing the enemy for a brief time.
[*] Dagger Souljade: [Abyssal Aura] Alters Daggers' charged vertical strikes, and restores 100% of damage dealt as Health or Armor.
[*] Longsword Souljade: [Blue Moon II] The 3rd horizontal strike in a combo unleashes sword energy, silencing the enemy for a brief time.
[*] Katana Souljade: [Stamina Strike II] The 3rd strike in a horizontal combo restores 100% of the damage dealt as Health or Armor.
[*] Dual Halberds Souljade: [Whirling Slash] Alters the 3rd vertical strike in the Dual Halberds combo, and restores 100% of damage dealt as Health or Armor.
[*] Dual Blades Souljade: [Splitter] Alters the 3rd horizontal strike in the Dual Blades combo, silencing the enemy for a brief time.
[*] Nunchucks Souljade: [Flying Kick] Alters the 3rd horizontal strike in the Nunchucks combo, silencing the enemy for a brief time.
[*] Other Souljades: [Starfall] When launching Grappling Hook again during a Grappling Strike, players will teleport to their target and deal a high-damage blow which leaves enemies [Vulnerable].
[/list]
[u]2. New Consumable Souljades:[/u]
[list]
[*] [Explosive Armor] Knock nearby enemies airborne with its shards when Armor is shattered.
[*] [Follow the Recall] Grants a piece of Rare Armor and a Rare Weapon upon Rebirth.
[/list]

[b]II. Upgradable Souljades: Unlock new effects by meeting certain conditions in battle.[/b]
Melee Weapon's Upgradable Souljades have an inherent attribute of Health +12%.
Ranged Weapon's Upgradable Souljades have the inherent attributes of Ranged Resist +10% and Head Defense +8%.

[u]1. Some Souljades have changed into Upgradable Souljades.[/u]
On top of inherent effects, completing certain quests will grant extra combat effect. By combining Souljades, the issue where the Souljade Bag was often short of storage has been alleviated.
[list]
[*] Nunchucks Souljade [Trigger & Lock Breaker]: Using Horizontal Block no longer consumes Biding Fury and triggers when hit by ranged attacks. After triggering the Horizontal Block of Nunchucks twice, gains new attributes: Alters the Horizontal Block Backfire.
[*] Spear Souljade [Erudition & Spear Storm]: Alters the Spear's charged vertical strikes. After hitting enemies 8 times with the Spear's charged vertical strikes, gains new attributes: Alters the 3rd vertical strike in the Spear combo.
[*] Greatsword Souljade [Warrior Pace & Infernal Slash]: Increases move speed while charging up a horizontal strike with Greatsword. After hitting enemies with the Greatsword's charged horizontal strikes 4 times, gains new attributes: Alters the Greatsword's 1st- and 2nd-stage charged horizontal strikes.
[*] Repeating Crossbow Souljade [Venom Tip & Barbed Bolts]: The Repeating Crossbow deals less damage but poisons enemies hit, dealing damage over time. After hitting enemies with the Repeating Crossbow 20 times, gains new attributes: Landing a shot on an enemy with the Repeating Crossbow leaves them unable to sprint for 1 sec.
[*] [Curative Bolts & Healing Bolts]: The Repeating Crossbow's shots restore 40% of the damage dealt as Health or Armor. After hitting enemies with the Repeating Crossbow 20 times, gains new attributes: Allows you to heal teammates by shooting them with the Repeating Crossbow.
[*] Bow Souljade [Fire Arrows & Target Lock]: Arrows fired in the Bow's 2nd charge state deal less damage but can ignite enemies, dealing damage over time. After hitting an enemy with the Bow 5 times, gains new attributes: Shooting enemies with the Bow leaves them unable to sprint or dodge for 3 sec. Attacks on the same enemy can only trigger this once per 15 sec.
[*] Cannon Souljade [Twinshot & Bounce Shell]: The Cannon deals less damage but fires 2 projectiles with each shot. After hitting enemies with the Cannon 8 times, gains new attributes: Cannon shots can bounce twice, and automatically explode with increased damage when near enemies.
[*] [Rupture Gale Orb & Burn]: Increases the explosion radius of the Cannon's shots. After hitting enemies with the Cannon 8 times, gains new attributes: Cannon shots burn enemies, dealing damage over time.
[*] Pistol Souljade [Quick Charge & Thundercall]: Reduces charged Pistol shots' damage, but allows you to load up to two shots at a time and the charging will be muted. After hitting enemies with the Pistol 20 times, gains new attributes: Charged Pistol shots fire with larger explosion range and higher damage.
[*] Musket Souljade [Slowshot & Sunwing Shot]: Increases the intervals between and the damage of the Musket's aimed shots. After hitting enemies with the Musket 5 times, gains new attributes: Musket shots' bullet velocity is greatly increased.
[*] [Soft Step & Gecko Foot]: Silences the sound of your footsteps. After traveling 500m, gains new attributes: Increased speed when running up walls and increased Scale Rush damage. After staying still for 5 sec while climbing, you will enter Stealth for 15 sec or until you move again.
[*] [Ripple Step & Phantom Step]: Dodging while sprinting briefly provides Stealth. After dealing 2,500 damage, gains new attributes: The 1st-stage Dodge briefly provides Stealth.
[*] [Assault·Smolder]: Burns enemies hit with melee weapon's Grappling Strikes, dealing damage over time. After hitting enemies 8 times with Grappling Strikes, gains new attributes: Increased Grappling Strike damage.
[*] [Switch·Dazzle]: Switching to a ranged weapon while carrying out a melee attack unleashes a special move (Morus' Blessing weapons excluded). After hitting enemies with Switch·Dazzle 3 times, gains new attributes: Switching between a ranged and a melee weapon increases Attack by 15% for 3 sec.
[*] [Soothing Boon]: There's a 25% chance that Weapon Repair Kits, Grappling Hooks, Healing Berries or Armor Powder won't deplete after use. After dealing 2,500 damage, gains new attributes: The chance that Weapon Repair Kits and Grappling Hooks won't deplete after use is increased to 40%.
[*] [Poison Splash] Players will release poisonous gas around them 0.5 sec after death. Enemies affected will take damage over time. After dealing 2,500 damage to enemies, gains new attributes: Enemies affected will take damage over time and their recovery effect is reduced.
[/list]
2. New Upgradable Souljades 
[Auspicious Jade]: Increase Dark Tide Coins obtained from quests. After completing 2 in-match quests, gains: An Epic or better Souljade.

[b]III. Souljade Adjustments[/b]
[u]1. The following Souljades will no longer be available:[/u]
[list]
[*] Spear Souljade: [Spear Storm]
[*] Greatsword Souljade: [Infernal Slash]
[*] Longsword Souljade: [Whirlwind]
[*] Repeating Crossbow Souljade: [Healing Bolts] and [Barbed Bolts]
[*] Bow Souljade: [Target Lock]
[*] Cannon Souljade: [Bounce Shell] and [Burn]
[*] Pistol Souljade: [Thundercall]
[*] Musket Souljade: [Sunwing Shot]
[*] Other Souljades: [Gecko Foot] and [Phantom Step]
[/list]
[u]2. Attribute Adjustments[/u]
Attribute stats of the Legendary Souljades are reduced to the same level as the Epic Souljades.
[list]
[*] Health +18% is reduced to +12%.
[*] Attack +6% is reduced to +4%.
[*] Melee Resist +9% is reduced to +6%
[*] Ranged Resist +15% is reduced to +10%.
[*] Head Defense +12% is reduced to +8%.
[/list]
[u]3. Previous Souljade Adjustments[/u]
[list]
[*] [Stamina Strike] Only retains its original Vertical Strike combo and effects. Unlimited usage.
[*] [Blue Moon] Only retains its original Vertical Strike combo and effects. Unlimited usage.
[*] The second-stage strike of Dagger's Skill [Dreadful Wail] can be countered.
[/list]

[b][h2]Out-game Adjustments[/h2][/b]
[b]I. Fairyland Penglai Optimizations[/b]
[list]
[*] Upon logging into the game or returning from a match, your character will not enter Fairyland Penglai by default. Instead, you can get there by tapping the shortcut button or the Fairyland Penglai button on the homepage. Once inside, you can switch freely between Fairyland Penglai and the homepage.
[*] Improved interface performance when entering Fairyland Penglai.
[*] Merged all sample songs from the Musical Performance into the Music Score section.
[/list]
[b]II. Hero Badge[/b]
[list]
[*] Added Topaz, a new grade in the [Admirable Collection].
[*] Added name displays in the Hero Badge assembly list in the profile interface.
[/list]

[b][h2]Showdown Adjustments[/h2][/b]
[b]I. Enigma Domain Adjustments[/b]
In Solo Enigma Domain, the Boss' location will not be locked in advance when the progress reaches 75%. (Trios remain unchanged.)

[b]II. Combat Adjustments[/b]
Improved the sound effects of the special effect during Fiery Monster uses its Meteor Rain move.

[b][h2]Store Updates[/h2][/b]
[b]I. New Discounts[/b]
[olist]
[*] Newly added Takeda Nobutada Legendary Outfit [Autumn Hunt]. Standard price: 1,800 Gold; Now: 1,500 Gold.
[*] Newly added Fan Legendary Skin [Iron Feathers]. Standard price: 1,500 Gold; Now: 1,250 Gold.
[*] Viper Ning Legendary Outfit [Automata·2B]. Standard price: 1,800 Gold; Now: 1,500 Gold.
[*] Wuchen Legendary Outfit [Automata·9S]. Standard price: 1,800 Gold; Now: 1,500 Gold.
[*] Justina Gu Legendary Outfit [Automata·A2]. Standard price: 1,800 Gold; Now: 1,500 Gold.
[*] Tessa Legendary Outfit [Replicant·Kainé]. Standard price: 1,800 Gold; Now: 1,500 Gold.
[/olist]
[b]II. Discounts End[/b]
[olist]
[*] Legendary Pose [Championship] for Female Characters has returned to its standard price of 800 Gold.
[*] Legendary Pose [Victory] for Male Characters has returned to its standard price of 800 Gold.
[*] Ziping Yin Legendary Pose [Creatures Myth·Spring Vibe] has returned to its standard price of 900 Gold.
[*] Ziping Yin Legendary Outfit [Creatures Myth·Deity of Spring] has returned to its standard price of 1,800 Gold.
[*] Ziping Yin Legendary Accessory [Creatures Myth·Springtime Saplings] has returned to its standard price of 2,000 Gold. Equipping it changes the appearance of the skill 'Nature's Touch'.
[*] Ziping Yin Legendary Hairstyle [Creatures Myth·Spring Sunlight] has returned to its standard price of 800 Gold.
[*] Pose [Pop Dance·Left] has returned to its standard price of 1,200 Gold.
[*] Pose [Pop Dance·Right] has returned to its standard price of 1,200 Gold.
[/olist]
[b]III. Featured Cosmetics Returns in Limited Time[/b]
[olist]
[*] Valda Cui Legendary Hairstyle [Great Oceans] with a standard price of 1,200 Gold.
[*] Viper Ning Legendary Hairstyle [Misty] with a standard price of 1,200 Gold.
[*] Wuchen Legendary Hairstyle [Nine Ridges] with a standard price of 1,200 Gold.
[*] Kurumi Legendary Hairstyle [Moonlight Aroma] with a standard price of 1,200 Gold.
[*] Takeda Nobutada Legendary Hairstyle [Yama Style] with a standard price of 1,200 Gold. 
[*] Matari Legendary Hairstyle [Dawn Hawk] with a standard price of 1,200 Gold. 
[/olist]
[b]III. Featured Cosmetics Returns in Limited Time[/b]
[olist]
[*] Valda Cui Legendary Hairstyle [Great Oceans] with a standard price of 1,200 Gold.
[*] Viper Ning Legendary Hairstyle [Misty] with a standard price of 1,200 Gold.
[*] Wuchen Legendary Hairstyle [Nine Ridges] with a standard price of 1,200 Gold.
[*] Kurumi Legendary Hairstyle [Moonlight Aroma] with a standard price of 1,200 Gold.
[*] Takeda Nobutada Legendary Hairstyle [Yama Style] with a standard price of 1,200 Gold.
[*] Matari Legendary Hairstyle [Dawn Hawk] with a standard price of 1,200 Gold.
[/olist]

[b][h2]Client Optimization[/h2][/b]
[b]D3D12 Beta Version is Open[/b]
[u]1. HDR Function[/u]
HDR is a technology that improves the brightness and contrast of an image. It improves detail levels in dark places, making them seem darker, and provides a greater variety of colors, improving the visibility of the gaming screen.

[i]* Turning on HDR requires a monitor that supports HDR. To turn on HDR, open Windows System Settings - Screen - Use HDR. Some monitors also need to additionally turn on the HDR.[/i]

[u]2. Intel XeSS[/u]
Intel Xe Super Sampling (XeSS) technology is a new image amplification technology based on AI deep learning which supports high performance and high fidelity visuals. It uses deep learning to synthesize images that are very close to the quality of native high-resolution rendering, which can dramatically improve game performance and ensure excellent image quality.

[u]3. DLSS 3[/u]
DLSS is a revolutionary breakthrough in AI-powered graphics that multiplies performance. DLSS 3 is powered by the new fourth-generation Tensor Core and optical flow accelerators on GeForce RTX 40-series Gpus, which can use AI to generate more frames and improve image quality.

[u]4. At present, D3D12 is still in testing[/u]
Its functions and performance are still under continuous optimization:
[list]
[*] (1) At present, only some graphics cards can open the D3D12 test version.
[*] (2) Opening D3D12 may cause game instability or reduce its frame rate. We look forward to your feedback, questions and suggestions, and we will continue to improve and optimize based on this information.
[/list]

[b][h2]Bug Fixes[/h2][/b]
[b]Battle-related Bug[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed the issue where skills that can be used under attack failed when the Hero was attacked too frequently.
[*] Fixed the issue where enemies are not damaged when grabbed by Tianhai's double hands.
[/list]

[h1]Dear players,[/h1]
The servers of NARAKA: BLADEPOINT will be suspended for maintenance from Sep 26th, 2023 23:00 (UTC) to Sep 27th, 2023 03:00 (UTC). We suggest you log out in advance and enter the game again after the maintenance.

The details for this update are as follows:

[b][h2]Brand New Content[/h2][/b]
[b]Limited-time Event: Mythic Scrolls[/b]
The scroll paintings stand majestic, each depicting a scene of natural beauty.

[u]Event Time:[/u] From Sep 27, 2023 Update to Oct 18, 2023 at 20:00 (UTC)

[u]Event Rules:[/u]
There are 8 Scrolls which will open as time progresses. Once open, players can complete the Scroll Quests to get Lunar Essence and other rewards. During the event, all quests are permanently valid and will not reset.

[b][h2]Hero Adjustments[/h2][/b]
[b]I. Zai[/b]
Adjustments made to the Ultimate [Chain Scythe: Suppress] with the move [Chain Link: Suppress] are as follows:
[olist]
[*] Optimized enemy reactions when hit by the move.
[*] Slightly reduced the interval between strikes.
[*] Reduced the stagger time after the last strike hits.
[/olist]
[b][h2]Weapon Adjustments[/h2][/b]
[b]I. Spear/Staff[/b]
New Mechanism: Congeneric Skill of Spear and Staff is now available.

[b]II. Staff[/b]
Reduced damage multiplier of Staff's Counterstrike Combo from 3.22 * 2 to 1.30 + 5.14.
(Showdown mode excluded)

[b][h2]Combat Adjustments[/h2][/b]
Moderately reduced the Disengage points granted by hits from Grappling Hook and Scale Rush.
In-game Adjustments

[b][h2]Feature Optimizations[/h2][/b]
[b]I. Adjusted the interaction priority of mechanisms and interactive objects to avoid conflicts with dropped items.[/b]

[b]II. Capture the Spirit Well[/b]
Added a mini-map warning before the Flag respawns in Capture the Flag Challenge, and the Flag will respawn in random locations.

[b][h2]Out-game Adjustments[/h2][/b]
[b]Ref Spectate Optimizations[/b]
Expanded the original options in Settings - Game - Ref Spectate - See-through of Free Roam to include Free Roam/Camera Follow See-through.

[b]II. Custom Match Adjustments[/b]
The Omni's Nightmare mode will be temporarily removed from the Custom Room.

[b]III. Fairyland Penglai Optimizations[/b]
Added a quick interaction feature to view target player info with one tap.

[b]IV. The Hero Returns Event is Now Permanent[/b]
[list]
[*] If a player has been offline for over 14 days, The Hero Returns event will be initiated upon login.
[*] Obtain Rebirth Seals by being online for a certain duration or completing given event quests, which can be exchanged for various rare Collections.
[*] During the event, players can view changes made to each Hero during their absence in the Hero interface to have a quicker grasp of the adjustments.
[/list]
[b]V. Free Training Adjustments[/b]
[list]
[*] The style of the Free Training menu has been changed.
[*] Ally Bots are now listed as an independent option.
[/list]
[b]VI. Rotating Mode[/b]
Rotating mode is available again! The modes ready to be rotated are Shadow Surge (Morus Isle) and Capture the Spirit Well.

[b]VII. Hero Stats[/b]
Added Quick Match Stats to Hero Stats

[b]VIII. Star-Collections[/b]
Tessa exclusive Star-Collection [Star - Nine Tailed Destiny] will be available for trade from Oct 1st, 2023 at 02:00 (UTC). Players can then trade this outfit in Steam Market.

[b]IX. Daily Quests[/b]
The following Daily Quests can currently be completed in the Showdown mode:
[list]
[*]Travel 500m using the Grappling Hook.
[*] Hit 8 enemies with the Grappling Hook.
[*] Travel 2,000m.
[*] Deal 2,000 damage with melee weapons.
[*] Deal 1,000 damage with ranged weapons.
[/list]
Daily Quests will automatically refresh after the update.

[b]X. Deluxe Edition and Ultimate Edition have been removed[/b]
From October 1, 2023, the Deluxe and Ultimate editions will be removed from in-game store. Rewards that come with the Deluxe and Ultimate editions (such as Spear Legendary Skin [White Viper], Legendary Accessory [Aroma] and the Matari's Extreme Outfit [Flawless Elegance) will also be temporarily unavailable.

We will strive to bring more season packs in the future which will not only upgrade the game edition but also grant players with more Gold, Treasure, exclusive outfits and items as rewards. Thank you for your understanding and support as always.

[b]Showdown Adjustments[/b]
[u]Combat Adjustments[/u]
Reduced the Attack of bosses in Solo Showdown stages.

[b]II. Out-game Adjustments[/b]
Modified the recommended Sense level and gameplay description for Enigma Domain. Players who meet the recommended level are encouraged to try Enigma Domain more often, without clearing all waves as a requirement.

[b][h2]Store Updates[/h2][/b]
[b]I. New Packs[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36350327/ccd8b517d708849193a340b25852043715568125.png[/img]
Newly added Ziping Yin exclusive Pack [Deity of Spring], including Legendary Outfit [Creatures Myth·Deity of Spring], Legendary Accessory [Creatures Myth·Springtime Saplings] and Legendary Hairstyle [Creatures Myth·Spring Sunlight]. Standard price: 4,600 Gold; Now: 3,000 Gold.

[b]II. New Discounts[/b]
[olist]
[*] Newly added Legendary Gesture [Championship] for all Female Characters. Standard price: 800 Gold; Now: 450 Gold.
[*] Newly added Legendary Gesture [Victory] for all Male Characters. Standard price: 800 Gold; Now: 450 Gold.
[*] Newly added Ziping Yin Legendary Pose [Creatures Myth·Spring Vibe]. Standard price: 900 Gold; Now: 750 Gold.
[*] Newly added Ziping Yin Legendary Outfit [Creatures Myth·Deity of Spring]. Standard price: 1,800 Gold; Now: 1,500 Gold.
[*] Newly added Ziping Yin Legendary Accessory [Creatures Myth·Springtime Saplings], unlocking which can get a new appearance of the skill 'Nature's Touch'. Standard price: 2,000 Gold; Now: 1,600 Gold.
[*] Newly added Ziping Yin Legendary Hairstyle [Creatures Myth·Spring Sunlight]. Standard price: 800 Gold; Now: 600 Gold.
[/olist]
[b]III. Featured Items return for limited-time[/b]
[olist]
[*] Kurumi Legendary Outfit [Summer Party·School Maillot] Standard price: 1,500 Gold.
[*] Tarka Ji Legendary Outfit [Summer Party·Twilight Sunshine]. Standard price: 1,500 Gold.
[*] Staff Legendary Skin [Staff of Precepts]. Standard price: 1,500 Gold.
[*] Greatsword Legendary Skin [Monarch's Roar]. Standard price: 1,500 Gold.
[*] Yueshan Legendary Base [Flag Platform]. Standard price: 1,200 Gold.
[*] Yueshan Legendary Background [Expedition]. Standard price: 600 Gold.
[*] Legendary Bubble [Whatever] for all characters. Standard price: 600 Gold.
[*] Tarka Ji Legendary Bubble [Tarka Ji·Burning Rage]. Standard price: 600 Gold.
[*] Grappling Hook Legendary Skin [Glacial Chain]. Standard price: 1,200 Gold.
[/olist]
[b]IV. Discounts End[/b]
[olist]
[*] Zai Legendary Outfit [Laudation·Chain Break] has returned to its standard price of 1,800 Gold.
[*] Zai Legendary Accessory [Laudation·Antenna] has returned to its standard price of 1,200 Gold.
[*] Zai Legendary Hairstyle [Laudation·Blade of Darkness] has returned to its standard price of 800 Gold.
[*] Polesword Legendary Skin [Automata·Type-3 Lance] has returned to its standard price of 1,800 Gold.
[*] Viper Ning Legendary Pose [Sword at the Ready] has returned to its standard price of 900 Gold.
[*] Tessa Legendary Pose [Swordplay] has returned to its standard price of 900 Gold.
[/olist]
[b][h2]Client Optimization[/h2][/b]
[b]I. Graphic Enhancement[/b]
[u]Added FSR2 Graphic Enhancement Options[/u]
AMD FidelityFX Super Resolution 2 is a cutting-edge temporal upscaling algorithm that produces high resolution frames from lower resolution inputs.

[u]Settings Integration[/u]
DLSS, NIS and FSR2 are integrated under the Graphic Enhancement options. Players can select the best option to improve their frame rate and visual effect.

[b]II. Optimization of Resource Structure[/b]
[olist]
[*] Optimized the structure of all weapons, mechanisms and other resources to improve resource loading and running efficiency.
[*] Optimized the resource structure of all fashions and accessories to improve the performance when running.
[*] Optimized the static resource structure of all scenarios to improve resource loading running efficiency.
[/olist]
[b][h2]Bug Fixes[/h2][/b]
[b]I. Hero-related Bugs[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue in [Showdown] where Yueshan displayed Focus errors after activating the Ultimate.
[*] Fixed an issue where Viper Ning's ultimate was interrupted by certain movements.
[/list]
[b]II. Weapon-related Bugs[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where stagger sometimes fails during the [Earthshaker] Souljade attack.
[*] Fixed an issue where the Longsword's energy sometimes couldn't properly knock enemies airborne.
[/list]
[b]III. Showdown Bugs[/b]
Fixed an issue in Solo Showdown mode where the Witch Ghosts couldn't summon Miasma Ghosts.

[b]IV. Other Bugs[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where all friend info occasionally disappears from the friends list.
[*] Fixed the incorrect Collection Points of Zai's [Soul Carving], which should be 15.
[/list]

notes.title: NARAKA: BLADEPOINT Update – September 7th, 2023
notes.content:
[h1]Dear players,[/h1]
The servers of NARAKA: BLADEPOINT will be suspended for maintenance from Sep 6th, 2023 23:00 (UTC) to Sep 7th, 2023 03:00 (UTC). We suggest you log out in advance and enter the game again after the maintenance.

The details for this update are as follows:

[b][h2]Brand New Content[/h2][/b]
[previewyoutube=n73CuRJYE3I;full][/previewyoutube]
[b]I. Capture the Spirit Well[/b]
[olist]
[*] Introducing a brand-new map area for Capture the Spirit Well: Celestra.
[*] The map rotation between the new area, Celestra, and the existing area, Plumed Castle, will occur every hour.
[*] New combat items have been added for Capture the Spirit Well: use Charms to cast ploys and to secure victory.
[list]
[*] Ploy Charm·Ballista: Summons a Ballista at the current location. (Only accessible for allies. Projectiles will be cleared out once used.)
[*] Ploy Charm·Forbidden Seal: Summons a Forbidden Seal at the current location. (Only affects your enemies.)
[*] Ploy Charm·Rift: Summons an Enigmatic Rift that connects a location in a valid area and the current location. (Only accessible for your allies.)
[*] Ploy Charm·Banish: After a warning, teleports enemies in the selected area to their Spawn Point.
[*] Ploy Charm·Reclaim: Changes the status of a selected Spirit Well to be uncaptured.
[*] Ploy Charm·Detect: Detects enemies in the selected area.
[/list]
[/olist]
[b]II. Tessa's new Skill [Tail Strike: Repel] and Ultimate [Enchant: Group Prey] are now available[/b]
Skill [Tail Strike: Repel]: Tessa unleashes her fox tail and summons a Tailglow Zone in the aimed direction that lasts 6 sec.
[list]
[*] Summons a fox tail upon an ally entering the zone, knocking nearby enemies in the air while gaining [Foxfire] for 5 sec.
[/list]
Ultimate [Enchant: Group Prey]: Tessa summons the fox spirit that unleashes a shockwave and snatches all enemies' souls within 10m, storing them in a Soul Vessel.
[list]
[*] Enemies who fail to retrieve their soul by interacting with the Soul Vessel within 6 sec will be [Enchanted] for 3 sec.
[*] It costs only 50% of the Rage if no souls are snatched.
[*] If the shockwave hits an enemy, Tessa will gradually restore Health in 6 sec (exceeded amount will turn into Armor). Each enemy hit by the shockwave increases the Health recovery by 100% (up to 300%).
[/list]
[b]III. Solo mode is now available in Showdown[/b]
[list]
[*] Now you can select [Solo] in the stage selection page of Showdown mode to challenge Showdown alone. Monsters will be weakened for solo gameplay, and all rewards remain the same.
[*] You can play solo mode in all levels, including Emerald and Topaz Enigma Domain. But it's temporarily unavailable in Doom levels and Enigma Peak.
[/list]
[b]IV. Clash League[/b]
[u]Info[/u]
Available Time: From Sep 6, 2023, 20:00 to Sep 26, 2023, 04:00 (UTC).

Server Times:
[list]
[*] NA Server: 00:00 - 04:00 (UTC) every day
[*] EU Server: 18:00 - 22:00 (UTC) every day
[*] AS Server: 11:00 - 15:00 (UTC) every day
[*] SEA Server: 12:00 - 16:00 (UTC) every day
[/list]
Rules: Same as Capture the Spirit Well. For details, please check the rules of Capture the Spirit Well mode.
Check the June 29th patch notes [url=https://www.narakathegame.com/news/update/20230619/33459_1094079.html]here[/url].

Requirement: Join a Justice Chamber and form a party of 3/6/9/12 with Justice Chamber members in the Justice Rally Room.

Stages: There are three stages: preliminary, semifinal, and final. Each round of competition starts from the preliminary stage and ends when you fail to advance or win the final stage. Winning a single match will advance you to the next stage. You can play unlimited rounds of competition while it is available. The preliminary and semifinal stages are played on the Plumed Castle map, and the final stage is set on the Celestra map.

Rewards:
[list]
[*] Advancing to the final stage: Hero Badges.
[*] Winning in the final stage: Hero Badges, preparation-stage special effects and titles.
[/list]
[u]Scoring[/u]
[list]
[*] You get different points for victory/draw/defeat in each stage: 20/15/10 points respectively in the preliminary stage 30/20/15 points respectively in the semifinal stage, and 40/30/20 points respectively in the final stage.
[*] A Justice Chamber's total score is the sum of all players' single-match scores in that Justice Chamber.
[/list]
[u]Clash League Leaderboard[/u]
Clash League Leaderboard is ranked based on Justice Chamber Total Score
(Clash League is not yet available for Xbox One players due to the console features.) 

[b]V. Limited-time Event: Refreshing Equinox[/b]
Autumnal winds arrive to whisk away clouds, as crisp leaves fall in unison.

[u]Event Rules:[/u]
[list]
[*] Players can obtain Equinox Coins by completing daily and event quests. Equinox Coins can be exchanged for rare rewards.
[*] Challenge Quests include Event-Only Quests (completed in Clash League matches) and Showdown Exclusive Quests (completed in Showdown mode). Clash League quests are unavailable for Xbox players. Xbox players can complete the corresponding event-only quests through Ranked Mode, Quick Match, Bot Mode and Casual Mode with the same amount of Equinox Coins as rewards.
[/list]
[b][h2]Hero Adjustments[/h2][/b]
[b]I. Justina Gu[/b]
[list]
[*] Adjusted Justina Gu's Freeze threshold for transformed enemies with all her Ultimate Talents. The threshold is changed from (1.5x Attack + 90) to (5x Attack + 10).
[*] Modified the freezing conditions of [Shadowswipe] against transformed enemies in [Arctic Wraith]. Now, [Shadowswipe] can freeze all transformed enemies who are not currently using skills.
[*] Increased the attack Focus level of Shadowswipe against transformed enemies in [Arctic Wraith] and [Arctic Wraith: Blizzard], allowing it to stagger transformed enemies who are not using skills.
[*] During the recovery frames of [Arctic Wraith] and [Arctic Wraith: Blizzard], an additional 0.3 sec of Ultimate Focus and 70% Damage Reduction have been added.
[*] Increased the duration of freezing effects against transformed enemies in [Arctic Wraith: Blizzard] and [Arctic Wraith: Frostwind]. The duration is now 3 sec, up from 1.6 sec.
[*] Reduced the startup frames of [Arctic Wraith: Frostwind] to a unified 1.5 sec.
[/list]
[i]//Dev Notes: Due to changes in the game environment, Justina Gu's Ultimate had poor performance when facing transformed enemies, making her susceptible to counterplay. Therefore, we've adjusted her gameplay interaction with transformed enemies.[/i]

[b]II. Other Changes[/b]
The skills consuming Rage, such as Flame Force, Shadowswipe, and Demonic Strike, will now display the remaining usable times based on your remaining Rage.

[b][h2]Weapon Adjustments[/h2][/b]
[b]I. Staff[/b]
[list]
[*] Slightly reduced the stagger time caused by vertical and sprint vertical strikes.
[*] Optimized the mismatch between the hit range and the visual effects of charged vertical strikes.
[/list]
[b]II. Greatsword and Polesword[/b]
[list]
[*] Reduced damage multiplier for Scale Rushes while hanging on an eave from 4.32 to 3.24.
[*] Reduced damage multiplier for charged Scale Rush from 5.64 to 4.51.
[/list]
[b][h2]Souljade Adjustments[/h2][/b]
[b]I. Dagger Souljade[/b]
Slightly adjusted the effect of [Dreadful Wail] of adhering to targets upon attacking.

[b][h2]In-game Adjustments[/h2][/b]
[b]I. Feature Optimizations[/b]
[list]
[*] Mini-Map Feature Optimizations
When entering multi-layer cave areas such as Shadowjade Mine in The Morus Isle or Camel's Hump in Holoroth, the mini-map will automatically zoom in for better navigation.
[*] If multiple targets are in the area you’re targeting, your crosshair will target whichever is closest to it.
[/list]
[b]II. Adjustments for Capture the Spirit Well[/b]
[list]
[*] Rift Dealer Adjustments
The weapon rarity of Morus' Blessing sold by Rift Dealer in the Spirit Well has been upgraded from Rare to Epic; meanwhile, the price has been increased to 15,000 Dark Tide Coins.
[*] Removed Draco Storm, Mystic Might and Moonbane Charm in the Morus' Blessing.
[*]  Added a warning of the next new Flag's location in the Capture the Flag challenge.
[/list]
[b][h2]Out-game Adjustments[/h2][/b]
[b]I. Improvements on Fairyland Penglai:[/b]
Optimized HUD display in Fairyland Penglai.

[b]II. New Feature: Friend Groups[/b]
[list]
[*] Customizable friend groups can now be created by tapping a friend's avatar in the friend list.
[*] Created groups will appear in the friend list with custom names; up to 10 groups can be created, and each player can only be in one group.
[/list]
[b]III. Social Label[/b]
The maximum number of equipped "Style" labels has been increased to 2.

[b]IV. Hero Badge[/b]
The Citrine stage has been added to the "Muscle Memory" Hero Badge.

[b]V. Level Cap Extension[/b]
[list]
[*] The account level cap has been extended from 500 to 1000 through this update.
[*] Players with XP overflow from previous versions will attain the correct level after the update.
[*] Players above Lv.500 will receive the new "Sunwing" profile frame.
[/list]
[b]VI. Baize's Blessing[/b]
[list]
[*] Baize's Blessing extra rewards now have a total of 6 tiers. During the Blessing's duration, you can claim rewards by signing in for 4, 8, 12, 16, 20, and 24 days.
[*] After claiming all sign-in rewards, you can skip waiting time and start the next Blessing.
[*] You can jump to preview the rewards of Baize's Shop.
[/list]
[b]VII. Inventory Item Preview Optimization[/b]
You can now jump to preview collections contained in items like Trial Cards and Choice Gifts within the Inventory.

[b]VIII. Mail System Optimization[/b]
[list]
[*] Added mail categorization. Mails will be categorized into Notifications, Surveys, Promotions, and Events. You can now sort emails by category.
[*] Time Display Optimization. In the mail list, the area where the receive time was shown now shows the countdown to expiration; and at the right side of the title, the area where the expiration time was shown now shows the receive time.
[/list]
[b]IX. Collection Sets Expansion[/b]
The maximum number of Collection Sets per hero has been increased from 6 to 10. Unlocking 6 Sets will allow further unlocking of Sets 7 to 10.

[b]X. Star-Collection Interface Adjustments[/b]
Optimized layout and design of the Restyle and the switch buttons in the Star-Collection interface.

[b]XI. Bonus Cards[/b]
Players currently participating in the Showdown mode can also enjoy the effects of the XP Bonus Card and the Treasure Bonus Card.

[b]XII. Temporarily disabled the [Photo Customization][/b]
The [Photo Customization] is temporarily unavailable after the update, the already generated face data will not be affected.

[b]XIII. [Reset] feature for Hair Color[/b]
Newly added [Reset] button on the Hairstyle page. Tap the button to reset the hair color. It is not available for Hairstyles that cannot be adjusted.

[b]XIV. Custom Room[/b]
Newly added the Disengagement Multiplier settings in the Custom Room, players can adjust the Disengagement Multiplier after enabling the Disengagement.

[b]XV. Lobby Music[/b]
Removed "The Flame of Fate" from the Lobby music.

[b]XVI. Purchase Limit Adjustments[/b]
[list]
[*] The purchase limit of Treasures in a single transaction at the Treasure Pavilion has been adjusted to 200.
[*] The purchase limit of Restyle Orb for the Star - Collections has been adjusted to 500.
[/list]
[b]XVII. Outfit Transparency Feature[/b]
[list]
[*] You can enable/disable the Transparency in the corresponding outfit interface. You can view the effects when turning this feature on.
[*] Transparency applies only during matches (but not in Fairyland Penglai, or during match preparation).
[*] Outfits that support the Transparency feature: [Onmyoji Arena·Ecliptic Meander], [Golden Damselfly], [Giant Whale], [Nine Tailed Destiny] and [Star - Nine Tailed Destiny].
[/list]
[b][h2]Showdown Adjustments[/h2][/b]
[b]I. Combat Adjustments[/b]
Fiery Monster
[list]
[*] Adjusted its combo sequence of melee moves;
[*] Removed the hovering disc move;
[*] The tracking projectile move is now in a Blue Focus state. Make a counter to deflect the projectile;
[*] Reduced the range of Binding Circle and increased the time needed to break free from its effects. Now, when using the Binding Circle move, this monster can cast up to five circles in succession;
[*] The Meteor Rain move no longer follows the player's movement;
[*] Adjusted AI behavior probabilities in different Difficulties.
[/list]
[b]II. Showdown Scroll[/b]
[list]
[*] 1. Showdown Scroll is available to enter the Solo mode and Enigma Domain levels.
[*] 2. Removed the value bonus.
[/list]
[b][h2]Store Updates[/h2][/b]
[b]I. New Packs[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36350327/a94c7ab7f5e785fae61585bd1a8bd0a2a7cef93f.png[/img]
Newly added Zai exclusive Pack [Chain Break], including Legendary Outfit [Laudation·Chain Break], Legendary Accessory [Laudation·Antenna] and Legendary Hairstyle [Laudation·Blade of Darkness]. Standard price: 3,800 Gold; Now: 2,600 Gold.

[b]II. New Discounts[/b]
[olist]
[*] Newly added Legendary Gesture [Pop Dance·Left] for all heroes. Standard price: 1,200 Gold; Now: 900 Gold.
[*] Newly added Legendary Gesture [Pop Dance·Right] for all heroes. Standard price: 1,200 Gold; Now: 900 Gold.
[*] Newly added Zai Legendary Outfit [Laudation·Chain Break]. Standard price: 1,800 Gold; Now: 1,500 Gold.
[*] Newly added Zai Legendary Accessory [Laudation·Antenna]. Standard price: 1,200 Gold; Now: 1,000 Gold.
[*] Newly added Zai Legendary Hairstyle [Laudation·Blade of Darkness]. Standard price: 800 Gold; Now: 600 Gold.
[/olist]
[b]III. Featured Items return for limited-time[/b]
[olist]
[*] Valda Cui Legendary Outfit [Pearled Maiden]. Standard price: 1,800 Gold.
[*] Temulch Legendary Outfit [Skywolf]. Standard price: 1,800 Gold.
[*] Longsword Legendary Skin [Amicus Brand]. Standard price: 1,500 Gold.
[*] Nunchucks Legendary Skin [Devil's Hand]. Standard price: 1,500 Gold.
[*] Temulch Legendary Accessory [Sirius Helmet]. Standard price: 1,200 Gold.
[*] Valda Cui Legendary Hairstyle [Torrent]. Standard price: 1,200 Gold.
[*] Viper Ning Legendary Group Pose [Sword at the Ready]. Standard price: 900 Gold.
[*] Viper Ning Legendary Group Background [Violet Rattan]. Standard price: 600 Gold.
[/olist]
[b]IV. New Items in Item Store[/b]
In "Item" store, [Surmount Card·Mythic] is now available. Use to upgrade Hidden Treasure of Mythic Season by 30 levels. The price of [Surmount Card·Reckoning] is 1800 Gold, purchase limit is 1.

[b]V. Discounts End[/b]
[olist]
[*] Justina Gu Legendary Outfit [Automata·A2] has returned to its standard price of 1,800 Gold. 
[*] Justina Gu Epic Hairstyle [Automata·A2 Hairstyle] has returned to its standard price of 500 Gold. 
[*] Spear Legendary Skin [Automata·Type-4O Spear] has returned to its standard price of 1,800 Gold. 
[*] Tessa Legendary Outfit [Replicant·Kainé] has returned to its standard price of 1,800 Gold.
[*] Tessa Epic Hairstyle [Replicant·Kainé Hairstyle] has returned to its standard price of 500 Gold. 
[*] Dual Blades Legendary Skin [Replicant·Kainé's Blades] has returned to its standard price of 1,800 Gold.
[/olist]
[b][h2]Client Optimization[/h2][/b]
Optimized the loading efficiency of dropped items, weapons, and other resources during battles.

[b][h2]Bug Fixes[/h2][/b]
[b]I. Hero-related Bug[/b]
Fixed an issue where using the crouch action after activating Zai's Ultimate would cause abnormalities.

[b]II. Battle-related Bugs[/b]
Fixed an issue where grappling after the aerial counter would play the ground grappling animation.

[b]III. Other Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where a teammate's voice status wasn't displayed while in spectator mode.
[*] Addressed the inability to clear friend notes.
[*] Fixed the issue where continuously holding down the speech shortcut key upon entering a match caused abnormal shortcut functionality.
[/list]

notes.title: NARAKA: BLADEPOINT Banned Players List 09-5
notes.content:
Dear players,

NARAKA: BLADEPOINT is committed to creating a fair and healthy competitive environment. We have not only used new anti-cheat technologies, but also established special cheat-reporting reward activities to encourage those players who defend the fairness with us. From now on, players who make outstanding contributions to reporting cheats will get the Legendary spear skin 'Righteous Polearm' .

More details:
1. Players who successfully reported 1 time will get [Immortal Treasure] X1;

2. Players who successfully report 10 times with low misreport rate will get [Immortal Treasure] X10 (In order to ensure the efficiency of detecting, please report reasonably);

3. Players who have successfully reported for many times or made great contributions to anti-cheat will get the Legendary spear skin [Righteous Polearm] X1.

We strongly recommend that players report via in-game report system, so that we can confirm the cheat as soon as possible and record successful report times for you!

From 08.28 to 09.03, there are 8 players who have successfully reported the cheating or hacking in total and get the reward [Righteous Polearm]! We hope that more players can become the Justice Supporter on the Morus Isle in the future.

notes.title: NARAKA: BLADEPOINT Update – August 24th, 2023
notes.content:
[h1]Dear players,[/h1]

The servers of NARAKA: BLADEPOINT will be suspended for maintenance from August 23th, 2023 at 23:00 (UTC) to August 24th, 2023 at 03:00 (UTC). We suggest you log out in advance and enter the game again after the maintenance.

The details for this update are as follows:

[b][h2]Hero Adjustments[/h2][/b]
[b]I. Tianhai[/b]
Adjusted Tianhai's jump-and-smash response when activating [Titan's Call] and all its talents. The trigger is changed from "button press" to "button release," allowing Tianhai to deactivate the Ultimate without using the jump-and-smash.

[b]II. Other Optimizations and Adjustments[/b]
[list]
[*] Optimized the display of skill icons such as [Flash: Repeat], [Demonic Strike], and others when they have no uses remaining.
[*] Optimized the collision for skills such as [Healing Ray], [Tai Chi Teleport], [Demonic Aid: Teleport], and more.
[*] Reworked collision logic for teleport skills such as [Flash], [Flying Edge], and more, reducing issues of being unable to teleport to the intended location due to special circumstances and complex scenes.
[*] Slightly expanded the interactive range of the Soul Vessel generated by Tessa's Ultimate.
[/list]

[b][h2]Weapon Adjustments[/h2][/b]
[b]I. Greatsword and Polesword[/b]
[list]
[*] Adjusted the release method of Congeneric Charged Moves. After a combo, you now need to tap Horizontal or Vertical Strike again to trigger the next Move.
[*] Optimized the animations for the movements of Congeneric Charged Shots.
[/list]

[b][h2]Souljade Adjustments[/h2][/b]
[b]I. Dual Halberds Souljade[/b]
Adjusted the release method of [Dragonlike Might]. It now requires tapping Horizontal or Vertical Strike again when on the ground to trigger the next Airborne Move.

[b][h2]In-game Adjustments[/h2][/b]
[b]I. New Morale Challenge in Capture the Spirit Well[/b]
Changed the second round of Morale Challenge to Capture the Flag.
[u]Rules:[/u] When the Morale Challenge starts, a flag will spawn in the middle of the battlefield. Players have to capture the flag, go to any of their Spirit Well areas, and stay there for 10 seconds to successfully deliver the flag and increase their team's Morale. The team with higher Morale will win the rewards for that round.

[b]II. New Custom Settings in Capture the Spirit Well:[/b]
[list]
[*] Total points required to win;
[*] Rebirth countdown time;
[*] Points gained per kill;
[*] Morale Boost toggle;
[*] Bounty toggle;
[*] Block Morus' Blessing toggle;
[*] Spirit Well toggle, allowing the disabling of any Spirit Well;
[*] Money Tree toggle, allowing the disabling of any Money Tree.
[/list]

[b]III. Feature Optimizations[/b]
[u]Optimized Rebirth[/u]
When you interact with Soul Altars as a soul, you will now respawn where your soul is instead of a random location.

[u]Added Remains' Mark[/u]
When you release your soul, your Remains location will be marked automatically and will be seen by your teammates. The mark works the same way as destination marks, and can be aimed at or canceled.

[u]You can now drag to adjust weapon positions in your Weapon Bag.[/u]
After dragging, the Weapon Bag's sorting rule changes to free sorting. Tapping the Sort by Quality button restores it to sorting by quality.

[b]IV. BOT Mode Adjustments[/b]
Optimized the pace of battle in BOT Mode, slightly reducing the chance of multiple AI opponents appearing simultaneously.

[b]V. Capture the Spirit Well Adjustments[/b]
[list]
[*] Increased the price of the [Dreadful Wail] Souljade at the Rift Dealer in Capture the Spirit Well to 25,000 Dark Tide Coins.
[*] Postponed the first Morus' Blessing.
[/list]

[b][h2]Out-game Adjustments[/h2][/b]
[b]I. Custom Room Adjustments[/b]
Added Musical Practice Mode—Unchained Melody
[list]
[*] A new mode titled "Unchained Melody" has been added to the Custom Room gameplay. Based on the solo Bloodbath mode, it features instruments placed in the scene (with obvious visual effects prompting their locations), which you can head to and play music.
[/list]
New Option Added
[list]
[*] In all game modes, added new option of disengagement.
[*] In the settings of The Bloodbath mode, added new option of Grappling Hooks Cost, which is turned on by default.
[/list]

[b]II. New Feature: Social Tags[/b]
You can now set personal social tags in your friend list, so your friends can know you better.

[b]III. Buying and Selling Cosmetics on Steam is now available[/b]
[Star-Collections] are available to purchase in the Steam Community Market. However, the initial set of items is only usable in-game on the Chinese servers. In the in-game Star-Colletion page, you can add them in Steam Inventory or retrieve them.
[olist]
[*] You have to add the in-game items into the Steam Inventory to trade them.
[*] Players below Lv.10 cannot add items into the Steam Inventory.
[/olist]
For more details about this please see our FAQ post here: [url=https://www.narakathegame.com/news/update/20230823/33459_1106117.html]https://www.narakathegame.com/news/update/20230823/33459_1106117.html[/url]

[b]IV. Free Training Modifications[/b]
[list]
[*] AI opponents in combo practice will initiate Disengage when their Disengage points are full.
[*] Resist Disengagement practice is removed.
[/list]
[i]//Dev notes: This change makes AI opponents attempt to both Dodge and Disengage, better simulating real situations and streamlining practice types.[/i]

[b]V. Congeneric Skill Preview added on Weapons Page[/b]
Added preview icons for Congeneric Skills in the weapon advantage section of the Weapons Page. Tap these icons to view the description and related videos of Congeneric Moves.

[b]VI. Weekly Quest Adjustments[/b]
Adjusted weekly quests related to dealing damage and defeating enemies using specific Heroes, so that new players with only free Heroes can also complete these quests.

[b]VII. Baize's Blessing[/b]
[list]
[*] Added the end time of the current round of Baize's Blessing.
[*] On Baize's Blessing page, added the preview of available rewards in the Baize Shop.
[/list]

[b][h2]Store Updates[/h2][/b]
[b]I. New Packs[/b]

Newly added Justina Gu exclusive Pack [A2 Pack (Justina Gu)], including Justina Gu Legendary Outfit [Automata·A2], Epic Hairstyle [Automata·A2 Hairstyle], Spear Legendary Skin [Automata·Type-4O Spear]. Standard price: 4,100 Gold; Now: 2,600 Gold.

Newly added Tessa exclusive Pack [Kainé Pack (Tessa)], including Tessa Legendary Outfit [Replicant·Kainé], Legendary Hairstyle [Replicant·Kainé Hairstyle], Dual Blades Legendary Skin [Replicant·Kainé's Blades]. Standard price: 4,100 Gold; Now: 2,600 Gold.
 
[b]II. New Discounts[/b]
[olist]
[*] Newly added Polesword Legendary Skin [Automata·Type-3 Lance]. Standard price: 1,800 Gold; Now: 1,500 Gold.
[*] Newly added Viper Ning Legendary Pose [Swing the Sword]. Standard price: 900 Gold; Now: 750 Gold.
[*] Newly added Tessa Legendary Pose [Swordplay]. Standard price: 900 Gold; Now: 750 Gold.
[*] Newly added Justina Gu Legendary Outfit [Automata·A2]. Standard price: 1,800 Gold; Now: 1,500 Gold.
[*] Newly added Justina Gu Epic Hairstyle [Automata·A2 Hairstyle]. Standard price: 500 Gold; Now: 400 Gold.
[*] Newly added Spear Legendary Skin [Automata·Type-4O Spear]. Standard price: 1,800 Gold; Now: 1,500 Gold.
[*] Newly added Tessa Legendary Outfit [Replicant·Kainé]. Standard price: 1,800 Gold; Now: 1,500 Gold.
[*] Newly added Tessa Epic Hairstyle [Replicant·Kainé Hairstyle]. Standard price: 500 Gold; Now: 400 Gold.
[*] Newly added Dual Blades Legendary Skin [Replicant·Kainé's Blades]. Standard price: 1,800 Gold; Now: 1,500 Gold.
[/olist]
 
[b]III. Discounts End[/b]
[olist]
[*]Feria Shen Legendary Hairstyle [Creatures Myth·Bliss] has returned to its standard price of 800 Gold. 
[*] Tarka Ji Legendary Hairstyle [Creatures Myth·Scorched] has returned to its standard price of 800 Gold. 
[*] Valda Cui Legendary Hairstyle [Creatures Myth·Nocturne] has returned to its standard price of 800 Gold. 
[*] Viper Ning Legendary Outfit [Automata·2B] has returned to its standard price of 1,800 Gold. 
[*] Viper Ning Epic Hairstyle [Automata·2B Hairstyle] has returned to its standard price of 500 Gold. 
[*] Greatsword Legendary Skin [Automata·Virtuous Treaty] has returned to its standard price of 1,800 Gold. 
[*] Wuchen Legendary Outfit [Automata·9S] has returned to its standard price of 1,800 Gold. 
[*] Wuchen Legendary Accessory [Automata·Camouflage Goggles] has returned to its standard price of 1,200 Gold.
[*] Wuchen Epic Hairstyle [Automata·9S Hairstyle] has returned to its standard price of 500 Gold. 
[*] Katana Legendary Skin [Automata·Cruel Oath] has returned to its standard price of 1,800 Gold.
[*] Tessa Legendary Outfit [Noir Sash] has returned to its standard price of 1,800 Gold.
[*] Tessa Legendary Hairstyle [Unfazed] has returned to its standard price of 800 Gold.
[*] Dual Halberds Legendary Skin [Lunar Call] has returned to its standard price of 1,500 Gold.
[/olist]
 
[b]IV. New Items in Spectral Silk Store[/b]
[list]
[*] Newly added Yueshan Legendary Outfit [Replicant·Nier] with a price of 18,000 Spectral Silk.
[*] Newly added Yueshan Epic Hairstyle [Replicant·Nier Hairstyle] with a price of 5,000 Spectral Silk.
[/list]

[b][h2]Client Optimization[/h2][/b]
Optimized the rendering performance of fuzzy materials.

[b][h2]Bug Fixes[/h2][/b]
[b]I. Hero-related Bugs[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where Tarka Ji, after activating the Ultimate, would exhibit abnormal Dodges when Countered in certain situations.
[*] Fixed an issue where the camera would abnormally rotate when Tessa activated the Ultimate with the locked camera enabled.
[*] Fixed the incorrect pause of Rage recovery after Tessa uses her Ultimate [Enchant: Bite].
[/list]

[b]II. Weapon-related Bugs[/b]
Fixed an issue where the display of collection points for the Longsword Skin [Duplicate·Moonrise] was incorrect.

III. Battle-related Bugs
1. Fixed an issue where the Longsword Souljade [Whirlwind] did not take effect when equipped.

IV. Showdown Bugs
1. Fixed an issue in the Enigma Domain: Shadowjade Mine, where the portal from Gamma Mine to Shadowjade Mine might spawn in the wrong location and did not display the boss prompt.

V. Outfit-related Bug
1. Fixed an issue of the out-game animation of Valda Cui's Extreme Outfit [Merfolk Finery].

notes.title: Star Collection Steam Market Notice
notes.content:
Dear Forerunners,

On August 24, you may notice the addition of NARAKA: BLADEPOINT cosmetics on the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/market/]Steam Community Market[/url]. This is an extension of the Star Collections system we announced in our [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1203220/view/3656408671668156598]July 14 update[/url]. Currently, Star Collection items will be available for sale on the Steam Community Market by their owners but these initial items will only be usable on the Chinese servers of NARAKA. While players from any server can purchase these items from others, they will only be usable on the Chinese servers.

Players in all other servers will eventually have access to versions of these cosmetics that will work in-game for them. Until then, we STRONGLY discourage the purchase/trade of items that are not intended for your server as you will NOT be able to use those items in-game.

[h2]Star Collections & Steam Market FAQ:[/h2]

[b][h3]What is the Steam Community Market?[/h3][/b]

The Steam Community Market is a virtual trading platform designed by Valve. It is used for trading game-specific items, trading cards, backgrounds and emoticons. Items are purchased in the Market via the Steam Wallet. For a full breakdown of what you can and cannot do, please see their FAQ.

[h2][h3]Are refunds available?[/h3][/h2]

Once you make a purchase on the Steam Community Market, there is no way to reverse or cancel the transaction.

[h2][h3]What are the items available on the platform?[/h3][/h2]

At this time, there are two items that can be purchased on the Steam Community Market, these are Star - Wolf King’s Fang and Star - Dragon’s Bane. [b]These items are only usable in-game on the Chinese server.[/b] Please look out for updates when these items become available on servers other than the Chinese server.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36350327/978935918a22ccf0875cafc9221931d39e6e5cd9.png[/img]


[b][h3]I have a Star - 2P or Star - Nine Tailed Destiny Outfit can I sell my Outfits?[/h3][/b]

No, at this current moment, you will not be able to sell Star - 2P or Star - Nine Tailed	Destiny Outfits. The ability to do so will come at a later time, please stay tuned for more details.

[b][h3]I am not a Steam player of NARAKA, can I participate?[/h3][/b]
	
No, the Steam Community Market is only accessible to players who use Steam to access NARAKA. Epic, Standalone Installers, and Console players will not be able to access cosmetics using this system.
	
[b][h3]Are there plans to expand the number of items that can be traded?[/h3][/b]

Yes, in future updates we will release new Star Collections and allow players to trade eligible existing Star Collections. Please stay tuned for more details.

[b][h3]What happens if I buy a cosmetic from a server that is not intended for my own?[/h3][/b]

You may hold onto or sell that cosmetic as a Community member but you will not be able to use that cosmetic in-game.

[b][h3]Do we know when we will be able to get these cosmetics on our own servers?[/h3][/b]

Please stay tuned to our official channels for updates about the availability of Star Collections on servers other than the Chinese server.

[b][h3]Are there any other limitations for selling/buying cosmetics on the Steam Community Market?[/h3][/b]

The only limitations on selling/buying cosmetics are that players below level 10 cannot add items to their Steam inventory as well as the rules outlined by Valve here.


We will share updates for all servers outside of China once we have more details to share. Until then we really encourage you to be patient as we work to make these cosmetics available to you on your servers. [b]The purchase of Chinese server content is at your own risk as it will not work in-game.[/b]

Thank you for your continued support of NARAKA: BLADEPOINT!

notes.title: NARAKA: BLADEPOINT Banned Players List 08-15
notes.content:
Dear players,

NARAKA: BLADEPOINT is committed to creating a fair and healthy competitive environment. We have not only used new anti-cheat technologies, but also established special cheat-reporting reward activities to encourage those players who defend the fairness with us. From now on, players who make outstanding contributions to reporting cheats will get the Legendary spear skin 'Righteous Polearm' .

More details:
1. Players who successfully reported 1 time will get [Immortal Treasure] X1;

2. Players who successfully report 10 times with low misreport rate will get [Immortal Treasure] X10 (In order to ensure the efficiency of detecting, please report reasonably);

3. Players who have successfully reported for many times or made great contributions to anti-cheat will get the Legendary spear skin [Righteous Polearm] X1.

We strongly recommend that players report via in-game report system, so that we can confirm the cheat as soon as possible and record successful report times for you!

From 08.7 to 08.13, there are 4 players who have successfully reported the cheating or hacking in total and get the reward [Righteous Polearm]! We hope that more players can become the Justice Supporter on the Morus Isle in the future.

Han***ilk

世一***花集
