notes.title: NARAKA: BLADEPOINT Update – August 10th, 2023
notes.content:
[h1]Dear players,[/h1]
The servers of NARAKA: BLADEPOINT will be suspended for maintenance from Aug 9th, 2023 at 23:00 (UTC) until Aug 10th, 2023 at 03:00 (UTC). We suggest that you log out in advance and enter the game again after the maintenance.

The details for this update are as follows:

[b][h2]Brand-new Content[/h2][/b]
[b]I. New Hero: Tessa, The Vixen[/b]
[previewyoutube=gZyGN1XQmPM;full][/previewyoutube]
Sultry but deadly, don't let those tails fool you. Many have fallen prey to her beguiling charms.

A young Herald sharing her soul with an ancient fox spirit, Tessa uses charm and trickery to manipulate any and all into doing her bidding. 

She wields sensuality and wit like weapons, weaving a web of pleasure to ensnare her prey. Though her love might feel genuine, the targets of her affection are little more than pawns in her quest to revive the fallen god Sunwing.

The third skill and ultimate are not yet available in this version. Once available, you can complete heroes' Cultivation Quests to unlock them. If you've completed the required Cultivation Quests before upcoming updates, the skill and ultimate will be unlocked automatically.

[b]II. New Mechanism: Congeneric Skill[/b]
New Mechanism: Congeneric Skill of Greatsword and Polesword is now available.

How to use the move:
[olist]
[*] Equip both Greatsword and Polesword in the weapon slots;
[*] While performing an attack move with Greatsword or Polesword, you can switch between primary and secondary weapons to execute the resonated move, which enables subsequent "Congeneric Skill".
[/olist]
[b]III. Fight with Tenacity (Newbie Protection)[/b]
Players below Lv. 20 (this standard will be adjusted according to actual performance in battle) will gain the Tenacity effect in Quick Matches.

The specifics are as follows:
[olist]
[*] An extra Rebirth (each player can have 2 Rebirth chances until the Shadow Corruption's first advance).
[*] +25% damage reduction.
[/olist]
[b]IV. Crossover Event with NieR is now available[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36350327/c41732ee187b31efd6958027d25c10c8b294ee8d.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36350327/ae07bec17540c96ffdfb0c3de1c386a663dc34fe.jpg[/img]
[i]"Everything that lives is designed to end.
We are perpetually trapped...
in a never-ending spiral of life and death."[/i]

[u]1. Fairyland Penglai Updates[/u]
[list]
[*] NARAKA × NieR crossover-themed song "The Flames of Fate" is now available in the background music.
[*] You can now sit on the chairs and benches on Fairyland Penglai.
[*] Updated the appearance of NARAKA Balls on Fairyland Penglai and reactivated their interaction with players.
[*] Redesigned the appearance of the Giant Kitebird and introduced new tour routes; board them at Wind's Abode and Mystoland to experience different tours.
[/list]
[u]2. Map Updates[/u]
[olist]
[*]Holoroth - Frigid Pools
On the Frigid Pools of Holoroth, vast fields of Lunar Tears have bloomed, along with peculiar iron puppets appearing. A strange skull is found among the blooms; what happens if you offer it the Lunar Tears you’ve picked?
[*] The Morus Isle - Cosmic Pillars
An anomaly occurred at the Cosmic Pillars: a portal that cannot be closed has opened!
[/olist]
[u]3. New Mechanism - Pod[/u]
Small accompanying robots appeared in the Morus Isle and Holoroth. Hold the button to interact and awaken these robots. When your Armor is not full, they will provide you with recovery until their stored armor is depleted.

[u]4. Limited-time Event: New Era[/u]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36350327/46de2ec6379efdbc786b75b9019e6a8652c65858.jpg[/img]
[list]
[*] During the event, you can select any chapter each day to complete its quests. The quests of each chapter will be unlocked in a timely order. Once you begin exploring a selected chapter, you cannot switch to other chapters on the same day nor complete quests in other chapters. However, you can still claim rewards for completed quests from other chapters. Changing chapters do not change your current quest progress.
[*] Complete all chapter quests to claim the Crossover-Themed Longsword Legendary Skin: [Replicant ·Moonrise].
[*] Complete event quests and pick up Lunar Tears during matches to give them to Emil. Participate in Sky-high Racing to obtain [Bolt], which can be used to redeem the rewards that Pod-24 secretly "acquired" from the game operation system.
[*] Pod-24 has hacked into your friend list, you may sometimes receive messages or rewards from it.
[*] Event Time: From Aug 10th, 2023 Update to Sep 6th, 2023 at 20:00 (UTC)
[/list]
[u]V. Limited-time Event: Vixen's Trick[/u]
[i]Red blooms sway, sun-kissed after the rain; fragrant air, a sight to gain.[/i]

[u]Event Rules:[/u]
[olist]
[*] Players can obtain Fox Spirit Beads by completing daily and event quests. Fox Spirit Beads can be exchanged for rare rewards.
[*] You must complete an event quest to unlock the next one. You can't complete an event quest before it becomes available. 
[*] Completing each event quest will unlock a question. Tap on the spirit fox to answer the question and claim generous rewards when you answer correctly.
[/olist]
[b]VI. Mythic Treasure with Bonus Star - Collections[/b]
Event Time: From Aug 10th, 2023 Update to Nov 16th, 2023 at 00:00 (UTC)

When opening Mythic Treasures, there is a chance to receive the Extreme Outfit, Star - Nine Tailed Destiny and the Legendary Outfit, Star - 2P.

How to Obtain:
[list]
[*] [Star - Nine Tailed Destiny]: There is a chance to get this outfit when obtaining an Extreme cosmetic from Mythic Treasures. Your chances increase as you obtain more Extremes, up to a maximum of 100%.
[*] [Star - 2P]: There is a chance to get this outfit when obtaining a Legendary cosmetic from Mythic Treasures. Your chances increase as you obtain more Legendaries, up to a maximum of 100%.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36350327/b74b5666170a128ffc338fdc4ac0df0acd78ce52.png[/img]
[*] After you have obtained the Star-Collections listed above, your increased chances will reset to their original level.
[/list]
The number of Star-Collections that can be obtained from Mythic Treasures is limited.
- [Star-Nine Tailed Destiny] has four Constellations that are [Color], [Fox Tail], [Dress Pattern], and [Divine Fox].
- [Star - 2P] has no Constellation and cannot be restyled.

[u]Identifier Rules:[/u]
Each Star-Collection has its own unique 6-digit code, determined at intervals of 50 by the time at which it was claimed.

It means that the first 50 to claim theirs will have codes (randomly) ranging from 000001-000050, the next 50 from 000051-000100, and so on.

This is not applicable for Star-Collections before this updates, which means the identifier of [Star - Wolf King's Fang] and [Star-Dragon's Bane] remain the same.

For more detailed information on these particular Star-Collection Bonus Gifts please see our FAQ: [url=https://www.narakathegame.com/news/update/20230808/35280_1103467.html]https://www.narakathegame.com/news/update/20230808/35280_1103467.html[/url]. 

[b][h2]Hero Adjustments[/h2][/b]
[b]I. Kurumi[/b]
[list]
[*] Optimized the [Healing Ray] skill and its Talents, altering the logic it uses to choose a link target.
[olist]
[*] If there's an [Marked] ally in the direction aimed, it links to them.
[*] If not, it links instead to the nearest ally within 30m (prioritizing heroes and Remains, then Light Parasols).
[*] In the event there are no [Marked] allies, and no others to link within 30m, a Light Parasol is summoned in the direction aimed instead.
[/olist]
[*]Optimized the skill [Healing Ray] and all its talent moves.
[olist]
[*] (1) Slightly increased the attack range of the Horizontal Strike after connecting the target.
[*] (2) The Horizontal Strike after connecting the target now provides 100% damage reduction instead of 70%. During the recovery frames, the damage reduction is 0.
[/olist]
[*] While the healing circle of Ultimates [Purified Circle] or [Purified Circle: Armor] is active, you can recast it by unleashing the Ultimate again. The new circle inherits the old one's remaining time and elemental effects.
[*] The Ultimate [Purified Circle: Rapid] now launches a knock-airborne attack on nearby enemies.
[/list]
[i]//Dev Note: Kurumi possesses strong rescue and protection capabilities, but her survivability has been slightly lacking through each version update. Therefore, we have adjusted the difficulty of using [Healing Ray] and added additional effects to [Purified Circle] to lower the entry barrier for Kurumi and enhance her survivability.[/i]

[b]II. Temulch[/b]
Improved the operation experience of all [Zephyr Wisp] skill branches:
[olist]
[*] Jump optimization: slightly increased the jumping height. Now the character's speed when activating the skill will be reset, ensuring consistent jumping height. During the jump phase, you can control the character's movement with directional buttons.
[*] Changed the status during the jump from Blue Focus to Golden Focus.
[/olist]
[i]//Dev Notes: The ability to perform horizontal movement during the jump phase significantly enhances Temulch's mobility. We hope this change addresses the issue of Temulch being easily interrupted by the Uppercut Slash move after skill activation and jumping.[/i]

[b]III. Tarka Ji[/b]
[list]
[*] After activating the Ultimate, Tarka Ji's 2nd-stage dodge (elbow strike) attack can interrupt higher Focus. Now it can interrupt enemies' Purple Focus Strikes.
[*] The damage multiplier for the skill [Flame Force: Fireball] has been adjusted from 2.0 to 2.2.
[*] Tarka Ji now expends 8.5% instead of 9% Rage to cast [Flame Force: Fireball] while [Fire Frenzy: Reload] is in effect.
[/list]

[b]IV. Valda Cui[/b]
[list]
[*] The bubble duration of skill [Water Trap: Trinity] has been adjusted from 4 sec to 2.5 sec.
[*] Added a 3-sec CD after throwing the water spear during the Ultimate [Rising Tide: Unchained], preventing consecutive spear throws.
[/list]
[i]//Dev Notes: Consecutive spear throws with continuous Focus have provided Valda with strong defensive advantages and exerted immense pressure on opponents during gameplay. To balance her offensive and defensive capabilities, we have introduced a CD for consecutive spear throws.[/i]

[b]V. Zai[/b]
[list]
[*] All talents of the skill [Flame Ward] and itself will now exit the [Flame Ward] state when affected by Control effects.
[*] Adjusted the rush action for [Flame Ward] and [Flame Ward: Ignition] to rush toward the aiming direction.
[*] Adjustments to the attack moves of [Chain Scythe] after activating the Ultimate:
[olist]
[*] Changed the Focus level for the second hit of Horizontal and Vertical Strikes from Golden Focus to Purple Focus.
[*] Increased gravity during Airborne Horizontal Strikes.
[*] The charged move [Chain Link: Suppress] can no longer knock enemies airborne.
[/olist]
[*] Updated the skill description for the Ultimate [Chain Scythe: Afflict].
[/list]
[i]//Dev Notes: Zai's continuous Horizontal Strikes with [Chain Scythe] made it difficult for opponents to counter, and her Airborne Horizontal Strike mechanism granted her additional survivability and damage output. We have adjusted the performance of the [Chain Scythe] moves to address these issues. Additionally, Zai's ability to continue using [Flame Ward] even under Control effects made it challenging for Control-based Heroes to time their actions correctly when facing Zai. Thus, we have revised the interruption conditions to reduce Zai's margin for error.[/i]

[b]VI. Wuchen[/b]
Optimized the placement of Yin Yang Orbs for Wuchen's Ultimates [Tai Chi Teleport] and [Tai Chi Teleport: Switch], as well as the selection of the aiming point for [Tai Chi Teleport: Portal], reducing potential issues and camera blocking to ensure accurate targeting.

[b][h2]Weapon Adjustments[/h2][/b]
[b]I. General Adjustments for Melee Weapons[/b]
Added a grappling button buffer during the execution of the Uppercut Slash move.

[i]//Dev Notes: Combining Uppercut Slash, grappling, and Blink Strike with the Katana or Uppercut Slash, grappling, and Decimator with Dual Halberds is fascinating gameplay. However, the use of the grappling hook mid-combo was leading to combo failures more than we would like due to timing issues. To address this, we have introduced a grappling button buffer during the execution of the Uppercut Slash move, ensuring that you can perform the combo without grappling prematurely. With this input buffer, we hope that more of you will be encouraged to explore and enjoy these combos.[/i]

[b]II. Katana[/b]
Slightly reduced the stagger duration after hitting an enemy with the horizontal strike when sprinting.

[b]III. Staff[/b]
[list]
[*] Reduced the pursuing effects and camera turning of charged horizontal strikes.
[*] Reduced the stagger duration when hitting enemies lying on the ground by Crouch+Horizontal Strike and Slide+Horizontal Strike.
[/list]
[b]IV. Spear[/b]
Reduced the stagger time when hitting enemies lying on the ground by Crouch+Horizontal Strike and Slide+Horizontal Strike.

[b]V. Dual Blades[/b]
[list]
[*] Slightly reduced the stagger duration after hitting an enemy with the charged Vertical Strike.
[*] Charged Vertical Strike 1st stage damage multiplier: increased from 1.64*3 to 1.79*3.
[*] Charged Vertical Strike 2nd stage damage multiplier: increased from 1.01*6 to 1.12*6.
[/list]
[b]VI. Longsword[/b]
Changed the effect when knocking enemies airborne by hitting enemies already in midair by Uppercut Slash.

[b]VII. Greatsword[/b]
[list]
[*] Reduced the stagger duration when hitting enemies that have been lying on the ground with a Vertical Strike immediately after a Horizontal Strike.
[*] Adjusted the damage multiplier of Brutal Tide from 2.12*2 to 1.27 + 2.97.
[/list]
[b]VIII. Polesword[/b]
[list]
[*] Reduced the stagger duration when hitting enemies that have been lying on the ground with a Vertical Strike immediately after a Horizontal Strike.
[*] Adjusted the damage multiplier of Brutal Tide from 2.12*2 to 1.27 + 2.97.
[/list]
[b]IX. Dual Halberds[/b]
[list]
[*] Charged Vertical Strike 1st stage damage multiplier: decreased from 0.89*6 to 0.87*6.
[*] Charged Vertical Strike 2nd stage damage multiplier: decreased from 0.85*8 to 0.82*8.
[/list]
[b][h2]In-game Adjustments[/h2][/b]
[b]I. Adjustments to Game Mechanics[/b]
Slightly increased the interaction range of the Wishing Wells.

[b][h2]Out-Game Adjustments[/h2][/b]
[b]I. Fairyland Penglai Optimizations[/b]
[list]
[*] Party characters are now visible in the Home interface.
[*] The same button is now used for both switching lobbies and accessing your Bag during a match, and can be reassigned.
[*] Party members may now Teleport to each other's Fairyland Penglai locations.
[/list]
[b]II. Hero Badge[/b]
New Hero Badge
[list]
[*] Divine Treasures: Unlock by obtaining a certain number of Extreme Cosmetics.
[*] Admirable Collection: Unlock by obtaining a certain number of Set Collections.
[*] Steal the Show: Unlock you reach a certain amount of Collection Points.
[/list]
[b]III. Free Training[/b]
1. Adjustments to Specialized Training:
[list]
[*] Added a new segment, "Chapter 7: Combos".
[*] Adjusted the weapon of AI opponents in Tap To Dodge training and simplified Hold To Dodge training.
[*] Enhanced UI display for actions involving holding down buttons, providing more precise prompts when the action is required.
[*] Optimized AI opponent demonstrations to avoid failures in certain scenarios.
[*] Added explanatory information for some training items, explaining new terms or training techniques.
[/list]
2. Added a button for direct jump to custom behavior practice.
3. AI opponents in custom behavior practice will switch weapons and restart commands after being countered.
4. Adjusted the positions of AI opponents and AI allies in general training.

[b]IV. Justice Chamber[/b]
1. Positions have been added to Justice Chamber. Currently only the position of "Co-Leader" is available.
2. Title has been added to Justice Chamber, which is determined by players' Activeness.
3. Contract Quest has been added to Justice Chamber.
[list]
[*] Post and complete contracts to get rewards. The poster needs to party up with other Justice Chamber members to complete the quests. Each player can post up to 3 contracts per week.
[*] Justice Chamber members in the poster's team can also claim rewards once the quest is completed. 
[*] Each player can claim up to 5 rewards per week.
[/list]
4. Justice Store Updates
[list]
[*] Players can team up with "Outstanding Potential" players (those who are below Lv.50 or have not logged in for the past 14 days) in the Justice Chamber, or complete their contract quests to get Journey Coins. Each minute that you've played together grants you 1 Journey Coin. Journey Coin can be redeemed for rewards at the Justice Store·Journey.
[/list]
[b]V. Gold Purchase Updates[/b]
[list]
[*] The icon of Gold on the top right corner can now direct you to the Recharge page. (Not yet available for the controller)
[*] If you attempt to purchase while having insufficient gold, you can navigate directly to the Recharge page. And on the Recharge page, you can also directly return to the previous page.
[/list]
[b][h2]Settings[/h2][/b]
[b]I. Capture the Spirit Well Chat Optimizations[/b]
Players' chat channel settings are now saved in Settings - Audio - Capture the Spirit Well (Chat).

[b][h2]Feature Optimizations[/h2][/b]
[b]I. Client[/b]
We've improved NARAKA's disk read efficiency to tackle lag and frame drops, greatly reducing the performance hit when starting a match, when large groups of characters interact, and other times at which character resources could cause slowdowns.

[b][h2]Store Updates[/h2][/b]
I. The Mythic Treasure is available now!
[previewyoutube=QWPkI9vTWak;full][/previewyoutube]
Mythic Treasure sells for 360 Gold. Open it and there's a chance to get Tessa Extreme Outfit [Nine Tailed Destiny], Dagger Extreme Skin [Beyonder Stone] and more.

Minimum Guarantee:
[olist]
[*] Players are guaranteed to receive at least 1 Red (Extreme) reward during the process of opening at most 100 Treasures. This can be triggered multiple times.​ 
[*] Red (Extreme) rewards will not repeat until all of them have been obtained.
Wishing Legendary Reward: If you draw an Extreme cosmetic, you gain a Legendary cosmetic guarantee, which allows you to pre-set the Legendary cosmetic which you receive when you next draw a Legendary cosmetic. You can accumulate multiple guarantees, but you can only pre-set 1 cosmetic each time.
[/olist]
[b]II. New Pack[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36350327/2cfd80b7be51fef64f993a36b1e20a2c62e076ac.png[/img]
1. Newly added Viper Ning exclusive Pack [2B Pack], including Viper Ning Legendary Outfit [Automata·2B], Epic Hairstyle [Automata·2B Hairstyle], Greatsword Legendary Skin [Automata·Virtuous Treaty]. Standard price: 4,100 Gold; Now: 2,600 Gold.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36350327/edeff2048a784d6c5b9a4d62d40d95a19439a177.png[/img]
2. Newly added Wuchen exclusive Pack [9S Pack], including Wuchen Legendary Outfit [Automata·9S], Epic Hairstyle [Automata·9S Hairstyle], Wuchen Legendary Accessory [Automata·Camouflage Goggles], Katana Legendary Skin [Automata·Virtuous Treaty]. Standard price: 5,300 Gold; Now: 3,200 Gold.

3. Newly added Tessa exclusive Pack [Lethal Allure Pack], including Tessa Legendary Outfit [Noir Sash], Legendary Hairstyle [Unfazed], Dual Halberds Legendary Skin [Lunar Call]. Standard price: 4,100 Gold; Now: 2,600 Gold.

[b]III. New Discounts[/b]
[olist]
[*] Newly added Viper Ning Legendary Background [Automata·Amusement Park Ruins]. Standard price: 600 Gold; Now: 500 Gold.
[*] Newly added Viper Ning Legendary Base [Automata·The Carousel]. Standard price: 1,200 Gold; Now: 1,000 Gold.
[*] Newly added Feria Shen Legendary Hairstyle [Creatures Myth·Bliss]. Standard price: 800 Gold; Now: 600 Gold.
[*] Newly added Tarka Ji Legendary Hairstyle [Creatures Myth·Scorched]. Standard price: 800 Gold; Now: 600 Gold.
[*] Newly added Valda Cui Legendary Hairstyle [Creatures Myth·Nocturne]. Standard price: 800 Gold; Now: 600 Gold.
[*] Newly added Viper Ning Legendary Outfit [Automata·2B]. Standard price: 1,800 Gold; Now: 1,500 Gold.
[*] Newly added Viper Ning Epic Hairstyle [Automata·2B Hairstyle]. Standard price: 500 Gold; Now: 400 Gold.
[*] Newly added Greatsword Legendary Skin [Automata·Virtuous Treaty]. Standard price: 1,800 Gold; Now: 1,500 Gold.
[*] Newly added Wuchen Legendary Outfit [Automata·9S]. Standard price: 1,800 Gold; Now: 1,500 Gold.
[*] Newly added Wuchen Legendary Accessory [Automata·Camouflage Goggles]. Standard price: 1,200 Gold; Now: 1,000 Gold.
[*] Newly added Wuchen Epic Hairstyle [Automata·9S Hairstyle]. Standard price: 500 Gold; Now: 400 Gold.
[*] Newly added Katana Legendary Skin [Automata·Cruel Oath]. Standard price: 1,800 Gold; Now: 1,500 Gold.
[*] Newly added Tessa Legendary Outfit [Noir Sash]. Standard price: 1,800 Gold; Now: 1,500 Gold.
[*] Newly added Tessa Legendary Hairstyle [Unfazed]. Standard price: 800 Gold; Now: 600 Gold.
[*] Newly added Dual Halberds Legendary Skin [Lunar Call]. Standard price: 1,500 Gold; Now: 1,250 Gold.
[/olist]

[b]IV. Discounts End[/b]
[olist]
[*] Katana Legendary Skin [The Breaker·Exorcist's Blade] has returned to its standard price of 1,500 Gold. 
[*] Longsword Legendary Skin [Fuchun Mountains·Verdure] has returned to its standard price of 1,800 Gold. 
[*] Justina Gu Legendary Gesture [Fuchun Mountains·Gleaming Peak] has returned to its standard price of 900 Gold.
[*] Kill Announcement [Journey of Blades·All-Seeing Eye] has returned to its standard price of 300 Gold.
[*] Kill Announcement [Journey of Blades·Flaming Depths] has returned to its standard price of 300 Gold.
[*] Justina Gu Legendary Outfit [Fuchun Mountains·Hills Afar] has returned to its standard price of 1,800 Gold.
[*] Justina Gu Legendary Hairstyle [Fuchun Mountains·Sunrise-lit] has returned to its standard price of 800 Gold.
[*] Kurumi Legendary Outfit [JTeam·Virtuous Empress] has returned to its standard price of 1,800 Gold.
[*] Kurumi Legendary Pose [JTeam·Curtsy] has returned to its standard price of 800 Gold. 
[*] Yueshan Legendary Outfit [JTeam·Demon's Nightmare] has returned to its standard price of 1,800 Gold.
[*] Yueshan Legendary Pose [JTeam·Blade's Edge] has returned to its standard price of 800 Gold.
[*] Tianhai Legendary Outfit [JTeam·Feller of Dragons] has returned to its standard price of 1,800 Gold.
[*] Tianhai Legendary Pose [JTeam·Sharpened] has returned to its standard price of 800 Gold.
[/olist]

[b]V. Rotation Sale of Cosmetics[/b]
On August 10th, we will discontinue the direct sale of collections including:
[list]
[*] Feria Shen Legendary Outfit [2674·CyberKitty].
[*] Viper Ning Legendary Outfit [2674·GasViper].
[*] Justina Gu Legendary Outfit [2674·Frost Drift].
[/list]
[b]VI. New Items in Spectral Silk Store[/b]
[list]
[*]Newly added Mythic Treasure with the price of 3,600 Spectral Silk. Please note that there is a limit of 1 purchase per 24 hours, and a maximum of 6 purchases for each player.
[*]Newly added Viper Ning Legendary Gesture [Viper Ning·Social] with a price of 9,000 Spectral Silk.
[*] Newly added Wuchen Legendary Gesture [Wuchen·Social] with a price of 9,000 Spectral Silk.
[*] Newly added Valda Cui Legendary Accessory [Creatures Myth·Birdlike Carp] with a price of 9,000 Spectral Silk.
[*] Newly added Viper Ning Epic Hairstyle [Automata·2P Hairstyle] with a price of 5,000 Spectral Silk.
[/list]
[b][h2]Bug Fixes[/h2][/b]
[b]I. Hero-related Bug[/b]
Fixed an issue with Tarka Ji's ground strikes during the Ultimate being mistakenly judged as airborne strikes.

[b]II. Other Bugs[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where other players could teleport to a player's location in Fairyland Penglai even when the target player was in the Invisible state.
[*] Fixed an issue where the Lobby music would be abnormally interrupted.
[*] Fixed an issue where the map, game mode selection, and friend list interfaces were overlapping on Fairyland Penglai.
[*] Fixed an issue where the male Hero's action clipped when handling the Dual Halberds in the closet page.
[*] Fixed an issue where the Fairyland Penglai would flicker occasionally when opening the Treasure Pavillion.
[/list]

notes.title: NARAKA: BLADEPOINT Banned Players List 08-08
notes.content:
Dear players,

NARAKA: BLADEPOINT is committed to creating a fair and healthy competitive environment. We have not only used new anti-cheat technologies, but also established special cheat-reporting reward activities to encourage those players who defend the fairness with us. From now on, players who make outstanding contributions to reporting cheats will get the Legendary spear skin 'Righteous Polearm' .

More details:
1. Players who successfully reported 1 time will get [Immortal Treasure] X1;

2. Players who successfully report 10 times with low misreport rate will get [Immortal Treasure] X10 (In order to ensure the efficiency of detecting, please report reasonably);

3. Players who have successfully reported for many times or made great contributions to anti-cheat will get the Legendary spear skin [Righteous Polearm] X1.

We strongly recommend that players report via in-game report system, so that we can confirm the cheat as soon as possible and record successful report times for you!

From 07.31 to 08.06, there are 4 players who have successfully reported the cheating or hacking in total and get the reward [Righteous Polearm]! We hope that more players can become the Justice Supporter on the Morus Isle in the future.

notes.title: NARAKA: BLADEPOINT Banned Players List 08-01
notes.content:
Dear players,

NARAKA: BLADEPOINT is committed to creating a fair and healthy competitive environment. We have not only used new anti-cheat technologies, but also established special cheat-reporting reward activities to encourage those players who defend the fairness with us. From now on, players who make outstanding contributions to reporting cheats will get the Legendary spear skin 'Righteous Polearm' .

More details:
1. Players who successfully reported 1 time will get [Immortal Treasure] X1;

2. Players who successfully report 10 times with low misreport rate will get [Immortal Treasure] X10 (In order to ensure the efficiency of detecting, please report reasonably);

3. Players who have successfully reported for many times or made great contributions to anti-cheat will get the Legendary spear skin [Righteous Polearm] X1.

We strongly recommend that players report via in-game report system, so that we can confirm the cheat as soon as possible and record successful report times for you!

From 07.24 to 07.30, there are 6 players who have successfully reported the cheating or hacking in total and get the reward [Righteous Polearm]! We hope that more players can become the Justice Supporter on the Morus Isle in the future.

notes.title: NARAKA: BLADEPOINT Update – July 27th, 2023
notes.content:
[h1]Dear players,[/h1]

The servers of NARAKA: BLADEPOINT will be suspended for maintenance from July 26th, 2023 at 23:00 (UTC) to July 27th, 2023 03:00 (UTC). We suggest you log out in advance and enter the game again after the maintenance.

The details for this update are as follows:

[b][h2]Brand New Content[/h2][/b]
[b]I. Limited-time Event: Dwelling in the Fuchun Mountains[/b]
Embrace the fusion of past and present as the landscapes come alive!

[u]Event Rules:[/u]
Embrace the fusion of past and present as the landscapes come alive! Brace yourself for [Dwelling in the Fuchun Mountains]—the latest project of Sunwing Relic, and an epic journey through the ink of ages! In the crossover event, we introduce Legendary Outfit [Fuchun Mountains·Hills Afar] for Justina Gu, Legendary Skin [Fuchun Mountains·Verdure] for Longsword, a thrilling combination exhibition of colossal artworks in Fairyland Penglai, and more! Dive into the limited-time mini-game [Wandering Through the Fuchun Mountains], introducing the captivating history of the painting and its artist, Huang Gongwang. Immerse yourself in the unique charm of China's national treasure!
[olist]
[*] Tap the button on the event page or scan the QR code to play
[*] Play through the mini-game to unlock Justina Gu exclusive Epic Background [Fuchun Mountains·Wooden Hue] along with Score Keeper Cards and more rewards! By sharing the game page, you can claim extra Regular Treasure Choice Gifts!  
[/olist]
[b]II. Limited-time event: A Nine-Tailed Tale[/b]
Tessa's a cunning sort, her next move a mystery to all.

[u]Event Rules:[/u]
[olist]
[*] By completing Daily Quests, players can obtain Tessa's Token: Foxbloom and have additional chance to obtain one of the following rewards: Tae, Spectral Silk, Mythic Treasure, Regular Treasure Choice Gift, Hero Coin, Legendary Outfit Trial Card, Mythic Coin. 
[*] There are 4 Sections, which can be unlocked with the corresponding Foxbloom. 
[*] You can claim rewards by unlocking any of the four Sections. Some rewards will be available after the new version is released, so stay tuned. 
[*] Each day, you can help a player obtain a Foxbloom (by tapping the "Share Tessa Token" in the contact list, selecting a Foxbloom, and confirming to share it). You won't consume your Tokens by doing so. However, each player will be given just one Foxbloom per day. 
[*] After the event ends, you can still claim unlocked rewards on the event page within the remaining time to claim rewards. But you can no longer complete Quests or Share Tessa Tokens during that period. Once the Tokens expire, they can be disposed into 160 Tae each in the Inventory.
[/olist]
[b]III. Fairyland Penglai[/b]
A new interactive feature is added – Giant Kitebird.
[list]
[*] In Fairyland Penglai, you can find Giant Kitebird docks at Wind's Abode. Wait at these docks for the Giant Kitebird to arrive, and it will fly along a fixed trajectory after docking for a certain period of time.
[*] Up to five players can ride the Giant Kitebird simultaneously, and you can exit the Kitebird by pressing Interactive button during the ride.
[/list]

[b][h2]Weapon Adjustments[/h2][/b]
[b]Dual Halberds[/b]
[list]
[*] Optimized the camera effects for charged horizontal strikes.
[*] Increased startup frames for charged horizontal strikes and delayed the timing at which the move can be canceled by a jump while airborne.
[*] While airborne, charged horizontal strikes can no longer be canceled by grappling.
[*] Prolonged startup frames for [Hooked Wings].
[*] Narrowed the attack range of charged vertical strikes.
[/list]

[b][h2]Souljade Adjustments[/h2][/b]
[b]I. Dagger Souljade[/b]
[list]
[*] The 1st-stage strike of [Dreadful Wail] remains Blue Focus, but the subsequent strikes have been modified to Golden Focus.
[*] Improved the effect of [Dreadful Wail] by increasing its ability to adhere to targets upon attacking.
[*] Shortened the start-up frame and increased the stagger time of the horizontal strike after leaping with [Dreadful Wail].
[/list]

[b]II. Dual Halberds Souljade[/b]
[list]
[*] Prolonged startup frames for [Dragonlike Might] and reduced the hit range of the first stage of the attack.
[/list]

[b][h2]In-game Adjustments[/h2][/b]
[b]I. Capture the Spirit Well Adjustments[/b]
[list]
[*] Added the display of teammates' numbers on the mini-map for better communication within the faction.
[*] The rewards for the 2nd and 3rd rounds of Morale-Boost Challenges are adjusted to Score +50.
[*] Slightly slow the growth speed of winning points to allow the match of Capture the Spirit Well mode last longer.
[*] Added in-match achievements in the Capture the Spirit Well mode.
[/list]

[b]II. Negative Gameplay Detection[/b]
[list]
[*] Implemented in-game negative behavior detection and penalty system. When we detect potential negative behaviors from a player's character, we will issue a prompt. Repeated instances of negative behavior in a single game will result in the deduction of the Reputation Score as a penalty.
[*] [i](Currently, the detection and penalty system are only active in Capture the Spirit Well mode.)[/i]
[/list]

[b]III. Other[/b]
[list]
[*] Newly added a special mark for the Valiant Challenger and the Bounty target when they enter the Realm of Yang.
[/list]

[b][h2]Out-game Adjustments[/h2][/b]
[b]I. Improvements on Fairyland Penglai:[/b]
[list]
[*] You can now mute instrument performance sound and nearby voice chat via the Main Lobby screen.
[*] HUD adjustments within Fairyland Penglai.
[*] Removed Marks to player characters.
[*] You can now better interact with weapons and water plants in Fairyland Penglai.
[*] Adjusted the range of instrument performance sound heard by nearby players, highlighting the sound while lowering default background music.
[*] Improved the performance and frame rate of Fairyland Penglai by streamlining the loading of environmental resources.
[*] Temporarily disabled the collision interaction with [NARAKA Ball] on the Fairyland Penglai.
[/list]

[b]II. Free Training Mode Adjustments[/b]
[list]
[*] The Rift Dealer in Free Training mode now offers recommendations for Souljades and weapons.
[*] Revamped certain challenges in Specialized Practice to better suit the difficulty levels across sections.
[*] Optimized some voiceovers in certain Specialized Practice sections.
[/list]

[b]III. Hero Badge[/b]
[list]
[*] The [Speedrunner] Hero Badge now displays the current progress count directly on the badge.
[/list]
[b][h2]Showdown Adjustments[/h2][/b]
[b]I. Combat Adjustments[/b]
[list]
[*] Reduced the cooldown time for interacting with the Enigmatic Rift in Showdown Mode.
[*] Optimized the fog effect performance when players inflict the [Hydroflare] effect on giant monsters.
[/list]

[b]II. Enigma Domain[/b]
[list]
[*] You will now receive visual cues if a boss monster is present on the other side of the Enigmatic Rift. The spawn speed of the Enigmatic Rift has been increased.
[/list]

[b][h2]Store Updates[/h2][/b]
[b]I. New Packs[/b]
[olist]
[*] Newly added Justina Gu exclusive Pack [Daybreak Cloud Pack], including Legendary outfit [Fuchun Mountains·Hills Afar], Legendary Hairstyle [Fuchun Mountains·Sunrise-lit]. Standard price: 2,600 Gold; Now: 1,800 Gold.
[*] Newly added Kurumi exclusive Pack [Unyielding Pink Pack], including Legendary Outfit [JTeam·Virtuous Empress] and Legendary Pose [JTeam·Curtsy]. Standard price: 2,600 Gold; Now: 1,800 Gold.

[*] Newly added Kurumi Legendary Outfit [JTeam·Virtuous Empress]. Standard price: 1,800 Gold; Now: 1,500 Gold.

[*] Newly added Yueshan Legendary Outfit [JTeam·Demon's Nightmare]. Standard price: 1,800 Gold; Now: 1,500 Gold.
[*] Newly added Yueshan Legendary Pose [JTeam·Blade's Edge]. Standard price: 800 Gold; Now: 600 Gold.

notes.title: NARAKA: BLADEPOINT Update – July 14th, 2023
notes.content:
[h2]Dear players,[/h2]

The servers of NARAKA: BLADEPOINT will be suspended for maintenance from July 13th, 2023 at 23:00 (UTC) to July 14th, 2023 at 03:00 (UTC). We suggest you log out in advance and enter the game again after the maintenance.

The details for this update are as follows:

[b][h2]Brand New Content[/h2][/b]
[b]I. New Lobby- Fairyland Penglai[/b]
[previewyoutube=KYgg2enbC6k;full][/previewyoutube]

Following the Heroes' victory over Omnius, the Psylith people escaped and launched their retaliation. Under critical circumstances, the Fervent disciples transported the Heroes from the Morus Isle to the floating island of Fairyland Penglai.

The lobby has been upgraded to a brand-new interactive scene—Fairyland Penglai! Embark on a journey in Fairyland Penglai, where you'll meet different Heroes or even dance together. Compete in Sky-high Racing, take photos, and create memories. You can even team up and battle on the Morus Isle.

[i](After the update, log in to the game lobby and press [Tab] if you're using  mouse and keyboard or [Options] if using a controller to enter Fairyland Penglai.)[/i]

[b]1. Interactions[/b]
[olist]
[*] Instrumental Performance: You can play four types of instruments, which are [Guzheng], [Er-hu], [Flute], and [Drum]. You may perform solo or as part of  an ensemble, and do your own interpretations.
[*] Parkour Racing: [Sky-high Racing] lets you compete with other players in an epic airborne race, dodging obstacles and striving to become the fastest of all in Fairyland Penglai.
[*] Interactive Mechanisms: Discover and interact with [NARAKA Balls] scattered all over the island for delightful surprises.
[/olist]
[b]2. Photo Mode[/b]
Take photos with three different camera modes tailored to meet different needs, and share them with just one button. You can use the scenes from Pantheon, Reverie Cascade, to Fairy Cave and other locations to get that perfect shot!

[b]3. Social Features[/b]
[olist]
[*] [Nearby Voice Chat] and [Nearby Chat] are offered for convenience. The addition of [Nearby Players] in the friend list also allows you to connect with and befriend people you're interested in.
[*] A [Teleport] function has also been added. You can teleport to where your friends and Justice Chamber teammates are by using this function in the friend list.
[/olist]
[b]4. Custom Display[/b]
You can change your current character, weapons, and outfit combinations to your liking. Use various emotes and gestures to become the center of attention!

[b]II. New Congeneric Weapon: Dual Halberds[/b]
[previewyoutube=OtohZvhds9I;full][/previewyoutube]
Wield power and grace, a storm's silent embrace.

In the new update, we'll be introducing the ancient Chinese weapon—Dual Halberds. Try it out!

[b]III. New Specialized Practice Mode[/b]
[olist]
[*] Specialized Practice is now available in Free Training mode. This new mode aims to assist players in gaining a better understanding of advanced combat skills through various demonstrations and explanations. You can now access the Specialized Practice menu and start training in Free Training through the training mode selection. You can also switch between Specialized Practice and Free Training modes in the Training Ground.
[*] Specialized Practice is divided into 6 chapters: Common Attack, Grappling Hook, Charged Attack, and more. They consist of 23 training exercises, such as Airborne Horizontal Strike, Consecutive Grappling, Charged Attack and Uppercut Slash, Charged Attack and Slide, Charged Attack and Counter, and others.
[*] Upon reaching a certain level and completing all exercises in the previous chapter, the next chapter will be unlocked automatically. When completing all training exercises in each chapter for the first time, you can claim corresponding rewards in the Specialized Practice menu.
[/olist]
[b]IV. Brand-new series of Star-Collections (Coming Soon)[/b]
On the day when the energies of water and gold intersect, a starfall comes.

You may notice some changes to the Collections UI to allow for some new fields of information to be revealed. These changes are in preparation for a new series of cosmetics that will be coming later in NARAKA.

The brand-new Star-Collections will arrive in August. Star-Collections have two qualities: Legendary and Extreme. In addition to a more exquisite appearance, they have some unique features including: [Star-Constellations], [Can be Obtained Repeatedly], [Exclusive Number], [Exclusive Stats], [Custom Name], [Support Trading], [Security Lock], etc.

Star-Collections are incredibly rare and each server has a limited number of Star-Collections available. There will be no new Star-Collections generated once the current distribution is completed.

[u]Star-Collection Features Info[/u]
[olist]
[*] Star-Constellations: Each Constellation represents an attribute that can be randomly altered. Changing the Constellation can affect the appearance of the cosmetic.
[*] Obtained Repeatedly: Star-Collections can be obtained multiple times, and if you obtain a duplicate, it will not be converted into Spectral Silk.
[*] Unique Identifier: Each Star-Collection is assigned an exclusive 6-digit number that is sorted according to the date it was claimed.
[*] Exclusive Stats: When wearing Star-Collections, the battle stats of players are registered exclusively.
[*] Custom Name: Players can customize the name of their Star-Collections, and each name is unique and cannot be repeated.
[*] Tradable: The Star-Collections can be traded on the Treasure Pavilion, Steam and other platforms. [i](Please stay tuned for more details on the trading platform, set to launch in August.)[/i]
[*] Security Lock: The player can use the Security Lock feature to lock the Star-Collections. Once a Star-Collection is locked, it can only be equipped and cannot be restyled, renamed, or undergo any other operations. To activate this feature, players can go to "Settings - Social - Security Lock Settings."
[/olist]
For detailed rules of the above features, please visit the in-game event page. Players can visit ''Inventory - Star-Collection'' to check the obtained collections.

[b]V. Edition Upgrade[/b]
1. You can use Gold to upgrade your game to the Standard, Deluxe, or Ultimate versions. The costs of each version are 980, 1680, and 2480 Gold, respectively.

2. Starting from July 14 to August 9 at 20:00 (UTC+0), you will get to enjoy a limited-time discount of 40% if you upgrade your game during this period.

3. Upgrading to the Standard edition or better will grant you the following privileges:
[list]
[*] Unlock Ranked Mode at Level 20.
[*] Unlock Public Chat at Level 5.
[*] Unlimited exchange of Hero Coins.
[*] Create Custom Rooms.
[/list]
4. Edition Upgrade Rewards for New Players
[olist]
[*] Upgrading to the Standard version grants the limited-edition Legendary Dual Blades Skin [Lacerator] and 300 Hero Coins.
[*] Upgrading to the Deluxe version includes the Standard version rewards and also the limited-edition Legendary Spear Skin [White Viper] and 10 Immortal Treasures.
[*] Upgrading to the Ultimate version includes rewards from the Standard and Deluxe versions, as well as the limited-edition Extreme Matari Skin [Flawless Elegance] and the limited-edition Legendary Grappling Hook Accessory [Aroma].
[/olist]
5. Edition Upgrade Rewards for Veteran Players
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36350327/b94820eb5d504369679a052e08a5aae95d2a9f9c.png[/img]
[olist]
[*] Players who have created a formal game character before July 14, 2023, will be eligible for existing player rewards.
[*] The rewards need to be claimed before  October 14, 2023, at 15:59:59 (UTC).
[*] The rewards include Viper Ning Outfit [Crepuscular Soulbloom], Special Avatar [Companionship], [Companionship Choice Gift]*10 and Gold Return. (1,960 Gold for Standard; 3,360 Gold for Deluxe; 4,960 Gold for Ultimate)
[/olist]
[b]VI. Anniversary Event: Glory Celebration[/b]
Two years of glory, a symphony of light. Blades resound, brilliance abounds.
Event Time: From July 14th, 2023 Update to August 9th, 2023 at 20:00. (UTC)

[u]Event Rules:[/u]
[olist]
[*] During the event, gain lots of Glory Stones by completing Glory Trial quests. Glory Trial quests will reset every 3 days.
[*] Accumulate the required number of Glory Stones to claim exclusive rewards from the Glory Treasure. The total number of Glory Stones required to obtain all exclusive rewards is 12,500. If you have extra Glory Stones, you can claim additional Regular Treasure Choice Gifts with them.
[*] You can get Glory Stones by participating in activities such as Glory Marks, Eventide Sign-In, Anniversary Stats, and Wells of Fate during the event.
[*] You can also get Glory Stones through the Sky-high Racing in Fairyland Penglai during the event.
[*] You can unlock Glory Memories videos by obtaining the corresponding Glory Treasure during the event.
[/olist]

[b]VII. Limited-time Event: Night of Euphoria Roll Call[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36350327/cb9c020a9b6735bc277984f9b62d101b5a383ac7.png[/img]
The future's aglow, and an eternity of delight follows.
Event Time: From July 14th, 2023 Update to August 9th, 2023 at 20:00. (UTC)

[u]Event Rules:[/u]
Each day, players can get 300 Glory Stones used in the Glory Celebration event. Players who sign in a total of 10 days during the event can receive Glory Chest Choice Gift*10, limited-edition weapon skins and other event rewards.

[b]VIII. Limited-time Event: Anniversary Sale[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36350327/5a3091485d0800de4c9f28d3701c49fe615c1db9.png[/img]
Event Time: From July 14th, 2023 Update to August 9th, 2023 at 20:00. (UTC)

[u]Event Rules:[/u]
[olist]
[*] During the event, 4 kinds of vouchers are claimable on the event page: Legendary Outfit 40% discount voucher, Legendary Weapon 40% discount voucher, Legendary Accessory 40% discount voucher and other Legendary Item 40% discount voucher. There are 2 of each voucher type to be claimed.
[*] Use a voucher when purchasing the corresponding Legendary cosmetic with Gold, and you'll get a 40% discount. These discounts cannot be applied when purchasing gifts for friends.
[*] Please note that vouchers are only eligible for the Legendary cosmetics of Season 6: Spark Season and its previous seasons.
[*] Vouchers are valid for a limited time only. Make sure you use yours before it expires.
[/olist]
[b]IX. Limited-time Event: Wells of Fate[/b]

The convergence of all spirits within the wells holds the fate of the universe.
Event Time: From July 14th, 2023 Update to August 9th, 2023 at 20:00. (UTC)
Redeem the rewards before: August 16th, 2023 at 20:00. (UTC)

[u]Event Rules:[/u]
[olist]
[*] During the event, players can obtain a great amount of Telluric Essence by playing Capture the Spirit Well mode. Opening stashes in the Survival Modes also grants a small amount of Telluric Essence.
[*] Playing in the Survival Modes with your Chamber Members or Returned Heroes is a good way to get bonus Telluric Essence.
[*] Use Telluric Essence to redeem rewards during the event, you can receive new ones each time a previous one is redeemed. You can also get Glory Stone by redeeming the rewards.
[*] You can redeem your rewards up to 10 times a week for free. Each time you refresh after that, it will cost 50 Telluric Essence. Another round of free refreshes begins every Wednesday
[/olist]
[b]X. Limited-time Event: Anniversary Stats[/b]

Check your own anniversary stats and review your accomplishments. Share the stats and there's a chance to get a limited-edition pose and other great rewards!
Event Time: From July 14th, 2023 Update to August 9th, 2023 at 20:00. (UTC)

[u]Event Rules:[/u]
During this event, generate your own Anniversary Stats with the QR code. Open it by scanning the QR code, you can check your own stats for the 2nd anniversary and claim limited-edition rewards. For more details, please check the event page.

[b]XI. Season Treasures Return[/b]
Event Time: From July 14th, 2023 Update to August 10th, 2023 at 00:00. (UTC)
[olist]
[*] During the event, Tidal Treasure, Echelon Treasure, Untamed Treasure and Dawn Treasure will be available again for a limited time. For full details about the Season Treasures returning, please see our post outlining the details [url=https://www.narakathegame.com/news/update/20230712/33459_1098155.html]here[/url].
[*] The content and drop rate of rewards in Treasures will remain unchanged.
[*] The number of times to trigger a Guarantee for all Treasures will not be reset, and the progress you made on the current season’sGuarantee will carry over. 
[/olist]

[b]XII. Limited-time Event: Glory Path[/b]
From a seedling, we have grown into a mighty oak.
Event Time: From July 14th, 2023 Update to August 9th, 2023 at 20:00. (UTC)

[u]Event Rules:[/u]
During the event, complete special achievements to get the Anniversary-themed Hero Badges as well as additional rewards such as Glory Stone and Glory Chest Choice Gift.

[b]XIII. Limited-time Event: The Hero Returns[/b]
Event Time: From July 14th, 2023 Update to August 9th, 2023 at 20:00. (UTC)

[u]Event Rules:[/u]
[olist]
[*] During this period, players are eligible for the Hero Returns event if it has been more than 14 days since their last login.
[*] Each round of the Hero Returns event lasts for 3 days which will be calculated since the return date.
[*] Complete the Hero Returns event quests and get the Rebirth Seal, which can be used to redeem limited-edition rewards in the Rebirth Seal Store. You can also redeem the Rebirth Seal with Spectral Silk in the Spectral Silk Store.
[/olist]
[b]Rebirth Seal Store:[/b]
[olist]
[*] Newly added redeemable item [Reckoning Treasure]. Each requires 5 Rebirth Seals with a purchase limit of 3.
[*] Newly added Accessory [Rice Dumpling], Background [Illuminated City] and [Conquest Lands]. Each requires 16 Rebirth Seal.
[*] Newly added Accessories [Kabuto Kitty], [Guiding Light] and [Petal Hossu]. Each requires 12 Rebirth Seal. 
[*] Newly added Stash Skin [Snowman] requires 11 Rebirth Seal.
[*] Newly added Background [Strange Tales], and [Quaint Landscape]. Each requires 8 Rebirth Seal.  
[*] Newly added Hero Outfits [Alchemist Apparel·Fortune], [Spring Silk·Mercy] and [Silk Dress·Cyan]. Each requires 8 Rebirth Seal.
[*] Newly added Weapon Skins [Wind Cut] and [Leaning Heaven·Moongazer]. Each requires 7 Rebirth Seal.
[*] Newly added Bases [Paper Lanterns], [Wreck] and [Aureate]. Each requires 6 Rebirth Seal.  
[*] Newly added Accessories [Inventor's Eyewear], [Chilly Wind], [Eerie Fire] and [Crystal Tassel]. Each requires 6 Rebirth Seal.
[*] Newly added Accessories [Antler Bell], [Lilacy Butterfly], [Duo Dragon·Green], [Duo Dragon·White], Pose [Jump for Joy], Hero Skin [Cloth Shirt·Milkvetch]. Each requires 4 Rebirth Seal.
[*] Newly added Backgrounds [Lion Dance], [Celestial Terrace], and [Aurora Night]. Each requires 3 Rebirth Seal.
[*] Newly added Bubble [Feria Shen·Snipe], Weapon Skin [Belladonna·Stormy] and [Stormcaller·Ebony]. Each requires 3 Rebirth Seal.
[*] Newly added Accessories [Snowflake Down], [Enamel Pocket Watch] and [Eventide Mirror]. Each requires 2 Rebirth Seal.
[/olist]
[b]XIV. Limited-time Event: Hero Recall[/b]

Event Time: From July 14th, 2023 Update to August 9th, 2023 at 20:00 (UTC)

[u]Event Rules:[/u]
[olist]
[*] All players can send up to 3 invitations per day to friends who haven't logged in to the game for more than 14 days. 
[*] After the players log in to the NARAKA: BLADEPOINT again, they can accept one of their friends' invitations to complete the recall. 
[*] Senders can reap rewards from an accepted invitation. If the returned player completes daily quests of The Hero Returns event, the sender can get extra rewards. Once players have recalled 20 friends, they cannot invite more.
[*] When the event expires, you can no longer send new invitations, but can still receive rewards. Your unclaimed rewards will be deleted when the event is removed from the website.
[/olist]
[b]XV. BATTLEPASS Updates[/b]
[Mythic] BATTLEPASS is now available, which includes a variety of valuable items and skins! Players can obtain more rewards by unlocking the Advanced Hidden Treasure! You can get a Treasure Scroll at the price of 1,200 Gold and a Glory Scroll at 2,840 Gold.

[b]XVI. Baize's Blessing[/b]
[olist]
[*] Each time you purchase Baize's Blessing, you can immediately receive 600 Gold. You can also get Baize Coins which can be redeemed for plenty of rewards in the Baize Shop. The rewards within are updated from time to time.
[*] You can get Baize Coins 24 times and an extra reward for logging in for 15 days.
[/olist]
[b]XVII. New Season - Season 9: Mythic[/b]
We have come to the end of Season 8: Reckoning and would like to thank all the players who participated in this season’s ranked matches. For the full recap of season rewards and score resets please see our official announcement post.

[b][h2]Hero Adjustments[/h2][/b]
[b]I. Zai[/b]
[list]
[*] Adjusted the total damage multiplier of the Charged Attack from 4.2 to 3 when Ensnared Soul is full for the [Chain Scythe: Suppress] Ultimate.
[*] Increased the time required to charge Ensnared Soul for the [Chain Scythe: Suppress] Ultimate after it is depleted from 6s to 8s.
[*] After the [Flame Ward] and [Flame Ward: Ignition] Skills enter the [Flame Ward] state, performing a Rescue will immediately end the state.
[/list]
[b]II. Valda Cui[/b]
[list]
[*] Reduced the duration of [Nether Nightmare: Smite] Ultimate in Solo mode from 20s to 15s. No change in Duos and Trios modes.
[/list]
[b]III. Akos Hu[/b]
[list]
[*] Adjusted the duration of [Feral Frenzy] and [Feral Frenzy: Grab] Ultimates in different modes:
[olist]
[*] Solo mode: Reduced from 26s to 24s.
[*] Duos mode: Reduced from 35s to 30s.
[*] Trios mode: Reduced from 35s to 30s.
[/olist]
[*] Adjusted the three consecutive strikes' damage multiplier in [Feral Frenzy] Ultimate from 2.8/3.1/3.4 to 2.3/2.6/2.9.
[*] Slightly reduced the absorption distance of Tiger-Claw Airborne Horizontal Strikes.
[/list]
[b]IV. Tianhai[/b]
New Skill features have been added to all modes and Talents for Tianhai.
[olist]
[*] When Tianhai activates his Ultimate and taps the Ultimate button again, he can initiate a jump-and-smash Skill in the aimed direction.
[*] The CD for this Skill is 15s, and it is reduced to 10s in Showdown mode.
[/olist]
[b]V. Others[/b]
[olist]
[*] Adjusted the pentagonal abilities display and difficulty index for some Heroes.
[*] Ultimate deactivation has been optimized. When derivative Ultimate Skills (such as Akos Hu's [Feral Frenzy: Grab]) are on CD, you can deactivate the Ultimate by holding the button.
[/olist]
[b][h2]Weapon Adjustments[/h2][/b]
[b]I. Staff[/b]
[olist]
[*] Slightly reduced the displacement of precise Charged attacks.
[*] Adjusted the damage multiplier of [Knee Breaker] from 0.71*7 to 0.55*2 + 0.69*2 + 0.83*3.
[i](The above adjustments do not involve Showdown mode.)[/i]
[*] Slightly reduced the displacement for light running strikes and light sprint strikes.
[/olist]
[b]II. Dual Blades[/b]
[olist]
[*] Slightly shortened the startup frames of Charged Vertical Strikes.
[*] Adjusted the airborne height when knocked airborne by Crouched Vertical Strikes.
[*] Slightly reduced the displacement during Charged Vertical Strikes and increased the displacement of Vertical Strikes.
[/olist]
[b]III. Greatsword[/b]
Increased the damage reduction ratio of Stone Form from 80% to 90%.

[b]IV. Polesword[/b]
Decreased the damage reduction ratio of Stone Form from 80% to 75%.

[b]V. Longsword[/b]
[olist]
[*] Charged Horizontal Strike first stage damage multiplier: decreased from 5.12 to 4.39.
[*] Charged Horizontal Strike second stage damage multiplier: decreased from 6.15 to 5.44.
[*] Charged Vertical Strike first stage damage multiplier: decreased from 4.46 to 3.99.
[*] Charged Vertical Strike second stage damage multiplier: decreased from 5.35 to 4.92.
[i](The above adjustments do not involve Showdown mode.)[/i]
[/olist]
[b][h2]Souljade Adjustments[/h2][/b]
[b]I. Staff Souljade[/b]
Optimized the special effects of [Stanchion·Rising·Sky Pillar] during charging.

[b]II. Dual Blades Souljade[/b]
Optimized the impact effects of [Universe Slash] for more stable attacks.

[b]III. Longsword Souljade[/b]
[list]
[*] Adjusted the damage of [Hepta-Detach]
[olist]
[*] Damage multiplier: Adjusted from 0.35*2 + 2.77 to 0.12*2 + 0.92.
[*] Recovery effect after a hit: Increased from 65% of damage to 400%.
[/olist]
[*] Adjusted the damage of [Phoenix Blast]
[olist]
[*] Charged Horizontal Strike first stage damage multiplier: decreased from 2.96*2 to 2.63*2.
[*] Charged Horizontal Strike second stage damage multiplier: decreased from 3.65*2 to 3.26*2.
[*] Charged Vertical Strike first stage damage multiplier: decreased from 2.58*2 to 2.39*2.
[*] Charged Vertical Strike second stage damage multiplier: decreased from 3.17*2 to 2.96*2.
[/olist]
[/list]
[b][h2]In-game Adjustments[/h2][/b]
[b]I. Capture the Spirit Well Adjustments[/b]
[olist]
[*] In Capture the Spirit Well, the start time for Match Acceleration has been delayed from the 12-minute mark to the 13-minute mark.
[*] The last round of Morale Rewards has changed to: Increase Attack and Defense and expose enemies' spots
[*] Optimized the placement of Soul Altars and Rift Dealer on the map.
[*] At the Rift Dealer in Capture the Spirit Well, the prices of [Phoenix Blast] and [Hepta-Detach] Souljades have been increased from 20,000 to 25,000 Dark Tide Coins.
[*] Group Heal has been reintroduced to the Rift Dealer's inventory, with its effective range in this mode adjusted to 50m.
[*] Dropping of Armor is no longer permitted in this mode.
[*] Reduced the initial quantity of Advanced Armor Powder and Large Vitalia from 6 to 4 in this mode.
[*] In Capture the Spirit Well, the default distance for the Grappling Hook has been adjusted from 30m to 40m.
[*] Optimized the voice chat HUD by adding channel names.
[/olist]

[b]II. New [Grappling Aim] Settings[/b]
[list]
[*] Added [Automatic] option for the [Grappling Aim] settings.
Hold the [Grappling Hook] button to aim with the scope, and release the button to automatically shoot the Grappling Hook. Tap the [Aim] button once to close the scope while aiming. The crosshair changes to a triangular shape when the target is within the range and reverts to a dot if outside the range.
[*] In controller mode, a new [Double Tap] mode has been added.
Tap the [Grappling Hook] button to aim, then tap the button again to fire the Grappling Hook. Tap the [Aim] button to close the scope while aiming.
[*] By default, new accounts have the [Automatic] mode for [Grappling Aim]. This setting does not affect existing players' configurations.
[*] You can modify the [Grappling Aim] in [ESC (or Options)] > [Settings] > [Gameplay] > [Combat].
[/list]
[b]III. Controller Vibration Optimization[/b]
[olist]
[*] Optimized the controller vibration curve.
[*] Added controller vibration when completing the [Swarm] Charged attack and when hitting with the Ultimate skills of Valda Cui, Yueshan, Wuchen, Justina Gu, Takeda Nobutada, Feria Shen, Akos Hu, and Zai.
[*] You can adjust [Controller Vibration] in [Options] > [Settings] > [Controller].
[/olist]
[b]IV. Feature Optimizations[/b]
Martial Artist Solo Mode Adjustments
[olist]
[*] Reduced the size of the combat area in this mode.
[*] Increased the initial number of Grappling Hooks from 6 to 12 in this mode.
[/olist]
[b]V. Mechanism Adjustments[/b]
When the current round in the Realm of Yang is full, the light effect at the Gate of Yang will fade and disappear, making it easier to determine from a distance whether entry is possible.

[b][h2]Out-game Adjustments[/h2][/b]
[b]I. Gameplay Adjustments[/b]
[olist]
[*] The Capture the Spirit Well is now a permanent mode.
[*] The rotation of gameplay modes will be temporarily disabled (including Shadow Surge and Through the Fire modes).
[/olist]
[b]II. Free Training Mode[/b]
[olist]
[*] Custom behavior practice is added, allowing you to input AI opponents' behavior for targeted practice sessions.
[*] Optimized the Free Training scene by adding slopes, houses, beams, and more for a diverse terrain.
[/olist]
[b]III. Opening Video[/b]
The opening video has been updated. It can be viewed by the ESC button (or Options button) in the lobby to open the menu and select the video.

[b]IV. Matchmaking Autofill Teammate Adjustment[/b]
In The Herald's Trial Duos and Trios modes, players ranked Solar and below will be unable to cancel the option for auto-matching teammates.

[b]V. Hero Badge[/b]
[olist]
[*] New Hero Badges added to the Capture the Spirit Well mode.
[*] Expanded the stage rewards for Hero Badge points, allowing you to obtain more showcase slots and Season Treasure Choice Gifts. If you meet the Hero Badge point requirements, the rewards will be automatically transferred into your Hero Badge interface after updating the game.
[/olist]
[b]VI. Profile[/b]
[olist]
[*] Season data and match history are added for the Capture the Spirit Well mode.
[*] Your personal profile now displays the Capture the Spirit Well stats, while Omni's Nightmare stats are temporarily removed.
[/olist]
[b]VII. Unlock Levels for Game Modes[/b]
Increased the unlock levels for some game modes and adjusted the unlock visualizations.

[b][h2]Showdown Adjustments[/h2][/b]
[b]I. Combat Adjustments[/b]
[olist]
[*] The pursuit ability and usage frequency of Iron Taifeng's four consecutive hammer strikes have been reduced.
[*] Removed fixed additional damage when calculating [Burn] damage while [Soaked].
[/olist]
[b] II. Showdown Scroll[/b]
In matches initiated with the Showdown Scroll, teammates are required to use Showdown Scrolls to obtain drop rewards for that match (including Souljade, Quench Crystal, etc.). Otherwise, they will not get the drop rewards.

[b]III. Souljade Adjustments[/b]
[list]
[*] [Thunder Surge]
Adjusted the effect of increasing ThunderShock based on Thunder-wielding levels. At higher Thunder-wielding levels, the ThunderShock accumulation speed remains mostly unchanged; at lower Thunder-wielding levels, the speed is appropriately reduced.
[*] [Storm Prison: Aegis-break]
Adjusted Aegis-break multiplier from 35 to 25 for Temulch's [Storm Prison: Showdown] Ultimate's concentrated strikes after equipping Souljade.
[*] Rare Attribute: [Scorching]
After a Counter, the effect of melee moves changes from "inflicting 6s of Burn with each attack within 10s" to "inflicting 18s of Burn with the next attack," with no change in damage per level.
[/list]
[b]IV. First Clear Rewards[/b]
Added first clear rewards for some stages, including new Souljades, Dynastic Treasure Choice Gifts, Legendary Display Bases, and more. If you have already cleared the stages, you can obtain these rewards immediately by entering the Showdown preparation interface after the update.

[b]V. New Showdown Souljades[/b]
New Showdown Souljades "Cloudscorch" and "Draco Stride" have been added in this update. Here are their specific effects:
[olist]
[*] Cloudscorch: Melee Charged attacks will inflict Burn on hit enemies.
[*] Draco Stride: After dodging, a wave is created, and hitting enemies will inflict Soaked on them.
[/olist]
[b][h2]Client Optimization[/h2][/b]
[list]
[*] Optimized and reduced memory allocation code in multiple areas to reduce game memory usage and improve frame rates.
[*] Continued optimization of runtime special effects resource management, further enhancing game performance in crowded or complex battles since the last update.
[/list]
[b][h2]Changes to some In-Game Names[/h2][/b]
We have renamed and re-translated some in-game names and stories to make them clearer. Here is the complete list of changes:
[b]I. Hero Skill and Ultimate Names:[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36350327/7ce248f0b9c9ae0c1a0fbadc10f1b59798166175.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36350327/dae20e026126744f3aea2fcaecdc5245ca3b9f4f.png[/img]
[b]II. Gameplay-related Items:[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36350327/4259a7ae58a8a1f63b376c0824bda718a632828b.png[/img]

[b]III. Cultivation Story [/b]
Tianhai's 4th cultivation story is revised to correct the mistranslated parts and wording based on his Chinese Story.

[b][h2]Store Updates[/h2][/b]
[b]I. New Packs[/b]
Newly added Takeda Nobutada exclusive Pack [Fighting Spirit], including Legendary outfit [Fighting Spirit Max], Legendary Hairstyle [Fighting Gold], Legendary Accessory [Max's Glasses] Standard price: 3,800 Gold; Now: 3,100 Gold.

[b]II. New Discounts[/b]
[olist]
[*] Newly added Tarka Ji Legendary Outfit [Dragon's Bane]. Standard price: 2,400 Gold; Now: 1,700 Gold.
[*] Newly added Dual Halberds Legendary Skin [Never to Return]. Standard price: 1,500 Gold; Now: 1,250 Gold.
[*] Newly added Legendary Gesture [Flutter·Left] for all heroes. Standard price: 400 Gold; Now: 300 Gold.
[*] Newly added Legendary Gesture [Flutter·Right] for all heroes. Standard price: 400 Gold; Now: 300 Gold.
[*] Newly added Kill Announcement [Benny High Five]. Standard price: 300 Gold; Now: 200 Gold.
[*] Newly added Takeda Nobutada Legendary Outfit [Fighting Spirit Max]. Standard price: 1,800 Gold; Now: 1,500 Gold.
[*] Newly added Takeda Nobutada Legendary Hairstyle [Fighting Gold]. Standard price: 800 Gold; Now: 600 Gold.
[*] Newly added Takeda Nobutada Legendary Accessory [Max's Glasses]. Standard price: 1,200 Gold; Now: 1,000 Gold.
[*] All Legendary items of [Untamed] and [Reckoning] seasons will be available again with their Arrival Discounts.
[/olist]

[b][h2]Bug Fixes[/h2][/b]
[b]I. Hero-related Bug[/b]
[olist]
[*] Fixed occasional abnormal attacks at the end of Zai's Ultimate.
[*] Fixed abnormal performance when Zai uses the [Chain Scythe: Afflict] Ultimate.
[*] Fixed an issue with Wuchen where the cancellation of the Yin Yang Orb encountered exceptions when his Rage was below the Teleport requirement.
[*] Fixed an issue where Wuchen can cancel his unleashing of ultimate without Rage cost.
[/olist]
[b]II. Weapon-related Bug[/b]
Fixed an issue where the second stage of Nunchucks' [Dragon Flurry] and [Dragon Roar] was unable to dispel sword energy.

[b]III. Battle-related Bug[/b]
Fixed the issues of the Grappling Hook under some special circumstances.

[b]IV. Profile-related Bug[/b]
Fixed the wrong calculation of collection points by [Sunrise Market] and [Coiled Dragon]. The correct collection points of [Sunrise Market] is 10, [Coiled Dragon] is 225.

notes.title: F2P FAQ | 2nd Anniversary
notes.content:
[h2]Free-to-play FAQ[/h2]
[h3]1)When will NARAKA go free to play and what exactly does this change mean? [/h3]

NARAKA: BLADEPOINT will go free to play on July 13, 2023. The server will go offline for maintenance at 2 p.m. PST that day.
After the maintenance, you can download the game from our website, Steam, Epic, Xbox, and PS5, and create a free account; then join us in Morus Isle—we look forward to meeting all of you! 

[h3]2)Why did you choose to go free to play? [/h3]

We want to make NARAKA accessible for as many players around the world as possible, so we're making it free to play. We hope that reaching this milestone will boost the game's popularity and help us reach an even wider audience!

[h3]3) What does the free version offer to players?[/h3]

All in-game content is available to free players, including all game modes, events, cosmetics, character customization, etc.

You can also purchase any of the Standard/Deluxe/Ultimate editions with gold in game which will grant access to new heroes more quickly.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36350327/4e1c5d01674d7426f805d47b1069a4ba3d7f6435.png[/img]

* Hero Coins are the currency used to purchase new heroes in NARAKA. There are a variety of ways in-game to earn them. New players will have a cap of 35 per week but those who wish to remove that limit can purchase any of our edition upgrades.

[h3]4)If I already have an account, do I need to take any steps before the transition?[/h3]

No, if you already have a NARAKA: Bladepoint account then you are all set. Simply login and continue playing.

[h3]5)What can I receive if I already own the game?[/h3]

Depending on the edition of NARAKA that you purchased you receive a set amount of Gold, and all editions receive the same items. You will receive 1960 Gold for Standard Edition, 3360 Gold for Deluxe Edition, and 4960 Gold for Ultimate Edition. In addition, all editions will receive an exclusive Avatar,  another exclusive Viper Ning outfit, and 10 Glory Chest Choice Gifts.
You will receive all items by in-game mail after the server maintenance on July 13. Remember to log in and claim your rewards before they expire on October 14.

[h3]6)What if I buy and play NARAKA Bladepoint between now and when it goes free to play. Do I get anything?[/h3]

If you purchase NARAKA and create a character during this period, you will be eligible for our existing players rewards:

●Gold based on the edition of NARAKA you have purchased
●An Exclusive Avatar
●10 Seasonal Chests
●A Legendary Weapon Skin
●Soul Bloom-themed Legendary Viper Ning Skin

[h3]7)Do I get to keep all of my items from playing NARAKA Bladepoint before?[/h3]

Yes, all of your account data and items will remain when NARAKA transitions to free to play.

[h3]8)If I refunded NARAKA on Steam, can I still receive the existing player rewards?[/h3]

Yes, as long as you purchase NARAKA on Steam again before 9 a.m. PST, July 13.
All data of the refund player will be cleaned at 9 a.m. PST, July 13.

[h3]9)Is NARAKA going to add features or have new content with free to play?[/h3]

NARAKA is a constantly evolving game, each season brings new heroes, cosmetics, and new discoveries to explore. Going free to play allows more players to join and share in our thrilling melee combat as they vie for the Mask of Immortality. 

[h3]10)Can F2P players team-up/match with existing players?[/h3]

Yes. 

[h3]11)Will you add pay-to-play content in the future?[/h3]

No. All game modes, weapons, heroes, and Souljades will be available to everyone for free.

[h3]12)Where can I play NARAKA Bladepoint?[/h3]

NARAKA: Bladepoint is available on PC (Steam, Epic Games Store, Official Website), Xbox, and PlayStation 5.


[h3]13)I have a NARAKA account on another platform, can I transfer to PS5?[/h3]

No, all NARAKA accounts are bound to the storefront and platform that the game was initiated on. This means that you cannot migrate your PC account to PS5 and similarly you cannot migrate your Epic Games account to Steam.

notes.title: NARAKA: BLADEPOINT Update – June 29th, 2023
notes.content:
[h1]Dear players,[/h1]

The servers of NARAKA: BLADEPOINT will be suspended for maintenance from June 28th, 2023 at 23:00 (UTC) to June 29th, 2023 at 03:00 (UTC). We suggest you log out in advance and enter the game again after the maintenance.

The details for this update are as follows:

[h2][b]Brand New Content[/b][/h2]

[b]I. Capture the Spirit Well Early Access[/b]

[previewyoutube=YpcgMfr_X6o;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]Story:[/b] 
Taking advantage of the heroes' victory over Omnius, the Psylith people, who had been suppressed for millennia, broke free from the prison island and initiated their retaliation against the Fervent disciples.

[u]1. Gameplay:[/u]
This is a battle between the Fervent and the Psylith factions for control over the Spirit Wells. Each faction consists of 12 players and is divided into 4 teams of 3 players each. Players on the same team cannot select the same Hero.

[u]2. Victory Conditions: [/u]
[list]
[*] Capture and maintain control of the 5 Spirit Wells on the battlefield to increase your faction's points. 
[*] The faction that reaches a total point of 1000 first wins the game. The result will be a draw if there is no clear winner.
[/list]

[u]3. Basic Rules: [/u]
[list]
[*] When defeated, you can open the map and choose to revive at your faction's Soul Altars. 
[*] In Capture the Spirit Well, players gain Dark Tide Coins over time. Additionally, capturing the Money Tree on the battlefield increases the Dark Tide Coins for your faction.
[*] Challenges to boost morale will appear periodically during the battle. You can get the corresponding rewards upon completing the challenges.
[*] You can spend Dark Tide Coins at the Rift Dealer on the battlefield to assemble powerful sets of equipment for yourself.
[*] When defeated you keep all your items, except for Extreme Souljades.
[/list]

[u]4. Other Rules:[/u]
[list]
[*] When there is a significant point difference between the factions, Bounty and Bodyguard Quests will be triggered. Pursuing or protecting the Bounty objective grants your faction a substantial points.
[*] In this mode, the effective range of Ziping Yin's Ultimate, [Saving Grace] and [Saving Grace: Aegis], is changed to 50 meters.
[*] Rift Dealer can now recommend suitable Souljades based on your current Primary Weapon and Secondary Weapon.
[/list]

[u]5. New Items[/u]
[list]
[*] A powerful Moonbane Charm item unique to the Capture the Spirit Well has been added: It has a shorter duration but greater potency.
[*] New Extreme Souljade items have been added to Morus' Blessing: Soulfire Blades, Shadow Eclipse, Annihilation Render, Moonbane's Wrath.
[*] New Souljade items have been added to the Rift Dealer: Warrior, Divine Form, Backfire, and Soul-drawing.
[/list]

[u]6. New Settings[/u]
[list]
[*] In Setting - Audio, "Omni's Nightmare Faction Voice Volume" is adjusted to "Faction Voice Volume". You can change the voice volume from your faction in Capture the Spirit Well and Omni's Nightmare modes.
[*] In Setting - Audio, "Capture the Spirit Well Voice" is added to switch the voice channel of your faction or team.
[/list]

[b]II. New Souljades[/b]
Extreme Souljades have been added for 4 weapons, with each having its own requirement for consumption of Ultimate Rage.
[olist]
[*] Soulfire Blades: [Dual Blades Skill] Grant Dual Blades a 3rd-stage vertical charged strike with enough Rage. Use vertical strike again while retrieving your Dual Blades to kick them out once more.
[*] Shadow Eclipse: [Dagger Skill] Grant Dagger a 3rd-stage horizontal charged strike with enough Rage, thrusting forth and leaving a marker. Can attack repeatedly, with its final blow launching another attack from the marker.
[*] Annihilation Render: [Greatsword Skill] Grant Greatsword a 3rd-stage vertical charged strike with enough Rage. Can attack repeatedly, and land an additional final blow.
[*] Moonbane's Wrath: [Longsword Skill] Grant Longsword a 3rd-stage horizontal charged strike with enough Rage. Enemies hit are marked. Can attack repeatedly, with its final blow stunning enemies.
[/olist]
Note: The above Souljades are only available in Capture the Spirit Well mode in the current game version.

[b]III. Zai's new Skill [Flame Ward: Firestorm] and Ultimate [Chain Scythe: Afflict] are now available[/b]
[previewyoutube=cboMsavYmnA;full][/previewyoutube]
[u]Skill [Flame Ward: Firestorm][/u]
[list]
[*] Zai transforms into [Flame Ward], entering aiming mode and cannot be hit.
[*] Then she dashes in the aimed direction, knocking nearby enemies airborne and burning them.
[/list]

[u]Ultimate [Chain Scythe: Afflict][/u]
[list]
[*] Zai switches her weapon to [Chain Scythe] which exists for 30 sec.
[*] Vertical and Horizontal strikes are changed into new attack ways.
[*] When charged strikes of [Chain Scythe] mark enemies twice, Zai can unleash [Splinter Soul] to attack the enemy.
[/list]

[b]IV. Brand-new system:Outfit Collection[/b]
[olist]
[*] When you get a cosmetic, the collection points will be increased. Once you reach the required amount, you can unlock a certification title.
[*] You can collect the single cosmetic or set to get [Romantic Mirror] for more collection points.
[*] Collecting the corresponding outfits, weapons, and accessories for ultimate and skills in the set can light up the set scroll.
[*] Collecting the set of cosmetics to earn Dynastic Treasure Choice Gift, Regular Treasure Choice Gift and more rewards.
[/olist]

[b]V. Limited-time event: The Herald's Duel[/b]
Event Time: From June 29th, 2023 Update to July 20th, 2023 at 20:00 (UTC)

[u]Event Info[/u]
The Herald's Duel is now available! Come experience a different mode of Showdown!
[olist]
[*] Tap the 'Join the event' button for the event.
[*] Use the cards to pass levels and win the mysterious reward: "Telluric Essence"!
[/olist]

[b]VI. Limited-time Event: Vein of Holoroth[/b]
Event Time: From June 29th, 2023 Update to July 13th, 2023 at 20:00 (UTC)

[u]Event Rules[/u]
[olist]
[*] During the event, log in daily and claim sign-in rewards - Vein of Holoroth Gift on the Daily Chest page.
[*] Gain Veinstones by completing quests during the event. Veintones can be used to redeem great event rewards.
[/olist]

[h2][b]Souljade Adjustments[/b][/h2]
[b]I. Souljade Adjustments[/b]
[olist]
[*] Health boost that [Health Souljade IV]'s provides is reduced from 25% to 24%.
[*] Melee resist that [Melee Resist Souljade IV] provides is reduced from 12.5% to 12%.
[*] Head defense that [Melee Resist Souljade IV] provides is increased from 15% to 16%.
[/olist]

[h2][b]In-game Adjustments[/b][/h2]
[b]I. Mechanism Adjustments[/b]
Optimized the collision volume of Scout Bells, addressing specific cases where they failed to trigger.

[b]II. Newly added Report Button to Martial Artist Solo[/b]
