notes.title: NARAKA: BLADEPOINT Update – June 1st, 2023
notes.content:
[h1]Dear players,[/h1]
The servers of NARAKA: BLADEPOINT will be suspended for maintenance from May 31st, 2023 at 23:00 (UTC) to June 1st, 2023 at 03:00 (UTC). We suggest you log out in advance and enter the game again after the maintenance.

The details for this update are as follows:

[h2][b]Brand New Content[/b][/h2]
[b]I. New Hero: Zai[/b]
[previewyoutube=Nyxbf3BRhGQ;full][/previewyoutube]

Zai's life is defined by pain and struggle. After a prophecy warned she would bring about great calamity, her parents sold her to human traffickers. 

She spent years in their hands before escaping to the Annica, an elite clan of assassins who recognized her potential for darkness and violence. 

They trained her to be the ultimate killing machine, and though she was denied the vengeance she initially wanted, she's found the next best thing: destroying everything good and pure in the world.
The third skill and ultimate are not yet available in this version. Once available, you can complete heroes' Cultivation Quests to unlock them. If you've completed the required Cultivation Quests before upcoming updates, the skill and ultimate will be unlocked automatically.

[b]II: New Feature: Spirit Well[/b]
Starting now, multiple Spirit Wells will spawn at the 240-second and 500-second marks in The Herald's Trial and BOT Mode. When you occupy one of them, you will receive an item that upgrades your main weapon or armor (excluding air-dropped weapons) to Epic quality.

[b]III: New Quest: Valiant Challenge[/b]
In Quick Match, The Herald's Trial, and BOT Mode, a new Valiant Challenge Quest Scroll has been introduced. Accepting the quest initiates the Valiant Challenge, which reveals the player's location to all non-friendly players on the map and periodically scans for non-friendly players within a specific range. If the challenger survives within the designated time, they will be rewarded with a large number of Dark Tide Coins.

When a player accepts the Valiant Challenge quest, they become the challenger, and non-friendly players become opponents. Opponents can track the challenger on the map, and defeating the challenger yields considerable rewards. Even assisting in the defeat will earn some Dark Tide Coins.

[b]IV. New Enigma Peak Levels in Showdown[/b]
In Showdown, when your sense level reaches 450, you can challenge the new Enigma Peak Levels, where the monsters have strengthened Health and Attack, and some of the Bosses' moves have changed.
In the Enigma Peak, Showdown Souljades drop by various kinds. If you defeat a certain number of Bosses in a single match, you can also receive rewards like Legendary Souljade Choice Gift, Thunder Essence, exclusive Hero Badge, Quench Crystal and so on.

[b]V: Map Updates[/b]
1. Optimized and iterated the spawn point of Inn of the Dunes, and enhanced resource allocation.

[b]VI. Limited-time Event: Unruly Blaze[/b]
Event Time: From June 1 Update to June 14, 2023 at 20:00 (UTC)

[u]Event Rules:[/u]
[olist]
[*] Complete daily quests to earn Ghoulish Lanterns and Soul Orders. Soul Orders can be redeemed for exclusive event rewards.
[*] Ghoulish Lanterns are used to refresh Underworld Register for random quests. Complete the quests to earn Reckoning Treasures and more!
[*] All players share the same Underworld Registers Quests and once you've completed one, it will not appear again.
[/olist]

[h2][b]Hero Adjustments[/b][/h2]
[b]I. Justina Gu[/b]
Adjustments have been made to the Rage consumption of [Arctic Wraith] and [Arctic Wraith: Blizzard] as follows:
[olist]
[*] Activating the Ultimate will consume 40% Rage, and the remaining Rage will not gradually deplete over time. The duration of the Ultimate remains at 30 seconds.
[*] Using [Shadowswipe] and [Shadowswipe: Blizzard] will consume Rage: 20%/30% in Solo and Duos, and 15%/30% in Trios.
[*] If [Shadowswipe] hits 2 enemies at the same time, the next [Shadowswipe] will not consume Rage.
[*] [Shadowswipe] and [Shadowswipe: Blizzard] will now have a 70% damage reduction effect.
[/olist]
[i]//Dev Notes: The benefits that Justina gains after activating her Ultimate now solely depend on the player's performance with Shadowswipe. In the current environment, we believe that the previous Rage consumption was somewhat high, especially in Solos. After the adjustment, Shadowswipe will now consume Rage, thus limiting its synergy with the Souljade [Soul Release]. However, it gains more flexible endurance through [Rebirth Blossom Spirit].[/i]

[b]II. Valda Cui[/b]
[olist]
[*] The duration of the [Nether Nightmare: Smite] Ultimate has been increased from 16 to 20 seconds, and the Protective Qi has been raised from 2000 to 2200.
[*] The startup frames of the water spear in [Nether Nightmare: Smite] have been significantly reduced to optimize the throwing experience. The number of times the water spear can be thrown has been adjusted from 4 to 3. Immune time after being freed from the [Dragon's Coil] is increased to 4 sec.
[/olist]

[i]//Dev Notes: Currently, Valda’s V2 Ultimate has a short duration after activation, making it difficult to exert its intended pressure. The use count and hit experience of the water spear also fall short of expectations. Therefore, we have extended the duration of the V2 Ultimate and optimized the throwing experience of the water spear to make it easier to hit enemies.[/i]

[b]III. Yueshan[/b]
[olist]
[*] [Rampage: Heaven's Descent] has been changed to [Rampage: Command]. This ability now attacks surrounding enemies and grants substantial health recovery, with a CD of 16 seconds.
[*] The duration of the recovery frames for [Dragontail] has been slightly shortened.
[/olist]

[i]//Dev Notes: Currently, Yueshan's V2 has limited utility and lacks effective recovery capabilities during combat. Therefore, we have made adjustments to V2’s skills and effects to provide Yueshan with a means of health recovery.[/i]

[b]IV. Viper Ning[/b]
The Recovery reduction effect of [Yushan Enigma: Enfeeble] now lasts for 7 seconds, down from 15, and its CD has been increased from 20 to 22 seconds.

[i]//Dev Notes: Viper Ning's F3 currently triggers opponents to confront and seek healing opportunities after being hit. However, the 15-second healing ban significantly limits this strategy. Therefore, we have reduced the duration of the healing ban and will closely monitor its performance.[/i]

[b]V. Akos Hu[/b]
[olist]
[*] The duration of the [Feral Frenzy] and [Feral Frenzy: Grab] Ultimates has been adjusted to 26 seconds in Solos, while it remains 35 seconds in Duos and Trios.
[*] The duration of the recovery frames for the airborne vertical strikes performed during the tiger leap state has been increased.
[*] The airborne horizontal strikes performed during the tiger leap state will no longer stagger targets under the effect of Ziping Yin's [Inspiration Shield].
[*] With the Talent Skill [Roar: Terror], targets under the terror effect can now pre-input commands while in a controlled state.
[/olist]

[i]//Dev Notes: Currently, Akos Hu can gain an advantage by utilizing a pounce attack after activating his Ultimate. While preserving the experience of his enhanced burst ability, we have adjusted the duration of Akos Hu’s abilities in Solos to balance his combat effectiveness against other heroes.
[Roar: Terror] is intended to primarily serve as a tool for focus firing in team modes, but currently, it also provides a strong advantage in initiating combat in Solos. Allowing pre-input commands while under the terror effect will enable players to react promptly once the terror effect ends.[/i]

[b]VI. Tarka Ji[/b]
[olist]
[*] The default duration for all of Tarka Ji's Ultimate talents will vary depending on the different game modes. [Blackout] and [Blackout: Vulcan] now last 24 seconds in Solos, while [Blackout: Frenzy] lasts for 20 seconds. The default durations of all Ultimate Talents in Duos and Trios remain unchanged.
[*] The Rage recovery efficiency of [Blackout: Frenzy] has been reduced by 35%, and the Attack boost for both the player and teammates has been adjusted from 10% to 5%.
[*] The Rage consumption of [Inner Fire] and [Inner Fire: Bide] while using [Blackout: Vulcan] has been reduced. The current Rage consumption for both abilities is now 20% across the board.
[/olist]

[i]//Dev Notes: Currently, Tarka Ji's exceptional durability, extended invincibility frames, and stamina make him excel in terms of survival, mobility, and damage output, surpassing most other heroes. Therefore, while preserving his core gameplay, we have adjusted the duration of Tarka Ji’s Ultimates across different modes and talents. This is to maintain a balanced combat pace and ensure fair matchups with other heroes.[/i]

[h2][b]Souljade Adjustments[/b][/h2]
[b]I. Move Souljades[/b]
Reduced enemies' staggering time caused by Souljade [Stormstride] when they are knocked down on the ground.

[h2][b]Weapon Adjustments[/b][/h2]
[b]I. Staff[/b]
[olist]
[*] Newly added Staff Souljade [Stanchion·Sky Pillar].
[*] Newly added Staff Souljade [Ocean Parter]. 
[/olist]

[b]II. Polesword[/b]
The damage multipliers of the 2nd stage of Torrent Flow have been adjusted from 3.42x2 to 3.2x2, and the damage multipliers of the 3rd stage of Torrent Flow have been adjusted from 2.81x3 to 2.61x3.

[h2][b]In-game Adjustments[/b][/h2]
[b]I. Shadow Corruption Pace Adjustment [/b]
We have made adjustments to the spreading pace of Shadow Corruption in Ranked Mode, Quick Match, and BOT Mode. The pace of the first 1-5 instances of Shadow Corruption has been accelerated, and a slight increase has been made to the size of the safe area after the first 1-3 instances of Shadow Corruption.

The Shadow Corruption pace for Duos and Trios has been adjusted as follows:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36350327/72ba0ecb2dc2683f68f17bcccce1a9b119a9c1b4.png[/img]

The Shadow Corruption pace for Solo has been adjusted as follows:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36350327/ab1eb02e2fcd868ab4825dce2ee288e115df390c.png[/img]

[b]II. Features Optimization[/b]
The current scene’s name is now displayed on the map.

[b]III. Others[/b]
[olist]
[*] The duration of Vermillion Bird's Might has been reduced from 210 seconds to 180 seconds.
[*] In response to the changes in the pacing of Shadow Corruption mentioned earlier, the refresh time of Morus' Blessing has been adjusted.
[*] During the preparation phase, the Melee Aim Assist and locking functions for players have been disabled.
[*] Optimized the timing of interrupting some Gestures.
[/olist]

[h2][b]Out-game Adjustments[/b][/h2]
[b]I. New Collection: [Talents][/b]
[olist]
[*] The original Accessory’s effect that changes the Skill Ultimate can now be freely equipped in the [Talents] tab under Collection. This allows you to select the appearance change for the corresponding Skill and Ultimate of the hero.
[*] The corresponding Accessories must still be obtained to unlock Skills and Ultimates.
[/olist]

[b]II. Hero Badge[/b]
Enigma Peak Hero Badge [Proficient Pathfinder] expanded the Extreme quality stage.

[b]III. Animation Played when Previewing Outfits and Weapons[/b]
[olist]
[*] Added animation of Zai when previewing her Extreme Outfit [Wandering Firefly].
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36350327/2a828bb47c835f76c6d6a0b9d08b160d95f3241e.png[/img]
[*]Added animation of Staff Extreme Skin [Journey of Blades·The Golden-Hooped Rod] with the officially authorized soundtrack " Dagger Group Prelude".
[/olist]

[b]IV. Voice Pack[/b]
A new voice pack feature was added for cosmetics. Unlock the voice pack to use it with the corresponding outfit. The following outfits automatically unlock their respective voice pack:
[olist]
[*] Akos Hu Legendary Outfit [Journey of Blades·Wukong].
[*] Yueshan Legendary Outfit [Journey of Blades·Yang Jian].
[*] Feria Shen Legendary Outfit [Journey of Blades·Purple Fairy].
[/olist]

[h2][b]Showdown Adjustments[/b][/h2]
[b]I. Combat Adjustments[/b]
The invincibility duration during the spawn animation of Stone Monsters and Corpse Monsters in Immovable and Enigma Domain has been shortened.

[b]II. Out-game Adjustments[/b]
A Sense grade prompt has been added to the loading screen in Showdown mode.

[b]III. Enigma Domain Adjustments[/b]
[olist]
[*] Boss monsters in Enigma Domain will no longer generate individual drops. In Enigma Domain, players will receive different amounts of Showdown Souljade/Quench Crystal drops based on the number of bosses defeated.
[*] Bosses in Enigma Domain will no longer be enhanced based on progress.
[*] The battlefields of some boss encounters in Eventide Temple and Shadowjade Mine have been adjusted to be more level and even.
[*] The spawn points of boss monsters near Lake Yellowleaf and Sunvale Dwelling in the Eventide Temple have been adjusted.
[*] The number of strongholds in the northern part of the main area in Shadowjade Mine has been reduced.
[/olist]

[b]IV. Hero Adjustments[/b]
[b]Valda Cui[/b]
[olist]
[*] After successfully using [Defuse Solve], the combo of horizontal strikes has been changed to [Dragonslayer].
[*] During the [Nezha] move, [Defuse Solve] can be released at any time by using vertical strikes. This change only applies to the [Showdown] mode and does not affect other modes.
[*] The damage multipliers of [Dragonslayer] + [Nezha's Might] have been adjusted from 4.26+0.85*2+1.25*2+1.63*2 to 1.41+0.42*2+0.53*2+0.69*2, and the Aegis-break damage multiplier has been adjusted from 1 to 7. The damage multiplier of [Heartstopper Kick] has also been adjusted from 5.02 to 1.88, and the Aegis-break damage multiplier has been adjusted from 1 to 7.
[/olist]

[i]//Dev Notes: The Spear’s unique move. [Nezha's Might] is rarely used in [Showdown] due to its long duration. Therefore, we hope to retain the weapon's distinctiveness while enhancing its versatility and maneuverability to offset the disadvantage of the move's lengthy duration. We have also shifted some of its damage to break Astral Aegis, in order to enhance its effectiveness when fighting with the Boss protected by Aegis.[/i]

notes.title: NARAKA: BLADEPOINT Update – May 18th, 2023
notes.content:
Dear players,
The servers of NARAKA: BLADEPOINT will be suspended for maintenance from May 17th, 2023 at 23:00 (UTC) to May 18th, 2023 at 03:00 (UTC). We suggest you log out in advance and enter the game again after the maintenance.
The details for this update are as follows:

Brand New Content
I. Limited-time Event: Dark Undercurrents
Event Time: From May 18, 2023 Update to May 31, 2023 at 20:00 (UTC)
Event Rules:
1. During the event, players can open Troves to get event-exclusive Thunder Cove Coins through the Ranked Mode, Quick Match, and BOT Mode. Up to 10 Thunder Cove Coins can be obtained per day (5 at most in one match), which can be used to explore the merchant ship during the event.
2. You can obtain special clues and random rewards by exploring the merchant ship.
3. Collecting special clues in the corresponding locations can unlock new explorable areas as well as clue stories and rewards.
4. After the event ends, you can claim clue collection rewards but can no longer explore the merchant ship.

Weapon Adjustments
I. Unified Adjustments for Melee Weapons
Reduced the stagger time caused by launching horizontal strikes while grappling with an enemy on the ground.
II. Unified Adjustments for Ranged Weapons
Added special sound effects when bullets pass through unattackable objectives.
III. Staff
Increased the attack range of charged vertical strikes, and changed the Focus level of the third attack from Blue Focus to Purple Focus.
IV. Spear
Widened the attack range of charged vertical strikes.
Combat Adjustments
Adjusted the damage calculation details when dealing with additional Armor (such as Feria Shen’s Bronze Mech’s Health and Valda Cui’s Protective Qi). Specifically:
1. You can gain Rage and deal damage normally when hit and deducting the Health of an enemy's Bronze Mech.
2. You can deal damage normally to Valda Cui when hit in her Ultimate state and reduce the amount of her Protective Qi.

Souljade Adjustments
I. Polesword Souljade
Reduced the knockback distance caused by the final hit of [The Overcomer].
II. Staff Souljade
1. Increased the attack range of [Jabbing], and the damage is increased from 4.78 to 5.04.
2. Optimized the special effects of [Merciless Havoc].

Out-game Adjustments
I. Treasure Pavilion
Past content can now be viewed in the Treasure Pavilion.
II. Personal Information
Adjusted the type of stats display for [The Bloodbath] mode.
Showdown Adjustments
I. Combat Adjustments
1. Optimized the timing of turning for certain attack moves of the Copperclad Staff and Copperclad Hammer.
2. Fixed the issue where [Condensed Qi] was ineffective when releasing charged moves at close range with a Longsword.
3. The Golden Focus attack moves of Greatsword and Polesword can now perform Stone Form against the Boss's Blue Focus attack moves.
4. The effect of [Silkworm Cocoon] can now be triggered when hit by Divine Thunder.
5. Yueshan is now able to use the [Defuse·Dash] when running out of energy.
6. Optimized the hit performance of Omnius·Aureate's Ultimate.
II. Level Adjustments
1. Added guidance marks for Stronghold Chests in the Eventide Ember at Easy difficulty.
III. Omens Adjustments
1. Adjusted the spawn locations for the Divine Strikes Omen in certain levels, and reduced the trigger range of Divine Strikes.
IV. Attribute Adjustments
1. Countering Divine Thunder with the [Thunder Counter] Souljade equipped now may trigger the rare effect of [Scorching]. The burn Damage Multiplier provided by each level of [Scorching] effect is adjusted from 0.72 to 0.36.
V. Sense Level
Increased the max level of Sense from 500 to 525.
VI. Showdown Souljade Storage
Increased the max capacity of Storage from 300 to 400.

Store Updates
I. New Pack

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36350327/d2ed3546599cf7bf4597b8b99bbdd203fe6f5a09.png[/img]

Newly added Yoto Hime exclusive Pack [Dancing Petals], including Legendary outfit [Dancing Petals], Greatsword Legendary Skin [Scarlet Chaos]. Standard price: 4,200 Gold; Now: 2,880 Gold.

notes.title: NARAKA: BLADEPOINT Update – April 27th, 2023
notes.content:
[b]Dear players,[/b]

The servers of NARAKA: BLADEPOINT will be suspended for maintenance from 04/26/2022 23:00 (UTC) to 04/27/2022 03:00 (UTC). We suggest you log out in advance and enter the game again after the maintenance.

The details for this update are as follows:

[h2][b]New Showdown Chapter[/b][/h2]
[previewyoutube=qYGv5aGGa2I;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]I. New Boss: Omnius·Aureate[/b]
Challenge the Aureate form of Omnius in the Celestra of the Morus Isle, there are new levels and new stories await!

More than 10 new "Thunder Omens" have been added in the Hard and Nightmare modes.

[b]II. New Hero: Yueshan[/b]
Overcome challenges in Showdown as the almighty general, with a new "Counter" skill. Counterstrike combo will be enhanced when equipped with an exclusive Souljade.

[b]III. New Feature: Souljade Recast[/b]
Epic and Legendary Showdown Souljades can be recast by consuming another Showdown Souljade of the same quality. After recasting, the attributes of the new Souljade will be randomly selected and combined from the consumed ones, and the values will be random (affected by the original attribute). After recasting, you can choose to keep the original attributes or accept the new ones generated by the recast.

If the number of attributes in the newly created Souljade is less than 4, there is a chance to get an extra attribute and possibly yield an additional powerful rare attribute. Please refer to Narakapedia - Showdown - Buffs - Rare Attribute for further details.

[i]//Dev Note: The attributes of the Showdown Souljades are a crucial part of the development of the Showdown. However, obtaining the desired attributes (and ideal values) through specific combinations of Souljdes has been overly random and difficult. Therefore, we have introduced the recast system to help players develop attributes in a more purposeful and enjoyable way.[/i]

[b]IV. Huge selection of new Showdown Souljades[/b]
The new version offers over 30 new Showdown Souljades to collect and enrich your game.
New elemental attribute [Thunder-wielding]: The Thunder strikes of Omens or monsters can accumulate a 'ThunderShock'. When it reaches its maximum, it will trigger a Divine Thunder that can cause electric shock and stagger effects.

When equipped with a Thunder-wielding Souljade, ThunderShock accumulates at a slower rate and can trigger Divine Strikes to attack monsters.

[b]V. Opening Hours[/b]
After this update, the Showdown will be open continuously from April 27th to May 7th (with no changes to daily opening hours). The weekend-only schedule will resume after May 7th.

[h2][b]Brand New Content[/b][/h2]
I. Limited-time Event: Cultivation Master
Event Time: From April 27, 2023 Update to May 10, 2023 at 20:00 (UTC)

[u]Event Rules:[/u]
[olist] 
[*] Each day, you may choose one of the two Cultivation Zones.
[list]
[*] Nether Abode: If you gain positive Scores in the ranked match, you will get a 25% Score bonus. (Diminish 1 Eurekas).
[*] Fiery Mountainside: If you gain negative Scores in the ranked match, your Scores deducted are halved. (Diminish 1 Eurekas).
[/list]

If you get 0 Score, it doesn't consume Eurekas.
You can choose only one type each day, and once chosen, it cannot be changed.

[*] You will receive 1 Eureka once you've made your choice.
[*] An additional Eureka is granted for each event quest you complete. These quests are in 7 groups and each is available in turn at different times. The next set of quests can be unlocked only after completing the former ones.
[*] Eurekas gained are valid for that day only. They do not carry over to the next day, so please use them in time.
[*] Complete more quests to win more great rewards.
[/olist]

[b]II. Limited-time Event: There! A Cabbage Dog![/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36350327/bde4b0da4f2af27de00ccca3b996100a2ff206e8.jpg[/img]
Event Time: From April 27, 2023 Update to May 24, 2023 at 20:00 (UTC)

[u]Event Rules:[/u]
[olist]
[*] During this event, sign in for 7 days in total to get rewards including limited-edition Accessory, and limited-edition Mark of Victory.
[*] Play the game "Dig! Cabbage Dog!" minigame to win rewards like crossover event-themed Bubble and Regular Treasure Choice Gift! 
[/olist]

[b]III. Limited-time Event: Immortal Wrath[/b]
Event Time: From April 27, 2023 Update to July 10, 2023 at 20:00 (UTC)

Earth shakes, mountains move: a glimmering torrent rushes forth to the Immortal's Temple of the Heralds' ancestors...

[u]Event Rules:[/u]
Gain Gild Seal by completing quests during the event to redeem great event rewards. 
Notice: Event quests only refresh when Showdown mode is available. But you can redeem rewards when it's closed.

[b]IV. Limited-time Event: The Phoenix Soars[/b]
[previewyoutube=LEdiEBKtb2E;full][/previewyoutube]
Event Time: From April 27, 2023 Update to May 17, 2023 at 20:00 (UTC)

Unchained, with the spirit of a phoenix! NARAKA: BLADEPOINT has joined hands with the Taishun People's Government of Wenzhou, Zhejiang province. Ms. Lan Xiaolu, an inheritor of the traditional She Ethnic Group culture, joins us in releasing the [She Ethnic·Phoenix Princess], a crossover series including Justina Gu outfit, avatars, and much more.

[u]Event Rules:[/u]
Find out more about the crossover event on the feature page, and watch our special crossover teaser: 'A Phoenix Returns to Roost'!


[b]V. New Season: Reckoning[/b]
The Untamed season will come to an end on April 27th, 2023 at 00:00:00 (UTC), and the rank of this season will be settled. Thank you all for your suggestions during the Untamed Season, we will work harder to bring a better gaming experience! 

The details of season rewards and the reset of scores are as follows. Players will be able to claim the rewards after the update of the new season. 

[u]Season Rewards:[/u]
Season rewards will be awarded based on the highest rank gained in The Herald's Trial (Solo, Duos or Trios) during the Untamed Season.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36350327/1032bcbd77c5fa9d330b2e2aa2381e727e3219cf.png[/img]

The Avatar rewards for the Asura and Unrivaled Asura ranks are differentiated by Solo, Duos, and Trios, and can be earned repeatedly across various game modes.

[u]Season Rewards:[/u]
Wuchen Epic Outfit [Alchemist Apparel·Stamp]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36350327/f2f8a459f91c0b7c57ef1600ce68b43aa3e5d02a.png[/img]
Legendary Musket Skin [Gilded Scorpion]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36350327/a0ba6ffb3f0697515ca4d68c06782d9448eedba6.png[/img]
Epic Background [Resounding Roar]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36350327/04f4947acd0a20d512c212323c0103a2f48486b7.png[/img]

[u]Score Reset[/u]
1. Scores in The Herald's Trial (Solos, Duos or Trios) will partially carry over to the new season.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36350327/93adc19e02d7d5206018fecec2ddd7978ae96105.png[/img]

2. Kill Score, Survival Score, and Hero Score will partially carry over to the new season, with a greater ratio being carried over for those with lower scores.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36350327/43fde8c5e5cc3c45a3261ca488805976135af783.png[/img]

Thanks to all for supporting NARAKA: BLADEPOINT and we value your feedback so much. The new season is coming, welcome to explore!

[h2][b]Hero Adjustments[/b][/h2]
[b]I. Akos Hu[/b]
[olist]
[*] Akos Hu is now immune to hit damage during the preparation stage of [Roar] before the shock takes effect. (Originally Akos Hu would get a 70% damage reduction.)
[*] Reduced [Roar: Blast]'s CD from 28 sec to 22 sec.
[*] Increased [Roar: Terror]'s CD from 20 sec to 25 sec. Slightly put off the time when Akos Hu can interrupt the shockwave and narrowed [Roar: Terror]'s effective range.
[*] During the ultimates [Feral Frenzy] and [Feral Frenzy: Grab], Akos Hu will get a 30% damage reduction during Tiger Leap and a 70% reduction while launching Pounce Strikes.
[*] Optimized the issue where [Feral Frenzy]'s tiger strikes would be blocked by low barriers.
[*] The chain binding effect of [Feral Frenzy: Lockdown] will no longer restrict players' interaction with teleport mechanisms.
[/olist]

[b]II. Valda Cui[/b]
[olist]
[*] Greatly reduced the startup frames of [Haze: Array]'s Tide Traps, changed the Skill's Focus to Golden, and adjusted its CD to 25 sec.
[*] [Nether Nightmare: Smite] now has the following new effects:
[list]
[*] Knocks back enemies and protects herself with Water Energy that lasts for 16 sec, during which she can launch water spear attacks repeatedly.
[*] Tap the Skill button to throw water spears with a binding effect to trap enemies with [Dragon's Coil] at a low height for 2 sec.
[*] Hold the Skill button to aim.
[*] Enemies hit by water spears will be inflicted with the [Soaked] effect. Bound enemies will get off the control after being attacked and get immune to [Dragon's Coil] for 3 sec.
[*] Enemies with Ultimate Focus can't be bound.
[*] [Soaked]: Decreases enemies' Attack by 5% for 10 sec, and immediately triggers all remaining [Burn] damage (Maximum 400).
[/list]
[*] After being bound by the Tide Traps of [Haze] and all its derived Skills, enemies will get immune to Bind for 2.5 sec.
[list]
[*] [i]//Dev Notes: Valda Cui's [Haze: Array] was hard to play a part in combats for various reasons. Therefore, we have lowered its threshold to ensure it can produce stable effects. So, we have redesigned [Nether Nightmare: Smite] to make Valda Cui's combat skills more flexible.[/i]
[/list]
[*] The protection of [Nether Nightmare] and all its derived ultimates will no longer decay over time. Now it has a fixed duration for different skills:
[list]
[*] The protection of [Nether Nightmare] can last for 15 sec at most;
[*] The protection of [Nether Nightmare: Bind] can last for 12 sec at most.
[/list]
[*] Removed Valda Cui's performance of being teleported in the air during [Nether Nightmare] and [Nether Nightmare: Bind].
[*] Reduced [Haze]'s CD from 15 sec to 18 sec.
[/olist]

[b]III. Viper Ning[/b]
[olist]
[*] Adjusted the Defense Focus of [Yushan Enigma: Lockdown] from Blue to Golden.
[*] Adjusted the related performance of [Yushan Enigma: Enfeeble]:
[list]
[*] Upgraded the Focus level of  [Yushan Enigma: Enfeeble], from interrupting common attacks to interrupting golden Focus strikes.
[*] Increased the Damage Multiplier of from 1.0 to 3.5 and the hit effect has been changed to knock airborne.
[*] Increased CD from 15 sec to 20 sec. 
[/list]
[/olist]

[b]IV. Kurumi[/b]
Now Kurumi can cast [Sacred Circle: Rapid Healing] when attacked.

[b]V. Tianhai[/b]
Increased the Attack Focus of Vajra skills under all Ultimate Talents. Now it can interrupt golden Focus strikes instead of common attacks.

[b]VI. Tarka Ji[/b]
Now after Tarka Ji casts his ultimate, he will perform a 1st stage dodge after getting up from the ground.

[i]//Dev Notes: There were inconsistencies in the rules governing Tarka Ji's actions when he got up after being knocked down, which occasionally resulted in unexpected performance. Therefore, we have standardized the rules for getting up to ensure that both Tarka Ji and his enemies can understand the moves more precisely.[/i]

[h2][b]Weapon Adjustments[/b][/h2]
[b]I. General Adjustments[/b]
[olist]
[*] Slightly advanced the interruptible time point for all weapon repair.
[*] Slightly put off the timing for dodge after switching weapons in mid-air.
[/olist]

[b]II. Polesword[/b]
[olist]
[*] Slightly increased the recovery frames after the 1st stage charged [Torrent Flow]. Slightly shortened enemies' stagger time. Reduced the Damage Multiplier from 6.14 to 5.33.
[*] Reduced the Damage Multiplier of the 1st stage charged [Wave Breaker] from 5.22 to 4.7.
[*] Optimized the motion of follow-up strikes of [Torrent Flow].
[/olist]

[b]III. Spear[/b]
[olist]
[*] Slightly adjusted the hit performance of horizontal strikes and the 2nd vertical strikes to airborne objectives, to chain the strikes of the two stages more smoothly.
[*] Slightly shortened the startup frames of [Dragonslayer].
[*] Increased the Damage Multiplier of [Dragonslayer] from 2.51 to 3.53; Reduced the Damage Multiplier of [Nezha] from 4.64 to 3.62.
[/olist]

[i]//Dev Notes: The Spear's precise charged strikes and follow-up combos are often affected by complications in the battlefield, resulting in unstable effects. We have therefore adjusted the damage distribution of the moves to increase the efficiency of its output.[/i]

[b]IV. Staff[/b]
[olist]
[*] Slightly adjusted the hit performance of horizontal strikes and the 2nd stage vertical strikes to airborne objectives, to chain the strikes of the two stages more smoothly.
[*] Added the absorption effect to [Heaven Uproar].
[*] Now [Stanchion·Rising Cloud] will knock back enemies instead of knocking them airborne when they stand.
[/olist]

[h2][b]Souljade Adjustments[/b][/h2]
[b]I. Buff Souljade[/b]
Optimized the sound effect of [Stormstride Sword] and [Stormstride] when they hit enemies.

[b]II. Spear Souljade[/b]
[olist]
[*] Slightly reduced the start-up frame of [Heartstopper Kick].
[*] Increased the Damage Multiplier of [Heartstopper Kick] from 1.81 to 3.53
[/olist]

[b]III. Polesword Souljade[/b]
Reduced the Damage Multiplier of [Blistering Edge]'s 1st stage from 4.38 to 3.94.

[h2][b]In-game Adjustments[/b][/h2]
[b]I. BOT Mode Adjustments[/b]
Increased AI opponents' use frequency of blue Focus Strikes at the Easy level.

[b]II. Team's Info Page[/b]
Added a switch to block the in-team chat channel.

[b]III. Training Ground Adjustments[/b]
Combined Rift Dealers on Training Ground and added category tabs to display items of different types.

[h2][b]Out-game Adjustments[/b][/h2]

[b]I. New Option Added[/b]
1. Added the option of Auto-Switch Weapon after being Countered to Settings-Game-Combat. When it's on, the system will help players equip the first melee weapon in Weapon Bag automatically after being Countered or Disarmed.

[i]//Dev Notes: We added the option to make sure players can toggle to spare weapons quickly in combats after being Countered. It can be turned on or off in Combat.[/i]

2. Added the option of Sort by Pick Up in Weapon Bag to Settings-Game-Combat. When it's on, players can drag weapons in their Weapon Bags to sort them freely. By default, weapons in Weapon Bags will be sorted by the time they are put in.

[b]II. Personal Info Page Upgrade[/b]
[olist]
[*] A brand-new interface is applied.
[*] Added stats display of more game modes. (Some data will be reset due to a lack of history.)
[*] Players are allowed to customize which game mode is displayed by default.
[/olist]

[b]III. Adjustments to the unlocking requirements of some Features and Gameplay[/b]
[olist]
[*] Now players can unlock Custom Room at Level 2.
[*] Now players can unlock RANK at Level 20.
[/olist]

[b]IV. Hero Badge[/b]
1. Added new levels to Hero Badges including [Cotton Finery] and [Formidable Cache].

[b]V. New Videos[/b]
[olist]
[*] Outfits
[list]
[*] Added CG videos for [She Ethnic·Phoenix Princess], [Longmen·Flying Immortal], [Huaxia Armors·Qin Epithet], and many other outfits.
[/list]
[*] Battlepass
[list]
[*] You can now play introduction video for the current Season on the battlepass interface.
[/list]
[/olist]

[b]VI. Season Settlements[/b]
[olist]
[*] Season Rewards
[list]
[*] Added season reward interface. Check it in Reckoning-Season Rewards.
[/list]
[*] Season Stats
[list]
[*] Added season stats to Shadow Surge mode
[/list]
[/olist]

[h2][b]Showdown Adjustments[/b][/h2]

[b]I. Levels[/b]
[olist]
[*] Adjusted the recommended Sense levels of some stages to streamline the gaming experience in Showdown.
[*] Meanwhile, we have reconstructed the unlocking hierarchy of levels. Following the update, certain levels may be locked until players complete their prerequisite stages.
[/olist]

[b]II. Monsters[/b]
Optimized the window of clashing with Thunderspawn, Bindspawn, Cursespawn.

[b]III. Hero[/b]
[olist]
[*] Slightly increased the damage multipliers of Tianhai's ultimate:
[list]
[*] Vajra: increased the damage multipliers of melee grab from 1.5 to 2.
[/list]
[*] Slightly increased the damage multipliers of Ground Stomp:
[list]
[*] Increased the damage multipliers of Ground Stomp (with one enemy in hand) from 5 to 7.5.
[*] Increased the damage multipliers of Ground Stomp (with two enemies in hand) from 12 to 18.
[/list]
[*] Increased the damage multipliers of counterstrike combo when equipping with [Titan's Call·Soul Seeking] from 16 to 18.
[*] Increased the base health of Vajra from 3000 to 6500.
[*] Increased the armor conversion rate for Tianhai transforming into Vajra from 100% to 160%.
[/olist]

[b]IV. Omens[/b]
Slightly lowered the Luck provided by Omens.

[b]V. Enigma Domain[/b]
Weakened monsters at strongholds near the main area of Eventide Temple.

[b]VI. Showdown Souljade Drops[/b]
[olist]
[*] Increased the drop probability of high-quality Souljades and proportion of Legendary Showdown Souljades in non-Enigma Domain stages of Showdown.
[*] Lowered the drop probability of high-quality Souljades in Enigma Domain stages of Showdown.
[/olist]

[i]//Dev Notes: There was a far higher drop probability of high-quality Souljade in Enigma Domain than in other stages, which means that it was extremely hard for players who preferred non-Enigma Domain stages to get high-quality Souljades. Therefore, we have balanced the drop probability for two types of stages to improve players' gaming experience.[/i]

[b]VII. Showdown Souljade[/b]
[olist]
[*] Added the Recommended Souljade Set
[list]
[*] Players can use the recommended Souljades sets provided by developers or popular Souljades set among players through the button Recommended. With one tap and you can quickly auto-equip the sets.
[/list]
[*] [Quick Charge]
[list]
[*] Increased the Damage Reduction Multiplier of the Pistol's charged shots from 15% to 25%.
[/list]
[*] [Assassin's Lunge]
[list]
[*] Decreased the Damage Multiplier from 3.17+0.35*3 to 2.38+0.26*3.
[/list]
[*] [Quick Attack]
[list]
[*] Decreased the Attack Bonus Multiplier from 20% to 15%.
[/list]
[*] [Detonating Rounds]
[list]
[*] Decreased the Damage Multiplier of delayed explosion from 1.15 to 1.
[/list]
[*] [Scattershot Enhance]
[list]
[*] Decreased the Damage-Rage Transformation Multiplier by 30%.
[/list]
[*] [Bounce Shell]
[list]
[*] Increased the Damage Boost Multiplier of shells from 10% to 15%.
[/list]
[*] [Crossbow Augmentation]
[list]
[*] No more reduction on bullet damage
[/list]
[*] [Warrior]
[list]
[*] Increased the duration from 3 sec to 5 sec.
[/list]
[*] [Heavy Sword Sap]
[list]
[*] Increased the Damage Multiplier from 11.37 to 13.38.
[/list]
[/olist]

[b]VIII. New and Removed Effects[/b]
Showdown Souljades now have 14 brand new attributes and 3 new rare ones. The new Showdown Souljades will not change the following attributes:
[list]
[*] Attributes related to the range and speed of the Grappling Hook;
[*] The initial health and health loss speed of Cairns.
[*] Health after rebirth, etc.
[/list]

[b]1. New Attributes[/b]
[olist]
[*] Damage Boost of Melee Weapons:
[list]
[*] The damage of specific melee weapons' strikes are boosted. Damage boost attributes of different melee weapons repel each other when they are generated, but cause no impacts when they are recast. (For example, "Longsword Damage Bonus" and "Katana Damage Bonus" won't be simultaneously generated.)
[/list]
[*] Damage Boost of Ranged Weapons:
[list]
[*] The damage of specific ranged weapons' strikes are boosted. Damage boost attributes of different ranged weapons repel each other when they are generated, but cause no impacts when they are recast. (For example, "Cannon Damage Bonus" and "Repeating Crossbow Damage Bonus" won't be simultaneously generated.)
[/list]
[*] Charged/Non-charged DMG to Aegis Bonus
[*] Ice Blast/Divine Strikes Damage Bonus
[*] Increase DMG to Boss/Non-Boss monsters
[*] Reduce DMG taken from Boss/Non-Boss monsters
[*] Vitalia/Armor Powder Recovery Bonus
[*] Counter/Defuse trigger Recovery
[*] New Rare Effects
[list]
[*] [Windfall]: increases the possibility of extra sub-attributes of the Souljade.
[*] [Moderation]: reduces Skills' CD by a percentage after dealing elemental damage.
[*] [Scorching]: enables melee strikes to inflict the burning effect of different levels on enemies after Counter.
[/list]
[*] Elemental Effect Adjustments
[list]
[*] Reduced base Damage Multipliers of Ice Blast from 2 to 0.58.
[*] Increased damage bonus provided by every Ice-wielding level from 17% to 100%.
[*] Damage provided by 6-level Ice-wielding remains relatively consistent before the updates.
[*] Sense Level
[/list]
[/olist]
Increased the max level of Sense to 500.

[Reckoning] BATTLEPASS is now available, which includes a variety of valuable items and skins! Players can obtain more rewards by unlocking the Advanced Hidden Treasure! You can get a Treasure Scroll at the price of 1200 Gold and a Glory Scroll at 2840 Gold.

notes.title: NARAKA: BLADEPOINT Update – April 13th, 2023
notes.content:
[b][h1][h2]Dear players,[/h2][/h1][/b]
 
The servers of NARAKA: BLADEPOINT will be suspended for maintenance from Apr 12th, 2023 at 23:00 (UTC) to Apr 13th, 2023 at 03:00 (UTC). We suggest that you log out in advance and enter the game again after the maintenance.
 
The details for this update are as follows:
 
[h2][b]Brand New Content![/b][/h2]
[previewyoutube=RVRnWZixxWo;full][/previewyoutube]
[b]I. [/b][b]Akos Hu's new Skill [Roar: Terror] and Ultimate [Feral Frenzy: Lockdown] are now available![/b]
[b]1. Skill [Roar: Terror][/b]
Akos roars like a tiger, unleashing a continuous shockwave towards the aimed direction. Deal damage and [Terror] enemies, making them unable to move.
[list]
[*] When affected by [Terror], enemies will be immune to further [Terror] effect after being attacked or when the effect ends.
[*] During the shockwave, Akos can stop it at any time.
[/list]

[b]2. Ultimate [Feral Frenzy: Lockdown][/b]
Create a banner array that lasts for 15 sec, chaining enemies to the banner.
[list]
[*] The chain pulls back enemies who struggle to escape, but can only take effect twice.
[*] Relocation skills (excluding Wuchen's Teleport) are disabled while chained to a banner.
[*] [Lunge] towards the aimed direction. Can be used 3 times.
[*] [Lunge] at a banner to climb on it and launch a Tiger-Claw Scale Rush in Golden Focus.
[/list]
[Lunge] at a banner can be used under attack.

[h2][b]II. Map Updates[/b][/h2]
With the advent of spring, peach and pear flowers at Pool of Cleansing on The Morus Isle have bloomed. Go and enjoy the springtime.
 
[h2][b]III. Justice Chamber Optimizations[/b][/h2]
1. The max initial number of Justice Chamber members has been expanded to 15.
2. Added the level system to Justice Chamber, which now can rise to a maximum level of 20 by accumulating experience. The activeness points of the Justice Chamber will be transformed into equal experience.
3. New contents added to Justice Chamber Store, unlock more rewards with the levelling up of Justice Chamber.
4. More benefits will be unlocked with the increase of Justice Chamber's level, such as a higher upper limit of members, more Justice Coin rewards, advanced Justice Store, account experience bonus, intimacy bonus and Showdown luck bonus.
 
[h2][b]IV. Clash League[/b][/h2]
[b]1. Rules: [/b]
[u]1) Basic Rules[/u]
Same as the rules of NARAKA: BLADEPOINT official tournaments.

[u]2) Time[/u]
Available Time: From Apr 12, 2023 at 20:00 to Apr 26, 2023 at 6:00 (UTC).
[list]
[*] NA Server: 1:00 - 3:00 (UTC) every day
[*] EU Server: 19:00 - 21:00 (UTC) every day
[*] AS Server: 12:00 - 14:00 (UTC) every day
[*] SEA Server: 13:00 - 15:00 (UTC) every day
[/list]
Redeem Reward: From Apr 12, 2023 at 20:00 to May 2, 2023 at 20:00

[u]3) Stage[/u]
[list]
[*] The games are divided into Preliminary, Semifinals and Finals stages.
[*] Scoring 6.0 or higher in a single game of preliminary advances the participants to the semifinals, and scoring 6.0 or higher in a single game during the semifinals advances the participants to the finals.
[/list]

[u]4) Rounds[/u]
[list]
[*] A round ends when you fail to advance or complete the finals.
[*] You will start over from preliminary after a round ends.
[/list]

[u]5) Reward[/u]
[list]
[*] Get League Coins based on the survival time and individual scores for the round. Use League Coins to redeem for rewards in the Redeem store.
[*] As the clash league ends, players can get extra rewards according to their Justice Chamber Total Score.
[*] Advancing to Finals or winning in the Finals unlock exclusive Hero Badges.
[/list]

[u]6) Matchmaking Rules:[/u]
[list]
[*] Only chamber members playing in the same stage can join the game together.
[*] Cannot fill party.
[/list]
 
[b]2. Score Rules: [/b]
[u]1) In-match Score[/u]
In-match Score = Ranking Score + Eliminates by the Team*Ranking Multiplier
*Eliminates: A player being killed to Death (one's Cairn runs out of Health with or without Rebirth chance) is regarded as an Eliminate.

[u]2) Round Score[/u]
Round Score is the sum of all game scores within the round.

[u]3) Justice Chamber Total Score[/u]
Justice Chamber Total Score is the sum of all members' in-match scores gained in the chamber.
 
The ranking coefficient and ranking score according to different rankings are as follows:
 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36350327/a6fd697a3605462db9372c07305c7257b659fbc3.png[/img]

[h2][b]Hero Adjustments[/b][/h2]
[b]I. Feria Shen[/b]
1. Optimized the performance of Bronze Mech's jump by adding a jet propulsion effect to its back.
 
[b]II. Akos Hu[/b]
1. Now his Pounce and other Tiger-claw Strikes will no longer be triggered when equipped with ranged weapons.
 
[b]III. Valda Cui[/b]
1. Optimized the hit determination of [Nether Nightmare] and [Nether Nightmare: Smite]'s Great Wave.
 
[h2][b]Weapon Adjustments[/b][/h2]
[b]I. Spear[/b]
1. Slightly relaxed the restriction on [Dragonslayer]'s perfect use timing.
 
[b]II. Staff[/b]
1. Slightly relaxed the restriction on [Stanchion·Rising Cloud]'s perfect use timing.

[h2][b]In-game Adjustments[/b][/h2]
[b]I. Feature Optimizations[/b]
1. Adjusted some of the maps where players can select spawn points in Holoroth.
2. Optimized the display of tips on the loading screen. Besides, certain unnecessary tips will be filtered out according to players' use of input devices (keyboards and mice/controllers).
 
[b]II. Mechanism Adjustments[/b]
1. Dandelions can now be picked up repeatedly. They will regrow after all have been picked in every area.
 
[b]III. BOT Mode Adjustments[/b]
1. Decreased the possible Hero types that AI opponents will use at the Easy level.
2. Now AI opponents have a chance to yield Legendary Souljades, especially at the Easy level.
 
[b]IV. Realm of Yang[/b]
1. Removed Realm of Yang from Quick Match Mode of The Herald's Trial.
(Ranked Mode and BOT Mode remain unchanged.)
2. Adjusted the number of first-round Morus' Blessing in Quick Match Mode of The Herald's Trial back to two (2).
 
[h2][b]Out-game Adjustments[/b][/h2]
[b]I. New Settings in Custom Room[/b]
1. In Custom Room, you can turn off Shadow Corruption settings in the Ranked Mode.
2. In Custom Room, you can Ban Grappling Hook in all modes.
3. In The Bloodbath mode, you can now toggle the settings as following: Restore Health and Armor upon defeating, restore weapon durability upon defeating, remove Biding Fury upon defeating, block Morus' Blessing and Souljade Rift Dealer.

[b]II. Cross-rank Team Up Restrictions[/b]
In the Duos and Trios modes of the Herald’s Trial, matchmaking fails if the rank gap between team members exceeds two major ranks. For instance, if the lowest-ranked player in the team is Gold, they can only join teams with players of Solar rank or below.

[i]Dev Notes: We’ve implemented this team-up restriction to prevent the huge gaps that may arise within a party. This way, players can enjoy a fair and balanced gameplay experience.[/i]

[b]III. Team Up[/b]
Cross-rank restriction rules will be imposed on the upper and lower limits of the recruitable players when creating teams in Ranked Mode.
 
[b]IV. Optimizations of Illume Project 2674 Event [/b]
1. Slightly raised the volume of the event page's BGM.
2. In some of the dialogues, the options that have been chosen will be marked.
 
[b]V. The In-Game Wiki: Baizepedia is ready now![/b]
1. Baizepedia will include such official content as tutorials, weapon introductions and hero walkthroughs to help beginners learn about and get familiar with all kinds of techniques.
2. Players can access Baizepedia on such pages as Hero, Weapons and Training Ground to check whatever they need.
3. After each match, Baizepedia will recommend the most suitable walkthroughs to players based on their performance, proficiency in using the chosen Heroes and rank scores.
Baizepedia will be continuously updated in the future to cover more content such as Showdown. Please wait and see!
 
[h2][b]Showdown Adjustments[/b][/h2]
[b]I. Enigma Domain Adjustments[/b]
1. Narrowed the alert range of all monsters in Enigma Domain to make players less detectable.
2. This round of Enigma Peak has been extended to April 23.
 
[h2][b]Feature Optimizations[/b][/h2]
[b]I. Client[/b]
We will optimize the performance of multi-threaded disk reading to gradually reduce game stuttering caused by resource loading, thus improving game fluency.

[h2][b]Store Updates[/b][/h2]
[b]I. New Packs[/b]
[previewyoutube=5nIgZ9ljgrs;full][/previewyoutube]
[olist]
[*] Newly added Justina Gu Exclusive Pack [Frost Drift], including Legendary Outfit [2674·Frost Drift], Dagger Legendary Skin [2674·Shiver], Legendary Accessory [2674·Visor], and Epic Hairstyle [Lab Specialist]. Standard price: 5,000 Gold; Now: 3,200 Gold.
[*] Newly added Viper Ning Exclusive Pack [Digital Serpent], including Legendary Outfit [2674·GasViper] and Legendary Hairstyle [Freelance Hacker]. Standard price: 2,600 Gold; Now: 1,850 Gold.
[/olist]


[b]II. Added New Discounts[/b]
[olist]
[*] Newly added Staff Legendary Skin [2674·Plasma Saber Mk II]. Standard price: 1,500 Gold; Now: 1,250 Gold.
[*] Newly added Justina Gu Epic Pose [2674·Bio-Tech]. Standard price: 500 Gold; Now: 350 Gold.

[*] Newly added Viper Ning Epic Mark of Victory [2674·Yushan Group]. Standard price: 1,200 Gold; Now: 750 Gold.

[*] Newly added Justina Gu Legendary Accessory [2674·Visor], comes with Justina Gu Legendary Gesture [2674·Mini Workshop]. Standard price: 1,200 Gold; Now: 1,000 Gold. 
[*] Newly added Viper Ning Legendary Hairstyle [Freelance Hacker]. Standard price: 800 Gold; Now: 650 Gold.
