notes.title: NARAKA: BLADEPOINT Update – October 24th, 2022
notes.content:
Dear players,

The servers of NARAKA: BLADEPOINT will be suspended for maintenance from 10/23/2022 23:00 (UTC) to 10/24/2022 03:00 (UTC). We suggest that you log out in advance and enter the game again after the maintenance. 

The details for this update are as follows:

Brand-new content!
Ⅰ. A New Episode of Showdown
The sand and dust are lifted into the air by the eerie winds at the Shadowjade Mine, and in that veil of sand are the figures of the Eagle and the Grey Wolf.
From October 28th, Showdown will be available for a limited time on every Friday, Saturday and Sunday. In [Eventide Temple] and the new episode [Shadowjade Mine], heroes are gathering to confront the Herald's Boss, Omnius, along with his servants who appear as the first time.
1. New Hero Joined: Matari, Temulch
Matari and Temulch are now on the list to face the new challenges in Showdown.
2. Sense Level System
(1) When playing Showdown, there's a chance of getting Showdown Souljade (can't be shared among team members). Equip Showdown Souljades for heroes to grant them more powerful and diversified skills.
(2) Hero Sense Level equals the average of the levels of equipped Souljades. If the Hero Sense Level is lower than the recommended level, you'll cause less damage to the monsters while taking more damage from them. On the contrary, you'll cause more damage while taking less damage from them when with higher sense level.
(3) Enhance the Souljade to raise its sense level. As the Sense Level increases, heroes will gain extra attribute bonus.
3. Omens
In Hard and Nightscream levels, Omens will randomly appear every time you start a new match. There will be new challenges, along with more powerful Souljades that can enhance Weapon and Hero-exclusive Skills.
4. Doom
Complete certain levels and the event [Shadow of Dust] to unlock Doom mode, where stronger Omens that can't be seen in other modes will occur. Once completed, there's a chance of getting Legendary weapon skin [Flaming Ash·Burning], Legendary Showdown Souljades and titles by topping the rank of Racing Leaderboard.

II. Time-limited Event: Autumn Chill
Event time: 10/25/2022 16:00 (UTC) to 11/10/2022 16:00 (UTC)
Event Details:
1. Several Halloween Specters pop up during the preparation stage. Try grasp one!
2. Looting troves in the battle grant chances to obtain [Candy]. Each player can gain up to 5 Candies in every match and up to 8 per day.
3. If a player has 2 or more Candies in the match, one [Candy] will drop along with the weapon when being countered.
4. At the start of each round, an advanced reward can be selected as the special reward for this round. This selection is irreversible.
5. Complete event quests to get corresponding numbers of [Candy Bucket] and [Candy]. Send [Candy Bucket] to other players and you both get [Candy] (with extra Candy when sending Candy Bucket to friends). Use [Candy] to redeem event rewards of the current round.
Duration of each round:
First Round: 10/25/2022 16:00 (UTC) to 11/02/2022 16:00 (UTC)
Second Round: 11/02/2022 16:00 (UTC) to 11/10/2022 16:00 (UTC)

III. Time-limited Event: Shadow of Dust
Sand in the air, and crisis within. 
Event time: 10/27/2022 20:00 (UTC) to 11/21/2022 20:00 (UTC)
Event Rules:
1. Complete Event Quests for [Dust Emblem], and use [Dust Emblem] to redeem exclusive event rewards. 
2. Complete any mode of Showdown to earn your individual points. Getting full points to claim individual rewards.
3. Clearing any mode of Showdown to earn whole-server points. Getting full points can unlock [Doom Mode]. Participate in it and there’s a slight chance to get the Legendary weapon skin [Flaming Ash·Burning].
*Note: Event quests can be refreshed only when the Showdown mode is open. At other times, you can redeem rewards only.

Hero Adjustments
Ⅰ.Kurumi
Adjusted the recovery amount of Kurumi's Ultimate [Sacred Circle: Rapid Healing] from 500 Health + 500 Armor to 750 Health. The additional Health recovered will be converted to Armor. 

II. Ziping Yin
1. Weakened the effect of Ziping Yin's Skill [Aromatherapy: Embrace] in Solo Mode. 
Adjusted to: Triggers [Inspiration Shield] if the player is attacked within 8 seconds (12 seconds in Duos/Trios Mode) after the player absorbed Spiritual Energy, lasting 5 seconds (8 seconds in Duos/Trios Mode). The effect ends in advance after taking 450 damages. 
2. Adjusted the effects of Inspiration Shield for Ziping Yin's Skills [Aromatherapy: Embrace] and [Aromatherapy: Protection]. 
Inspiration Shield now cannot negate the freezing effects of Justina Gu's Ultimate [Arctic Wraith] [Shadowswipe], the airborne effect of Temulch's Skill [Zephyr Wisp] and the stagger effect of being smashed by Vajra. 
//Dev Note: Inspiration Shield makes Ziping Yin escape easily in Solo Mode. Therefore, we decreased its duration and threshold of damage taken. 
3. Adjusts Ziping Yin's Ultimates 
(1) Adjusted the basic Recovery effect per second of [Saving Grace] from 35 Health + 30 Armor to 45 Health. The additional Health recovered will be converted to Armor. 
(2) Adjusted the basic Recovery effect per second of [Saving Grace: Aegis] from 30 Health + 30 Armor to 35 Health. The additional Health recovered will be converted to Armor. 
//Dev Note: Ziping Yin's Ultimate [Saving Grace] takes effect slowly, continues for a long time, and won't cost all Rage immediately after casting. Therefore, we made it more flexible to cast. It used to recover both Health and Armor simultaneously, which inevitably made players tend to cast it when they had low Health or Armor. Therefore, we adjusted the recovery mechanism to stabilize the benefits gained from casting it. 

III. Yoto Hime
Increased the Rage required for Yoto Hime's all Ultimates from 25% to 40%, and decreased the Rage required for each slash from 25% to 20%.  

Ⅳ. Valda Cui
1. Decreased the Immune time after the Horizontal Strike of Valda Cui's Ultimate [Nether Nightmare: Bind] water spear hits the enemies from 3 to 1 second. 
2. Optimized the movement performance of Valda Cui after unleashing [Nether Nightmare] and [Nether Nightmare: Bind] sea dragon. 

V. Takeda Nobutada
Increased the cooldown of Takeda Nobutada Ultimate's derived skill [Demonic Strike·Havoc] from 3 to 4 seconds. 

VI. Tarka Ji
It costs less Energy for Tarka Ji to cast ultimate [Blackout], other talents, and 2nd stage Dodge.

Souljade Adjustments
Ⅰ. Longsword Souljade 
Optimized the move of [Zodiac Sorrow]. 

In-game Adjustments
I. Feature Optimizations 
Added quick collecting Soulbloom Essences in nearby Cairn. If there are Soulbloom Essences in any Cairn nearby, click the certain button will collect them quickly.

Ⅱ. Combat Adjustments
Optimized Quick Counter 

II. Controller Adjustment
1. Added tips for equipping slots when selecting items. 
2. Optimized tips for alternative weapons in the weapon bag.
3. Displayed items nearby in columns. Weapons and Souljades are in separate columns.

IV. Added Shortcut for Moonbane Charm 
Tapping Alt+Z on the keyboard (For controllers, tap RT (XBOX) / R2 (PS) after selecting Moonbane Charm in the radial menu) will unleash Moonbane Charm centered on the player directly, instead of opening the map first. 

V. Mechanism Adjustments
1. Spikes will be triggered immediately when the player enters its range. 
2. Removed the limit of using Forbidden Seal mechanics. 

VI. Hero Cultivation Adjustments
Matari's Yin Yang Mastery stage cultivation quest "Defeat 3 enemies with Bloodrippers" is changed to "Defeat 5 enemies with Flamebringer". 

VII. BOT Mode Adjustments 
1.Temporarily turned off the Nightscream level, the AI opponents will continue learning and come back again with better skills.
2.Adjusted the behaviors of AI opponents at the Easy level and lowered the difficulty appropriately. 
Out-game Adjustments
I. Hero Badge 
1. Added the Hero Badges of Showdown, Shadow Surge, and Through the Fire. 
2. Optimized Profile Display. 

II. Hero Info 
Clicking "Collection" on the Hero interface will access "Closet" instead of "Outfit". 

III. Hidden Treasure
Added tips of available Advanced Hidden Treasure rewards accumulated so far when collecting Hidden Treasure when the player has not purchase Advanced Hidden Treasure.

Ⅳ. Hero Voice 
Optimized some of Temulch's lines and his tone. 

Ⅴ. Cosmetics for all 
Added “Cosmetics for all” on the Hero interface. Click “Interface” to access the preview interface of “Kill Announcement” 

VI. Customization
Changed the ordering of some heroes’ default faces.
Feature Optimizations
Ⅰ. Client
1. Optimized the loading efficiency of the weapons to reduce the game lagging. 
2. Cleared redundant data to save memory. 

Store Updates
Ⅰ. New Packs
Added Tarka Ji Exclusive Pack [Nezha the Conqueror], including Tarka Ji Legendary Outfits [Ill Omen], Legendary Spear Skin [Blastburn Spear], Legendary Pose [Nezha·Soar], Legendary Backgrounds [Nezha·Break], and Legendary Base [Nezha·Transform]. Pack standard price: 6,000 Gold; Now: 4,200 Gold.

II. Added New Discounts
1. Newly added Legendary Accessory [Zhurong's Jadeball]. Standard price: 4,600 Gold; Now: 3,050 Gold.
2. Newly added Takeda Legendary outfit [Spring Blossom]. Standard price: 1,800 Gold; Now: 1,500 Gold.
3. Newly added Takeda Legendary Pose [Fast Blade]. Standard price: 800 Gold; Now: 560 Gold.
4. Newly added Ziping Yin Legendary Pose [Shivering]. Standard price: 800 Gold; Now: 560 Gold.
5. Dagger Legendary skin [The Breaker·Myriad Edge]. Standard price: 1,500 Gold; Now: 1,250 Gold.

Ⅲ. Spectral Silk Store Updates
Newly added Epic Kill Announcement [Thunderous]. Standard price: 4,000 Spectral Silk.

Ⅳ. Discounts End
1. Katana Legendary skin [Gale's Edge] has returned to its standard price of 1,500 Gold.
2. Epic Background [Sunshine Waters] has returned to its standard price of 200 Gold.
3. Epic Base [Summer Beach] has returned to its standard price of 400 Gold.
4. Wuchen Legendary Outfit [Incompletion Robe] has returned to its standard price of 1,800 Gold.
5. Yueshan Legendary Outfit [JTeam·Mountain Shaker] has returned to its standard price of 1,800 Gold.

Bug Fixes
1. Fixed a bug where the dodge effect of the 1st and 2nd stages failed to display in a few cases after casting the ultimate [Blackout]. 
2. Fixed a bug where the recovery frame of some blue Focus can be interrupted by grappling.
3. Fixed a bug where grappling hook cannot lock on heroes on the ice surface.
4. Fixed a bug where the dodge after successful counterstrike combo of [Dagger Sap] was not Dagger Dash.

notes.title: NARAKA: BLADEPOINT Update – September 29th, 2022
notes.content:
Dear players,

The servers of NARAKA: BLADEPOINT will be suspended for maintenance from 09/28/2022 23:00 (UTC) to 09/29/2022 03:00 (UTC). We suggest that you log out in advance and enter the game again after the maintenance. 

The details for this update are as follows:
Brand-new content!
Ⅰ. Ziping Yin
Her new skill [Aromatherapy: Protection] and ultimate [Saving Grace: Gauze] are available to unlock now.

II. Map Updates of Holoroth
1. Brand-new area: Boomerang Cliff
There has been something wrong with Yushan Ruins recently. The thick iceberg is becoming loose with its edge gradually melting. When the ice is melting, a new place where players can move around takes shape on the left of Yushan Ruins, called Boomerang Cliff. A dangerous mountain road leads to the area, in the middle of which currents of chill air are blowing. Be careful and don't fall off.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36350327/db44eb34c3b56e72a03ac77137d195124d1f9967.png[/img]

III. Time-limited Nightscream BOT Mode is now available
In Nightscream BOT Mode, AI opponents are more skillful than in the Hard level, and won't attack each other actively. Besides, Rebirth will remain usable till the end of the third Shadow Corruption. Come challenge them with your skill and wisdom!
Nightscream BOT Mode is a time-limited mode. We'll continue to train AI opponents and will reopen it someday.

Ⅳ. Brand-new Event: Mystery of Plumed Castle
Glory once belonged to the Plumed Castle before the downfall of Holoroth. There was the great eagle-like castle stretching to the sky, and the mysterious treasuries housing world's fortunes. But all were annihilated with the doom of Holoroth. All there left were the broken wings of the Falcon Statues, and the floating stones with strange force. Now Holoroth is confronted with desert bandits wreaking havoc, power division and faith loss to the once gloried Aquila. There, people struggle to make a living.
Event Time: 09/29/2022 update – 12/10/2022 20:00 (UTC)
Event Rules: 
1.During the event, the theme of the preparation phase is changed to the Auspicious Clouds Celebration. Up-currents from specific clouds can help players jump higher! You can pick up [Crystal Stones]> in the scene of the preparation stage, or get them by looting gold and green Troves in the match, with a maximum of 10 every day. 
2.Consume [Crystal Stones] to randomly unlock a location on the event page. You'll get corresponding rewards after unlocking all locations in an area. There are 7 areas in total waiting to be unlocked. 
3.The first match of Nightscream Bot Mode every day earns you 1 [Doom Smasher Giftbox]. Every [Doom Smasher Giftbox] must contain 1 [Crystal Core], which can be used to unlock a designated location. Besides, you can get more rare rewards randomly from [Doom Smasher Giftboxes].
4. Participating in the external event [Forerunner GO!] can also get you [Crystal Stones] and [Crystal Cores]. Besides, you can also obtain [Dawn Treasure] and Event-limited Avatar from it.
5.After all 7 areas are unlocked, you can still use [Crystal Stone] and [Crystal Cores] on the event page to get Tae and Spectral Silk awards.

Hero Adjustments
I. Tianhai
1. When casting [The Divine Bell] and all its Skill Talents, Tianhai is immune to debuffs. But those taken effect before casting the skill will not be affected.
2. Increased the Damage Multiplier of [Ground Stomp] from 10 to 12 when Tianhai grabs two enemies in the transformed state of all Ultimate Talents.

II. Wuchen
When Wuchen is casting [Tai Chi Rift] and all Ultimate Talents, players now can press the Ultimate button to turn off Aim.

III. Valda Cui
Improved her ability to interrupt the Focus grade by her water spear when casting [Nether Nightmare] and [Nether Nightmare: Bind], now she can interrupt the golden Focus strikes. 

IV. Temulch
1. Changed the airborne effect of Temulch's [Zephyr Wisp] and all his Talents to the Control effect (can ban the skills that can be cast when under attack, but can be broken by attacks with stagger effect) and optimized the performance of the action.
2. Adjusted the Ultimate [Zephyr Prison] and all his Talents. Now when Zephyr Prison takes shape, enemies in it will be imposed with the [Slowed] effect.

V. Yoto Hime
Decreased the flying/staying time of [Spirit Slash: Vortex] from 5s/5s to 3.5s/3.5s.

VI. Viper Ning
1.Viper Ning's [Yushan Enigma] can now be used while under attack and can interrupt golden Focus strikes, and the cooldown has been adjusted to 25 sec.
2.When casting [Twilight Crimson: Unchained], Viper Ning will get a 40% damage reduction.

VII. Other Adjustments
Optimized the prompt effect of some skills when the target is beyond their range.

Weapon Adjustments
I. Longsword
1. Slightly shortened the startup frames of Longswords' charged attacks.
2. Extended the duration that players can perform combos after charged attacks.

II. Spear
1. Extended the stagger time after Horizontal Strikes while sprinting, running and standing.
2. Decreased the Damage Multiplier of Airborne Horizontal Strikes from 2.01 to 1.6.

Ⅲ. Greatsword
Optimized the special effect of the second Horizontal Strike.

Souljade Adjustments
I. Longsword Souljade
Added a new Legendary Souljade: [Hepta-Detach].

In-game Adjustments
I. Combat Adjustments
1. Greatly increased players' sliding duration and max distance on the ice in Snowy Peaks.

II. Holoroth Map Adjustments
1. Increased the resources in Inn of the Dunes, Jade Pass, Altar of Tranquility, and Emberhawk.

III. Holoroth Mechanism Adjustments
1. Players can trigger the Spikes by hitting them instead of triggering them passively. The CD of triggering was decreased to 5s.
2. Added a wide-range Silence effect to Ghostly Hands after they are triggered. The Silence duration was adjusted to 8s.
3. Expanded the hit radius of the Cactus to 10m.
4. Shortened the time needed to set a Trap Clip to 1s.
5. Shortened the blinding time of Sand Konjac to 5s.
6. Adjusted the refresh locations of Spikes, Frost Moth and Trap Clip.
7. The Ballistas at the bottom left and bottom right of Plumed Castle now are refreshed randomly.

IV. Weather System Adjustments
1. Optimized the occurrence time and duration of weather at each stage.
2. Renamed "Sandstorm" as "Howling Gale", where players' ability to run toward a wall and the max range of Grappling Hook will be improved.

V. Feature Optimizations
Added the See-through effect when your teammates are blocked. (You can turn on the feature in Settings - Assist Settings - Ally See-through Effect.)

VI. BOT Mode Adjustments
Adjusted the behaviors of AI opponents at the Easy level in BOT Mode and lowered the difficulty appropriately.

VII. Omni's Nightmare Adjustments
1. Hero Echo: Explosive Shot can take effect on ranged weapons only.
2. Adjusted the airborne distance and recovery frames of Evil-Ents' Charged Horizontal Strikes.
3. Revised some expressions of in-game prompts.

Ⅷ. Spectating Adjustments
After being defeated in the Survival Modes, Killer’s info page will be shown to player automatically. You can manually close it, or it will be automatically closed as you start spectating.

Out-game Adjustments
I. Hero Badge System
1. You can check completed and ongoing phases for each Hero Badge on the Hero Badge Page.
2. Added a new Hero Badge: [Veteran].

II. Friend List Optimization
Now displays the last online time of your close friends.

III. Settlement Page Optimization
Now players can check Hero Badges and the progress of quests on the settlement page.
Ⅳ. Optimized Match History
1. Added Damage stats into the Match History Interface.
2. Rank in Match History will be shown as party rank after all party members are defeated.  
3. Added Match Details into The Herald's Trial mode, where players can check detailed stats of the match.
4. You can now view other players' Match History.
5. Added "Battle Stats Setting" under "Settings-Social Settings-Privacy Settings". You can choose whether to make your Match History public.
6. Damage stats of matches before this update will not be provided. We are sorry for any inconvenience.

V. BGM Adjustments
1. Added the song "From The Ashes" by JJ Lin to Lobby BGM.
2. Replaced the BGMs in the Hero Cultivation Page of Viper Ning, Matari, Valda Cui, Justina Gu and Ziping Yin.

Feature Optimizations
I. Client
1. Improved the efficiency of loading action resources in combats to further reduce the memory usage of actions. 
2. Reduced the memory usage of weapons in combats.
3. Fixed the stuttering caused by the shift of weathers in Holoroth Map.
4. Optimized some Outfit resources to reduce CPU time.

Store Updates
Ⅰ. New Packs
1. Added new Justina Gu Exclusive Pack [Summer Snowflakes], which includes Justina Gu Legendary outfit [Summer Party·Summer Snowflakes], Justina Gu Epic Pose [Piacevole], Justina Gu Legendary Accessory [Summer Party·Sunhat]. The Pack's standard price: 3,500 Gold; Now: 2,600 Gold.
2. Added new Viper Ning Exclusive Pack [Rosy Meridiem], which includes Viper Ning Legendary outfit [Summer Party·Rosy Meridiem], Viper Ning Epic Pose [Cozy]. The Pack's standard price: 2,300 Gold; Now: 1,750 Gold.
3. Available on October, 12th: Matari Exclusive Pack [Aureate Spoondrift], which includes Matari Legendary outfit [Summer Party·Aureate Spoondrift], Matari Epic Pose [Surfing]. The Pack's standard price: 2,300 Gold; Now: 1,750 Gold.

II. Added New Discounts
1. Added new Katana Legendary Skin [Gale's Edge]. Standard price: 1,500 Gold; Now: 1,250 Gold. 
2. Added new Epic Background [Sunshine Waters]. Standard price: 200 Gold; Now: 160 Gold.
3. Added new Epic Base [Summer Beach]. Standard price: 400 Gold; Now: 320 Gold.
4. Wuchen Legendary Outfit [Incompletion Robe]. Original price: 1,800 Gold; Now: 1,500 Gold.
5. Yueshan Legendary Outfit [JTeam·Mountain Shaker]. Original price: 1,800 Gold; Now: 1,500 Gold.

III. Discounts End
1. Tianhai Legendary Accessory [Operatic Legend·Crown]  has returned to its original price of 1,200 Gold.
2. Valda Cui Legendary Accessory [Summer Party·Teashades] has returned to its original price of 1,000 Gold.
3. Tianhai Legendary Pose [Operatic Legend·All Existence] has returned to its original price of 900 Gold.
4. Tianhai Legendary Accessory [Longmen·Stone Statue] has returned to its original price of 4,800 Gold.
5. Tianhai Legendary Accessory [Longmen·Gargoyle Glow] has returned to its original price of 900 Gold.
6. Dagger Legendary Skin [The Breaker·Myriad Edge] has returned to its original price of 1,500 Gold.
7. Katana Legendary Skin [The Breaker·Dazzling Sun] has returned to its original price of 1,500 Gold.
Bug Fixes
I. Weapon-related Bugs
Fixed an issue where the hit range and special effect of Nunchucks' Scale Rush didn't match.

II. Omni's Nightmare-related Bugs
Fixed an issue where Evil-Ent Lord could be stuck at Ballistas.

III. Hero-related Bugs
1. Fixed an issue where Kurumi may link to a target outside the range when using her skill [Binding Prayer].
2.Fixed an issue where Temulch may replay the ultimate animation after casting it already.

notes.title: NARAKA: BLADEPOINT Update – September 15th, 2022
notes.content:
Dear players,
The servers of NARAKA: BLADEPOINT will be suspended for maintenance from 09/14/2022 23:00 (UTC) to 09/15/2022 03:00 (UTC). We suggest that you log out in advance and enter the game again after the maintenance.

The details for this update are as follows:
Brand-new Achievements System
I. Added a new Achievements System--Hero Badge
Their heroic legends shall echo across the plains for all eternity.
1. You can complete different Challenges to get Hero Badges, which will level up as the progress goes on.
2. You can check the conditions for reaching each stage via Profile-Achievement-Hero Badge.
3. At the same time, you will be accumulating Hero Badge Points to obtain rewards including legendary weapon skins, avatars and Dynastic Treasure Choice Gifts.
4. Hero Badges obtained can be equipped on the Personal Info page.

Hero Adjustments
I. Kurumi
The [Cleanse] effect of Kurumi's skills and ultimate, and such gameplay settings as Cascade now can remove debuffs only. [Ban] effects like "Dodge Banning" and "Sprint Banning", etc., cannot be cleansed any more.

II. Ziping Yin
1. [Aromatherapy] and [Aromatherapy: Embrace] now will produce an extra Health recovery effect when their effects are imposed to allies. (Previously, you got the effect only when an ally was directly hit.)
2. Increased the basic Recovery effect of [Saving Grace] from "30 Health/s and 20 Armor/s" to "35 Health/s and 30 Armor/s".
The extra Recovery effect was decreased from 30% to 20%.
Constant Rage consumption was decreased. (The duration with full Rage was increased from 20 sec to 24 sec.).
3. [Saving Grace: Aegis]'s basic recovery effect remains unchanged, but constant Rage consumption was decreased. (The duration with full Rage was increased from 12 sec to 16 sec.).

Ⅲ. Tianhai
Optimized the performance of some of Vajra's actions.

IV. Other Adjustments
Now the explosion effects (if with) of bullets can be triggered as usual when they hit Tianhai's [The Divine Bell] and Justina Gu's [Ice Core].

Weapon Adjustments
I. Greatsword
Slightly shortened the stagger caused to enemies when performing Airborne Horizontal Strikes with the Greatswords.

In-game Adjustments
I. Adjustments to Hero Changing Process in The Bloodbath.
1. In Solos, you'll get 5 more sec to finish your operation as long as you open the Hero Replacement page within the 5-sec countdown of rebirth.
2. In Duos and Trios, when the 5-sec countdown of the rebirth of the whole team begins, the original page will be closed automatically. You'll get 5 more sec to finish your operation as long as you open the “Change Hero” page during the 5-sec countdown.

II. Adjustments to Through the Fire
1. Players now can get bounties for the completion of Bounty Quests in Through the Fire.
2. Team's spawn location was changed from a random location to a fixed one. Signs of teams' flags were added to the scene.
3. The quality of initial equipment was changed from Common to Rare. Rift Dealer's equipment and the price were adjusted for better balance.

III. Mechanism Adjustments
1. Decreased the cooldown of Scout Bell from 120 sec to 60 sec and removed the max number of uses.
2. Adjusted the duration of disperse-the-Chill buff from Campfires to 240 sec.

IV. Spawn Point Adjustment
Adjusted some of the selectable areas of spawn points in Holoroth.

V. Bot Mode Adjustments
1. Optimized the behavioral pattern of AI opponents in combats greatly and adjusted the difficulty.
2. The deployment of AI opponents now is based on players' difficulty selection only, instead of their Rank scores.

VI. Cairn Adjustment
Added a new form of performance to Cairns without soul.

Out-game Adjustments
I. Feature Tag for Talent Descriptions
Added Feature Tags to Talent descriptions of all Skills and Ultimates for all Heroes.

II. More Hero Information Can be Showed
1. Added Hero Ability Radar, which can show Heroes' general rating in terms of Survival, Damage, Control, Motility and Support.
2. Added Hero Difficulty Rating.

III. Justice Chamber Adjustment
Added the Exit feature for members of Justice Chamber. Now players can leave by themselves or be removed by the Chamber owner.

IV. Free Training Adjustment
In the Free Training mode, all of Rift Dealer's items now are sold in groups.

Ⅴ. Friend List Optimizations
1. Now friend requests will expire automatically in 3 days.
2. Extended the expiration time of recent teammates to 3 days.

VI. Now Extreme Weapon Skins can be equipped with special effects.
Players now can equip owned Extreme Weapon skins of the same type with special effects.

VII. [Longmen·Gargoyle Glow] Special Effect Adjustment
1. The form effect of "Vajra" changed by equipping Tianhai Accessory [Longmen·Gargoyle Glow] will be carried over by a new Legendary Accessory, [Longmen·Stone Statue]. Equipping [Longmen·Gargoyle Glow] will no longer alter the look of "Vajra" in Tianhai's ultimate.
2. [Longmen·Stone Statue] is now available in shop, along with a price adjustment to [Longmen·Gargoyle Glow].
3. For players who purchased [Longmen·Gargoyle Glow] before the updates, please kindly check your email to receive the new accessory [Longmen·Stone Statue] for free.

VIII. Out-game Inventory
Expanded the max capacity of players' Inventory to 300. Optimized Inventory display so that there will not be too many blank slots.
2. Changed the ordering rule to auto ordering for better user experience.
Feature Optimizations
I. Client
1. Optimized action loading speed and memory usage.
2. Optimized the memory usage of in-game drops, Ornament and the Grappling Hook.
3. Optimized the performance of some areas of Holoroth.

Shop Updates
I. Season Exclusive: Dawn Treasure Available Now
Dawn Treasure sells for 360 Gold. When opening it, you will have a chance to get Ziping Yin's Extreme outfit [A Chinese Ghost Story·High Heavens], Greatsword Extreme skin [Scorching Sun] and other rewards.
Minimum Guarantee
1. Players are guaranteed to receive at least 1 Red (Extreme) reward during the process of opening at most 100 Treasures. This can be triggered multiple times.​
2. Red (Extreme) rewards will not be repeated until all of them have been obtained.

Wishing Legendary Reward
Whenever you draw an Extreme cosmetic, you'll have a chance to set a Legendary cosmetic, which will be guaranteed when you draw a Legendary cosmetic next time. Times of guarantee can stack, but you can only have 1 cosmetic set each time.

II. Item Adjustment in Shop
1.Adjusted the transform effect of [Longmen·Gargoyle Glow], please refer to the Out-game Adjustments for more details.
2.[Longmen·Gargoyle Glow] will no longer alter the look of "Vajra" after the adjustment. Standard price: 900 Gold; Now: 750 Gold.

notes.title: NARAKA: BLADEPOINT Update – September 1st, 2022
notes.content:
Dear players,
The servers of NARAKA: BLADEPOINT will be suspended for maintenance from 08/31/2022 23:00 (UTC) to 09/01/2022 03:00 (UTC). We suggest that you log out in advance and enter the game again after the maintenance.
The details for this update are as follows:

Brand-new content!
I. New modes for Holoroth Map
1. Holoroth is added to Shadow Surge. When Shadow Surge opens, one of the maps will be available for the week, and it will switch to another when the next Shadow Surge opens (The map pool will only include Holoroth for the time being before regular rotation between The Morus Isle and Holoroth);
2. Holoroth is added to The Bloodbath. Choose the map you wish for matchmaking in The Bloodbath, and you can enter the game faster if you choose a random map match.

II. Preparation Phase
The preparation phase has been decorated for the upcoming Mid-Autumn Festival. We wish all players a Mid-Autumn reunion beneath a bright moon!

III. Limited-time Event [United Once More]
Event Time: 09/01/2022 update – 09/14/2022 20:00 (UTC)
Event Rules: Gain Jade Rabbit Lamps by completing quests during the event. Jade Rabbit Lamps can be redeemed for great event rewards including Ziping Yin’s legendary accessory [Petal Hossu], Ziping Yin’s Epic outfit [Silk Dress·Cyan], Viper Ning’s Epic accessory [Duo Dragon·White], Justina Gu’s Epic accessory [Duo Dragon·Green], Dawn Treasure, etc. Tap the task link to the Sunwing Relics page and immerse yourself in the wonders of The Legend of the White Snake.

Hero Adjustments
I. Ziping Yin
1. Optimized the special effects of adding [Sedate Soul], which is now clearer;
2. The recovery effects of [Saving Grace] and [Saving Grace: Aegis] will be immediately triggered once when added.

II. Valda Cui
Valda Cui's skill [Haze], ultimate [Nether Nightmare] and all its talent variants will attach the [Soaked] effect to the enemy hit.
[Soaked]: Decreases enemies' Attack by 5% within 10 sec, and immediately triggers all remaining [Burn] damage with a cap.

III. Kurumi
1. [Sacred Circle: Water] will attach [Soaked] effect to Enemies in it; the debuff will last for 10 sec after leaving the circle.

IV. Takeda Nobutada
1. Optimized the special effect of [Demonic Strike Havoc]. Now its movements are clearer.
2. Optimized the sound effect of common and purple [Demonic Strike Havoc] strikes.
3. Optimized the hit of common and purple [Demonic Strike Havoc]. The sprint takes melee and ranged phases. Now a player will not be hit before being reached by the Furen.

V. Unified Optimization for Talent Skill Descriptions
1. Extra brief descriptions are added to all Talent Skills. Tap [ALT] on your keyboard or [Y] on your controller to switch versions.
2. Optimized the content of all Talent Skill descriptions.

In-game Adjustments
Ⅰ. Combat Adjustments
1. Fixed an issue where Counterstrike fails even with the red flash of light.
2. Optimized the animation of the Katana Souljade [Stamina Strike].
3. The [Burn] effect is divided into 4 types based on its source: [Weapon] (Flamebringer), [Souljade] (Infernal Slash, Fire Arrows, etc.), [Mechanism] (Flaming Cages, Ballista, etc.), [Hero] (Tarka Ji, Kurumi's fire circle), only one [Burn] effect will be triggered in each type at the same time.

II. Adjustments to Holoroth map
1. Several location names are added to Holoroth to facilitate team communication and strategy-making.
2. Adjusted the location of the green and golden Troves in Empyreal Village, City of Tang and Mehtaab for more regular distribution.
3. Adjusted the hit range of Thorny Roller to make it more reasonable visually.
4. Optimized and added some ambient sound effects.
5. The animals now leave footprints.

III. Adjustment for Duos
1. Adjusted the max number of players in the Duos mode of The Herald's Trial and Quick Match from 60 to 48;
//Dev Note: 30 teams led to overcrowding players on the map in Duos mode. It was too likely for players to engage in multi-team combat;

IV. Mode Optimization
Optimized the cliff of Through the Fire. Now players knocked airborne have more chances to get back to the combat.

V. Bloodsport Adjustment
Jade Pond is added and some locations are removed or adjusted.

VI. Combat BGM
Wild combat BGMs are added to all 5 main regions in Holoroth.

Out-Game Adjustments
Ⅰ. Custom Room Adjustments
1. You are now free to customize the spawn location in Holoroth for The Herald's Trial in Custom Room. Try it and be creative;
2. Holoroth map is now available for The Bloodbath in Custom Room.

II. Bot Mode
The "Easy" difficulty is added to Bot Mode. All difficulties are adjusted to make them in line with expectations.

Feature Optimizations
I. Client
1. Reduced game stuttering when opening the Bag.
2. Reduced game stuttering when generating pickable objects and mechanisms in a scenario.
3. Reduced game stuttering by optimizing audio CPU and memory usage.
4. New setting in Graphics: "Light".
     (1) Options: The " Light" option is divided into four grades: Low, Medium, High and Highest.
     (2) Description: "Medium" light quality is the same as in the previous game versions; "Low" is a simplification of the scene material performance to reduce GPU pressure; "High" and "Ultra High" enable the global lighting effect in the screen space to improve the detailed shading performance.
     (3) Default Setting: To maintain your current experience, the light quality will be set as "Medium" if your graphic quality preset is "Medium", "High", "Highest" or "Custom", and as "low" if your preset is "Low" or " Lowest". You can adjust the light quality to meet your needs.

Ⅱ. In-game Adjustments
1. Adjustment to Score Settlement
Reduced the correction to the score settlement for matches ‘With Ease’ and ‘Quite Challenging’.

Ⅲ. Out-game Adjustments
You will be notified when purchasing an item included in a pack and can navigate directly to purchase the pack.

Shop Updates
I. New Packs
1. Added Justina Gu’s exclusive pack [Operatic Lady·Viridian], which includes Justina Gu’s Legendary outfit [Operatic Legend·Madam Green Snake], Justina Gu’s Legendary hairstyle [Green Skies]. The Pack’s Standard price: 2,600 Gold; Now: 1,850 Gold.
2. Added Viper Ning’s exclusive pack [Operatic Lady·Pearl], which includes Viper Ning’s Legendary outfit [Operatic Legend·Madam White Snake], Viper Ning’s Legendary hairstyle [Pure Moon]. The Pack’s Standard price: 2,600 Gold; Now: 1,850 Gold.

II. New Discounts
1.Added Justina Gu’s Legendary Pose [Operatic Legend·Phoenix]. Standard price: 900 Gold; Now: 750 Gold.
2.Added Viper Ning’s Legendary Pose [Operatic Legend·Return]. Standard price: 900 Gold; Now: 750 Gold.
3.Katana Legendary Skin [Soulbloom Gem]. Standard price: 1,500 Gold; Now: 1,250 Gold.
4.Tarka Ji’s Legendary Outfit [Ill Omen]. Standard price: 1,800 Gold; Now: 1,500 Gold.

III. Discounts End
1.Ziping Yin’s Legendary Outfit [A Chinese Ghost Story·Floral Shade] has returned to its standard price of 1,800 Gold.
2.Dual Blades Legendary Skin [Lunular Blades] has returned to its standard price of 1,500 Gold.
3.Ziping Yin’s Legendary Pose [Overlook] has returned to its standard price of 900 Gold.
4.Tarka Ji’s Epic Pose [Volleyball] has returned to its standard price of 300 Gold.

Bug Fixes
I. Hero-related Bugs
1. Fixed an issue where the passive effect of [Sedate Soul] of Ziping Yin with [Saving Grace] is still in effect in a Custom Lobby where ultimates are disabled.

II. Battle-related Bugs
1. Fixed an issue where Scale Rush can't be interrupted before the charging is completed.
2. Fixed an issue where the Dagger Skill [Pride's Fall] misses its strike in certain terrain.
3. Fixed an issue where the usage of Vitalia or Armor Powder might be abnormal under certain circumstances.

III. Map-related Bugs
1. Fixed some issues in several scenarios of Holoroth.
2. Fixed an issue where the Trap Clip will clamp teammates with certain operations.

notes.title: NARAKA: BLADEPOINT Update – August 19th , 2022
notes.content:
Dear players,
The servers of NARAKA: BLADEPOINT will be suspended for maintenance from 08/18/2022 23:00 (UTC) to 08/19/2022 03:00 (UTC). We suggest that you log out in advance and enter the game again after the maintenance. 
The details for this update are as follows:

Brand-new content!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36350327/6017194aa5a3f0d29591ce8e5e6b317ba9920703.png[/img]
Ⅰ.New Map: Holoroth
5 Regions: Plumed Castle, Mehtaab, City of Tang, Empyreal Village, and Yushan Ruins.
(Yushan Ruins is unavailable now: In northwestern Holoroth sits the inaccessible Snowy Peaks that have been ice-bound for years. But something abnormal is plotting inside Snowy Peaks these years, evident in the abrupt cracks on the ice. Perhaps the ice will melt soon.)

1. Brand New Mechanisms
Thorny Roller: Maintains cyclic motion, knocks players airborne once touched and deals a huge amount of damage.
Trap Clip: Interact with it to set a trap. Deals a small amount of damage to enemies stepping on it and bans Grappling Hook and Tracking for a certain time.
Spikes: Knocks players airborne once entering the trap and deals damage. There is a cooldown.
Cactus: Activated by player attacks, deals ranged damage to nearby players and knocks players hit to a far distance.
Firefly Cage: Interact with it to absorb Rage. It can be interacted with multiple players simultaneously and has an upper limit for a single absorption. Upon being drained, it will enter a CD.
Frost Moth: Activated by player attacks, releases ice mist in a wide range and freezes enemies within.
Sand Konjac: Activated by player attacks, releases dust in a wide range and blind enemies within.
Falcon Statues: Keep updating four statues in the Salvation Podium until they face their respective correct direction, in which case mysterious treasures will appear.
Campfire: Interact with it to disperse the Chill brought by the Snowstorm.
Rising Wind: Strengthens the jumping ability of players within range.
Ghostly Hand: Silences the objectives attacked by it for a while.

2. Weather System
In the game, Snowstorm, Sandstorm, and Ghostly Mist will be triggered in random areas at a random time. More advanced Troves will appear in areas affected by weather events.
Snowstorm: Occurs only in the cloudy environment. In a Snowstorm, players affected will gain Chill, forcing players into Heat Loss and reducing Rage constantly when the gauge is full. You can disperse the Chill by getting close to the Campfires marked on the map. New Troves will appear in Snowstorm areas and disappear after the weather changes.
Sandstorm: Occurs only in the cloudy or dusk environment. During a Sandstorm, a large amount of Rising Wind will appear in the area. New Troves will appear in Sandstorm areas and disappear after the weather changes.
Ghostly Mist: Occurs only in the cloudy or dusk environment. During a Ghostly Mist, a large number of Ghostly Hands will appear in the area. New Troves will appear in Ghostly Mist areas and disappear after the weather changes.

3. Regional Gameplays
1) Sliding on the Ice: When Sliding on the ice in Snowy Peaks, players' speed and max sliding distance will be greatly boosted. Enjoy your wild journey in Yushan!
2) Ecosystem: Embracing complex terrain, Holoroth has abundant species. Sand Pears that have two efficacy is an easy-to-find specialty here. You can also pick the Snow Lotus, an antidote to numerous poisons. But icecones may fall from nowhere, so be cautious. The snow caps on pine trees fall from occasionally, and squirrels keep hoarding food in the tree. In the desert, which seems to be desolate and uninhabited, there roam scorpions and lizards.

4. Map Selection
In the Herald's Trial, Quick Match, and Bot Mode, players can choose a specific map or any map to match;
//Players selecting the "Any Map" can be matched with players choosing a specific map, making the matching more effective.

5. New BGM
1) New Combat BGMs
All 5 main regions in Holoroth will have characteristic and exclusive combat BGMs. The new combat BGMs are still designed on the main idea of "Unfettered" as the old ones did. With the improvisation of locally featured instruments, we hope players can obtain an immersive gaming experience on the new map of Holoroth.
2) New Final BGMs
All 5 main regions in Holoroth have new BGMs exclusive to the Finals. Moreover, the 5 main regions in the Morus Isle also have their Final BMG renewed. The Final BGMs are played during the 6th and 7th corruption spread to generate passion in players fighting in the Finals.
3) New Combat BGMs Triggering Mechanism
Optimized BGM mechanism for frequent switching between combat and normal states. This smarter BGM triggering mechanism will enhance your combat experience.

II. New Crossover Hero: Ziping Yin
Gifted and selfless, she gives her all in healing and treating anyone in need. 
Such is her medical skill that you'd be forgiven for thinking just her presence alone can heal the sick, or return the fallen from their eternal slumber.
Ziping's gentleness and lively nature belied her strength: for here she stood, unflinching and unwavering though her family and the entire nation were under threat.
"Saving a single life is one thing. To save everyone, however... Yet no matter how tough, I'll do what I can!"
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36350327/ec1a362ac289ba8ca72a7e143018973e966b6646.png[/img]

(The third F skill and V ultimate variants are not yet available in this version. Once available, complete hero's Cultivation Quests to unlock. Unlocked automatically if you've already completed the required Cultivation Quests.)

III. New Season: Dawn
The Season 4 [Ordeal] will come to an end on 08/19/2022 00:00 (UTC). Meanwhile, the rank of this season will be settled and the new season [Dawn] will be open. Players will be able to claim the rewards after the update of the new season.
1. Season Rewards

6000+	60%

1500-3000	90%-80%
0-1500	100%-90%

Ⅳ. Adjustments of the Rank scores in Dawn Seaon
1. Added new Rank [Unrivaled Asura]
Above [Asura], a new Rank [Unrivaled Asura] was added. Players with 5,000+ scores in The Herald's Trial mode will reach to [Unrivaled Asura].
2. Adjustments of Rank [Asura]
Score requirements of [Asura] are changed from 4,500+ to 4,500-4,999 in The Herald's Trial.

V. New Season Lobby
Theme of the Lobby page has been updated to [Dawn]. Along with the new map of Holoroth, lobby BGMs were changed to Holoroth theme music "Iridescence of Holoroth" and Season theme music "Cascading Glory". Hope this will bring you excellent audiovisual experience.

VI. Limited-time Event: Anniversary Roll Call
Event Time: 08/19/2022 update – 09/14/2022 20:00 (UTC)
Event Details:
During the event, players could get limited-edition rewards including outfits, accessories and avatars by checking in for 10 days in total.

VII. Limited-time Event: Plumed Holoroth
Event Time: 08/19/2022 update – 09/14/2022 20:00 (UTC)
Event Details:
1. Players could choose one region to explore upon the first time participating in the event.
2. When exploring the chosen region, the Exploration Progress will be advanced by completing Exploration Quests The player will gain corresponding rewards once the exploration is completed. This means the player has to complete Special Quests and finish the Exploration Progress to claim the rewards.
3.Players can obtain Map Fragments by finishing Exploration Quests. Map Fragments can be used to help other players. Each time helping another player who is exploring the same region, both players can gain 3 points in the Exploration Progress. If the two players are exploring different regions, then only progress of the supported one will increase.
4. Finish exploring all regions to obtain the final Exploration rewards.

VIII. Limited-time Event: The Hero Returns
Event Time: 08/19/2022 update – 10/12/2022 20:00 (UTC)
Event Details:
1. You are qualified to participate in The Hero Returns as long as you have not logged in for over 28 days since your last login.
2. Each round of The Hero Returns lasts for 7 days which will be timed since your return date.
3. Complete the Hero Returns quests and get the Rebirth Seal, which can be used to redeem limited-edition rewards in the Rebirth Seal Store. You can also redeem the Rebirth Seal with Spectral Silk in the Spectral Silk Store.

IX. Limited-time Event: Free Trial
Event Time: 08/19/2022 update – 08/22/2022 17:00 (UTC)
Event Details:
1. During the event, one can play NARAKA: BLADEPOINT for free trial without purchasing the game.
2. Free trial of the game allows players use heroes including Viper Ning, Temulch, Matari, Tarka Ji, Kurumi and Tianhai, and experience modes including The Herald's Trial, Omni's Nightmare, Bloodsport, Showdown (players with free trial will be matched with each other in priority).
3. Players with free trial cannot participate in Torchbearer event, recharge, send public chat messages, receive gifts or use items like Treasures and Name-change Card. While all the data during free-trial playing will be permanently reserved. Players can enjoy the full version of NARAKA: BLADEPOINT by purchasing the game anytime.

X. Limited-time Return: Season Treasure
Event Time: 08/19/2022 update – 09/15/2022 00:00 (UTC)
Event Details:
1. Tidal Treasure, Cavalry Treasure, and Echelon Treasure will be available again for a limited time.
2. As the crossover ended, the Tianhai Legendary outfit [Dragon Shadow·Brink of Death] will no longer be available in Cavalry Treasures. The chance to obtain this reward will be evenly distributed to other Legendary rewards in the Cavalry Treasures to maintain the same overall drop rate of Legendary rewards.
3. The content and drop rate of rewards in other Treasures will remain unchanged.
4. The number of times to trigger a Guarantee for all Treasures will not be reset, and the Guarantee progress for each season will be reserved.

XI. Limited-time Return: Limited-edition Cosmetics
Event Time: 08/19/2022 update – 09/15/2022 00:00 (UTC)
Event Details:
You can buy limited-edition cosmetics of past seasons during this event on the [Store - Cosmetics Return] page. They are divided into four groups: Hero Outfit, Weapon Skin, Accessory & Grappling Hook, and Other cosmetics, with a purchase limit of three pieces per group.

XII. Newly added: Meeting Chest
It only takes a low price to unlock the Meeting Chest. You can respectively choose one reward from the [Ashy Cloud] Hero Outfits, the [Unfeigned] Ranged Weapon Skins, and the [Hidden Blade] Melee Weapon Skin for 3 consecutive days, as well as Advanced Hidden Treasure Voucher, Limited-edition Avatar such as [Drunken Fire], and other valuable rewards equaling more than 2,000 Gold!  

XIII. Personal Annual Report
Event Time: 08/19/2022 update – 09/19/2022 15:59 (UTC)
Event Details:
During this event, scan the QR code on the event page with your phone to open the link, or directly go Naraka+ APP and click the advertising on the home page to get your own exclusive annual report. Please see the specific event page for details.

XIV. Celebration Balloon
Newly added Celebration Balloons in the preparation stage. Thank you for your companions all the way!
