Ⅰ. Temulch
1. Temulch's [Zephyr Wisp] and all his Talents will get into blue Focus while summoning Zephyr Wisp. The stagger time of blowing the enemies is now always 3s and not determined by the number of remaining wisps.
2. Temulch's [Zephyr Prison] and all his Talents can now block the enemy's skill lock, including [Binding Prayer] and [Backstab].
3. Decreased startup frames of Temulch releasing Ultimate in the air and on beams to be consistent with the startup frames when on the ground.

II. Valda Cui
1. Adjusted Valda Cui's [Nether Nightmare: Bind] startup frames from 3.2s to 1.6s. Adjusted the max duration of the Sea Dragon from 20s to 12s, during which Valda Cui can hurl unlimited water spears. All water spear attacks during this Ultimate are ranged strikes.
2. Valda Cui's [Nether Nightmare: Bind] now binds the enemies with [Dragon's Coil] for 1.8s, and the binding is unbreakable. The enemies will be bound at a 1.5m height rather than 3.5m, allowing them to be hit by melee attacks. Enemies are immune to [Dragon's Coil] for 3s after unbinding.
3. Adjusted horizontal strike Damage Multiplier of Valda Cui's [Nether Nightmare: Bind] water spear from 0.72 to 0.25, vertical strike Damage Multiplier from 4.65 to 2, with its startup and recovery frames shortened, keeping the same feel as the horizontal strike.
//Dev Note: The special mechanism of Valda's ultimate makes it difficult to cooperate with other heroes except Tianhai and Viper Ning. Thus, we lower the height of Dragon's Coil in [Nether Nightmare: Bind], so the bound enemies can be attacked by weapons on the ground. Meanwhile, use of water spears is also optimized, which can hit the enemies simpler. Hope this can bring more lineup alternatives with Valda Cui.

III. Viper Ning
Optimized enemy animation of taking damage when [Stunned].

Weapon Adjustments
I. Dual Blades
Optimized charging animation for Dual Blades when moving.

II. Bow
1. Increased speed of bow shots for different charging states.
2. Adjustments to Damage Multipliers:
Horizontal strike Damage Multiplier: adjusted from 2.8 to 2.15;
Charged strike First-stage Damage Multiplier: adjusted from 4.05 to 3.1;
Charged strike Second-stage Damage Multiplier: adjusted from 5.5 to 4.2.

III. Musket
1. Increased speed of Musket shots for different states, including equipping Sunwing Shot.
2. Musket's Damage Multiplier has been reduced from 2.4 to 2.15.

Ⅳ. Pistol
1. Increased speed of Pistol shots for different charging states.
2. Increased hit range of Pistol shots.
3. Adjustments to Damage Multipliers:
Pistol's horizontal strike Damage Multiplier: adjusted from 0.4 to 0.32;
Pistol's charged strike Damage Multiplier: adjusted from 0.84 to 0.68.

V. Cannon
1. Canceled explosion range damage decay. The adjustments include: 
Central explosion Damage Multiplier: adjusted from 3 to 2.15;
Middle Circle explosion Damage Multiplier: adjusted from 2.25 to 2.15;
Outer Circle explosion Damage Multiplier: adjusted from 1.5 to 2.15.

//Dev Note: The experience of using ranged weapons varies greatly between players. We expect to improve it for all players by increasing the overall hit rate while limiting weapons performance by reducing the damage.

Souljade Adjustments
I. Move Souljades
Optimized special effect of [Focus Slide].

II. Melee Weapon Souljades
[Pride's Fall]: After hitting, first-stage attack will not be interrupted by Counterstrike. Adjusted damage from 1.11*2+3.32 to 1.34*2+4.03.

III. Ranged Weapon Souljades
1. [Scattershot]'s shoot damage reduction: adjusted from 55% to 60%;
2. [Fire Arrows]'s burning damage: adjusted from 50 to 30;
3. [Burst Arrow]'s shoot damage reduction: adjusted from 82% to 88%;
4. [Armor Pierce]'s shoot damage reduction: adjusted from 25% to 10%;
5. [Bounce Shell]'s shoot damage boost: adjusted from 20% to 12%;
6. [Storm Cannon]'s shoot damage reduction: adjusted from 20% to 35%;
7. [Burn]'s shoot damage reduction: adjusted from 40% to 35%;
8. [Burn]'s burning damage: adjusted from 40 to 30.

In-game Adjustments
I. Feature Optimizations
Optimized the Stash icon. The Stash icon now shows three states representing [Unavailable], [Opening] and [Open] besides outlines.

II. AI Opponents Adjustments
Optimized behavior of AI opponents.

Ⅲ. Adjustments in Omni's Nightmare
Slightly reduce the XP of Evil-Ents gained by defeating heroes.

Out-game Adjustments
I. Narakapedia
Added descriptions of Holoroth's mechanics and events.

II. Custom Room
Holoroth map is now available for The Herald's Trial in Custom Room.

III. Season Stats
Evil-Ent Lord Stats can now be recorded separately in the Omni's Nightmare Season Stats.

Ⅳ. Adjustments of Heroes' Cultivation Quests
1. All Heroes' Cultivation Quests for reaching [Mortal Legend]:
1) "Open 100 Troves in [Certain Region]" is adjusted to "Open 100 Troves in the Survival Mode".
2) "Defeat 1 enemy in [Certain Region]" is adjusted to "In the Survival Modes, spend at least 50,000 Dark Tide Coins".

V. Added New Default Faces
As the new Season Dawn opens, some heroes will possess a new Default Face, which will be available in the Customization Interface after the update.

Store Updates
I. BATTLEPASS Updates
[Dawn] BATTLEPASS is now available, which includes a variety of valuable items and skins! Players can obtain more rewards through unlocking Hidden Treasure!
[Justice Chamber] was newly added. After purchasing Advanced Hidden Treasure, players can create a Justice Chamber with friends and complete the Justice Quests to get rewards.

Ⅱ. New Packs
Added Kurumi Exclusive Pack [School Maillot], which contains Kurumi Legendary Outfit [Summer Party·School Maillot], Kurumi Legendary Accessory [Unicorn Float]. Standard price: 2,400 Gold; Now: 1,800 Gold.

Ⅲ. Added New Discounts
1. Added Tarka Ji Legendary Outfit [Summer Party·Twilight Sunshine]. Standard price: 1,800 Gold; Now: 1,500 Gold.
2. Added Ziping Yin Legendary Outfit [A Chinese Ghost Story·Floral Shade]. Standard price: 1,800 Gold; Now: 1,500 Gold.
3. Added the new Dual Blades Legendary Skin [Lunular Blades]. Standard price: 1,500 Gold; Now: 1,250 Gold.
4. Added Ziping Yin Legendary Pose [Overlook]. Standard price: 900 Gold; Now: 750 Gold.
5. Added Tarka Ji Epic Pose [Volleyball]. Standard price: 300 Gold; Now: 240 Gold.

Ⅳ. Discounts End
1. Justina Gu Legendary Accessory [White Cat Tail] has returned to its original price of 900 Gold.
2. Justina Gu Legendary Accessory [White Cat Ears] has returned to its original price of 1,200 Gold.
3. Nunchucks Legendary Skin [The Breaker·Golden Sun] has returned to its original price of 1,500 Gold.
4. Longsword Legendary Skin [The Breaker·Cloud Ride] has returned to its original price of 1,500 Gold.
5. Katana Legendary Skin [The Breaker·Dazzling Sun] has returned to its original price of 1,500 Gold.

V. Spectral Silk Store Updates
1. Added new item [Rebirth Seal], with the price of 800 Spectral Silk.
2. Added Matari Epic Outfit [Guillotine's Edge], with the price of 6,000 Spectral Silk.
3. Added Viper Ning Rare Outfit [Splitjaw], with the price of 2,400 Spectral Silk.
4. Added Nunchucks Epic Skin [Earthen Tempest], with the price of 5,000 Spectral Silk.
5. Added Musket Rare Skin [Rouge Rage], with the price of 2,000 Spectral Silk.
6. Added Valda Cui Legendary Accessory [Lunar Beauty], with the price of 9,000 Spectral Silk.
7. Added Rare Accessory [Mighty Daruma·M], with the price of 1,200 Spectral Silk.
8. Added Rare Accessory [Mighty Daruma·F], with the price of 1,200 Spectral Silk.
9. Added Epic Bubble [Counter them!], with the price of 2,000 Spectral Silk.
10. Added Epic Gesture [All Male Characters·Greetings], with the price of 3,000 Spectral Silk.
11. Added Epic Background [Golden Twilight], with the price of 2,000 Spectral Silk.
12. Added Yueshan Epic Base [Roster Platform], with the price of 4,000 Spectral Silk.
13. Added Kurumi Rare Pose [Stroll], with the price of 1,200 Spectral Silk.
14. Legendary Outfit 30% discount voucher, Legendary Weapon 30% discount voucher and Legendary Accessory 30% discount voucher are no longer for sale after Aug 18, 20:00 (UTC).

Bug Fixes
I. Hero-related Bugs
Fixed an issue where recovery effects with damage (e.g., those from Yoto Hime's Ultimate and Souljades of Sap) are not affected by burning reduction.
//Dev Note: We are working to maintain more comprehensive interaction rules and results among Heroes and Souljades.

II. Weapon-related Bugs
Fixed an issue where Nunchucks and Greatsword's Scale Rush can go through the floor.

notes.title: NARAKA: BLADEPOINT Update – August 4th , 2022
notes.content:
The servers of NARAKA: BLADEPOINT will be suspended for maintenance from 08/03/2022 23:00 (UTC) to 08/04/2022 03:00 (UTC). We suggest that you log out in advance and enter the game again after the maintenance.

The details for this update are as follows:
Brand-new content!
I. Brand new mode: Showdown (Trial)
In the Showdown: Eventide Temple Chapter, Viper Ning, Kurumi, Tarka Ji and Valda Cui will face one of Omnius' incarnations, who is the leader of the Heralds.
Showdown will be open during the following periods:
Date: August 5th - 7th, August 12th - 14th, August 19th – 21st 
The Common, Hard and Nightscream stages will be open from August 5th.
Time: 
NA Server 20:00-6:00 (UTC); 
EU Server 13:00-23:00 (UTC); 
EAS & AS Servers 7:00-17:00 (UTC)
1.Hard Stage: More monsters have stronger attack power, health and moves. The Omnius’ form and Attack moves will be totally new.
2.Nightscream Stage: Monsters with diverse moves will swarm with more oppressive attack power and health. Omnius’ attack moves become more challenging.
3.Legend Stage: This will be available along with the Racing Leaderboard on August 12th. Monsters with more varied attack methods drown the heroes with desperate attack power and health. Omnius, with new moves, will also become more overwhelming. His continuous attacks will make the heroes have no time to breathe.

II. Through the Fire
Now Through the Fire is added to the Custom Room.

III. Takeda Nobutada’s new skill [Mythic Grab·Takedown] and new ultimate [Demonic Aid·Engulf] are available now
1.[Mythic Grab·Takedown]
Takeda Nobutada charges forward, slamming the first enemy with a blue Focus strike or skill (whether the enemy is attacking or not) to the ground, and grabbing the enemy's weapon. He will gain a great damage reduction effect during the use of the skill.
This will not block blue Focus damage.
Cannot be used while under attack.
2.[Demonic Aid·Engulf]
Takeda unleashes the seal of the demonic spirit inside, Furen, instantly knocking back nearby enemies a short distance. Furen will enhance itself by [Demonic Force], meanwhile  the skill will turn into [Demonic Strike·Havoc], lasting for 30 sec.
[Demonic Strike·Havoc]: Furen launches an attack upon enemies standing ahead Takeda. Takeda can use [Demonic Strike·Havoc] 3 times, after which Furen will be sealed again. Takeda will recover a large amount of Health and Armor after [Demonic Strike·Havoc] causes damage.
[Demonic Force] will be upgraded when Takeda grabs weapons or allies obtain weapons. The upgraded [Demonic Force] will be deducted after the weapon drops.
When Furen's [Demonic Force] turns purple, [Demonic Strike·Havoc] can be launched 4 times. When Furen's [Demonic Force] turns golden, [Demonic Strike·Havoc] will be even more powerful. 
 [Demonic Strike] can be used when Takeda is under attack or controlled and does not interrupt Takeda's own movements.

IV. Brand New Event: Cure the World
Event Time: 08/04/2022 update – 08/18/2022 20:00 UTC
Event Rules:
1. By completing Daily Quests, players can obtain Puzzle Shard of Ziping Yin and have additional chance to obtain any one of Tae, Spectral Silk, Legendary Outfit and Legendary Ornament at random.
2. The Puzzle has 16 pieces and four Sections, which can be unlocked with the use of random Puzzle Shards. Alternatively, a specific region can be unlocked with the corresponding Puzzle Shards. 
3. You can claim rewards by unlocking any of the four Sections. Some rewards will be available after the new version is released, so stay tuned. 
4. Each day, you can help a player obtain a Puzzle Shard (by tapping the contact list, selecting a "Puzzle Shard of Ziping”, and confirming to share it). You won't consume your Puzzle Shards by doing so. However, each player will be given just one Puzzle Shard per day. 
5. You can still claim unlocked rewards on the event page and unlock Puzzle Shards to obtain rewards anytime within the remaining time to claim rewards after the end of the event. But you can no longer complete Quests or send Puzzle Shards during that period. You can get 160 Tae for each Puzzle Shard destroyed at the Inventory after the end of the time period available to claim rewards (i.e., upon the expiration of the item).

V. Brand New Event: Eventide Fire
Event Time: 08/04/2022 20:00 UTC – 08/22/2022 20:00 UTC
Event Rules:
1. Complete Daily Quests to obtain Bounty Emblems and Fiery Ents. The latter can be used to redeem limited-edition rewards!
2. Bounty Emblems can be used to refresh bounty quests randomly. Complete bounty quests to obtain lots of rewards, including Legendary Ornaments.
3. Bounty quests are the same for all players. Completed quests won't be refreshed.
Note: Event quests can be refreshed only when the Showdown mode is open. At other times, players could only redeem rewards.

VI．The new map Holoroth will be released soon, and the shadow of Plumed Castle will appear in the preparation phase of all Survival modes, The Bloodbath and Shadow Surge. 

Hero Adjustments
I. Kurumi
1. When affected by other elements, Kurumi's ultimates [Sacred Circle] and [Sacred Circle: Armor Enhance] will produce different extra effects besides healing according to different elements, and continue the remaining time of the healing circle. The damage and healing effects, etc., inflicted by the adjusted circle still come from Kurumi.
The extra effects of Kurumi's healing circle when affected by different elements are as follows:
- Fire circle: Enemies in the circle will lose health continuously, and their healing will be reduced by 50%. After leaving the circle, the debuff will last for 5 seconds (the damage will be greatly reduced compared to when they were in the fire circle).
- Poison circle: Enemies in the circle will lose health continuously. After enemies leave the circle, the debuff will last for 5 seconds (the damage and the duration will be greatly reduced compared to when they were in the poison circle).
- Wind circle: Enemies in the circle will restore their Energy slower. After leaving the circle, the debuff will last for 4 seconds.
- Water circle: Allies that enter the circle for the first time will gain an extra healing effect.
- Ice circle: The circle will regularly make ice storms, which can freeze enemies.
//Dev Note: After being summoned out, Kurumi's healing circle could be changed occasionally in unexpected situations, which sometimes resulted in the loss of urgently needed healing effect. Therefore, we made the basic healing effect to teammates of the circle unchanged even though it's affected by different elements, and added extra effects to create uniqueness according to different elements.

II. Tarka Ji
Optimized the performance when following other actions after ending his ultimate in the air.

In-game Adjustments
I. Matchmaking Optimization
1. Adjusted the max number of players in the solo mode of The Herald's Trial, Quick Match and Bot Mode from 60 to 48.
//Dev Note: The added Rebirths changed the combat tempo of the match. We reduced the max number of players to align combat tempo with the design expectation.

II. Through the Fire
1. Increased the height of the island from the sea level in Through the Fire properly. Now players can use Grappling Hook to get on the island before falling into the sea. The error-tolerant rate was improved.
2. [Uppercut Slash·Pendulum] and [Lethal Descent·Pendulum]: The attack range was increased and now they can cause a strong knockback effect to Almighty General and Vajra (not working for the Vajra when it launches a vertical strike).
3. Optimized the sound effect of [Uppercut Slash·Pendulum].

4. Enhanced the knockback effect of the pendulum to Vajra and Almighty General.
5. Equipment and items in Exquisite Vessel will upgrade as time goes by.
6. Reduced the default Grappling Hooks in the Bag from 18 to 3. More Grappling Hooks will spawn from the Exquisite Vessel.

Ⅲ. Omni's Nightmare
1. Evil-Ents can destroy Soul Lanterns to get more EXP, which will be shared proportionately among all Evil-Ents.
2. Fixed an issue where Evil-Ent’s level icon in the front of the health bar could be seen in the preparation phase.
3. Decreased Evil-Ents’ base Ranged Resist from 35% to 20%.
4. Fixed the issue where the stiff could be abnormal while Evil-Ents attack downed enemies.

IV. Combat
Quick Counter: Now the Quick Counter used while charging after a combo has the same speed as the manual counter.

V. In-game Gestures
Renamed the gesture [Pray] to [Salute] with the effect unchanged.

VI. Quests
Renamed the quest [Pray] to [Salute].

Out-game Adjustments
I. Team-up Lobby Optimization
1. Now recruitment is supported in all team-up modes.
2. Added a new feature that can filter players according to the rank of the recruiter.
3. Adjusted the level required to unlock the feature to 5.

Settings
Ⅰ. New Video Volume Adjustment Feature
Via Settings - Audio - Volume - Video, you could adjust the volume of the opening video and videos that display hero outfits and weapon skins.

Feature Optimizations
I. Client
1. Optimized the loading logic of characters to reduce instant stuttering caused by character loading.
2. Fixed part of memory leak to reduce memory usage due to a long gaming time.

Ⅱ. Out-game
1. Optimized the operation experience of Shop Overview
(1) Now when you go to the Preview page and tap the “Back” button, you will go back to the former page.
(2) Added the reminder of price changes of the packs when you own a single item in the pack to Shop Overview.
2.When some of the time-limited modes are open, there will be a red dot as a reminder on the mode-selection page.

Shop Updates
I. Spectral Silk Store Update
Added the new items: Legendary Outfit 30% discount voucher, Legendary Weapon 30% discount voucher, Legendary Accessory 30% discount voucher. Each sell for 1,000 Spectral Silk and each can be purchased only once for a limited time. A large number of legendary outfits, weapons and accessories can be purchased with a 30% account (for more details, please refer to the item info).

II. Added New Discounts
1.Added the new Justina Gu’s Legendary Accessory [White Cat Tail]. Standard price: 900 Gold; Now: 750 Gold.
2.Added the new Justina Gu’s Legendary Accessory [White Cat Ears]. Standard price: 1,200 Gold; Now: 1,000 Gold.
3.Added the new Nunchucks Legendary skin [The Breaker·Golden Sun]. Standard price: 1,500 Gold; Now: 1,250 Gold.
4.Added the new Longsword Legendary skin [The Breaker·Cloud Ride]. Standard price: 1,500 Gold; Now: 1,250 Gold.
5.Added the new Katana Legendary skin [The Breaker·Burning Sun]. Standard price: 1,500 Gold; Now: 1,250 Gold.

III. Discounts End
1.Wuchen’s Legendary outfit [Alioth] has returned to its standard price of 1,800 Gold.
2.Matari’s Legendary accessory [Pearldust Gauze] has returned to its standard price of 1,200 Gold.
3.Dagger Legendary skin [The Breaker·Myriad Edge] has returned to its standard price of 1,500 Gold.
4.Dagger Legendary skin [The Breaker·Cavern] has returned to its standard price of 1,500 Gold.
5.Justina Gu’s Legendary outfit [Aegis Embroidery] has returned to its standard price of 1,800 Gold.
6.Viper Ning’s Legendary outfit [Maple Snowfall] has returned to its standard price of 1,800 Gold.

Bug Fixes
I. Hero-related Bugs
1. Fixed an issue where Tarka Ji would dodge when getting up from the ground after casting his ultimate.

II. Weapon-related Bugs
1.Fixed an issue where Katana and Nunchucks couldn't block bullets after casting Grappling Strike.
2.Fixed an issue where the action and the time couldn’t match while repairing Dual Blades.

III. Combat-related Bugs
1. Fixed an issue where Quick Counter didn't work while slaying Moonbane.

notes.title: NARAKA: BLADEPOINT Update – July 14th , 2022
notes.content:
Dear players,
The servers of NARAKA: BLADEPOINT will be suspended for maintenance from 07/13/2022 23:00 (UTC) to 07/14/2022 03:00 (UTC). We suggest that you log out in advance and enter the game again after the maintenance.

The details for this update are as follows: 
Brand-new content!
I. The New Casual Mode [Through the Fire]
Rules:
1.Two Exclusive Souljades ([Uppercut Slash·Pendulum] and [Lethal Descent·Pendulum]) will appear in this mode. And all the Souljades and Dark Tide Coins you obtained will not be dropped again.
1)[Uppercut Slash·Pendulum]: Enhances Katana, Spear and Dual Blades' Uppercut Slash.
2)[Lethal Descent·Pendulum]: Use the crouch button while jumping or free-falling to land quickly and knock nearby enemies airborne. Lethal Descent grows in power according to the height fallen.
2.The mode requires a party of three.
3.You can utilize the large mechanisms on the island to defeat enemies.
4.Fall in the water and you're defeated.
5.Every now and then, the Exquisite Vessel will spawn forth loads of weapons and rare Souljades.
6.At set intervals, the Top 1 player will become the bounty target: killing the bounty target will get Bounty Score.
Score Rules:
Kills: +5 point
Killstreaks: +1 bonus point 
5+ killstreaks: +1 bonus points
Kills the bounty target: +30 bonus points
Have fun and be the last standing!

Ⅱ. The New Event [Sunwing Solstice·Mutation]
Event Time: 07/20/2022 20:00 (UTC) – 08/03/2022 20:00 (UTC)
Event Rules: 
1. Gain [Plumes·Scarlet] and a certain amount of [Event Points] by completing quests during the event.
2. During match preparation stages, players must gather their efforts to activate the altar upon the center of Origin Island. Having done so, they'll receive [Plumes·Scarlet] upon opening gold or green Troves. Up to 10 [Plumes·Scarlet] can be obtained from each match, and total of 10 can be obtained per day (this excludes those from Omni's Nightmare and Bloodsport).
3. Submit [Plumes·Scarlet] to gain event points. Clicking the Submit button will submit all your [Plumes·Scarlet], granting you 10 points for each one.
4. You'll also receive a [Summer Solstice Gift] for every 20 [Plumes·Scarlet] submitted.
5. You gain certain rewards once you've gained enough event points, with 2,300 needed to gain them all.
6. Every [Plumes·Scarlet] submitted increases the Total Points figure by 1, and once it reaches its maximum, all players will be rewarded 1 [Fortune Treasure].
*Note: Remember to claim your rewards before the event ends, or you'll miss out.

Ⅲ. The New Event [Morus' Fall]
Event Time: 07/14/2022 update – 07/20/2022 20:00 (UTC)
Event Rules: 
1. During the preparation phase in [Through the Fire], players can collect [Fall Guys] found on the ground. Up to 6 [Fall Guys] can be gained this way per day. 
2. Fall Guys can be exchanged for limited rewards! 
*Note: Rewards may be redeemed during the event up until 07/23/2022 20:00 (UTC), so don't leave it too late!

Ⅳ. The New Event [Summer Herald]
Event Time: 07/14/2022 update – 08/03/2022 20:00 (UTC)
Event Rules: 
1. Complete Daily Quests for [Sunhats], and use [Sunhats] to redeem exclusive event rewards. The quests will be reset at 20:00 (UTC) every day.
2. Certain players will become [Summer Heralds] during the event. They receive daily [Melons] after logging in. [Summer Heralds] will be reset every Thursday at 20:00 (UTC).
Players can use [Melons] to send greeting Emails to other players. Those who have received the Email can claim a [Fresh Melons], which can be redeemed for limited event rewards.

Hero Adjustments
I. Takeda Nobutada
1. Takeda’s new skill [Mythic Grab·Takedown] and new ultimate [Demonic Aid·Engulf] will not be included in the update this time. According to the feedback from players in the Test Server, Takeda’s new skill and ultimate did not meet expectations. Thus, we decided to readjust and they will be available in the next update. We appreciate all the feedback from players and look forward to more of your suggestions. 
2. Optimized the problem that Takeda would pull the target to his side while grabbing the weapon. Now Takeda will rush to the target.
3. Optimized the problem that the crosshair of Takeda Nobutada's [Demonic Aid: Teleport] would be blocked when he backs against occluded objects, which restricted the normal aim range.
4. Optimized the descriptions of Takeda Nobutada's skills and ultimates.

Ⅱ. Matari
1. Optimized the special effect of [Backstab]'s special attacks when casting [Unseen Wings].
2. Optimized [Backstab]'s locking range. Now enemies near the screen edge won't be locked.
3. Increased the Max Rage required for casting the ultimate [Unseen Wings] and all its variations by 25%, which is the same as the Max Rage of most heroes.

Souljade Adjustments
Ⅰ. Dual Blades Souljades
1. Added [Dual Blades Sap]: The last move of a Counterstrike Combo restores 75% of the damage dealt as health or armor.
2. [Universe Slash]: Optimized the motions of fingers.
3. [Universe Slash]: Adjusted the Damage Multiplier of each stage from 3.89 to 3.48.

In-game Adjustments
Ⅰ. Feature Optimizations
1. In-game Quest Optimization:
Icons of quest location were added to the descriptions of Cache Hunt, Prayer and Blessings quests, and descriptions of Quest Scrolls.
2. Direction Indicator Optimization:
Marks of North, South, East and West, etc., were added to the direction indicator to make reporting enemies' location easier for players.

Ⅱ. Combat Adjustments
1. Quick Counter:
You will no longer crouch when using Quick Counter before a charging is completed. The response interval of Quick Counter is now lengthened when you continuously tap or hold the button to reduce misoperation.

Ⅲ. Omni's Nightmare Adjustments
1. Now the location of Soul Lanterns will be displayed when players select the spawn point.
2. Adjusted Soul Lanterns' repairing time to 6s by 1 player, 4s by 2 players and 2s by 3 or more players. There will be motional signals on the map when Heroes are repairing Soul Lanterns.
3. Added a mechanism to dynamically adjust the frequency of Rattans’ refreshing around the Soul Lanterns according to the situation on the field, and reflected it on the icon of Soul Lanterns.
4. Adjusted the negative effects on Heroes who extinguish the Soul Spark. Their ultimates will be banned for 10s, and a random debuff (skill banning, Grappling Hook banning and Blind) will be imposed on them.
5. After extinguishing the Soul Spark, Evil-Ent Lords will increase Attack by 20%, Melee Resistance by 25% and Ranged Resistance by 35%, lasting for 20s. 
6. Reduced the protection time of Soul Spark to 50s.
7. Now all Souljades will be retained after Heroes' rebirth.
8. Evil-Ents now can counter. 
9. Increased Evil-Ents' Ranged Resistance by 35% and doubled their tree climbing speed.
10. Now you can adjust the voice volume of the faction.

Ⅳ. Solo Mode Adjustments
1. In all Solo modes (The Herald's Trial, Bot Mode and Quick Match):
1) Players can get one Rebirth now.
2) The first spread of the Shadow Corruption was delayed for 60s.
3) The appearance time of Morus' Blessing has also been adjusted according to the delay of the Shadow Corruption spread.

Out-game Adjustments
Ⅰ. Out-game Voice
1. Now players can voice chat with teammates in the Lobby when teaming up.
2. Two chat modes are supported: Open Mic and Tap To Speak.
3. Now players can mute their teammates.

Ⅱ. Talent-Glyph Value Adjustments
1. Reduced the bonus of Talents related to Energy Cap, Energy Restoring Speed, Dodge Energy Consumption/Dagger Dash Energy consumption by 33%. (The reduction was added to players' basic buffs to ensure the performance remains consistent after the adjustment when Energy Glyphs are fully equipped.)
2. Party's Shared Rift Dealer Discount replaced the former buff of Rift Dealer Discount. To be specific:
1) Now players could provide discounts to both themselves and teammates. Party's Shared Rift Dealer Discount from different teammates could be stacked.
2) The additional discount was reduced to 50% of the original.
3) Party's Shared Rift Dealer Discount and discounts provided by in-game mechanisms (such as the global effect from statues in Stashes) can be multiplied.

Ⅲ. Team Stats
Optimized the performance of some Poses.
Settings
Ⅰ. Faction Voice Volume in Omni's Nightmare
Added [Omni's Nightmare Faction Voice Volume] to Settings-Audio-Volume, which could be used to adjust the voice volume of Heroes and Evil-Ent faction channels.

Feature Optimizations
Ⅰ. Client
1. Optimized the loading logic of radar maps to reduce instant stuttering caused by map loading in certain circumstances.
2. Optimized the loading logic of characters and scene objects to reduce instant stuttering caused by their loading in certain circumstances.
3. Optimized the performance consumption of the special effects of Cairns and pickable objects to improve their recognizability at different angles with slight changes in cosmetics.

Ⅱ. In-match
1. Optimized the attack while falling from a platform with a height of 1.3m and below, which will connect ground attacks instead of airborne attacks.
2. Optimized button tips in the matches. Now different tips will be displayed according to the melee or ranged weapons you hold. Button tips were added to Training Ground too.

Ⅲ. Packs
Added the [Default Collocation] feature to the Pack Preview: tap the button of [Default Collocation] to toggle between the officially recommended collocation and the player’s individual collocation.

Store Updates
I. Crossover Expiration
The Crossover between NARAKA: BLADEPOINT and [Sword and Fairy] [Xuan-Yuan Sword] will come to an end, and the following items will not be purchasable from 07/15/2022 at 15:59 (UTC).
1. Hero Outfits: [Sword and Fairy·Zhao Ling-er], [Sword and Fairy·Li Xiaoyao], [Xuan-Yuan Sword·Chen Jingchou], [Xuan-Yuan Sword·Tuoba Yu'er].
2. Weapon Skin: [Xuan-Yuan Sword].
3. Packs: [Astral Chaser Pack], [Revered Blade Pack], [Pearl Deity Pack], [Vigorous Youth Pack].
The items above will be unpurchasable then, while players who have unlocked those items will continue to keep them.

Ⅱ. New Packs
Added the new Yoto Hime Exclusive Pack [Ocean Coral], which includes Yoto Hime’s Legendary outfits [Ocean Coral], Greatsword Legendary skin [Coral Blade]. The Original price of the pack: 4,200 Gold; Now: 2,880 Gold.

Ⅲ. Added New Discounts
(1)Added the new Dagger Legendary skin [The Breaker·Myriad Edge]. Original price: 1,500 Gold; Now: 1,250 Gold.
(2)Added the new Katana Legendary skin [The Breaker·Cavern]. Original price: 1,500 Gold; Now: 1,250 Gold.
(3)Justina Gu’s Legendary outfit [Aegis Embroidery]. Original price: 1,800 Gold; Now: 1,500 Gold.
(4)Viper Ning’s Legendary outfit [Maple Snowfall]. Original price: 1,800 Gold; Now: 1,500 Gold.

Ⅳ. Discounts End
(1)Dual Blades Legendary skin [Peacebreaker] has returned to its original price of 1,500 Gold.
(2)Takeda’s Legendary Accessory [Helm of Malevolence] has returned to its original price of 1,200 Gold.
(3)Nunchucks Legendary skin [Tiger's Grace] has returned to its original price of 1,500 Gold.
(4)Viper Ning’s Legendary outfit [Dragon Will·Awareness] has returned to its original price of 2,400 Gold.

Bug Fixes
I. Hero-related Bugs
1. Fixed an issue where the frozen value of Justina Gu's [Arctic Wraith] failed to be increased by attack bonus.
2. Fixed an issue where Kurumi’s [Sacred Circle] would not consume Rage in some cases.

II. Battle-related Bugs
1.Fixed an issue where Evil-Ents' Horizontal Strike and Axe Throwing were on ranged buttons when players use controllers in [Omni's Nightmare].
2.Fixed an issue where the Counterstrike Combo could fail after an airborne counter.

Ⅲ. Voice-related Bugs
1.Fixed an issue where player voice echo and the receiving volume could be too loud.

notes.title: NARAKA: BLADEPOINT Update – June 23rd , 2022
notes.content:
Dear players,
The servers of NARAKA: BLADEPOINT will be suspended for maintenance from 06/22/20 23:00 (UTC) to 06/23/2022 03:00 (UTC). We suggest that you log out in advance and enter the game again after the maintenance. 
The details of the update are as follows
Brand-new content!
I. Brand-new weapon: Dual Blades
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36350327/ae4a1325b606fd54f94f0e16aa54c93b2e99beb7.png[/img]
Autumn flows on like surging waves, as warriors slice through foes like willow leaves dancing upon water.
The new weapon Dual Blades will be available. Come and try it out for yourself!

II. Omni's Nightmare is back once again.
1. Choose your Faction
You can choose your preferred Faction before each match, influencing who is assigned to each side.
2. In-game Content
1) Spirit Echoes: Heroes can now gain up to two passive buffs in the form of Spirit Echoes. These include 'Golden Rattan', 'Light's Rage', 'Lethal Armor', 'Copper Ward', 'Explosive Shot' and 'Beckon'. Evil-Ents may choose two from 'Hook Axe', 'Enrage', 'Split Axe', 'Eagle Vision', 'Miasma Rattan' and 'Eternal' to replace their default skills, ultimates or moves. (Check the Narakapedia for details.)
2) Check Faction info for the current match and allocate your Spirit Echoes during preparation.
3) Rattan is found around the map, but only grows near Soul Lanterns. Evil-Ents can damage Soul Lanterns to remove the Rattan, yet heroes can repair the Soul Lanterns in turn, allowing Rattan to respawn once more. Once all Rattan near Soul Lanterns have been taken, some respawn every 4 sec (or immediately when a Soul Lantern is repaired) until the respawn cap is reached.
4) Heroes now have gold Focus during the last second they submit Rattan.
5) Soul Lanterns can be repaired by multiple players at once, speeding up their repairs.
6) Ballista spawn at random spots along the tracks. Heroes must spend 10,000 Dark Tide Coins to unlock them before they can be used, however.
7) Once the match has been underway for a set time, heroes will no longer be able to Rebirth. However, Evil-Ents will also drop more Rattan when defeated.
8) The 'Nearby chat' voice channel has now been replaced with 'Faction chat'. Team chat has been added for those players who join the match as a party. Toggle Open Mic or switch voice channels in Settings - Audio.
9) Improved the sorting of Rift Dealers' items.
10) Improved the balance between Heroes and Evil-Ents in Omni's Nightmare:
i. Lowered Evil-Ents' base attack, while increasing their attack gained with each level.
ii. Changed randomly-spawned Soul Sparks' initial progress to 34%
iii. Now 2 Rattans will be dropped when Heroes defeat the Evil-Ents. When Heroes’ Rebirths have been deducted, the dropping amount will be 5.
3. Game Settlement
1) Once the match ends, you're shown a settlement page including the winning faction's top 3 players.
2)The match stats interface has been completely overhauled: it now includes the heroes selected, specific mode achievements, and more.

III. New Event: [Double-Edged]
Event Time: 06/22/2022 update – 07/01/2022 20: 00 (UTC) 
Event Rules:
Gain Whetstones by completing quests during the event. Whetstones can be redeemed for great event rewards.

IV. New Event [Sunwing Solstice]
The world bristles with Yang energies as the Summer Solstice arrives.
It's unknown when it first appeared, but out on Morus Isle, there stands a Solstice Altar.
A most peculiar sensation, as if one's inner Yang energies were reaching out toward the altar, overcame all heroes who approached its location.
And once the Solstice Altar was activated, Plumes were found scattered across Morus Isle.
The people came to realize that, once taken to Sunwing's Rest, these Plumes were absorbed into the air around them. Not only that, however. Sunwing's Rest itself began to change slowly as it absorbed them...
Event Time: 06/28/2022 20: 00 (UTC) – 07/13/2022 20: 00 (UTC) 
Event Rules:
1. Gain [Plumes] and [Event Points] by completing quests during the event.
2. During match preparation stages, players must gather their efforts to activate the altar upon the center of Origin Island. Having done so, they'll receive [Plumes] upon opening gold or green Troves. Up to 10 [Plumes] can be obtained from matches per day (this excludes those from Omni's Nightmare and Bloodsport).
3. Submit Plumes to gain event points. You gain 10 points for each.
4. A [Summer Solstice Gift] is awarded for every 20 [Plumes] submitted.
5. Event rewards are granted once players reach a set score total. The point maximum is 3,000, granting all event rewards once reached.
6. Every [Plume] submitted increases the Total Points figure by 1, and once it reaches its maximum, all players will be rewarded 1 [Fortune Treasure].
*Note: Remember to claim your rewards before the event ends, or you'll miss out.

V. Map Updates
The winds of change continue to blow, and dark undercurrents sweep Sunwing's Rest.

Hero Adjustments
//Dev Note: In the month-and-a-bit since the Ordeal season began, we've been hard at work analyzing NARAKA's ever-growing game data. We've also received loads of great player feedback—thanks again for your continued support!
Our analysis showed us that the hero skills and ultimates are dealing more damage in battle than we'd anticipated, meaning combat would often be over in a flash. We don't want teams wiped out just because a player unleashed their skill/ultimate at an inopportune time. Yet simultaneously, we don't want players' hard work and advantages to be for nothing just because we've changed up a strategy.
With this in mind, we've adjusted skill and ultimate damage for most heroes. We hope this will serve to improve the strategic environment in-game, and also that it'll give rise to new and exciting lineups and battle strategies too.

Ⅰ. Yoto Hime
1. Adjusted her ultimate [Ominous Blade] and all its variations. The basic Damage Multiplier of its slashes was reduced from 4.5 to 2.6 for the 1st slash, 3.2 for the 2nd slash, and 3.8 for the 3rd slash.
2. Adjusted extra slashes of her ultimate [Ominous Blade: Combo]. The Damage Multiplier was reduced from 2.25 to 1.6.
//Dev Note: After recent adjustments to the mechanism of Yoto Hime's ultimate, the hit rate of its slashes has been improved. To balance the Hero, we adjusted the Damage Multiplier slightly.

Ⅱ. Matari
1. Increased the single moving distance of her Skill [Silent Flutter: Rapid Flash] from 6m to 9m.
2. Added a new mechanism to her ultimate [Unseen Wings] and all its Talents. Now when Matari is in stealth, [Silent Flutter]'s CD will be reduced and the moving distance will be increased and be with the [Backstab] status. 
[Backstab]: An enemy within the range of [Silent Flutter] in front of Matari will be locked. When the enemy is locked, Matari can use [Silent Flutter] to teleport to the target's back and launch a special attack.
3. Reduced max rage needed to cast her ultimate [Unseen Wings] and all its variations by 20%.
//Dev Note: Before these adjustments, Matari's ultimate [Unseen Wings] could increase her fighting capacity in open battles only to a limited extent without effective deterrence. Therefore, we added the [Backstab] mechanism to improve her offensive capability and give her a competitive edge after casting the ultimate.

III. Takeda Nobutada
1. [Demonic Strike]’s base Damage Multiplier during [Demonic Aid] has been reduced from 0.5*2 to 0.4*2, and [Airborne Strike] base Damage Multiplier reduced from 1*2 + 1.5 to 0.5*2 + 1.5.
2. Ultimate: [Demonic Aid: Teleport]
1) [Demonic Aid: Teleport] attacks no longer grant the user Rage.
2) [Demonic Aid: Teleport] base Damage Multiplier has been reduced from 1.5 + 0.5*6 + 3 to 1 + 0.3*6 + 2.2.
3) [Demonic Aid: Teleport] attacks now restore the attacker's health by 30% of the damage dealt.

IV. Tianhai
1. Tianhai's ultimate [Titan's Call] and all its variations' base Damage Multiplier have been changed.
1) Skills' base Damage Multiplier (when Tianhai hasn't grabbed an enemy) has been reduced from 4.28 to 3.75.
2) Skills' base Damage Multiplier (when Tianhai's got a single enemy in his grasp) has been reduced from 4.28 to 3.75.
3) Skills' base Damage Multiplier (when Tianhai's got two enemies in his grasp) has been reduced from 12.5 to 10.
2. Tianhai's ultimate [Titan's Call] and all its variations’ base Health and Armor Conversion Multiplier have been changed.
1) In Solos, Tianhai's base Health while in Vajra form has been increased from 1,900 to 2,300 and his Armor Conversion Multiplier from 0.6 to 0.8.
2) In Duos, Tianhai's Armor Conversion Multiplier while in Vajra form has been increased from 0.8 to 0.9.

V. Yueshan
Yueshan's ultimate [Troop Decimation] and all its variations' base Damage Multiplier have been changed.
1. [Leaping Slash] 's base Damage Multiplier has been reduced from 0.34 + 1.66 * 2 to 0.26 + 1.29 * 2.
2. [Dragontail] 's base Damage Multiplier has been reduced from 7.34 to 6.52.

VI. Valda Cui
The Damage Multiplier of Valda Cui’s water spears in her ultimate [Nether Nightmare] has been reduced from 1.5 + 3.2 to 1.2 + 2.5.

VII. Tarka Ji
1. The Burn damage inflicted by Tarka Ji's skills and ultimate has been reduced from 4% to 2% of the enemy's Health per second. Burn duration remains the same.
2. Tarka Ji now expends 9% instead of 7% Rage to cast [Inner Fire: Gigaflame] while [Blackout: Vulcan] is in effect.

VIII. Justina Gu
1. [Shadowswipe] 's base Damage Multiplier has been reduced from 0.5 to 0.1.
2. [Shadowswipe·Blizzard] 's base Damage Multiplier has been reduced from 0.5 to 0.1.
3. [Arctic Wraith·Frostwind] 's sword energy base Damage Multiplier has been reduced from 1 to 0.1.
4. Enemies frozen by any [Arctic Wraith] and all its variations are now frozen for 1.6 sec instead of 2 sec.

Weapon Adjustments
Ⅰ. Nunchucks
1. Changed the Biding Fury consumed by Horizontal Block from one stack to two stacks.
2. Reduced the damage reduction ratio while triggering Horizontal Block from 80% to 50%.
3. You now can get into the golden Focus after the second strike of Dragon Flurry.

Ⅱ. Unarmed
Slightly reduced the stagger time caused by airborne vertical strikes to enemies falling down while in unarmed status.

Souljade Adjustments
Ⅰ. Dual Blades Souljades
1. Added a new Souljade [Universe Slash], which changes the second stage of charged vertical strikes.
2. Added a new Souljade [Cavalry Bloom], which changes charged horizontal strikes.
3. Added a new Souljade [Splitter], which changes the third stage of horizontal strikes.

Ⅱ. Dagger Souljades
The first stage of Dagger Skill [Pride's Fall]'s attack will break the [Freeze] status of enemies being hit.

Ⅲ. Nunchucks Souljades
Reduced the Damage Multiplier of Skill [Dragon Roar]:
Reduced the Damage Multiplier of the first stage of its attack from 0.57*8 to 0.5*8;
Reduced the Damage Multiplier of the second stage of its attack from 0.38*6 to 0.33*6;
Reduced the Damage Multiplier of the third stage of its attack from 0.75+1.51 to 0.67+1.33.

Ⅳ. Katana Souljades
Reduced the Damage Multiplier of Skill [Soul Slash] from 0.82*8 to 0.73*8;
Reduced the Damage Multiplier of Skill [Thunderstorm] from 0.81*5 to 0.68*5.

Ⅴ. Common Souljades
1) [Focus Slide] can no longer impose airborne effect on enemies falling down.
2) Under the stealth effect of [Phantom Step], no text indicators will be displayed.

In-game Adjustments
I. Controller Adjustments
1. Optimized the deadzone of the view while using joystick. Adjusted the default value to 16. Settings beyond this value will not be affected.
2. Optimized the experience of Ballista's [Aim] and [Shoot], which is now consistent with the operations of ranged weapons' [Aim with Scope] and [Shoot].
3. Optimized the interactive style of Training Ground Settings of the Free Training mode:
(1) Now players can open Training Ground Settings by tapping the map button instead of through the Radial Menu. (If you need to check the map of Training Ground, you can do it by opening the bag and switching the tab.)
(2) Now when Training Ground Settings is open, players can move and adjust the camera through two joysticks.
(3) Now when Training Ground Settings is open, players can toggle among options with the D-pads (up and down), and tap the round button (Xbox: A, PS: ×) to use. Original shortcut buttons were canceled.

Ⅱ. Combat Adjustments
Quick Counter: The character will no longer crouch after using Quick Counter while standing or dodging.

III. Mechanism Adjustments
1. Now Matari's ultimate will be affected within Forbidden Seals.
2. Reduced the number of Fireflies in the cave.

Out-game Adjustments
Ⅰ. Added in-game interaction of introduction to Narakapedia.
[Combat Items] and videos about all kinds of interactive events in the game were added to Narakapedia.

II. Hero Cultivation
Lowered the difficulty of Cultivation missions for all Heroes in the "Greater Understanding" phase.

Feature Optimization
Ⅰ. Client Optimization
1. Fixed the problem where players cannot select the spawn points or pick up items at the beginning of each match caused by slow resources loading in certain scenes.
2. Optimized the loading speed of characters' faces and hair in certain scenes.
3. Optimized the lagging caused by excessive loading of UI components in certain cases.
4. Optimized and reduced the loading data when launching the game for the first time, so that the game can start faster.
5. Due to the shader warmup's incompatibility with certain scenes, the feature will be turned off temporarily for further development and optimization. Meanwhile, we also optimized the loading strategy of the shader, which effectively reduced stuttering caused by loading.

Ⅱ. Matchmaking Optimization
Optimized the matchmaking rules. Now when players start a new mode or come back to a mode they haven't participated in for a long time, the system will estimate players' strength more accurately than before.

Ⅲ. Out-game Adjustments
Optimized the performance of the Stats Pentagon on the settlement page in solo mode. " Rescue" and "Fight" were removed, while "Kills" and "Damage" were added to align the Stats Pentagon more appropriately with the performance of solo players.

Ⅳ. In-game Adjustments
1. Added the Map Legend to the map page, which shows players the meaning of possible icons according to the current gameplay.
2. Now when players open the map in the preparation phase, they can control their characters' movement.

Setting Updates
Ⅰ. New volume adjustment feature for the out-game environment.
The "Ambience (Menus)" option was added to "Settings--Audio--All Sounds" to adjust the sound effect and volume in the Lobby.

Store Updates
I. Season Exclusive: Fortune Treasure
Fortune Treasure sells for 360 Gold. When opening it, you will have a chance to get Takeda Nobutada's Extreme outfit [Arm of Malevolence], Dual Blades Extreme skin [Phoenix Plume] and other rewards.
Minimum Guarantee
1. Players are guaranteed to receive at least 1 Red (Extreme) reward during the process of opening at most 100 Treasures. This can be triggered multiple times.​
2. Red (Extreme) rewards will not be repeated until all of them have been obtained.

Ⅱ. Store Overview
Added the “Store Overview” feature. You can now view and filter the products in the game through Store Overview now and purchase them in a more intuitive and convenient way.

Ⅲ. Discount Info
1.Added New Discounts
(1)Added the new Dual Blades Legendary skin [Peacebreaker]. Original price: 1,500 Gold; Now: 1,250 Gold.
(2)Added the new Takeda’s Legendary Accessory [Helm of Malevolence]. Original price: 1,200 Gold; Now: 1,000 Gold.
(3)Nunchucks Legendary skin [Tiger's Grace]. Original price: 1,500 Gold; Now: 1,000 Gold.
(4)Viper Ning’s Legendary outfit [Dragon Will·Awareness]. Original price: 2,400 Gold; Now: 1,700 Gold.
2.Discounts End
(1)Sunwing Relics Crossover – Tianhai’s Legendary Accessory [Longmen·Gargoyle Glow] has returned to its original price of 4,800 Gold.
(2)Sunwing Relics Crossover – Greatsword Legendary Skin [Longmen·Longmen Guardian] has returned to its original price of 1,500 Gold.
(3)Kurumi Legendary Accessory [Kitsune Ears] has returned to its original price of 1,200 Gold.
(4)Kurumi Legendary Accessory [Fox Tail] has returned to its original price of 900 Gold.
(5)Matari Legendary Pose [The Dragon·Void] has returned to its original price of 900 Gold.
(6)Viper Ning Legendary Pose [The Dragon·Side Kick] has returned to its original price of 900 Gold.

Ⅳ. Spectral Silk Store Updates
1.Added the new Takeda’s Legendary Accessory [Twilight Visage]: 12,000 Spectral Silk.
2.Added the new Fortune Treasure: 3,600 Spectral Silk (purchase limitation: 1 purchase per 24 hours, a maximum of 6 can be purchased in total).

Bug Fixes
I. Hero-related Bugs
1. Fixed an issue where characters failed to be teleported by Wuchen's ultimate when interrupted by death, counter, etc.
2. Fixed an issue where the time required to hold the ultimate button was not consistent with the time displayed on the interface when canceling the [Yin Yang Orb] by Wuchen’s ultimate [Tai Chi Rift].
3. Fixed an issue where the frozen effect of Justina Gu's ultimate worked abnormally on targets bound by Valda Cui's Tide Traps.
4. Fixed an issue where Kurumi cannot link allies or Light Parasol while using skills in some special cases.

notes.title: NARAKA: BLADEPOINT Update – June 1st , 2022
notes.content:
Dear players,
The servers of NARAKA: BLADEPOINT will be suspended for maintenance from 05/31/2022 23:00 (UTC) to 06/01/2022 03:00 (UTC). We suggest that you log out in advance and enter the game again after the maintenance.
The details for this update are as follows:
Brand-new content!
I. Time-limited Event [Longmen Sails]
Participate in the event to redeem [[Refulgence] Pack 40% discount voucher, Wuchen’s Legendary Accessory [Astrolabe], Matari’s Legendary Pose [Longmen·Divine Dance] and other rewards!
Event Time:
Round One: 06/01/2022 update – 06/08/2022 20:00 (UTC)
Round Two: 06/08/2022 20:00 (UTC) – 06/15/2022 20:00 (UTC)
Round Three: 06/15/2022 20:00 (UTC) – 06/22/2022 20:00 (UTC)
Event Rules:
1. At the start of each round, an advanced reward can be selected as the special reward for this round. This selection is irreversible.
2. Complete Daily Quests and Event Quests to get the corresponding number of Zongzi. Zongzi can be exchanged for various rewards of the corresponding round.
3. When a new round starts, a new advanced reward can be selected (obtained rewards excluded).
4. Show you care about cultural relics! Unlock the Longmen Grottoes collection and scan the QR code or tap the share button on the event page to show your care for the cultural heritage!

II. Map Updates
There's something off in the Sunwing's Rest recently. Check it out now!

Hero Adjustments
I. Justina Gu
1. Justina Gu no longer gains rage when ice fog is active after casting ultimate [Arctic Wraith·Frostwind].
//Dev Note: Justina Gu casts [Arctic Wraith·Frostwind] more frequently than expected during a long-lasting battle, so we have limited her rage gains within some time after casting the ultimate.
2. Adjusted the initial skill [Ice Core]. It no longer negates physical strikes during the startup frames (0-1s), but Justina Gu gains a 70% damage reduction. After the startup frames, Justina Gu's physical immunity will resume. Other features of [Ice Core], such as active interruption, focus, restoration, etc., have not been adjusted.
//Dev Note: [Ice Core] used to have restoration capability and 5-sec physical immunity—way too overwhelming than the other two skills. The long duration of immunity can leave the opponent in an awkward predicament. Therefore, we have shortened the duration and granted damage reduction to Justina Gu to improve the combat experience for both parties.

II. Yueshan
1. Slightly adjusted Yueshan's startup frames (increased from 0.7s to 1.1s) when casting the ultimate.
//Dev Note: Even with extremely low remaining HP after taking heavy damage, Yueshan may still cast the ultimate, perform the transformation, and fully restore HP, which can be quite frustrating for the opponent. Also, Yueshan's transformation startup frames are way shorter than Tianhai's. As a result, we have increased Yueshan's transformation startup frames by 0.4s.

III. Wuchen
1. Adjusted the Focus level during the charging stage from golden to blue for [Spirit Blades] and [Spirit Blades·Shield].
//Dev Note: The maximum charging time of Wuchen's skills is relatively long. With golden focus, Wuchen can gain a huge advantage. Therefore, we adjusted the focus level to clarify these skills' roles.
2. Reduced Wuchen and allies' damage reduction from 90% to 70% when Wuchen uses ultimate [Tai Chi Rift] to teleport allies.
3. Increased the required rage limit by 25% (to be the same as most heroes) for unleashing ultimates [Tai Chi Rift] and [Tai Chi Rift·Switch].
//Dev Note: After casting [Tai Chi Rift], Wuchen recovers its rage a bit too fast. Therefore, we have raised the rage limit to slightly slow down his ultimate’s pace.

IV. Tianhai
1. Adjusted the counter rage of [The Divine Bell: Counter] from 0-0.7s to 0-1s. In another word, Tianhai can now counter during the whole process of casting [The Divine Bell: Counter]. A successful counter can be immediately followed by a Counterstrike Combo.
2. Tianhai can now cancel the Divine Bell by dodging, jumping, or crouching within 0.4s after casting [The Divine Bell: Counter] and [The Divine Bell: Blast]. And the clash stagger time has been extended from 0.8s to 1.1s.
3. [The Divine Bell: Blast] can now knock away enemies that are using a golden focus (weapon moves).

V. Viper Ning
1. Ultimate [Twilight Crimson: Unchained]'s ending strike can no longer be negated by dodging.

VI. Takeda
1. Increased the range of the first hit after the grab in [Mythic Grab] and [Mythic Grab·Defend] slightly, and they can now interrupt enemies in blue Focus.
2. [Mythic Grab] and [Mythic Grab·Defend] are no longer interruptable by weapon moves while Wuchen is grabbing a blade. Also, Takeda can perform assault moves more conveniently now after a grab.
3. Increased the catch range of [Mythic Grab·Defend].
4. Optimized the aiming performance by adding an aiming window to [Demonic Aid: Teleport] to show the aiming lock-on area.
5. Increased [Demonic Aid: Teleport]'s maximum aiming distance from 20m to 25m. Improved its strike range.
6. [Demonic Aid: Teleport]'s damage resistance of ultimate Focus will last till the final slash. And it won't be interrupted by wind pressure.

VII. Other Adjustments
1. Adjusted the duration of all heroes' ultimate canceling (holding) to 0.25s.

Weapon Adjustments
Ⅰ. Adjusted Damage Multiplier in Unarmed Status:
Vertical strike 1st stage Damage Multiplier: adjusted from 2.79 to 1.13
Horizontal strike 1st stage Damage Multiplier: adjusted from 2.32 to 1.12
Airborne Vertical strike stage Damage Multiplier: adjusted from 2.58 to 1.88
Sprint Horizontal strike Damage Multiplier: adjusted from 2.54 to 1.10
Crouch Horizontal strike Damage Multiplier: adjusted from 2.81 to 1.56
Sprint Vertical strike Damage Multiplier: adjusted from 2.07 to 1.13

II. Longsword
Added the second-stage to the charged attack.

Ⅲ. Greatsword
Optimized the range of the slide horizontal strike.

IV. Dagger
1. Slightly reduced startup frames and increased strike range for charged horizontal strike [Uppercut Rush].
2. Canceled Dagger Dash golden focus. Adjusted the invincible duration of Dagger Dash to the same as the dodge while using other weapons.
//Dev Note: Since the time of the golden Focus and the invincibility time of the Dagger Dash completely overlap, the golden Focus is actually not needed during the invincibility period. After the golden Focus is removed, the information expression will be more accurate.
3. Dagger Dash can no longer pass through the Tide Traps generated by [Haze].

Souljade Adjustments
I. Dagger
Added the Dagger Skill [Pride's Fall]: Added the second-stage move to Daggers' charged horizontal strike. And the final hit can recover yourself (65% of the damage values)

II. Ranged
Added [Switch·Dazzle]: Switching to a ranged weapon while carrying out a melee attack unleashes a special move (Morus' Blessing weapons excluded). The drop of [Switch·Bow] and [Switch·Cannon] will be paused. Their effects have been merged into the new souljade [Switch·Dazzle].
III. Special Souljade
While being attacked by [Starfall], you can no longer use Grappling Hooks. And the special camera will no longer be triggered.

IV. Souljade Performance
Optimized the notification effects for the completion of charging for Katana technique [Soul Slash], Greatsword technique [Earthshaker], and Nunchucks technique [Dragon Roar].

Match Adjustments
I. Controller Adjustments
1. Optimized the target-switching and lock-on canceling mechanic when the controller is in the lock-on status.
1) When locking on a target, push the right stick to switch target immediately.
2) If the right stick is pushed toward where there are no targets, the lock-on status will remain unchanged. Press the lock-on button again to cancel the lock-on.
2. Optimized map cursor interactions.
1) Optimized the absorption performance when moving the map cursor.
2) Optimized the cursor performance when moved to the edge of the zoomed map.
3. Optimized the order of preset controller settings.
1) The [Default] controller preset will now be renamed to [Classic]. The button layout preset remains unchanged.
2) Previous preset order: [Default], [Shooter], [Warrior], [Swordsman], [Custom]. New order: [Warrior], [Classic], [Swordsman], [Warrior], [Custom]. (This change to the preset order won't change saved button layout presets.)

II. Environment Adjustments
Added a number of Fireflies to the hidden cave.

III. Mechanism Adjustments
Shortened the cooldown for the mechanism in Forbidden Seals from 180s to 90s.

IV. Omni's Nightmare
The Omni's Nightmare mode of Custom Room has been temporarily unavailable for the current version due to gameplay adjustments. See you next time!

V. Dynamically-opened Regions Adjustments
Expanded the dynamically-opened regions and increased the number of high-resource areas.

Out-Game Adjustments
I. Private Message Optimization
Added Private Message Notifications. When the player receives a private message from a friend, they will receive audio and text notifications, so as not to miss any message.

II. Hero Cultivation Adjustments
Adjusted Valda Cui's Cultivation quest "Pray to a statue in a Stash." to "Open the Stash by yourself 5 times. ".

III. Emote Optimization
The game now supports English, Japanese, and Korean lip sync.

IV. Team Display
Optimized the performance of some Poses.

V. Hall of Fame Settlement Page
Optimized the performance of Hall of Fame Settlement Page, so that it can now display the rewards of multiple Heroes.

Settings
I. Private Chat Notifications
1. Added [Private Message Notifications] to Settings - Social Settings - Chat. You can turn on and off the audio and text notifications when receiving a private message from a friend.

II. Shader Warmup
1. Added [Shader Warmup] to Options - Graphics Settings. Tap it to perform the shader warmup.

III. Added Melee Assist (Controller)
1. [Aim Assist + Camera Shift]: Automatically aims melee strikes toward the enemy, and moves the camera to face them when attacking.
2. [Aim Assist Only]: Automatically aims melee strikes toward the enemy, without moving the camera.
3. [Off]: Launch melee strikes in the direction faced.
4. [Aim Assist + Camera Shift] is selected by default. This can be changed or turned off via ESC - Settings - Game - Combat - Melee Aim Assist  (Controller).

IV. Counter - Composite Buttons
1. Added [Counter - Composite Buttons] Toggle to Settings - Game - Combat. You can turn on or turn off the Composite Buttons for Counter.

Feature Optimization
I. Shader Warmup
After the update, the shader warmup will perform automatically when entering the Lobby.
Shader rendition during the game may extend loading time, take up more CPU usage, and result in noticeable game stuttering within the first few matches after the update. Shader warmup technologies bring this process forward to the login stage, which can significantly reduce stuttering and improve the gaming experience. 
Notifications:
1. Warmup is performed only once after each update, which will bring better gaming experience.
2. Warmup will need to be performed again after changing the graphic card or updating the driver.
3. The game can still run even after terminating the warmup. Manual warmup can be performed via Settings - Graphics Settings - Shader Warmup.

II. Loading Assets
Optimized assets loading multi-threading scheduling to reduce game stuttering and increase FPS.

Store Updates
I. Added New Pack
1. Added Yueshan’s Exclusive pack [Refulgence], which contains Yueshan's Legendary outfit [Huaxia Armors·Righteousness], Legendary Accessory [Huaxia Armors·Restoration]. Original price: 3,000 Gold; Now: 2,100 Gold. (Participate in the Longmen Sails event and get [Refulgence] Pack 40% discount voucher to save more!)

notes.title: NARAKA: BLADEPOINT Update – May 21st , 2022
notes.content:
Dear players,
The servers of NARAKA: BLADEPOINT will be suspended for maintenance from 05/20/2022 23:00 (UTC) to 05/21/2022 03:00 (UTC). We suggest that you log out in advance and enter the game again after the maintenance.

The details for this update are as follows:

Brand-new content!
Ⅰ. New Hero: The Demon Vessel - Takeda Nobutada
Live a live free of desire, with no regrets left behind. Even if spurned by others and accused of injustice, we must still stand by our friends and never break their trust.
If faced with a dead end, raise your blade and cut out a new path!
Though my body may one day stumble and fall, never shall I forsake my honor!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36350327/1910149aedc5724eb11400645bceea5e0a008d6f.png[/img]
(The third F skill and V ultimate variants are not yet available in this version.)
II. Season Rewards
The Season 3 [Echelon] will come to an end on 05/21/2022 00:00 (UTC). In the meanwhile, the rank of this season will be settled. In the meanwhile, the new season [Ordeal] will be open. Players will be able to claim the rewards after the update of the new season.
1. Season rewards will be awarded based on highest rank gained in The Herald's Trial (Solo, Duos or Trios) during the Echelon season.
